teaching_sense.en_definition: To save small amounts over time, gradually building up a reserve.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过一段时间内的小额储蓄，逐渐积攒钱款或储备。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Faddal ammonti żgħar maż-żmien biex bil-mod il-mod jiġbor somma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逐渐积攒；一点点储蓄。

collocations.en: saved up a little money each week
gradually saved enough to buy a bicycle
collocations.zh: 逐渐攒够买自行车的钱

formal.mt: Matul is-sena, Pawlu rakkas parti żgħira mill-paga tiegħu biex iħallas għal kors.
formal.en: Over the year, Pawlu gradually saved a small part of his wages to pay for a course.
formal.zh: 这一年里，保罗从工资中一点点攒下一小部分，用来支付课程费用。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif ħallas Pawlu għar-rota? Lara: Rakkas ftit flus kull ġimgħa sakemm kellu biżżejjed.
colloquial.en: Marija: How did Pawlu pay for the bicycle? Lara: He saved up a little money each week until he had enough.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：保罗买自行车的钱是怎么来的？拉拉：他每周攒一点，直到攒够。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗买自行车的钱是怎么来的？
messages.en: How did Pawlu pay for the bicycle?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rakkas ftit flus kull ġimgħa sakemm kellu biżżejjed.
messages.mt_standard: Rakkas ftit flus kull ġimgħa sakemm kellu biżżejjed.
messages.zh: 他每周攒一点，直到攒够。
messages.en: He saved up a little money each week until he had enough.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象每周往储蓄罐放一枚硬币，用逐渐装满的画面记住“一点点积攒”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or narrative voice that tells a story or recounts events.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 讲述故事或叙述事件的人，也可指作品中承担叙事的声音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew vuċi f'xogħol letterarju li tirrakkonta storja jew ġrajjiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 叙述者；讲故事的人。

formal.mt: Ir-rakkontatur jiddeskrivi l-ġrajjiet mill-perspettiva ta' tifel żgħir.
formal.en: The narrator describes the events from the perspective of a young boy.
formal.zh: 叙述者从一个小男孩的视角描述这些事件。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex it-tfal iridu jisimgħu lin-nannu kull filgħaxija? Mark: Għax hu rakkontatur tajjeb u dejjem għandu storja ġdida.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why do the children want to listen to Grandpa every evening? Mark: Because he is a good storyteller and always has a new story.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：孩子们为什么每天晚上都想听爷爷讲话？马克：因为他很会讲故事，而且总有新故事。

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex it-tfal iridu jisimgħu lin-nannu kull filgħaxija?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex it-tfal iridu jisimgħu lin-nannu kull filgħaxija?
messages.zh: 孩子们为什么每天晚上都想听爷爷讲话？
messages.en: Why do the children want to listen to Grandpa every evening?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu rakkontatur tajjeb u dejjem għandu storja ġdida.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu rakkontatur tajjeb u dejjem għandu storja ġdida.
messages.zh: 因为他很会讲故事，而且总有新故事。
messages.en: Because he is a good storyteller and always has a new story.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上“有人坐在孩子面前讲故事”的画面，同时记住文学中的叙述者。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A rally: a motor competition in which drivers follow a set route, often with timed stages.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拉力赛：车手沿规定路线行驶、通常包含计时赛段的汽车比赛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kompetizzjoni tal-karozzi li fiha s-sewwieqa jsegwu rotta stabbilita, spiss b'taqsimiet imkejla bil-ħin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拉力赛，指沿规定路线进行的汽车赛事。

collocations.en: to take part in a rally

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti fir-rali għandhom isegwu r-rotta indikata mill-organizzaturi.
formal.en: Participants in the rally must follow the route indicated by the organizers.
formal.zh: 拉力赛参赛者必须沿组织者标明的路线行驶。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Se tmur tara r-rali nhar il-Ħadd? Rita: Iva, ħija se jieħu sehem b'karozza ħamra.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Are you going to watch the rally on Sunday? Rita: Yes, my brother is taking part in a red car.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：你星期天会去看拉力赛吗？丽塔：会，我哥哥要开一辆红色汽车参赛。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se tmur tara r-rali nhar il-Ħadd?
messages.mt_standard: Se tmur tara r-rali nhar il-Ħadd?
messages.zh: 你星期天会去看拉力赛吗？
messages.en: Are you going to watch the rally on Sunday?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħija se jieħu sehem b'karozza ħamra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħija se jieħu sehem b'karozza ħamra.
messages.zh: 会，我哥哥要开一辆红色汽车参赛。
messages.en: Yes, my brother is taking part in a red car.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把读音与中文“拉力”相联系，再想象赛车沿标好的路线逐段计时行驶。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Ramadan, the ninth month of the Islamic calendar, observed by Muslims as a month of fasting, prayer, and reflection.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 斋月，即伊斯兰历的第九个月，是穆斯林进行斋戒、祈祷与反思的月份。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-disa' xahar tal-kalendarju Iżlamiku, li l-Musulmani josservaw bħala xahar ta' sawm, talb u riflessjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 斋月；伊斯兰历第九个月。

formal.mt: Matul ir-Ramadan, ħafna Musulmani jsumu mis-sebħ sa nżul ix-xemx.
formal.en: During Ramadan, many Muslims fast from dawn until sunset.
formal.zh: 斋月期间，许多穆斯林从黎明到日落进行斋戒。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tixtieq tiekol magħna llum? Amir: Grazzi! Qed insum għar-Ramadan, imma nista' ningħaqad magħkom wara nżul ix-xemx.
colloquial.en: Sara: Would you like to eat with us today? Amir: Thank you! I am fasting for Ramadan, but I can join you after sunset.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你今天想和我们一起吃饭吗？阿米尔：谢谢！我正在守斋月的斋戒，不过日落后可以和你们一起吃。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天想和我们一起吃饭吗？
messages.en: Would you like to eat with us today?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi! Qed insum għar-Ramadan, imma nista' ningħaqad magħkom wara nżul ix-xemx.
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi! Qed insum għar-Ramadan, imma nista' ningħaqad magħkom wara nżul ix-xemx.
messages.zh: 谢谢！我正在守斋月的斋戒，不过日落后可以和你们一起吃。
messages.en: Thank you! I am fasting for Ramadan, but I can join you after sunset.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“黎明开始斋戒，日落后进食”的时间画面，把 Ramadan 与斋月联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Containing much sand or having a surface covered with sand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 含有较多沙子，或表面由沙子覆盖的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li fih ħafna ramel jew li għandu wiċċ miksi bir-ramel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沙质的；多沙的；覆有沙子的。

formal.mt: Il-bajja għandha qiegħ ramli, u l-ilma qrib ix-xatt huwa baxx.
formal.en: The bay has a sandy bottom, and the water near the shore is shallow.
formal.zh: 这个海湾的水底是沙质的，岸边水位较浅。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-qiegħ hawn ramli jew bil-blat? Toni: Ramli, imma oqgħod attent għal xi ġebel qrib ix-xatt.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is the bottom here sandy or rocky? Toni: Sandy, but watch out for some stones near the shore.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这里的水底是沙子还是岩石？托尼：是沙子，不过要留意岸边的一些石头。

messages.speaker: Lara (游泳同伴)
messages.zh: 这里的水底是沙子还是岩石？
messages.en: Is the bottom here sandy or rocky?

messages.speaker: Toni (游泳同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Ramli, imma oqgħod attent għal xi ġebel qrib ix-xatt.
messages.mt_standard: Ramli, imma oqgħod attent għal xi ġebel qrib ix-xatt.
messages.zh: 是沙子，不过要留意岸边的一些石头。
messages.en: Sandy, but watch out for some stones near the shore.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象脚下细沙松软的触感，把 ramli 记成描述地面或水底“多沙的”形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone to lose their spouse through death, leaving that person widowed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人因配偶死亡而成为鳏夫或寡妇，即使其丧偶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġiegħel lil xi ħadd jitlef lil żewġu jew lil martu bil-mewt u jibqa' armel jew armla.

sense_translations.en_definition: to deprive sb. of their spouse
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人失去配偶；使其丧偶。

collocations.zh: 那场事故使玛丽亚丧偶

collocations.en: the conflict left many people widowed
collocations.zh: 那场冲突使许多人丧偶

formal.mt: Il-kunflitt rammal ħafna nies u ħalla lil bosta familji mingħajr appoġġ.
formal.en: The conflict left many people widowed and many families without support.
formal.zh: 那场冲突使许多人丧偶，也使许多家庭失去了支撑。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'ġara lir-raġel ta' Marija? Pawlu: Miet f'inċident. Dak l-inċident rammal lil Marija meta kienet għadha żgħira.
colloquial.en: Rita: What happened to Marija's husband? Pawlu: He died in an accident. That accident left Marija widowed while she was still young.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：玛丽亚的丈夫怎么了？保罗：他在一场事故中去世了。那场事故使玛丽亚年纪轻轻就丧偶了。

messages.speaker: Rita (邻居)
messages.zh: 玛丽亚的丈夫怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to Marija's husband?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Miet f'inċident. Dak l-inċident rammal lil Marija meta kienet għadha żgħira.
messages.mt_standard: Miet f'inċident. Dak l-inċident rammal lil Marija meta kienet għadha żgħira.
messages.zh: 他在一场事故中去世了。那场事故使玛丽亚年纪轻轻就丧偶了。
messages.en: He died in an accident. That accident left Marija widowed while she was still young.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用句式“事故使某人丧偶”来记，重点抓住它表达外部原因使人失去配偶。

gloss_zh: 用钩钩住；用章鱼罐捕鱿鱼或章鱼

teaching_sense.en_definition: To hook something, especially a bucket for lowering into a well; also, to catch squid or octopus using an octopus pot.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用钩钩住物体，尤其指钩住准备放入井中的水桶；也指用章鱼罐捕捉鱿鱼或章鱼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Waħħal xi ħaġa b'ganċ, speċjalment barmil biex jitniżżel f'bir; ukoll, stad għall-klamari jew għall-qarnit b'qasrija tas-sajd.

sense_translations.en_definition: to hook (especially a bucket to be lowered into a well)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用钩钩住，尤其指钩住准备放入井中的水桶。

sense_translations.en_definition: to fish for squid or octopus using an octopus pot
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用章鱼罐捕捉鱿鱼或章鱼。

collocations.en: hooked the bucket onto the hook
fished for octopus using a pot

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem rampel il-barmil mal-ganċ qabel niżżlu fil-bir.
formal.en: The worker hooked the bucket onto the hook before lowering it into the well.
formal.zh: 工人先把水桶钩在钩子上，然后将它放入井中。

colloquial.mt: Anna: In-nannu kif qabad dak il-qarnit? Toni: Rampel b'qasrija tas-sajd. Il-qarnit daħal fiha.
colloquial.en: Anna: How did Grandpa catch that octopus? Toni: He used a fishing pot. The octopus went inside it.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：爷爷是怎么捉到那只章鱼的？托尼：他用了捕鱼罐，章鱼钻进了里面。

messages.speaker: Anna (孙女)
messages.zh: 爷爷是怎么捉到那只章鱼的？
messages.en: How did Grandpa catch that octopus?

messages.speaker: Toni (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: Rampel b'qasrija tas-sajd. Il-qarnit daħal fiha.
messages.mt_standard: Rampel b'qasrija tas-sajd. Il-qarnit daħal fiha.
messages.zh: 他用了捕鱼罐，章鱼钻进了里面。
messages.en: He used a fishing pot. The octopus went inside it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张独立画面记两个义项：井口钩住水桶，海底放罐捕章鱼；不要漏记捕鱼义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who retrieves things by catching them with a hook.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用钩钩住物品并将其捞出或取回的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tuża ganċ biex taqbad u ttella' oġġetti minn post li diffiċli tilħqu.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who fishes things out with a hook
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用钩将物品捞出或钩取出来的人。

collocations.en: a person retrieving things with a long hook
the person who retrieved the bucket with a hook

formal.mt: Ir-rampiel uża ganċ twil biex itella' l-barmil li kien waqa' fil-bir.
formal.en: The person retrieving things with a hook used a long hook to raise the bucket that had fallen into the well.
formal.zh: 那位用钩捞取物品的人用一把长钩，将掉进井里的水桶捞了上来。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min tella' l-barmil mill-bir? Ġużeppi: Ir-rampiel. Qabdu b'ganċ twil u tellgħu bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who got the bucket out of the well? Ġużeppi: The man who retrieves things with a hook. He caught it with a long hook and slowly pulled it up.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：谁把水桶从井里捞出来了？朱塞佩：那个用钩捞东西的人。他用长钩钩住水桶，慢慢拉了上来。

messages.speaker: Marija (邻居)
messages.zh: 谁把水桶从井里捞出来了？
messages.en: Who got the bucket out of the well?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-rampiel. Qabdu b'ganċ twil u tellgħu bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-rampiel. Qabdu b'ganċ twil u tellgħu bil-mod.
messages.zh: 那个用钩捞东西的人。他用长钩钩住水桶，慢慢拉了上来。
messages.en: The man who retrieves things with a hook. He caught it with a long hook and slowly pulled it up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象井边一个手持长钩、把掉落水桶捞上来的人，记住这个名词指执行捞取动作的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Reporting that presents an event or situation through factual description, observation and accounts from people involved.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过事实描述、现场观察及相关人物的叙述，呈现事件或实际情况的报道。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rapport ġurnalistiku li jippreżenta ġrajja jew sitwazzjoni permezz ta' fatti, osservazzjonijiet u rakkonti tan-nies involuti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以事实记录、现场观察和人物叙述为内容的纪实报道。

collocations.en: a reportage about life in the city
collocations.zh: 关于城市生活的纪实报道

formal.mt: Ir-raportaġ jippreżenta l-esperjenzi tar-residenti u jiddeskrivi l-bidliet li seħħew fil-lokal.
formal.en: The reportage presents residents' experiences and describes the changes that have taken place in the area.
formal.zh: 这篇纪实报道呈现了居民的经历，并描述了当地发生的变化。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt ir-raportaġ dwar is-suq il-ġdid? Mark: Iva, għoġobni għax tkellmu wkoll mal-bejjiegħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see the reportage about the new market? Mark: Yes, I liked it because they also spoke to the sellers.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看了那则关于新市场的纪实报道吗？马克：看了，我挺喜欢，因为他们也采访了摊贩。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看了那则关于新市场的纪实报道吗？
messages.en: Did you see the reportage about the new market?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għoġobni għax tkellmu wkoll mal-bejjiegħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għoġobni għax tkellmu wkoll mal-bejjiegħa.
messages.zh: 看了，我挺喜欢，因为他们也采访了摊贩。
messages.en: Yes, I liked it because they also spoke to the sellers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 raportaġ 联想成记者带着镜头走进现场：既记录事实，也让当事人开口讲述，帮助记住“纪实报道”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To force saliva or another substance out of the mouth by spitting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把唾液或其他物质从嘴里吐出来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħareġ bżieq jew xi ħaġa oħra minn ħalqu billi beżaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吐出唾液或嘴里的东西；吐唾沫。

formal.mt: Ix-xhud qal li r-raġel raq fl-art qabel telaq minn ħdejn il-bieb.
formal.en: The witness said that the man spat on the ground before leaving the doorway.
formal.zh: 目击者说，那名男子离开门口前朝地上吐了一口唾沫。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dak ir-raġel raq fl-art? Pawlu: Iva, eżatt ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did that man spit on the ground? Pawlu: Yes, right beside the door.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那个人刚才朝地上吐唾沫了吗？保罗：是啊，就在门边。

messages.speaker: Lara (路人)
messages.zh: 那个人刚才朝地上吐唾沫了吗？
messages.en: Did that man spit on the ground?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，就在门边。
messages.en: Yes, right beside the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读到短短的 raq，就想象嘴里的一口唾沫被迅速吐出去；用这个动作画面记住“吐唾沫”。

gloss_zh: 以法术或超自然方式治病

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cure someone, usually with the implication that magical or supernatural means are used.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 治愈某人，通常暗示采用法术或其他超自然手段。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fejjaq lil xi ħadd, ġeneralment bil-fehma li ntużaw mezzi maġiċi jew sopranaturali.

sense_translations.en_definition: to cure (usually implying magical or supernatural means)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 治愈，通常含有借助法术或超自然手段治病的意思。

collocations.en: cured the sick person, with an implication of supernatural means
collocations.zh: 以带有超自然意味的方式治好了病人

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, jingħad li x-xiħ raqa lill-marid permezz ta' kliem maġiku.
formal.en: In the story, the old man is said to have cured the sick person through magical words.
formal.zh: 故事中说，那位老人用咒语治好了病人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif fieq il-marid fl-istorja? Ninu: Skont ir-rakkont, ix-xiħ raqa lill-marid bil-kliem maġiku.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did the sick person recover in the story? Ninu: According to the tale, the old man cured the sick person through magical words.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：故事里的病人是怎么康复的？尼努：按故事的说法，老人用咒语治好了病人。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 故事里的病人是怎么康复的？
messages.en: How did the sick person recover in the story?

messages.speaker: Ninu (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Skont ir-rakkont, ix-xiħ raqa lill-marid bil-kliem maġiku.
messages.mt_standard: Skont ir-rakkont, ix-xiħ raqa lill-marid bil-kliem maġiku.
messages.zh: 按故事的说法，老人用咒语治好了病人。
messages.en: According to the tale, the old man cured the sick person through magical words.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 raqa 放进民间故事的画面：老人念出咒语，故事便说病人痊愈了；记住它通常带有超自然治病的意味。

gloss_zh: 精细装饰；巧妙润饰或处理

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something ornate through detailed decoration, or to refine or handle something with finesse.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过细致装饰使事物华美，或以细腻巧妙的手法润饰、处理事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żejjen xi ħaġa b'dettalji elaborati, jew irfina xi ħaġa u ħadem fuqha b'ħila u reqqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给某物添加精细或繁复的装饰，使其华美。
以细腻、巧妙而熟练的手法润饰或处理。

formal.mt: L-artiġjan raqam il-qafas b'dettalji żgħar li jagħtuh dehra aktar elaborata.
formal.en: The artisan embellished the frame with small details that give it a more ornate appearance.
formal.zh: 工匠用细小的装饰润饰了框架，使它显得更加华美。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-qafas kien sempliċi qabel? Mark: Iva, l-artiġjan raqam il-qafas b'ħafna dettalji żgħar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Was this frame plain before? Mark: Yes, the artisan made it ornate with lots of small details.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个框架以前很朴素吗？马克：是的，工匠加了许多细小的装饰，把它做得很精致。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个框架以前很朴素吗？
messages.en: Was this frame plain before?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, l-artiġjan raqam il-qafas b'ħafna dettalji żgħar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, l-artiġjan raqam il-qafas b'ħafna dettalji żgħar.
messages.zh: 是的，工匠加了许多细小的装饰，把它做得很精致。
messages.en: Yes, the artisan made it ornate with lots of small details.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象用细笔给普通相框添上花纹，再把同样的细致功夫用在措辞上；分别对应 raqam 的装饰和巧妙润饰两义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To walk with hesitant, interrupted steps or with a limp.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 走路不连贯、一步一顿，或一瘸一拐地行走。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mexa b'passi mhux regolari, b'waqfiet qosra jew b'zappip.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 步履不连贯地行走；一步一顿、走走停停。
跛行；一瘸一拐地走。

collocations.zh: 因疼痛而一瘸一拐地走

formal.mt: Wara li weġġa' siequ, ir-raġel raqas sal-bank u qagħad bilqiegħda.
formal.en: After hurting his foot, the man limped to the bench and sat down.
formal.zh: 那名男子伤了脚后，一瘸一拐地走到长椅旁坐下。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu raqas sal-karozza? Lara: Weġġa' siequ waqt il-logħba.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu limp to the car? Lara: He hurt his foot during the game.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么一瘸一拐地走向汽车？拉拉：他比赛时伤了脚。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么一瘸一拐地走向汽车？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu limp to the car?

messages.speaker: Lara (队友)
messages.zh: 他比赛时伤了脚。
messages.en: He hurt his foot during the game.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“一步、停一下、再一步”的节奏记 raqas：重点是步态不顺，可以表示蹒跚，也可以表示一瘸一拐。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The back of the neck, just below the back of the head.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 脖子的后部，位于后脑下方的颈背区域。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti ta' wara tal-għonq, eżatt taħt in-naħa ta' wara tar-ras.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 后颈；脖子后面、后脑下方的部位。

formal.mt: Fil-pittura, ix-xagħar miġbur juri r-raqba tal-mara b'mod ċar.
formal.en: In the painting, the woman's tied-up hair clearly reveals the nape of her neck.
formal.zh: 画中，女子束起的头发清楚地露出了她的后颈。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandi ftit trab fuq ir-raqba? Maja: Iva, eżatt taħt ix-xagħar. Ħa nneħħihulek.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have I got a little dust on the back of my neck? Maja: Yes, just below your hair. Let me get it off for you.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我后颈上是不是有点灰？玛雅：是的，就在头发下面。我帮你弄掉。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我后颈上是不是有点灰？
messages.en: Have I got a little dust on the back of my neck?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, eżatt taħt ix-xagħar. Ħa nneħħihulek.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, eżatt taħt ix-xagħar. Ħa nneħħihulek.
messages.zh: 是的，就在头发下面。我帮你弄掉。
messages.en: Yes, just below your hair. Let me get it off for you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 轻轻把手放在后脑下方、头发边缘下面的位置，那里就是 raqba；用身体定位记住“后颈”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become lighter in body weight; in another sense, to be unwilling or hesitant to do something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 体重减轻、变瘦；另一个义项表示不愿意或对做某事有所迟疑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Naqas fil-piż tal-ġisem; f'tifsira oħra, wera nuqqas ta' rieda jew eżitazzjoni biex jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 体重减轻；变瘦。
不情愿；不愿意做某事或对此有所迟疑。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-karattru prinċipali raqq ħafna matul il-vjaġġ twil.
formal.en: In the story, the main character lost a lot of weight during the long journey.
formal.zh: 故事中，主人公在漫长的旅途中瘦了很多。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fl-ewwel kapitlu, Pawlu kien diġà raqq? Lara: Iva, raqq ħafna matul il-vjaġġ.
colloquial.en: Mark: In the first chapter, had Pawlu already lost weight? Lara: Yes, he lost a lot of weight during the journey.
colloquial.zh: 马克：第一章里，保罗已经瘦下来了吗？拉拉：是的，他在旅途中瘦了很多。

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-ewwel kapitlu, Pawlu kien diġà raqq?
messages.mt_standard: Fl-ewwel kapitlu, Pawlu kien diġà raqq?
messages.zh: 第一章里，保罗已经瘦下来了吗？
messages.en: In the first chapter, had Pawlu already lost weight?

messages.speaker: Lara (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 是的，他在旅途中瘦了很多。
messages.en: Yes, he lost a lot of weight during the journey.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 raqq 做两张独立记忆卡：一张画体重秤数字下降，另一张画迟疑摇头的人；分别记“变瘦”和“不情愿”，按语境选择。

gloss_zh: 哄睡；使困倦；使厌倦；使动物安乐死

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone sleep or feel drowsy, including by boring them; when used of an animal, it can also mean to euthanise it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人入睡或感到困倦，也可指因乏味而使人厌倦；用于动物时，还可表示使其安乐死。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġiegħel lil xi ħadd jorqod jew iħoss in-ngħas, ukoll minħabba d-dwejjaq; meta jintuża dwar annimal, jista' jfisser ukoll li temmlu ħajtu bl-ewtanasja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使入睡；哄睡。
使感到困倦；引起睡意。
使厌倦；使人因乏味而昏昏欲睡。
使动物安乐死。

formal.mt: Wara li qara storja qasira, il-missier raqqad lit-tifel u ħareġ bil-kwiet mill-kamra.
formal.en: After reading a short story, the father put the boy to sleep and quietly left the room.
formal.zh: 父亲读完一个小故事，把男孩哄睡后，轻轻地走出了房间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min raqqad lit-tarbija llejla? Mark: Jien. Kantajt ftit u malajr raqdet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who put the baby to sleep tonight? Mark: I did. I sang a little and she soon fell asleep.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今晚是谁把宝宝哄睡的？马克：是我。我唱了一会儿，她很快就睡着了。

messages.speaker: Maja (母亲)
messages.zh: 今晚是谁把宝宝哄睡的？
messages.en: Who put the baby to sleep tonight?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Kantajt ftit u malajr raqdet.
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Kantajt ftit u malajr raqdet.
messages.zh: 是我。我唱了一会儿，她很快就睡着了。
messages.en: I did. I sang a little and she soon fell asleep.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用四幅情境记 raqqad：家长哄睡、听者犯困、观众厌倦、兽医为动物实施安乐死；尤其遇到动物宾语时，要结合上下文判断。

gloss_zh: 被迫跛行；因某种原因而一瘸一拐地走

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be caused to walk with a limp.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因受伤、疼痛等原因而被迫一瘸一拐地走路。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun imġiegħel jimxi b'diffikultà minħabba problema f'siequ jew f'riġlu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被迫跛行；由于某种原因而一瘸一拐地走。

collocations.en: was made to limp by an injury
was made to limp by pain in his foot

formal.mt: Wara l-waqgħa, Pawlu raqqas minħabba l-uġigħ f'siequ.
formal.en: After the fall, pain in his foot made Paul limp.
formal.zh: 跌倒后，保罗因脚痛而一瘸一拐地走路。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu raqqas fi triqtu lejn id-dar? Lara: Weġġa' siequ waqt il-logħba.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why was Paul made to limp on his way home? Lara: He hurt his foot during the game.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗回家时为什么一瘸一拐的？拉拉：他比赛时伤了脚。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu raqqas fi triqtu lejn id-dar?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu raqqas fi triqtu lejn id-dar?
messages.zh: 保罗回家时为什么一瘸一拐的？
messages.en: Why was Paul made to limp on his way home?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他比赛时伤了脚。
messages.en: He hurt his foot during the game.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象脚痛让人不得不一瘸一拐地走，把这个词与“受到影响而跛行”的画面联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not often; on very few occasions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某件事发生的频率很低，即很少或不常发生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mhux spiss; fi ftit okkażjonijiet biss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 很少；难得；不经常。

formal.mt: Il-librerija rarament tagħlaq qabel il-ħin imħabbar.
formal.en: The library rarely closes before the announced time.
formal.zh: 图书馆很少在公布的时间之前闭馆。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tmur spiss f'dak il-kafetterija? Mark: Le, rarament immur hemm. Normalment nagħmel il-kafè d-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you often go to that café? Mark: No, I rarely go there. I usually make coffee at home.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你经常去那家咖啡馆吗？马克：不，我很少去。我通常在家煮咖啡。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你经常去那家咖啡馆吗？
messages.en: Do you often go to that café?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, rarament immur hemm. Normalment nagħmel il-kafè d-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Le, rarament immur hemm. Normalment nagħmel il-kafè d-dar.
messages.zh: 不，我很少去。我通常在家煮咖啡。
messages.en: No, I rarely go there. I usually make coffee at home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个月的日历上只有一天画了圆圈，用稀疏的次数记住“很少发生”的频率。

gloss_zh: 直接对阵地；正面交锋地

teaching_sense.en_definition: In direct competition or confrontation with one another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指双方直接面对彼此展开竞争或较量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: F'kompetizzjoni jew f'konfront dirett ma' xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 直接对阵地；正面交锋地。

formal.mt: Fil-finali, iż-żewġ plejers se jikkompetu ras imb ras għat-titlu.
formal.en: In the final, the two players will compete head to head for the title.
formal.zh: 决赛中，两名选手将直接对阵，争夺冠军。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Se nilagħbu ras imb ras illum? Lara: Iva, logħba bejni u bejnek. Min jibda?
colloquial.en: Mark: Are we playing head to head today? Lara: Yes, a game between you and me. Who starts?
colloquial.zh: 马克：今天我们俩直接对阵吗？拉拉：对，就你和我比一场。谁先开始？

messages.speaker: Mark (棋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nilagħbu ras imb ras illum?
messages.mt_standard: Se nilagħbu ras imb ras illum?
messages.zh: 今天我们俩直接对阵吗？
messages.en: Are we playing head to head today?

messages.speaker: Lara (棋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, logħba bejni u bejnek. Min jibda?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, logħba bejni u bejnek. Min jibda?
messages.zh: 对，就你和我比一场。谁先开始？
messages.en: Yes, a game between you and me. Who starts?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两名选手面对面坐在棋盘两侧，把整个短语记成“双方直接交锋”的比赛画面。

gloss_zh: 圣灰星期三；四旬期首日

teaching_sense.en_definition: Ash Wednesday, the day that begins Lent in the Catholic liturgical calendar.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 圣灰星期三，即天主教礼仪年中四旬期开始的日子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-jum li fih jibda r-Randan fil-kalendarju liturġiku Kattoliku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 圣灰星期三；天主教四旬期开始的日子。

formal.mt: F'Ras ir-Randan, il-parroċċa se torganizza quddiesa bit-tqegħid tal-irmied.
formal.en: On Ash Wednesday, the parish will hold a Mass with the imposition of ashes.
formal.zh: 圣灰星期三当天，堂区将举行弥撒，并施行圣灰礼。

colloquial.mt: Maja: F'liema ħin hi l-quddiesa ta' Ras ir-Randan? Pawlu: Fis-sitta ta' filgħaxija. Nistgħu mmorru flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: What time is the Ash Wednesday Mass? Pawlu: At six in the evening. We can go together.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：圣灰星期三的弥撒是几点？保罗：晚上六点。我们可以一起去。

messages.speaker: Maja (堂区教友)
messages.mt_spoken: F'liema ħin hi l-quddiesa ta' Ras ir-Randan?
messages.mt_standard: F'liema ħin hi l-quddiesa ta' Ras ir-Randan?
messages.zh: 圣灰星期三的弥撒是几点？
messages.en: What time is the Ash Wednesday Mass?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (堂区教友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fis-sitta ta' filgħaxija. Nistgħu mmorru flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Fis-sitta ta' filgħaxija. Nistgħu mmorru flimkien.
messages.zh: 晚上六点。我们可以一起去。
messages.en: At six in the evening. We can go together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把日历上的四旬期起点与额头上的圣灰记号联系起来，整组记作“圣灰星期三”。

gloss_zh: 用力压；围聚在某物周围

teaching_sense.en_definition: To press something firmly, or to crowd around something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用较大的力按压某物；也可表示围聚在某物周围。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħfas xi ħaġa bis-saħħa, jew jinġabar ma' oħrajn madwar xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用力压；使劲按压。
围聚在某物周围；挤到某物旁边。

collocations.en: the people crowded around the table

formal.mt: It-tekniku rassas l-għatu biex jagħlaq il-kaxxa sew, waqt li n-nies rasssu madwar il-mejda biex jaraw ix-xogħol.
formal.en: The technician pressed the lid firmly to close the box securely, while people crowded around the table to watch the work.
formal.zh: 技术员用力按压盖子，把箱子关严；人们则围聚在桌子周围观看操作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark rassas l-għatu, imma l-kaxxa għadha miftuħa. Pawlu: Hemm biċċa karta taħtu. Neħħiha u erġa' pprova.
colloquial.en: Maja: Mark pressed the lid firmly, but the box is still open. Pawlu: There is a piece of paper underneath it. Remove it and try again.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克用力压了盖子，可箱子还是开着的。保罗：盖子下面夹着一张纸。拿掉后再试试。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark rassas l-għatu, imma l-kaxxa għadha miftuħa.
messages.mt_standard: Mark rassas l-għatu, imma l-kaxxa għadha miftuħa.
messages.zh: 马克用力压了盖子，可箱子还是开着的。
messages.en: Mark pressed the lid firmly, but the box is still open.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm biċċa karta taħtu. Neħħiha u erġa' pprova.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm biċċa karta taħtu. Neħħiha u erġa' pprova.
messages.zh: 盖子下面夹着一张纸。拿掉后再试试。
messages.en: There is a piece of paper underneath it. Remove it and try again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画分别记义：手掌用力压盖子，人群挤到桌子周围；这是记忆联想，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 把东西串起来；将蔬菜、鱼等串成串

teaching_sense.en_definition: To join separate items, such as vegetables or fish, into a string.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用绳线等把蔬菜、鱼或其他单件物品连接成一串。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħaqqad affarijiet, bħal ħaxix jew ħut, f'rasta permezz ta' ħajta jew spaga.

sense_translations.en_definition: to string things together (e.g. vegetables, fish etc)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把东西串在一起，例如将蔬菜、鱼等串成串。

collocations.en: strung the fish together with string

formal.mt: Il-bejjiegħ rassat il-ħaxix bi spaga u dendel ir-rasta mal-ħajt.
formal.en: The seller strung the vegetables together with string and hung the bunch on the wall.
formal.zh: 摊贩用绳子把蔬菜串起来，再把整串挂到墙上。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min rassat dan il-ħut? Mark: Pawlu. Uża spaga twila biex iżommu flimkien.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who strung these fish together? Mark: Pawlu did. He used a long piece of string to keep them together.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这些鱼是谁串起来的？马克：保罗串的。他用了一根长绳，把鱼连在一起。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 这些鱼是谁串起来的？
messages.en: Who strung these fish together?

messages.speaker: Mark (摊贩)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu. Uża spaga twila biex iżommu flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu. Uża spaga twila biex iżommu flimkien.
messages.zh: 保罗串的。他用了一根长绳，把鱼连在一起。
messages.en: Pawlu did. He used a long piece of string to keep them together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手里的一根长绳把散开的蔬菜或鱼连成一串，重点记住“串起来”这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A group of items joined together on a string or cord.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用线或绳连接在一起的一串物品，例如一串洋葱或鱼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għadd ta' affarijiet magħqudin flimkien b'ħajta jew bi spaga.

sense_translations.en_definition: a bunch of things strung together
sense_translations.zh_definition: 串在一起的一串东西；用绳线连成串的一组物品。

formal.mt: Il-bejjiegħ dendel rasta basal ħdejn il-bank tal-ħaxix.
formal.en: The seller hung a string of onions beside the vegetable stall.
formal.zh: 摊贩在蔬菜摊旁挂了一串洋葱。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm tiswa din ir-rasta basal? Mark: Tliet ewro għar-rasta kollha.
colloquial.en: Maja: How much is this string of onions? Mark: Three euros for the whole string.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这串洋葱多少钱？马克：整串三欧元。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这串洋葱多少钱？
messages.en: How much is this string of onions?

messages.speaker: Mark (摊贩)
messages.zh: 整串三欧元。
messages.en: Three euros for the whole string.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象厨房墙上挂着一整串洋葱，rasta 指已经串好的那一串，记住它是物品名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To join onions, fish, or similar items together in a string.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把洋葱、鱼等单件物品用绳线连接成串。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħaqqad basal, ħut jew affarijiet simili f'rasta b'ħajta jew bi spaga.

sense_translations.en_definition: to string onions, fish, etc. together
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把洋葱、鱼等串在一起；将这些物品连成串。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi rastat il-basal bi spaga u dendel ir-rasta f'post niexef.
formal.en: The farmer strung the onions together with string and hung the bunch in a dry place.
formal.zh: 农民用绳子把洋葱串起来，并把整串挂在干燥的地方。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min rastat il-basal li hemm fil-kċina? Pawlu: Missieri. Dendlu hemm dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who strung together the onions in the kitchen? Pawlu: My father did. He hung them there this morning.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：厨房里的洋葱是谁串起来的？保罗：我爸爸。他今天早上把它们挂在那里的。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min rastat il-basal li hemm fil-kċina?
messages.mt_standard: Min rastat il-basal li hemm fil-kċina?
messages.zh: 厨房里的洋葱是谁串起来的？
messages.en: Who strung together the onions in the kitchen?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我爸爸。他今天早上把它们挂在那里的。
messages.en: My father did. He hung them there this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把画面定格在双手正将洋葱逐个连成串的时刻，借这个动作记住“串在一起”的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An apostle: a person sent to proclaim a religious message.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使徒，受派遣去宣讲宗教信息的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Appostlu: persuna mibgħuta biex ixxandar messaġġ reliġjuż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使徒；与 appostlu 同义。

formal.mt: Fil-lezzjoni tar-reliġjon, l-istudenti ddiskutew il-missjoni ta' rasul.
formal.en: In the religion lesson, the students discussed the mission of an apostle.
formal.zh: 在宗教课上，学生们讨论了一位使徒的使命。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'rasul'? Mark: Tfisser appostlu, persuna mibgħuta biex ixxandar messaġġ reliġjuż.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the word 'rasul' mean? Mark: It means an apostle, a person sent to proclaim a religious message.
colloquial.zh: Maja：rasul 这个词是什么意思？Mark：意思是使徒，也就是受派遣去宣讲宗教信息的人。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: rasul 这个词是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word 'rasul' mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser appostlu, persuna mibgħuta biex ixxandar messaġġ reliġjuż.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser appostlu, persuna mibgħuta biex ixxandar messaġġ reliġjuż.
messages.zh: 意思是使徒，也就是受派遣去宣讲宗教信息的人。
messages.en: It means an apostle, a person sent to proclaim a religious message.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rasul 配上一幅使徒受派遣、向人群传讲的画面，用“传讲者这个人”记住它是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the apostles, their teaching, or their mission.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与使徒、使徒的教导或使命有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-appostli, mat-tagħlim tagħhom jew mal-missjoni tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使徒的；与使徒及其教导或使命有关的。

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina t-tagħlim rasuli u l-importanza tiegħu għall-komunità.
formal.en: The study examines apostolic teaching and its importance for the community.
formal.zh: 这项研究探讨使徒的教导及其对群体的重要性。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hawn miktub 'tagħlim rasuli'. Xi jfisser? Mark: Ifisser tagħlim marbut mal-appostli.
colloquial.en: Maja: It says 'apostolic teaching' here. What does that mean? Mark: It means teaching connected with the apostles.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这里写着“使徒的教导”。这是什么意思？Mark：就是与使徒有关的教导。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这里写着“使徒的教导”。这是什么意思？
messages.en: It says 'apostolic teaching' here. What does that mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 就是与使徒有关的教导。
messages.en: It means teaching connected with the apostles.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rasuli 放在 tagħlim“教导”旁边记：它说明教导具有使徒性质，是描述性质的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Dung: solid waste passed from an animal's body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 动物排出的固体废物，即动物粪便。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħmieġ solidu li joħroġ mill-ġisem ta' annimal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 动物粪便；粪。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema ġabru r-rawt mill-istalla u naddfu l-art.
formal.en: The workers collected the dung from the stable and cleaned the floor.
formal.zh: 工人们清走了畜舍里的粪便，并清洁了地面。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Attent, hemm ir-rawt ħdejn il-bieb! Pawlu: Rajtu. Se nġib il-pala biex inneħħih.
colloquial.en: Lara: Careful, there's dung beside the door! Pawlu: I saw it. I'll get the shovel to remove it.
colloquial.zh: Lara：小心，门旁边有粪便！Pawlu：我看到了。我去拿铲子把它清走。

messages.speaker: Lara (农场工人)
messages.zh: 小心，门旁边有粪便！
messages.en: Careful, there's dung beside the door!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农场工人)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtu. Se nġib il-pala biex inneħħih.
messages.mt_standard: Rajtu. Se nġib il-pala biex inneħħih.
messages.zh: 我看到了。我去拿铲子把它清走。
messages.en: I saw it. I'll get the shovel to remove it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“牛舍地上有一堆粪”的画面记 rawt，再连读 rawt tal-baqar“牛粪”，把词义和场景绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A piece or quantity of excrement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一块或一定量的粪便、排泄物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa jew kwantità ta' ħmieġ li joħroġ mill-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一块粪便。
一定量的排泄物；一团粪便。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem neħħa rawta minn fuq il-bankina u naddaf il-post.
formal.en: The worker removed a dropping from the pavement and cleaned the area.
formal.zh: 工人清除了人行道上的一团粪便，并清洁了该处。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Hemm rawta tal-kelb ħdejn is-siġra. Toni: Tajjeb li għedtli. Se niġborha b'borża.
colloquial.en: Sara: There's a dog dropping beside the tree. Toni: Thanks for telling me. I'll pick it up with a bag.
colloquial.zh: Sara：树旁边有一团狗粪。Toni：谢谢你告诉我。我用袋子把它捡起来。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.zh: 树旁边有一团狗粪。
messages.en: There's a dog dropping beside the tree.

messages.speaker: Toni (狗主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb li għedtli. Se niġborha b'borża.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb li għedtli. Se niġborha b'borża.
messages.zh: 谢谢你告诉我。我用袋子把它捡起来。
messages.en: Thanks for telling me. I'll pick it up with a bag.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rawta 想成需要用袋子捡起的“一团粪便”；练习时突出“一团”的量感，帮助记住这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To pass waste matter out of the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将身体产生的废物排出体外。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ l-iskart minn ġismu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 排泄；将身体产生的废物排出体外。

formal.mt: Skont in-noti tal-osservazzjoni, l-annimal rawwat ftit wara li kiel.
formal.en: According to the observation notes, the animal excreted shortly after eating.
formal.zh: 根据观察记录，这只动物在进食后不久排泄了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kelb rawwat fil-bitħa. Mark: Se nġib borża u nnaddaf il-post.
colloquial.en: Maja: The dog excreted in the yard. Mark: I'll get a bag and clean the area.
colloquial.zh: Maja：狗在院子里排泄了。Mark：我去拿个袋子，把那里清理干净。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.zh: 狗在院子里排泄了。
messages.en: The dog excreted in the yard.

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nġib borża u nnaddaf il-post.
messages.mt_standard: Se nġib borża u nnaddaf il-post.
messages.zh: 我去拿个袋子，把那里清理干净。
messages.en: I'll get a bag and clean the area.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 rawwat 时播放“动物排出废物”的动作画面，再背 il-kelb rawwat，把它记作动作动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of scraping a surface, often to remove material from it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 刮擦表面，常用于去除表面材料的动作或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li jinbarax wiċċ, spiss biex jitneħħa materjal minn fuqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刮擦或刮除的动作。

formal.mt: Ir-raxkar taż-żebgħa l-qadima għandu jsir b'attenzjoni biex il-wiċċ ma jiġix imħassar.
formal.en: Scraping off the old paint should be done carefully so that the surface is not damaged.
formal.zh: 刮除旧油漆时应小心操作，以免损坏表面。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għadek taħdem fuq dak il-bieb? Pawlu: Iva, ir-raxkar taż-żebgħa qed jieħu ħafna ħin.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are you still working on that door? Pawlu: Yes, scraping off the paint is taking a long time.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你还在处理那扇门吗？Pawlu：是啊，刮除油漆很费时间。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 你还在处理那扇门吗？
messages.en: Are you still working on that door?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (维修工)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ir-raxkar taż-żebgħa qed jieħu ħafna ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ir-raxkar taż-żebgħa qed jieħu ħafna ħin.
messages.zh: 是啊，刮除油漆很费时间。
messages.en: Yes, scraping off the paint is taking a long time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 raxkar 配上刮刀反复刮旧漆的画面；这个名词指“刮擦这件事”，可用“刮漆过程”来记忆。

gloss_zh: 石料刮修工；修整石材的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who scrapes or dresses stone to prepare its surface or shape.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过刮削或修整来处理石材表面或形状的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tobrox jew tirfina l-ġebel biex tħejji l-wiċċ jew il-forma tiegħu.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who scrapes or dresses stone
sense_translations.zh_definition: 刮削或修整石料的人；石料刮修工。

formal.mt: Ir-raxkettur irfina l-wiċċ tal-ġebla qabel ma tqiegħdet f'postha.
formal.en: The stone dresser finished the surface of the stone before it was put in place.
formal.zh: 石料修整工在石块安装就位前修整了它的表面。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'jagħmel raxkettur? Toni: Iħejji u jirfina l-ġebel, bħal dak li qed tara fuq il-bank tax-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does a stone dresser do? Toni: He prepares and finishes stone, like the stone you can see on the workbench.
colloquial.zh: Sara：石料修整工做什么工作？Toni：他加工和修整石材，就像你在工作台上看到的那块石头。

messages.speaker: Sara (学徒)
messages.zh: 石料修整工做什么工作？
messages.en: What does a stone dresser do?

messages.speaker: Toni (师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Iħejji u jirfina l-ġebel, bħal dak li qed tara fuq il-bank tax-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Iħejji u jirfina l-ġebel, bħal dak li qed tara fuq il-bank tax-xogħol.
messages.zh: 他加工和修整石材，就像你在工作台上看到的那块石头。
messages.en: He prepares and finishes stone, like the stone you can see on the workbench.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 raxkettur 画一张职业卡：一位工人正在刮修石块。把整词与“修整石材的人”绑定记忆。

gloss_zh: 种族主义的；带有种族歧视的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Expressing or involving prejudice or discrimination against people because of their race.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因他人的种族而表现出偏见或歧视的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jesprimi jew jinvolvi preġudizzju jew diskriminazzjoni kontra nies minħabba r-razza tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 种族主义的；具有种族偏见或种族歧视的。

formal.mt: Ir-regolament tal-iskola jipprojbixxi kull aġir razzist u jitlob rispett lejn kull student.
formal.en: The school rules prohibit all racist behaviour and require respect for every student.
formal.zh: 校规禁止一切种族歧视行为，并要求尊重每一位学生。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak il-kumment kien razzist. Mark: Għandek raġun. Se nitkellem mal-għalliem dwaru.
colloquial.en: Maja: That comment was racist. Mark: You're right. I'll speak to the teacher about it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那句话带有种族歧视。Mark：你说得对。我会跟老师谈谈这件事。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 那句话带有种族歧视。
messages.en: That comment was racist.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun. Se nitkellem mal-għalliem dwaru.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun. Se nitkellem mal-għalliem dwaru.
messages.zh: 你说得对。我会跟老师谈谈这件事。
messages.en: You're right. I'll speak to the teacher about it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 razzist 和 kumment“评论”一起记成“带有种族歧视的评论”，用它描述言论的性质，记牢形容词用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Money or prizes won in a game, competition, or similar activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在游戏、比赛等活动中赢得的钱款或奖品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Flus jew premjijiet li jintrebħu f'logħba, kompetizzjoni jew attività simili.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 赢得的钱款或奖品；奖金。

formal.mt: It-tim iddeċieda li jagħti r-rbieħ tal-kompetizzjoni lil għaqda tal-karità.
formal.en: The team decided to donate the winnings from the competition to a charity.
formal.zh: 团队决定把比赛赢得的奖金捐给一家慈善机构。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'se tagħmel bir-rbieħ? Pawlu: Se naqsam ir-rbieħ ma' ħija.
colloquial.en: Marija: What will you do with the winnings? Pawlu: I'll share the winnings with my brother.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你打算怎么用赢来的钱？保罗：我会和哥哥分享这笔钱。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你打算怎么用赢来的钱？
messages.en: What will you do with the winnings?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我会和哥哥分享这笔钱。
messages.en: I'll share the winnings with my brother.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rbieħ 放进领奖后分钱的画面里，记住它指赢到手的钱或奖品。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of tying or fastening something; also a commitment or duty toward something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西系住或绑牢的行为；也指对某事承担的承诺或义务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li torbot xi ħaġa; ukoll impenn jew dmir lejn xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 系住、捆绑或绑牢的行为。
对某事的承诺、责任或义务。

formal.mt: Il-parteċipazzjoni f'dan il-proġett tinvolvi rbit lejn l-għanijiet u l-iskadenzi tiegħu.
formal.en: Participation in this project involves a commitment to its goals and deadlines.
formal.zh: 参与这个项目意味着要对其目标和期限作出承诺。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ir-rbit ta' dan il-pakkett tajjeb? Mark: Iva, il-ħabel hu ssikkat u l-pakkett ma jinfetaħx.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this package tied properly? Mark: Yes, the rope is tight and the package won't come open.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个包裹绑得好吗？马克：好，绳子很紧，包裹不会散开。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 这个包裹绑得好吗？
messages.en: Is this package tied properly?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-ħabel hu ssikkat u l-pakkett ma jinfetaħx.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-ħabel hu ssikkat u l-pakkett ma jinfetaħx.
messages.zh: 好，绳子很紧，包裹不会散开。
messages.en: Yes, the rope is tight and the package won't come open.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅图记 rbit：绳子绑住包裹，承诺牵住责任；这是帮助区分义项的联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sound strongly through a space or to be heard again as an echo.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 声音在空间中响亮地传播，或以回声的形式再次被听见。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinstema' b'qawwa fi spazju jew jerġa' jinstema' bħala eku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 响彻；回响；产生回声。

formal.mt: Il-ħoss tal-qanpiena rbombja fil-bitħa u nstema' minn kull rokna.
formal.en: The sound of the bell resounded through the courtyard and was heard in every corner.
formal.zh: 钟声在庭院中回荡，每个角落都能听见。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Smajt kif rbombja leħnek fil-mina? David: Iva, qisu xi ħadd wieġeb minn ġewwa!
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you hear how your voice echoed in the tunnel? David: Yes, it sounded as if someone answered from inside!
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你听见自己的声音怎么在隧道里回响了吗？戴维：听见了，像是里面有人回答了一样！

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听见自己的声音怎么在隧道里回响了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear how your voice echoed in the tunnel?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qisu xi ħadd wieġeb minn ġewwa!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qisu xi ħadd wieġeb minn ġewwa!
messages.zh: 听见了，像是里面有人回答了一样！
messages.en: Yes, it sounded as if someone answered from inside!

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 rbombja 时想象在隧道喊一声，声音又传回来，把动作和回声画面连在一起。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A low, deep rumbling sound, such as the sound of distant thunder or an engine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 低沉的隆隆声，例如远处的雷声或发动机声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħoss baxx u fond, bħal dak tar-ragħad fil-bogħod jew ta' magna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 低沉的隆隆声；轰隆声。

formal.mt: Ir-rbumbjatura tar-ragħad instemgħet fil-bogħod ftit qabel bdiet ix-xita.
formal.en: The rumble of thunder was heard in the distance shortly before the rain began.
formal.zh: 下雨前不久，远处传来了低沉的雷声。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Qed tisma' dik ir-rbumbjatura? Toni: Iva, ġejja mill-magna tat-trakk barra.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can you hear that rumble? Toni: Yes, it's coming from the engine of the truck outside.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你听见那阵隆隆声了吗？托尼：听见了，是外面卡车的发动机发出的。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 你听见那阵隆隆声了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear that rumble?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.zh: 听见了，是外面卡车的发动机发出的。
messages.en: Yes, it's coming from the engine of the truck outside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rbumbjatura 配上远雷或卡车低沉的隆隆声，重点记住这是声音的名词。

gloss_zh: 吮吸；法式接吻；口交（以口刺激阴茎）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of sucking with the mouth, for example when a baby takes in milk.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用嘴吮吸的行为，例如婴儿吸吮乳汁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jiġbed b'ħalqu, pereżempju meta tarbija tixrob il-ħalib.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吮吸；用嘴吸取的行为。
法式接吻；伴有舌头接触的亲吻。
以口刺激阴茎的性行为；此类口交。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, l-infermiera nnutat li r-rdigħ tat-tarbija kien regolari.
formal.en: During the observation, the nurse noted that the baby's sucking was regular.
formal.zh: 观察期间，护士注意到婴儿的吮吸很有规律。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Ir-rdigħ tagħha jidher regolari llum. Pawlu: Iva, qed tixrob il-ħalib bil-kalma.
colloquial.en: Marija: Her sucking seems regular today. Pawlu: Yes, she's drinking her milk calmly.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：她今天吸奶似乎很有规律。保罗：是啊，她正在安静地喝奶。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 她今天吸奶似乎很有规律。
messages.en: Her sucking seems regular today.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.zh: 是啊，她正在安静地喝奶。
messages.en: Yes, she's drinking her milk calmly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用婴儿吸奶的画面记 rdigħ 的吮吸义；另把接吻和口交义分开记，依语境判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To double something again or greatly increase its strength, amount, or intensity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某事物再次加倍，或大幅增加其力度、数量或强度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jirdoppja xi ħaġa mill-ġdid jew iżid ħafna l-qawwa, il-kwantità jew l-intensità tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 再次加倍；使倍增；进一步加强。

formal.mt: It-tim rdobbla l-isforzi tiegħu biex il-proġett jitlesta fil-ħin.
formal.en: The team redoubled its efforts to complete the project on time.
formal.zh: 团队加倍努力，以便按时完成项目。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif irnexxielu jgħaddi mill-eżami? Mark: Rdobbla l-isforzi tiegħu u studja kuljum.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did he manage to pass the exam? Mark: He redoubled his efforts and studied every day.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：他是怎么通过考试的？马克：他加倍努力，每天都学习。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 他是怎么通过考试的？
messages.en: How did he manage to pass the exam?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Rdobbla l-isforzi tiegħu u studja kuljum.
messages.mt_standard: Rdobbla l-isforzi tiegħu u studja kuljum.
messages.zh: 他加倍努力，每天都学习。
messages.en: He redoubled his efforts and studied every day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rdobbla 和学习时再加一把劲的画面绑定，记住它表示加倍或进一步加强。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cut material using a leatherworking knife.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用皮革加工用的裁刀切割材料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaqta' materjal b'sikkina li tintuża għax-xogħol tal-ġilda.

sense_translations.en_definition: to cut with a leather knife
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用皮革加工用的裁刀切割。

collocations.en: cut the leather with a leatherworking knife
trimmed the edges with a leatherworking knife

formal.mt: L-artiġjan rdonja l-ġilda skont il-kejl indikat fid-disinn.
formal.en: The craftsperson cut the leather with a leatherworking knife according to the measurements shown in the design.
formal.zh: 工匠按照设计图标明的尺寸，用皮革裁刀切割了皮革。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min rdonja din il-biċċa ġilda? Ġużeppi: L-imgħallem; imbagħad jien ħejjejt it-toqob għall-ħjata.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who cut this piece of leather with the leatherworking knife? Ġużeppi: The master craftsperson; then I prepared the holes for stitching.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：谁用皮革裁刀裁了这块皮革？朱塞佩：师傅裁的；然后我打好了缝线用的孔。

messages.speaker: Anna (学徒)
messages.zh: 谁用皮革裁刀裁了这块皮革？
messages.en: Who cut this piece of leather with the leatherworking knife?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (工坊同事)
messages.mt_spoken: L-imgħallem; imbagħad jien ħejjejt it-toqob għall-ħjata.
messages.mt_standard: L-imgħallem; imbagħad jien ħejjejt it-toqob għall-ħjata.
messages.zh: 师傅裁的；然后我打好了缝线用的孔。
messages.en: The master craftsperson; then I prepared the holes for stitching.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象皮具工匠沿线落刀，把 rdonja 记成带有皮革裁刀这一工具信息的切割动作。

gloss_zh: 在现有墙旁加砌第二道墙

teaching_sense.en_definition: The construction of a second wall beside an existing wall.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在已有墙体旁边再建一道墙的施工行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-bini ta' ħajt ieħor maġenb ħajt li diġà jeżisti.

sense_translations.en_definition: building a second wall besides an existing one
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在现有墙旁边加建第二道墙。

collocations.en: the construction of a second wall beside the existing wall
collocations.zh: 在现有墙旁加砌一道墙

collocations.en: work to build a second wall beside an existing one

formal.mt: Il-pjan jipprevedi r-rdubblatura ta' dan il-ħajt billi jinbena ħajt ieħor maġenbu.
formal.en: The plan provides for the construction of a second wall beside this existing wall.
formal.zh: 该方案计划在这道现有墙旁边再建一道墙。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'inhi r-rdubblatura li semmejt? Mario: Nibnu ħajt ieħor maġenb il-ħajt li hemm diġà.
colloquial.en: Rita: What is the wall-doubling work you mentioned? Mario: We build another wall beside the wall that is already there.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你说的加砌第二道墙是怎么回事？马里奥：就是在已有的墙旁边再建一道墙。

messages.speaker: Rita (屋主)
messages.zh: 你说的加砌第二道墙是怎么回事？
messages.en: What is the wall-doubling work you mentioned?

messages.speaker: Mario (泥瓦匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Nibnu ħajt ieħor maġenb il-ħajt li hemm diġà.
messages.mt_standard: Nibnu ħajt ieħor maġenb il-ħajt li hemm diġà.
messages.zh: 就是在已有的墙旁边再建一道墙。
messages.en: We build another wall beside the wall that is already there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两道并排的墙，先画已有的一道，再添第二道，用这个施工顺序记 rdubblatura。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act that breaks criminal law and can lead to prosecution and punishment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 违反刑事法律、可能受到起诉和处罚的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Att li jikser il-liġi kriminali u li jista' jwassal għal proċeduri fil-qorti u għal piena.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 犯罪；违反刑事法律的罪行。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi r-reat u jippreżenta l-provi miġbura mill-pulizija.
formal.en: The report describes the criminal offence and presents the evidence collected by the police.
formal.zh: 报告描述了该刑事罪行，并列出了警方收集的证据。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Jekk xi ħadd jisraq rota, ikun wettaq reat? Mark: Iva, is-serq huwa reat.
colloquial.en: Maja: If someone steals a bicycle, have they committed a crime? Mark: Yes, theft is a criminal offence.
colloquial.zh: Maja：如果有人偷了一辆自行车，算是犯罪了吗？Mark：是的，盗窃属于刑事罪行。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Jekk xi ħadd jisraq rota, ikun wettaq reat?
messages.mt_standard: Jekk xi ħadd jisraq rota, ikun wettaq reat?
messages.zh: 如果有人偷了一辆自行车，算是犯罪了吗？
messages.en: If someone steals a bicycle, have they committed a crime?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.zh: 是的，盗窃属于刑事罪行。
messages.en: Yes, theft is a criminal offence.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 reat 放进“警方记录一宗罪行”的画面中记忆，搭配 iwettaq reat 一起背，表示“实施犯罪”。

gloss_zh: 钻孔；在木材或石材上打洞

teaching_sense.en_definition: To use a drilling tool to make a hole, especially in wood or stone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用钻孔工具打出孔洞，尤指在木材或石材上钻孔。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel toqba b'għodda għat-tħaffir, speċjalment fl-injam jew fil-ġebel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钻孔；使用钻孔工具进行钻削。

sense_translations.en_definition: to make a hole in wood or stone
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在木材或石材上打洞、钻孔。

formal.mt: Il-mastrudaxxa rebbek l-injam fil-punti mmarkati qabel waħħal il-viti.
formal.en: The carpenter drilled the wood at the marked points before inserting the screws.
formal.zh: 木匠先在木材上标记的位置钻孔，然后装入螺丝。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex rebbek l-injam hawn? Mark: Biex nagħmel toqba għall-vit.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you drill the wood here? Mark: To make a hole for the screw.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么在木头这里钻孔？Mark：为了给螺丝打一个孔。

messages.speaker: Maja (学徒)
messages.zh: 你为什么在木头这里钻孔？
messages.en: Why did you drill the wood here?

messages.speaker: Mark (木匠)
messages.zh: 为了给螺丝打一个孔。
messages.en: To make a hole for the screw.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 rebbek 时想象钻头旋转、木板出现小孔的连续动作；重点记住它表示“钻孔”这个动作。

gloss_zh: 春季的；具有春天气息的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to spring or having the fresh, mild qualities associated with spring.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与春季有关的，或具有春天清新、温和特点的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mar-rebbiegħa jew mal-karatteristiċi tagħha, bħall-freskezza u t-temp ħafif.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 春季的；春天般的；具有春天气息的。

formal.mt: Il-pittur juża kuluri ċari biex juri pajsaġġ rebbiegħi mimli fjuri.
formal.en: The painter uses light colours to depict a spring landscape full of flowers.
formal.zh: 画家用明亮的色彩描绘了一幅繁花盛开的春日景色。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm hu sabiħ dan it-temp rebbiegħi! Mark: Iva, ejja mmorru nimxu fil-kampanja.
colloquial.en: Maja: This springlike weather is so lovely! Mark: Yes, let's go for a walk in the countryside.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这春天般的天气真好！Mark：是啊，我们去乡间散步吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu sabiħ dan it-temp rebbiegħi!
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu sabiħ dan it-temp rebbiegħi!
messages.zh: 这春天般的天气真好！
messages.en: This springlike weather is so lovely!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，我们去乡间散步吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's go for a walk in the countryside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rebbiegħi 和鲜花、嫩叶、温和天气放在同一幅春景中记忆；特别留意中间的 għ，避免与表示胜利的 rebbieħi 混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having won a contest, competition, or struggle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在比赛、竞争或斗争中取得了胜利的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun kiseb rebħa f'logħba, f'kompetizzjoni jew f'taqbida.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 获胜的；取得胜利的。

formal.mt: It-tim rebbieħi rċieva t-trofew fi tmiem il-kompetizzjoni.
formal.en: The victorious team received the trophy at the end of the competition.
formal.zh: 获胜的队伍在比赛结束时领取了奖杯。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema hu t-tim rebbieħi? Mark: Dak bil-flokk blu; rebaħ tnejn b'wieħed.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which is the victorious team? Mark: The one in blue shirts; they won two to one.
colloquial.zh: Maja：哪支队伍获胜了？Mark：穿蓝色球衣的那支；他们以二比一获胜。

messages.speaker: Maja (观众)
messages.zh: 哪支队伍获胜了？
messages.en: Which is the victorious team?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak bil-flokk blu; rebaħ tnejn b'wieħed.
messages.mt_standard: Dak bil-flokk blu; rebaħ tnejn b'wieħed.
messages.zh: 穿蓝色球衣的那支；他们以二比一获胜。
messages.en: The one in blue shirts; they won two to one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“举起奖杯的队伍”记 rebbieħi，表示队伍已经获胜；看清词中的 ħ，并与春季形容词 rebbiegħi 分开记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cutting part fitted to a drill that rotates to make a hole in a material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 安装在钻孔工具上、通过旋转切削材料形成孔洞的部件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-biċċa li titwaħħal ma' għodda għat-tħaffir u ddur biex taqta' l-materjal u tagħmel toqba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钻头；安装在钻孔工具上、用于旋转切削并打孔的部件。

formal.mt: Qabel jibda x-xogħol, il-ħaddiem jagħżel rebekkin adattat għall-materjal u għad-daqs tat-toqba.
formal.en: Before starting work, the worker selects a drill bit suited to the material and the size of the hole.
formal.zh: 开始工作前，工人会选择适合材料和孔洞尺寸的钻头。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema rebekkin għandi nuża għal din il-biċċa njam? Mark: Uża dan; huwa għall-injam u jagħmel toqba żgħira.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which drill bit should I use for this piece of wood? Mark: Use this one; it is for wood and makes a small hole.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这块木头该用哪个钻头？Mark：用这个；它是木工钻头，能钻出小孔。

messages.speaker: Maja (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema rebekkin għandi nuża għal din il-biċċa njam?
messages.mt_standard: Liema rebekkin għandi nuża għal din il-biċċa njam?
messages.zh: 这块木头该用哪个钻头？
messages.en: Which drill bit should I use for this piece of wood?

messages.speaker: Mark (木匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Uża dan; huwa għall-injam u jagħmel toqba żgħira.
messages.mt_standard: Uża dan; huwa għall-injam u jagħmel toqba żgħira.
messages.zh: 用这个；它是木工钻头，能钻出小孔。
messages.en: Use this one; it is for wood and makes a small hole.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rebekkin 记成手里可以更换的那一根钻头：rebbek 记动作“钻孔”，rebekkin 记具体部件“钻头”。

gloss_zh: 杂乱；乱七八糟的一堆东西

teaching_sense.en_definition: An untidy collection of things or a state of disorder in a place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物品乱放形成的杂乱堆积，或某个地方凌乱无序的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġabra ta' affarijiet imħallta u mqiegħda bla ordni, jew stat ta' diżordni f'post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 杂乱；凌乱状态；乱七八糟堆放的东西。

formal.mt: Qabel il-laqgħa, il-persunal neħħa r-rebus minn fuq il-mejda u qiegħed id-dokumenti f'ordni.
formal.en: Before the meeting, the staff cleared the clutter from the table and put the documents in order.
formal.zh: 会议开始前，工作人员清理了桌上的杂乱物品，并把文件整理好。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dan ir-rebus fuq il-mejda? Mark: Karti u kotba tal-istudju; issa nqegħedhom f'posthom.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is all this clutter on the table? Mark: Study papers and books; I'll put them away now.
colloquial.zh: Maja：桌上这乱七八糟的一堆是什么？Mark：学习用的纸张和书；我这就把它们收好。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 桌上这乱七八糟的一堆是什么？
messages.en: What is all this clutter on the table?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Karti u kotba tal-istudju; issa nqegħedhom f'posthom.
messages.mt_standard: Karti u kotba tal-istudju; issa nqegħedhom f'posthom.
messages.zh: 学习用的纸张和书；我这就把它们收好。
messages.en: Study papers and books; I'll put them away now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象桌上纸张、书本和杂物混在一起的画面来记 rebus；配着 rebus fuq il-mejda 背，就是“桌上的一片杂乱”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of winning or the successful result of a contest or struggle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 赢得比赛或斗争这一行为，或由此取得的胜利结果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tirbaħ jew ir-riżultat ta' suċċess f'kompetizzjoni jew f'taqbida.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 获胜；赢得比赛或竞争这一行为或过程。
胜利；在比赛、竞争或斗争中取得的成功结果。

formal.mt: Ir-rebħ tal-kampjonat kien ir-riżultat ta' taħriġ regolari u ħidma f'tim.
formal.en: Winning the championship was the result of regular training and teamwork.
formal.zh: 赢得锦标赛冠军是坚持训练和团队合作的结果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'kien l-aħjar mument tal-istaġun? Mark: Ir-rebħ tat-tazza; għadni niftakar iċ-ċelebrazzjoni!
colloquial.en: Maja: What was the best moment of the season? Mark: Winning the cup; I still remember the celebration!
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个赛季最精彩的时刻是什么？Mark：夺冠的时候；我至今还记得那场庆祝！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个赛季最精彩的时刻是什么？
messages.en: What was the best moment of the season?

messages.speaker: Mark (球员)
messages.zh: 夺冠的时候；我至今还记得那场庆祝！
messages.en: Winning the cup; I still remember the celebration!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rebħ 放在记分牌定格的一刻：既可着眼“赢得比赛”这件事，也可着眼“胜利”这个结果；它在这里是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Successful in a contest or struggle; having achieved victory.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在比赛或斗争中取得成功、获得胜利的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun irnexxa f'kompetizzjoni jew f'taqbida u kiseb rebħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 获胜的；胜利的；在竞争或斗争中取得成功的。

formal.mt: Wara partita diffiċli, it-tim ħareġ rebħan u kiseb post fil-finali.
formal.en: After a difficult match, the team emerged victorious and secured a place in the final.
formal.zh: 经过一场艰难的比赛，该队最终获胜，取得了决赛资格。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ħareġ rebħan fil-logħba taċ-ċess? Mark: Jien! Imma kienet logħba diffiċli.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who came out victorious in the chess game? Mark: I did! But it was a difficult game.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那盘国际象棋最后谁赢了？Mark：我赢了！不过那盘棋下得很艰难。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那盘国际象棋最后谁赢了？
messages.en: Who came out victorious in the chess game?

messages.speaker: Mark (棋手)
messages.zh: 我赢了！不过那盘棋下得很艰难。
messages.en: I did! But it was a difficult game.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rebħan 连同 ħareġ rebħan 一起记，想象选手赛后举手庆祝；rebħ 表示“胜利”这件事，rebħan 用来形容获胜的人或队伍。

gloss_zh: 吸吮；吃奶；榨取、剥削；为他人口交

teaching_sense.en_definition: To draw milk or another liquid into the mouth by sucking, as a baby does when feeding.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过吸吮把奶或其他液体吸入口中，例如婴儿吃奶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġbed il-ħalib jew likwidu ieħor għal ġo ħalqu billi jerdgħu, bħalma tagħmel tarbija waqt l-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吸吮；吮奶、吃奶。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be parasitic; to exploit; to rip off
sense_translations.zh_definition: 寄生于他人；榨取、剥削；敲诈或坑骗。
为他人进行阴茎口交。

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, it-tifel reda' minn ommu mingħajr diffikultà.
formal.en: According to the report, the boy suckled at his mother's breast without difficulty.
formal.zh: 报告记载，这名男婴顺利地吮吸了母乳。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Iċ-ċkejken għadu bil-ġuħ? Pawlu: Le, għadu kemm reda' u issa raqad.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is the little one still hungry? Pawlu: No, he has just had a breastfeed and has now fallen asleep.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：小家伙还饿吗？保罗：不饿了，他刚吃过母乳，现在睡着了。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 小家伙还饿吗？
messages.en: Is the little one still hungry?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għadu kemm reda' u issa raqad.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għadu kemm reda' u issa raqad.
messages.zh: 不饿了，他刚吃过母乳，现在睡着了。
messages.en: No, he has just had a breastfeed and has now fallen asleep.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“婴儿吸奶”记住吸吮义，再把剥削义记成比喻性的榨取；性行为义另设语境卡片。

gloss_zh: 变硬；勃起（通常指男性生殖器）

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become stiff or erect, usually referring to the penis.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得坚硬或勃起，通常用于描述阴茎。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir iebes jew wieqaf, ġeneralment meta ssir referenza għall-pene.

sense_translations.en_definition: to become stiff or erect (usually used of male genitalia)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 变硬或勃起，通常用于男性生殖器。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport mediku, il-pazjent adult qal li l-pene redaq waqt l-irqad.
formal.en: In the medical report, the adult patient stated that his penis became erect during sleep.
formal.zh: 医疗报告中，这名成年患者表示，他的阴茎在睡眠中勃起了。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Qed naqra l-kelma 'redaq'. Xi tfisser? Dottor Borg: Normalment tfisser li l-pene sar iebes jew wieqaf.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: I'm reading the word 'redaq'. What does it mean? Dr Borg: It usually means that the penis became stiff or erect.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：我读到了“redaq”这个词，是什么意思？博格医生：通常表示阴茎变硬或勃起了。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (成年患者)
messages.zh: 我读到了“redaq”这个词，是什么意思？
messages.en: I'm reading the word 'redaq'. What does it mean?

messages.speaker: Dottor Borg (医生)
messages.mt_spoken: Normalment tfisser li l-pene sar iebes jew wieqaf.
messages.mt_standard: Normalment tfisser li l-pene sar iebes jew wieqaf.
messages.zh: 通常表示阴茎变硬或勃起了。
messages.en: It usually means that the penis became stiff or erect.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用医疗词卡把它与“由软变硬、出现勃起”的状态变化配对，记住这是动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To pass excrement, used of animals such as sheep or rabbits.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 排出粪便，用于羊、兔等动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ il-ħmieġ minn ġismu; jintuża għal annimali bħan-nagħaġ u l-fniek.

sense_translations.en_definition: to evacuate excrement (used of animals such as sheep or rabbits)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 排出粪便、排便，用于羊、兔等动物。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, il-fenek reddes u l-veterinarju eżamina l-ħmieġ.
formal.en: During the observation, the rabbit passed droppings and the veterinarian examined them.
formal.zh: 观察期间，兔子排了便，兽医随后检查了粪便。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed tnaddaf il-gaġġa mill-ġdid? Mark: Il-fenek reddes hawn, eżatt ħdejn l-ilma.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you cleaning the cage again? Mark: The rabbit left droppings here, right beside the water.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你怎么又在清理笼子？马克：兔子在这里排了便，就在水旁边。

messages.speaker: Lara (兔子饲养者)
messages.zh: 你怎么又在清理笼子？
messages.en: Why are you cleaning the cage again?

messages.speaker: Mark (共同照料者)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-fenek reddes hawn, eżatt ħdejn l-ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Il-fenek reddes hawn, eżatt ħdejn l-ilma.
messages.zh: 兔子在这里排了便，就在水旁边。
messages.en: The rabbit left droppings here, right beside the water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象兔子刚在笼边排便，把 reddes 记成排便动作，再与表示粪便的 redus 对照。

gloss_zh: 法式舌吻；吻痕；损人之举

teaching_sense.en_definition: A kiss in which the participants use their tongues, also called a French kiss.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 双方使用舌头接吻的一次亲吻，即法式舌吻。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bewsa li fiha ż-żewġ persuni jużaw ilsienhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 法式舌吻；使用舌头的亲吻。
吻痕；亲吻或吸吮皮肤留下的痕迹。
损害或亏待他人的举动；损人之举。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, iż-żewġ maħbubin adulti qasmu redgħa qabel infirdu.
formal.en: In the novel, the two adult lovers shared a French kiss before parting.
formal.zh: 小说中，两位成年恋人在分别前进行了一次法式舌吻。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għandi redgħa fuq għonqi u tidher ħafna. Maja: Jekk trid, tista' tgħattiha b'xalpa.
colloquial.en: Rita: I have a lovebite on my neck, and it's very noticeable. Maja: If you want, you can cover it with a scarf.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：我脖子上有个吻痕，特别明显。玛雅：你愿意的话，可以用围巾遮住。

messages.speaker: Rita (成年朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi redgħa fuq għonqi u tidher ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi redgħa fuq għonqi u tidher ħafna.
messages.zh: 我脖子上有个吻痕，特别明显。
messages.en: I have a lovebite on my neck, and it's very noticeable.

messages.speaker: Maja (成年朋友)
messages.zh: 你愿意的话，可以用围巾遮住。
messages.en: If you want, you can cover it with a scarf.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做三张语境卡分别画舌吻、脖子吻痕和损人举动；这是分义记忆法，不表示词义的历史来源。

gloss_zh: 粪便；羊、兔等动物的粪便

teaching_sense.en_definition: Excrement, especially the droppings of animals such as rabbits or sheep.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 粪便，尤其指兔、羊等动物排出的粪便。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħmieġ tal-imsaren, speċjalment ta' annimali bħall-fniek jew in-nagħaġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 粪便；排泄物。

sense_translations.en_definition: faeces (of animals such as rabbits or sheep)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 兔、羊等动物的粪便。

formal.mt: Il-veterinarju ġabar kampjun ta' redus tal-fniek għall-analiżi.
formal.en: The veterinarian collected a sample of rabbit droppings for analysis.
formal.zh: 兽医采集了一份兔粪样本用于分析。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'hemm fl-art ħdejn il-gaġġa? Lara: Dak redus tal-fenek; se niġbru issa.
colloquial.en: Mark: What's on the floor beside the cage? Lara: That's rabbit droppings; I'll pick them up now.
colloquial.zh: 马克：笼子旁边的地上是什么？拉拉：那是兔粪，我现在就收拾。

messages.speaker: Mark (共同照料者)
messages.zh: 笼子旁边的地上是什么？
messages.en: What's on the floor beside the cage?

messages.speaker: Lara (兔子饲养者)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak redus tal-fenek; se niġbru issa.
messages.mt_standard: Dak redus tal-fenek; se niġbru issa.
messages.zh: 那是兔粪，我现在就收拾。
messages.en: That's rabbit droppings; I'll pick them up now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 redus 贴在兔粪或羊粪的图片旁，记住它指排出的东西；reddes 则记排便动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An official holding the title of referendary.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 担任呈报官职务的官员；这里指一种官员职称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Uffiċjal li għandu t-titlu ta' referendarju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 呈报官；一种官员职称，具体职责依所属机构而定。

formal.mt: Id-dokument uffiċjali jsemmi r-referendarju b'ismu u bit-titlu sħiħ tiegħu.
formal.en: The official document identifies the referendary by his name and full title.
formal.zh: 这份正式文件列出了呈报官的姓名及完整职称。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'inhu t-titlu ta' dan l-uffiċjal? Mark: Hawn miktub 'referendarju'. Anna: Sewwa, inniżżlu kif jidher fid-dokument.
colloquial.en: Anna: What is this official's title? Mark: It says 'referendary' here. Anna: All right, I'll record it as it appears in the document.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这位官员的职称是什么？马克：这里写的是“呈报官”。安娜：好，我就按文件上的写法记录。

messages.speaker: Anna (档案工作人员)
messages.zh: 这位官员的职称是什么？
messages.en: What is this official's title?

messages.speaker: Mark (档案工作人员)
messages.zh: 这里写的是“呈报官”。
messages.en: It says 'referendary' here.

messages.speaker: Anna (档案工作人员)
messages.zh: 好，我就按文件上的写法记录。
messages.en: All right, I'll record it as it appears in the document.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象档案中一栏写着“姓名”，另一栏写着“呈报官”，把 referendarju 作为人物职称整体记忆。

gloss_zh: 受规管的；受规则约束的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Subject to rules or controls governing how something operates.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受规则或管理措施约束，用来描述其运作受到规管的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Suġġett għal regoli jew kontrolli li jirregolaw kif jaħdem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受规管的；受到规则或控制措施约束的。

formal.mt: Il-proċess regolabbli deskritt fid-dokument isegwi regoli ċari f'kull stadju.
formal.en: The regulated process described in the document follows clear rules at every stage.
formal.zh: 文件所述的受规管流程在每个阶段都遵循明确的规则。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi jfisser 'regolabbli' f'dan it-test? David: Ifisser li l-proċess huwa suġġett għal regoli u kontrolli.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does 'regolabbli' mean in this text? David: It means that the process is subject to rules and controls.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这篇文章里的regolabbli是什么意思？戴维：意思是这个流程受到规则和控制措施的约束。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的regolabbli是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'regolabbli' mean in this text?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li l-proċess huwa suġġett għal regoli u kontrolli.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li l-proċess huwa suġġett għal regoli u kontrolli.
messages.zh: 意思是这个流程受到规则和控制措施的约束。
messages.en: It means that the process is subject to rules and controls.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按本词条给定词义，想象流程每一步都有规则约束，把regolabbli记作“受规管的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of happening or being done consistently, often at even intervals.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事情持续按一定规律发生或进行的性质，常指时间间隔较为固定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' xi ħaġa li sseħħ jew issir b'mod konsistenti u f'intervalli regolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 规律性；有规则或按固定间隔发生的性质。

formal.mt: Ir-regolarità tal-laqgħat tgħin lit-tim jippjana x-xogħol tiegħu.
formal.en: The regularity of the meetings helps the team plan its work.
formal.zh: 定期举行会议有助于团队规划工作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tmur timxi b'regolarità? Pawlu: Iva, immur kull filgħodu qabel ix-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you go walking regularly? Pawlu: Yes, I go every morning before work.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你经常定时去散步吗？保罗：是的，我每天早上上班前都去。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你经常定时去散步吗？
messages.en: Do you go walking regularly?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, immur kull filgħodu qabel ix-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, immur kull filgħodu qabel ix-xogħol.
messages.zh: 是的，我每天早上上班前都去。
messages.en: Yes, I go every morning before work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象日历上每周同一天都有一个圆点，用重复而整齐的时间标记记住regolarità的规律性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be very angry or emotionally upset.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 处于非常愤怒的状态，或因某事感到心烦、难受。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun mimli rabja kbira jew iħoss dwejjaq minħabba xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大怒；感到极为愤怒。
感到心烦、难过或情绪不安。

collocations.en: he was upset because of the news
collocations.zh: 他因那则消息而心烦难受

formal.mt: Il-karattru regħem meta sar jaf li l-ħabib tiegħu kien gideb.
formal.en: The character was enraged when he discovered that his friend had lied.
formal.zh: 这个人物发现朋友说了谎后大为愤怒。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif ħadha Mark meta sema' l-aħbar? Toni: Regħem, u ma ried ikellem lil ħadd.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did Mark take the news? Toni: He was upset and did not want to speak to anyone.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：马克听到消息后有什么反应？托尼：他很难受，不想跟任何人说话。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif ħadha Mark meta sema' l-aħbar?
messages.mt_standard: Kif ħadha Mark meta sema' l-aħbar?
messages.zh: 马克听到消息后有什么反应？
messages.en: How did Mark take the news?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Regħem, u ma ried ikellem lil ħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Regħem, u ma ried ikellem lil ħadd.
messages.zh: 他很难受，不想跟任何人说话。
messages.en: He was upset and did not want to speak to anyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张情绪卡记住regħem：一张是怒气冲冲，一张是心烦难受；结合上下文判断具体情绪。

gloss_zh: 拔除羽毛；用钓线和羽毛钓鱼

teaching_sense.en_definition: To remove feathers from a bird; also, to fish with a fishing line and a feather.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拔去鸟类的羽毛；也指使用钓线和羽毛钓鱼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Neħħa r-rix minn tajra; ukoll, stad b'xlief u rixa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拔除鸟类的羽毛。

sense_translations.en_definition: to fish using a fishing line and feather
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使用钓线和羽毛钓鱼。

collocations.en: fished with a fishing line and a feather

formal.mt: Il-kok rejjex it-tiġieġa qabel ħejjieha għat-tisjir.
formal.en: The cook plucked the chicken before preparing it for cooking.
formal.zh: 厨师先给鸡拔毛，再做烹饪前的准备。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min rejjex it-tiġieġa? Pawlu: Jien. Issa tista' taħsilha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who plucked the chicken? Pawlu: I did. You can wash it now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁给鸡拔了毛？保罗：我拔的。现在可以洗了。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.zh: 谁给鸡拔了毛？
messages.en: Who plucked the chicken?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.zh: 我拔的。现在可以洗了。
messages.en: I did. You can wash it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个义项都配上羽毛画面：厨房里拔羽毛，海边用羽毛配钓线；同词分场景记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To collect and keep things in quantity, build up a stock, or put something away for later use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物品收集并留存起来，积聚成一定数量，或收好以备日后使用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġabar u żamm affarijiet fi kwantità, żied il-ħażna tiegħu, jew poġġa xi ħaġa fil-ġenb għal aktar tard.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大量囤积并留存物品。
逐渐积聚大量物品、财富等。
把物品收好、存放起来。

collocations.en: stowed the blankets in the cupboard

formal.mt: Is-sid rekken il-materjal li kien fadal biex jużah fit-tiswijiet li jmiss.
formal.en: The owner stored the remaining material for use in future repairs.
formal.zh: 物主把剩余材料收存起来，供日后维修使用。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min rekken il-kutri? Mark: Jien, fl-armarju tal-kamra ż-żgħira.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who put the blankets away? Mark: I did, in the cupboard in the small room.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：谁把毯子收起来了？马克：我收的，放在小房间的柜子里。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 谁把毯子收起来了？
messages.en: Who put the blankets away?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 我收的，放在小房间的柜子里。
messages.en: I did, in the cupboard in the small room.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把东西一件件收进柜子：强调数量多是囤积，强调逐渐增多是积聚，强调放好是收存。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The best officially recognized performance in the world in a particular activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某项活动中获得正式认可的世界最佳成绩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-aqwa prestazzjoni fid-dinja f'attività partikolari, rikonoxxuta uffiċjalment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 世界纪录；某个项目中获认可的世界最佳成绩。

formal.mt: L-atleta stabbilixxa rekord dinji ġdid fit-tellieqa tal-mitt metru.
formal.en: The athlete set a new world record in the hundred-metre race.
formal.zh: 这名运动员在百米赛跑中创下了新的世界纪录。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kiser ir-rekord dinji? David: Le, imma kien qrib ħafna!
colloquial.en: Sara: Did he break the world record? David: No, but he came very close!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：他打破世界纪录了吗？戴维：没有，不过非常接近！

messages.speaker: Sara (观众)
messages.zh: 他打破世界纪录了吗？
messages.en: Did he break the world record?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 没有，不过非常接近！
messages.en: No, but he came very close!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语贴在领奖台上记：成绩达到全球最佳，便是世界纪录；再搭配“创下”和“打破”练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The final part of the large intestine, where faeces are held before leaving the body through the anus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 大肠的末段，在粪便经肛门排出体外前暂时储存粪便。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-aħħar parti tal-musrana l-kbira, fejn jinżamm l-ippurgar qabel joħroġ mill-anus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 直肠，位于大肠末端、与肛门相接的肠段。

formal.mt: Id-dijagramma turi r-rektum bħala l-aħħar parti tal-musrana l-kbira.
formal.en: The diagram shows the rectum as the final part of the large intestine.
formal.zh: 图中标明直肠是大肠的末段。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn qiegħed ir-rektum f'din l-istampa? Adam: Hawn, fl-aħħar tal-musrana l-kbira.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where is the rectum in this picture? Adam: Here, at the end of the large intestine.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这张图里的直肠在哪里？亚当：这里，在大肠的末端。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 这张图里的直肠在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the rectum in this picture?

messages.speaker: Adam (同学)
messages.zh: 这里，在大肠的末端。
messages.en: Here, at the end of the large intestine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在消化系统示意图上沿大肠走到末段，给该位置贴上 rektum，靠位置记住“直肠”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that is needed or must be fulfilled for a particular purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为实现某个目的而必需具备的条件，或必须满足的要求。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa meħtieġa jew kundizzjoni li trid titwettaq għal skop partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 必需的事物、必要条件或必须满足的要求。

formal.mt: Għal dan il-kors, għarfien bażiku tal-Malti huwa rekwiżit essenzjali.
formal.en: For this course, a basic knowledge of Maltese is an essential requirement.
formal.zh: 参加这门课程的必要条件是具备基础马耳他语知识。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hemm xi rekwiżit biex nidħol fil-kors? Toni: Iva, trid tkun taf ftit Malti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is there any requirement for joining the course? Toni: Yes, you need to know some Maltese.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：参加这门课程有什么要求吗？托尼：有，你需要会一点马耳他语。

messages.speaker: Maja (申请人)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm xi rekwiżit biex nidħol fil-kors?
messages.mt_standard: Hemm xi rekwiżit biex nidħol fil-kors?
messages.zh: 参加这门课程有什么要求吗？
messages.en: Is there any requirement for joining the course?

messages.speaker: Toni (课程工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, trid tkun taf ftit Malti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, trid tkun taf ftit Malti.
messages.zh: 有，你需要会一点马耳他语。
messages.en: Yes, you need to know some Maltese.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象报名表旁的一张条件清单：每一项必须满足的条件都可叫 rekwiżit，勾选后才算达标。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The prosecution's closing speech in a trial, presenting its final arguments about the case.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 审判中控方在结案阶段发表的陈词，用于总结案情并提出最后论证。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-diskors finali tal-prosekuzzjoni fi proċess, li fih tippreżenta l-aħħar argumenti tagħha dwar il-każ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 控方在审判结案阶段发表的总结陈词。

collocations.en: to deliver the prosecution's closing speech

formal.mt: Fir-rekwiżitorja tagħha, il-prosekuzzjoni ġabret il-punti ewlenin tal-provi ppreżentati.
formal.en: In its closing speech, the prosecution summarized the main points of the evidence presented.
formal.zh: 控方在结案陈词中总结了已提交证据的要点。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhi r-rekwiżitorja? Mark: Hija d-diskors finali tal-prosekuzzjoni fil-proċess.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is the rekwiżitorja? Mark: It is the prosecution's closing speech in the trial.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：rekwiżitorja 是什么意思？马克：就是审判中控方的结案陈词。

messages.speaker: Lara (法律学生)
