messages.zh: rekwiżitorja 是什么意思？
messages.en: What is the rekwiżitorja?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 就是审判中控方的结案陈词。
messages.en: It is the prosecution's closing speech in the trial.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用法庭场景记住三个限定：发言者是控方，时间在结案阶段，内容是总结论证，合起来就是此词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An official demand for goods, property, or services, especially for use by a public authority.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 正式要求提供物资、财产或服务，尤其指公共机关为公务用途进行的征用或征调。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Talba uffiċjali għal oġġetti, proprjetà jew servizzi, speċjalment għall-użu ta' awtorità pubblika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对物资、财产或服务的正式征用、征调或调拨要求。

formal.mt: Id-dokument jiddeskrivi r-rekwiżizzjoni ta' vetturi għat-trasport tal-provvisti waqt l-emerġenza.
formal.en: The document describes the requisition of vehicles to transport supplies during the emergency.
formal.zh: 文件说明了在紧急情况下征用车辆运输物资的安排。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi tfisser rekwiżizzjoni hawn? David: Talba uffiċjali biex jingħataw vetturi għall-użu waqt l-emerġenza.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does requisition mean here? David: An official demand for vehicles to be provided for use during the emergency.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这里的“征用”是什么意思？戴维：就是正式要求提供车辆，供紧急情况下使用。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的“征用”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does requisition mean here?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Talba uffiċjali biex jingħataw vetturi għall-użu waqt l-emerġenza.
messages.mt_standard: Talba uffiċjali biex jingħataw vetturi għall-użu waqt l-emerġenza.
messages.zh: 就是正式要求提供车辆，供紧急情况下使用。
messages.en: An official demand for vehicles to be provided for use during the emergency.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一份盖章文件要求调集车辆运物资，把“正式要求提供使用”的画面与此词连接起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: With religious devotion; also, with strict and faithful regularity in following a practice or rule.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 怀着宗教虔诚；也可形容严格、忠实且有规律地遵循某种做法或规则。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'devozzjoni reliġjuża; ukoll, b'reqqa u regolarità kbira fit-twettiq ta' drawwa jew regola.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 虔诚地；也可引申为严格遵守、一丝不苟地或始终如一地。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema segwew reliġjożament l-istruzzjonijiet tas-sigurtà matul ix-xogħol kollu.
formal.en: The workers followed the safety instructions religiously throughout the work.
formal.zh: 工人在整个工作过程中都一丝不苟地遵守安全指示。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Taqra bil-Malti kuljum? Adam: Iva, insegwi din id-drawwa reliġjożament, anki meta nkun impenjat.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you read in Maltese every day? Adam: Yes, I stick to that habit religiously, even when I am busy.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你每天都读马耳他语吗？亚当：对，我一直严格坚持这个习惯，即使忙的时候也一样。

messages.speaker: Nina (学习伙伴)
messages.zh: 你每天都读马耳他语吗？
messages.en: Do you read in Maltese every day?

messages.speaker: Adam (学习伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, insegwi din id-drawwa reliġjożament, anki meta nkun impenjat.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, insegwi din id-drawwa reliġjożament, anki meta nkun impenjat.
messages.zh: 对，我一直严格坚持这个习惯，即使忙的时候也一样。
messages.en: Yes, I stick to that habit religiously, even when I am busy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面联想：祈祷时态度虔诚，学习时天天坚持；分别帮助记住宗教用法与严格坚持的引申用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being religious or showing devotion through beliefs, worship, and conduct.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在信仰、礼拜和日常行为中表现出的宗教虔诚或虔敬。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' min juri fidi u devozzjoni reliġjuża fit-twemmin, fil-qima u fl-imġiba tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宗教虔诚；对宗教的笃信与虔敬。

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina kif ir-reliġjożità tidher fil-ħajja ta' kuljum tal-komunità.
formal.en: The study examines how religiosity appears in the community's everyday life.
formal.zh: 这项研究考察宗教虔诚如何体现在该社群的日常生活中。

colloquial.mt: Maja: In-nanna tiegħek għandha reliġjożità profonda, hux? Pawlu: Iva, u turiha wkoll bil-mod kif tgħin lill-oħrajn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Your grandmother has deep religious devotion, doesn't she? Pawlu: Yes, and she also shows it through the way she helps others.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你奶奶的宗教信仰很虔诚，对吧？Pawlu：是的，她帮助别人的方式也体现了这份虔诚。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: In-nanna tiegħek għandha reliġjożità profonda, hux?
messages.mt_standard: In-nanna tiegħek għandha reliġjożità profonda, hux?
messages.zh: 你奶奶的宗教信仰很虔诚，对吧？
messages.en: Your grandmother has deep religious devotion, doesn't she?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u turiha wkoll bil-mod kif tgħin lill-oħrajn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u turiha wkoll bil-mod kif tgħin lill-oħrajn.
messages.zh: 是的，她帮助别人的方式也体现了这份虔诚。
messages.en: Yes, and she also shows it through the way she helps others.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与“信仰体现在礼拜和待人方式中”的画面相连，记住它表示宗教虔诚这种品质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move something by rolling it along, or to form something into a roll.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使物体沿着表面滚动，或把材料卷成卷状。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iċaqlaq xi ħaġa billi jġegħelha ddur fuq wiċċ, jew jagħmel xi ħaġa f'għamla ta' romblu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物沿着表面滚动。

sense_translations.en_definition: to make a roll (e.g. in rolling a cigarette)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把材料卷成卷状，例如卷一支香烟。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem rembel il-bettija vojta sal-bieb tal-maħżen.
formal.en: The worker rolled the empty barrel to the warehouse door.
formal.zh: 工人把空桶滚到了仓库门口。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min rembel il-bettija sal-bieb? Mark: Jien. Kienet vojta, allura kien faċli.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who rolled the barrel to the door? Mark: I did. It was empty, so it was easy.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁把桶滚到门口了？Mark：是我。桶是空的，所以很容易。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 谁把桶滚到门口了？
messages.en: Who rolled the barrel to the door?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Kienet vojta, allura kien faċli.
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Kienet vojta, allura kien faċli.
messages.zh: 是我。桶是空的，所以很容易。
messages.en: I did. It was empty, so it was easy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个动作记忆：桶一圈圈滚着前进，材料一圈圈卷成卷；分别对应滚动与卷制。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To ring or give out a clear, resonant sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸣响，发出清脆而有共鸣的声音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel ħoss ċar u li jidwi, bħal ħoss ta' qanpiena.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸣响；发出清脆的响声。

formal.mt: Il-metall renda bħal qanpiena meta ntlaqat.
formal.en: The metal rang like a bell when it was struck.
formal.zh: 金属受到敲击时，发出了铃一般的清脆响声。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Smajt kif renda dan il-metall? Maja: Iva, donnu ħoss ta' qanpiena!
colloquial.en: Mark: Did you hear how this metal rang? Maja: Yes, it sounds like a bell!
colloquial.zh: Mark：你听见这块金属刚才的响声了吗？Maja：听见了，像铃声一样！

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 你听见这块金属刚才的响声了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear how this metal rang?

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 听见了，像铃声一样！
messages.en: Yes, it sounds like a bell!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象轻敲金属后听见一声清脆的“叮”，把这个声音画面与 renda 的鸣响义相连。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A rendering or interpretation of a work, such as a song or a poem.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对作品的演绎或诠释呈现，例如对歌曲或诗歌的演绎。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Interpretazzjoni jew preżentazzjoni ta' xogħol, bħal kanzunetta jew poeżija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对作品的演绎、诠释或呈现。

formal.mt: Ir-rendiment tal-kanzunetta kien ċar u espressiv.
formal.en: The rendering of the song was clear and expressive.
formal.zh: 这首歌曲的演绎清晰而富有表现力。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għoġbok ir-rendiment tal-kanzunetta? Pawlu: Iva, speċjalment il-mod kif kanta l-aħħar parti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you like the rendering of the song? Pawlu: Yes, especially the way he sang the last part.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你喜欢这首歌的这次演绎吗？Pawlu：喜欢，尤其喜欢他演唱最后一部分的方式。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢这首歌的这次演绎吗？
messages.en: Did you like the rendering of the song?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, speċjalment il-mod kif kanta l-aħħar parti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, speċjalment il-mod kif kanta l-aħħar parti.
messages.zh: 喜欢，尤其喜欢他演唱最后一部分的方式。
messages.en: Yes, especially the way he sang the last part.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一首歌由不同歌手唱出不同感觉，用“作品被怎样呈现”来记住这里的演绎义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The United Kingdom, a country in Northern Europe whose full official name is the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 英国，即联合王国，是北欧的一个国家，全称为大不列颠及北爱尔兰联合王国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fit-Tramuntana tal-Ewropa li l-isem uffiċjali sħiħ tiegħu huwa r-Renju Unit tal-Gran Brittanja u l-Irlanda ta' Fuq.

sense_translations.en_definition: United Kingdom (a kingdom and country in Northern Europe; official name: Renju Unit tal-Gran Brittanja u l-Irlanda ta’ Fuq)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 英国；联合王国，北欧的一个王国和国家，全称为大不列颠及北爱尔兰联合王国。

formal.mt: L-istudenta se tqatta' sena akkademika fir-Renju Unit.
formal.en: The student will spend an academic year in the United Kingdom.
formal.zh: 这名学生将在英国度过一个学年。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se tistudja s-sena d-dieħla? Mark: Fir-Renju Unit. Se nibqa' hemm għal sena.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where will you study next year? Mark: In the United Kingdom. I'll stay there for a year.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你明年要去哪里学习？Mark：英国。我会在那里待一年。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你明年要去哪里学习？
messages.en: Where will you study next year?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fir-Renju Unit. Se nibqa' hemm għal sena.
messages.mt_standard: Fir-Renju Unit. Se nibqa' hemm għal sena.
messages.zh: 英国。我会在那里待一年。
messages.en: In the United Kingdom. I'll stay there for a year.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Renju Unit 与英文 United Kingdom、中文“英国”做成三面词卡，再用“在英国、来自英国”练习识别。

exact_key: renju unit tal-gran brittanja u l-irlanda ta' fuq
gloss_zh: 大不列颠及北爱尔兰联合王国

teaching_sense.en_definition: The full official name of the United Kingdom, a country in Northern Europe.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 英国的正式全称：大不列颠及北爱尔兰联合王国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem uffiċjali sħiħ tar-Renju Unit, pajjiż fit-Tramuntana tal-Ewropa.

sense_translations.en_definition: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland (official name of the United Kingdom: a country in Northern Europe)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 大不列颠及北爱尔兰联合王国，英国的正式名称；该国位于北欧。

collocations.mt: il-gvern tar-Renju Unit tal-Gran Brittanja u l-Irlanda ta' Fuq
collocations.en: the government of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
collocations.zh: 大不列颠及北爱尔兰联合王国政府

collocations.mt: iċ-ċittadini tar-Renju Unit tal-Gran Brittanja u l-Irlanda ta' Fuq
collocations.en: the citizens of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
collocations.zh: 大不列颠及北爱尔兰联合王国公民

formal.mt: F'dan id-dokument, l-isem tal-pajjiż huwa miktub sħiħ: ir-Renju Unit tal-Gran Brittanja u l-Irlanda ta' Fuq.
formal.en: In this document, the country's name is written in full: the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland.
formal.zh: 本文件使用该国的完整名称：大不列颠及北爱尔兰联合王国。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu l-isem sħiħ tar-Renju Unit? Mark: Ir-Renju Unit tal-Gran Brittanja u l-Irlanda ta' Fuq. Huwa isem twil!
colloquial.en: Maja: What is the full name of the United Kingdom? Mark: The United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland. It's a long name!
colloquial.zh: Maja：英国的全称是什么？Mark：大不列颠及北爱尔兰联合王国。这个名字真长！

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 英国的全称是什么？
messages.en: What is the full name of the United Kingdom?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-Renju Unit tal-Gran Brittanja u l-Irlanda ta' Fuq. Huwa isem twil!
messages.mt_standard: Ir-Renju Unit tal-Gran Brittanja u l-Irlanda ta' Fuq. Huwa isem twil!
messages.zh: 大不列颠及北爱尔兰联合王国。这个名字真长！
messages.en: The United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland. It's a long name!

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“联合王国／大不列颠／和北爱尔兰”三段朗读整个名称，再连起来复述，帮助记住正式全称的顺序。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Using harsh control to restrict people's freedom, expression, or actions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过严厉控制来限制人们的自由、表达或行动的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juża kontroll aħrax biex jillimita l-libertà, l-espressjoni jew l-azzjonijiet tan-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 压制性的；以严厉手段限制自由或镇压活动的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi reġim repressiv li jillimita l-libertà tal-espressjoni.
formal.en: The report describes a repressive regime that restricts freedom of expression.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一个限制言论自由、实行镇压的政权。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tgħid li dan il-kontroll huwa repressiv? Pawlu: Għax in-nies jibżgħu jitkellmu u ma jistgħux jikkritikaw id-deċiżjonijiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you say this control is repressive? Pawlu: Because people are afraid to speak and cannot criticize the decisions.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么说这种控制具有压制性？Pawlu：因为人们害怕发声，也不能批评这些决定。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tgħid li dan il-kontroll huwa repressiv?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tgħid li dan il-kontroll huwa repressiv?
messages.zh: 你为什么说这种控制具有压制性？
messages.en: Why do you say this control is repressive?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax in-nies jibżgħu jitkellmu u ma jistgħux jikkritikaw id-deċiżjonijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Għax in-nies jibżgħu jitkellmu u ma jistgħux jikkritikaw id-deċiżjonijiet.
messages.zh: 因为人们害怕发声，也不能批评这些决定。
messages.en: Because people are afraid to speak and cannot criticize the decisions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“让人不敢发声的控制”作画面，记住 repressiv 是描述压制性质的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The use of force or harsh control to suppress people's freedom, expression, or activities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过武力或严厉控制压制人们的自由、表达或活动的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-użu tal-forza jew ta' kontroll aħrax biex jiġu mrażżna l-libertà, l-espressjoni jew l-attivitajiet tan-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 压制；镇压，尤指以强制手段限制自由、表达或活动。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport janalizza l-effetti tar-repressjoni politika fuq il-libertà tal-espressjoni.
formal.en: The report analyzes the effects of political repression on freedom of expression.
formal.zh: 报告分析了政治镇压对言论自由的影响。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex l-artiklu juża l-kelma repressjoni? Mark: Għax jiddeskrivi kif intużat il-forza biex jitwaqqaf protest paċifiku.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does the article use the word repression? Mark: Because it describes how force was used to stop a peaceful protest.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这篇文章为什么使用“镇压”这个词？Mark：因为它描述了如何使用武力阻止一场和平抗议。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这篇文章为什么使用“镇压”这个词？
messages.en: Why does the article use the word repression?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jiddeskrivi kif intużat il-forza biex jitwaqqaf protest paċifiku.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jiddeskrivi kif intużat il-forza biex jitwaqqaf protest paċifiku.
messages.zh: 因为它描述了如何使用武力阻止一场和平抗议。
messages.en: Because it describes how force was used to stop a peaceful protest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 配对记忆：repressiv 回答“具有怎样的性质”，repressjoni 回答“发生了什么行为”，后者是压制或镇压这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A country in Central Africa, the larger of the two countries named Congo.

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of a country in the Caribbean.

teaching_sense.en_definition: A country in Central Africa, the smaller of the two countries named Congo.

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of a country in Central Africa.

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used for living in, or relating to homes and the areas where people live.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于居住的，或与住宅及居民居住区域有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Maħsub għall-abitazzjoni jew marbut mad-djar u maż-żoni fejn jgħixu n-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 住宅的；供居住使用的；与居住区域有关的。

formal.mt: Il-pjan jinkludi bini residenzjali ġdid f'din iż-żona.

formal.zh: 该规划包括在这一区域新建住宅楼。

messages.en: Are there any shops nearby?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象地图上一片供人居住的房屋，把 żona residenzjali 整体记成“住宅区”，再迁移到“住宅楼”等搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move someone or something closer; also, to put forward an idea or proposal for consideration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人或物靠近；也指提出想法或建议，供他人考虑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġib lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa aktar qrib; ukoll jippreżenta idea jew proposta biex tiġi kkunsidrata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使靠近；把人或物移到更近的位置。
提出；提出想法、建议或方案供人考虑。

formal.mt: Il-membru ressaq proposta ġdida waqt il-laqgħa tal-kumitat.

teaching_sense.en_definition: Work done to repair a building, artwork, or other object and return it to good condition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对建筑、艺术品或其他物件进行修整，使其恢复良好状态的工作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xogħol biex jissewwew bini, xogħlijiet tal-arti jew oġġetti oħra u jinġiebu lura f'kundizzjoni tajba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 修复工作；为使建筑、艺术品等恢复良好状态而进行的修整工作。

formal.mt: Ix-xogħol ta' restawr tal-bini se jibda x-xahar id-dieħel.

formal.zh: 这座建筑的修复工作将于下个月开始。

colloquial.zh: Lara：这个房间为什么关闭了？Mark：里面的画正在进行修复。Lara：那我们等工作完成后再来。

messages.mt_standard: Qed isir xogħol ta' restawr fuq il-pitturi.
messages.zh: 里面的画正在进行修复。

messages.speaker: Lara (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela nerġgħu niġu meta jispiċċa x-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Mela nerġgħu niġu meta jispiċċa x-xogħol.

messages.en: Then we'll come back when the work is finished.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一幅旧画经过修整恢复良好状态，把整个过程标为 restawr；搭配 xogħol ta' restawr 一起记“修复工作”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose work is restoring artworks, buildings, or other objects to good condition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以修复艺术品、建筑或其他物件，使其恢复良好状态为工作的人。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min jista' jsewwi din il-pittura l-qadima?
messages.mt_standard: Min jista' jsewwi din il-pittura l-qadima?
messages.zh: 谁能修复这幅旧画？
messages.en: Who can repair this old painting?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)

messages.en: I know an experienced painting restorer.

messages.en: Can you give me his number?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 restawr“修复工作”和 restawratur“修复师”放在同一幅教学画面中：前者标在工作上，后者标在拿着工具的人身上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The work of repairing a damaged or old building, artwork, or object to recover its earlier condition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对受损或老旧的建筑、艺术品或物件进行修理，使其恢复原有状态的工作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xogħol biex bini, opra tal-arti jew oġġett antik jew bil-ħsara jerġa' jikseb il-kundizzjoni ta' qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 修复；使建筑、艺术品或物件恢复原有状态的工作。

formal.mt: Ir-restawrazzjoni tal-kappella se tinkludi t-tiswija tas-saqaf u t-tindif tal-ħitan.

formal.zh: 小教堂的修复工程将包括修理屋顶和清洁墙壁。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex il-mużew għalaq din il-kamra? Pawlu: Għax il-pittura l-kbira għandha bżonn restawrazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why has the museum closed this room? Pawlu: Because the large painting needs restoration.
colloquial.zh: Marija：博物馆为什么关闭了这个展厅？Pawlu：因为那幅大画需要修复。

messages.speaker: Marija (参观者)
messages.zh: 博物馆为什么关闭了这个展厅？

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-pittura l-kbira għandha bżonn restawrazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-pittura l-kbira għandha bżonn restawrazzjoni.
messages.zh: 因为那幅大画需要修复。
messages.en: Because the large painting needs restoration.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象修复师一点点修补旧画，让它重现原貌；把 restawrazzjoni 和“旧物恢复状态”的画面一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To shake involuntarily, especially because of cold or fear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体不由自主地颤抖，尤其指因寒冷或害怕而发抖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitriegħed bla ma jrid, speċjalment minħabba l-kesħa jew il-biża'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发抖；打寒战，常指因寒冷或害怕而颤抖。

formal.mt: Waqt li kien qed jistenna barra, it-tifel retaħ bil-kesħa.
formal.en: While waiting outside, the boy shivered with cold.
formal.zh: 男孩在外面等候时，冷得发抖。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex tajt il-kutra lil Mark? Luqa: Għax retaħ bil-kesħa meta ħareġ mill-ilma.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you give Mark the blanket? Luqa: Because he shivered with cold when he came out of the water.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你为什么把毯子给了 Mark？Luqa：因为他从水里出来时冷得发抖。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把毯子给了 Mark？
messages.en: Why did you give Mark the blanket?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax retaħ bil-kesħa meta ħareġ mill-ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Għax retaħ bil-kesħa meta ħareġ mill-ilma.
messages.zh: 因为他从水里出来时冷得发抖。
messages.en: Because he shivered with cold when he came out of the water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 retaħ 配上“出水后抱紧双臂打寒战”的画面，记住它表达身体自己发抖的动作。

gloss_zh: 被弄得发抖；受刺激而颤抖

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made to shiver by cold, fear, or another stimulus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到寒冷、恐惧或其他刺激而被弄得发抖，强调引发颤抖的外在因素。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mġiegħel jitriegħed minħabba l-kesħa, il-biża' jew xi ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被弄得发抖；因某种刺激而被引起颤抖。

collocations.en: was made to shiver by the cold
was made to shiver by fear

formal.mt: Meta nfetħet it-tieqa, ir-raġel rettaħ bil-kesħa.
formal.en: When the window was opened, the man was made to shiver by the cold.
formal.zh: 窗户打开后，那个男人被寒冷弄得发抖。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'ġara lil Pawlu meta sema' l-għajta? Sara: Rettaħ bil-biża', imma mbagħad ikkalma.
colloquial.en: Marija: What happened to Pawlu when he heard the scream? Sara: He was made to shiver with fear, but then he calmed down.
colloquial.zh: Marija：Pawlu 听到尖叫时怎么了？Sara：他被吓得发抖，不过后来平静下来了。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ġara lil Pawlu meta sema' l-għajta?
messages.mt_standard: X'ġara lil Pawlu meta sema' l-għajta?
messages.zh: Pawlu 听到尖叫时怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to Pawlu when he heard the scream?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他被吓得发抖，不过后来平静下来了。
messages.en: He was made to shiver with fear, but then he calmed down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 学习时把 rettaħ 配上“冷风一吹，人被弄得发抖”的因果画面；用这个画面区分 retaħ 的“发抖”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to be revised or amended after further consideration or new information.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可以在进一步考虑或获得新信息后加以修订、修改的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jiġi rivedut jew emendat wara aktar kunsiderazzjoni jew fid-dawl ta' informazzjoni ġdida.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可修订的；可以重新审视并修改的。

formal.mt: Il-pjan huwa revidibbli fid-dawl tal-kummenti li jaslu matul il-konsultazzjoni.
formal.en: The plan is revisable in light of comments received during the consultation.
formal.zh: 该计划可根据咨询期间收到的意见进行修订。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-pjan huwa finali? Lara: Le, għadu revidibbli jekk jinbidlu l-ħinijiet.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this plan final? Lara: No, it is still revisable if the times change.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这个计划已经定稿了吗？Lara：没有，如果时间有变，还可以修改。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 这个计划已经定稿了吗？
messages.en: Is this plan final?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għadu revidibbli jekk jinbidlu l-ħinijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għadu revidibbli jekk jinbidlu l-ħinijiet.
messages.zh: 没有，如果时间有变，还可以修改。
messages.en: No, it is still revisable if the times change.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象计划旁贴着“还可以修改”的便签；revidibbli 描述的是这种允许修订的状态。

gloss_zh: 修正主义者；主张重新解释既有观点的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who advocates revising an established interpretation, theory, or doctrine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 主张修正既有解释、理论或学说的人；具体含义取决于历史、思想或政治语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ssostni li interpretazzjoni, teorija jew duttrina stabbilita għandha tiġi riveduta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 修正主义者；主张修正既有解释、理论或学说的人。

collocations.zh: 一位修正主义者的论点

formal.mt: Ir-reviżjonista ppropona interpretazzjoni ġdida tal-avvenimenti abbażi ta' dokumenti li ma kinux ġew studjati qabel.
formal.en: The revisionist proposed a new interpretation of the events based on documents that had not previously been studied.
formal.zh: 这位修正主义者依据此前未经研究的文件，对这些事件提出了新的解释。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex issejjaħ lil dan l-awtur reviżjonista? David: Għax irid ibiddel l-interpretazzjoni tas-soltu ta' dawk l-avvenimenti.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why do you call this author a revisionist? David: Because he wants to change the usual interpretation of those events.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你为什么称这位作者为修正主义者？David：因为他想改变对那些事件的通常解释。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex issejjaħ lil dan l-awtur reviżjonista?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex issejjaħ lil dan l-awtur reviżjonista?
messages.zh: 你为什么称这位作者为修正主义者？
messages.en: Why do you call this author a revisionist?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax irid ibiddel l-interpretazzjoni tas-soltu ta' dawk l-avvenimenti.
messages.mt_standard: Għax irid ibiddel l-interpretazzjoni tas-soltu ta' dawk l-avvenimenti.
messages.zh: 因为他想改变对那些事件的通常解释。
messages.en: Because he wants to change the usual interpretation of those events.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 reviżjonista 想成讨论桌旁说“这个解释需要重看”的那个人；这里记的是持某种主张的人。

gloss_zh: 修正主义；修正既有解释的思潮

teaching_sense.en_definition: An approach or tendency that seeks to revise established interpretations, theories, or doctrines.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 寻求修正既有解释、理论或学说的立场、倾向或思潮。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Approċċ jew tendenza li tfittex li tirrevedi interpretazzjonijiet, teoriji jew duttrini stabbiliti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 修正主义；主张重新审视并修正既有解释、理论或学说的倾向。

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina r-reviżjoniżmu storiku u l-użu ta' sorsi ġodda biex jiġu riveduti interpretazzjonijiet stabbiliti.
formal.en: The study examines historical revisionism and the use of new sources to revise established interpretations.
formal.zh: 该研究探讨历史修正主义，以及如何利用新资料修正既有解释。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu s-suġġett tal-preżentazzjoni tiegħek? Mark: Ir-reviżjoniżmu, jiġifieri t-tendenza li jiġu riveduti ideat stabbiliti.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is your presentation about? Mark: Revisionism, meaning the tendency to revise established ideas.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你的报告讲什么？Mark：修正主义，也就是修正既有观念的倾向。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你的报告讲什么？
messages.en: What is your presentation about?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-reviżjoniżmu, jiġifieri t-tendenza li jiġu riveduti ideat stabbiliti.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-reviżjoniżmu, jiġifieri t-tendenza li jiġu riveduti ideat stabbiliti.
messages.zh: 修正主义，也就是修正既有观念的倾向。
messages.en: Revisionism, meaning the tendency to revise established ideas.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 reviżjoniżmu 记成一整套“重新审视既有观点”的思路；与表示人的 reviżjonista 配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who checks and revises a text or translation to correct errors and improve it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 检查并修订文本或译文，以纠正错误、改善表达的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li teżamina u tirrevedi test jew traduzzjoni biex tikkoreġi l-iżbalji u ttejjeb il-kitba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 修订者；负责检查、修改文本或译文的审校人员。

formal.mt: Ir-reviżur qabbel it-traduzzjoni mat-test oriġinali u kkoreġa diversi żbalji.
formal.en: The reviser compared the translation with the original text and corrected several errors.
formal.zh: 审校人员将译文与原文进行对照，并纠正了几处错误。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Nista' nibgħat it-test issa? Pawlu: Stenna ftit; ir-reviżur għadu qed jiċċekkja l-aħħar paġna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can I send the text now? Pawlu: Wait a moment; the reviser is still checking the last page.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我现在可以把文本发出去了吗？Pawlu：稍等，审校人员还在检查最后一页。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 我现在可以把文本发出去了吗？
messages.en: Can I send the text now?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Stenna ftit; ir-reviżur għadu qed jiċċekkja l-aħħar paġna.
messages.mt_standard: Stenna ftit; ir-reviżur għadu qed jiċċekkja l-aħħar paġna.
messages.zh: 稍等，审校人员还在检查最后一页。
messages.en: Wait a moment; the reviser is still checking the last page.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位拿着红笔逐句核对译文的人；reviżur 就是负责检查和修订文本的那个人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The care, guidance, and teaching a child receives while growing up, especially within the family.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 孩子成长过程中接受的照顾、引导和教育，尤其指家庭中的养育与教养。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kura, il-gwida u t-tagħlim li jirċievi tifel jew tifla waqt it-trobbija, speċjalment fil-familja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 养育；成长过程中接受的家庭教育与教养。

formal.mt: Ir-rewmien tat-tfal jinkludi kemm il-kura ta' kuljum kif ukoll it-tagħlim tar-rispett lejn ħaddieħor.
formal.en: The upbringing of children includes both daily care and teaching respect for others.
formal.zh: 孩子的养育既包括日常照顾，也包括教导他们尊重他人。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Pawlu dejjem jirringrazzja lil kulħadd. Luqa: Iva, kellu rewmien tajjeb; id-dar għallmuh jirrispetta lin-nies.
colloquial.en: Marija: Pawlu always thanks everyone. Luqa: Yes, he had a good upbringing; at home they taught him to respect people.
colloquial.zh: Marija：Pawlu 总会向每个人道谢。Luqa：是啊，他从小受到良好的家庭教育，家里教他尊重别人。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu 总会向每个人道谢。
messages.en: Pawlu always thanks everyone.

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kellu rewmien tajjeb; id-dar għallmuh jirrispetta lin-nies.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kellu rewmien tajjeb; id-dar għallmuh jirrispetta lin-nies.
messages.zh: 是啊，他从小受到良好的家庭教育，家里教他尊重别人。
messages.en: Yes, he had a good upbringing; at home they taught him to respect people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rewmien 连到“家人照顾孩子，也教他说谢谢”的成长画面，同时记住养育和教养两层意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move air to cool oneself, or to let fresh air circulate through a place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过扇动空气给自己降温，或使某个空间空气流通。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iċaqlaq l-arja biex jibred hu stess, jew iħalli arja friska tiċċirkola f'post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给自己扇风以降温。
使某处通风，让新鲜空气流通。

collocations.en: fanned himself with a sheet of paper

formal.mt: Qabel il-laqgħa, il-ħaddiem fetaħ it-twieqi u rewwaħ il-kamra.
formal.en: Before the meeting, the worker opened the windows and ventilated the room.
formal.zh: 会议开始前，工作人员打开窗户，给房间通风。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qiegħed iċaqlaq dik il-karta? Pawlu: Hawn ħafna sħana. Ara, anki Mark rewwaħ lilu nnifsu b'karta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you waving that sheet of paper? Pawlu: It's very hot here. Look, even Mark fanned himself with a sheet of paper.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么挥着那张纸？保罗：这里太热了。你看，连马克都用纸给自己扇风了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么挥着那张纸？
messages.en: Why are you waving that sheet of paper?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn ħafna sħana. Ara, anki Mark rewwaħ lilu nnifsu b'karta.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn ħafna sħana. Ara, anki Mark rewwaħ lilu nnifsu b'karta.
messages.zh: 这里太热了。你看，连马克都用纸给自己扇风了。
messages.en: It's very hot here. Look, even Mark fanned himself with a sheet of paper.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个场景连起来记：纸扇让自己凉快，开窗让房间通风；共同画面都是让空气动起来。

gloss_zh: 去除多余部分，尤指谷物

teaching_sense.en_definition: To remove an excess amount, especially of grain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 去掉超出所需数量的部分，尤其用于谷物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Neħħa l-kwantità żejda, speċjalment ta' qamħ.

sense_translations.en_definition: to remove excess (esp. used of grain)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 去除多余的部分，尤其指去掉多余的谷物。

collocations.en: removed the excess from the measuring container
collocations.zh: 去掉量器中多出的部分

formal.mt: Biex il-kejl ikun preċiż, il-bidwi rexaq il-qamħ żejjed mill-kejl.
formal.en: To make the measurement accurate, the farmer removed the excess grain from the measuring container.
formal.zh: 为了保证计量准确，农民去掉了量器中多余的谷物。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex hemm il-qamħ fuq il-mejda? Toni: Missieri rexaq iż-żejjed mill-kejl u ħallieh hemm.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is there grain on the table? Toni: My father removed the excess from the measuring container and left it there.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：桌子上为什么有谷物？托尼：我爸爸把量器里多出的部分去掉，放在那里了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 桌子上为什么有谷物？
messages.en: Why is there grain on the table?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Missieri rexaq iż-żejjed mill-kejl u ħallieh hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Missieri rexaq iż-żejjed mill-kejl u ħallieh hemm.
messages.zh: 我爸爸把量器里多出的部分去掉，放在那里了。
messages.en: My father removed the excess from the measuring container and left it there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象量器里的谷物堆得太高，把高出的部分去掉；用这个动作记住“去除多余”。

gloss_zh: 加强或反复去除多余部分

teaching_sense.en_definition: To remove excess with greater intensity or through repeated action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以加强的动作或反复的操作去掉多余部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Neħħa ż-żejjed b'aktar intensità jew b'azzjoni ripetuta.

sense_translations.en_definition: to remove excess (intensive or frequentative meaning)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 加强或反复进行去除多余部分的动作。

collocations.mt: rexxaq il-qamħ żejjed minn kull kejl
collocations.en: repeatedly removed the excess grain from each measuring container
collocations.zh: 逐个去掉各量器中多余的谷物

formal.mt: Matul ix-xogħol, il-bidwi rexxaq il-qamħ żejjed minn kull kejl biex il-kwantitajiet ikunu ndaqs.
formal.en: During the work, the farmer repeatedly removed the excess grain from each measuring container so that the quantities would be equal.
formal.zh: 作业时，农民逐个去掉各量器中多余的谷物，使各份数量相等。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dam daqshekk bil-kejl? Toni: Rexxaq iż-żejjed diversi drabi, għax baqa' jżid wisq qamħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did he take so long measuring? Toni: He removed the excess several times because he kept adding too much grain.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他怎么量了那么久？托尼：他去掉了好几次多余的部分，因为他总是加进太多谷物。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他怎么量了那么久？
messages.en: Why did he take so long measuring?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rexxaq iż-żejjed diversi drabi, għax baqa' jżid wisq qamħ.
messages.mt_standard: Rexxaq iż-żejjed diversi drabi, għax baqa' jżid wisq qamħ.
messages.zh: 他去掉了好几次多余的部分，因为他总是加进太多谷物。
messages.en: He removed the excess several times because he kept adding too much grain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把双写的 xx 当作个人记忆提示：去掉一次，再去掉一次；这里只帮助记住本词的加强或反复含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To talk a great deal or keep chattering, especially in an informal conversation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说很多话或持续闲聊，尤其指在日常交谈中说个不停。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitkellem ħafna jew jibqa' jpaċpaċ, speċjalment f'konversazzjoni informali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 说很多话；说个不停。
闲聊；叽叽喳喳地说话。

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, wieħed mill-parteċipanti reċpel bla waqfien u ma ħalliex lill-oħrajn jitkellmu.
formal.en: During the meeting, one participant talked incessantly and did not let the others speak.
formal.zh: 会议期间，一名参与者说个不停，没有让其他人发言。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif mar il-vjaġġ ma' Pawlu? Rita: Tajjeb, imma reċpel it-triq kollha!
colloquial.en: Maja: How was the trip with Pawlu? Rita: Good, but he chattered the whole way!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：和保罗一起出行怎么样？丽塔：挺好，不过他一路上说个不停！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 和保罗一起出行怎么样？
messages.en: How was the trip with Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 挺好，不过他一路上说个不停！
messages.en: Good, but he chattered the whole way!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上一幅“朋友一路说到终点”的画面，记住重点是话多、聊个不停。

gloss_zh: 返回；再来一次；重做一次

teaching_sense.en_definition: An instance of returning to a place or doing something again.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一次返回某地的行动，或再次进行某件事的一次重复。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Darba li fiha xi ħadd jiġi lura jew jagħmel xi ħaġa mill-ġdid.

sense_translations.en_definition: a return, an instance of coming back or doing again
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次返回；一次再来或重做。

formal.mt: L-ittra tiddeskrivi r-reġgħa tiegħu lejn id-dar wara żmien twil barra minn Malta.
formal.en: The letter describes his return home after a long period outside Malta.
formal.zh: 这封信描述了他长期身处马耳他以外地区后返回家中的经历。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif kienet ir-reġgħa tiegħek lejn id-dar? Pawlu: Twila, imma fl-aħħar wasalt u striħajt.
colloquial.en: Maja: How was your journey back home? Pawlu: Long, but I finally arrived and had a rest.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你回家的路程怎么样？保罗：挺漫长的，不过总算到了家，也休息了一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif kienet ir-reġgħa tiegħek lejn id-dar?
messages.mt_standard: Kif kienet ir-reġgħa tiegħek lejn id-dar?
messages.zh: 你回家的路程怎么样？
messages.en: How was your journey back home?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (返家的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Twila, imma fl-aħħar wasalt u striħajt.
messages.mt_standard: Twila, imma fl-aħħar wasalt u striħajt.
messages.zh: 挺漫长的，不过总算到了家，也休息了一下。
messages.en: Long, but I finally arrived and had a rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一条回到起点的箭头，再标上“一次返回”；另画重复动作，帮助记住它是表示一次事件的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The management and organization of the affairs of an institution or service.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对机构或服务的事务进行组织、安排和管理。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tmexxija u l-organizzazzjoni tal-affarijiet ta' istituzzjoni jew servizz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 行政管理；机构或事务的管理工作。

collocations.en: under the administration of the committee

formal.mt: Ir-reġija tas-servizz tinkludi l-organizzazzjoni tax-xogħol u t-tqassim tar-responsabbiltajiet.
formal.en: The administration of the service includes organizing the work and allocating responsibilities.
formal.zh: 该服务的管理工作包括组织工作和分配职责。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Taħt ir-reġija ta' min hu ċ-ċentru? Toni: Taħt ir-reġija tal-kumitat lokali.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who administers the centre? Toni: It is under the administration of the local committee.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个中心由谁管理？托尼：由当地委员会管理。

messages.speaker: Nina (居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħt ir-reġija ta' min hu ċ-ċentru?
messages.mt_standard: Taħt ir-reġija ta' min hu ċ-ċentru?
messages.zh: 这个中心由谁管理？
messages.en: Who administers the centre?

messages.speaker: Toni (中心职员)
messages.zh: 由当地委员会管理。
messages.en: It is under the administration of the local committee.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象办公室把工作和职责逐项安排好，用这个管理场景记住reġija的行政管理义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who kills a king.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 杀害国王的人，即弑君者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li toqtol re.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弑君者；杀害国王的人。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, ir-reġiċida jitressaq quddiem il-qorti wara l-qtil tar-re.
formal.en: In the novel, the regicide is brought before the court after the king's murder.
formal.zh: 在小说中，弑君者在国王遇害后被带上法庭。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu r-reġiċida f'din l-istorja? Pawlu: Hu dak li qatel lir-re.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is the regicide in this story? Pawlu: He is the one who killed the king.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个故事里的弑君者是谁？保罗：就是杀死国王的那个人。

messages.speaker: Maja (读者)
messages.zh: 这个故事里的弑君者是谁？
messages.en: Who is the regicide in this story?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 就是杀死国王的那个人。
messages.en: He is the one who killed the king.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放在故事人物卡上记忆：reġiċida回答“谁杀了国王”，指弑君的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of killing a king.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 杀害国王这一行为或事件，即弑君。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li fih jinqatel re.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弑君；杀害国王这一行为或事件。

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tad-dramm, ir-reġiċidju huwa l-ġrajja li tbiddel il-kors tal-istorja.
formal.en: In the analysis of the play, the regicide is the event that changes the course of the story.
formal.zh: 在这部戏剧的分析中，弑君是改变故事走向的事件。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jiġri f'dan il-kapitlu? Mark: Iseħħ reġiċidju: xi ħadd joqtol lir-re.
colloquial.en: Lara: What happens in this chapter? Mark: A regicide takes place: someone kills the king.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：这一章发生了什么？马克：发生了弑君事件，有人杀死了国王。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 这一章发生了什么？
messages.en: What happens in this chapter?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iseħħ reġiċidju: xi ħadd joqtol lir-re.
messages.mt_standard: Iseħħ reġiċidju: xi ħadd joqtol lir-re.
messages.zh: 发生了弑君事件，有人杀死了国王。
messages.en: A regicide takes place: someone kills the king.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把reġiċidju写在故事事件时间轴上：它表示“发生了弑君”，与表示人物的reġiċida对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The organ in which a baby develops during pregnancy; the womb.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 怀孕期间胚胎和胎儿在其中发育的器官，即子宫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-organu li fih tiżviluppa t-tarbija waqt it-tqala.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 子宫；胚胎和胎儿在怀孕期间发育的器官。

formal.mt: Id-dijagramma turi r-reħem u l-pożizzjoni tiegħu fil-ġisem.
formal.en: The diagram shows the womb and its position in the body.
formal.zh: 这幅示意图展示了子宫及其在身体中的位置。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhu r-reħem? Sara: Hu l-organu fejn tiżviluppa t-tarbija waqt it-tqala.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is the womb? Sara: It is the organ where a baby develops during pregnancy.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：子宫是什么？萨拉：就是怀孕期间宝宝在里面发育的器官。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 子宫是什么？
messages.en: What is the womb?

messages.speaker: Sara (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu l-organu fejn tiżviluppa t-tarbija waqt it-tqala.
messages.mt_standard: Hu l-organu fejn tiżviluppa t-tarbija waqt it-tqala.
messages.zh: 就是怀孕期间宝宝在里面发育的器官。
messages.en: It is the organ where a baby develops during pregnancy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在人体示意图上给子宫贴上reħem标签，联想胎儿在其中发育的画面来记忆词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The loosening of something or its becoming limp.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物松开的过程，或由绷紧、有力变得松软无力的状态变化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess ta' xi ħaġa li tinħall jew issir laxka u bla saħħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 松开；使原本绷紧或固定的东西变松的过程。
变得松软无力；失去原有紧张度或支撑力的过程。

formal.mt: Id-deskrizzjoni tax-xena ssemmi r-reħi tad-driegħ tal-pupazz meta jitħalla l-ħajt li jżommu.
formal.en: The scene description mentions the puppet's arm going limp when the string supporting it is released.
formal.zh: 场景描述提到，支撑木偶手臂的线被放开时，手臂随之松软下垂。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'reħi' hawn? Pawlu: Il-ħabel kien miġbud, imbagħad sar laxk. Il-kelma hawn tfisser dak il-proċess.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'reħi' mean here? Pawlu: The rope was taut, then it became slack. Here the word means that process.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的reħi是什么意思？保罗：绳子原来绷得很紧，后来松了。这里这个词指的就是这个过程。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的reħi是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'reħi' mean here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħabel kien miġbud, imbagħad sar laxk. Il-kelma hawn tfisser dak il-proċess.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħabel kien miġbud, imbagħad sar laxk. Il-kelma hawn tfisser dak il-proċess.
messages.zh: 绳子原来绷得很紧，后来松了。这里这个词指的就是这个过程。
messages.en: The rope was taut, then it became slack. Here the word means that process.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象绷紧的绳子松下来，再想象木偶手臂失去支撑而下垂，用这两个画面记住reħi的两个名词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of holding something up or keeping it steady by providing support.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过提供支撑，使物体保持直立、稳定或不致倒下的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li żżomm xi ħaġa wieqfa jew stabbli billi tagħtiha appoġġ.

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of supporting or propping up
sense_translations.zh_definition: 支撑或撑住某物的行为。

collocations.en: the propping up of the wall

formal.mt: Ir-rfid tal-ħajt b'travi tal-injam żammu stabbli waqt it-tiswija.
formal.en: Propping up the wall with wooden beams kept it stable during the repair.
formal.zh: 修缮期间，用木梁撑住墙体使其保持稳定。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex hemm dawk it-travi mal-ħajt? Mark: Qegħdin hemm għar-rfid tal-ħajt waqt it-tiswija.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are those beams against the wall? Mark: They're there to prop up the wall during the repair.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：墙边为什么放着那些梁？马克：修墙时用它们来撑住墙体。

messages.speaker: Lara (住户)
messages.zh: 墙边为什么放着那些梁？
messages.en: Why are those beams against the wall?

messages.speaker: Mark (维修工)
messages.mt_spoken: Qegħdin hemm għar-rfid tal-ħajt waqt it-tiswija.
messages.mt_standard: Qegħdin hemm għar-rfid tal-ħajt waqt it-tiswija.
messages.zh: 修墙时用它们来撑住墙体。
messages.en: They're there to prop up the wall during the repair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中画一根木梁斜撑着墙：本词记的是“撑住这件事”，把动作画面与名词含义一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of raising something, or of putting something away for storage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将某物抬高的行为，也可指将某物收起存放的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li ttella' xi ħaġa 'l fuq, jew li tqegħedha f'post fejn tinżamm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将某物抬起或升高的行为。
将某物收起存放的行为。

formal.mt: Il-pjan tax-xogħol jinkludi r-rfigħ tal-kaxxi għal fuq l-ixkaffa u r-rfigħ tal-ħwejjeġ tax-xitwa fl-armarju.
formal.en: The work plan includes lifting the boxes onto the shelf and storing the winter clothes in the wardrobe.
formal.zh: 工作计划包括把箱子抬到架子上，以及把冬衣收进衣柜。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Lestejt ir-rfigħ tal-ħwejjeġ tax-xitwa? Lara: Iva, kollox fl-armarju. Issa għandi bżonn l-għajnuna fir-rfigħ ta' din il-kaxxa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you finished putting the winter clothes away? Lara: Yes, everything is in the wardrobe. Now I need help lifting this box.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：冬衣都收好了吗？拉拉：收好了，都在衣柜里。现在我需要有人帮我抬这个箱子。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 冬衣都收好了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished putting the winter clothes away?

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kollox fl-armarju. Issa għandi bżonn l-għajnuna fir-rfigħ ta' din il-kaxxa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kollox fl-armarju. Issa għandi bżonn l-għajnuna fir-rfigħ ta' din il-kaxxa.
messages.zh: 收好了，都在衣柜里。现在我需要有人帮我抬这个箱子。
messages.en: Yes, everything is in the wardrobe. Now I need help lifting this box.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用整理房间的两幅画面记两个义项：先把箱子抬起来，再把冬衣收起来；分别对应抬起与收存。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who refines a material by making it purer or improving its quality.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过精炼使材料更纯净或品质更好的人员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tirfina materjal biex tagħmlu aktar pur jew ittejjeb il-kwalità tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 精炼者；从事材料提纯或精炼的人。

formal.mt: Ir-rfinitur tad-deheb jikkontrolla l-purità tal-materjal matul il-proċess.
formal.en: The gold refiner checks the purity of the material during the process.
formal.zh: 黄金精炼人员在加工过程中检查材料的纯度。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'xogħol jagħmel ħuk? Mark: Hu rfinitur tad-deheb. Jaħdem biex id-deheb ikun aktar pur.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does your brother do? Mark: He's a gold refiner. He works to make gold purer.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你哥哥做什么工作？马克：他是黄金精炼人员，负责提高黄金的纯度。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥做什么工作？
messages.en: What does your brother do?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu rfinitur tad-deheb. Jaħdem biex id-deheb ikun aktar pur.
messages.mt_standard: Hu rfinitur tad-deheb. Jaħdem biex id-deheb ikun aktar pur.
messages.zh: 他是黄金精炼人员，负责提高黄金的纯度。
messages.en: He's a gold refiner. He works to make gold purer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位工人检查黄金纯度，把“人、材料、提高纯度”三个线索一起记，就能想起精炼者。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A final small improvement or detail that completes a piece of work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为使作品或工作完成得更好而添加的最后一点修饰或细节。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-aħħar titjib jew dettall li jagħti dehra lesta lil xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 完成作品或工作时所加的最后一点润饰或点缀。

formal.mt: L-artist żied linja rqiqa madwar it-titlu bħala rfinitura dekorattiva.
formal.en: The artist added a thin line around the title as a decorative finishing touch.
formal.zh: 艺术家在标题周围加了一道细线，作为最后的装饰性点缀。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kartolina lesta? Lara: Kważi. Żigarella żgħira tkun l-aħħar rfinitura.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the card ready? Lara: Almost. A little ribbon will be the finishing touch.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：卡片做好了吗？拉拉：差不多了。再加一条小丝带就完成最后的点缀了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 卡片做好了吗？
messages.en: Is the card ready?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi. Żigarella żgħira tkun l-aħħar rfinitura.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi. Żigarella żgħira tkun l-aħħar rfinitura.
messages.zh: 差不多了。再加一条小丝带就完成最后的点缀了。
messages.en: Almost. A little ribbon will be the finishing touch.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象卡片已经做好，最后系上一条小丝带；这最后一点让作品完整的修饰，就是本词的记忆画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Awkwardness in behaviour or action; also strife or conflict between people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 行为或动作上的笨拙、不自然；也可指人与人之间的争斗或冲突。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' naturalezza jew ħila fl-imġiba jew fl-azzjonijiet; ukoll tilwim jew ġlied bejn in-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 笨拙；举止或动作不自然、不灵巧。
争斗；人与人之间的争执或冲突。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi r-rgenn bejn iż-żewġ gruppi u l-isforzi biex jerġgħu jibdew jitkellmu.
formal.en: The report describes the strife between the two groups and the efforts to get them talking again.
formal.zh: 报告描述了两个群体之间的争斗，以及促使双方恢复对话的努力。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex hemm dan ir-rgenn kollu bejn il-ġirien? Mark: Ma qablux fuq il-parkeġġ, u issa kulħadd irrabjat.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is there all this strife between the neighbours? Mark: They disagreed about parking, and now everyone is angry.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：邻居们为什么闹得这么厉害？马克：他们在停车问题上意见不合，现在大家都很生气。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm dan ir-rgenn kollu bejn il-ġirien?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm dan ir-rgenn kollu bejn il-ġirien?
messages.zh: 邻居们为什么闹得这么厉害？
messages.en: Why is there all this strife between the neighbours?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma qablux fuq il-parkeġġ, u issa kulħadd irrabjat.
messages.mt_standard: Ma qablux fuq il-parkeġġ, u issa kulħadd irrabjat.
messages.zh: 他们在停车问题上意见不合，现在大家都很生气。
messages.en: They disagreed about parking, and now everyone is angry.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面分开记：一个人动作笨拙，两群人发生争斗；遇到这个词时靠上下文判断义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Restraint that limits an action or response, or control over behaviour or a situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对行动或反应的克制、约束；也指对行为或局面的控制。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Trażżin li jillimita azzjoni jew reazzjoni, jew kontroll fuq l-imġiba jew fuq sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 克制；对冲动、反应或行为的约束。
控制；使行为或局面处于掌握之中。

formal.mt: Waqt id-dibattitu, ir-rgin fuq ir-reazzjonijiet personali għen biex id-diskussjoni tibqa' rispettabbli.
formal.en: During the debate, restraint in personal reactions helped keep the discussion respectful.
formal.zh: 辩论期间，对个人反应的克制有助于维持讨论中的相互尊重。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif ma għajjatx meta semgħet dak il-kliem? Maja: Għandha ħafna rgin fuq l-emozzjonijiet tagħha.
colloquial.en: Nina: How did she manage not to shout when she heard those words? Maja: She has a lot of control over her emotions.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：她听到那些话，怎么还能忍住不喊？玛雅：她很能控制自己的情绪。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif ma għajjatx meta semgħet dak il-kliem?
messages.mt_standard: Kif ma għajjatx meta semgħet dak il-kliem?
messages.zh: 她听到那些话，怎么还能忍住不喊？
messages.en: How did she manage not to shout when she heard those words?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandha ħafna rgin fuq l-emozzjonijiet tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Għandha ħafna rgin fuq l-emozzjonijiet tagħha.
messages.zh: 她很能控制自己的情绪。
messages.en: She has a lot of control over her emotions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象生气时先停一下再回应：停住冲动是“克制”，掌握反应是“控制”，两义可以一起记。

gloss_zh: 马耳他语旧音位 /ɣ~ʁ/，即浊软腭或浊小舌擦音

teaching_sense.en_definition: An archaic Maltese phoneme described as a voiced velar or voiced uvular fricative, /ɣ~ʁ/.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马耳他语中的一个旧音位，记作 /ɣ~ʁ/，属于浊软腭擦音或浊小舌擦音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fonema arkajka fil-Malti, /ɣ~ʁ/, deskritta bħala frikattiva velari jew uvulari leħnija.

sense_translations.en_definition: the voiced velar or voiced uvular fricative /ɣ~ʁ/, an archaic phoneme in Maltese; see għ for more
sense_translations.zh_definition: 浊软腭擦音或浊小舌擦音 /ɣ~ʁ/，是马耳他语中的一个旧音位；更多说明参见 għ。

formal.mt: Fil-glossarju, ir-rgħajn hija deskritta bħala fonema arkajka tal-Malti, rappreżentata bis-simboli /ɣ~ʁ/.
formal.en: In the glossary, rgħajn is described as an archaic Maltese phoneme, represented by the symbols /ɣ~ʁ/.
formal.zh: 词汇表将 rgħajn 描述为马耳他语的一个旧音位，用 /ɣ~ʁ/ 表示。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhi r-rgħajn f'dawn in-noti? Toni: Hija fonema arkajka tal-Malti; hawn juruha bħala /ɣ~ʁ/.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is rgħajn in these notes? Toni: It is an archaic Maltese phoneme; here they show it as /ɣ~ʁ/.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这份笔记里的 rgħajn 是什么？托尼：它是马耳他语的一个旧音位，这里用 /ɣ~ʁ/ 表示。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这份笔记里的 rgħajn 是什么？
messages.en: What is rgħajn in these notes?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija fonema arkajka tal-Malti; hawn juruha bħala /ɣ~ʁ/.
messages.mt_standard: Hija fonema arkajka tal-Malti; hawn juruha bħala /ɣ~ʁ/.
messages.zh: 它是马耳他语的一个旧音位，这里用 /ɣ~ʁ/ 表示。
messages.en: It is an archaic Maltese phoneme; here they show it as /ɣ~ʁ/.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词形和音标 /ɣ~ʁ/ 写在同一张卡片上，再标注“旧音位、浊擦音”，用语音标签辅助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An excessive desire to have more, especially money or possessions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 过度想要获得更多东西的欲望，尤其指对金钱或财物的贪求。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xewqa eċċessiva li wieħed ikollu aktar, speċjalment flus jew ġid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贪婪；过分追求更多财物或好处的欲望。
贪财；对金钱和财富的强烈贪求。

formal.mt: Ir-rgħiba għall-flus wasslet lill-personaġġ biex jittradi l-fiduċja ta' sħabu.
formal.en: Greed for money led the character to betray his companions' trust.
formal.zh: 对金钱的贪婪使这个人物辜负了同伴们的信任。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandu biżżejjed, imma xorta jrid jieħu kollox għalih. Lara: Dik rgħiba; għandu jħalli xi ħaġa għall-oħrajn ukoll.
colloquial.en: Mark: He has enough, but he still wants to take everything for himself. Lara: That is greed; he should leave something for the others too.
colloquial.zh: 马克：他已经有足够的东西了，却还是想把所有东西都据为己有。劳拉：这就是贪婪，他也应该给别人留一些。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu biżżejjed, imma xorta jrid jieħu kollox għalih.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu biżżejjed, imma xorta jrid jieħu kollox għalih.
messages.zh: 他已经有足够的东西了，却还是想把所有东西都据为己有。
messages.en: He has enough, but he still wants to take everything for himself.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik rgħiba; għandu jħalli xi ħaġa għall-oħrajn ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Dik rgħiba; għandu jħalli xi ħaġa għall-oħrajn ukoll.
messages.zh: 这就是贪婪，他也应该给别人留一些。
messages.en: That is greed; he should leave something for the others too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象已经装满的钱袋旁还伸着一只手，用“已经够了，还想更多”的画面记住贪婪这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Greedy or avaricious; wanting more money, possessions, or benefits than is reasonable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 贪婪的、贪财的；对金钱、财物或好处有过度欲望的，与 rgħib 同义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu xewqa eċċessiva għall-flus, għall-ġid jew għall-vantaġġi; sinonimu ta' rgħib.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与 rgħib 同义：贪婪的；贪财的。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, in-negozjant rgħibi jfittex il-profitt tiegħu mingħajr ma jqis il-ħtiġijiet tal-oħrajn.
formal.en: In the story, the greedy merchant pursues his own profit without considering other people's needs.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个贪婪的商人只追求自己的利润，不考虑别人的需要。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex qed issejjaħlu rgħibi? Pawlu: Għax irid jieħu l-flus kollha għalih, anki s-sehem tagħna.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why are you calling him greedy? Pawlu: Because he wants to take all the money for himself, even our share.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么说他贪婪？保罗：因为他想把所有钱都拿走，连我们的那份也要。

messages.speaker: Nina (合伙人)
messages.zh: 你为什么说他贪婪？
messages.en: Why are you calling him greedy?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (合伙人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax irid jieħu l-flus kollha għalih, anki s-sehem tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: Għax irid jieħu l-flus kollha għalih, anki s-sehem tagħna.
messages.zh: 因为他想把所有钱都拿走，连我们的那份也要。
messages.en: Because he wants to take all the money for himself, even our share.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bniedem rgħibi 作为整组记成“贪婪的人”；用它描述人，和表示“贪婪”这种欲望的名词 rgħiba 对照。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Very intense anger, expressed as fury or rage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 极其强烈的愤怒，即暴怒或狂怒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rabja qawwija ħafna, li tista' tidher fi kliem jew f'azzjonijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 暴怒；极其强烈的愤怒。
狂怒；怒不可遏的情绪。

formal.mt: L-awtriċi turi r-rgħim tal-personaġġ permezz ta' kliem qasir u deskrizzjonijiet tal-ġesti tiegħu.
formal.en: The author conveys the character's rage through brief utterances and descriptions of his gestures.
formal.zh: 作者通过简短的话语和对人物动作的描写，表现他的狂怒。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Smajt dik l-għajta ta' rgħim? Mark: Iva, xi ħadd irrabja ħafna. Ejja naraw x'ġara.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you hear that cry of fury? Mark: Yes, someone got very angry. Let's see what happened.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你听见刚才那声怒吼了吗？马克：听见了，有人发了很大的火。我们去看看发生了什么。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.zh: 你听见刚才那声怒吼了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that cry of fury?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, xi ħadd irrabja ħafna. Ejja naraw x'ġara.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, xi ħadd irrabja ħafna. Ejja naraw x'ġara.
messages.zh: 听见了，有人发了很大的火。我们去看看发生了什么。
messages.en: Yes, someone got very angry. Let's see what happened.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在情绪温度计的最高处写上这个词，旁边画一声怒吼，提醒自己它表示非常强烈的愤怒。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of pawning an item to obtain a loan; also the act of exchanging things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物品交作担保以借取钱款的典当行为；也可指交换物品的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għoti ta' oġġett bħala garanzija għal self ta' flus; ukoll l-att ta' bdil ta' ħaġa ma' oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 典当；以物品作担保换取借款的行为。
交换；以某物换取另一物的行为。

collocations.en: the exchanging of items between participants

formal.mt: Id-dokument jiddeskrivi r-rhin ta' ġojjelli bħala mezz biex is-sid jikseb self ta' flus.
formal.en: The document describes the pawning of jewellery as a way for the owner to obtain a loan.
formal.zh: 文件将典当珠宝描述为物主取得借款的一种方式。

colloquial.mt: Toni: X'tifhem b'rhin f'dan l-eżempju? Maja: Hawn ifisser li tagħti oġġett bħala garanzija għal self; f'eżempju ieħor jista' jfisser bdil.
colloquial.en: Toni: What do you mean by rhin in this example? Maja: Here it means giving an item as security for a loan; in another example it can mean exchanging.
colloquial.zh: 托尼：这个例子里的 rhin 是什么意思？玛雅：这里指拿物品作担保借款；在另一个例子里也可以指交换。

messages.speaker: Toni (学生)
messages.zh: 这个例子里的 rhin 是什么意思？
messages.en: What do you mean by rhin in this example?

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn ifisser li tagħti oġġett bħala garanzija għal self; f'eżempju ieħor jista' jfisser bdil.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn ifisser li tagħti oġġett bħala garanzija għal self; f'eżempju ieħor jista' jfisser bdil.
messages.zh: 这里指拿物品作担保借款；在另一个例子里也可以指交换。
messages.en: Here it means giving an item as security for a loan; in another example it can mean exchanging.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张情景卡记忆：一张是拿首饰作担保借钱，另一张是两人交换物品；分别对应典当和交换。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A reduction in a price or an amount returned to a buyer; in another sense, an abundant quantity of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指价格上的折扣或返还给买方的款项；另一个义项指某物数量很多。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tnaqqis fil-prezz jew somma li tingħata lura lix-xerrej; f'sens ieħor, kwantità kbira ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 折扣；返利；返还给买方的部分款项。
大量；充裕的数量。

formal.mt: Il-ħanut joffri ribass ta' għaxra fil-mija fuq dan il-prodott.
formal.en: The shop offers a ten per cent discount on this product.
formal.zh: 该商店为这款商品提供百分之十的折扣。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Hemm xi ribass fuq dan il-kowt? Pawlu: Iva, illum tħallas għoxrin ewro inqas.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is there a discount on this coat? Pawlu: Yes, today you pay twenty euros less.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这件大衣有折扣吗？保罗：有，今天便宜二十欧元。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm xi ribass fuq dan il-kowt?
messages.mt_standard: Hemm xi ribass fuq dan il-kowt?
messages.zh: 这件大衣有折扣吗？
messages.en: Is there a discount on this coat?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, illum tħallas għoxrin ewro inqas.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, illum tħallas għoxrin ewro inqas.
messages.zh: 有，今天便宜二十欧元。
messages.en: Yes, today you pay twenty euros less.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面分别记 ribass：商店价签对应折扣，堆满的果篮对应大量；看到上下文再选义项。

gloss_zh: 想两全其美；想兼得无法同时得到的好处

teaching_sense.en_definition: To want two benefits at the same time when having one prevents or conflicts with having the other.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 想同时得到彼此冲突、难以兼得的两种好处，常带有批评贪求两全的意味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed ikun irid żewġ vantaġġi fl-istess ħin, meta wieħed minnhom ma jkunx jaqbel mal-ieħor.

sense_translations.en_definition: to (want to) have one's cake and eat it too
sense_translations.zh_definition: 想鱼与熊掌兼得；想同时享有彼此冲突的两种好处。

collocations.mt: riedha ħobla u tredda', bla ebda kompromess
collocations.en: he wanted to have his cake and eat it too, without any compromise
collocations.zh: 他想两样好处都占，还不肯作任何让步

collocations.mt: riedha ħobla u tredda': il-qligħ kollu u ebda riskju
collocations.en: he wanted to have his cake and eat it too: all the profit and none of the risk
collocations.zh: 他想鱼与熊掌兼得：利润全拿，风险一点不担

formal.mt: In-negozjant riedha ħobla u tredda': talab il-qligħ kollu iżda rrifjuta li jieħu kwalunkwe riskju.
formal.en: The businessman wanted to have his cake and eat it too: he demanded all the profit but refused to take any risk.
formal.zh: 那位商人想鱼与熊掌兼得：他要求拿走全部利润，却拒绝承担任何风险。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark ried il-karozza għalih kuljum, imma riedni nħallas nofs l-ispejjeż. Lara: Riedha ħobla u tredda'!
colloquial.en: Maja: Mark wanted the car to himself every day, but he wanted me to pay half the costs. Lara: He wanted to have his cake and eat it too!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克想每天独占那辆车，却要我付一半费用。拉拉：他可真想把两头的好处都占了！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark ried il-karozza għalih kuljum, imma riedni nħallas nofs l-ispejjeż.
messages.mt_standard: Mark ried il-karozza għalih kuljum, imma riedni nħallas nofs l-ispejjeż.
messages.zh: 马克想每天独占那辆车，却要我付一半费用。
messages.en: Mark wanted the car to himself every day, but he wanted me to pay half the costs.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他可真想把两头的好处都占了！
messages.en: He wanted to have his cake and eat it too!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语当成一句批评来记：既要独占汽车，又要别人分摊费用，就是想把冲突的好处都拿到。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A form meaning 'he wanted me', often followed by a verb explaining what he wanted me to do.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示“他想要我”或“他想让我……”，后面常接动词，说明他希望我做什么。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma li tfisser li hu ried lili, spiss segwita minn verb li juri x'ried li nagħmel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: ried 加上表示“我”的 -ni，意为“他想要我”或“他想让我……”。

collocations.en: he wanted me to help him
he wanted me to go with him

formal.mt: Id-direttur riedni nipprepara rapport qabel il-laqgħa.
formal.en: The director wanted me to prepare a report before the meeting.
formal.zh: 主任想让我在开会前准备一份报告。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex ċempillek Mark? Lara: Riedni ngħinu jġorr il-kaxxi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Mark call you? Lara: He wanted me to help him carry the boxes.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克为什么给你打电话？拉拉：他想让我帮他搬箱子。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么给你打电话？
messages.en: Why did Mark call you?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他想让我帮他搬箱子。
messages.en: He wanted me to help him carry the boxes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按给定结构把 ried 和 -ni 连起来记成“他想让我”，再接具体动作，例如 ngħinu“帮他”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Oregano, an aromatic herb whose leaves are used to flavour food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 牛至，一种叶子可用来给食物调味的芳香草本植物，也指这种香草调料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaxixa aromatika li l-weraq tagħha jintuża biex jagħti t-togħma lill-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 牛至；用作烹饪调料的牛至叶。

collocations.en: a little oregano on the pizza
collocations.zh: 撒在披萨上的少许牛至

formal.mt: Żid kuċċarina riegnu niexef maz-zalza tat-tadam u ħawwad sew.
formal.en: Add a teaspoon of dried oregano to the tomato sauce and stir well.
formal.zh: 向番茄酱中加入一茶匙干牛至，并充分搅拌。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Trid ftit riegnu fuq il-pizza? Sara: Iva, imma ftit biss, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Mark: Would you like a little oregano on the pizza? Sara: Yes, but just a little, please.
colloquial.zh: 马克：披萨上要撒点牛至吗？萨拉：要，不过请只放一点。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 披萨上要撒点牛至吗？
messages.en: Would you like a little oregano on the pizza?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ftit biss, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ftit biss, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 要，不过请只放一点。
messages.en: Yes, but just a little, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一小撮 riegnu 撒在披萨上，用“披萨上的牛至香草”这个厨房画面记住词义。

gloss_zh: 未能成功的；未能完成的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Failing to develop fully or to achieve the intended result.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容某事未能充分发展、未能完成，或没有达到预期结果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jiżviluppax għalkollox jew ma jilħaqx ir-riżultat mixtieq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 未能完成的；未能成功的；未达到预期结果的。

collocations.zh: 一番未能取得结果的努力

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi tentattiv riemi biex jintlaħaq ftehim bejn iż-żewġ naħat.
formal.en: The report describes an abortive attempt to reach an agreement between the two sides.
formal.zh: 报告描述了双方一次未能达成协议的尝试。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Irnexxielkom taslu għal ftehim? Pawlu: Le, kien tentattiv riemi; ħadd ma ried iċedi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you manage to reach an agreement? Pawlu: No, it was an abortive attempt; nobody was willing to give way.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你们达成协议了吗？保罗：没有，那次尝试没成功；谁也不肯让步。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 你们达成协议了吗？
messages.en: Did you manage to reach an agreement?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, kien tentattiv riemi; ħadd ma ried iċedi.
messages.mt_standard: Le, kien tentattiv riemi; ħadd ma ried iċedi.
messages.zh: 没有，那次尝试没成功；谁也不肯让步。
messages.en: No, it was an abortive attempt; nobody was willing to give way.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 riemi 放进“尝试开始了，却没有达到目标”的情境中记忆，重点抓住未成、未果的结果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a state of sleep, rather than awake.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 处于睡眠状态，表示已经睡着或正在睡觉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fi stat ta' rqad, jiġifieri mhux imqajjem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 睡着的；处于睡眠状态的。

formal.mt: Meta wasal it-tabib, il-pazjent kien rieqed fis-sodda.
formal.en: When the doctor arrived, the patient was asleep in bed.
formal.zh: 医生到达时，病人正在床上睡觉。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn hu Ben? Lara: Għadu rieqed. Tkellimx għoli, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where is Ben? Lara: He's still asleep. Please don't speak loudly.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：本在哪里？拉拉：他还在睡觉。请别大声说话。

messages.speaker: Sara (姐姐)
messages.zh: 本在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Ben?

messages.speaker: Lara (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu rieqed. Tkellimx għoli, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu rieqed. Tkellimx għoli, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 他还在睡觉。请别大声说话。
messages.en: He's still asleep. Please don't speak loudly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 rieqed，就想象一个闭眼熟睡的人；用 għadu rieqed“他还睡着”整块记忆这个状态词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To grow feathers, as a young bird does while developing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指鸟类长出羽毛，尤其可用于描述幼鸟生长过程中的变化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għasfur jikber ir-rix fuq ġismu matul l-iżvilupp tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 长出羽毛；身上开始生长羽毛。

formal.mt: Il-fellus riex matul il-ġimgħat ta' wara u kompla jikber.
formal.en: The chick grew feathers over the following weeks and continued to grow.
formal.zh: 在接下来的几周里，小鸡长出了羽毛，并继续长大。

colloquial.mt: Ben: Ara l-fellus! Riex malajr! Maja: Iva, issa għandu ħafna aktar rix minn qabel.
colloquial.en: Ben: Look at the chick! It grew feathers quickly! Maja: Yes, it has much more plumage now than before.
colloquial.zh: 本：快看这只小鸡！它这么快就长出羽毛了！玛雅：是啊，它现在的羽毛比以前多多了。

messages.speaker: Ben (儿子)
messages.zh: 快看这只小鸡！它这么快就长出羽毛了！
messages.en: Look at the chick! It grew feathers quickly!

messages.speaker: Maja (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa għandu ħafna aktar rix minn qabel.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa għandu ħafna aktar rix minn qabel.
messages.zh: 是啊，它现在的羽毛比以前多多了。
messages.en: Yes, it has much more plumage now than before.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用幼鸟逐渐披上羽毛的连续画面记 riex；它表达的是“长出羽毛”这一变化过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of stamping on or treading over something with the feet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用脚踩、踏或踏压某物的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li tagħfas jew timxi fuq xi ħaġa bis-saqajn.

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of stamping or treading
sense_translations.zh_definition: 踩踏或踏压的动作。

formal.mt: Ir-rifs fuq il-ħamrija mxarrba ħalla marki ċari ħdejn id-daħla.
formal.en: Treading on the wet soil left clear marks near the entrance.
formal.zh: 踩踏湿润的泥土，在入口附近留下了清晰的痕迹。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex poġġejt ħabel madwar il-ħaxix? Pawlu: Biex innaqqas ir-rifs; għadni kemm żrajt iż-żerriegħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you put a rope around the grass? Pawlu: To reduce treading on it; I've only just sown the seeds.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么在草地周围围了绳子？保罗：为了减少踩踏；我才刚播下种子。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 你为什么在草地周围围了绳子？
messages.en: Why did you put a rope around the grass?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex innaqqas ir-rifs; għadni kemm żrajt iż-żerriegħa.
messages.mt_standard: Biex innaqqas ir-rifs; għadni kemm żrajt iż-żerriegħa.
messages.zh: 为了减少踩踏；我才刚播下种子。
messages.en: To reduce treading on it; I've only just sown the seeds.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象刚播种的草地被脚踩压，把 rifs 与“踩踏这个动作”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A single tread or an instance of pressing down with the foot.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用脚踏下的一下，或一次踩踏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Darba waħda li tagħfas b'sieqek fuq xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一脚；一下踏压或踩踏。

formal.mt: Rifsa waħda fuq il-fjura kienet biżżejjed biex tkissrilha z-zokk.
formal.en: A single tread on the flower was enough to break its stem.
formal.zh: 只踩了那朵花一脚，就足以把花茎踩断。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ajma, tajtni rifsa fuq sieqi! Mark: Skużani, ma rajtekx warajja.
colloquial.en: Lara: Ow, you stepped on my foot! Mark: Sorry, I didn't see you behind me.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：哎哟，你踩了我的脚！马克：对不起，我没看见你在我身后。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 哎哟，你踩了我的脚！
messages.en: Ow, you stepped on my foot!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 对不起，我没看见你在我身后。
messages.en: Sorry, I didn't see you behind me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rifsa 想成脚落地的“一下”：在人群里被踩一脚，就记住这个具体动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A safe place where someone can find protection from danger or hardship.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人能够躲避危险或困境、获得保护的安全场所。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post sigur fejn persuna tista' ssib kenn u protezzjoni mill-periklu jew mit-tbatija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 避难处、庇护所或收容处，指提供安全保护的场所。

formal.mt: Waqt il-maltemp, il-familji sabu rifuġju f'bini pubbliku qrib il-pjazza.
formal.en: During the storm, the families found shelter in a public building near the square.
formal.zh: 暴风雨期间，各家人在广场附近的一座公共建筑里找到了避难处。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn nistgħu nsibu rifuġju mix-xita? Toni: Hemm bini miftuħ hemmhekk; ejja nidħlu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where can we find shelter from the rain? Toni: There's an open building over there; let's go inside.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们能到哪里避雨？托尼：那边有座开着门的建筑，我们进去吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (徒步同伴)
messages.zh: 我们能到哪里避雨？
messages.en: Where can we find shelter from the rain?

messages.speaker: Toni (徒步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm bini miftuħ hemmhekk; ejja nidħlu.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm bini miftuħ hemmhekk; ejja nidħlu.
messages.zh: 那边有座开着门的建筑，我们进去吧。
messages.en: There's an open building over there; let's go inside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象暴风雨中亮着灯的安全小屋，把 rifuġju 与“进去就能获得庇护的地方”联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A straight tool used for measuring or drawing straight lines; also, a line.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于测量或画直线的尺子；也指一条线或一行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda dritta biex tkejjel jew tiġbed linji dritti; ukoll linja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 直尺，用于测量长度或画直线的工具。
线；一条线或一行。

formal.mt: L-istudent uża riga biex ikejjel it-tul tar-rettangolu fid-dijagramma.
formal.en: The student used a ruler to measure the length of the rectangle in the diagram.
formal.zh: 学生用直尺测量了图中长方形的长度。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek riga? Irrid inkejjel din il-karta. Luqa: Iva, ħu din; hija twila tletin ċentimetru.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you got a ruler? I want to measure this paper. Luqa: Yes, take this one; it's thirty centimetres long.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你有直尺吗？我想量一下这张纸。卢卡：有，拿这把吧，长三十厘米。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek riga? Irrid inkejjel din il-karta.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek riga? Irrid inkejjel din il-karta.
messages.zh: 你有直尺吗？我想量一下这张纸。
messages.en: Have you got a ruler? I want to measure this paper.

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħu din; hija twila tletin ċentimetru.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħu din; hija twila tletin ċentimetru.
messages.zh: 有，拿这把吧，长三十厘米。
messages.en: Yes, take this one; it's thirty centimetres long.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拿着一把直尺画出一条直线，用“尺子与线条”这组课堂画面同时记住 riga 的两义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To hold someone or something back, or to become reactionary in outlook.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 约束或制止某人、某事物；也指思想立场变得反动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iżżomm lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa lura, jew issir reazzjonarju fil-fehmiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 约束、抑制或制止，使其不能自由行动或发展。
变得反动；思想或政治立场转向反动。

collocations.en: became reactionary in his political views

formal.mt: Wara l-bidla fit-tmexxija, il-politiku rigen u beda jopponi r-riformi li qabel kien jappoġġa.
formal.en: After the change in leadership, the politician became reactionary and began opposing the reforms he had previously supported.
formal.zh: 领导层更换后，这名政治人物转向反动立场，开始反对他先前支持的改革。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'ġara meta n-nies resqu lejn il-bieb? Mark: Il-kap rigen lill-folla, u kulħadd stenna barra.
colloquial.en: Rita: What happened when people approached the door? Mark: The supervisor restrained the crowd, and everyone waited outside.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：人们走近门口时发生了什么？马克：负责人制止了人群，大家都在外面等候。

messages.speaker: Rita (活动参加者)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ġara meta n-nies resqu lejn il-bieb?
messages.mt_standard: X'ġara meta n-nies resqu lejn il-bieb?
messages.zh: 人们走近门口时发生了什么？
messages.en: What happened when people approached the door?

messages.speaker: Mark (活动工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kap rigen lill-folla, u kulħadd stenna barra.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kap rigen lill-folla, u kulħadd stenna barra.
messages.zh: 负责人制止了人群，大家都在外面等候。
messages.en: The supervisor restrained the crowd, and everyone waited outside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 rigen 做两张记忆卡：一张画负责人拦住人群，另一张写政治立场变得反动，分别记牢两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The grazing of animals, especially their feeding on grass in an open area.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 牲畜在草地等地方吃草的活动，也可指相应的放牧活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività tal-annimali meta jieklu l-ħaxix f'għalqa jew f'post miftuħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 动物吃草；牲畜的放牧活动。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi ħalla parti mill-art għar-rigħi tan-nagħaġ matul ir-rebbiegħa.
formal.en: The farmer set aside part of the land for sheep grazing during the spring.
formal.zh: 农民留出了一部分土地，供羊群在春季吃草。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex ma żrajtx din l-għalqa? Pawlu: Ħallejtha għar-rigħi; in-nagħaġ jieklu hawn filgħodu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why didn't you plant this field? Pawlu: I left it for grazing; the sheep feed here in the morning.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你为什么没有在这块田里种东西？保罗：我把它留作放牧用，羊群早上在这里吃草。

messages.speaker: Anna (访客)
messages.zh: 你为什么没有在这块田里种东西？
messages.en: Why didn't you plant this field?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħallejtha għar-rigħi; in-nagħaġ jieklu hawn filgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Ħallejtha għar-rigħi; in-nagħaġ jieklu hawn filgħodu.
messages.zh: 我把它留作放牧用，羊群早上在这里吃草。
messages.en: I left it for grazing; the sheep feed here in the morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一群羊低头慢慢吃草，把 rigħi 记作整幅画面中的“吃草、放牧活动”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who uses threats to reveal damaging information to force someone to give money or do something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以揭露不利信息相威胁，强迫他人交钱或做某事的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li thedded li tikxef informazzjoni li tagħmel ħsara lil xi ħadd biex iġġiegħlu jħallas jew jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 敲诈者；以揭露秘密或不利信息相威胁来索取钱财或迫使他人服从的人。

formal.mt: Ir-rikattatur talab il-flus u hedded li jippubblika l-ittri privati.
formal.en: The blackmailer demanded money and threatened to publish the private letters.
formal.zh: 勒索者索要钱财，并威胁要公开那些私人信件。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dak ir-raġel talabni l-flus biex ma jikxifx is-sigriet tiegħi. Luqa: Dak rikattatur; qed juża s-sigriet biex iġiegħlek tħallas.
colloquial.en: Anna: That man demanded money from me to keep my secret. Luqa: He is a blackmailer; he is using the secret to make you pay.
colloquial.zh: Anna：那个男人向我要钱，才肯替我保守秘密。Luqa：他是个勒索者，正利用这个秘密逼你付钱。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ir-raġel talabni l-flus biex ma jikxifx is-sigriet tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Dak ir-raġel talabni l-flus biex ma jikxifx is-sigriet tiegħi.
messages.zh: 那个男人向我要钱，才肯替我保守秘密。
messages.en: That man demanded money from me to keep my secret.

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak rikattatur; qed juża s-sigriet biex iġiegħlek tħallas.
messages.mt_standard: Dak rikattatur; qed juża s-sigriet biex iġiegħlek tħallas.
messages.zh: 他是个勒索者，正利用这个秘密逼你付钱。
messages.en: He is a blackmailer; he is using the secret to make you pay.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一句情境台词来记：给钱，否则公开秘密。说这句话索取钱财的人就是勒索者。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity or act of riding, for example on a horse or a bicycle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 骑在马、自行车等上面行进的行为或活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew l-attività li wieħed jirkeb, pereżempju fuq żiemel jew rota.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 骑乘的行为；如骑马或骑自行车这一活动。

formal.mt: Il-kors jinkludi taħriġ bażiku fir-rikbien taż-żwiemel.
formal.en: The course includes basic training in horse riding.
formal.zh: 该课程包括基础骑马训练。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Tħobb ir-rikbien taż-żwiemel? Ben: Iva, imma għadni qed nitgħallem.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you like horse riding? Ben: Yes, but I am still learning.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你喜欢骑马吗？Ben：喜欢，不过我还在学。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢骑马吗？
messages.en: Do you like horse riding?

messages.speaker: Ben (骑马初学者)
messages.zh: 喜欢，不过我还在学。
messages.en: Yes, but I am still learning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己跨坐在马背或自行车上前进，把整个骑乘活动装进这个名词，而不是只记坐骑。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To support something with a prop or strengthen a structure with additional support.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用支撑物撑住某物，或增加支撑以加固结构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iżomm xi ħaġa wieqfa permezz ta' appoġġ, jew isaħħaħ struttura b'appoġġ addizzjonali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用支撑物撑住或托住某物，使其保持位置。
为结构增加支撑，使其更加稳固。

collocations.zh: 对结构进行了支撑加固

formal.mt: Il-bennej riken il-ħajt b'appoġġ temporanju qabel ma beda t-tiswija.
formal.en: The builder propped up the wall with a temporary support before starting the repair.
formal.zh: 建筑工人在开始维修前，用临时支撑撑住了墙体。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex hemm dak l-appoġġ mal-ħajt? Toni: Il-bennej riken il-ħajt bih biex iżommu wieqaf.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why is that support against the wall? Toni: The builder propped up the wall with it to keep it standing.
colloquial.zh: Rita：墙边为什么有那个支撑物？Toni：建筑工人用它撑住墙，让墙保持直立。

messages.speaker: Rita (住户)
messages.zh: 墙边为什么有那个支撑物？
messages.en: Why is that support against the wall?

messages.speaker: Toni (维修工人)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-bennej riken il-ħajt bih biex iżommu wieqaf.
messages.mt_standard: Il-bennej riken il-ħajt bih biex iżommu wieqaf.
messages.zh: 建筑工人用它撑住墙，让墙保持直立。
messages.en: The builder propped up the wall with it to keep it standing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一面摇晃的墙被支撑杆顶稳：撑住单个物体与加固整个结构，都抓住增加支撑这一动作。

gloss_zh: 让某人搭乘；把某物倚靠在另一物上

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give someone a ride, or to place something so that it leans on something else.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 让某人搭乘交通工具，或把某物放成倚靠另一物的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti lil xi ħadd rikba, jew iqiegħed xi ħaġa tistrieħ fuq xi ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 让某人搭乘；载某人一程。

sense_translations.en_definition: to lean sth. on sth. else
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某物倚靠在另一物上，使其得到支撑。

collocations.en: gave his friend a ride in the car
leaned the ladder against the wall

formal.mt: Is-sewwieq rikkeb lill-viżitatur fil-karozza u wasslu sal-istazzjon.
formal.en: The driver gave the visitor a ride in the car and took him to the station.
formal.zh: 司机让来访者搭车，把他送到了车站。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Fejn poġġa s-sellum Pawlu? Ġanni: Rikkeb is-sellum mal-ħajt tal-garaxx.
colloquial.en: Marta: Where did Pawlu put the ladder? Ġanni: He leaned the ladder against the garage wall.
colloquial.zh: Marta：Pawlu把梯子放在哪里了？Ġanni：他把梯子靠在车库的墙上了。

messages.speaker: Marta (邻居)
messages.zh: Pawlu把梯子放在哪里了？
messages.en: Where did Pawlu put the ladder?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (邻居)
messages.zh: 他把梯子靠在车库的墙上了。
messages.en: He leaned the ladder against the garage wall.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分成两张情境卡记忆：一张是司机让朋友搭车，另一张是工人把梯子靠墙；分别对应两个动词义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Wealth in money or possessions, or richness in variety, content, or quality.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 金钱或财产方面的富有，也指种类、内容或品质上的丰富。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Abbundanza ta' flus jew ġid, jew abbundanza fil-varjetà, fil-kontenut jew fil-kwalità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 财富；富有；也指内容、种类或品质的丰富。

formal.mt: Il-mużew juri r-rikkezza kulturali tal-pajjiż permezz tal-arti u t-tradizzjonijiet tiegħu.
formal.en: The museum shows the country's cultural richness through its art and traditions.
formal.zh: 博物馆通过该国的艺术与传统，展示其文化的丰富性。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Meta tgħid rikkezza, qed titkellem fuq il-flus? Samwel: Hawn qed nitkellem fuq ir-rikkezza kulturali, bħall-arti u t-tradizzjonijiet.
colloquial.en: Elena: When you say wealth, are you talking about money? Samwel: Here I mean cultural richness, such as art and traditions.
colloquial.zh: Elena：你说财富，是在说钱吗？Samwel：这里我说的是文化的丰富性，比如艺术和传统。

messages.speaker: Elena (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta tgħid rikkezza, qed titkellem fuq il-flus?
messages.mt_standard: Meta tgħid rikkezza, qed titkellem fuq il-flus?
messages.zh: 你说财富，是在说钱吗？
