messages.en: When you say wealth, are you talking about money?

messages.speaker: Samwel (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn qed nitkellem fuq ir-rikkezza kulturali, bħall-arti u t-tradizzjonijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn qed nitkellem fuq ir-rikkezza kulturali, bħall-arti u t-tradizzjonijiet.
messages.zh: 这里我说的是文化的丰富性，比如艺术和传统。
messages.en: Here I mean cultural richness, such as art and traditions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个装满东西的箱子记忆：一个装钱财，表示财富；一个装艺术与传统，表示文化的丰富性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Directly connected with the subject, question, or situation being considered.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与正在讨论的主题、问题或情况直接有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam direttament mas-suġġett, il-mistoqsija jew is-sitwazzjoni li tkun qed tiġi kkunsidrata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 相关的；与当前主题或问题有关的。

formal.mt: L-applikant għandu jehmeż id-dokumenti kollha rilevanti mal-applikazzjoni.
formal.en: The applicant must attach all relevant documents to the application.
formal.zh: 申请人必须在申请中附上所有相关文件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-artiklu rilevanti għall-proġett tagħna? Pawlu: Iva, fih informazzjoni dwar l-istess suġġett.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this article relevant to our project? Pawlu: Yes, it contains information about the same subject.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这篇文章跟我们的项目有关吗？保罗：有，里面有关于同一主题的信息。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这篇文章跟我们的项目有关吗？
messages.en: Is this article relevant to our project?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, fih informazzjoni dwar l-istess suġġett.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, fih informazzjoni dwar l-istess suġġett.
messages.zh: 有，里面有关于同一主题的信息。
messages.en: Yes, it contains information about the same subject.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rilevanti 贴在与题目有关的材料上：能帮助回答当前问题，就是“相关的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The connection that something has with a particular subject, question, or situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某事物与特定主题、问题或情况之间的关联。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ir-rabta li xi ħaġa għandha ma' suġġett, mistoqsija jew sitwazzjoni partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 相关性；与某个主题、问题或情况的关联。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega r-rilevanza ta' dawn ir-riżultati għall-istudju.
formal.en: The report explains the relevance of these results to the study.
formal.zh: 报告解释了这些结果与该研究的关联。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'rilevanza għandu dan l-eżempju għas-suġġett tagħna? Mark: Juri kif tintuża l-idea fil-ħajja ta' kuljum.
colloquial.en: Sara: What relevance does this example have to our subject? Mark: It shows how the idea is used in everyday life.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个例子跟我们的主题有什么关联？马克：它展示了这个想法如何运用于日常生活。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: X'rilevanza għandu dan l-eżempju għas-suġġett tagħna?
messages.mt_standard: X'rilevanza għandu dan l-eżempju għas-suġġett tagħna?
messages.zh: 这个例子跟我们的主题有什么关联？
messages.en: What relevance does this example have to our subject?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Juri kif tintuża l-idea fil-ħajja ta' kuljum.
messages.mt_standard: Juri kif tintuża l-idea fil-ħajja ta' kuljum.
messages.zh: 它展示了这个想法如何运用于日常生活。
messages.en: It shows how the idea is used in everyday life.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rilevanza 想成材料与题目之间的一条连线：这个名词说的是“相关性”，不是“相关的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose job is to gather information about events and report the news.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以搜集事件信息并报道新闻为工作的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li xogħolha hu li tiġbor informazzjoni dwar ġrajjiet u tirrapporta l-aħbarijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 记者；搜集信息并报道新闻的人。

formal.mt: Ir-riporter intervista lir-residenti u ħejja rapport dwar is-sitwazzjoni fir-raħal.
formal.en: The reporter interviewed the residents and prepared a report on the situation in the village.
formal.zh: 记者采访了居民，并就村里的情况撰写了一篇报道。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hu dak bil-mikrofonu ħdejn il-grawnd? Toni: Hu riporter sportiv; qed jintervista lill-plejers.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is that with the microphone next to the pitch? Toni: He's a sports reporter; he's interviewing the players.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：球场边那个拿着麦克风的人是谁？托尼：他是体育记者，正在采访球员。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak bil-mikrofonu ħdejn il-grawnd?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak bil-mikrofonu ħdejn il-grawnd?
messages.zh: 球场边那个拿着麦克风的人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that with the microphone next to the pitch?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu riporter sportiv; qed jintervista lill-plejers.
messages.mt_standard: Hu riporter sportiv; qed jintervista lill-plejers.
messages.zh: 他是体育记者，正在采访球员。
messages.en: He's a sports reporter; he's interviewing the players.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 riporter，就想象一个拿着麦克风采访、随后报道新闻的人，把词与“记者”的工作画面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the biological process by which living organisms produce offspring.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与生物产生后代的生殖或繁殖过程有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-proċess bijoloġiku li bih l-organiżmi jipproduċu l-frieħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生殖的；与生物繁殖或产生后代有关的。

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina ċ-ċiklu riproduttiv ta' din l-ispeċi ta' għasafar.
formal.en: The study examines the reproductive cycle of this bird species.
formal.zh: 该研究考察了这种鸟类的繁殖周期。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi jfisser 'riproduttiv' f'dan il-kapitlu? David: Ifisser li għandu x'jaqsam ma' kif l-organiżmi jipproduċu l-frieħ.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does 'reproductive' mean in this chapter? David: It means relating to how organisms produce offspring.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这一章里的“riproduttiv”是什么意思？戴维：意思是与生物如何产生后代有关。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 这一章里的“riproduttiv”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'reproductive' mean in this chapter?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li għandu x'jaqsam ma' kif l-organiżmi jipproduċu l-frieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li għandu x'jaqsam ma' kif l-organiżmi jipproduċu l-frieħ.
messages.zh: 意思是与生物如何产生后代有关。
messages.en: It means relating to how organisms produce offspring.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 riproduttiv 放进“繁殖周期”的图里记；搭配 sistema 时记作 sistema riproduttiva，表示“生殖系统”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of producing offspring, or the act or result of making a copy of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 生物产生后代的过程；也指复制某物的行为或所得的复制品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih l-organiżmi jipproduċu l-frieħ, jew l-att li ssir kopja ta' xi ħaġa u l-kopja li tirriżulta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 繁殖；生殖；也可指复制行为或复制品，具体含义由语境决定。

formal.mt: Il-mużew juri riproduzzjoni tal-pittura, filwaqt li l-oriġinal jinżamm fil-maħżen.
formal.en: The museum displays a reproduction of the painting, while the original is kept in storage.
formal.zh: 博物馆展出的是这幅画的复制品，原作则存放在库房中。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din il-pittura hi l-oriġinal? Mark: Le, hi riproduzzjoni, imma d-dettalji jidhru ċari ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this painting the original? Mark: No, it's a reproduction, but the details look very clear.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这幅画是原作吗？马克：不是，是复制品，不过细节看起来很清楚。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.zh: 这幅画是原作吗？
messages.en: Is this painting the original?

messages.speaker: Mark (导览员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hi riproduzzjoni, imma d-dettalji jidhru ċari ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hi riproduzzjoni, imma d-dettalji jidhru ċari ħafna.
messages.zh: 不是，是复制品，不过细节看起来很清楚。
messages.en: No, it's a reproduction, but the details look very clear.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面记 riproduzzjoni：植物产生新植株是“繁殖”，画作被做成另一份是“复制”；看上下文选义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of curing an illness or restoring someone to health.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 治愈疾病或使人恢复健康的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess ta' fejqan ta' marda jew ta' persuna marida.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 治愈；使疾病痊愈或使人恢复健康的过程。

formal.mt: F'dan it-test, il-kelma 'riqi' tirreferi għall-fejqan tal-mard.
formal.en: In this text, the word 'riqi' refers to the curing of illnesses.
formal.zh: 在这篇文本中，“riqi”一词指疾病的治愈。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'riqi' hawn? Pawlu: Hawn tfisser fejqan; qed titkellem dwar il-fejqan tal-mard.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does the word 'riqi' mean here? Pawlu: Here it means curing; it is talking about curing illnesses.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：“riqi”这个词在这里是什么意思？保罗：这里是“治愈”的意思，说的是治愈疾病。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: “riqi”这个词在这里是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word 'riqi' mean here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser fejqan; qed titkellem dwar il-fejqan tal-mard.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser fejqan; qed titkellem dwar il-fejqan tal-mard.
messages.zh: 这里是“治愈”的意思，说的是治愈疾病。
messages.en: Here it means curing; it is talking about curing illnesses.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 riqi 与“从患病走向恢复健康”的过程画面连起来记，抓住本条所给的“治愈”义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The risk of financial loss because a borrower or another party fails to make an agreed payment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因借款人或其他交易方未按约定付款而遭受经济损失的风险。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ir-riskju ta' telf finanzjarju minħabba li min jissellef jew parti oħra ma tagħmilx ħlas miftiehem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 信用风险；借款人或交易方未按约定履行付款义务而造成损失的风险。

formal.mt: Qabel ma japprova s-self, il-bank iwettaq valutazzjoni tar-riskju ta' kreditu.
formal.en: Before approving the loan, the bank carries out a credit risk assessment.
formal.zh: 银行在批准贷款之前会进行信用风险评估。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex il-bank irid jara d-dħul tiegħi? Mark: Biex jivvaluta r-riskju ta' kreditu, jiġifieri r-riskju li ma tkunx tista' tħallas lura s-self.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why does the bank want to see my income? Mark: To assess credit risk, meaning the risk that you might be unable to repay the loan.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：银行为什么要看我的收入？马克：为了评估信用风险，也就是你可能无法偿还贷款的风险。

messages.speaker: Sara (贷款申请人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-bank irid jara d-dħul tiegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-bank irid jara d-dħul tiegħi?
messages.zh: 银行为什么要看我的收入？
messages.en: Why does the bank want to see my income?

messages.speaker: Mark (银行职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex jivvaluta r-riskju ta' kreditu, jiġifieri r-riskju li ma tkunx tista' tħallas lura s-self.
messages.mt_standard: Biex jivvaluta r-riskju ta' kreditu, jiġifieri r-riskju li ma tkunx tista' tħallas lura s-self.
messages.zh: 为了评估信用风险，也就是你可能无法偿还贷款的风险。
messages.en: To assess credit risk, meaning the risk that you might be unable to repay the loan.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 riskju ta' kreditu 整体记成“借出去的钱可能收不回来”：先想到约定还款，再想到未能还款的风险。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Involving a possibility of danger, harm, loss, or failure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 存在发生危险、伤害、损失或失败的可能性的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinvolvi l-possibbiltà ta' periklu, ħsara, telf jew falliment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有风险的；可能带来危险、损失或失败的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport iqis dan il-pjan bħala riskjuż minħabba n-nuqqas ta' informazzjoni.
formal.en: The report considers this plan risky because of the lack of information.
formal.zh: 报告认为，由于信息不足，这项计划存在风险。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Naqsmu x-xmara minn hawn? Maja: Jidher riskjuż; l-ilma miexi malajr. Ejja nużaw il-pont.
colloquial.en: Toni: Shall we cross the river here? Maja: It looks risky; the water is flowing fast. Let's use the bridge.
colloquial.zh: 托尼：我们从这里过河吗？玛雅：看起来有风险，水流很急。我们走桥吧。

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们从这里过河吗？
messages.en: Shall we cross the river here?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jidher riskjuż; l-ilma miexi malajr. Ejja nużaw il-pont.
messages.mt_standard: Jidher riskjuż; l-ilma miexi malajr. Ejja nużaw il-pont.
messages.zh: 看起来有风险，水流很急。我们走桥吧。
messages.en: It looks risky; the water is flowing fast. Let's use the bridge.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象急流旁写着 riskjuż 的提示牌，记住“有风险的”；再配对记 pass riskjuż 和 deċiżjoni riskjuża。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling or expression of regard for someone, including treating them with consideration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对他人的重视与敬意，也指在言行中体谅并尊重对方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stima lejn xi ħadd u l-attenzjoni li nuru lejn is-sentimenti u d-drittijiet tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 尊重；敬意

formal.mt: L-istudenti għandhom juru rispett lejn xulxin waqt id-diskussjoni.
formal.en: Students should show respect for one another during the discussion.
formal.zh: 学生在讨论时应当相互尊重。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ma naqbilx miegħu, imma rrid nitkellem b'rispett. Mark: Sewwa. Tista' tgħid l-opinjoni tiegħek mingħajr ma tweġġgħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: I disagree with him, but I want to speak respectfully. Mark: Right. You can express your opinion without hurting him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我不同意他，但我想以尊重的态度说话。马克：对。你可以表达自己的意见，又不伤害他。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma naqbilx miegħu, imma rrid nitkellem b'rispett.
messages.mt_standard: Ma naqbilx miegħu, imma rrid nitkellem b'rispett.
messages.zh: 我不同意他，但我想以尊重的态度说话。
messages.en: I disagree with him, but I want to speak respectfully.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwa. Tista' tgħid l-opinjoni tiegħek mingħajr ma tweġġgħu.
messages.mt_standard: Sewwa. Tista' tgħid l-opinjoni tiegħek mingħajr ma tweġġgħu.
messages.zh: 对。你可以表达自己的意见，又不伤害他。
messages.en: Right. You can express your opinion without hurting him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象讨论时先听完对方的话：rispett 是心里的尊重，也能通过说话态度表现出来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Deserving respect or regarded as decent and socially acceptable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 值得尊敬的，或被认为正派、体面且符合社会认可标准的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jistħoqqlu rispett jew li jitqies deċenti u aċċettabbli fis-soċjetà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 值得尊敬的；正派的；体面的

formal.mt: Il-kandidata hija persuna rispettabbli li dejjem taqdi dmirijietha b'onestà.
formal.en: The candidate is a respectable person who always carries out her duties honestly.
formal.zh: 这位候选人值得尊敬，始终诚实地履行职责。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'taħseb dwar is-sid il-ġdid tal-ħanut? Pawlu: Jidher raġel rispettabbli; jittratta lil kulħadd sew.
colloquial.en: Lara: What do you think of the shop's new owner? Pawlu: He seems like a respectable man; he treats everyone well.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你觉得这家店的新老板怎么样？保罗：他看起来是个正派的人，对大家都很好。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 你觉得这家店的新老板怎么样？
messages.en: What do you think of the shop's new owner?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Jidher raġel rispettabbli; jittratta lil kulħadd sew.
messages.mt_standard: Jidher raġel rispettabbli; jittratta lil kulħadd sew.
messages.zh: 他看起来是个正派的人，对大家都很好。
messages.en: He seems like a respectable man; he treats everyone well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给一位诚实可靠的人贴上“值得尊敬”的标签来记 rispettabbli；重点是这个人获得怎样的评价。

gloss_zh: 体面；正派；受人尊敬的名声

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality or reputation of being decent, socially acceptable, and worthy of respect.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因正派、体面和符合社会认可标准而值得尊敬的特质或名声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità jew ir-reputazzjoni ta' min jitqies deċenti, aċċettabbli fis-soċjetà u li jistħoqqlu rispett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 体面；正派；值得尊敬的特质或社会名声

formal.mt: Ir-rumanz jesplora d-differenza bejn id-dehra ta' rispettabilità u l-imġiba vera tal-karattri.
formal.en: The novel explores the difference between the appearance of respectability and the characters' actual conduct.
formal.zh: 这部小说探讨人物表面的体面形象与实际行为之间的差异。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fil-ktieb, għaliex il-familja taħbi kull problema? David: Għax tinkwieta ħafna dwar ir-rispettabilità tagħha u dwar x'jgħidu n-nies.
colloquial.en: Sara: In the book, why does the family hide every problem? David: Because it worries a lot about its respectability and what people will say.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：书里的这个家庭为什么什么问题都要隐瞒？戴维：因为他们很在意家庭的体面名声，也很在意别人会怎么说。

messages.speaker: Sara (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-ktieb, għaliex il-familja taħbi kull problema?
messages.mt_standard: Fil-ktieb, għaliex il-familja taħbi kull problema?
messages.zh: 书里的这个家庭为什么什么问题都要隐瞒？
messages.en: In the book, why does the family hide every problem?

messages.speaker: David (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax tinkwieta ħafna dwar ir-rispettabilità tagħha u dwar x'jgħidu n-nies.
messages.mt_standard: Għax tinkwieta ħafna dwar ir-rispettabilità tagħha u dwar x'jgħidu n-nies.
messages.zh: 因为他们很在意家庭的体面名声，也很在意别人会怎么说。
messages.en: Because it worries a lot about its respectability and what people will say.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rispettabilità 想成别人眼中的一张“体面名声卡”：它是抽象的特质或声誉，可用来讨论社会评价。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Showing respect and consideration for another person through words or behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过言语或行为表现出对他人的尊重与体谅的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri rispett u konsiderazzjoni lejn ħaddieħor bil-kliem jew bl-imġiba tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 恭敬的；表现出尊重的

formal.mt: L-awtur juża ton rispettuż anki meta jesprimi nuqqas ta' qbil.
formal.en: The author uses a respectful tone even when expressing disagreement.
formal.zh: 作者即使表达不同意见，也使用尊重他人的语气。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif kien it-tifel waqt iż-żjara? Marija: Kien rispettuż ħafna; sema' lil kulħadd u rringrazzjahom qabel telaq.
colloquial.en: Nina: How did the boy behave during the visit? Marija: He was very respectful; he listened to everyone and thanked them before leaving.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：那个男孩来做客时表现怎么样？玛丽亚：他很有礼貌，认真听大家说话，离开前还向大家道谢。

messages.speaker: Nina (母亲)
messages.zh: 那个男孩来做客时表现怎么样？
messages.en: How did the boy behave during the visit?

messages.speaker: Marija (亲戚)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien rispettuż ħafna; sema' lil kulħadd u rringrazzjahom qabel telaq.
messages.mt_standard: Kien rispettuż ħafna; sema' lil kulħadd u rringrazzjahom qabel telaq.
messages.zh: 他很有礼貌，认真听大家说话，离开前还向大家道谢。
messages.en: He was very respectful; he listened to everyone and thanked them before leaving.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个认真倾听、礼貌道谢的人来记 rispettuż；重点是他怎样对待别人，可与“值得尊敬”的 rispettabbli 对照。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or occasion of coming or going back to a place or activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 回到某个地方或重新参与某项活动的行为或时刻。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-mument li fih xi ħadd jerġa' lura lejn post jew attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 返回；归来；回归

formal.mt: Ir-ritorn tal-grupp lejn Malta huwa ppjanat għall-Ġimgħa filgħaxija.
formal.en: The group's return to Malta is planned for Friday evening.
formal.zh: 该团体计划于星期五晚上返回马耳他。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Meta hu r-ritorn tiegħek minn Ruma? Luqa: Il-Ħadd filgħaxija. Tista' tiġi għalija l-ajruport?
colloquial.en: Anna: When is your return from Rome? Luqa: Sunday evening. Can you pick me up at the airport?
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你什么时候从罗马回来？卢卡：星期日晚上。你能到机场接我吗？

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta hu r-ritorn tiegħek minn Ruma?
messages.mt_standard: Meta hu r-ritorn tiegħek minn Ruma?
messages.zh: 你什么时候从罗马回来？
messages.en: When is your return from Rome?

messages.speaker: Luqa (旅行者)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-Ħadd filgħaxija. Tista' tiġi għalija l-ajruport?
messages.mt_standard: Il-Ħadd filgħaxija. Tista' tiġi għalija l-ajruport?
messages.zh: 星期日晚上。你能到机场接我吗？
messages.en: Sunday evening. Can you pick me up at the airport?

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画一条从家出发又回到家的箭头，把回程这一段标为 ritorn，记住它是表示“返回”的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A line or section repeated in a song or poem, especially the chorus of a song.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 歌曲或诗歌中反复出现的句子或段落，尤其指歌曲的副歌。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Vers jew parti li tirrepeti ruħha f'kanzunetta jew poeżija, speċjalment il-parti tal-kanzunetta li terġa' titkanta bejn l-istrofi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 叠句；副歌；歌曲或诗歌中反复出现的句子或段落

formal.mt: Il-kor ikanta r-riturnell wara kull strofa, u b'hekk jenfasizza l-messaġġ ewlieni tal-kanzunetta.
formal.en: The choir sings the refrain after each verse, thereby emphasizing the song's main message.
formal.zh: 合唱团在每段主歌之后演唱副歌，以此突出歌曲的核心信息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Taf il-kliem kollu ta' din il-kanzunetta? Ben: Le, naf biss ir-riturnell. Dak nibqa' nkantah il-ġurnata kollha!
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you know all the words to this song? Ben: No, I only know the chorus. I keep singing that all day!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这首歌的歌词你全都会吗？本：不会，我只会副歌。那一段我整天都在唱！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taf il-kliem kollu ta' din il-kanzunetta?
messages.mt_standard: Taf il-kliem kollu ta' din il-kanzunetta?
messages.zh: 这首歌的歌词你全都会吗？
messages.en: Do you know all the words to this song?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, naf biss ir-riturnell. Dak nibqa' nkantah il-ġurnata kollha!
messages.mt_standard: Le, naf biss ir-riturnell. Dak nibqa' nkantah il-ġurnata kollha!
messages.zh: 不会，我只会副歌。那一段我整天都在唱！
messages.en: No, I only know the chorus. I keep singing that all day!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一首歌里大家每次都能跟唱的那一段，把它标为 riturnell；反复唱回来的副歌最容易形成记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The historical revolution in France known in English as the French Revolution.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发生在法国、中文通常称为“法国大革命”的历史革命事件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem tar-rivoluzzjoni storika li seħħet fi Franza u li bl-Ingliż tissejjaħ il-French Revolution.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 法国大革命

collocations.en: the causes of the French Revolution
the effects of the French Revolution

formal.mt: F'dan l-esej, l-istudenta tanalizza l-kawżi u l-effetti tar-Rivoluzzjoni Franċiża.
formal.en: In this essay, the student analyses the causes and effects of the French Revolution.
formal.zh: 在这篇文章中，这名学生分析法国大革命的起因与影响。

colloquial.mt: Ella: X'se nistudjaw fil-lezzjoni tal-istorja għada? Toni: Ir-Rivoluzzjoni Franċiża. Trid tirrevedi n-noti miegħi?
colloquial.en: Ella: What are we studying in history class tomorrow? Toni: The French Revolution. Do you want to review the notes with me?
colloquial.zh: 埃拉：明天历史课我们学什么？托尼：法国大革命。你想和我一起复习笔记吗？

messages.speaker: Ella (同学)
messages.zh: 明天历史课我们学什么？
messages.en: What are we studying in history class tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-Rivoluzzjoni Franċiża. Trid tirrevedi n-noti miegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Ir-Rivoluzzjoni Franċiża. Trid tirrevedi n-noti miegħi?
messages.zh: 法国大革命。你想和我一起复习笔记吗？
messages.en: The French Revolution. Do you want to review the notes with me?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Rivoluzzjoni Franċiża 整体写在历史课笔记标题上，与“法国大革命”并排记忆；正文中的两个词都用大写开头。

gloss_zh: 用夹板支撑；装腿；为论点提供支持

teaching_sense.en_definition: To support something with splints, fit an object with legs, or give support to an argument.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用夹板固定支撑某物，为物件安装腿，或为论点提供支持。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Issostni xi ħaġa bi qasab, twaħħal saqajn ma' oġġett, jew tagħti sostenn lil argument.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用夹板固定或支撑。

sense_translations.en_definition: to fit sth. with legs (e.g. a piece of furninture)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 给某物安装腿，例如给家具装上支腿。

sense_translations.en_definition: to support, give leg to (used of an argument)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 支持、支撑某个论点，为其提供依据。

collocations.en: supported the arm with a splint
supported the argument with new evidence

formal.mt: Il-mastrudaxxa riġġel il-mejda b'erba' saqajn tal-injam u ċċekkja li kienet soda.
formal.en: The carpenter fitted the table with four wooden legs and checked that it was stable.
formal.zh: 木匠给桌子装上了四条木腿，并检查桌子是否稳固。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-mastrudaxxa lesta l-mejda? Ġanni: Iva, illum riġġel il-mejda u issa nistgħu nużawha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Has the carpenter finished the table? Ġanni: Yes, he fitted the table with legs today, and now we can use it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：木匠把桌子做好了吗？詹尼：做好了，他今天给桌子装上了腿，现在我们可以用了。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.zh: 木匠把桌子做好了吗？
messages.en: Has the carpenter finished the table?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (家具店店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, illum riġġel il-mejda u issa nistgħu nużawha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, illum riġġel il-mejda u issa nistgħu nużawha.
messages.zh: 做好了，他今天给桌子装上了腿，现在我们可以用了。
messages.en: Yes, he fitted the table with legs today, and now we can use it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三幅支撑画面记 riġġel：夹板撑住手臂、桌腿撑住桌面、证据撑住论点；这是记义联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A flow of charged particles released by the Sun into space.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 太阳向太空释放的带电粒子流。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fluss ta' partiċelli ċċarġjati li joħorġu mix-Xemx u jinfirxu fl-ispazju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 太阳风，即太阳向太空释放的带电粒子流。

collocations.en: the speed of the solar wind

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jippreżenta kejl tal-veloċità tar-riħ solari.
formal.en: The report presents measurements of the speed of the solar wind.
formal.zh: 该报告展示了太阳风速度的测量结果。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu r-riħ solari? David: Huwa fluss ta' partiċelli li joħorġu mix-Xemx.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is the solar wind? David: It is a flow of particles released by the Sun.
colloquial.zh: Sara：太阳风是什么？David：就是太阳释放出来的粒子流。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 太阳风是什么？
messages.en: What is the solar wind?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa fluss ta' partiċelli li joħorġu mix-Xemx.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa fluss ta' partiċelli li joħorġu mix-Xemx.
messages.zh: 就是太阳释放出来的粒子流。
messages.en: It is a flow of particles released by the Sun.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象太阳向太空不断送出粒子，把太阳与粒子流连成一幅图，记牢太阳风的含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A flow of particles released by a star into the surrounding space.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 恒星向周围太空释放的粒子流。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fluss ta' partiċelli li joħorġu minn stilla u jinfirxu fl-ispazju ta' madwarha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 恒星风，即恒星向周围太空释放的粒子流。

collocations.en: the speed of the stellar wind

formal.mt: L-istudju janalizza l-partiċelli tar-riħ stellari madwar din l-istilla.
formal.en: The study analyses the particles of the stellar wind around this star.
formal.zh: 该研究分析了这颗恒星周围的恒星风粒子。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan ir-riħ stellari ġej minn dik l-istilla? Mark: Iva, il-partiċelli joħorġu minnha u jinfirxu fl-ispazju.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does this stellar wind come from that star? Mark: Yes, the particles leave it and spread into space.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这股恒星风来自那颗恒星吗？Mark：对，粒子从它那里释放出来，扩散到太空中。

messages.speaker: Lara (天文爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan ir-riħ stellari ġej minn dik l-istilla?
messages.mt_standard: Dan ir-riħ stellari ġej minn dik l-istilla?
messages.zh: 这股恒星风来自那颗恒星吗？
messages.en: Does this stellar wind come from that star?

messages.speaker: Mark (天文馆讲解员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-partiċelli joħorġu minnha u jinfirxu fl-ispazju.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-partiċelli joħorġu minnha u jinfirxu fl-ispazju.
messages.zh: 对，粒子从它那里释放出来，扩散到太空中。
messages.en: Yes, the particles leave it and spread into space.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画一颗恒星向四周释放粒子的图，再与太阳风配对记忆，突出恒星这一来源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Myrtle, an evergreen shrub with aromatic leaves.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 香桃木，一种叶片具有香气的常绿灌木。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arbuxxell li jibqa' aħdar is-sena kollha u għandu weraq ifuħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 香桃木，一种芳香的常绿灌木。

formal.mt: Fil-ġnien botaniku, it-tikketta ħdejn ir-riħan tiddeskrivi l-weraq aromatiku tiegħu.
formal.en: In the botanical garden, the label beside the myrtle describes its aromatic leaves.
formal.zh: 在植物园里，香桃木旁的标牌介绍了它具有香气的叶片。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dan l-arbuxxell li jfuħ? Toni: Dan riħan; il-weraq tiegħu għandu riħa sabiħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is this fragrant shrub? Toni: It's myrtle; its leaves have a lovely scent.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这丛有香味的灌木是什么？托尼：这是香桃木，它的叶子很好闻。

messages.speaker: Lara (花园访客)
messages.zh: 这丛有香味的灌木是什么？
messages.en: What is this fragrant shrub?

messages.speaker: Toni (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan riħan; il-weraq tiegħu għandu riħa sabiħa.
messages.mt_standard: Dan riħan; il-weraq tiegħu għandu riħa sabiħa.
messages.zh: 这是香桃木，它的叶子很好闻。
messages.en: It's myrtle; its leaves have a lovely scent.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象植物园里标着 riħan 的绿色灌木，再记住叶片的香气，把名称与“香桃木”对应起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A practice session in which performers prepare for a performance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 演员、歌手或其他表演者为正式演出而进行的练习或排练。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sessjoni ta' prattika li fiha l-artisti jħejju għal wirja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 排练；为正式演出进行的练习。

formal.mt: Ir-riħersal ġenerali se jsir fit-teatru lejlet l-ewwel wirja.
formal.en: The dress rehearsal will take place in the theatre on the evening before the first performance.
formal.zh: 总彩排将于首场演出的前一晚在剧院举行。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għandna riħersal illejla? Pawlu: Iva, fis-sebgħa fit-teatru.
colloquial.en: Marija: Do we have a rehearsal tonight? Pawlu: Yes, at seven in the theatre.
colloquial.zh: Marija：我们今晚有排练吗？Pawlu：有，七点在剧院。

messages.speaker: Marija (合唱团成员)
messages.zh: 我们今晚有排练吗？
messages.en: Do we have a rehearsal tonight?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (合唱团成员)
messages.zh: 有，七点在剧院。
messages.en: Yes, at seven in the theatre.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和舞台上反复练习同一幕的画面绑定，记住正式演出前的活动就是排练。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Rice of poor or inferior quality.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 品质较差、质量低劣的大米。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ross ta' kwalità baxxa jew ħażina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 劣质米；品质差的大米

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi r-ross mibjugħ f'din il-borża bħala riżella minħabba l-kwalità baxxa tiegħu.
formal.en: The report describes the rice sold in this bag as poor-quality rice because of its inferior quality.
formal.zh: 报告因这袋大米品质低劣而将其描述为劣质米。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dan ir-ross ta' kwalità baxxa kif jissejjaħ? Pawlu: Riżella. Ejja nagħżlu ross ta' kwalità aħjar.
colloquial.en: Marija: What do you call this poor-quality rice? Pawlu: Riżella. Let's choose better-quality rice.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：这种品质差的大米叫什么？保罗：叫 riżella。我们选品质更好的米吧。

messages.speaker: Marija (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan ir-ross ta' kwalità baxxa kif jissejjaħ?
messages.mt_standard: Dan ir-ross ta' kwalità baxxa kif jissejjaħ?
messages.zh: 这种品质差的大米叫什么？
messages.en: What do you call this poor-quality rice?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (购物同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Riżella. Ejja nagħżlu ross ta' kwalità aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Riżella. Ejja nagħżlu ross ta' kwalità aħjar.
messages.zh: 叫 riżella。我们选品质更好的米吧。
messages.en: Riżella. Let's choose better-quality rice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象米袋上贴着“品质差”的标签，再把 riżella 写在旁边；记忆重点是米的质量评价，而非某个大米品种。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something available that can be used to meet a need or achieve a goal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可用来满足需要或实现目标的资源，如材料、资金或知识。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa disponibbli li tista' tintuża biex jintlaħaq għan jew tiġi sodisfatta ħtieġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 资源；可供利用的材料、资金、知识或其他条件。

formal.mt: L-ilma huwa riżorsa naturali essenzjali li għandna nużaw b'għaqal.
formal.en: Water is an essential natural resource that we should use wisely.
formal.zh: 水是我们应当合理利用的重要自然资源。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan is-sit jgħinni nitgħallem il-Malti. Pawlu: Iva, huwa riżorsa utli ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: This website helps me learn Maltese. Pawlu: Yes, it is a very useful resource.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个网站帮助我学习马耳他语。保罗：是啊，它是很有用的学习资源。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这个网站帮助我学习马耳他语。
messages.en: This website helps me learn Maltese.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 是啊，它是很有用的学习资源。
messages.en: Yes, it is a very useful resource.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把水、资金和学习网站放进同一个“可利用资源箱”，用 riżorsa 统称其中一种资源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to a king, queen, or royal family.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与国王、女王或王室有关的；王室的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' re, reġina jew familja ta' rejiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 王室的；皇家的；与国王或女王有关的。

formal.mt: Id-dokument għandu siġill rjal li jikkonferma l-awtorità tiegħu.
formal.en: The document bears a royal seal confirming its authority.
formal.zh: 这份文件盖有王室印玺，以确认其权威性。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dak il-bini kbir? Mark: Dak hu palazz rjal.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is that large building? Mark: That is a royal palace.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那座大建筑是什么？马克：那是一座王宫。

messages.speaker: Lara (游客)
messages.zh: 那座大建筑是什么？
messages.en: What is that large building?

messages.speaker: Mark (导游)
messages.zh: 那是一座王宫。
messages.en: That is a royal palace.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象王宫大门上的王冠，把 palazz rjal 连成“王室的宫殿”来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become ill again or return to a worse condition after an improvement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在病情或状况好转之后再次患病或恶化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reġa' marad jew reġa' mar għall-agħar wara li kien tjieb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 复发；在好转后再次陷入原来的不良状态。

formal.mt: Il-pazjent rkada wara perjodu ta' titjib u reġa' ddaħħal l-isptar.
formal.en: The patient relapsed after a period of improvement and was admitted to hospital again.
formal.zh: 患者在一段时间的好转后病情复发，再次住院。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif inhu ħuk illum? Luqa: Kien aħjar, imma lbieraħ rkada.
colloquial.en: Sara: How is your brother today? Luqa: He had been better, but yesterday he relapsed.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你哥哥今天怎么样？卢卡：他原本好些了，但昨天又复发了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥今天怎么样？
messages.en: How is your brother today?

messages.speaker: Luqa (患者的弟弟)
messages.zh: 他原本好些了，但昨天又复发了。
messages.en: He had been better, but yesterday he relapsed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一条先上升又下滑的康复曲线，把再次下滑的动作记作 rkada，注意它是动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An instance of becoming ill again or returning to a worse condition after improvement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 病情或状况好转后再次发作、再次恶化的一次情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Każ fejn persuna terġa' timrad jew il-qagħda tagħha terġa' tmur għall-agħar wara titjib.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 复发；好转后再次发病或恶化的情况。

formal.mt: Wara rkadatura fil-marda, il-pazjent kellu bżonn aktar kura.
formal.en: After a relapse of the illness, the patient needed further care.
formal.zh: 疾病复发后，患者需要进一步治疗。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex Anna reġgħet l-isptar? David: Kellha rkadatura, imma issa tinsab aħjar.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why is Anna back in hospital? David: She had a relapse, but she is better now.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：安娜为什么又住院了？戴维：她的病复发了，不过现在好些了。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 安娜为什么又住院了？
messages.en: Why is Anna back in hospital?

messages.speaker: David (安娜的家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Kellha rkadatura, imma issa tinsab aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Kellha rkadatura, imma issa tinsab aħjar.
messages.zh: 她的病复发了，不过现在好些了。
messages.en: She had a relapse, but she is better now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把病历上“好转后再次发作”的那一次事件圈起来，标上名词 rkadatura，记住它表示一次复发。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A return of illness or a worse condition after a period of improvement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经过一段好转后疾病再次出现或状况再次恶化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta marda terġa' tidher jew il-qagħda terġa' tmur għall-agħar wara perjodu ta' titjib.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 复发；疾病或不良状况在好转后再次出现。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi rkaduta wara diversi ġimgħat ta' titjib.
formal.en: The report describes a relapse after several weeks of improvement.
formal.zh: 报告描述了病情在好转数周后再次复发的情况。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kont naħseb li Paul kien fieq. Ġanni: Iva, imma kellu rkaduta u reġa' beda l-kura.
colloquial.en: Marija: I thought Paul had recovered. Ġanni: Yes, but he had a relapse and started treatment again.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：我以为保罗已经康复了。詹尼：是啊，但他的病又复发了，于是重新开始治疗。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kont naħseb li Paul kien fieq.
messages.mt_standard: Kont naħseb li Paul kien fieq.
messages.zh: 我以为保罗已经康复了。
messages.en: I thought Paul had recovered.

messages.speaker: Ġanni (保罗的家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma kellu rkaduta u reġa' beda l-kura.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma kellu rkaduta u reġa' beda l-kura.
messages.zh: 是啊，但他的病又复发了，于是重新开始治疗。
messages.en: Yes, but he had a relapse and started treatment again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“康复、复发、重新治疗”排成三格图，中间一格写 rkaduta，用事件画面记住这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be clearly noticeable because of a difference from the surroundings, especially in colour or appearance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因颜色或外观等与周围不同而显得突出、形成明显对比。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Deher b'mod ċar għax kien differenti minn dak ta' madwaru, speċjalment fil-kulur jew fid-dehra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 显得突出；因与周围不同而形成对比。

collocations.en: stood out against a dark background
collocations.zh: 在深色背景上显得突出

collocations.en: contrasted with the colour of the wall
collocations.zh: 与墙面的颜色形成对比

formal.mt: Il-kulur abjad tat-titlu rkaċċa fuq l-isfond iswed tal-poster.
formal.en: The white colour of the title stood out against the poster's black background.
formal.zh: 标题的白色在海报的黑色背景上显得十分突出。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex għażilt il-qafas abjad? Toni: Għax rkaċċa sew mal-kulur skur tal-ħajt.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did you choose the white frame? Toni: Because it contrasted well with the dark colour of the wall.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么选白色画框？托尼：因为它和墙面的深色形成了鲜明对比。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么选白色画框？
messages.en: Why did you choose the white frame?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax rkaċċa sew mal-kulur skur tal-ħajt.
messages.mt_standard: Għax rkaċċa sew mal-kulur skur tal-ħajt.
messages.zh: 因为它和墙面的深色形成了鲜明对比。
messages.en: Because it contrasted well with the dark colour of the wall.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中放一张黑底白字海报，白字因对比而跳入眼帘，这个画面对应 rkaċċa。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Careful use of money or other resources to avoid waste.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 谨慎使用金钱或其他资源、避免浪费的做法或习惯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-użu bil-għaqal tal-flus jew ta' riżorsi oħra biex jiġi evitat il-ħela.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 节俭；谨慎花钱、避免浪费的习惯。
节约；对金钱、材料等资源的合理节省。

collocations.en: economy in the use of materials

formal.mt: Ir-rkis fl-użu tal-materjal naqqas il-ħela waqt il-proġett.
formal.en: Economy in the use of materials reduced waste during the project.
formal.zh: 节约使用材料减少了项目过程中的浪费。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Se tixtri mejda ġdida? Ben: Le, nista' nsewwi din; ftit rkis fl-infiq jgħinna niffrankaw.
colloquial.en: Marta: Are you going to buy a new table? Ben: No, I can repair this one; a little thrift in spending helps us save.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你要买张新桌子吗？本：不，我可以修好这张；开支上节俭一点能帮我们省钱。

messages.speaker: Marta (家人)
messages.zh: 你要买张新桌子吗？
messages.en: Are you going to buy a new table?

messages.speaker: Ben (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, nista' nsewwi din; ftit rkis fl-infiq jgħinna niffrankaw.
messages.mt_standard: Le, nista' nsewwi din; ftit rkis fl-infiq jgħinna niffrankaw.
messages.zh: 不，我可以修好这张；开支上节俭一点能帮我们省钱。
messages.en: No, I can repair this one; a little thrift in spending helps us save.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象修好旧桌子、用完剩余材料两个场景，用 rkis 把“节俭习惯”和“节约资源”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process in which suspended dust or particles move down and come to rest on a surface or at the bottom of a liquid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 悬浮的灰尘或颗粒逐渐落下，停留在表面或液体底部的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih trab jew frak sospiż jinżel u joqgħod fuq wiċċ jew fil-qiegħ ta' likwidu.

sense_translations.en_definition: settling (used, e.g., of dust or sediment)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 沉降；沉淀，指灰尘或悬浮颗粒等逐渐落下并积聚的过程。

formal.mt: Ir-rkit tas-sediment fil-qiegħ tal-kontenitur ġie osservat matul l-esperiment.
formal.en: The settling of sediment at the bottom of the container was observed during the experiment.
formal.zh: 实验过程中观察到了沉积物向容器底部沉降的现象。

colloquial.mt: Ella: Għaliex qed nistennew qabel innaddfu l-ixkafef? Samwel: Qed nistennew ir-rkit tat-trab.
colloquial.en: Ella: Why are we waiting before cleaning the shelves? Samwel: We are waiting for the dust to settle.
colloquial.zh: 埃拉：为什么要等一等再擦架子？萨姆韦尔：我们在等灰尘落定。

messages.speaker: Ella (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed nistennew qabel innaddfu l-ixkafef?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed nistennew qabel innaddfu l-ixkafef?
messages.zh: 为什么要等一等再擦架子？
messages.en: Why are we waiting before cleaning the shelves?

messages.speaker: Samwel (室友)
messages.zh: 我们在等灰尘落定。
messages.en: We are waiting for the dust to settle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一杯浑水静置后颗粒慢慢沉到底部，用 rkit 记住“逐渐沉降的过程”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A soft, mild cheese used in sweet and savoury dishes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种质地柔软、味道温和的奶酪，可用于甜食或咸味菜肴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġobon artab b'togħma ħafifa, li jintuża fi platti ħelwin u mielħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 里科塔奶酪；一种柔软的乳清奶酪。

collocations.zh: 里科塔奶酪馅意式饺子

formal.mt: Għall-mili tar-ravjul, ħallat rkotta friska ma' ftit tursin imqatta'.
formal.en: For the ravioli filling, mix fresh ricotta with a little chopped parsley.
formal.zh: 制作意式饺子馅时，将新鲜里科塔奶酪与少许切碎的欧芹混合。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għandna rkotta għall-għaġin? Pawlu: Iva, hemm pakkett fil-friġġ.
colloquial.en: Marija: Do we have ricotta for the pasta? Pawlu: Yes, there's a packet in the fridge.
colloquial.zh: Marija：我们有做意面的里科塔奶酪吗？Pawlu：有，冰箱里有一包。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 我们有做意面的里科塔奶酪吗？
messages.en: Do we have ricotta for the pasta?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 有，冰箱里有一包。
messages.en: Yes, there's a packet in the fridge.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rkotta 和白色柔软的奶酪馅联系起来：一想到意式饺子里的奶酪，就复习这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Suitable or able to be ridden, for example a horse.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 适合或能够供人骑乘的，例如可以骑乘的马。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jinkiteb, pereżempju żiemel adattat biex wieħed jirkbu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可骑乘的；适合供人骑的。

formal.mt: Qabel il-lezzjoni, l-għalliem għandu jiżgura li ż-żiemel huwa rkubi u adattat għall-istudent.
formal.en: Before the lesson, the instructor should ensure that the horse is rideable and suitable for the student.
formal.zh: 上课前，教练应确认这匹马可以骑乘，并且适合该学生。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-poni rkubi? Mark: Iva, imma stenna lill-għalliem qabel titla' fuqu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this pony rideable? Mark: Yes, but wait for the instructor before getting on.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这匹小马可以骑吗？Mark：可以，不过要等教练来了再骑上去。

messages.speaker: Lara (骑术学员)
messages.zh: 这匹小马可以骑吗？
messages.en: Is this pony rideable?

messages.speaker: Mark (马场工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma stenna lill-għalliem qabel titla' fuqu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma stenna lill-għalliem qabel titla' fuqu.
messages.zh: 可以，不过要等教练来了再骑上去。
messages.en: Yes, but wait for the instructor before getting on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用 żiemel rkubi 记住“可骑乘的马”：这个形容词描述能否骑乘，不表示马跑得快。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become well again, regain strength, or get back something lost.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 重新恢复健康或体力，也可指重新获得失去的东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reġa' kiseb saħħtu jew xi ħaġa li kien tilef.

sense_translations.en_definition: to recuperate, to regain, to recover
sense_translations.zh_definition: 康复；恢复体力或状态；重新获得、找回失去的东西。

collocations.en: he recovered the money he had lost
collocations.zh: 他追回了先前损失的钱

formal.mt: Wara perjodu ta' mistrieħ, l-atleta rkupra saħħtu u reġa' beda jitħarreġ.
formal.en: After a period of rest, the athlete regained his strength and resumed training.
formal.zh: 休息一段时间后，这名运动员恢复了体力，重新开始训练。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif inhu Pawlu llum? Toni: Aħjar ħafna; rkupra saħħtu u ħareġ jimxi.
colloquial.en: Sara: How is Pawlu today? Toni: Much better; he has regained his strength and gone out for a walk.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Pawlu 今天怎么样？Toni：好多了；他恢复了体力，还出去散步了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu 今天怎么样？
messages.en: How is Pawlu today?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar ħafna; rkupra saħħtu u ħareġ jimxi.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar ħafna; rkupra saħħtu u ħareġ jimxi.
messages.zh: 好多了；他恢复了体力，还出去散步了。
messages.en: Much better; he has regained his strength and gone out for a walk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“失去后重新得到”的画面：体力回来了、钱追回来了，都可帮助理解 rkupra 的恢复含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process or result of returning to health, strength, or a previous condition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 重新恢复健康、体力或原有状态的过程或结果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess jew ir-riżultat li wieħed jerġa' jikseb saħħtu jew jerġa' lura għall-qagħda ta' qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 恢复；康复；回到原有状态的过程或结果。

formal.mt: Il-pjan tat-taħriġ jinkludi perjodu ta' rkupru wara kull kompetizzjoni.
formal.en: The training plan includes a recovery period after each competition.
formal.zh: 训练计划包括每次比赛之后的一段恢复期。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Meta jerġa' jibda jitħarreġ ħuk? David: Wara ftit jiem oħra ta' rkupru.
colloquial.en: Nina: When will your brother start training again? David: After a few more days of recovery.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你哥哥什么时候恢复训练？David：再休养几天之后。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥什么时候恢复训练？
messages.en: When will your brother start training again?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Wara ftit jiem oħra ta' rkupru.
messages.mt_standard: Wara ftit jiem oħra ta' rkupru.
messages.zh: 再休养几天之后。
messages.en: After a few more days of recovery.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rkupru 放进“恢复期”这个名词框架：perjodu ta' rkupru，重点记住它表示恢复的过程或结果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be stiff, with the body or a body part difficult to move freely.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体或某个部位僵硬，难以自如活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sar iebes u ma setax jiċċaqlaq faċilment, bħall-ġisem wara żmien twil bla moviment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 僵硬；身体或肢体不易灵活活动。

collocations.en: he became stiff after hours of sitting
collocations.zh: 他坐了几个小时后身体僵硬了

formal.mt: Wara li baqa' bilqiegħda għal żmien twil, ġismu rmazza u sabha diffiċli biex iqum.
formal.en: After sitting for a long time, his body became stiff and he found it difficult to get up.
formal.zh: 久坐之后，他的身体变得僵硬，起身有些困难。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex qed jimxi daqshekk bil-mod Pawlu? Toni: Ġismu rmazza wara l-vjaġġ twil.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why is Pawlu walking so slowly? Toni: His body became stiff after the long journey.
colloquial.zh: Marija：Pawlu 为什么走得这么慢？Toni：长途旅行之后，他的身体僵硬了。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed jimxi daqshekk bil-mod Pawlu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed jimxi daqshekk bil-mod Pawlu?
messages.zh: Pawlu 为什么走得这么慢？
messages.en: Why is Pawlu walking so slowly?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 长途旅行之后，他的身体僵硬了。
messages.en: His body became stiff after the long journey.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象长途坐车后起身不灵活的感觉，用“身体僵住了”这一动作画面记住动词 rmazza。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state or feeling of stiffness that makes movement less easy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使活动不够灵活的僵硬状态或感觉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat jew sensazzjoni ta' ebusija li tagħmel il-moviment inqas faċli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 僵硬；身体或部位活动不灵活的状态、感觉。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tiegħu, l-istudent semma rmazzatura fl-għonq wara sigħat twal quddiem il-kompjuter.
formal.en: In his report, the student mentioned neck stiffness after long hours at the computer.
formal.zh: 这名学生在报告中提到，长时间使用电脑之后出现了颈部僵硬。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandi rmazzatura fl-għonq illum. Ben: Jien ukoll; ilbieraħ qattajna sigħat quddiem il-kompjuter.
colloquial.en: Lara: My neck feels stiff today. Ben: Mine too; yesterday we spent hours at the computer.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我今天觉得脖子僵硬。Ben：我也是；昨天我们在电脑前坐了好几个小时。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 我今天觉得脖子僵硬。
messages.en: My neck feels stiff today.

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien ukoll; ilbieraħ qattajna sigħat quddiem il-kompjuter.
messages.mt_standard: Jien ukoll; ilbieraħ qattajna sigħat quddiem il-kompjuter.
messages.zh: 我也是；昨天我们在电脑前坐了好几个小时。
messages.en: Mine too; yesterday we spent hours at the computer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“我有一种僵硬感”来记名词 rmazzatura，再搭配颈部或肌肉，帮助把状态名称与具体部位联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small container for cigarette ash and cigarette ends.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来盛放香烟烟灰和烟头的小容器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent żgħir biex jitqiegħdu fih irmied tas-sigaretti u loqom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 烟灰缸；盛放烟灰和烟头的容器。

formal.mt: Fiż-żona fejn huwa permess it-tipjip, hemm rmidiera fuq kull mejda.
formal.en: In the area where smoking is permitted, there is an ashtray on each table.
formal.zh: 在允许吸烟的区域，每张桌子上都有一个烟灰缸。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandkom rmidiera, jekk jogħġbok? Rita: Iva, inġiblek waħda fuq il-mejda ta' barra.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have an ashtray, please? Rita: Yes, I'll bring one to your table outside.
colloquial.zh: Mark：请问有烟灰缸吗？Rita：有，我给你拿一个到外面的桌子上。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 请问有烟灰缸吗？
messages.en: Do you have an ashtray, please?

messages.speaker: Rita (服务员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, inġiblek waħda fuq il-mejda ta' barra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, inġiblek waħda fuq il-mejda ta' barra.
messages.zh: 有，我给你拿一个到外面的桌子上。
messages.en: Yes, I'll bring one to your table outside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rmidiera 记成桌上接住烟灰的小容器，想象玻璃烟灰缸的形状，再复习 rmidiera tal-ħġieġ。

gloss_zh: 灰色的；灰白色的；灰蒙蒙的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Greyish or ash-coloured, ranging from light grey to ashy grey.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带灰色或呈灰烬般颜色的，色调可从浅灰到烟灰色。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ta' lewn griż jew li jixbah il-kulur tal-irmied, minn griż ċar sa griż bħall-irmied.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 灰烬色的；带灰色的；灰蒙蒙的。

sense_translations.en_definition: grey; from light grey to ashy grey
sense_translations.zh_definition: 灰色的；色调从浅灰色到灰烬般的烟灰色。

formal.mt: Id-disinn jippreżenta bini ta' kulur rmiedi taħt sema msaħħab.
formal.en: The drawing depicts an ashy grey building beneath a cloudy sky.
formal.zh: 这幅画描绘了一座烟灰色的建筑，上方是多云的天空。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Liema kulur tippreferi għall-ħajt? Sam: Kulur rmiedi ċar; naħseb li jaqbel mal-għamara.
colloquial.en: Nina: Which colour do you prefer for the wall? Sam: A light ashy grey; I think it matches the furniture.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你更喜欢把墙刷成什么颜色？Sam：浅烟灰色；我觉得和家具很搭。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 你更喜欢把墙刷成什么颜色？
messages.en: Which colour do you prefer for the wall?

messages.speaker: Sam (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kulur rmiedi ċar; naħseb li jaqbel mal-għamara.
messages.mt_standard: Kulur rmiedi ċar; naħseb li jaqbel mal-għamara.
messages.zh: 浅烟灰色；我觉得和家具很搭。
messages.en: A light ashy grey; I think it matches the furniture.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画一张从浅灰到烟灰的色卡，把 rmiedi 放在这段颜色上；它描述颜色，不表示表面一定沾了灰。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To mix playing cards so that their order changes before they are dealt.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把扑克牌混合，改变牌的排列顺序，通常在发牌前进行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħallat il-karti tal-logħob biex ibiddel l-ordni tagħhom qabel ma jitqassmu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 洗牌；把扑克牌的顺序打乱。

formal.mt: Qabel ma qassam il-karti, il-plejer rmixka l-mazz kollu.
formal.en: Before dealing the cards, the player shuffled the whole deck.
formal.zh: 发牌前，这名玩家把整副牌洗了一遍。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min rmixka l-karti? Mark: Jien. Trid tqassamhom int?
colloquial.en: Maja: Who shuffled the cards? Mark: I did. Do you want to deal them?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁洗的牌？马克：我洗的。你来发牌好吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁洗的牌？
messages.en: Who shuffled the cards?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我洗的。你来发牌好吗？
messages.en: I did. Do you want to deal them?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rmixka 和双手交错洗牌的动作一起记：重点是打乱牌序，随后才发牌。

gloss_zh: 重新洗牌；一次重新洗牌

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act of shuffling playing cards again to change their order.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 再次混合扑克牌、改变牌序的动作，也可指一次重新洗牌。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li terġa' tħallat il-karti tal-logħob biex tbiddel l-ordni tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 重新洗牌；对扑克牌进行的一次再次混洗。

formal.mt: Wara rmixkatura tal-karti, il-plejer qassam ħames karti lil kull parteċipant.
formal.en: After a reshuffle of the cards, the player dealt five cards to each participant.
formal.zh: 重新洗牌后，这名玩家给每位参与者发了五张牌。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nagħmlu rmixkatura oħra? Mark: Iva, imbagħad inqassam il-karti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we give them another reshuffle? Mark: Yes, then I'll deal the cards.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们再洗一次牌好吗？马克：好，然后我来发牌。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们再洗一次牌好吗？
messages.en: Shall we give them another reshuffle?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，然后我来发牌。
messages.en: Yes, then I'll deal the cards.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rmixkatura 记成牌局中可数的“一次重新洗牌”，用名词给整个动作命名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of pulling a vehicle or vessel using another vehicle or vessel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用另一辆车或另一艘船牵引车辆或船只的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li vettura jew bastiment jiġbed vettura jew bastiment ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拖曳；牵引，尤指拖动车辆或船只。

formal.mt: Is-servizz tar-rmonk ġie msejjaħ biex jittrasporta l-karozza sal-garaxx.
formal.en: The towing service was called to transport the car to the garage.
formal.zh: 有人叫来了拖车服务，把汽车运到修理厂。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-karozza ma tridx tistartja. Maja: Ċempel lis-servizz tar-rmonk; nistenna hawn miegħek.
colloquial.en: Mark: The car won't start. Maja: Call the towing service; I'll wait here with you.
colloquial.zh: 马克：车发动不了了。玛雅：打电话叫拖车服务吧，我在这儿陪你等。

messages.speaker: Mark (车主)
messages.zh: 车发动不了了。
messages.en: The car won't start.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ċempel lis-servizz tar-rmonk; nistenna hawn miegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Ċempel lis-servizz tar-rmonk; nistenna hawn miegħek.
messages.zh: 打电话叫拖车服务吧，我在这儿陪你等。
messages.en: Call the towing service; I'll wait here with you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象故障汽车被前方车辆牵着走，把 rmonk 与“拖车服务”这个完整场景相连。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state or period of being a widow or widower after a spouse has died.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 配偶去世后成为寡妇或鳏夫的状态，也可指处于这种状态的时期。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istat jew il-perjodu ta' persuna li tkun romlot wara l-mewt ta' żewġha jew ta' martha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 丧偶的状态或时期；守寡或鳏居。

formal.mt: Fl-awtobijografija tagħha, l-awtriċi tiddeskrivi s-snin ta' rmulija u l-appoġġ li sabet mingħand il-familja.
formal.en: In her autobiography, the author describes her years of widowhood and the support she received from her family.
formal.zh: 作者在自传中描述了丧偶后的岁月，以及家人给予她的支持。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif kienet għan-nanna l-ewwel sena ta' rmulija? Anna: Kienet diffiċli, imma konna nżuruha spiss.
colloquial.en: Maja: What was Grandma's first year of widowhood like? Anna: It was difficult, but we visited her often.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：奶奶丧偶后的第一年过得怎么样？安娜：很艰难，不过我们经常去看她。

messages.speaker: Maja (孙女)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif kienet għan-nanna l-ewwel sena ta' rmulija?
messages.mt_standard: Kif kienet għan-nanna l-ewwel sena ta' rmulija?
messages.zh: 奶奶丧偶后的第一年过得怎么样？
messages.en: What was Grandma's first year of widowhood like?

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Kienet diffiċli, imma konna nżuruha spiss.
messages.mt_standard: Kienet diffiċli, imma konna nżuruha spiss.
messages.zh: 很艰难，不过我们经常去看她。
messages.en: It was difficult, but we visited her often.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rmulija 放在“丧偶后的岁月”里记：它表示生活状态或时期，而不是某个人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The result or eventual outcome of an action, process, or undertaking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某项行动、过程或事业最终产生的结果或结局。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ir-riżultat jew it-tmiem li joħroġ minn azzjoni, proċess jew ħidma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 结果；结局；事情发展到最后所产生的结果。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-proċess u jispjega r-rnexxija tal-proġett.
formal.en: The report describes the process and explains the outcome of the project.
formal.zh: 报告描述了项目的过程，并说明了最终结果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'kienet ir-rnexxija tad-diskussjoni? Mark: Qbilna li nibdew ix-xogħol nhar it-Tnejn.
colloquial.en: Maja: What was the outcome of the discussion? Mark: We agreed to start work on Monday.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：讨论结果怎么样？马克：我们同意星期一开始工作。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 讨论结果怎么样？
messages.en: What was the outcome of the discussion?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Qbilna li nibdew ix-xogħol nhar it-Tnejn.
messages.mt_standard: Qbilna li nibdew ix-xogħol nhar it-Tnejn.
messages.zh: 我们同意星期一开始工作。
messages.en: We agreed to start work on Monday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 rnexxija 就追问“事情最后怎样了”；英语释义中的 issue 在这里也表示结果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A successful result in which an effort or undertaking achieves its intended aim.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 努力或某项事业达到了预期目标而取得的成功结果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Riżultat tajjeb li fih ħidma jew sforz jilħaq l-għan maħsub.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 成功的结果；达到预期目的的圆满结局。

collocations.en: the successful outcome of the project
the successful outcome of the efforts
collocations.zh: 各项努力取得的成功结果

formal.mt: Ir-rnexxitura tal-proġett kienet frott ta' ppjanar bir-reqqa u kooperazzjoni bejn il-parteċipanti.
formal.en: The successful outcome of the project was the result of careful planning and cooperation among the participants.
formal.zh: 项目的成功得益于周密的规划和参与者之间的合作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif se niċċelebraw ir-rnexxitura tal-proġett? Mark: Ejja nieħdu kafè flimkien wara x-xogħol!
colloquial.en: Maja: How shall we celebrate the successful outcome of the project? Mark: Let's have a coffee together after work!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们怎么庆祝项目成功呢？马克：下班后一起喝杯咖啡吧！

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 我们怎么庆祝项目成功呢？
messages.en: How shall we celebrate the successful outcome of the project?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nieħdu kafè flimkien wara x-xogħol!
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nieħdu kafè flimkien wara x-xogħol!
messages.zh: 下班后一起喝杯咖啡吧！
messages.en: Let's have a coffee together after work!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rnexxitura 配上项目完成后举杯庆祝的画面，记住它明确包含“成功”的结果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element rhodium, referred to by name in chemistry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素铑的名称，用于指称这一元素。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-element kimiku magħruf bl-isem rodju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 铑，一种化学元素。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tal-laboratorju jikkonferma l-preżenza tar-rodju fil-kampjun analizzat.
formal.en: The laboratory report confirms the presence of rhodium in the analysed sample.
formal.zh: 实验室报告确认，所分析的样品中含有铑。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif ngħidu rhodium bil-Malti? Lara: Ngħidu rodju. Ikteb l-isem ħdejn it-traduzzjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: How do we say rhodium in Maltese? Lara: We say rodju. Write the name next to the translation.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：rhodium 用马耳他语怎么说？拉拉：说 rodju。把这个名称写在译名旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: rhodium 用马耳他语怎么说？
messages.en: How do we say rhodium in Maltese?

messages.speaker: Lara (化学教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ngħidu rodju. Ikteb l-isem ħdejn it-traduzzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Ngħidu rodju. Ikteb l-isem ħdejn it-traduzzjoni.
messages.zh: 说 rodju。把这个名称写在译名旁边。
messages.en: We say rodju. Write the name next to the translation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作三语元素卡“rodju—rhodium—铑”，并用“铑样品”帮助自己把名称放进语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element roentgenium, referred to by name in chemistry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素錀的名称，用于指称这一元素。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-element kimiku magħruf bl-isem roentgenju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 錀，一种化学元素。

formal.mt: Il-glossarju tal-kimika jagħti l-isem Malti roentgenju flimkien mal-isem Ingliż roentgenium.
formal.en: The chemistry glossary gives the Maltese name roentgenju alongside the English name roentgenium.
formal.zh: 化学术语表把马耳他语名称 roentgenju 与英语名称 roentgenium 并列列出。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Roentgenju huwa isem ta' element kimiku? Lara: Iva. Bl-Ingliż ngħidu roentgenium.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is roentgenju the name of a chemical element? Lara: Yes. In English we say roentgenium.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：roentgenju 是一种化学元素的名称吗？拉拉：是的，英语叫 roentgenium，也就是錀。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Roentgenju huwa isem ta' element kimiku?
messages.mt_standard: Roentgenju huwa isem ta' element kimiku?
messages.zh: roentgenju 是一种化学元素的名称吗？
messages.en: Is roentgenju the name of a chemical element?

messages.speaker: Lara (化学教师)
messages.zh: 是的，英语叫 roentgenium，也就是錀。
messages.en: Yes. In English we say roentgenium.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 roentgenju 分段看作 roent-gen-ju 来练习拼写，再与英语 roentgenium 和中文“錀”配成一张记忆卡。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An artistic and decorative style featuring elaborate ornament and curved forms.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种以精巧繁复的装饰和曲线造型为特点的艺术与装饰风格，即洛可可。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stil fl-arti u fid-dekorazzjoni b'tiżjin elaborat u forom mgħawġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 洛可可，一种装饰精巧繁复、常用曲线造型的艺术风格。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi d-dekorazzjoni tal-kamra bħala eżempju tal-istil rokokò.
formal.en: The report describes the room's decoration as an example of the rococo style.
formal.zh: 报告将该房间的装饰描述为洛可可风格的实例。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm għandu tiżjin dan il-qafas! Mark: Iva, huwa fl-istil rokokò. Ara dawk il-linji mgħawġa.
colloquial.en: Lara: This frame has so much decoration! Mark: Yes, it is in the rococo style. Look at those curved lines.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个画框的装饰真多！马克：对，这是洛可可风格。看看那些弯曲的线条。

messages.speaker: Lara (参观者)
messages.zh: 这个画框的装饰真多！
messages.en: This frame has so much decoration!

messages.speaker: Mark (导览员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa fl-istil rokokò. Ara dawk il-linji mgħawġa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa fl-istil rokokò. Ara dawk il-linji mgħawġa.
messages.zh: 对，这是洛可可风格。看看那些弯曲的线条。
messages.en: Yes, it is in the rococo style. Look at those curved lines.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rokokò 与中文“洛可可”对应起来，再联想装饰繁复、曲线弯绕的画框。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act of rolling something, including rolling it along a surface or pressing it by rolling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使物体滚动，或通过滚动进行压平等操作的一次动作或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li ġġiegħel xi ħaġa ddur fuq wiċċ, jew li tagħfasha billi tgħaddi romblu fuqha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 滚动或滚压的动作。

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta titlob romblatura uniformi tal-għaġina qabel il-ħami.
formal.en: The recipe calls for even rolling of the dough before baking.
formal.zh: 食谱要求在烘烤前将面团均匀擀压。

colloquial.mt: Nina: L-għaġina għadha ħoxna wisq? Pawlu: Iva, agħtiha romblatura oħra biex tiġi irqaq.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is the dough still too thick? Pawlu: Yes, give it another rolling to make it thinner.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：面团还是太厚了吗？保罗：对，再擀一遍，让它薄一些。

messages.speaker: Nina (烹饪学员)
messages.zh: 面团还是太厚了吗？
messages.en: Is the dough still too thick?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (烹饪老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, agħtiha romblatura oħra biex tiġi irqaq.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, agħtiha romblatura oħra biex tiġi irqaq.
messages.zh: 对，再擀一遍，让它薄一些。
messages.en: Yes, give it another rolling to make it thinner.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象擀面时滚过面团的一遍动作：romblatura 记的是滚动或滚压这一过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Somewhat round in shape, without necessarily being perfectly round.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形状有些圆、接近圆形，但不一定完全圆的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu forma kważi tonda, iżda mhux bilfors perfettament tonda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 略圆的；大致呈圆形的。

formal.mt: L-oġġett għandu profil romblaturi u wiċċ lixx.
formal.en: The object has a roundish profile and a smooth surface.
formal.zh: 该物体的轮廓略圆，表面光滑。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'forma għandu dan l-oġġett? David: Huwa romblaturi, kważi tond.
colloquial.en: Sara: What shape is this object? David: It is roundish, almost round.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个物体是什么形状的？戴维：它有点圆，接近圆形。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这个物体是什么形状的？
messages.en: What shape is this object?

messages.speaker: David (老师)
messages.zh: 它有点圆，接近圆形。
messages.en: It is roundish, almost round.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个不太规整的圆来记 romblaturi：重点是“大致圆”，不要求完美正圆。

gloss_zh: 游戏用小弹珠；砌筑用语中 romblu 的同义词

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small marble used by children in a game.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 儿童玩弹珠游戏时使用的小弹珠。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Boċċa żgħira li t-tfal jużaw fil-logħob tal-boċċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小弹珠，供儿童游戏使用；与 ġakk 同义。
（砌筑用语）romblu 的同义名称。

formal.mt: Kull parteċipant għandu jġib romboll tal-ħġieġ għal-logħba.
formal.en: Each participant must bring a glass marble for the game.
formal.zh: 每位参与者都须为游戏带来一颗玻璃弹珠。

colloquial.mt: Ben: Rajt ir-romboll blu tiegħi? Emma: Iva, qiegħed taħt is-siġġu. Ħudu biex nilagħbu.
colloquial.en: Ben: Have you seen my blue marble? Emma: Yes, it is under the chair. Get it so we can play.
colloquial.zh: 本：你看到我的蓝色弹珠了吗？艾玛：看到了，在椅子下面。拿来，我们一起玩。

messages.speaker: Ben (玩伴)
messages.zh: 你看到我的蓝色弹珠了吗？
messages.en: Have you seen my blue marble?

messages.speaker: Emma (玩伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħed taħt is-siġġu. Ħudu biex nilagħbu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħed taħt is-siġġu. Ħudu biex nilagħbu.
messages.zh: 看到了，在椅子下面。拿来，我们一起玩。
messages.en: Yes, it is under the chair. Get it so we can play.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用掌心里的彩色小弹珠记 romboll；遇到砌筑语境，再切换到它与 romblu 同义的专门用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To jump about, making repeated jumps while moving around.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一边移动一边反复跳跃，蹦来蹦去。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaqbeż minn post għal ieħor jew jagħmel diversi qabżiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 跳来跳去；蹦来蹦去。

formal.mt: Waqt il-logħba, it-tifel roqos fil-bitħa flimkien ma' sħabu.
formal.en: During the game, the boy jumped around in the yard with his friends.
formal.zh: 游戏时，男孩和朋友们一起在院子里蹦来蹦去。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Kif ħassu Leo meta ra r-rigal? Marija: Kien ferħan ħafna! Roqos bil-ferħ.
colloquial.en: Rita: How did Leo feel when he saw the present? Marija: He was very happy! He jumped around with joy.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：利奥看到礼物时是什么心情？玛丽亚：他高兴极了！开心得蹦来蹦去。

messages.speaker: Rita (阿姨)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif ħassu Leo meta ra r-rigal?
messages.mt_standard: Kif ħassu Leo meta ra r-rigal?
messages.zh: 利奥看到礼物时是什么心情？
messages.en: How did Leo feel when he saw the present?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 他高兴极了！开心得蹦来蹦去。
messages.en: He was very happy! He jumped around with joy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 roqos 配上孩子收到礼物后连续蹦跳的画面，记住它表示跳来跳去。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become less expensive than before.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 价格比原来降低，变得更便宜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinżel fil-prezz u jsir irħas minn qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得更便宜；价格下降。

formal.mt: Skont il-lista l-ġdida tal-prezzijiet, il-prodott roħos b'żewġ ewro.
formal.en: According to the new price list, the product became cheaper by two euros.
formal.zh: 根据新的价目表，该产品降价了两欧元。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-ħobż kien jiswa aktar, hux? Toni: Iva, roħos. Illum jiswa żewġ ewro.
colloquial.en: Maja: This bread used to cost more, didn't it? Toni: Yes, it became cheaper. Today it costs two euros.
colloquial.zh: 玛娅：这种面包以前更贵，对吧？托尼：对，降价了。今天卖两欧元。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ħobż kien jiswa aktar, hux?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ħobż kien jiswa aktar, hux?
messages.zh: 这种面包以前更贵，对吧？
messages.en: This bread used to cost more, didn't it?

messages.speaker: Toni (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, roħos. Illum jiswa żewġ ewro.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, roħos. Illum jiswa żewġ ewro.
messages.zh: 对，降价了。今天卖两欧元。
messages.en: Yes, it became cheaper. Today it costs two euros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象价签上的数字往下降：roħos 强调从原价变得更便宜这一变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A nightingale, a small bird known for its rich, melodious song.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 夜莺，一种以婉转悦耳的鸣唱闻名的小鸟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur żgħir magħruf għall-għana sabiħ u melodjuż tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 夜莺，一种鸣声婉转的小鸟。

formal.mt: L-istudenti semgħu reġistrazzjoni tal-għana tar-rożinjol waqt il-lezzjoni.
formal.en: The students listened to a recording of the nightingale's song during the lesson.
formal.zh: 学生们在课堂上听了一段夜莺鸣唱的录音。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Tisma' dak l-għasfur fil-ġnien? Ġużeppi: Iva, dak rożinjol. Kemm għandu għana sabiħ!
colloquial.en: Anna: Can you hear that bird in the garden? Ġużeppi: Yes, that is a nightingale. What a beautiful song it has!
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你听见花园里那只鸟的叫声了吗？朱塞佩：听见了，那是夜莺。它唱得真好听！

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听见花园里那只鸟的叫声了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear that bird in the garden?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dak rożinjol. Kemm għandu għana sabiħ!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dak rożinjol. Kemm għandu għana sabiħ!
messages.zh: 听见了，那是夜莺。它唱得真好听！
messages.en: Yes, that is a nightingale. What a beautiful song it has!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一只在花园里婉转鸣唱的小鸟作记忆图像，把 rożinjol 与“夜莺”直接连接。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To regain strength or energy, or to restore vigour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 重新获得体力或精力，恢复活力、重振精神。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jerġa' jikseb is-saħħa jew l-enerġija, jew jagħti saħħa ġdida.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 恢复体力或精力；使重新振作、恢复活力。

formal.mt: Wara perjodu ta' mistrieħ, l-atleta rpilja u reġa' beda t-taħriġ.
formal.en: After a period of rest, the athlete regained strength and resumed training.
formal.zh: 经过一段时间的休息，运动员恢复了体力，并重新开始训练。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Kif inhu Toni wara dik il-mixja twila? Karl: Strieħ ftit u rpilja. Issa għandu l-enerġija mill-ġdid.
colloquial.en: Marta: How is Toni after that long walk? Karl: He rested for a while and regained his strength. Now he has his energy back.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：走了那么远，托尼现在怎么样？卡尔：他休息了一会儿，恢复了体力。现在又有精神了。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif inhu Toni wara dik il-mixja twila?
messages.mt_standard: Kif inhu Toni wara dik il-mixja twila?
messages.zh: 走了那么远，托尼现在怎么样？
messages.en: How is Toni after that long walk?

messages.speaker: Karl (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Strieħ ftit u rpilja. Issa għandu l-enerġija mill-ġdid.
messages.mt_standard: Strieħ ftit u rpilja. Issa għandu l-enerġija mill-ġdid.
messages.zh: 他休息了一会儿，恢复了体力。现在又有精神了。
messages.en: He rested for a while and regained his strength. Now he has his energy back.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象疲惫的人休息后重新精神起来：用“精力充回来”的画面记住 rpilja。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The recovery of strength or energy after tiredness, illness, or weakness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在疲劳、生病或虚弱之后，体力或精神重新恢复的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-irkupru tas-saħħa jew tal-enerġija wara għeja, mard jew dgħufija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 恢复力量或体力；重新焕发精神。

formal.mt: Wara perjodu ta' mistrieħ, il-pazjent wera rpiljatura tas-saħħa u seta' jerġa' jagħmel mixjiet qosra.
formal.en: After a period of rest, the patient showed a recovery of strength and could take short walks again.
formal.zh: 经过一段时间的休息，病人的体力有所恢复，又能进行短距离散步了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif qed tħossok wara l-mistrieħ? | Pawlu: Aħjar ħafna. Ħassejt rpiljatura u issa għandi aktar enerġija.
colloquial.en: Maja: How are you feeling after resting? | Pawlu: Much better. I felt my strength return, and now I have more energy.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：休息之后感觉怎么样？ | 保罗：好多了。我感觉体力恢复了，现在更有精神了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 休息之后感觉怎么样？
messages.en: How are you feeling after resting?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar ħafna. Ħassejt rpiljatura u issa għandi aktar enerġija.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar ħafna. Ħassejt rpiljatura u issa għandi aktar enerġija.
messages.zh: 好多了。我感觉体力恢复了，现在更有精神了。
messages.en: Much better. I felt my strength return, and now I have more energy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象疲惫的人休息后重新站起来，把这个词与“体力回来了”的画面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To stop activity and rest, or to remain in a state of repose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 停止活动以获得休息，或保持安静休憩的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieqaf mill-attività biex jistrieħ, jew ikun fi stat ta' mistrieħ.

sense_translations.en_definition: to rest, to be at rest, to repose
sense_translations.zh_definition: 休息；处于休息状态；安静地休憩。

formal.mt: Wara l-vjaġġ twil, il-mistieden rpoża għal siegħa qabel ma ngħaqad mal-bqija tal-grupp.
formal.en: After the long journey, the guest rested for an hour before joining the rest of the group.
formal.zh: 长途旅行之后，这位客人休息了一个小时，随后才与团队其他成员会合。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hu n-nannu? | Mark: Fil-kamra tiegħu. Rpoża ftit wara l-ikla.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is Grandpa? | Mark: In his room. He rested for a little while after the meal.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：爷爷在哪里？ | 马克：在他房间里。他吃完饭后休息了一会儿。

messages.speaker: Lara (孙女)
messages.zh: 爷爷在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Grandpa?

messages.speaker: Mark (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-kamra tiegħu. Rpoża ftit wara l-ikla.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-kamra tiegħu. Rpoża ftit wara l-ikla.
messages.zh: 在他房间里。他吃完饭后休息了一会儿。
messages.en: In his room. He rested for a little while after the meal.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“长途旅行后坐下休息”的场景，记住它表示休息这个动作或状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Calm and quiet in manner, without agitation or excitement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 举止或性情沉静平和，没有明显的激动或躁动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kalma u kwiet fl-imġiba jew fil-karattru, mingħajr aġitazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 平静的；安静的；性情温和平稳的。

formal.mt: Minkejja d-diskussjoni twila, ir-rappreżentant baqa' rpożat u wieġeb il-mistoqsijiet kollha b'mod ċar.
formal.en: Despite the lengthy discussion, the representative remained calm and answered all the questions clearly.
formal.zh: 尽管讨论持续了很久，这位代表仍然保持沉静，并清楚地回答了所有问题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħuk dejjem daqshekk rpożat? | Lara: Iva, anki meta kulħadd ikun eċċitat, hu jibqa' kalm.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is your brother always this calm? | Lara: Yes, even when everyone is excited, he stays calm.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你哥哥总是这么沉静吗？ | 拉拉：是的，即使大家都很激动，他也能保持平静。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥总是这么沉静吗？
messages.en: Is your brother always this calm?

messages.speaker: Lara (妹妹)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, anki meta kulħadd ikun eċċitat, hu jibqa' kalm.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, anki meta kulħadd ikun eċċitat, hu jibqa' kalm.
messages.zh: 是的，即使大家都很激动，他也能保持平静。
messages.en: Yes, even when everyone is excited, he stays calm.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象热闹人群中一位神态平和的人，用“沉静的性情”记住这个形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The natural state of sleeping, when the body rests and awareness of the surroundings is reduced.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体得到休息、对周围环境的意识减弱的自然睡眠状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istat naturali meta persuna tkun rieqda, il-ġisem jistrieħ u l-għarfien tal-madwar jonqos.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 睡眠；睡觉时的休息状态。

formal.mt: Wara lejl ta' rqad tajjeb, l-istudenta setgħet tikkonċentra aħjar waqt il-lezzjoni ta' filgħodu.
formal.en: After a night of good sleep, the student could concentrate better during the morning lesson.
formal.zh: 经过一夜良好的睡眠，这名学生在早上的课堂上能够更好地集中注意力。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex qed titniehed daqshekk? | Pawlu: Għandi bżonn ta' rqad. Ilbieraħ mort norqod tard ħafna.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why are you yawning so much? | Pawlu: I need sleep. Yesterday I went to bed very late.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你怎么一直打哈欠？ | 保罗：我需要睡觉。昨天我很晚才上床。

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 你怎么一直打哈欠？
messages.en: Why are you yawning so much?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi bżonn ta' rqad. Ilbieraħ mort norqod tard ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi bżonn ta' rqad. Ilbieraħ mort norqod tard ħafna.
messages.zh: 我需要睡觉。昨天我很晚才上床。
messages.en: I need sleep. Yesterday I went to bed very late.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个名词与枕头和闭眼入睡的画面绑定，搭配“需要睡眠”一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of improving something through careful, fine adjustments to its details.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过细致调整和修整细节，使事物更加完善的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li ttejjeb xi ħaġa permezz ta' tibdil żgħir u xogħol bir-reqqa fuq id-dettalji.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某事物进行精细修整、细致润饰或巧妙完善的行为。

formal.mt: Ir-rqim tad-dettalji fl-aħħar stadju tax-xogħol għen biex il-prodott finali jkun aktar preċiż u eleganti.
formal.en: Careful refinement of the details in the final stage of the work helped make the finished product more precise and elegant.
formal.zh: 在工作的最后阶段对细节进行精细修整，使最终成品更加精准、雅致。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ix-xogħol lest? | Mark: Kważi. Għad fadal ftit rqim tad-dettalji qabel nurih lill-klijent.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is the work finished? | Mark: Almost. A little fine adjustment of the details remains before I show it to the client.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：作品完成了吗？ | 马克：差不多了。给客户看之前，还有些细节需要修整。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 作品完成了吗？
messages.en: Is the work finished?

messages.speaker: Mark (设计师)
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi. Għad fadal ftit rqim tad-dettalji qabel nurih lill-klijent.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi. Għad fadal ftit rqim tad-dettalji qabel nurih lill-klijent.
messages.zh: 差不多了。给客户看之前，还有些细节需要修整。
messages.en: Almost. A little fine adjustment of the details remains before I show it to the client.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象作品已基本完成，工匠仍在仔细调整小细节，用“最后的精修”记住这个名词。

gloss_zh: 跛行；一瘸一拐的走路状态

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or condition of walking unevenly, with one leg moving differently from the other.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 走路时双腿动作不均衡，呈现一瘸一拐的行为或状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-mod kif persuna timxi b'pass mhux indaqs, b'sieq tiċċaqlaq b'mod differenti mill-oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 跛行；走路一瘸一拐的状态。

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżami, it-tabib osserva rqis ħafif meta l-pazjent mexa minn naħa għall-oħra tal-kamra.
formal.en: During the examination, the doctor observed a slight limp as the patient walked across the room.
formal.zh: 检查过程中，病人走过房间时，医生观察到他有轻微跛行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għad għandek dak ir-rqis meta timxi? | Pawlu: Ftit biss. Illum qed nimxi aħjar mill-bieraħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you still have that limp when you walk? | Pawlu: Only a little. Today I'm walking better than yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你现在走路还一瘸一拐的吗？ | 保罗：只有一点了。今天走得比昨天好了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad għandek dak ir-rqis meta timxi?
messages.mt_standard: Għad għandek dak ir-rqis meta timxi?
messages.zh: 你现在走路还一瘸一拐的吗？
messages.en: Do you still have that limp when you walk?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftit biss. Illum qed nimxi aħjar mill-bieraħ.
messages.mt_standard: Ftit biss. Illum qed nimxi aħjar mill-bieraħ.
messages.zh: 只有一点了。今天走得比昨天好了。
messages.en: Only a little. Today I'm walking better than yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用左右脚步不均匀的走路画面记忆，注意这里的名词表示“跛行”这种状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone angry, or to become angry oneself.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使别人生气，或自己产生愤怒的情绪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jirrabja, jew isir irrabjat hu stess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人生气；激怒某人。
生气；变得愤怒；发怒。

collocations.en: got angry because of the delay

formal.mt: Il-kumment rrabja lil diversi parteċipanti, u wieħed minnhom rrabja tant li telaq mil-laqgħa.
formal.en: The comment angered several participants, and one of them became so angry that he left the meeting.
formal.zh: 这番评论激怒了几名与会者，其中一人气得离开了会场。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex rrabja Mark? | Maja: Il-kumment tiegħi rrabjah. Se nitlob skuża.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Mark get angry? | Maja: My comment angered him. I'll apologize.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克为什么生气了？ | 玛雅：我的那句话惹他生气了。我会道歉。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么生气了？
messages.en: Why did Mark get angry?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kumment tiegħi rrabjah. Se nitlob skuża.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kumment tiegħi rrabjah. Se nitlob skuża.
messages.zh: 我的那句话惹他生气了。我会道歉。
messages.en: My comment angered him. I'll apologize.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住两个相连的画面：“一句话惹人生气”和“那个人生气了”，分别对应使动与自身变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To improve something by making careful changes that make it more precise, polished, or effective.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过细致修改，使事物更加精准、完善或有效。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Itejjeb xi ħaġa b'tibdil bir-reqqa biex jagħmilha aktar preċiża, mirquma jew effettiva.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 精炼；精修；通过细致调整加以改进或完善。

formal.mt: Wara li qara l-kummenti tal-editur, l-awtur rrafina l-istil tiegħu u għamel l-argument aktar ċar.
formal.en: After reading the editor's comments, the author refined his style and made the argument clearer.
formal.zh: 阅读编辑的意见后，作者进一步锤炼了文风，使论述更加清楚。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Id-disinn jidher aħjar issa. Min bidlu? | Lara: Mark rrafina d-dettalji wara l-laqgħa tagħna.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: The design looks better now. Who changed it? | Lara: Mark refined the details after our meeting.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：这个设计现在看起来更好了。谁改的？ | 拉拉：我们开完会后，马克精修了细节。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Id-disinn jidher aħjar issa. Min bidlu?
messages.mt_standard: Id-disinn jidher aħjar issa. Min bidlu?
messages.zh: 这个设计现在看起来更好了。谁改的？
messages.en: The design looks better now. Who changed it?

messages.speaker: Lara (设计师)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark rrafina d-dettalji wara l-laqgħa tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: Mark rrafina d-dettalji wara l-laqgħa tagħna.
messages.zh: 我们开完会后，马克精修了细节。
messages.en: Mark refined the details after our meeting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把初稿反复打磨成精稿，用“越改越精细”的过程记住这个动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To suggest someone or something as a good choice, or advise a course of action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 认为某人或某物值得选择而加以推荐，或建议采取某种行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tissuġġerixxi persuna jew ħaġa bħala għażla tajba, jew tagħti parir dwar x'għandu jsir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 推荐某人或某物；建议采取某种行动。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tiegħu, Pawlu rrakkomanda soluzzjoni li tnaqqas l-ispejjeż.
formal.en: In his report, Pawlu recommended a solution that reduces costs.
formal.zh: 保罗在报告中推荐了一个降低成本的解决方案。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema ktieb irrakkomanda Pawlu? Mark: Irrakkomanda dan il-ktieb dwar Malta; qal li faċli biex taqrah.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which book did Pawlu recommend? Mark: He recommended this book about Malta; he said it is easy to read.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗推荐了哪本书？马克：他推荐了这本介绍马耳他的书，说读起来很容易。
