messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗推荐了哪本书？
messages.en: Which book did Pawlu recommend?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Irrakkomanda dan il-ktieb dwar Malta; qal li faċli biex taqrah.
messages.mt_standard: Irrakkomanda dan il-ktieb dwar Malta; qal li faċli biex taqrah.
messages.zh: 他推荐了这本介绍马耳他的书，说读起来很容易。
messages.en: He recommended this book about Malta; he said it is easy to read.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友把一本好书递给你，说“这本值得读”，把推荐好选择的场景与这个词绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To tell a story or describe events in words.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用语言讲故事，或叙述发生过的事情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tgħid storja jew tiddeskrivi bil-kliem dak li ġara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 讲述故事；叙述事件或经历。

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, Mario rrakkonta l-esperjenza tiegħu bħala voluntier.
formal.en: During the meeting, Mario recounted his experience as a volunteer.
formal.zh: 会议期间，马里奥讲述了自己做志愿者的经历。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'irrakkonta n-nannu lbieraħ? Leo: Irrakkonta storja dwar meta kien żgħir. Kienet tad-daħk!
colloquial.en: Sara: What did Grandpa tell you yesterday? Leo: He told a story about when he was young. It was funny!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：爷爷昨天讲了什么？利奥：他讲了一个小时候的故事，可好笑了！

messages.speaker: Sara (姐姐)
messages.zh: 爷爷昨天讲了什么？
messages.en: What did Grandpa tell you yesterday?

messages.speaker: Leo (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Irrakkonta storja dwar meta kien żgħir. Kienet tad-daħk!
messages.mt_standard: Irrakkonta storja dwar meta kien żgħir. Kienet tad-daħk!
messages.zh: 他讲了一个小时候的故事，可好笑了！
messages.en: He told a story about when he was young. It was funny!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“爷爷开口讲往事”的画面，顺着人物、经过、结尾记住讲述与叙述。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give an account of events or details, or provide information to an authority against someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 报告事件或具体情况，也可指向有关机构举报或告发某人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħti tagħrif dwar ġrajja jew dettalji, jew tagħti informazzjoni lill-awtoritajiet kontra xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 报告、汇报或报道某事，交代其具体情况。
向有关机构提供针对某人的信息；举报或告发某人。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tiegħu, Mario rrapporta d-dettalji tal-inċident u l-ħin meta seħħ.
formal.en: In his report, Mario gave the details of the incident and the time it occurred.
formal.zh: 马里奥在报告中交代了事件的具体情况及发生时间。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex Pawlu rrapporta lill-ġar lill-pulizija? Mark: Qal li l-ġar heddidu.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why did Pawlu report his neighbor to the police? Mark: He said the neighbor had threatened him.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：保罗为什么向警方举报邻居？马克：他说邻居威胁了他。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么向警方举报邻居？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu report his neighbor to the police?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 他说邻居威胁了他。
messages.en: He said the neighbor had threatened him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住两幅相连画面：向主管报告事件，向警方举报某人；看报告的是事情还是人来区分词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To scrape a surface or remove material from it by scraping.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 刮擦物体表面，或通过刮擦去除表面的东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tgħaddi għodda fuq wiċċ biex tobroxu jew tneħħi materjal minn fuqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刮擦；刮去表面的附着物或材料。

formal.mt: Qabel beda jiżbogħ, Mario rraxka ż-żebgħa l-qadima minn mal-ħajt.
formal.en: Before he started painting, Mario scraped the old paint off the wall.
formal.zh: 开始刷漆前，马里奥刮掉了墙上的旧油漆。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex hawn biċċiet taż-żebgħa mal-art? Leo: Mario rraxka l-ħajt dalgħodu. Issa niġborhom.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why are there bits of paint on the floor? Leo: Mario scraped the wall this morning. I'll pick them up now.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：地上怎么有油漆碎片？利奥：马里奥今天早上刮了墙。我现在把它们收起来。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 地上怎么有油漆碎片？
messages.en: Why are there bits of paint on the floor?

messages.speaker: Leo (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mario rraxka l-ħajt dalgħodu. Issa niġborhom.
messages.mt_standard: Mario rraxka l-ħajt dalgħodu. Issa niġborhom.
messages.zh: 马里奥今天早上刮了墙。我现在把它们收起来。
messages.en: Mario scraped the wall this morning. I'll pick them up now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象刮刀贴着墙面移动，旧漆一片片掉下来，用这个具体动作记住刮擦与刮除。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To respond to something that happens through an action, feeling, or change.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对发生的事情作出反应，表现为行动、情绪或状态的变化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tw ieġeb għal dak li jiġri b'azzjoni, b'emozzjoni jew b'bidla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某种情况、消息或刺激作出反应。

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżerċizzju, Pawlu rreaġixxa malajr għas-sinjal u waqqaf il-magna.
formal.en: During the exercise, Pawlu reacted quickly to the signal and stopped the machine.
formal.zh: 演练中，保罗迅速对信号作出反应，关停了机器。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif irreaġixxa Pawlu għall-aħbar? Rita: Tb issem u qal li kien ferħan ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did Pawlu react to the news? Rita: He smiled and said he was very happy.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗听到消息后有什么反应？丽塔：他笑了，说自己非常高兴。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗听到消息后有什么反应？
messages.en: How did Pawlu react to the news?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tb issem u qal li kien ferħan ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Tb issem u qal li kien ferħan ħafna.
messages.zh: 他笑了，说自己非常高兴。
messages.en: He smiled and said he was very happy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想一个消息，再想听到消息后的表情或动作；把“刺激来了，反应出现”作为记忆顺序。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To act as the referee in a game or sporting match.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在比赛中担任裁判，依据规则作出判定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taġixxi bħala r-referee f'logħba jew f'partita u tapplika r-regoli tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在体育比赛中担任裁判；执裁比赛。

formal.mt: Il-Ħadd li għadda, Mario rreffja l-finali tat-turnew tal-futbol.
formal.en: Last Sunday, Mario refereed the final of the football tournament.
formal.zh: 上周日，马里奥担任了足球锦标赛决赛的裁判。

colloquial.mt: Leo: Min ir reffja l-partita lbieraħ? Sara: Mario. Kienet l-ewwel partita tiegħu bħala referee.
colloquial.en: Leo: Who refereed the match yesterday? Sara: Mario. It was his first match as a referee.
colloquial.zh: 利奥：昨天那场比赛是谁执裁的？萨拉：马里奥。那是他第一次担任比赛裁判。

messages.speaker: Leo (球迷)
messages.zh: 昨天那场比赛是谁执裁的？
messages.en: Who refereed the match yesterday?

messages.speaker: Sara (球迷)
messages.mt_spoken: Mario. Kienet l-ewwel partita tiegħu bħala referee.
messages.mt_standard: Mario. Kienet l-ewwel partita tiegħu bħala referee.
messages.zh: 马里奥。那是他第一次担任比赛裁判。
messages.en: Mario. It was his first match as a referee.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和球场上吹哨、判罚的裁判联系起来，记住它表示执行裁判职责这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To control or adjust how something works, or to conduct oneself in a particular way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 控制、调节或规范某事物的运行，也可指以某种方式行事或表现自己的举止。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tikkontrolla jew taġġusta kif taħdem xi ħaġa, jew iġġib ruħek b'ċertu mod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 调节、控制或规范，使某事物按所需方式运行。
行事；表现出某种举止，常与表示自身的词语连用。

formal.mt: Matul l-esperiment, Pawlu rregola t-temperatura tal-ilma biex tibqa' kostanti.
formal.en: During the experiment, Pawlu regulated the water temperature to keep it constant.
formal.zh: 实验期间，保罗调节水温，使其保持恒定。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif irregola ruħu Leo waqt iż-żjara? Mark: Tajjeb ħafna; sema' bil-kwiet u stenna sakemm spiċċaw jitkellmu.
colloquial.en: Anna: How did Leo behave during the visit? Mark: Very well; he listened quietly and waited until they finished speaking.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：利奥在拜访期间表现怎么样？马克：很好，他安静地听着，一直等到他们说完。

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif irregola ruħu Leo waqt iż-żjara?
messages.mt_standard: Kif irregola ruħu Leo waqt iż-żjara?
messages.zh: 利奥在拜访期间表现怎么样？
messages.en: How did Leo behave during the visit?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb ħafna; sema' bil-kwiet u stenna sakemm spiċċaw jitkellmu.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb ħafna; sema' bil-kwiet u stenna sakemm spiċċaw jitkellmu.
messages.zh: 很好，他安静地听着，一直等到他们说完。
messages.en: Very well; he listened quietly and waited until they finished speaking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面并排记忆：转动旋钮调节温度，约束自己保持得体举止；遇到 ruħu 时联想自身行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bring a situation or arrangement into conformity with the relevant rules or requirements.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过补办手续或调整安排，使某种情况符合相关规定或要求。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel is-sitwazzjoni jew l-arranġamenti konformi mar-regoli jew mar-rekwiżiti rilevanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使规范化；使某种情况、身份或安排符合有关规定或正式要求。

collocations.zh: 使自己的情况符合规定
使自己的身份状态符合规定

formal.mt: Wara li ppreżenta d-dokumenti meħtieġa, Pawlu rregolarizza l-istatus tiegħu.
formal.en: After submitting the required documents, Pawlu regularized his status.
formal.zh: 提交所需文件后，保罗使自己的身份状态符合了规定。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu rregolarizza s-sitwazzjoni tiegħu? Rita: Iva, ressaq id-dokumenti li kienu neqsin u rċieva l-konferma.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has Pawlu regularized his situation? Rita: Yes, he submitted the missing documents and received confirmation.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗把手续补齐、使自己的情况符合规定了吗？丽塔：是的，他提交了缺少的文件，也收到了确认。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 保罗把手续补齐、使自己的情况符合规定了吗？
messages.en: Has Pawlu regularized his situation?

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ressaq id-dokumenti li kienu neqsin u rċieva l-konferma.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ressaq id-dokumenti li kienu neqsin u rċieva l-konferma.
messages.zh: 是的，他提交了缺少的文件，也收到了确认。
messages.en: Yes, he submitted the missing documents and received confirmation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把缺少的文件一份份补齐，最后得到正式确认；用“补齐要求，使之合规”的流程记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To officially demand the use of property or supplies, especially for public or emergency needs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 凭官方权限要求使用财物或物资，尤指为公共事务或紧急需要而征用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitlob proprjetà jew provvisti b'awtorità uffiċjali biex jintużaw għal ħtieġa pubblika jew urġenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由有权机关正式征用财物、设备或物资。

formal.mt: Waqt l-emerġenza, il-gvern rrekwiżizzjona vetturi privati biex jittrasporta l-provvisti lejn iż-żoni milquta.
formal.en: During the emergency, the government requisitioned private vehicles to transport supplies to the affected areas.
formal.zh: 紧急情况期间，政府征用了私人车辆，将物资运往受灾地区。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hemm suldati fil-maħżen? Mark: Il-gvern rrekwiżizzjona l-maħżen biex iżomm fih il-provvisti tal-emerġenza.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are there soldiers in the warehouse? Mark: The government requisitioned the warehouse to store emergency supplies.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：仓库里为什么有军人？马克：政府征用了这座仓库，用来存放应急物资。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 仓库里为什么有军人？
messages.en: Why are there soldiers in the warehouse?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-gvern rrekwiżizzjona l-maħżen biex iżomm fih il-provvisti tal-emerġenza.
messages.mt_standard: Il-gvern rrekwiżizzjona l-maħżen biex iżomm fih il-provvisti tal-emerġenza.
messages.zh: 政府征用了这座仓库，用来存放应急物资。
messages.en: The government requisitioned the warehouse to store emergency supplies.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象应急人员拿着正式文件调用车辆：把这个词和“官方征用物资”的场景一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To forcefully control or suppress an activity, an expression, or a feeling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 强行压制某种活动或表达，也可指抑制自己的情绪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Irażżan jew iwaqqaf bil-forza attività jew espressjoni, jew iżomm lura sentiment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 压制或镇压活动与表达，或抑制情绪。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif ir-reġim rreprima l-protesti u l-espressjoni pubblika tad-diżgwid.
formal.en: The report describes how the regime repressed protests and public expressions of disagreement.
formal.zh: 报告描述了该政权如何镇压抗议，并压制公开表达的不同意见。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu ma deherx irrabjat waqt il-laqgħa. Mark: Kien irrabjat, imma rreprima r-rabja tiegħu biex ma jibdiex argument.
colloquial.en: Maja: Paul didn't seem angry during the meeting. Mark: He was angry, but he repressed his anger to avoid starting an argument.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗开会时看起来没有生气。马克：他其实生气了，只是压住了怒火，免得吵起来。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu ma deherx irrabjat waqt il-laqgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu ma deherx irrabjat waqt il-laqgħa.
messages.zh: 保罗开会时看起来没有生气。
messages.en: Paul didn't seem angry during the meeting.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien irrabjat, imma rreprima r-rabja tiegħu biex ma jibdiex argument.
messages.mt_standard: Kien irrabjat, imma rreprima r-rabja tiegħu biex ma jibdiex argument.
messages.zh: 他其实生气了，只是压住了怒火，免得吵起来。
messages.en: He was angry, but he repressed his anger to avoid starting an argument.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把快要冒出来的怒火用盖子压住，再联系压制抗议的场景，记住共同含义“压下去”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To repair something old or damaged and return it to its former condition or appearance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 修理陈旧或受损的物品，使其恢复原有状态或外观。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isewwi xi ħaġa qadima jew bil-ħsara biex jerġa' jagħtiha l-kundizzjoni jew id-dehra ta' qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 修复某物，使其恢复原有状态、功能或外观。

formal.mt: It-tim rrestawra l-pittura b'attenzjoni kbira u żamm kemm seta' mill-materjal oriġinali.
formal.en: The team restored the painting with great care and preserved as much of the original material as possible.
formal.zh: 团队细心修复了这幅画，并尽可能保留了原有材料。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan is-siġġu kien tan-nannu? Mark: Iva, missieri rrestawra s-siġġu u issa nistgħu nerġgħu nużawh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did this chair belong to your grandfather? Mark: Yes, my father restored the chair, and now we can use it again.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这把椅子以前是你爷爷的吗？马克：是的，我爸爸把它修复好了，现在我们又能用了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这把椅子以前是你爷爷的吗？
messages.en: Did this chair belong to your grandfather?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, missieri rrestawra s-siġġu u issa nistgħu nerġgħu nużawh.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, missieri rrestawra s-siġġu u issa nistgħu nerġgħu nużawh.
messages.zh: 是的，我爸爸把它修复好了，现在我们又能用了。
messages.en: Yes, my father restored the chair, and now we can use it again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把一把破旧木椅修回原来模样的前后画面并排想象，用“恢复原貌”记住这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To force someone to give money or do something by threatening to reveal damaging information about them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以公开对某人不利的信息相威胁，迫使其交钱或做某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jagħti flus jew jagħmel xi ħaġa billi jheddu li jikxef informazzjoni li tista' tagħmillu ħsara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以揭露隐私或不利信息为要挟，向某人敲诈钱财或迫使其就范。

collocations.mt: rrikatta lil xi ħadd b'ritratti privati

formal.mt: Skont ix-xhieda, ir-raġel rrikatta lin-negozjant billi hedded li jippubblika dokumenti privati jekk ma jirċevix il-flus.
formal.en: According to the testimony, the man blackmailed the businessman by threatening to publish private documents unless he received the money.
formal.zh: 根据证词，该男子勒索了那名商人，威胁说如果拿不到钱，就公开私人文件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu mar għand il-pulizija? Mark: Xi ħadd rrikatta lil Pawlu b'ritratti privati u talbu l-flus.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Paul go to the police? Mark: Someone blackmailed Paul with private photographs and demanded money from him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么去找警察？马克：有人用私人照片勒索保罗，向他索要钱财。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么去找警察？
messages.en: Why did Paul go to the police?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd rrikatta lil Pawlu b'ritratti privati u talbu l-flus.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd rrikatta lil Pawlu b'ritratti privati u talbu l-flus.
messages.zh: 有人用私人照片勒索保罗，向他索要钱财。
messages.en: Someone blackmailed Paul with private photographs and demanded money from him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“不给钱就公开秘密”这句威胁与词义相连，记住其核心是利用秘密进行勒索。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To draw attention to a fact, detail, or problem by mentioning it clearly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 明确提及某个事实、细节或问题，使别人注意到它。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġbed l-attenzjoni għal fatt, dettall jew problema billi jsemmiha b'mod ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 指出某个事实、细节或问题，提请别人注意。

collocations.en: pointed out the importance of cooperation

formal.mt: Fid-diskors tiegħu, il-kelliem rrileva li l-proġett jeħtieġ aktar fondi biex jitlesta fil-ħin.
formal.en: In his speech, the speaker pointed out that the project needs more funding to be completed on time.
formal.zh: 发言人在讲话中指出，该项目需要更多资金才能按时完成。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex biddilt id-data fuq l-istedina? Mark: Pawlu rrileva żball fid-data, u kkoreġejtu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you change the date on the invitation? Mark: Paul pointed out an error in the date, and I corrected it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么改了邀请函上的日期？马克：保罗指出日期有误，我就改正了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么改了邀请函上的日期？
messages.en: Why did you change the date on the invitation?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu rrileva żball fid-data, u kkoreġejtu.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu rrileva żball fid-data, u kkoreġejtu.
messages.zh: 保罗指出日期有误，我就改正了。
messages.en: Paul pointed out an error in the date, and I corrected it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老师在一处错误旁画圈并说“请注意这里”，用“明确指出、引人注意”记住词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To express gratitude to someone for help, kindness, or something they have done.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因别人提供帮助、表现善意或做了某事而向其表达谢意。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jesprimi gratitudni lil xi ħadd għall-għajnuna, il-qalb tajba jew xi ħaġa li jkun għamel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向某人表示感谢或致谢。

collocations.en: thanked his friends for their help

formal.mt: Fi tmiem iċ-ċerimonja, id-direttur rringrazzja lill-voluntiera għall-ħin u l-impenn tagħhom.
formal.en: At the end of the ceremony, the director thanked the volunteers for their time and commitment.
formal.zh: 仪式结束时，主任感谢志愿者们付出的时间和努力。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark għoġbu r-rigal? Pawlu: Iva, rringrazzja lil kulħadd u fetaħ il-kaxxa minnufih.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Mark like the gift? Paul: Yes, he thanked everyone and opened the box straight away.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克喜欢那份礼物吗？保罗：喜欢，他感谢了大家，马上就打开了盒子。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克喜欢那份礼物吗？
messages.en: Did Mark like the gift?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, rringrazzja lil kulħadd u fetaħ il-kaxxa minnufih.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, rringrazzja lil kulħadd u fetaħ il-kaxxa minnufih.
messages.zh: 喜欢，他感谢了大家，马上就打开了盒子。
messages.en: Yes, he thanked everyone and opened the box straight away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把收到礼物后微笑说谢谢的动作与这个词绑定，再练习说清楚“感谢谁、感谢什么”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a copy of something or produce the same result or effect again.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 制作某物的副本，或再次产生相同的结果或效果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel kopja ta' xi ħaġa jew jerġa' joħloq l-istess riżultat jew effett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 复制某物，或重现原有的结果、效果或表现。

collocations.en: reproduced the results of the experiment

formal.mt: It-tim rriproduċa r-riżultati tal-esperiment billi uża l-istess metodu u l-istess kundizzjonijiet.
formal.en: The team reproduced the results of the experiment by using the same method and the same conditions.
formal.zh: 团队采用相同的方法和条件，重现了该实验的结果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan ir-ritratt hu l-oriġinal? Mark: Le, ħija rriproduċa r-ritratt il-qadim biex kull wieħed minna jkollu kopja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this the original photograph? Mark: No, my brother reproduced the old photograph so that each of us could have a copy.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这是照片的原件吗？马克：不是，我哥哥复制了那张老照片，好让我们每人都有一份。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这是照片的原件吗？
messages.en: Is this the original photograph?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ħija rriproduċa r-ritratt il-qadim biex kull wieħed minna jkollu kopja.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ħija rriproduċa r-ritratt il-qadim biex kull wieħed minna jkollu kopja.
messages.zh: 不是，我哥哥复制了那张老照片，好让我们每人都有一份。
messages.en: No, my brother reproduced the old photograph so that each of us could have a copy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排想象两张相同照片，再想象重复实验得到相同结果，用“再次做出相同内容”串联词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To do something despite the possibility of harm or failure, or to expose something valuable to possible loss.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 明知可能受损或失败仍采取行动，或使重要的人或事物面临损失的风险。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tagħmel xi ħaġa minkejja l-possibbiltà ta' ħsara jew falliment, jew tqiegħed xi ħaġa ta' valur fil-periklu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 冒险做某事；使某人或某物面临危险或损失。

formal.mt: Is-salvatur rriskja ħajtu biex jgħin lill-persuna li kienet fil-baħar.
formal.en: The rescuer risked his life to help the person who was in the sea.
formal.zh: 救援人员冒着生命危险帮助海中的那个人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu rriskja li jitlef il-ferrovija? Leo: Ried jixtri kafè qabel jitlaq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu risk missing the train? Leo: He wanted to buy a coffee before leaving.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu为什么冒着赶不上火车的风险？Leo：他想在出发前买杯咖啡。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu rriskja li jitlef il-ferrovija?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu rriskja li jitlef il-ferrovija?
messages.zh: Pawlu为什么冒着赶不上火车的风险？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu risk missing the train?

messages.speaker: Leo (朋友)
messages.zh: 他想在出发前买杯咖啡。
messages.en: He wanted to buy a coffee before leaving.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和“为了买咖啡，冒险错过火车”的画面相连：知道可能有损失，仍然去做，就是冒险。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To treat someone with consideration and regard, or to act in accordance with a rule, right, or agreement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以体谅和重视的态度对待他人，或按照规则、权利和约定行事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tittratta lil xi ħadd b'konsiderazzjoni u stima, jew timxi skont regola, dritt jew ftehim.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 尊重他人及其权利、意见或意愿；遵守规则或约定。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat irrispetta d-deċiżjoni tal-parteċipanta li ma tkomplix fl-istudju.
formal.en: The committee respected the participant's decision not to continue in the study.
formal.zh: 委员会尊重了这位参与者不再继续参加研究的决定。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Mark qabel mal-għażla tiegħek? Nina: Le, imma rrispetta d-deċiżjoni tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did Mark agree with your choice? Nina: No, but he respected my decision.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Mark赞同你的选择吗？Nina：不赞同，但他尊重了我的决定。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark赞同你的选择吗？
messages.en: Did Mark agree with your choice?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 不赞同，但他尊重了我的决定。
messages.en: No, but he respected my decision.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“意见可以不同，决定仍要尊重”的对话；对象是人或意见时想到尊重，对象是规则时想到遵守。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give an answer to a question or message, or to react to a request or situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对问题或信息作出答复，或对请求和情况作出回应。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tagħti tweġiba għal mistoqsija jew messaġġ, jew tirreaġixxi għal talba jew sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 回答问题；回复消息；对请求或情况作出回应。

formal.mt: Id-direttur irrisponda għat-talba bil-miktub u spjega l-passi li jmiss.
formal.en: The director responded to the request in writing and explained the next steps.
formal.zh: 主管以书面形式回应了请求，并说明了接下来的步骤。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu rrisponda għall-messaġġ tiegħek? Leo: Iva, qal li jasal fit-tmienja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Pawlu reply to your message? Leo: Yes, he said he would arrive at eight.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu回复你的消息了吗？Leo：回复了，他说八点到。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu回复你的消息了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu reply to your message?

messages.speaker: Leo (朋友)
messages.zh: 回复了，他说八点到。
messages.en: Yes, he said he would arrive at eight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把手机收到问题后出现回复气泡的画面与这个词绑定：问题有回答，消息有回复，请求有回应。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a process, development, or movement happen more slowly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使过程、发展或运动的速度降低，延缓其进展。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġġiegħel proċess, żvilupp jew moviment jimxi aktar bil-mod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 延缓；阻缓；使某个过程、发展或运动变慢。

formal.mt: In-nuqqas ta' ilma rritardja t-tkabbir tal-pjanti matul is-sajf.
formal.en: The lack of water slowed the plants' growth during the summer.
formal.zh: 夏季缺水使植物的生长变慢了。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex ix-xogħol miexi daqshekk bil-mod? Mark: In-nuqqas ta' materjal irritardja kollox.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is the work moving so slowly? Mark: The shortage of materials slowed everything down.
colloquial.zh: Sara：工作为什么进展这么慢？Mark：材料短缺拖慢了所有进度。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 工作为什么进展这么慢？
messages.en: Why is the work moving so slowly?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 材料短缺拖慢了所有进度。
messages.en: The shortage of materials slowed everything down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象进度条因为材料不足而缓慢前进，把这个词记成“给进展踩了刹车”，核心是使速度变慢。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To examine a text, plan, or other piece of work again and make changes to improve or update it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 重新检查文本、计划或其他成果，并通过修改加以完善或更新。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li terġa' teżamina test, pjan jew xogħol ieħor u tagħmel bidliet biex ittejjbu jew taġġornah.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 修订；重新审阅并修改文本、计划或其他内容。

formal.mt: L-awtur irriveda r-rapport wara li rċieva l-kummenti tal-editur.
formal.en: The author revised the report after receiving the editor's comments.
formal.zh: 作者收到编辑的意见后修订了报告。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan hu l-istess pjan ta' qabel? Leo: Le, Mark irriveda l-pjan wara l-laqgħa.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this the same plan as before? Leo: No, Mark revised the plan after the meeting.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这还是之前那个计划吗？Leo：不是，Mark开会后修改了计划。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan hu l-istess pjan ta' qabel?
messages.mt_standard: Dan hu l-istess pjan ta' qabel?
messages.zh: 这还是之前那个计划吗？
messages.en: Is this the same plan as before?

messages.speaker: Leo (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, Mark irriveda l-pjan wara l-laqgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Le, Mark irriveda l-pjan wara l-laqgħa.
messages.zh: 不是，Mark开会后修改了计划。
messages.en: No, Mark revised the plan after the meeting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“旧稿加上修改标记，变成新版”的画面记忆：先重新检查，再动笔完善，就是修订。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To practise a performance, speech, or sequence of actions before presenting or carrying it out.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在正式演出、讲话或行动之前，练习其内容或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jipprattika spettaklu, diskors jew sensiela ta' azzjonijiet qabel ma jippreżentahom jew iwettaqhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为正式表演、发言或行动进行排练或预演。

formal.mt: Il-grupp rriħersja x-xena finali diversi drabi qabel il-wirja biex itejjeb il-koordinazzjoni bejn l-atturi.
formal.en: The group rehearsed the final scene several times before the performance to improve coordination among the actors.
formal.zh: 剧组在演出前多次排练最后一场戏，以改善演员之间的配合。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark lest għad-diskors ta' għada? Pawlu: Iva, illum rriħersja d-diskors kollu quddiemi darbtejn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is Mark ready for tomorrow's speech? Paul: Yes, today he rehearsed the whole speech in front of me twice.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克准备好明天的讲话了吗？保罗：准备好了，他今天在我面前把整篇讲话预演了两遍。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克准备好明天的讲话了吗？
messages.en: Is Mark ready for tomorrow's speech?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, illum rriħersja d-diskors kollu quddiemi darbtejn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, illum rriħersja d-diskors kollu quddiemi darbtejn.
messages.zh: 准备好了，他今天在我面前把整篇讲话预演了两遍。
messages.en: Yes, today he rehearsed the whole speech in front of me twice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象正式登台前对着空座位完整演一遍：把“先练一遍，再正式上场”作为记忆提示。

gloss_zh: 安排路线；按路线行进；按指定路线发送

teaching_sense.en_definition: To determine or follow a route, or to direct someone or something along a particular route.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 确定或遵循行进路线，或安排人和物沿某条指定路线前往目的地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tippjana jew issegwi rotta, jew tidderieġi lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa minn rotta partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为人、车辆、货物等安排路线；使其沿某条路线行进或传送。
规划行进路线；按照某条路线行进。

sense_translations.en_definition: to send by a specified route
sense_translations.zh_definition: 按照指定路线发送或运送。

collocations.zh: 将交通引导至另一条道路

collocations.en: routed the delivery via an alternative road
collocations.zh: 安排货物经替代道路运送

formal.mt: Il-koordinatur irrotta l-kunsinna minn triq alternattiva minħabba li t-triq prinċipali kienet magħluqa.
formal.en: The coordinator routed the delivery via an alternative road because the main road was closed.
formal.zh: 由于主路封闭，协调员安排货物经另一条道路运送。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-vann għadda minn hemm? Leo: L-uffiċċju rrotta l-kunsinna minn triq oħra biex jevita t-traffiku.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the van go that way? Leo: The office routed the delivery via another road to avoid traffic.
colloquial.zh: Maja：货车为什么走那边？Leo：办公室安排货物走另一条路，以避开拥堵。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 货车为什么走那边？
messages.en: Why did the van go that way?

messages.speaker: Leo (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: L-uffiċċju rrotta l-kunsinna minn triq oħra biex jevita t-traffiku.
messages.mt_standard: L-uffiċċju rrotta l-kunsinna minn triq oħra biex jevita t-traffiku.
messages.zh: 办公室安排货物走另一条路，以避开拥堵。
messages.en: The office routed the delivery via another road to avoid traffic.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象在地图上画出送货路线：画线是规划路线，沿线走是遵循路线，让货物沿线送达是按路线发送。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of moving nearer to someone or something, or of bringing someone or something closer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向某人或某物靠近，或使人或物彼此接近的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tersaq lejn xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, jew li tressaq lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa aktar qrib.

sense_translations.en_definition: act of bringing close or approaching sth. or sb.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人或物靠近，或向某人、某物接近的行为。

collocations.en: the ship's approach to the quay
collocations.zh: 船舶向码头靠近的过程

collocations.en: a gradual approach to the shore

formal.mt: Ir-rsiq tal-vapur lejn il-moll sar bil-mod biex jiġu evitati ħsarat.
formal.en: The ship's approach to the quay was carried out slowly to avoid damage.
formal.zh: 船舶缓慢靠近码头，以避免造成损坏。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex id-dgħajsa miexja daqshekk bil-mod? Mark: Biex ir-rsiq lejn il-moll ikun aktar faċli.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is the boat moving so slowly? Mark: To make the approach to the quay easier.
colloquial.zh: Sara：小船为什么开得这么慢？Mark：这样更容易靠近码头。

messages.speaker: Sara (乘客)
messages.zh: 小船为什么开得这么慢？
messages.en: Why is the boat moving so slowly?

messages.speaker: Mark (船员)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex ir-rsiq lejn il-moll ikun aktar faċli.
messages.mt_standard: Biex ir-rsiq lejn il-moll ikun aktar faċli.
messages.zh: 这样更容易靠近码头。
messages.en: To make the approach to the quay easier.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中播放小船与码头之间距离逐渐缩短的画面；这个名词给“靠近这一过程”起了名字。

gloss_zh: 被系住；受到约束；作出承诺

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become tied or bound, physically or by an obligation, or to commit oneself to doing something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在实际意义上被系住或绑住，或因义务而受到约束，也可指承诺承担某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ssir marbut fiżikament jew b'obbligu, jew tintrabat li tagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被系住或绑住。
被束缚；受到约束，包括受义务或协议的约束。
作出承诺；承担义务；承诺投入某项事务。

formal.mt: Il-voluntier rtabat li jgħin fit-tqassim tal-ikel kull nhar ta' Sibt.
formal.en: The volunteer committed himself to helping with food distribution every Saturday.
formal.zh: 这位志愿者承诺每周六协助分发食物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu se jgħinna nhar is-Sibt? Leo: Iva, rtabat li jiġi filgħodu u jgħin bil-kaxxi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Will Pawlu help us on Saturday? Leo: Yes, he committed himself to coming in the morning and helping with the boxes.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu星期六会来帮我们吗？Leo：会，他答应早上过来帮忙搬箱子。

messages.speaker: Maja (志愿者)
messages.zh: Pawlu星期六会来帮我们吗？
messages.en: Will Pawlu help us on Saturday?

messages.speaker: Leo (志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, rtabat li jiġi filgħodu u jgħin bil-kaxxi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, rtabat li jiġi filgħodu u jgħin bil-kaxxi.
messages.zh: 会，他答应早上过来帮忙搬箱子。
messages.en: Yes, he committed himself to coming in the morning and helping with the boxes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“绳子系住物品，承诺约束行动”作学习联想，串起被系住、受约束和作出承诺三个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be buried beneath earth, rubble, or other covering material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被泥土、碎石或其他覆盖物埋住。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jindifen taħt il-ħamrija, it-tiġrif jew materjal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被埋在地下或被覆盖物掩埋。

formal.mt: Waqt ix-xogħol, pajp antik rtadam taħt saff ġdid ta' ħamrija.
formal.en: During the work, an old pipe was buried beneath a new layer of soil.
formal.zh: 施工时，一根旧管道被埋在新铺的一层土下面。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn mar il-ballun? Toni: Rtadam fir-ramel. Ejja nfittxuh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did the ball go? Toni: It got buried in the sand. Let's look for it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：球到哪里去了？托尼：被埋在沙里了。我们找找吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 球到哪里去了？
messages.en: Where did the ball go?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 被埋在沙里了。我们找找吧。
messages.en: It got buried in the sand. Let's look for it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象球被一层沙完全盖住，把 rtadam 与“被掩埋”的结果画面一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be rendered to someone or given back to the person to whom something belongs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被给予或交付给某人，或被归还给原来的所有者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħata lil xi ħadd jew jingħata lura lil sidu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被给予或交付。
被交还；被归还给原来的持有者或所有者。

collocations.en: was given back to its owner
was given back after being borrowed

formal.mt: Il-manuskritt misluf rtadd lil sidu wara li ntemmet il-wirja.
formal.en: The borrowed manuscript was given back to its owner after the exhibition ended.
formal.zh: 展览结束后，借来的手稿被归还给了物主。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-ktieb għadu għand Mark? Nina: Le, rtadd lil sidu lbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does Mark still have the book? Nina: No, it was given back to its owner yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：书还在马克那里吗？妮娜：不在了，昨天已经归还给书的主人了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 书还在马克那里吗？
messages.en: Does Mark still have the book?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 不在了，昨天已经归还给书的主人了。
messages.en: No, it was given back to its owner yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一本借出的书回到主人手中的画面记 rtadd，并把“交付”和“交还”分成两个义项复习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be put out to pasture or allowed to feed on growing grass.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 牲畜被放到牧场上，或获准在草地上吃草。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jittieħed fil-mergħa jew jitħalla jiekol il-ħaxix.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被放到牧场或草地上放牧。
被允许在草地上吃草。

collocations.en: was put out to pasture in the grazing field
was allowed to graze for a few hours

formal.mt: Il-gendus rtagħa fil-mergħa ħdejn ir-razzett għal sagħtejn.
formal.en: The bull was allowed to graze in the pasture near the farm for two hours.
formal.zh: 那头公牛获准在农场附近的牧场上吃了两个小时的草。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Iż-żiemel baqa' fl-istalla llum? Pawlu: Le, rtagħa fl-għalqa ta' wara għal ftit sigħat.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did the horse stay in the stable today? Pawlu: No, it was allowed to graze in the field at the back for a few hours.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马今天一直待在马厩里吗？保罗：没有，它获准到后面的田里吃了几个小时的草。

messages.speaker: Sara (农场访客)
messages.zh: 马今天一直待在马厩里吗？
messages.en: Did the horse stay in the stable today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农场主)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, rtagħa fl-għalqa ta' wara għal ftit sigħat.
messages.mt_standard: Le, rtagħa fl-għalqa ta' wara għal ftit sigħat.
messages.zh: 没有，它获准到后面的田里吃了几个小时的草。
messages.en: No, it was allowed to graze in the field at the back for a few hours.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rtagħa 记成打开牧场门后的两个镜头：牲畜被放出去，随后获准低头吃草。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be left with a pawnbroker as security for borrowed money.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物品被交给典当商，作为借款的担保。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħata għand min jislef il-flus bħala garanzija għal self.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被典当，即被交作借款的担保物。

collocations.en: was pawned to secure a loan

formal.mt: L-arloġġ tad-deheb rtahan bħala garanzija għal self żgħir.
formal.en: The gold watch was pawned as security for a small loan.
formal.zh: 那块金表被典当，作为一笔小额借款的担保。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Fejn hu l-arloġġ tan-nannu? Ġużeppi: Rtahan ix-xahar li għadda, imma se nifduh dalwaqt.
colloquial.en: Marta: Where is Grandpa's watch? Ġużeppi: It was pawned last month, but we'll redeem it soon.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：爷爷的手表在哪里？朱塞佩：上个月被典当了，不过我们很快就会把它赎回来。

messages.speaker: Marta (孙女)
messages.zh: 爷爷的手表在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Grandpa's watch?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Rtahan ix-xahar li għadda, imma se nifduh dalwaqt.
messages.mt_standard: Rtahan ix-xahar li għadda, imma se nifduh dalwaqt.
messages.zh: 上个月被典当了，不过我们很快就会把它赎回来。
messages.en: It was pawned last month, but we'll redeem it soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象金表暂时放在典当柜台里换取借款，用这个画面记 rtahan 的“被典当”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To show flexibility or be pliable enough to bend or change shape.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表现出柔韧性，或具有可以弯曲、改变形状的性质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Juri flessibbiltà jew ikun jista' jitgħawweġ u jieħu forma oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表现出柔韧性或可弯曲性。
质地柔韧，能够弯曲或改变形状。

collocations.zh: 在轻微压力下显出柔韧性
显出可弯曲性而未折断

formal.mt: Matul il-prova, il-materjal rtakat taħt pressjoni ħafifa mingħajr ma nkiser.
formal.en: During the test, the material showed flexibility under light pressure without breaking.
formal.zh: 测试中，这种材料在轻微压力下表现出柔韧性，没有断裂。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-wajer iebes wisq? Mark: Le, rtakat faċilment meta ppruvajt ngħawġu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this wire too stiff? Mark: No, it proved pliable when I tried to bend it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这根金属丝是不是太硬了？马克：不是，我试着弯它时，它很容易就弯了。

messages.speaker: Lara (手工课学生)
messages.zh: 这根金属丝是不是太硬了？
messages.en: Is this wire too stiff?

messages.speaker: Mark (手工课教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, rtakat faċilment meta ppruvajt ngħawġu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, rtakat faċilment meta ppruvajt ngħawġu.
messages.zh: 不是，我试着弯它时，它很容易就弯了。
messages.en: No, it proved pliable when I tried to bend it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用手轻压一根能弯而不断的金属丝，把 rtakat 与“显出柔韧、可以弯曲”相连。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be set up for use, or, of an animal, to be fitted with a harness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 设施被搭建或布置好以供使用；也指牲畜被套上挽具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi armat biex jintuża, jew, fil-każ ta' annimal, jitqegħedlu x-xedd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被搭建、架设或布置好。
牲畜被套上挽具，以便拉车或做其他牵引工作。

collocations.en: was set up for the performance
was harnessed to pull the cart

formal.mt: Il-palk rtama fil-pjazza qabel il-bidu tal-festival.
formal.en: The stage was set up in the square before the festival began.
formal.zh: 节庆开始前，舞台已在广场上搭建好。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Iż-żiemel lest biex jiġbed il-karru? Toni: Iva, rtama ftit ilu. Nistgħu nitilqu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Is the horse ready to pull the cart? Toni: Yes, it was harnessed a little while ago. We can leave.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：马准备好拉车了吗？托尼：好了，刚才已经套上挽具了。我们可以出发了。

messages.speaker: Anna (农场工人)
messages.zh: 马准备好拉车了吗？
messages.en: Is the horse ready to pull the cart?

messages.speaker: Toni (车夫)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, rtama ftit ilu. Nistgħu nitilqu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, rtama ftit ilu. Nistgħu nitilqu.
messages.zh: 好了，刚才已经套上挽具了。我们可以出发了。
messages.en: Yes, it was harnessed a little while ago. We can leave.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 rtama 配两张准备就绪的图：舞台被搭好，马被套好挽具；分别记住两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be bent so that something changes from a straight shape to a curved or angled one.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体被弄弯，由直的形状变成弧形或带角度的形状。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitgħawweġ u jinbidel minn forma dritta għal forma mgħawġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被弯折；被弄成弯曲的形状。

formal.mt: Il-pajp rtaqad taħt il-piż tal-ġebel u kellu jinbidel.
formal.en: The pipe was bent under the weight of the stones and had to be replaced.
formal.zh: 管道被石块的重量压弯，不得不更换。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-ganċ m'għadux dritt? Ben: Rtaqad meta waqgħet il-kaxxa fuqu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the hook no longer straight? Ben: It got bent when the box fell on it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个钩子怎么不直了？本：箱子掉在上面，把它砸弯了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 这个钩子怎么不直了？
messages.en: Why is the hook no longer straight?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.zh: 箱子掉在上面，把它砸弯了。
messages.en: It got bent when the box fell on it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一根受压后变弯的管子，用 rtaqad 标记“已经被弄弯”的结果，帮助区别柔韧性质。

gloss_zh: 被精细修饰；被装饰得华美

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be finished with skill and care or made ornate through decorative detail.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经过细致而有技巧的修饰，或通过添加装饰细节而变得华美。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinħadem b'ħila u b'attenzjoni għad-dettall jew jiġi mżejjen b'dettalji dekorattivi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被巧妙地细修或润饰，使细节更精致。
被加以精美繁复的装饰，变得华丽。

collocations.en: was made ornate with decorative details
collocations.zh: 通过装饰细节被修饰得华美

formal.mt: Il-qafas tal-injam rtaqam b'dettalji dekorattivi qabel ma tqiegħed fis-sala.
formal.en: The wooden frame was made ornate with decorative details before it was placed in the hall.
formal.zh: 木框被加上精美的装饰细节后，才放入大厅。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan il-qafas jidher ħafna isbaħ issa! Pawlu: Iva, rtaqam b'reqqa, speċjalment fil-kantunieri.
colloquial.en: Nina: This frame looks much nicer now! Pawlu: Yes, it was carefully finessed, especially at the corners.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个框现在好看多了！保罗：是啊，经过仔细修饰了，尤其是几个角。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-qafas jidher ħafna isbaħ issa!
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-qafas jidher ħafna isbaħ issa!
messages.zh: 这个框现在好看多了！
messages.en: This frame looks much nicer now!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (工匠)
messages.zh: 是啊，经过仔细修饰了，尤其是几个角。
messages.en: Yes, it was carefully finessed, especially at the corners.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朴素木框经过细修，再添上装饰花纹；用前后对照图记住 rtaqam 的精修与华饰两义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be squeezed or pressed tightly between things or into a confined space.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到挤压，或被挤在物体之间、狭窄空间之中。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħafas bejn affarijiet oħra jew fi spazju dejjaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被挤压；被挤紧。

formal.mt: Waqt it-trasport, il-pakkett rtass bejn żewġ kaxxi tqal u ġarrab ħsara.
formal.en: During transport, the parcel was squeezed between two heavy boxes and sustained damage.
formal.zh: 运输途中，包裹被挤在两个沉重的箱子之间，因而受损。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-pakkett hu mgħaffeġ? | Mark: Rtass bejn il-kaxxi fil-karozza.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the parcel squashed? | Mark: It got squeezed between the boxes in the car.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：包裹怎么压扁了？ | 马克：它在车里被挤在几个箱子之间了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 包裹怎么压扁了？
messages.en: Why is the parcel squashed?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 它在车里被挤在几个箱子之间了。
messages.en: It got squeezed between the boxes in the car.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rtass 配上包裹夹在两个箱子中间的画面，记住重点是承受挤压。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be overcome or defeated, as when an obstacle or difficulty is successfully dealt with.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被克服或战胜，可用于障碍、困难等得到解决的情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi megħlub, bħal ostaklu jew diffikultà li tinstab soluzzjoni għaliha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被克服；被战胜。

formal.mt: L-aħħar ostaklu rtebaħ permezz ta' kooperazzjoni bejn il-membri kollha tat-tim.
formal.en: The final obstacle was overcome through cooperation among all the team members.
formal.zh: 通过全体团队成员的合作，最后一道障碍被克服了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għad hemm xi ostaklu? | Mark: Le, l-aħħar wieħed rtebaħ dalgħodu. Nistgħu nibdew.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are there any obstacles left? | Mark: No, the last one was overcome this morning. We can start.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：还有什么障碍吗？ | 马克：没有，最后一个今天早上已经克服了。我们可以开始了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 还有什么障碍吗？
messages.en: Are there any obstacles left?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, l-aħħar wieħed rtebaħ dalgħodu. Nistgħu nibdew.
messages.mt_standard: Le, l-aħħar wieħed rtebaħ dalgħodu. Nistgħu nibdew.
messages.zh: 没有，最后一个今天早上已经克服了。我们可以开始了。
messages.en: No, the last one was overcome this morning. We can start.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rtebaħ 放进障碍终于被跨过去的场景，记住主语是被克服的困难。

gloss_zh: 被举起；被抬高；被收起；被储存

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be raised or lifted up, or to be put away and kept in storage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被举起或抬到较高处，也可指被收起来或储存。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jittella' 'l fuq, jew jitqiegħed f'post fejn jinżamm jew jinħażen.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被升高；被抬高。
被举起；被提起。
被收好；被放入存放处。
被储存；被存放。

collocations.en: was put away in the cupboard

formal.mt: Il-kontenitur rtefa' mill-art permezz ta' krejn u tqiegħed fuq il-vettura.
formal.en: The container was lifted off the ground by a crane and placed on the vehicle.
formal.zh: 集装箱被起重机从地上吊起，放到了车辆上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-kutri l-oħxon? | Mark: Rtefa' fl-armarju wara x-xitwa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the thick blanket? | Mark: It was put away in the cupboard after winter.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：厚毯子在哪里？ | 马克：冬天过后就收进柜子里了。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.zh: 厚毯子在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the thick blanket?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.zh: 冬天过后就收进柜子里了。
messages.en: It was put away in the cupboard after winter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画记 rtefa'：箱子被吊起，毯子被收好；分别对应抬起与存放。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be thrown away or discarded because something is no longer wanted or needed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因不再需要或不想保留而被扔掉、丢弃。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintrema jew jitwarrab għax ma jkunx għadu mixtieq jew meħtieġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被扔掉。
被丢弃；被弃置。

formal.mt: Il-materjal li ma setax jerġa' jintuża rtema skont il-proċedura stabbilita.
formal.en: The material that could not be reused was discarded according to the established procedure.
formal.zh: 无法再次使用的材料按照既定程序被弃置。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-biljett tiegħi? | Mark: Naħseb li rtema bi żball meta naddafna l-mejda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is my ticket? | Mark: I think it was thrown away by mistake when we cleared the table.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我的票在哪里？ | 马克：我想我们收拾桌子时不小心把它扔了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我的票在哪里？
messages.en: Where is my ticket?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħseb li rtema bi żball meta naddafna l-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Naħseb li rtema bi żball meta naddafna l-mejda.
messages.zh: 我想我们收拾桌子时不小心把它扔了。
messages.en: I think it was thrown away by mistake when we cleared the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象找票时发现票已经进了垃圾桶，用 rtema 记住东西被丢弃的结果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Restraint or control that limits an action, reaction, or impulse.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 限制行为、反应或冲动的克制与约束。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Trażżin jew kontroll li jillimita azzjoni, reazzjoni jew impuls.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 克制；约束；抑制。

formal.mt: Waqt id-dibattitu, il-kelliem wera rtenn u wieġeb għall-kritika b'rispett.
formal.en: During the debate, the speaker showed restraint and responded to criticism respectfully.
formal.zh: 辩论期间，发言者表现出克制，并以尊重的态度回应批评。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif bqajt kalm meta għajjat miegħek? | Mark: Ridt nuri ftit rtenn u ma nkomplix l-argument.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did you stay calm when he shouted at you? | Mark: I wanted to show some restraint and avoid prolonging the argument.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他冲你喊的时候，你怎么还能保持冷静？ | 马克：我想克制一下，别让争吵继续下去。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif bqajt kalm meta għajjat miegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Kif bqajt kalm meta għajjat miegħek?
messages.zh: 他冲你喊的时候，你怎么还能保持冷静？
messages.en: How did you stay calm when he shouted at you?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ridt nuri ftit rtenn u ma nkomplix l-argument.
messages.mt_standard: Ridt nuri ftit rtenn u ma nkomplix l-argument.
messages.zh: 我想克制一下，别让争吵继续下去。
messages.en: I wanted to show some restraint and avoid prolonging the argument.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rtenn 想成心里的刹车：情绪上来时先停一下，帮助记住克制这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To shake, tremble, or quiver with small repeated movements, for example from cold or fear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 出现反复的小幅抖动，例如因寒冷或恐惧而颤抖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitriegħed b'movimenti żgħar u ripetuti, pereżempju minħabba l-bard jew il-biża'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抖动；颤动。
颤抖；发抖。
微微颤动；轻颤。

formal.mt: Wara li ħareġ mill-ilma kiesaħ, it-tifel rtiegħed bil-bard u ngħata kutra.
formal.en: After coming out of the cold water, the boy shivered with cold and was given a blanket.
formal.zh: 男孩从冰冷的水里出来后冻得发抖，有人给了他一条毯子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark talab kutra oħra? | Lara: Rtiegħed bil-bard meta daħal id-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark ask for another blanket? | Lara: He was shivering with cold when he came into the house.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么又要了一条毯子？ | 拉拉：他进屋时冷得直发抖。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.zh: 马克为什么又要了一条毯子？
messages.en: Why did Mark ask for another blanket?

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.zh: 他进屋时冷得直发抖。
messages.en: He was shivering with cold when he came into the house.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象出水后裹着毯子还在打颤，把 rtiegħed 与身体连续小幅抖动联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be propped up or supported; in another sense, to eat or take some food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指被支撑或撑住；另一个义项指进食、吃些东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinżamm wieqaf permezz ta' appoġġ; f'tifsira oħra, jiekol jew jieħu xi ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被撑住；被支撑起来。
吃；进食。

collocations.en: was propped up with a beam

formal.mt: Il-ħajt rtifed b'travu tal-injam sakemm tlestew it-tiswijiet.
formal.en: The wall was propped up with a wooden beam until the repairs were completed.
formal.zh: 这面墙用一根木梁支撑着，直到修缮完成。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark kiel xi ħaġa qabel telaq? | Lara: Iva, rtifed b'biċċa ħobż u ftit ġobon.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Mark eat anything before leaving? | Lara: Yes, he had a piece of bread and some cheese.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克走之前吃东西了吗？ | 拉拉：吃了，他吃了一块面包和一点奶酪。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark kiel xi ħaġa qabel telaq?
messages.mt_standard: Mark kiel xi ħaġa qabel telaq?
messages.zh: 马克走之前吃东西了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark eat anything before leaving?

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, rtifed b'biċċa ħobż u ftit ġobon.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, rtifed b'biċċa ħobż u ftit ġobon.
messages.zh: 吃了，他吃了一块面包和一点奶酪。
messages.en: Yes, he had a piece of bread and some cheese.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 rtifed 做两张情景卡：木梁撑墙、出门前吃面包；分别记牢两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be stepped on or trampled underfoot, often with pressure or damage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被脚踩到或踩踏，常伴随挤压或损坏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jisfa taħt is-saqajn u jingħafas jew issirlu ħsara meta jgħaddu minn fuqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被踩踏；被践踏。

formal.mt: Il-ħaxix qrib id-daħla rtifes mill-viżitaturi li ħarġu mill-mogħdija.
formal.en: The grass near the entrance was trampled by visitors who stepped off the path.
formal.zh: 入口附近的草被走出步道的游客踩踏了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-kappell tiegħi hu mgħaffeġ? | Mark: Waqa' mal-art u rtifes meta għaddew in-nies.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is my hat squashed? | Mark: It fell on the ground and got trampled when people walked past.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我的帽子怎么被压扁了？ | 马克：它掉在地上，人们经过时踩到了它。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我的帽子怎么被压扁了？
messages.en: Why is my hat squashed?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Waqa' mal-art u rtifes meta għaddew in-nies.
messages.mt_standard: Waqa' mal-art u rtifes meta għaddew in-nies.
messages.zh: 它掉在地上，人们经过时踩到了它。
messages.en: It fell on the ground and got trampled when people walked past.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rtifes 配上帽子掉地后被行人踩扁的画面，记住承受踩踏的是主语。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be ridden: to have someone riding on one's back, as a horse does.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被人骑乘，指马等动物背上有人骑着。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu persuna riekba fuqu, bħal żiemel li jkun hemm xi ħadd jirkbu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被骑乘；供人骑在背上。

collocations.en: was ridden for the first time

formal.mt: Skont ir-reġistru, dan iż-żiemel rtikeb għall-ewwel darba taħt is-superviżjoni ta' għalliem.
formal.en: According to the record, this horse was ridden for the first time under an instructor's supervision.
formal.zh: 根据记录，这匹马第一次被骑乘时有教练在场监督。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan iż-żiemel qatt rtikeb? Sara: Iva, rtikeb ilbieraħ, u l-għalliem kien hemm il-ħin kollu.
colloquial.en: Mark: Has this horse ever been ridden? Sara: Yes, it was ridden yesterday, and the instructor was there the whole time.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这匹马以前有人骑过吗？萨拉：有，昨天有人骑过，教练全程都在场。

messages.speaker: Mark (骑术学员)
messages.zh: 这匹马以前有人骑过吗？
messages.en: Has this horse ever been ridden?

messages.speaker: Sara (骑术教练)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, rtikeb ilbieraħ, u l-għalliem kien hemm il-ħin kollu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, rtikeb ilbieraħ, u l-għalliem kien hemm il-ħin kollu.
messages.zh: 有，昨天有人骑过，教练全程都在场。
messages.en: Yes, it was ridden yesterday, and the instructor was there the whole time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把镜头对准马来记：rtikeb 描述的是马“被人骑过”，先确定谁是被骑乘的一方。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A withdrawal or retreat from a position or area, especially by an organized group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从某个阵地或区域撤离、退却的行动，尤其指有组织的群体撤退。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-moviment lura minn pożizzjoni jew żona, speċjalment minn grupp organizzat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 撤离；撤退，指离开原有位置或向后退却。
撤退；退却。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi rtir ordnat tat-truppi miż-żona.
formal.en: The report describes an orderly withdrawal of troops from the area.
formal.zh: 报告描述了部队从该区域有序撤离的过程。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Jekk nibqgħu hawn fil-logħba, nitilfu. Nagħmlu rtir? Pawlu: Iva, immorru lura u niddefendu l-pont.
colloquial.en: Nina: If we stay here in the game, we'll lose. Shall we retreat? Pawlu: Yes, let's move back and defend the bridge.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：游戏里我们要是继续守在这里，就会输。撤退吧？保罗：好，我们退回去守住桥。

messages.speaker: Nina (游戏队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jekk nibqgħu hawn fil-logħba, nitilfu. Nagħmlu rtir?
messages.mt_standard: Jekk nibqgħu hawn fil-logħba, nitilfu. Nagħmlu rtir?
messages.zh: 游戏里我们要是继续守在这里，就会输。撤退吧？
messages.en: If we stay here in the game, we'll lose. Shall we retreat?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (游戏队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, immorru lura u niddefendu l-pont.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, immorru lura u niddefendu l-pont.
messages.zh: 好，我们退回去守住桥。
messages.en: Yes, let's move back and defend the bridge.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象棋盘上的队伍一起向后移动，把 rtir 记成“撤退这个行动”；nagħmlu rtir 可联系“我们撤退”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Shivering: repeated small, involuntary movements of the body, for example when feeling cold.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体不由自主地连续轻微颤动，例如受冷时的发抖或打寒战。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rogħda ripetuta u involontarja tal-ġisem, pereżempju meta persuna tħoss il-bard.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发抖；打寒战，指身体不由自主地颤动。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport isemmi rtiħ qawwi wara li l-persuna qattgħet ħafna ħin fil-bard.
formal.en: The report mentions intense shivering after the person spent a long time in the cold.
formal.zh: 报告提到，此人在寒冷环境中待了很久之后出现了剧烈发抖。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għad għandek ir-rtiħ? Leo: Iva, għadni nħoss il-bard. Tgħaddili l-kutra?
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you still shivering? Leo: Yes, I still feel cold. Could you pass me the blanket?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你还在发抖吗？利奥：是啊，我还是觉得冷。能把毯子递给我吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还在发抖吗？
messages.en: Are you still shivering?

messages.speaker: Leo (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadni nħoss il-bard. Tgħaddili l-kutra?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadni nħoss il-bard. Tgħaddili l-kutra?
messages.zh: 是啊，我还是觉得冷。能把毯子递给我吗？
messages.en: Yes, I still feel cold. Could you pass me the blanket?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象冷风中裹着毯子仍在打哆嗦的人，把 rtiħ 和“发抖这一现象”的名词用法一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To tremble or quiver: to shake with small, involuntary movements.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 颤抖或发颤，指身体或身体某部分不由自主地轻微抖动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitriegħed b'movimenti żgħar u involontarji tal-ġisem jew ta' parti minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 颤抖；发颤；轻微而不由自主地抖动。

formal.mt: Il-karattru rtogħod bil-biża' meta sema' l-ħoss wara l-bieb.
formal.en: The character trembled with fear when he heard the sound behind the door.
formal.zh: 这个人物听见门后的声响时，吓得发抖。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex rtogħod it-tifel? Ben: Sema' ħoss qawwi u beża', imma issa jinsab tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did the boy tremble? Ben: He heard a loud noise and got scared, but he's all right now.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那个男孩刚才为什么发抖？本：他听到一声巨响，吓着了，不过现在已经没事了。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 那个男孩刚才为什么发抖？
messages.en: Why did the boy tremble?

messages.speaker: Ben (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Sema' ħoss qawwi u beża', imma issa jinsab tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Sema' ħoss qawwi u beża', imma issa jinsab tajjeb.
messages.zh: 他听到一声巨响，吓着了，不过现在已经没事了。
messages.en: He heard a loud noise and got scared, but he's all right now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记动作：冷得抖、怕得抖；rtogħod 放进句子时，要找出是谁发生了颤抖。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Rubidium, the chemical element referred to by this name.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 铷，一种化学元素的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem tal-element kimiku magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala rubidium.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 铷，化学元素。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tal-kimika, l-istudenta ddedikat taqsima qasira lir-rubidju.
formal.en: In the chemistry report, the student devoted a short section to rubidium.
formal.zh: 在化学报告中，这名学生用一个简短章节介绍了铷。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Liema element għażilt għall-preżentazzjoni? David: Għażilt ir-rubidju. Se nikteb ismu fuq l-ewwel paġna.
colloquial.en: Emma: Which element did you choose for the presentation? David: I chose rubidium. I'll write its name on the first page.
colloquial.zh: 艾玛：你选了哪种元素做课堂展示？戴维：我选了铷。我会把它的名字写在第一页。

messages.speaker: Emma (同学)
messages.zh: 你选了哪种元素做课堂展示？
messages.en: Which element did you choose for the presentation?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għażilt ir-rubidju. Se nikteb ismu fuq l-ewwel paġna.
messages.mt_standard: Għażilt ir-rubidju. Se nikteb ismu fuq l-ewwel paġna.
messages.zh: 我选了铷。我会把它的名字写在第一页。
messages.en: I chose rubidium. I'll write its name on the first page.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做一张三语元素卡片：正面写 rubidju，背面并排写“铷”和 rubidium，用同一张卡固定对应关系。

gloss_zh: 罗歇礼服（套在唱经袍外的教会礼服）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A rochet: a garment worn over the choir cassock by cardinals, bishops, and certain other church dignitaries.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 罗歇礼服，指枢机、主教及某些其他教会显贵套在唱经袍外穿着的礼服。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ilbies li jintlibes fuq is-suttana tal-kor minn kardinali, isqfijiet u ċerti dinjitarji oħra tal-Knisja.

sense_translations.en_definition: rochet (garment worn over the choir cassock by cardinals, bishops and certain other dignitaries)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 罗歇礼服，由枢机、主教及某些其他教会显贵穿在唱经袍外。

collocations.en: a rochet over the choir cassock
collocations.zh: 套在唱经袍外的罗歇礼服

formal.mt: Fil-pittura, l-isqof jidher liebes rukkett fuq is-suttana tal-kor.
formal.en: In the painting, the bishop is shown wearing a rochet over his choir cassock.
formal.zh: 画中的主教在唱经袍外穿着罗歇礼服。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dak li liebes l-isqof fuq is-suttana? Daniel: Dak rukkett. Hawnhekk jidher ċar fil-pittura.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is the bishop wearing over his cassock? Daniel: That's a rochet. You can see it clearly here in the painting.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：主教套在袍子外面的是什么？丹尼尔：那是罗歇礼服。在这幅画里可以看得很清楚。

messages.speaker: Maja (博物馆访客)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dak li liebes l-isqof fuq is-suttana?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dak li liebes l-isqof fuq is-suttana?
messages.zh: 主教套在袍子外面的是什么？
messages.en: What is the bishop wearing over his cassock?

messages.speaker: Daniel (博物馆导览员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak rukkett. Hawnhekk jidher ċar fil-pittura.
messages.mt_standard: Dak rukkett. Hawnhekk jidher ċar fil-pittura.
messages.zh: 那是罗歇礼服。在这幅画里可以看得很清楚。
messages.en: That's a rochet. You can see it clearly here in the painting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象主教画像中的两层衣服：内层是唱经袍，外层标上 rukkett；用穿着位置帮助记住这种礼服。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Romania, a country in Southeastern Europe.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 罗马尼亚，位于欧洲东南部的国家名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' pajjiż fix-Xlokk tal-Ewropa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 罗马尼亚，欧洲东南部的一个国家。

collocations.zh: 一次前往罗马尼亚的旅行

formal.mt: Ir-Rumanija hija pajjiż fix-Xlokk tal-Ewropa.
formal.en: Romania is a country in Southeastern Europe.
formal.zh: 罗马尼亚是欧洲东南部的一个国家。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn sejjer għall-vaganza? Pawlu: Sejjer ir-Rumanija ma' ħabib.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where are you going on holiday? Pawlu: I'm going to Romania with a friend.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你要去哪里度假？保罗：我要和一个朋友去罗马尼亚。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where are you going on holiday?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我要和一个朋友去罗马尼亚。
messages.en: I'm going to Romania with a friend.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Rumanija 与地图上的罗马尼亚配对记忆，再用 fir-Rumanija 练习表达“在罗马尼亚”。

gloss_zh: 罗马尼亚的；罗马尼亚人（通常指男性）；罗马尼亚语

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of, from, or relating to Romania, its people, or its culture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 罗马尼亚的，指来自罗马尼亚或与该国、其人民或文化有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej mir-Rumanija jew li għandu x'jaqsam ma' dan il-pajjiż, man-nies tiegħu jew mal-kultura tiegħu.

sense_translations.en_definition: Romanian (of, from or relating to Romania)

teaching_sense.en_definition: The purple heron, the bird species with the scientific name Ardea purpurea.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 杏仁甜饮；用于调制饮料的杏仁糖浆。

formal.mt: Waqt ir-riċeviment, il-mistednin ġew offruti tazza ruġġata kiesħa.
formal.en: During the reception, the guests were offered a glass of cold orgeat.
formal.zh: 招待会上，宾客获奉一杯冰凉的杏仁甜饮。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandkom ruġġata kiesħa? Rita: Iva. Trid tazza bis-silġ?
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have cold orgeat? Rita: Yes. Would you like a glass with ice?
colloquial.zh: 马克：你们有冰凉的杏仁甜饮吗？丽塔：有。要来一杯加冰的吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 你们有冰凉的杏仁甜饮吗？
messages.en: Do you have cold orgeat?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.zh: 有。要来一杯加冰的吗？
messages.en: Yes. Would you like a glass with ice?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象点单时桌上出现一杯杏仁甜饮，把 ruġġata 与 tazza“一杯”的搭配一起记，形成完整点单画面。

gloss_zh: 苦杏仁甜饮；亦可泛指杏仁甜饮

teaching_sense.en_definition: Orgeat made specifically from bitter almonds; the expression can also refer more broadly to almond-based orgeat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 特指以苦杏仁制成的杏仁甜饮；这个表达也可广义地指各类杏仁甜饮。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ruġġata magħmula speċifikament mil-lewż morr; l-espressjoni tista' tintuża wkoll b'mod usa' għal kull tip ta' ruġġata magħmula bil-lewż.

sense_translations.en_definition: orgeat made specifically from bitter almonds
sense_translations.zh_definition: 专门以苦杏仁制成的杏仁甜饮。

sense_translations.en_definition: any type of orgeat made of almonds
sense_translations.zh_definition: 任何以杏仁制成的杏仁甜饮，泛指各类杏仁甜饮。

formal.mt: Il-menu jinkludi ruġġata tal-lewż morr fost ix-xorb offrut lill-mistednin.
formal.en: The menu includes bitter-almond orgeat among the drinks offered to guests.
formal.zh: 菜单上供宾客选择的饮品包括苦杏仁甜饮。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Nixtieq tazza ruġġata tal-lewż morr, jekk jogħġbok. Toni: Żgur. Tridha bis-silġ?
colloquial.en: Anna: I'd like a glass of bitter-almond orgeat, please. Toni: Certainly. Would you like it with ice?
colloquial.zh: 安娜：请给我一杯苦杏仁甜饮。托尼：好的。要加冰吗？

messages.speaker: Anna (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Nixtieq tazza ruġġata tal-lewż morr, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Nixtieq tazza ruġġata tal-lewż morr, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 请给我一杯苦杏仁甜饮。
messages.en: I'd like a glass of bitter-almond orgeat, please.

messages.speaker: Toni (店员)
messages.zh: 好的。要加冰吗？
messages.en: Certainly. Would you like it with ice?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把短语分成“杏仁甜饮”和“苦杏仁”两块来记；同时做两张义项卡，分别标明特指苦杏仁与泛指杏仁饮品。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To rise up against authority or those in control.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 起来反抗权威或掌权者，发动反叛或起义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qam kontra l-awtorità jew kontra dawk li kellhom il-poter.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反叛；起来反抗当权者；起义。

formal.mt: Skont ir-rakkont, il-poplu rvella kontra l-ħakkiem wara snin ta' inġustizzja.
formal.en: According to the account, the people revolted against the ruler after years of injustice.
formal.zh: 据这段记述，人民在遭受多年不公之后起来反抗统治者。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex rvella l-poplu f'din l-istorja? Pawlu: Għax il-ħakkiem ma kienx jisma' l-ilmenti tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did the people revolt in this story? Pawlu: Because the ruler would not listen to their complaints.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个故事里的人民为什么起义？保罗：因为统治者不肯听取他们的诉求。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 这个故事里的人民为什么起义？
messages.en: Why did the people revolt in this story?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-ħakkiem ma kienx jisma' l-ilmenti tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-ħakkiem ma kienx jisma' l-ilmenti tiegħu.
messages.zh: 因为统治者不肯听取他们的诉求。
messages.en: Because the ruler would not listen to their complaints.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象故事里人民站起来反抗统治者，把这个动作和 il-poplu rvella 整句绑定，记住它表达“发动反叛”的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Rebellion against authority, or a state of conflict and strife.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 反抗权威的叛乱，或冲突、纷争的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rewwixta kontra l-awtorità, jew stat ta' ġlied u kunflitt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 叛乱；纷争；冲突。

formal.mt: Ir-rumanz jiddeskrivi żmien ta' rvellatura u l-isforzi tan-nies biex jerġgħu jsibu l-paċi.
formal.en: The novel describes a period of strife and people's efforts to find peace again.
formal.zh: 这部小说描写了一段纷争时期，以及人们为重新获得和平所作的努力。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dwar xiex inhu dan il-kapitlu? Mark: Dwar ir-rvellatura fir-raħal u kif fl-aħħar reġgħet ġiet il-paċi.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is this chapter about? Mark: About the strife in the village and how peace finally returned.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这一章讲什么？马克：讲村里的纷争，以及和平最终如何恢复。

messages.speaker: Sara (读书伙伴)
messages.zh: 这一章讲什么？
messages.en: What is this chapter about?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar ir-rvellatura fir-raħal u kif fl-aħħar reġgħet ġiet il-paċi.
messages.mt_standard: Dwar ir-rvellatura fir-raħal u kif fl-aħħar reġgħet ġiet il-paċi.
messages.zh: 讲村里的纷争，以及和平最终如何恢复。
messages.en: About the strife in the village and how peace finally returned.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rvellatura 想成故事章节的标题“叛乱与纷争”，再配上“纷争时期”这个短语，提醒自己它是命名事件或状态的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Making a lot of noise.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出很多声音的；吵闹或喧闹的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħmel ħafna storbju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吵闹的；喧闹的；发出很多噪声的。

formal.mt: Grupp rvelluż fil-kuritur fixkel il-lezzjoni.
formal.en: A noisy group in the corridor disrupted the lesson.
formal.zh: 走廊里一群吵闹的人干扰了课堂。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex mort tistudja fil-kamra l-oħra? Lara: Għax dak il-grupp hu rvelluż wisq u ma nistax nikkonċentra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you go to study in the other room? Lara: Because that group is too noisy and I can't concentrate.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么去另一个房间学习了？拉拉：因为那群人太吵，我没法集中注意力。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你为什么去另一个房间学习了？
messages.en: Why did you go to study in the other room?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dak il-grupp hu rvelluż wisq u ma nistax nikkonċentra.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dak il-grupp hu rvelluż wisq u ma nistax nikkonċentra.
messages.zh: 因为那群人太吵，我没法集中注意力。
messages.en: Because that group is too noisy and I can't concentrate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一群人大声说话，让你读不下书，再给这群人贴上 grupp rvelluż 的标签，用声音场景记住“吵闹的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of removing an excess amount or unnecessary material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 去掉过量或多余部分的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tneħħija ta' dak li jkun żejjed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 去除多余部分；除去过量之物的过程。

formal.mt: Ir-rxiq tal-materjal żejjed għandu jsir bir-reqqa biex il-biċċa ma ssirilhiex ħsara.
formal.en: Excess material should be removed carefully to avoid damaging the piece.
formal.zh: 去除多余材料时应当仔细，以免损坏工件。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'baqa' x'nagħmlu fuq din il-biċċa? Pawlu: Ir-rxiq tal-materjal żejjed. Wara nkunu lesti.
colloquial.en: Mark: What do we still need to do to this piece? Pawlu: Remove the excess material. Then we'll be finished.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这件东西还剩什么要做？保罗：去掉多余的材料。之后就完成了。

messages.speaker: Mark (学徒)
messages.zh: 这件东西还剩什么要做？
messages.en: What do we still need to do to this piece?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-rxiq tal-materjal żejjed. Wara nkunu lesti.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-rxiq tal-materjal żejjed. Wara nkunu lesti.
messages.zh: 去掉多余的材料。之后就完成了。
messages.en: Remove the excess material. Then we'll be finished.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象制作一件东西时，把超出需要的部分一点点去掉；将整个“除去多余”的过程标为 rxiq，记住它是过程名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To come back to life after death, or to bring someone back to life.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指死后重新活过来，也可指使死者复活或使人恢复生命。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reġa' ħa l-ħajja wara l-mewt, jew ta l-ħajja mill-ġdid lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.en_definition: to rise from the dead, to be resurrected, resuscitated
sense_translations.zh_definition: 从死亡状态中复活；被救活或恢复生命。

sense_translations.en_definition: to raise from the dead, to resurrect, resuscitate
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使死者复活；使人恢复生命或将人救活。

collocations.en: brought the dead person back to life

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-profeta rxoxta lit-tifel, u l-familja tiegħu mtliet bil-ferħ.
formal.en: In the story, the prophet brought the boy back to life, and his family was filled with joy.
formal.zh: 在故事中，先知使男孩复活，他的家人充满了喜悦。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara fl-aħħar tal-istorja? Mark: Ir-raġel rxoxta, u reġa' lura għand il-familja tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened at the end of the story? Mark: The man came back to life and returned to his family.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：故事最后发生了什么？马克：那个男人复活了，回到了家人身边。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 故事最后发生了什么？
messages.en: What happened at the end of the story?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-raġel rxoxta, u reġa' lura għand il-familja tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-raġel rxoxta, u reġa' lura għand il-familja tiegħu.
messages.zh: 那个男人复活了，回到了家人身边。
messages.en: The man came back to life and returned to his family.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象故事中的人物重新睁眼：人物自己活过来是“复活”，有人让他活过来则是“使复活”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of coming or going back to a place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 回到某处的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jerġa' jiġi jew imur lura lejn post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 返回；回到原处或某个地方的行为。

formal.mt: Ir-rġugħ tal-grupp lejn il-lukanda huwa ppjanat għas-sitta ta' filgħaxija.
formal.en: The group's return to the hotel is planned for six in the evening.
formal.zh: 团队计划于傍晚六点返回酒店。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta hu r-rġugħ tagħkom mill-vjaġġ? Pawlu: Għada filgħaxija. Naslu d-dar għall-ħabta tat-tmienja.
colloquial.en: Maja: When are you coming back from the trip? Pawlu: Tomorrow evening. We'll get home around eight.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你们什么时候旅行回来？保罗：明天晚上，大约八点到家。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们什么时候旅行回来？
messages.en: When are you coming back from the trip?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (旅行中的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għada filgħaxija. Naslu d-dar għall-ħabta tat-tmienja.
messages.mt_standard: Għada filgħaxija. Naslu d-dar għall-ħabta tat-tmienja.
messages.zh: 明天晚上，大约八点到家。
messages.en: Tomorrow evening. We'll get home around eight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象旅行路线最后一段箭头指回家门，把“回来的过程”作为整体画面记住，提醒自己这是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being manly, understood as having characteristics associated with men.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 男子气概；表现出被视为男性特征的气质或品质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' min juri karatteristiċi meqjusa bħala tipiċi tal-irġiel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 男子气概；被视为男性特有的气质或品质。

formal.mt: L-awtur jeżamina kif il-personaġġi jifhmu r-rġulija u kif dan jinfluwenza l-imġiba tagħhom.
formal.en: The author examines how the characters understand manliness and how this influences their behaviour.
formal.zh: 作者探讨人物如何理解男子气概，以及这种理解如何影响他们的行为。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għalik, x'inhi r-rġulija? Pawlu: Għalija, tfisser ukoll li tkun kapaċi tammetti żball.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does manliness mean to you? Pawlu: To me, it also means being able to admit a mistake.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：对你来说，男子气概是什么？保罗：对我来说，它也意味着能够承认错误。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 对你来说，男子气概是什么？
messages.en: What does manliness mean to you?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għalija, tfisser ukoll li tkun kapaċi tammetti żball.
messages.mt_standard: Għalija, tfisser ukoll li tkun kapaċi tammetti żball.
messages.zh: 对我来说，它也意味着能够承认错误。
messages.en: To me, it also means being able to admit a mistake.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“什么是男子气概”的讨论中记忆；它指一种气质或品质，不是某个男性本人。

gloss_zh: 大理石般的；有大理石纹理的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Resembling marble in appearance, especially in its colour or veined pattern.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容外观像大理石，尤其指颜色或纹理具有大理石的效果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jixbah l-irħam fid-dehra, speċjalment fil-kulur jew fid-disinn tal-vini.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大理石般的；呈大理石纹理的。

formal.mt: Il-perit għażel materjal b'effett rħami għas-sala tad-dħul.
formal.en: The architect chose a material with a marble-like effect for the entrance hall.
formal.zh: 建筑师为门厅选用了具有仿大理石效果的材料。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-mejda għandu wiċċ rħami? Mark: Iva, imma l-materjal mhuwiex irħam veru.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this table have a marbled surface? Mark: Yes, but the material isn't real marble.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这张桌子的表面有大理石纹理吗？马克：有，不过材料不是真正的大理石。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这张桌子的表面有大理石纹理吗？
messages.en: Does this table have a marbled surface?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma l-materjal mhuwiex irħam veru.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma l-materjal mhuwiex irħam veru.
messages.zh: 有，不过材料不是真正的大理石。
messages.en: Yes, but the material isn't real marble.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rħami 和桌面的灰白纹路一起记：它描述大理石般的外观，不一定表示材料就是真大理石。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Control over one's feelings, impulses, or actions, especially when choosing to act with restraint.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对自己的情绪、冲动或行为的控制，尤其指遇事能够克制。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħila li wieħed jikkontrolla l-emozzjonijiet u l-imġiba tiegħu u ma jaġixxix bl-għaġla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自制力；控制自身情绪、冲动和行为的能力。
克制；有意识地抑制冲动或避免过度反应。

formal.mt: Matul id-diskussjoni, ir-rappreżentant wera rżien u wieġeb għall-kritika bil-kalma.
formal.en: During the discussion, the representative showed self-control and responded calmly to criticism.
formal.zh: 讨论期间，代表表现出自制力，平静地回应了批评。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ma rrabjajtx meta qal hekk? Pawlu: Irrabjajt, imma wrejt rżien u ma għajjatx.
colloquial.en: Sara: Didn't you get angry when he said that? Pawlu: I did, but I showed self-control and didn't shout.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：他说那话时，你没有生气吗？保罗：生气了，但我克制住了，没有大喊。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他说那话时，你没有生气吗？
messages.en: Didn't you get angry when he said that?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Irrabjajt, imma wrejt rżien u ma għajjatx.
messages.mt_standard: Irrabjajt, imma wrejt rżien u ma għajjatx.
messages.zh: 生气了，但我克制住了，没有大喊。
messages.en: I did, but I showed self-control and didn't shout.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上“生气时先停三秒”的画面，记住它表示管住情绪和冲动的自制与克制。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The experience of becoming chilled or freezing from exposure to cold.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体因寒冷而受凉、挨冻或冻得厉害的状态或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qagħda ta' min jiksaħ jew ibati minn kesħa qawwija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受冷；身体逐渐变冷或感到寒冷。
挨冻；冻得厉害或冻僵的状态。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi r-rżiħ li batew il-mixiema waqt il-lejl kiesaħ.
formal.en: The report describes the chilling that the walkers suffered during the cold night.
formal.zh: 报告描述了步行者在寒夜中挨冻的情况。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ħadt kutra miegħek? Toni: Biex nevitaw ir-rżiħ wara l-għawm.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you bring a blanket? Toni: So we can avoid getting chilled after swimming.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么带了条毯子？托尼：这样我们游泳后就能避免受冷。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么带了条毯子？
messages.en: Why did you bring a blanket?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 这样我们游泳后就能避免受冷。
messages.en: So we can avoid getting chilled after swimming.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象游泳上岸后抱着双臂发抖，把这个名词与“身体受冷、一直挨冻”的感觉连起来记。

gloss_zh: 猛撞；砰地关上；用力敲击

teaching_sense.en_definition: To strike something forcefully or shut it with a loud bang.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用力撞击或敲击某物，或将门等物猛地关上，发出砰的一声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Laqat xi ħaġa bil-qawwa, jew għalaqha b'daqqa li tagħmel ħoss qawwi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 猛撞；用力敲击；使某物砰地作响。

collocations.en: banged his hand on the table

formal.mt: Ix-xhud qal li r-raġel sabat il-bieb qabel telaq mill-kamra.
formal.en: The witness said that the man slammed the door before leaving the room.
formal.zh: 证人说，那个男人离开房间前猛地关上了门。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'kien dak il-ħoss? Mark: Ħija sabat il-bieb għax kien irrabjat.
colloquial.en: Maja: What was that noise? Mark: My brother slammed the door because he was angry.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：刚才是什么声音？马克：我哥哥生气了，猛地关上了门。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 刚才是什么声音？
messages.en: What was that noise?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija sabat il-bieb għax kien irrabjat.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija sabat il-bieb għax kien irrabjat.
messages.zh: 我哥哥生气了，猛地关上了门。
messages.en: My brother slammed the door because he was angry.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住关门时“砰”的一下：这个动词突出用力撞击以及随之发出的响声。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An intestinal illness known as dysentery.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 痢疾，一种肠道疾病的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marda tal-imsaren magħrufa wkoll bħala diżenterija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 痢疾；一种肠道疾病。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport mediku jsemmi każ ta' sabb u jiddeskrivi l-kundizzjoni tal-pazjent.
formal.en: The medical report mentions a case of dysentery and describes the patient's condition.
formal.zh: 医疗报告提到一例痢疾，并描述了患者的状况。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Xi tfisser il-kelma sabb f'dan it-test? David: Tfisser diżenterija, marda tal-imsaren.
colloquial.en: Anna: What does the word sabb mean in this text? David: It means dysentery, an intestinal illness.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这篇文章里的 sabb 是什么意思？戴维：意思是痢疾，一种肠道疾病。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser il-kelma sabb f'dan it-test?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser il-kelma sabb f'dan it-test?
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的 sabb 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word sabb mean in this text?

messages.speaker: David (老师)
messages.zh: 意思是痢疾，一种肠道疾病。
messages.en: It means dysentery, an intestinal illness.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sabb 写在“疾病名称”词卡上，背面写“痢疾”，再用“一例痢疾”的搭配巩固记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A plant referred to as aloe or cactus, depending on the sense intended.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种植物名称；依具体词义可指芦荟，也可指仙人掌。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta msejħa aloe jew kaktus, skont is-sens tal-kelma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 芦荟；芦荟类植物。
仙人掌；仙人掌类植物。

collocations.en: an aloe or cactus in a pot
to plant an aloe or cactus

formal.mt: Il-ġardinar ħawwel sabbara f'borma kbira u poġġieha ħdejn it-tieqa.
formal.en: The gardener planted an aloe in a large pot and placed it near the window.
formal.zh: 园丁把一株芦荟种在大花盆里，并将它放在窗边。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Din is-sabbara hija aloe? Ġużepp: Iva, xtrajtha lbieraħ biex inpoġġiha fil-ġnien.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this plant an aloe? Ġużepp: Yes, I bought it yesterday to put in the garden.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这株 sabbara 是芦荟吗？朱塞佩：是的，我昨天买的，准备放在花园里。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这株 sabbara 是芦荟吗？
messages.en: Is this plant an aloe?

messages.speaker: Ġużepp (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, xtrajtha lbieraħ biex inpoġġiha fil-ġnien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, xtrajtha lbieraħ biex inpoġġiha fil-ġnien.
messages.zh: 是的，我昨天买的，准备放在花园里。
messages.en: Yes, I bought it yesterday to put in the garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 sabbara 配两张独立图片：一张芦荟，一张仙人掌；读句子时根据语境选对应的植物义。

gloss_zh: 有安慰作用的；令人宽慰的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Providing comfort or consolation to someone who is upset or distressed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够安慰难过或苦恼的人，使其感到宽慰的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħti faraġ lil min ikun imnikket jew imħasseb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有安慰作用的；能使人感到宽慰的。

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tagħha, l-għalliema kitbet kliem sabbari lill-istudent li kien għaddej minn żmien diffiċli.
formal.en: In her letter, the teacher wrote consoling words to the student who was going through a difficult time.
formal.zh: 老师在信中写下安慰的话语，送给正在经历困难时期的学生。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Kif ħassejtek wara li qrajt il-messaġġ? Marija: Aħjar. Kien messaġġ sabbari u tani ħafna faraġ.
colloquial.en: Elena: How did you feel after reading the message? Marija: Better. It was a comforting message and gave me a lot of consolation.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：读完那条信息后，你感觉怎么样？玛丽亚：好些了。那条信息很暖心，给了我很多安慰。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif ħassejtek wara li qrajt il-messaġġ?
messages.mt_standard: Kif ħassejtek wara li qrajt il-messaġġ?
messages.zh: 读完那条信息后，你感觉怎么样？
messages.en: How did you feel after reading the message?

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar. Kien messaġġ sabbari u tani ħafna faraġ.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar. Kien messaġġ sabbari u tani ħafna faraġ.
messages.zh: 好些了。那条信息很暖心，给了我很多安慰。
messages.en: Better. It was a comforting message and gave me a lot of consolation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象难过时收到朋友的一条暖心信息，用“读完心里舒服一点”的效果记住这个形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to bang things or slam doors and other objects.
