teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人有用力撞击物品或猛摔门等习惯或倾向的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jsabbat l-affarijiet jew jagħlaq il-bibien bil-qawwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于猛撞物品或砰地摔门的；动作常带有猛烈撞击的。

collocations.en: a man inclined to bang or slam things
collocations.zh: 一个爱猛撞物品或摔门的男人

collocations.en: a disposition inclined to banging or slamming things
collocations.zh: 动辄猛撞物品或摔门的性情

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-karattru sabbati tar-raġel jidher fil-mod kif jagħlaq il-bibien bil-qawwa.
formal.en: In the novel, the man's tendency to slam things is shown in the way he closes doors forcefully.
formal.zh: 小说通过那个男人用力关门的方式，表现出他动辄摔门撞物的性情。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex dejjem jagħlaq il-bieb b'dak il-ħoss? Karl: Hu sabbati; anki l-kxaxen jagħlaqhom bil-qawwa.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why does he always close the door with that noise? Karl: He tends to slam things; he even shuts drawers forcefully.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：他为什么每次关门都那么响？卡尔：他就爱摔摔打打，连抽屉都用力关。

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dejjem jagħlaq il-bieb b'dak il-ħoss?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dejjem jagħlaq il-bieb b'dak il-ħoss?
messages.zh: 他为什么每次关门都那么响？
messages.en: Why does he always close the door with that noise?

messages.speaker: Karl (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu sabbati; anki l-kxaxen jagħlaqhom bil-qawwa.
messages.mt_standard: Hu sabbati; anki l-kxaxen jagħlaqhom bil-qawwa.
messages.zh: 他就爱摔摔打打，连抽屉都用力关。
messages.en: He tends to slam things; he even shuts drawers forcefully.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个关门、关抽屉总是砰砰响的人：这个形容词描述反复出现的摔撞倾向。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A children's game in which a marble is thrown against a wall so that it rebounds as close as possible to another marble placed at a fixed spot.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种儿童弹珠游戏：把弹珠掷向墙壁，让它反弹后尽可能靠近放在固定位置的另一颗弹珠。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Logħba tat-tfal li fiha tintrema boċċa żgħira tal-ħġieġ ma' ħajt biex terġa' lura kemm jista' jkun qrib boċċa oħra mqiegħda f'post fiss.

sense_translations.en_definition: children's game so called because it consists in flinging a marble at a wall from which it rebounds as close as possible to another marble at a fixed place
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种儿童游戏：将弹珠掷向墙壁，使其反弹后尽可能靠近放在固定位置的另一颗弹珠。

collocations.zh: 一局撞墙反弹弹珠游戏

formal.mt: Fis-sabbita, it-tfal jitfgħu boċċa żgħira tal-ħġieġ ma' ħajt biex wara terġa' lura qrib boċċa oħra mqiegħda f'post fiss.
formal.en: In sabbita, children throw a small glass marble against a wall so that it rebounds close to another marble placed at a fixed spot.
formal.zh: 在这种撞墙反弹弹珠游戏中，孩子们把小玻璃弹珠掷向墙壁，使它反弹后靠近放在固定位置的另一颗弹珠。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid nilagħbu s-sabbita? Mark: Iva! Poġġi boċċa hemm, u jien nitfa' l-oħra mal-ħajt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we play sabbita? Mark: Yes! Put a marble there, and I'll throw the other one against the wall.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们玩撞墙反弹弹珠游戏好吗？马克：好！你把一颗弹珠放在那里，我把另一颗掷向墙壁。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们玩撞墙反弹弹珠游戏好吗？
messages.en: Shall we play sabbita?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! Poġġi boċċa hemm, u jien nitfa' l-oħra mal-ħajt.
messages.mt_standard: Iva! Poġġi boċċa hemm, u jien nitfa' l-oħra mal-ħajt.
messages.zh: 好！你把一颗弹珠放在那里，我把另一颗掷向墙壁。
messages.en: Yes! Put a marble there, and I'll throw the other one against the wall.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“弹珠撞墙再靠近另一颗”的画面，把 sabbita 与整套游戏动作一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A boy or male child.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 男孩，指男性儿童。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tifel; wild ta' sess maskili.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 男孩；男童。

formal.mt: Fl-istampa jidher sabi żgħir bilqiegħda ħdejn ommu.
formal.en: The picture shows a little boy sitting beside his mother.
formal.zh: 画面中有一个小男孩坐在母亲身旁。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak is-sabi ħdejn il-bieb? Mark: Dak ħija ż-żgħir. Qed jistennieni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that boy by the door? Mark: That's my little brother. He's waiting for me.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：门边那个男孩是谁？马克：那是我弟弟。他在等我。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak is-sabi ħdejn il-bieb?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak is-sabi ħdejn il-bieb?
messages.zh: 门边那个男孩是谁？
messages.en: Who is that boy by the door?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 那是我弟弟。他在等我。
messages.en: That's my little brother. He's waiting for me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象门边等哥哥的小男孩，用 sabi żgħir 这个短语把词义与人物画面绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Patience when waiting or facing difficulty; also acceptance of an unpleasant situation that one feels unable to change.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 等待或面对困难时的耐心；也指认为处境无法改变而接受现实的顺受心态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħila li tistenna jew tgħaddi minn diffikultà bil-kalma; ukoll l-aċċettazzjoni ta' sitwazzjoni spjaċevoli li tħoss li ma tistax tbiddel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 耐心；等待或面对困难时保持平静的能力。
顺受；无奈地接受自己认为无法改变的处境。

collocations.en: accept difficulties with patience or resignation
collocations.zh: 以忍耐或顺受的态度面对困难

formal.mt: Il-kura ta' persuna marida teħtieġ ħafna sabra u attenzjoni.
formal.en: Caring for a sick person requires a great deal of patience and attention.
formal.zh: 照顾病人需要很大的耐心和细心。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadna rridu nistennew ħafna? Mark: Ftit sabra! Wasalna kważi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do we still have to wait a long time? Mark: A little patience! We're nearly there.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们还得等很久吗？马克：耐心一点！快轮到我们了。

messages.speaker: Maja (排队的朋友)
messages.zh: 我们还得等很久吗？
messages.en: Do we still have to wait a long time?

messages.speaker: Mark (排队的朋友)
messages.zh: 耐心一点！快轮到我们了。
messages.en: A little patience! We're nearly there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“排队时耐心等待”和“无奈时接受现实”两幅画面，分别记住 sabra 的两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An exclamation expressing irritation or annoyance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示恼怒、不耐烦的感叹词，可依语境译为“哎呀！”或“真烦！”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma ta' esklamazzjoni li tesprimi dwejjaq jew irritazzjoni.

sense_translations.en_definition: an interjection used to express irritation
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于表达恼怒或不耐烦的感叹词。

collocations.en: Oh, bother, here we go again!
Oh, bother, what a lot of noise!

formal.mt: Fid-djalogu, il-karattru jgħid: 'Sabreċ! Il-bieb reġa' weħel.'
formal.en: In the dialogue, the character says: 'Oh, bother! The door is stuck again.'
formal.zh: 在对话中，人物说道：“真烦！门又卡住了。”

colloquial.mt: Maja: Sabreċ! Erġajt tlift iċ-ċwievet. Mark: Ħares fil-but tal-ġakketta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Oh, bother! I've lost my keys again. Mark: Look in your jacket pocket.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：真烦！我又找不到钥匙了。马克：看看你夹克的口袋。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 真烦！我又找不到钥匙了。
messages.en: Oh, bother! I've lost my keys again.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 看看你夹克的口袋。
messages.en: Look in your jacket pocket.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象钥匙又找不到时脱口而出的“真烦！”，用这股恼怒语气记住 sabreċ。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to wait or face difficulties calmly without becoming easily annoyed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有耐心的；能够平静等待或面对困难，不容易烦躁的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jaf jistenna jew jgħaddi minn diffikultà bil-kalma mingħajr ma jitlef sabru malajr.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有耐心的；能忍耐的。

formal.mt: L-għalliem huwa sabri u jispjega l-istess punt diversi drabi meta jkun hemm bżonn.
formal.en: The teacher is patient and explains the same point several times when necessary.
formal.zh: 这位老师很有耐心，必要时会把同一个要点解释好几遍。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark, kun sabri miegħi; għadni qed nitgħallem. Mark: Tinkwetax, għandna l-ħin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Mark, be patient with me; I'm still learning. Mark: Don't worry, we have time.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克，对我耐心一点，我还在学。马克：别担心，我们有时间。

messages.speaker: Maja (学习中的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark, kun sabri miegħi; għadni qed nitgħallem.
messages.mt_standard: Mark, kun sabri miegħi; għadni qed nitgħallem.
messages.zh: 马克，对我耐心一点，我还在学。
messages.en: Mark, be patient with me; I'm still learning.

messages.speaker: Mark (帮助学习的朋友)
messages.zh: 别担心，我们有时间。
messages.en: Don't worry, we have time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sabri 放进 kun sabri“耐心一点”中记忆，想象老师平静地再讲一遍。

teaching_sense.en_definition: During the same period, or while another event or activity is taking place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与此同时；在另一件事发生或进行的这段时间里。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fl-istess ħin jew waqt li tkun qed isseħħ xi ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与此同时；在此期间。

formal.mt: It-tim qed jiġbor id-data; sadattant, ir-riċerkaturi qed iħejju r-rapport.
formal.en: The team is collecting the data; meanwhile, the researchers are preparing the report.
formal.zh: 团队正在收集数据；与此同时，研究人员正在准备报告。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Jien se nsajjar l-għaġin. Mark: Tajjeb, sadattant nipprepara l-mejda.
colloquial.en: Maja: I'm going to cook the pasta. Mark: All right, meanwhile I'll set the table.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我来煮意大利面。马克：好，趁这会儿我来摆餐桌。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 我来煮意大利面。
messages.en: I'm going to cook the pasta.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 好，趁这会儿我来摆餐桌。
messages.en: All right, meanwhile I'll set the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中并排播放“一个人煮面、另一个人摆桌”两个画面，用 sadattant 连接同时进行的事情。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An object fitted into an opening to close it and prevent something from passing through.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 塞入开口以将其封住、防止物质通过的塞子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett li jiddaħħal f'fetħa biex jagħlaqha u ma jħallix xi ħaġa tgħaddi minnha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 塞子；用于封住开口的物件。

formal.mt: Wara li timla l-flixkun, daħħal is-saddied sew biex il-likwidu ma joħroġx.
formal.en: After filling the bottle, insert the stopper firmly so that the liquid does not leak out.
formal.zh: 装满瓶子后，把塞子塞紧，以免液体漏出。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu s-saddied tal-flixkun? Mark: Ħdejn it-tazza. Agħlaq il-flixkun sew.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the bottle stopper? Mark: Next to the glass. Close the bottle tightly.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：瓶塞在哪里？马克：在玻璃杯旁边。把瓶子塞紧。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 瓶塞在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the bottle stopper?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 在玻璃杯旁边。把瓶子塞紧。
messages.en: Next to the glass. Close the bottle tightly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把瓶口塞紧后水不再漏出，将 saddied 与“封住开口的塞子”这一用途绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A stopper, especially one used to close a cask; also a wedge inserted into a gap to hold something in place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 塞子，尤指封住大桶开口的桶塞；也指塞入缝隙以固定物体的楔子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett li jagħlaq fetħa, speċjalment ta' bettija; ukoll biċċa li tiddaħħal fi spazju dejjaq biex iżżomm xi ħaġa f'postha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 塞子，尤指封住大桶开口的桶塞。
楔子；塞入缝隙以固定或卡住物体的楔形物件。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem daħħal is-saddieda fil-fetħa tal-bettija biex ma jnixxix il-likwidu.
formal.en: The worker inserted the stopper into the opening of the cask to prevent the liquid from leaking.
formal.zh: 工人把桶塞塞入大桶的开口，以防液体渗漏。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-bieb jibqa' jingħalaq bir-riħ. Mark: Poġġi saddieda taħtu biex iżżommu miftuħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: The wind keeps blowing the door shut. Mark: Put a wedge under it to keep it open.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：风总是把门吹关。马克：在门下面塞个楔子，让门保持开着。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 风总是把门吹关。
messages.en: The wind keeps blowing the door shut.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Poġġi saddieda taħtu biex iżżommu miftuħ.
messages.mt_standard: Poġġi saddieda taħtu biex iżżommu miftuħ.
messages.zh: 在门下面塞个楔子，让门保持开着。
messages.en: Put a wedge under it to keep it open.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 saddieda 配两张学习图卡：一张是堵住桶口的桶塞，一张是卡在门下的楔子，分别记牢两个义项。

gloss_zh: 造成阻塞的；妨碍通行的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing a blockage that prevents passage or flow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使通道堵塞，妨碍物体通过或液体流动的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li joħloq ostaklu u ma jħallix xi ħaġa tgħaddi jew tnixxi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 造成阻碍或堵塞的。

collocations.en: an object that causes an obstruction

formal.mt: Il-materjal saddiedi għandu jitneħħa mill-pajp biex l-ilma jkun jista' jgħaddi.
formal.en: The material causing the blockage must be removed from the pipe so that water can flow through.
formal.zh: 必须清除管道内造成堵塞的材料，让水能够流通。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex l-ilma mhux għaddej? Lara: Hemm materjal saddiedi fil-pajp. Irridu nneħħuh.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why isn't the water flowing? Lara: There's material blocking the pipe. We need to remove it.
colloquial.zh: 马克：水怎么不流了？拉拉：管道里有造成堵塞的东西。我们得把它清掉。

messages.speaker: Mark (住户)
messages.zh: 水怎么不流了？
messages.en: Why isn't the water flowing?

messages.speaker: Lara (维修人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm materjal saddiedi fil-pajp. Irridu nneħħuh.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm materjal saddiedi fil-pajp. Irridu nneħħuh.
messages.zh: 管道里有造成堵塞的东西。我们得把它清掉。
messages.en: There's material blocking the pipe. We need to remove it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 saddiedi 放进水管堵塞的画面：它描述的是“造成堵塞的”东西，记住它是形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small spot or speck of rust on a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面上出现的一小点铁锈或小锈斑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tikka żgħira ta' sadid fuq wiċċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一小点铁锈；一处小锈斑。

collocations.en: a speck of rust on the metal
to remove a speck of rust

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni nstabet sadida żgħira fuq il-wiċċ tal-metall.
formal.en: During the inspection, a small speck of rust was found on the metal surface.
formal.zh: 检查时，在金属表面发现了一小点铁锈。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhi dik it-tikka fuq iċ-ċavetta? Pawlu: Dik sadida. Nipprova nneħħiha.
colloquial.en: Nina: What's that spot on the key? Pawlu: That's a speck of rust. I'll try to remove it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：钥匙上的那个小点是什么？保罗：那是一小点铁锈。我试着把它清掉。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 钥匙上的那个小点是什么？
messages.en: What's that spot on the key?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 那是一小点铁锈。我试着把它清掉。
messages.en: That's a speck of rust. I'll try to remove it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象钥匙上只有针尖大小的一点锈，把 sadida 与“一个小锈点”的画面一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Morally upright and virtuous in character and conduct.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 品格正直、行为符合道德并具有德行的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu karattru tajjeb u jaġixxi b'mod ġust u virtuż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 正直的；秉持正义和道德原则的。
有德行的；品德高尚的。

formal.mt: Ir-rakkont jippreżenta bniedem sadiq li jiddefendi lill-persuni dgħajfa u jaġixxi b'ġustizzja.
formal.en: The narrative presents a righteous person who defends vulnerable people and acts justly.
formal.zh: 这篇叙事描写了一位保护弱者、秉公行事的正直之人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tafdah daqshekk? David: Għax hu bniedem sadiq u dejjem jgħid il-verità.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you trust him so much? David: Because he's an upright person and always tells the truth.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么这么信任他？戴维：因为他为人正直，总是说实话。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么这么信任他？
messages.en: Why do you trust him so much?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu bniedem sadiq u dejjem jgħid il-verità.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu bniedem sadiq u dejjem jgħid il-verità.
messages.zh: 因为他为人正直，总是说实话。
messages.en: Because he's an upright person and always tells the truth.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 sadiq 配上“说真话、做公正事”的人物画像，同时记住“正直”和“有德行”两个侧重点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To end up or be left in a particular state or condition, often an unfavorable one.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 最终处于或被留在某种状态，常指落入不利的处境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jispiċċa jew jitħalla f'ċertu stat jew kundizzjoni, ħafna drabi mhux mixtieqa.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be left in a state
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被留在某种状态；最终处于某种境地。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be reduced to some condition
sense_translations.zh_definition: 沦落到某种境况；落得某种下场。

formal.mt: Wara l-għeluq tal-fabbrika, il-ħaddiem safa' bla xogħol u kellu jfittex impjieg ieħor.
formal.en: After the factory closed, the worker was left unemployed and had to look for another job.
formal.zh: 工厂关闭后，这名工人失去了工作，不得不另寻职位。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ġara lil Mark wara li telqu sħabu? Nina: Safa' waħdu, allura stedinnieh jiġi magħna.
colloquial.en: Lara: What happened to Mark after his friends left? Nina: He was left alone, so we invited him to come with us.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克的朋友们走后，他怎么样了？妮娜：他就剩一个人了，所以我们邀请他跟我们一起走。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ġara lil Mark wara li telqu sħabu?
messages.mt_standard: X'ġara lil Mark wara li telqu sħabu?
messages.zh: 马克的朋友们走后，他怎么样了？
messages.en: What happened to Mark after his friends left?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Safa' waħdu, allura stedinnieh jiġi magħna.
messages.mt_standard: Safa' waħdu, allura stedinnieh jiġi magħna.
messages.zh: 他就剩一个人了，所以我们邀请他跟我们一起走。
messages.en: He was left alone, so we invited him to come with us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 safa' 想成故事结尾的“结果落得……”，后面接处境，如独自一人或没有工作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that purifies by removing impurities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够去除杂质、起净化作用的物品或装置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li tneħħi l-impuritajiet u tagħmel xi ħaġa oħra aktar safja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 起净化作用的东西；净化物或净化装置。

formal.mt: Is-saffaj tal-ilma jintuża biex jitneħħew l-impuritajiet qabel l-użu tal-ilma.
formal.en: The water purifier is used to remove impurities before the water is used.
formal.zh: 净水装置用于在用水前去除水中的杂质。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Għal xiex jintuża dan l-apparat? Sara: Hu saffaj tal-ilma; ineħħi l-impuritajiet.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: What is this device used for? Sara: It's a water purifier; it removes impurities.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：这个装置是做什么用的？萨拉：这是净水装置，用来去除杂质。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个装置是做什么用的？
messages.en: What is this device used for?

messages.speaker: Sara (店员)
messages.zh: 这是净水装置，用来去除杂质。
messages.en: It's a water purifier; it removes impurities.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 saffaj 画一个“杂质进去、清水出来”的装置，借功能记住它表示起净化作用的东西。

gloss_zh: 吹口哨；使离开或出国；染黄；发嘶声或嗡鸣；吹口哨者

teaching_sense.en_definition: To produce a clear, high sound by blowing air through the lips or a whistle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过嘴唇吹气或吹哨子发出清亮、尖细的声音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel ħoss irqiq billi jonfoħ bejn xofftejh jew f'suffara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人离开。
使某人出国；安排或促使某人前往国外。
把某物染成黄色；使某物带上黄色。
吹口哨；吹哨子。
发出嘶嘶声或嗡嗡声。
吹口哨的人。

collocations.zh: 他用口哨吹了一段曲调

formal.mt: Ir-referee saffar biex iwaqqaf il-logħba wara li plejer weġġa'.
formal.en: The referee blew his whistle to stop the match after a player was injured.
formal.zh: 一名球员受伤后，裁判鸣哨暂停了比赛。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min saffar dik il-melodija? Mark: Jien! Smajtha dalgħodu u baqgħet f'moħħi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who whistled that tune? Mark: I did! I heard it this morning and it stuck in my head.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁用口哨吹了那段曲子？马克：是我！我今天早上听到的，一直记在脑子里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁用口哨吹了那段曲子？
messages.en: Who whistled that tune?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien! Smajtha dalgħodu u baqgħet f'moħħi.
messages.mt_standard: Jien! Smajtha dalgħodu u baqgħet f'moħħi.
messages.zh: 是我！我今天早上听到的，一直记在脑子里。
messages.en: I did! I heard it this morning and it stuck in my head.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“吹口哨唱曲子”记住 saffar 的教学义，再分卡片记离开、出国、染黄、嘶鸣和名词义，避免混成一个意思。

gloss_zh: 口哨迷；老爱吹口哨的人（戏称）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A joking name for someone who whistles constantly or cannot resist whistling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对总爱吹口哨、仿佛吹口哨上了瘾的人的诙谐称呼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem biċ-ċajt għal persuna li tħobb issaffar il-ħin kollu.

sense_translations.en_definition: (jocular) One who is addicted to whistling
sense_translations.zh_definition: （戏称）吹口哨成瘾的人；总爱吹口哨的人。

collocations.en: a joking nickname meaning an obsessive whistler

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont umoristiku, il-ħbieb taw lil Pawlu l-laqam ta' saffarhielu għax kien dejjem qed isaffar.
formal.en: In the humorous story, Pawlu's friends gave him the nickname 'the whistling addict' because he was always whistling.
formal.zh: 在这则幽默故事中，保罗的朋友们给他起了“口哨迷”的绰号，因为他总在吹口哨。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Erġajt bdejt issaffar, Pawlu? Pawlu: Iva! Nina: Int tassew saffarhielu!
colloquial.en: Nina: Have you started whistling again, Pawlu? Pawlu: Yes! Nina: You really are a whistling addict!
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：保罗，你又开始吹口哨了？保罗：是啊！妮娜：你可真是个口哨迷！

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗，你又开始吹口哨了？
messages.en: Have you started whistling again, Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊！
messages.en: Yes!

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你可真是个口哨迷！
messages.en: You really are a whistling addict!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 saffarhielu 记成朋友送给“走到哪里都吹口哨”的人的玩笑绰号；这里是称呼人的名词。

gloss_zh: 惯于吹口哨的；容易发出哨声或嘶声的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Habitually whistling, or tending to produce a whistling or hissing sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人惯于吹口哨，或形容物体容易发出哨声、嘶嘶声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu d-drawwa li jsaffar, jew li għandu tendenza jagħmel ħoss ta' tisfir jew tħaxwix.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 惯于吹口哨的；经常吹口哨的，形容人。

sense_translations.en_definition: sth. with a tendency to whistle or hiss
sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易发出哨声或嘶嘶声的，形容物体。

collocations.en: a pipe prone to whistling or hissing
collocations.zh: 容易发出哨声或嘶声的管道

formal.mt: It-tekniku identifika pajp saffari li kien jagħmel ħoss qawwi kull meta jinfetaħ il-vit.
formal.en: The technician identified a pipe prone to whistling that made a loud sound whenever the tap was turned on.
formal.zh: 技术人员找出了一根容易发出哨声的管道，每次打开水龙头，它都会发出很响的声音。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ħuk dejjem isaffar waqt li jaħdem? Mark: Iva, hu saffari. Dejjem tisma' xi melodija mingħandu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does your brother always whistle while he works? Mark: Yes, he's a habitual whistler. You always hear some tune from him.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你哥哥干活时总吹口哨吗？马克：是啊，他惯爱吹口哨。你总能听到他吹着什么曲子。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħuk dejjem isaffar waqt li jaħdem?
messages.mt_standard: Ħuk dejjem isaffar waqt li jaħdem?
messages.zh: 你哥哥干活时总吹口哨吗？
messages.en: Does your brother always whistle while he works?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hu saffari. Dejjem tisma' xi melodija mingħandu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hu saffari. Dejjem tisma' xi melodija mingħandu.
messages.zh: 是啊，他惯爱吹口哨。你总能听到他吹着什么曲子。
messages.en: Yes, he's a habitual whistler. You always hear some tune from him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 saffari 配两张图：常吹口哨的人、容易嘶鸣的管道；共同记成形容“有这种发声习惯或倾向”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who sifts material through a sieve to separate finer particles from larger pieces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用筛子筛分材料，将细小颗粒与较大块状物分开的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tgħaddi materjal minn għarbiel biex tifred il-partiċelli fini mill-biċċiet ikbar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 筛东西的人；筛料者。

collocations.en: the work of the person who sifts

formal.mt: Is-saffatur għadda d-dqiq mill-għarbiel biex ineħħi l-biċċiet iebsin qabel ma beda t-taħlit.
formal.en: The person responsible for sifting passed the flour through the sieve to remove hard lumps before mixing began.
formal.zh: 负责筛粉的人在开始搅拌前，将面粉过筛，去掉硬块。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jkun is-saffatur illum? Pawlu: Jien! Għaddili l-għarbiel u nibda bid-dqiq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who's going to do the sifting today? Pawlu: I am! Pass me the sieve and I'll start with the flour.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今天谁来负责筛粉？保罗：我来！把筛子递给我，我先筛面粉。

messages.speaker: Maja (烘焙伙伴)
messages.zh: 今天谁来负责筛粉？
messages.en: Who's going to do the sifting today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (烘焙伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien! Għaddili l-għarbiel u nibda bid-dqiq.
messages.mt_standard: Jien! Għaddili l-għarbiel u nibda bid-dqiq.
messages.zh: 我来！把筛子递给我，我先筛面粉。
messages.en: I am! Pass me the sieve and I'll start with the flour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把厨房里拿着筛子筛面粉的人想成 saffatur；记住这个词指操作筛子的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone feel ashamed, inferior, or stripped of dignity through degrading treatment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过贬低或侮辱性的对待，使某人感到羞耻、低人一等或失去尊严。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħossu mistħi jew inferjuri billi jnaqqaslu d-dinjità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 羞辱某人；使某人受辱或感到尊严受损。

collocations.mt: saffel lil xi ħadd quddiem kulħadd
collocations.en: he humiliated someone in front of everyone

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tiegħu, l-impjegat spjega li l-kap saffel lilu u lil sħabu b'kummenti offensivi waqt il-laqgħa.
formal.en: In his report, the employee explained that the manager humiliated him and his colleagues with offensive comments during the meeting.
formal.zh: 这名员工在报告中说明，主管在会议期间用冒犯性言论羞辱了他和同事。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Mark telaq hekk malajr? Nina: Għax Toni saffel lil Mark quddiem kulħadd. Se mmur nitkellem miegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Mark leave so quickly? Nina: Because Toni humiliated Mark in front of everyone. I'm going to talk to him.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克为什么这么快就走了？妮娜：因为托尼当众羞辱了马克。我要去和马克聊聊。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么这么快就走了？
messages.en: Why did Mark leave so quickly?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax Toni saffel lil Mark quddiem kulħadd. Se mmur nitkellem miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax Toni saffel lil Mark quddiem kulħadd. Se mmur nitkellem miegħu.
messages.zh: 因为托尼当众羞辱了马克。我要去和马克聊聊。
messages.en: Because Toni humiliated Mark in front of everyone. I'm going to talk to him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“当众说难听的话，让人抬不起头”的场景记 saffel，抓住伤害尊严的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of removing impurities or unwanted substances to make something purer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 去除杂质或不需要的物质，使某物变得更纯净的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih jitneħħew l-impuritajiet jew sustanzi mhux mixtieqa biex xi ħaġa ssir aktar pura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 净化；去除杂质而使之纯净的过程。

formal.mt: Id-dokument jiddeskrivi l-proċess ta' safja u jispjega kif jitneħħew l-impuritajiet mill-ilma.
formal.en: The document describes the purification process and explains how impurities are removed from the water.
formal.zh: 这份文件介绍了净化过程，并说明如何去除水中的杂质。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi s-safja tal-ilma? Pawlu: Hija proċess biex jitneħħew l-impuritajiet mill-ilma.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is water purification? Pawlu: It's a process for removing impurities from water.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：什么是水的净化？保罗：就是去除水中杂质的过程。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 什么是水的净化？
messages.en: What is water purification?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija proċess biex jitneħħew l-impuritajiet mill-ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Hija proċess biex jitneħħew l-impuritajiet mill-ilma.
messages.zh: 就是去除水中杂质的过程。
messages.en: It's a process for removing impurities from water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一杯含杂质的水经过净化逐渐清澈，用整个“去除杂质的过程”记住 safja。

gloss_zh: 苍白的；微黄的；面色蜡黄的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Pale or yellowish in colour; when describing a complexion, having an unhealthy-looking yellowish paleness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 颜色苍白或略带黄色的；形容肤色时，可指看起来不健康的蜡黄色。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ta' lewn pallidu jew jagħti fl-isfar; meta jiddeskrivi l-wiċċ, jista' jindika dehra pallida u safranija li tidher mhux f'saħħitha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 苍白的；颜色浅淡的。
微黄的；略带黄色的。
面色蜡黄的；肤色呈现不健康的淡黄色的。

formal.mt: Il-karta tad-dokument qadim għandha lewn safrani, iżda l-kitba għadha ċara.
formal.en: The paper of the old document has a yellowish hue, but the writing is still clear.
formal.zh: 这份旧文件的纸张略微泛黄，但字迹仍然清晰。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan id-dawl jidher ftit safrani, hux? Mark: Iva, jagħti kulur aktar sħun lill-kamra.
colloquial.en: Lara: This light looks a little yellowish, doesn't it? Mark: Yes, it gives the room a warmer colour.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这灯光看起来有点偏黄，对吧？马克：是啊，让房间的色调更暖了。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan id-dawl jidher ftit safrani, hux?
messages.mt_standard: Dan id-dawl jidher ftit safrani, hux?
messages.zh: 这灯光看起来有点偏黄，对吧？
messages.en: This light looks a little yellowish, doesn't it?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jagħti kulur aktar sħun lill-kamra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jagħti kulur aktar sħun lill-kamra.
messages.zh: 是啊，让房间的色调更暖了。
messages.en: Yes, it gives the room a warmer colour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三幅浅色画面记 safrani：苍白的颜色、微黄的纸张、蜡黄的脸；结合所描述的对象选中文义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sacred Christian rite, such as baptism, understood as a sign and means of divine grace.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基督宗教中的神圣礼仪，如洗礼，被理解为天主恩宠的标记和传递途径。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rit qaddis fil-fidi Nisranija, bħall-magħmudija, li jitqies bħala sinjal u mezz tal-grazzja ta' Alla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 圣事；基督宗教中表达并传递神圣恩宠的礼仪。

formal.mt: Fil-lezzjoni, l-għalliema spjegat it-tifsira tas-sagrament tal-magħmudija fil-ħajja Nisranija.
formal.en: During the lesson, the teacher explained the meaning of the sacrament of baptism in Christian life.
formal.zh: 课堂上，老师解释了洗礼圣事在基督徒生活中的意义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dwar liema sagrament se nitgħallmu llum? Pawlu: Dwar il-magħmudija. L-għalliema se tispjega x'jiġri waqt iċ-ċerimonja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which sacrament are we learning about today? Pawlu: Baptism. The teacher is going to explain what happens during the ceremony.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今天我们要学习哪项圣事？保罗：洗礼。老师会解释仪式中有哪些环节。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar liema sagrament se nitgħallmu llum?
messages.mt_standard: Dwar liema sagrament se nitgħallmu llum?
messages.zh: 今天我们要学习哪项圣事？
messages.en: Which sacrament are we learning about today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar il-magħmudija. L-għalliema se tispjega x'jiġri waqt iċ-ċerimonja.
messages.mt_standard: Dwar il-magħmudija. L-għalliema se tispjega x'jiġri waqt iċ-ċerimonja.
messages.zh: 洗礼。老师会解释仪式中有哪些环节。
messages.en: Baptism. The teacher is going to explain what happens during the ceremony.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用洗礼这一具体仪式记 sagrament，再把“领受圣事”作为整块短语记忆，抓住它是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to a sacrament or to the celebration and reception of sacraments.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与圣事有关的；涉及圣事的举行或领受的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' sagrament jew maċ-ċelebrazzjoni u r-riċeviment tas-sagramenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 圣事的；属于圣事或与圣事有关的。

formal.mt: Il-programm ta' tħejjija sagramentali jgħin lill-parteċipanti jifhmu s-sagrament li se jirċievu.
formal.en: The sacramental preparation programme helps participants understand the sacrament they are going to receive.
formal.zh: 圣事准备课程帮助参与者理解他们即将领受的圣事。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'tinkludi t-tħejjija sagramentali? Mark: Laqgħat biex nifhmu aħjar is-sagrament u nippreparaw biex nirċevuh.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does sacramental preparation include? Mark: Meetings to help us understand the sacrament better and prepare to receive it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：圣事准备包括哪些内容？马克：一些聚会，帮助我们更好地理解圣事，并为领受圣事作准备。

messages.speaker: Lara (课程参加者)
messages.zh: 圣事准备包括哪些内容？
messages.en: What does sacramental preparation include?

messages.speaker: Mark (课程辅导员)
messages.mt_spoken: Laqgħat biex nifhmu aħjar is-sagrament u nippreparaw biex nirċevuh.
messages.mt_standard: Laqgħat biex nifhmu aħjar is-sagrament u nippreparaw biex nirċevuh.
messages.zh: 一些聚会，帮助我们更好地理解圣事，并为领受圣事作准备。
messages.en: Meetings to help us understand the sacrament better and prepare to receive it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sagrament 记为“圣事”，把 sagramentali 放进“圣事的生活、圣事的准备”中，借搭配记住形容词功能。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a way that involves or takes place through a religious sacrament.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以涉及宗教圣事的方式，或通过圣事而进行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li jinvolvi sagrament jew li jseħħ permezz ta' sagrament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以圣事的方式；通过圣事。

formal.mt: Fit-tagħlim tal-Knisja, il-koppja hija magħquda sagramentalment permezz taż-żwieġ.
formal.en: In the Church's teaching, the couple is united sacramentally through marriage.
formal.zh: 按照教会的教导，这对夫妇通过婚姻圣事结合。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Xi jfisser li koppja tkun magħquda sagramentalment? Pawlu: Ifisser li l-għaqda tagħhom hija permezz tas-sagrament taż-żwieġ.
colloquial.en: Marija: What does it mean for a couple to be united sacramentally? Pawlu: It means their union is through the sacrament of marriage.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：说一对夫妇通过圣事结合，是什么意思？保罗：意思是他们通过婚姻圣事结合。

messages.speaker: Marija (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser li koppja tkun magħquda sagramentalment?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser li koppja tkun magħquda sagramentalment?
messages.zh: 说一对夫妇通过圣事结合，是什么意思？
messages.en: What does it mean for a couple to be united sacramentally?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li l-għaqda tagħhom hija permezz tas-sagrament taż-żwieġ.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li l-għaqda tagħhom hija permezz tas-sagrament taż-żwieġ.
messages.zh: 意思是他们通过婚姻圣事结合。
messages.en: It means their union is through the sacrament of marriage.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“通过圣事结合”的句子记忆：这个词说明事情以什么方式发生，对应中文的“以圣事方式”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A liturgical book containing prayers used by a priest when celebrating Mass and other sacred rites.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供神父举行弥撒及其他神圣礼仪时使用、收录相关祷文的礼仪经书。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ktieb liturġiku li fih talb għall-użu tas-saċerdot fiċ-ċelebrazzjoni tal-quddiesa u ta' riti qaddisa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 圣事礼仪经书；收录神父举行弥撒及其他神圣礼仪所用祷文的书。

collocations.zh: 一本古老的圣事礼仪经书
圣事礼仪经书中的祷文

formal.mt: Il-katalogu tal-librerija jiddeskrivi sagramentarju antik li fih talb għall-quddiesa.
formal.en: The library catalogue describes an old sacramentary containing prayers for Mass.
formal.zh: 图书馆目录介绍了一本收录弥撒祷文的古老圣事礼仪经书。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dak il-ktieb fil-vetrina? Mark: Huwa sagramentarju; fih talb li juża s-saċerdot waqt il-liturġija.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is that book in the display case? Mark: It is a sacramentary; it contains prayers the priest uses during the liturgy.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：展柜里的那本是什么书？马克：是圣事礼仪经书，里面有神父举行礼仪时使用的祷文。

messages.speaker: Lara (参观者)
messages.zh: 展柜里的那本是什么书？
messages.en: What is that book in the display case?

messages.speaker: Mark (导览员)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa sagramentarju; fih talb li juża s-saċerdot waqt il-liturġija.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa sagramentarju; fih talb li juża s-saċerdot waqt il-liturġija.
messages.zh: 是圣事礼仪经书，里面有神父举行礼仪时使用的祷文。
messages.en: It is a sacramentary; it contains prayers the priest uses during the liturgy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象展柜里摊开的一本礼仪经书，页上写着神父使用的祷文；用这幅画面把词义固定在“书”这个名词上。

gloss_zh: 亵渎的；冒犯神圣事物的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Showing serious disrespect for something sacred.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容对神圣事物表现出严重不敬、具有亵渎性质的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri nuqqas serju ta' rispett lejn xi ħaġa meqjusa qaddisa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 亵渎的；严重冒犯神圣事物的。

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi t-tkissir intenzjonat tal-istatwa sagra bħala att sagrilegu.
formal.en: The author describes the deliberate breaking of the sacred statue as a sacrilegious act.
formal.zh: 作者将蓄意毁坏圣像描述为一种亵渎行为。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex sejjaħt dak l-att sagrilegu? Ġorġ: Għax sar apposta biex joffendi dak li n-nies iqisu sagru.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why did you call that act sacrilegious? Ġorġ: Because it was done deliberately to offend what people consider sacred.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你为什么说那个行为是亵渎的？乔治：因为那是故意冒犯人们所认为神圣的事物。

messages.speaker: Rita (同学)
messages.zh: 你为什么说那个行为是亵渎的？
messages.en: Why did you call that act sacrilegious?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax sar apposta biex joffendi dak li n-nies iqisu sagru.
messages.mt_standard: Għax sar apposta biex joffendi dak li n-nies iqisu sagru.
messages.zh: 因为那是故意冒犯人们所认为神圣的事物。
messages.en: Because it was done deliberately to offend what people consider sacred.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 att sagrilegu“亵渎的行为”：把 sagrilegu 贴在行为或言语旁边，提醒自己它是描述性质的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act that treats something sacred with serious disrespect.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对神圣之物表现出严重不敬的行为，即亵渎行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Att li juri nuqqas serju ta' rispett lejn xi ħaġa meqjusa qaddisa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 亵渎；严重冒犯神圣事物的行为。

formal.mt: Il-komunità qieset il-ħsara intenzjonata lill-oġġetti sagri bħala att ta' sagrileġġ.
formal.en: The community regarded the deliberate damage to sacred objects as an act of sacrilege.
formal.zh: 该社群将蓄意损坏圣物视为亵渎行为。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex in-nies huma daqshekk irrabjati dwar il-ħsara fl-artal? David: Għax iqisuha sagrileġġ; l-artal huwa sagru għalihom.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why are people so angry about the damage to the altar? David: Because they consider it sacrilege; the altar is sacred to them.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：人们为什么对祭坛受损这么愤怒？戴维：因为他们认为这是亵渎；祭坛对他们来说是神圣的。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex in-nies huma daqshekk irrabjati dwar il-ħsara fl-artal?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex in-nies huma daqshekk irrabjati dwar il-ħsara fl-artal?
messages.zh: 人们为什么对祭坛受损这么愤怒？
messages.en: Why are people so angry about the damage to the altar?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax iqisuha sagrileġġ; l-artal huwa sagru għalihom.
messages.mt_standard: Għax iqisuha sagrileġġ; l-artal huwa sagru għalihom.
messages.zh: 因为他们认为这是亵渎；祭坛对他们来说是神圣的。
messages.en: Because they consider it sacrilege; the altar is sacred to them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“这是一种亵渎行为”来记：sagrileġġ 给行为命名。再与表示“亵渎的”的形容词 sagrilegu 配对区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Regarded as so sacred or important that it must not be violated or interfered with.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被视为极其神圣或重要，因此不得侵犯或干涉的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meqjus tant qaddis jew importanti li ħadd ma għandu jiksru jew imissu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 神圣不可侵犯的；被视为绝对不容触犯的。

formal.mt: Fid-diskors tiegħu, il-kelliem iddeskriva d-dritt għall-privatezza bħala dritt sagrosant.
formal.en: In his speech, the speaker described the right to privacy as a sacrosanct right.
formal.zh: 发言者在演讲中将隐私权描述为神圣不可侵犯的权利。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Nista' naqra d-djarju tiegħek? Luqa: Le, għalija d-dritt għall-privatezza huwa sagrosant.
colloquial.en: Marta: Can I read your diary? Luqa: No, to me the right to privacy is sacrosanct.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：我可以看你的日记吗？卢卡：不行，对我来说，隐私权是不可侵犯的。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 我可以看你的日记吗？
messages.en: Can I read your diary?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għalija d-dritt għall-privatezza huwa sagrosant.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għalija d-dritt għall-privatezza huwa sagrosant.
messages.zh: 不行，对我来说，隐私权是不可侵犯的。
messages.en: No, to me the right to privacy is sacrosanct.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象日记本上写着“隐私不可侵犯”，用 dritt sagrosant 连接“权利”和“不可触犯”，记住它强调保护的程度。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To suddenly force air out through the throat with a sharp sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 突然从喉咙用力呼出空气并发出声音，即咳嗽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ l-arja f'daqqa mill-pulmuni minn ġol-gerżuma b'ħoss qawwi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 咳嗽；从喉咙突然用力呼气并发出咳声。

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, il-kelliem sagħal darbtejn u waqaf għal ftit qabel kompla jitkellem.
formal.en: During the meeting, the speaker coughed twice and paused briefly before continuing to speak.
formal.zh: 会议期间，发言者咳嗽了两声，稍作停顿后继续讲话。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kollox sew ma' Pawlu? Għadu kemm sagħal bil-qawwa. Nina: Iva, qal li għandu gerżumtu xotta u mar iġib ftit ilma.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is Pawlu all right? He just coughed hard. Nina: Yes, he said his throat was dry and went to get some water.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗没事吧？他刚才咳得很厉害。妮娜：没事，他说喉咙干，去拿点水了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kollox sew ma' Pawlu? Għadu kemm sagħal bil-qawwa.
messages.mt_standard: Kollox sew ma' Pawlu? Għadu kemm sagħal bil-qawwa.
messages.zh: 保罗没事吧？他刚才咳得很厉害。
messages.en: Is Pawlu all right? He just coughed hard.

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qal li għandu gerżumtu xotta u mar iġib ftit ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qal li għandu gerżumtu xotta u mar iġib ftit ilma.
messages.zh: 没事，他说喉咙干，去拿点水了。
messages.en: Yes, he said his throat was dry and went to get some water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人“咳、咳”两声，再说 sagħal darbtejn。例句里的 sagħal 表示“他咳嗽了”，用动作和次数一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To support one's body by leaning against something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将身体倚靠在某物上，以支撑自己或保持稳定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iserraħ ġismu ma' xi ħaġa biex isostni lilu nnifsu jew iżomm il-bilanċ.

sense_translations.en_definition: to prop oneself by leaning against sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过倚靠某物来支撑自己；靠住某物稳住身体。

collocations.en: he supported himself by leaning against the wall
he supported himself by leaning against a tree
collocations.zh: 他倚着一棵树支撑自己

formal.mt: Wara l-mixja twila, ir-raġel sagħan mal-ħajt biex iserraħ ftit qabel kompla fi triqtu.
formal.en: After the long walk, the man supported himself against the wall to rest briefly before continuing on his way.
formal.zh: 走了很长一段路后，那名男子倚着墙支撑身体，稍作休息后继续赶路。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex Toni sagħan ma' dik is-siġra? Ġanni: Għax għeja wara t-telgħa u ried iserraħ ftit.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why did Toni lean against that tree for support? Ġanni: Because he was tired after the climb and wanted a short rest.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：托尼为什么靠着那棵树支撑身体？詹尼：因为爬坡后累了，想歇一会儿。

messages.speaker: Marija (徒步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Toni sagħan ma' dik is-siġra?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Toni sagħan ma' dik is-siġra?
messages.zh: 托尼为什么靠着那棵树支撑身体？
messages.en: Why did Toni lean against that tree for support?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (徒步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għeja wara t-telgħa u ried iserraħ ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għeja wara t-telgħa u ried iserraħ ftit.
messages.zh: 因为爬坡后累了，想歇一会儿。
messages.en: Because he was tired after the climb and wanted a short rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把身体靠向墙来想象 sagħan mal-ħajt，重点记“借物支撑身体”。与 sagħal 对照：词尾 n 联想倚靠，词尾 l 联想咳嗽，仅作区分提示。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who coughs heavily or frequently.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 咳嗽很厉害或经常咳嗽的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tisgħol ħafna jew bil-qawwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 咳嗽很厉害的人；经常猛烈咳嗽的人。

collocations.en: a heavy cougher in the room
collocations.zh: 房间里一个咳嗽很厉害的人

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-vjaġġatur huwa deskritt bħala sagħgħal li l-ħin kollu jinterrompi l-konversazzjoni bis-sogħla tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, the traveller is described as a heavy cougher who constantly interrupts the conversation with his coughing.
formal.zh: 故事将这名旅客描写成一个咳嗽很厉害的人，他的咳嗽不断打断谈话。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser sagħgħal f'din l-istorja? Mark: Xi ħadd li jisgħol ħafna; hawnhekk il-kittieb qed jiddeskrivi lill-vjaġġatur.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does sagħgħal mean in this story? Mark: Someone who coughs a lot; here the writer is describing the traveller.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：这个故事里的 sagħgħal 是什么意思？马克：指咳嗽很多的人；这里作者是在描写那名旅客。

messages.speaker: Lara (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 这个故事里的 sagħgħal 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does sagħgħal mean in this story?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd li jisgħol ħafna; hawnhekk il-kittieb qed jiddeskrivi lill-vjaġġatur.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd li jisgħol ħafna; hawnhekk il-kittieb qed jiddeskrivi lill-vjaġġatur.
messages.zh: 指咳嗽很多的人；这里作者是在描写那名旅客。
messages.en: Someone who coughs a lot; here the writer is describing the traveller.

cognitive_memory_aid: 将 sagħal“他咳嗽了”和 sagħgħal“咳嗽很厉害的人”做成两张卡：一张画动作，一张画人物；留意后者多写一个 għ。

gloss_zh: 百里香草丛；成片的百里香

teaching_sense.en_definition: Thyme growing together as a patch or mass of vegetation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 成片生长的百里香，侧重整片植被而非单独一株。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sagħtar li jikber flimkien u jifforma medda ta' veġetazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 成片生长的百里香；百里香草丛。

collocations.en: the scent of the thyme growth

formal.mt: Il-mixja tgħaddi ħdejn medda ta' sagħtir, u l-viżitaturi għandhom jibqgħu fil-mogħdija.
formal.en: The walk passes beside a stretch of thyme growth, and visitors should remain on the path.
formal.zh: 这条步道经过一片百里香草丛旁，游客应沿小径行走。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'riħa sabiħa! Minn fejn ġejja? Pawlu: Mis-sagħtir ħdejn il-mogħdija.
colloquial.en: Maja: What a lovely smell! Where is it coming from? Pawlu: From the thyme growing beside the path.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：好香啊！香味从哪里来的？保罗：从小径旁的百里香草丛飘来的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 好香啊！香味从哪里来的？
messages.en: What a lovely smell! Where is it coming from?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 从小径旁的百里香草丛飘来的。
messages.en: From the thyme growing beside the path.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sagħtir 配上一整片散发香气的百里香草丛图，记住它侧重成片生长的整体。

gloss_zh: 一株百里香；瘦削的人；令人烦恼的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: An individual thyme plant or a young shoot of thyme.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 单独一株百里香，或百里香的一根嫩枝。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta waħda tas-sagħtar jew rimja żgħira tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一根百里香嫩枝；一株百里香。

sense_translations.en_definition: an gaunt person (especially a young woman)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 瘦削、形容憔悴的人，尤指年轻女子。
令人烦恼、惹人心烦的人。

collocations.en: a thyme plant in a pot

formal.mt: L-istudenta poġġiet sagħtra żgħira f'borma u kitbet id-data fuq it-tikketta.
formal.en: The student placed a small thyme plant in a pot and wrote the date on the label.
formal.zh: 这名女学生把一株小百里香放进花盆，并在标签上写下日期。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din sagħtra? Mark: Iva, poġġiha ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this a thyme plant? Mark: Yes, put it beside the window.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这是一株百里香吗？马克：是的，把它放在窗边吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 这是一株百里香吗？
messages.en: Is this a thyme plant?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 是的，把它放在窗边吧。
messages.en: Yes, put it beside the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用一个花盆里的一株百里香记 sagħtra，再给瘦削的人、烦人的人分别做义项卡，避免混用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who stays awake for all or part of the night, or works extra hours in the evening.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 整夜或部分夜间保持清醒的人，也指在晚间加班工作的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tibqa' mqajma matul il-lejl kollu jew parti minnu, jew li taħdem sigħat żejda filgħaxija.

sense_translations.en_definition: (Erin Serracino Inglott writes sahar which he attributes to De Soldanis) One who spends the night or part of the night awake. One who works overtime in the evening
sense_translations.zh_definition: （Erin Serracino Inglott 写作 sahar，并将此写法归于 De Soldanis。）整夜或部分夜间不睡的人；晚间加班工作的人。

collocations.en: a person staying up late at work
collocations.zh: 在工作岗位上熬夜的人

collocations.en: a person staying up at night because of studying

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-protagonist huwa sahhar li jqatta' parti mil-lejl jaħdem fuq il-manuskritt tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, the protagonist is a person who stays awake for part of the night working on his manuscript.
formal.zh: 在这篇故事中，主人公是个熬夜者，夜里有一段时间都在写自己的手稿。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Pawlu għadu jaħdem f'dan il-ħin? Mark: Iva, huwa sahhar; spiss jibqa' mqajjem sa tard.
colloquial.en: Anna: Is Pawlu still working at this hour? Mark: Yes, he stays up at night; he often remains awake until late.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：都这个点了，保罗还在工作吗？马克：是啊，他是个熬夜的人，经常很晚还没睡。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.zh: 都这个点了，保罗还在工作吗？
messages.en: Is Pawlu still working at this hour?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa sahhar; spiss jibqa' mqajjem sa tard.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa sahhar; spiss jibqa' mqajjem sa tard.
messages.zh: 是啊，他是个熬夜的人，经常很晚还没睡。
messages.en: Yes, he stays up at night; he often remains awake until late.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象深夜台灯下仍在工作的人，把 sahhar 贴在人物身上，记成熬夜者或晚间加班者。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone who stays awake at night or works extra hours in the evening.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人在夜间不睡、熬夜，或在晚间加班工作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jibqa' mqajjem bil-lejl jew jaħdem sigħat żejda filgħaxija.

sense_translations.en_definition: erin serracino inglott writes sahari which he attributes to de soldanis) that spends the night awake; works overtime, etc.
sense_translations.zh_definition: （Erin Serracino Inglott 写作 sahari，并将此写法归于 De Soldanis。）夜间不睡的；熬夜的；加班工作的等。

collocations.en: a worker who stays up at night or works extra evening hours
collocations.zh: 熬夜或晚间加班的工人

collocations.en: a student who stays up at night

formal.mt: Ir-rakkont jiddeskrivi ħaddiem sahhari li jkompli jaħdem wara li jitilqu l-kollegi tiegħu.
formal.en: The story describes a worker who works extra evening hours and continues after his colleagues leave.
formal.zh: 这篇故事描写了一名晚间加班的工人，同事离开后他仍继续工作。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex sejjaħtlu student sahhari? Toni: Għax spiss jibqa' jistudja sa tard bil-lejl.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you call him a student who stays up at night? Toni: Because he often keeps studying until late at night.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么说他是个熬夜的学生？托尼：因为他经常学习到深夜。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你为什么说他是个熬夜的学生？
messages.en: Why did you call him a student who stays up at night?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax spiss jibqa' jistudja sa tard bil-lejl.
messages.mt_standard: Għax spiss jibqa' jistudja sa tard bil-lejl.
messages.zh: 因为他经常学习到深夜。
messages.en: Because he often keeps studying until late at night.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sahhari 放在 student 后面，整组记成熬夜的学生；用它描述人物的作息或工作状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A surname used to identify a person or family.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于标识个人所属家庭的姓氏，可音译为“赛义德”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom li jidentifika persuna jew familja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姓氏，音译为“赛义德”。

formal.mt: Is-Sur Said bagħat l-applikazzjoni tiegħu lill-uffiċċju qabel id-data tal-għeluq.
formal.en: Mr Said sent his application to the office before the closing date.
formal.zh: 赛义德先生在截止日期之前将申请寄到了办公室。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'inhu kunjomok? Mark: Il-kunjom tiegħi hu Said.
colloquial.en: Anna: What's your surname? Mark: My surname is Said.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你姓什么？马克：我姓赛义德。

messages.speaker: Anna (接待员)
messages.zh: 你姓什么？
messages.en: What's your surname?

messages.speaker: Mark (访客)
messages.zh: 我姓赛义德。
messages.en: My surname is Said.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象登记表上“姓氏”一栏填着 Said，再把它与“赛义德先生”一起记忆；作为姓氏使用时，首字母写大写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of catching fish, whether for work or recreation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 捕捉鱼类的活动，可指作为工作的捕鱼，也可指休闲钓鱼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li fiha wieħed jaqbad il-ħut, bħala xogħol jew bħala passatemp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 捕鱼；钓鱼活动。

formal.mt: Il-klabb organizza ħarġa għas-sajdien u pprovda t-tagħmir meħtieġ lill-parteċipanti.
formal.en: The club organized a fishing trip and provided the participants with the necessary equipment.
formal.zh: 俱乐部组织了一次钓鱼活动，并向参与者提供了所需用具。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Tiġi miegħi għas-sajdien għada? Rita: Niġi! Nieħu l-qasba tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Will you come fishing with me tomorrow? Rita: I will! I'll bring my fishing rod.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：明天跟我一起去钓鱼吗？丽塔：去！我带上自己的鱼竿。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 明天跟我一起去钓鱼吗？
messages.en: Will you come fishing with me tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 去！我带上自己的鱼竿。
messages.en: I will! I'll bring my fishing rod.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sajdien 与“拿鱼竿、带渔具、出门捕鱼”的整套活动相连，记住它表示捕鱼活动，而不是鱼本身或捕鱼的人。

gloss_zh: 有催熟作用的；促使成熟的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having an effect that helps fruit or other produce ripen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有促进果实等成熟作用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu effett li jgħin lill-frott jew lil prodotti oħra jimmaturaw.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有催熟作用的；能够促进成熟的。

collocations.zh: 有助于果实成熟的天气

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-temp ta' dik il-ġimgħa bħala temp sajjari li għen lill-frott jimmatura.
formal.en: The report describes that week's weather as weather that promoted ripening and helped the fruit mature.
formal.zh: 报告将那一周的天气描述为有助于果实成熟的天气。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser temp sajjari? Toni: Temp li jgħin lill-frott jimmatura.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does weather that is 'sajjari' mean? Toni: Weather that helps fruit ripen.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：形容天气的 sajjari 是什么意思？托尼：就是有助于果实成熟的天气。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 形容天气的 sajjari 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does weather that is 'sajjari' mean?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.zh: 就是有助于果实成熟的天气。
messages.en: Weather that helps fruit ripen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一颗青果在合适条件下渐渐成熟，用 sajjari 标记“促使它成熟的作用或条件”，抓住“催熟”这个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To develop pus or become filled with pus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 产生脓液或变得充满脓液，常用于描述伤口等部位的变化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiżviluppa l-materja jew jimtela biha, bħal fil-każ ta' feriment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 化脓；产生脓液。
变得充满脓液；积满脓液。

collocations.en: an abscess that has filled with pus

formal.mt: Fin-nota klinika, it-tabib kiteb li l-feriment sajjat u li kien hemm il-materja fih.
formal.en: In the clinical note, the doctor wrote that the wound had suppurated and contained pus.
formal.zh: 医生在临床记录中写道，伤口已经化脓，内部存在脓液。

colloquial.mt: Marija: It-tabib qal li l-feriment sajjat. Pawlu: Jiġifieri mtela bil-materja?
colloquial.en: Marija: The doctor said the wound had suppurated. Pawlu: Does that mean it filled with pus?
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：医生说伤口化脓了。保罗：意思是里面积了脓液吗？

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 医生说伤口化脓了。
messages.en: The doctor said the wound had suppurated.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 意思是里面积了脓液吗？
messages.en: Does that mean it filled with pus?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“伤口里出现脓液”的画面记 sajjat：一个义项强调化脓这个变化，另一个义项强调已经积满脓液的状态。

gloss_zh: 禁食的；饥饿的；缺乏某物的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fasting or very hungry; also deprived of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 处于禁食状态的或非常饥饿的；也可表示缺少某种东西、未能得到某物的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun qed isum jew bil-ġuħ ħafna; ukoll li jkun imċaħħad minn xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 禁食的；正在斋戒的。
极其饥饿的；饿极了的。
被剥夺某物的；缺乏或未能得到某物的。

collocations.en: remain fasting or go without food
collocations.zh: 继续禁食或继续没有进食

formal.mt: Matul il-jum ta' sawm, Mark baqa' sajjem u kiel biss filgħaxija.
formal.en: During the day of fasting, Mark remained without food and ate only in the evening.
formal.zh: 在禁食日，马克白天一直没有进食，直到晚上才吃东西。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Għadek sajjem? Mark: Iva, għadni ma kilt xejn illum.
colloquial.en: Toni: Are you still fasting? Mark: Yes, I haven't eaten anything today yet.
colloquial.zh: 托尼：你还在禁食吗？马克：是的，我今天还什么都没吃。

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还在禁食吗？
messages.en: Are you still fasting?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadni ma kilt xejn illum.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadni ma kilt xejn illum.
messages.zh: 是的，我今天还什么都没吃。
messages.en: Yes, I haven't eaten anything today yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“肚子里没有食物”记住 sajjem 的禁食和饥饿义，再把画面扩展到“没有得到信息”等缺乏状态；具体义项由上下文判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Connected with fishing or the work of catching fish.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与捕鱼活动、捕鱼工作或渔业有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mas-sajd jew max-xogħol tal-qbid tal-ħut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与捕鱼有关的；渔业方面的。

formal.mt: Il-mużew juri tagħmir sajjiedi li kien jintuża biex jinqabad il-ħut tul il-kosta.
formal.en: The museum displays fishing equipment that was used to catch fish along the coast.
formal.zh: 博物馆展出过去沿海捕鱼时使用的渔具。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex dan it-tagħmir jissejjaħ sajjiedi? Ġużeppi: Għax jintuża għas-sajd.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why is this equipment described as 'sajjiedi'? Ġużeppi: Because it's used for fishing.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：为什么用 sajjiedi 来形容这些设备？朱塞佩：因为它们是捕鱼用的。

messages.speaker: Nina (访客)
messages.zh: 为什么用 sajjiedi 来形容这些设备？
messages.en: Why is this equipment described as 'sajjiedi'?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (博物馆讲解员)
messages.zh: 因为它们是捕鱼用的。
messages.en: Because it's used for fishing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给渔网、渔具和捕鱼工作贴上“与捕鱼有关”的标签来记 sajjiedi；本词条是形容词，练习时把它放在所描述的名词旁边。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sliding fastening used to secure a door or similar opening.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过滑动来固定门等开口、使其保持关闭的门闩或插销。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa li tiżżerżaq biex iżżomm bieb jew fetħa simili magħluqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 门闩；用于闩住门等的插销。

formal.mt: Il-mastrudaxxa waħħal sakkara fuq in-naħa ta' ġewwa tal-bieb biex dan jinżamm magħluq.
formal.en: The carpenter fitted a bolt on the inside of the door to keep it closed.
formal.zh: 木匠在门的内侧安装了一枚插销，用来将门闩住。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għalaqt is-sakkara tal-bieb? Ben: Iva, għalaqtha qabel ma tlajt.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you slide the door bolt shut? Ben: Yes, I did before I came upstairs.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你把门闩插上了吗？本：插上了，我上楼之前就插好了。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 你把门闩插上了吗？
messages.en: Did you slide the door bolt shut?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.zh: 插上了，我上楼之前就插好了。
messages.en: Yes, I did before I came upstairs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手指把门内侧的小横杆推入固定孔，用这个“推上门闩”的动作记 sakkara，并搭配 tal-bieb 一起练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to shut or lock things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 倾向于把东西关上或锁上的；形容有这种习惯或倾向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jagħlaq jew jissakkar l-affarijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于关上或锁上的。

collocations.en: a caretaker inclined to shut or lock things
collocations.zh: 习惯关门或上锁的管理员

collocations.en: a man inclined to shut or lock things
collocations.zh: 惯于把东西关上或锁上的男子

formal.mt: Il-kustodju huwa sakkari u jħobb iżomm il-bibien magħluqin.
formal.en: The caretaker is inclined to shut things and likes to keep the doors closed.
formal.zh: 这位管理员习惯把东西关上，喜欢让门保持关闭。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex Pawlu dejjem jagħlaq il-bieb? Rita: Għax hu sakkari; iħobb iżomm kollox magħluq.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why does Pawlu always close the door? Rita: Because he tends to shut things; he likes to keep everything closed.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：保罗为什么总是把门关上？丽塔：因为他有随手关东西的习惯，喜欢让一切都关着。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么总是把门关上？
messages.en: Why does Pawlu always close the door?

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu sakkari; iħobb iżomm kollox magħluq.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu sakkari; iħobb iżomm kollox magħluq.
messages.zh: 因为他有随手关东西的习惯，喜欢让一切都关着。
messages.en: Because he tends to shut things; he likes to keep everything closed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位走到哪里都随手关门上锁的管理员，用 sakkari 记住这种习惯倾向。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small sack used to hold or carry things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来盛放或携带东西的小袋子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xkora żgħira li tintuża biex iżżomm jew iġġorr affarijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小袋子；小型的口袋或布袋。

formal.mt: Kull parteċipant irċieva sakkett tad-drapp biż-żrieragħ għall-attività.
formal.en: Each participant received a small cloth sack containing seeds for the activity.
formal.zh: 每位参加者都领到了一个小布袋，里面装着活动所需的种子。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn inpoġġi dan ir-ross? Pawlu: Hawn sakkett żgħir; poġġih fih.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where should I put this rice? Pawlu: Here is a little sack; put it in there.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这些米放在哪里？保罗：这里有个小袋子，放进去吧。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 这些米放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put this rice?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 这里有个小袋子，放进去吧。
messages.en: Here is a little sack; put it in there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象掌心大小的布袋里装着一把米，把这个小袋子的画面与 sakkett 一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of violently taking property from a place; plundering or pillage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以暴力夺取某地财物的行为，即洗劫或掠夺。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-teħid bil-vjolenza ta' ġid jew oġġetti minn post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 洗劫、掠夺或劫掠财物的行为。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, is-sakkeġġ tal-belt ħalla ħafna familji mingħajr ikel u ħwejjeġ.
formal.en: In the novel, the sacking of the city left many families without food and clothing.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，对城市的洗劫使许多家庭失去了食物和衣物。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ġara fil-kapitlu li qrajt? Mark: Kien hemm sakkeġġ fil-belt, u n-nies tilfu ħafna minn dak li kellhom.
colloquial.en: Lara: What happened in the chapter you read? Mark: There was plundering in the city, and people lost much of what they owned.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你读的那一章发生了什么？马克：城里发生了洗劫，人们失去了许多财物。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你读的那一章发生了什么？
messages.en: What happened in the chapter you read?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hemm sakkeġġ fil-belt, u n-nies tilfu ħafna minn dak li kellhom.
messages.mt_standard: Kien hemm sakkeġġ fil-belt, u n-nies tilfu ħafna minn dak li kellhom.
messages.zh: 城里发生了洗劫，人们失去了许多财物。
messages.en: There was plundering in the city, and people lost much of what they owned.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sakkeġġ 配上小说中整座城被抢掠的画面，记住它表示洗劫或掠夺这一行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Affected by alcohol so that normal judgment or coordination is impaired.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因饮酒而醉了的，判断或动作协调能力受到影响。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun taħt l-effett tal-alkoħol u ma jkunx jaħseb jew jiċċaqlaq bħas-soltu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喝醉的；醉酒的。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ir-raġel kien sakran u ħabibu sejjaħ taxi biex jieħdu d-dar.
formal.en: In the story, the man was drunk, and his friend called a taxi to take him home.
formal.zh: 在这个故事中，那名男子喝醉了，他的朋友叫了出租车送他回家。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Mark jidher sakran. Pawlu: Iva, sejjaħtlu taxi biex imur id-dar.
colloquial.en: Rita: Mark looks drunk. Pawlu: Yes, I called him a taxi so he can go home.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：马克看起来喝醉了。保罗：是的，我给他叫了出租车，让他回家。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克看起来喝醉了。
messages.en: Mark looks drunk.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, sejjaħtlu taxi biex imur id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, sejjaħtlu taxi biex imur id-dar.
messages.zh: 是的，我给他叫了出租车，让他回家。
messages.en: Yes, I called him a taxi so he can go home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用酒杯旁站立不稳的人物画面记 sakran，核心意思是喝醉后的状态。

gloss_zh: 睡得迷迷糊糊的；睡意未消的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Dazed and not fully alert because of sleepiness or having just woken up.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因困倦或刚醒来而迷迷糊糊、尚未完全清醒的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun imħawwad u mhux għalkollox imqajjem minħabba n-ngħas jew għax ikun għadu kemm qam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因睡意而昏昏沉沉的；刚睡醒时迷迷糊糊的。

formal.mt: Fit-test, it-tifel qam sakrangħas u dam ftit biex fehem x'kien qed jiġri.
formal.en: In the text, the boy woke up groggy with sleep and took a little while to understand what was happening.
formal.zh: 在这篇课文中，男孩醒来时睡意蒙眬，过了一会儿才明白正在发生什么。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għadek sakrangħas? Luqa: Iva, għadni kemm qomt. Agħtini minuta.
colloquial.en: Marija: Are you still groggy with sleep? Luqa: Yes, I have only just woken up. Give me a minute.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你还没睡醒吗？卢卡：是啊，我刚起床。给我一分钟。

messages.speaker: Marija (姐姐)
messages.zh: 你还没睡醒吗？
messages.en: Are you still groggy with sleep?

messages.speaker: Luqa (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadni kemm qomt. Agħtini minuta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadni kemm qomt. Agħtini minuta.
messages.zh: 是啊，我刚起床。给我一分钟。
messages.en: Yes, I have only just woken up. Give me a minute.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象闹钟响后抱着枕头发愣的自己，用 sakrangħas 记住刚醒时睡意蒙眬的感觉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A musical wind instrument called a saxophone, played by blowing into a mouthpiece and pressing keys.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 萨克斯管，一种通过向吹嘴吹气并按键来演奏的管乐器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument mużikali tan-nifs li jindaqq billi jonfoħ fih il-mużiċist u jagħfas it-tasti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 萨克斯管，一种管乐器。

formal.mt: Matul il-kunċert, il-mużiċist daqq is-saksofon flimkien ma' pjanista.
formal.en: During the concert, the musician played the saxophone together with a pianist.
formal.zh: 音乐会上，这位乐手与一位钢琴家一起演奏了萨克斯管。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'strument iddoqq? Mark: Indoqq is-saksofon. Trid tisma' biċċa qasira?
colloquial.en: Sara: What instrument do you play? Mark: I play the saxophone. Would you like to hear a short piece?
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你演奏什么乐器？马克：我吹萨克斯管。想听一小段吗？

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你演奏什么乐器？
messages.en: What instrument do you play?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Indoqq is-saksofon. Trid tisma' biċċa qasira?
messages.mt_standard: Indoqq is-saksofon. Trid tisma' biċċa qasira?
messages.zh: 我吹萨克斯管。想听一小段吗？
messages.en: I play the saxophone. Would you like to hear a short piece?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 saksofon 的读音与中文“萨克斯”、英文 saxophone 对照，再联想吹奏乐器的动作。

gloss_zh: 把……钉在十字架上；施以十字架刑

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put someone to death by fastening them to a cross.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某人固定在十字架上处死，即施以十字架刑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qatel lil xi ħadd billi waħħlu ma' salib.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某人钉在十字架上处死；对某人施以十字架刑。

collocations.zh: 把那名囚犯钉在十字架上处死了

collocations.mt: salab lil xi ħadd fuq salib tal-injam
collocations.en: crucified someone on a wooden cross
collocations.zh: 把某人固定在木制十字架上处死了

formal.mt: Fl-istorja fittizja, is-suldat salab lill-priġunier fuq għolja barra l-belt.
formal.en: In the fictional story, the soldier crucified the prisoner on a hill outside the city.
formal.zh: 在这个虚构故事中，士兵在城外的一座山丘上对那名囚犯施以十字架刑。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser 'salab' f'din is-sentenza? Rita: Tfisser li qatel lil xi ħadd billi waħħlu ma' salib.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'salab' mean in this sentence? Rita: It means that he killed someone by fastening them to a cross.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这句话里的 salab 是什么意思？丽塔：意思是他把某人固定在十字架上处死了。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这句话里的 salab 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'salab' mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li qatel lil xi ħadd billi waħħlu ma' salib.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li qatel lil xi ħadd billi waħħlu ma' salib.
messages.zh: 意思是他把某人固定在十字架上处死了。
messages.en: It means that he killed someone by fastening them to a cross.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用课文旁的十字架简图记 salab，记住它表示施以十字架刑这一动作。

gloss_zh: 点头哈腰；奉承；过分客套

teaching_sense.en_definition: Excessively deferential behavior or flattering words used to please someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为取悦别人而表现出的过分恭顺、点头哈腰或奉承客套。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imġiba ta' rispett żejjed jew kliem ta' tifħir biex wieħed jogħġob lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 点头哈腰、卑躬屈膝的举动；奉承或过分客套。

collocations.en: a lot of bowing and scraping or flattery
collocations.zh: 许多点头哈腰或奉承客套

formal.mt: Id-direttur talab lill-impjegati jesprimu l-opinjoni tagħhom b'mod ċar u bla salamalekki.
formal.en: The director asked the employees to express their opinions clearly and without flattery.
formal.zh: 主管要求员工清楚地表达自己的意见，无须奉承客套。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandi nibda b'ħafna tifħir meta nitkellem mal-kap? Rita: Le, bla salamalekki; għidlu x'taħseb b'rispett.
colloquial.en: Mark: Should I start with lots of praise when I speak to the boss? Rita: No, skip the flattery; tell him what you think respectfully.
colloquial.zh: 马克：跟老板说话时，我应该先说很多赞美的话吗？丽塔：不用，不必奉承客套；有礼貌地告诉他你的想法就行。

messages.speaker: Mark (新员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi nibda b'ħafna tifħir meta nitkellem mal-kap?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi nibda b'ħafna tifħir meta nitkellem mal-kap?
messages.zh: 跟老板说话时，我应该先说很多赞美的话吗？
messages.en: Should I start with lots of praise when I speak to the boss?

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, bla salamalekki; għidlu x'taħseb b'rispett.
messages.mt_standard: Le, bla salamalekki; għidlu x'taħseb b'rispett.
messages.zh: 不用，不必奉承客套；有礼貌地告诉他你的想法就行。
messages.en: No, skip the flattery; tell him what you think respectfully.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人边鞠躬边不停说好话，用 salamalekki 记住点头哈腰和过分奉承的感觉。

gloss_zh: 钉十字架事件；十字架刑

teaching_sense.en_definition: An event in which someone is put to death by being fastened to a cross.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将某人固定在十字架上处死的一次事件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġrajja li fiha persuna tinqatel billi titwaħħal ma' salib.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次将人钉在十字架上处死的事件。

collocations.zh: 关于一次十字架刑的记述

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi salba u t-tbatija tal-persuna kkundannata.
formal.en: The author describes a crucifixion and the suffering of the condemned person.
formal.zh: 作者描述了一次十字架刑以及受刑者的痛苦。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qed turi din il-pittura? Pawlu: Qed turi xena ta' salba.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does this painting show? Pawlu: It shows a crucifixion scene.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这幅画描绘的是什么？保罗：描绘的是十字架刑的场景。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.zh: 这幅画描绘的是什么？
messages.en: What does this painting show?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (导览员)
messages.zh: 描绘的是十字架刑的场景。
messages.en: It shows a crucifixion scene.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 salba 联想成画中正在发生的一次十字架刑，记住它指事件，而不是十字架这件物品。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A projecting piece of stone, wood, or another material that supports a structure above it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从墙面等处伸出、用于承托上方结构的石质、木质或其他材料构件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa ġebel, injam jew materjal ieħor li toħroġ minn ħajt u ssostni struttura fuqha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从墙体伸出以支承上部结构的托臂或承托构件。

formal.mt: Is-saljatura tal-ġebel taħt il-gallarija teħtieġ tiswija.
formal.en: The stone corbel beneath the balcony requires repair.
formal.zh: 阳台下方的石制托臂需要修缮。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhi dik il-biċċa ġebel taħt il-gallarija? Toni: Dik saljatura; qiegħda hemm biex issostni l-gallarija.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is that piece of stone beneath the balcony? Toni: That's a corbel; it's there to support the balcony.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：阳台下面那块石头是什么？托尼：那是托臂，用来支撑阳台。

messages.speaker: Lara (屋主)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi dik il-biċċa ġebel taħt il-gallarija?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi dik il-biċċa ġebel taħt il-gallarija?
messages.zh: 阳台下面那块石头是什么？
messages.en: What is that piece of stone beneath the balcony?

messages.speaker: Toni (建筑工匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik saljatura; qiegħda hemm biex issostni l-gallarija.
messages.mt_standard: Dik saljatura; qiegħda hemm biex issostni l-gallarija.
messages.zh: 那是托臂，用来支撑阳台。
messages.en: That's a corbel; it's there to support the balcony.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 saljatura 时想象墙上伸出一只石头手臂，托住上方阳台，就能抓住承托构件的意思。

gloss_zh: 十字形排列的；交叉纵横的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Arranged in the shape of a cross, or formed by lines or elements crossing one another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 排列成十字形的，或由线条、构件等彼此交叉形成的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Irranġat f'għamla ta' salib jew magħmul minn linji jew elementi li jaqsmu lil xulxin.

sense_translations.en_definition: arranged in the shape of a cross
sense_translations.zh_definition: 排列成十字形的。
相互交叉、纵横交错的。

formal.mt: Il-pannell għandu disinn sallabi magħmul minn strixxi tal-injam li jaqsmu lil xulxin.
formal.en: The panel has a criss-cross design made from wooden strips that cross one another.
formal.zh: 这块板采用交叉纵横的图案，由相互交叉的木条组成。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif inqiegħed dawn iż-żewġ strixxi? Mark: Agħmel arranġament sallabi, b'waħda fuq l-oħra bħal salib.
colloquial.en: Nina: How should I place these two strips? Mark: Make a cross-shaped arrangement, with one over the other like a cross.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这两根条子该怎么摆？马克：摆成十字形，一根叠在另一根上，像十字架一样。

messages.speaker: Nina (手工课学生)
messages.zh: 这两根条子该怎么摆？
messages.en: How should I place these two strips?

messages.speaker: Mark (手工课教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Agħmel arranġament sallabi, b'waħda fuq l-oħra bħal salib.
messages.mt_standard: Agħmel arranġament sallabi, b'waħda fuq l-oħra bħal salib.
messages.zh: 摆成十字形，一根叠在另一根上，像十字架一样。
messages.en: Make a cross-shaped arrangement, with one over the other like a cross.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 sallabi 配两幅记忆图：两根木条组成十字，多根木条交叉成网，分别对应两个形容词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For a ship to leave harbour, or for someone to raise its anchor before departure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指船只驶离港口，或指为启航而将船锚提起。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal vapur li jitlaq mill-port, jew għal min itella' l-ankra qabel it-tluq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 驶离港口，启航；用于船只。
起锚；将船锚提起。

formal.mt: Il-vapur salpa mill-port fis-sitta ta' filgħodu.
formal.en: The ship left harbour at six in the morning.
formal.zh: 该船于早晨六点驶离港口。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-vapur għadu fil-port? Ġanni: Le, salpa għaxar minuti ilu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is the ship still in harbour? Ġanni: No, it left ten minutes ago.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：船还在港口吗？詹尼：不在了，十分钟前已经启航了。

messages.speaker: Sara (旅客)
messages.zh: 船还在港口吗？
messages.en: Is the ship still in harbour?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (码头工作人员)
messages.zh: 不在了，十分钟前已经启航了。
messages.en: No, it left ten minutes ago.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 salpa 记成一段启航画面：先提起船锚，再驶离港口；两个动作正好串起两个词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Securely protected, or free from danger or harm.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到稳妥保护的，或没有危险、免受伤害的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Protett sew jew ħieles mill-periklu u l-ħsara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到稳妥保护的；有保障的。
安全的；免受危险或伤害的。

formal.mt: Wara l-evakwazzjoni, kull ħaddiem kien f'post salv.
formal.en: After the evacuation, every worker was in a safe place.
formal.zh: 疏散后，每位工作人员都已身处安全地点。

colloquial.mt: Omm: Wasalt id-dar? Pawlu: Iva, wasalt qawwi u salv.
colloquial.en: Mother: Have you arrived home? Pawlu: Yes, I got home safe and sound.
colloquial.zh: 妈妈：你到家了吗？保罗：到了，我已经平安到家了。

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.zh: 你到家了吗？
messages.en: Have you arrived home?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (儿子)
messages.zh: 到了，我已经平安到家了。
messages.en: Yes, I got home safe and sound.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 salv 放进平安到家的画面，再连着记 qawwi u salv，表示人安然无恙、处境安全。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Protection, or a measure intended to prevent harm, loss, or abuse.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 防止伤害、损失或滥用的保护，或为此设置的保障措施。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Protezzjoni jew miżura maħsuba biex tevita ħsara, telf jew abbuż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 保障；用于防止损害、损失或滥用的保护措施。

formal.mt: Il-verifika indipendenti tipprovdi salvagwardja kontra l-abbuż.
formal.en: Independent verification provides a safeguard against abuse.
formal.zh: 独立核查提供了防止滥用的保障。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hemm bżonn żewġ firem? Mark: Bħala salvagwardja kontra żbalji fil-ħlas.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are two signatures needed? Mark: As a safeguard against payment errors.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么需要两个人签字？马克：这是防止付款出错的一项保障措施。

messages.speaker: Maja (新员工)
messages.zh: 为什么需要两个人签字？
messages.en: Why are two signatures needed?

messages.speaker: Mark (财务主管)
messages.zh: 这是防止付款出错的一项保障措施。
messages.en: As a safeguard against payment errors.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 salvagwardja 想成付款前的第二道审核关卡：多一道保护，就多一项防止出错的保障。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An official permit, especially a document granting safe passage through a place or territory.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 正式签发的许可证，尤指准许持有人安全通过某地或某片区域的通行文件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Permess uffiċjali, speċjalment dokument li jagħti lil min iġorru d-dritt li jgħaddi b'mod sigur minn post jew territorju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 许可证；准许进行某项活动或通行的正式文件。
安全通行证；准许持有人安全通过指定地区的凭证。

formal.mt: L-awtorità ħarġet salvakondott biex id-delegat ikun jista' jgħaddi miż-żona.
formal.en: The authority issued a safe-conduct pass so that the delegate could pass through the area.
formal.zh: 主管机关签发了安全通行证，以便该代表通过这一区域。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'għandi nuri fil-punt ta' kontroll? Toni: Uri s-salvakondott tiegħek lill-uffiċjal.
colloquial.en: Lara: What should I show at the checkpoint? Toni: Show your safe-conduct pass to the officer.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：在检查站我该出示什么？托尼：向工作人员出示你的安全通行证。

messages.speaker: Lara (旅客)
messages.zh: 在检查站我该出示什么？
messages.en: What should I show at the checkpoint?

messages.speaker: Toni (向导)
messages.zh: 向工作人员出示你的安全通行证。
messages.en: Show your safe-conduct pass to the officer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 salvakondott 时想象检查站前出示的一张证件：凭它获准通过，并获得安全通行的保障。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Deliverance from sin or spiritual danger, understood as salvation in a religious context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 宗教语境中的救赎，指从罪或灵性危险中获得解脱、得救。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħelsien mid-dnub jew minn periklu spiritwali, f'kuntest reliġjuż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 救赎；得救，尤指宗教意义上从罪中获得解脱。

formal.mt: It-test reliġjuż jiddiskuti s-salvament tar-ruħ u r-rabta tiegħu mal-fidi.
formal.en: The religious text discusses the salvation of the soul and its connection with faith.
formal.zh: 这篇宗教文本讨论灵魂的得救及其与信仰的联系。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi jfisser salvament f'din it-talba? Pawlu: Hawnhekk ifisser li r-ruħ tinħeles mid-dnub.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does salvation mean in this prayer? Pawlu: Here it means that the soul is freed from sin.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这篇祷文里的救赎是什么意思？保罗：这里指灵魂从罪中获得解脱。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 这篇祷文里的救赎是什么意思？
messages.en: What does salvation mean in this prayer?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (宗教课教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk ifisser li r-ruħ tinħeles mid-dnub.
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk ifisser li r-ruħ tinħeles mid-dnub.
messages.zh: 这里指灵魂从罪中获得解脱。
messages.en: Here it means that the soul is freed from sin.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 salvament 和祷文中的灵魂得救连在一起记：想象心灵摆脱罪的重担，获得救赎。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of saving someone from danger.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某人从危险中救出的行为；这里用作名词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li ssalva lil xi ħadd minn periklu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 救助某人；把某人从危险中救出的行为。

collocations.en: the act of saving a person

formal.mt: Is-salvar tat-tifel mill-baħar kien possibbli grazzi għall-għajnuna ta' żewġ għawwiema.
formal.en: Saving the boy from the sea was possible thanks to the help of two swimmers.
formal.zh: 多亏两名游泳者出手相助，男孩才得以从海中获救。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Min għen fis-salvar tat-tifel? Pawlu: Żewġ għawwiema li kienu fil-qrib.
colloquial.en: Marta: Who helped save the boy? Pawlu: Two swimmers who were nearby.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：谁帮忙救了那个男孩？保罗：当时在附近的两名游泳者。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁帮忙救了那个男孩？
messages.en: Who helped save the boy?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 当时在附近的两名游泳者。
messages.en: Two swimmers who were nearby.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 salvar 配上“救人这件事”的画面来记；本条是名词，重点落在救助行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An operation to rescue people from danger or recover a vessel or property after an accident.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把人从危险中救出，或在事故后打捞、抢救船只及财物的行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħidma biex jiġu salvati persuni minn periklu jew jiġu rkuprati bastimenti jew oġġetti wara inċident.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对遇险或受损船只及财物的打捞、抢救或回收。
救援；把人从危险或困境中救出的行动。

formal.mt: Wara s-salvataġġ tal-ekwipaġġ, bdiet il-ħidma tas-salvataġġ tal-bastiment.
formal.en: After the crew had been rescued, work began on salvaging the vessel.
formal.zh: 船员获救后，船只的打捞抢救工作随即展开。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għadha għaddejja l-operazzjoni ta' salvataġġ? Mark: Iva, imma l-passiġġieri kollha diġà jinsabu fuq l-art.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is the rescue operation still going on? Mark: Yes, but all the passengers are already ashore.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：救援行动还在进行吗？马克：是的，不过所有乘客都已经上岸了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 救援行动还在进行吗？
messages.en: Is the rescue operation still going on?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma l-passiġġieri kollha diġà jinsabu fuq l-art.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma l-passiġġieri kollha diġà jinsabu fuq l-art.
messages.zh: 是的，不过所有乘客都已经上岸了。
messages.en: Yes, but all the passengers are already ashore.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象救援队先救船员、再抢救船只；用同一事故画面记住“救援”和“打捞”两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Someone who saves others from danger or distress; in religious use, a saviour or redeemer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 救人脱离危险或困境的人；在宗教语境中指救主或救赎者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħadd li jsalva lil oħrajn minn periklu jew tbatija; f'kuntest reliġjuż, il-Feddej.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 救星；救助他人的人；宗教语境中的救主。
救赎者；宗教语境中使人獲得救赎的救主。

formal.mt: Fit-tagħlim Nisrani, Ġesù jissejjaħ is-Salvatur u l-Feddej.
formal.en: In Christian teaching, Jesus is called the Saviour and Redeemer.
formal.zh: 在基督教教义中，耶稣被称为救主和救赎者。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Sibt iċ-ċwievet tiegħek taħt is-siġġu. David: Int is-salvatur tiegħi! Kont se ndum infittixhom.
colloquial.en: Nina: I found your keys under the chair. David: You're my saviour! I would have spent ages looking for them.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我在椅子下面找到了你的钥匙。戴维：你真是我的救星！我本来还得找上好久。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我在椅子下面找到了你的钥匙。
messages.en: I found your keys under the chair.

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Int is-salvatur tiegħi! Kont se ndum infittixhom.
messages.mt_standard: Int is-salvatur tiegħi! Kont se ndum infittixhom.
messages.zh: 你真是我的救星！我本来还得找上好久。
messages.en: You're my saviour! I would have spent ages looking for them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 salvatur 记成画面里“伸手救你的那个人”；日常可说救星，宗教语境可说救主。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An electrical protective device that automatically interrupts a circuit when it detects a fault.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 检测到电气故障时自动切断电路的保护装置，即断路器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat ta' protezzjoni elettrika li jaqta' ċ-ċirkwit awtomatikament meta jinduna b'ħsara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 断路器；发生电气故障时自动切断电路的保护装置。

collocations.en: the circuit breaker cut off the power

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni, l-elettriċista ċċekkja li s-salvavita kien jaħdem sew.
formal.en: During the inspection, the electrician checked that the circuit breaker was working properly.
formal.zh: 检查期间，电工确认了断路器是否正常工作。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex intefa d-dawl? Toni: Is-salvavita qata' d-dawl; se nċempel lill-elettriċista.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did the lights go out? Toni: The circuit breaker cut off the power; I'll call the electrician.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：灯怎么灭了？托尼：断路器切断了电源；我来给电工打电话。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
