messages.zh: 灯怎么灭了？
messages.en: Why did the lights go out?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-salvavita qata' d-dawl; se nċempel lill-elettriċista.
messages.mt_standard: Is-salvavita qata' d-dawl; se nċempel lill-elettriċista.
messages.zh: 断路器切断了电源；我来给电工打电话。
messages.en: The circuit breaker cut off the power; I'll call the electrician.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 salvavita 和配电箱里自动跳开的开关联想起来，用“故障出现、电路切断”记住断路器。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A buoyant jacket worn to help a person stay afloat in water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 穿在身上、帮助人在水中保持漂浮的救生衣。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġakketta li tintlibes biex tgħin lil persuna tibqa' fil-wiċċ tal-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 救生衣；帮助穿着者在水中保持漂浮的装备。

formal.mt: Qabel it-tluq tad-dgħajsa, l-istruttur wera lill-passiġġieri kif jilbsu s-salvawomu.
formal.en: Before the boat departed, the instructor showed the passengers how to put on the life jacket.
formal.zh: 船只出发前，教练向乘客示范了如何穿上救生衣。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Ilbes is-salvawomu qabel titla' fid-dgħajsa. Ben: Tajjeb, tista' tgħinni nagħlqu?
colloquial.en: Marija: Put on the life jacket before you get into the boat. Ben: Okay, can you help me fasten it?
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：上船前先穿上救生衣。本：好的，你能帮我把它扣好吗？

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 上船前先穿上救生衣。
messages.en: Put on the life jacket before you get into the boat.

messages.speaker: Ben (儿子)
messages.zh: 好的，你能帮我把它扣好吗？
messages.en: Okay, can you help me fasten it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象上船前穿好橙色救生衣的动作，把 salvawomu 与“穿在身上、帮助漂浮”连起来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Deliverance from sin or spiritual harm, especially in religious teaching.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尤指宗教教义中，人从罪或灵性上的危害中获得拯救与救赎。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħelsien mid-dnub jew minn ħsara spiritwali, speċjalment fit-tagħlim reliġjuż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 救恩；宗教意义上从罪及其后果中获得拯救。
救赎；宗教意义上从罪的束缚中获得释放。

formal.mt: Il-kapitlu jispjega l-kunċett tas-salvazzjoni fit-tagħlim Nisrani.
formal.en: The chapter explains the concept of salvation in Christian teaching.
formal.zh: 这一章解释了基督教教义中的救恩概念。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'tfisser salvazzjoni f'din is-silta? Luqa: Hawnhekk tfisser il-ħelsien mid-dnub.
colloquial.en: Anna: What does salvazzjoni mean in this passage? Luqa: Here it means deliverance from sin.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这段文字里的 salvazzjoni 是什么意思？卢卡：这里指从罪中获得拯救。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.zh: 这段文字里的 salvazzjoni 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does salvazzjoni mean in this passage?

messages.speaker: Luqa (教师)
messages.zh: 这里指从罪中获得拯救。
messages.en: Here it means deliverance from sin.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 salvazzjoni 放在宗教课本的“救恩、救赎”栏目下记，用灵魂获得拯救的画面提示词义。

gloss_zh: 《又圣母经》；向圣母诵念的祷文

teaching_sense.en_definition: The prayer Hail Holy Queen, addressed to the Virgin Mary.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向圣母玛利亚诵念的祷文 Hail Holy Queen，中文通常称《又圣母经》。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Talba lill-Verġni Marija magħrufa bħala s-Salvereġina.

sense_translations.en_definition: Hail Holy Queen (a prayer to Our Lady)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 《又圣母经》；一篇向圣母玛利亚诵念的祷文。

collocations.en: we pray the Hail Holy Queen
the words of the Hail Holy Queen

formal.mt: Il-fuljett jinkludi l-kliem tas-salvereġina biex il-parteċipanti jkunu jistgħu jsegwu t-talba.
formal.en: The leaflet includes the words of the Hail Holy Queen so that participants can follow the prayer.
formal.zh: 小册子收录了《又圣母经》的经文，方便参与者跟随诵念。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Fejn insib is-salvereġina f'dan il-ktieb? Ġużeppi: Fl-aħħar paġna; nistgħu nitolbuha flimkien.
colloquial.en: Rita: Where can I find the Hail Holy Queen in this book? Ġużeppi: On the last page; we can pray it together.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这本书里的《又圣母经》在哪里？朱塞佩：在最后一页；我们可以一起诵念。

messages.speaker: Rita (教友)
messages.zh: 这本书里的《又圣母经》在哪里？
messages.en: Where can I find the Hail Holy Queen in this book?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (教友)
messages.zh: 在最后一页；我们可以一起诵念。
messages.en: On the last page; we can pray it together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 salvereġina 当作祷文标题整体记忆：翻开祈祷书，找到向圣母诵念的《又圣母经》。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Safety or deliverance from danger; in religious contexts, salvation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 安全、脱离危险或获得拯救；在宗教语境中也指救恩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħelsien minn periklu jew stat ta' sigurtà; f'kuntest reliġjuż, il-ħelsien mid-dnub.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拯救；救恩，尤其指宗教意义上的得救。
安全；免受危险或已经脱险的状态。

formal.mt: Għas-salvezza tal-passiġġieri, il-kaptan iddeċieda li jirritorna lejn il-port.
formal.en: For the passengers' safety, the captain decided to return to port.
formal.zh: 为了乘客的安全，船长决定返回港口。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għaliex ma tlaqniex bid-dgħajsa? Karl: Għas-salvezza tagħna; il-baħar kien imqalleb wisq.
colloquial.en: Elena: Why didn't we set off in the boat? Karl: For our safety; the sea was too rough.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：我们为什么没有乘船出发？卡尔：为了我们的安全；海上风浪太大了。

messages.speaker: Elena (乘客)
messages.zh: 我们为什么没有乘船出发？
messages.en: Why didn't we set off in the boat?

messages.speaker: Karl (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għas-salvezza tagħna; il-baħar kien imqalleb wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Għas-salvezza tagħna; il-baħar kien imqalleb wisq.
messages.zh: 为了我们的安全；海上风浪太大了。
messages.en: For our safety; the sea was too rough.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“终于脱险、平安了”记 salvezza 的安全义；看到灵魂或宗教语境时，再联想到救恩义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element samarium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素钐的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-element kimiku magħruf bħala samarju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钐，一种化学元素。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-element kimiku samarju.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jidentifika l-kampjun bħala samarju u jagħti deskrizzjoni tiegħu.
formal.en: The report identifies the sample as samarium and provides a description of it.
formal.zh: 报告将该样品鉴定为钐，并对其作出描述。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'hemm f'dan il-kontenitur? Pawlu: Kampjun ta' samarju; ismu qiegħed fuq it-tikketta.
colloquial.en: Marta: What's in this container? Pawlu: A sample of samarium; its name is on the label.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这个容器里是什么？保罗：一份钐样品；标签上写着它的名称。

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.zh: 这个容器里是什么？
messages.en: What's in this container?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Kampjun ta' samarju; ismu qiegħed fuq it-tikketta.
messages.mt_standard: Kampjun ta' samarju; ismu qiegħed fuq it-tikketta.
messages.zh: 一份钐样品；标签上写着它的名称。
messages.en: A sample of samarium; its name is on the label.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 samarju 与英语 samarium 并排记忆，再配上中文“钐”和样品标签的画面。

gloss_zh: 使变硬；起硬化作用的东西

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something hard or harder.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变硬，或使其硬度增加。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa iebsa jew iżjed iebsa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使变硬；使硬化。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa iżjed iebsa.

sense_translations.en_definition: sth. that has the effect of hardening
sense_translations.zh_definition: 能使某物变硬的东西；起硬化作用的物质或事物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li għandha l-effett li tagħmel ħaġa oħra iżjed iebsa.

collocations.en: a hardening agent for the mixture

formal.mt: It-trattament sammam il-materjal, u l-bidla ġiet irreġistrata fir-rapport.
formal.en: The treatment hardened the material, and the change was recorded in the report.
formal.zh: 该处理使材料变硬，报告中记录了这一变化。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Dan il-prodott sammam it-taħlita? Mark: Iva, issa hi ħafna iżjed iebsa.
colloquial.en: Rita: Did this product harden the mixture? Mark: Yes, it's much harder now.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这个产品使混合物变硬了吗？马克：是的，现在硬多了。

messages.speaker: Rita (学徒)
messages.zh: 这个产品使混合物变硬了吗？
messages.en: Did this product harden the mixture?

messages.speaker: Mark (师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa hi ħafna iżjed iebsa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa hi ħafna iżjed iebsa.
messages.zh: 是的，现在硬多了。
messages.en: Yes, it's much harder now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“软材料经过处理变硬”的前后对照记 sammam：动词表示使变硬，名词表示起这种作用的东西。

gloss_zh: 有硬化作用的；能使变硬的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the effect of making something hard or harder.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有使某物变硬或增加其硬度的作用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-effett li jagħmel xi ħaġa iebsa jew iżjed iebsa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有硬化作用的；能使某物变硬的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu effett li jżid l-ebusija ta' xi ħaġa.

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina l-effett sammami tat-trattament fuq il-materjal.
formal.en: The study examines the hardening effect of the treatment on the material.
formal.zh: 该研究考察这种处理对材料产生的硬化作用。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex nużaw dan it-trattament? Toni: Għax għandu effett sammami u jagħmel il-materjal iżjed iebes.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why do we use this treatment? Toni: Because it has a hardening effect and makes the material harder.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们为什么使用这种处理？托尼：因为它有硬化作用，能让材料变得更硬。

messages.speaker: Nina (实习生)
messages.zh: 我们为什么使用这种处理？
messages.en: Why do we use this treatment?

messages.speaker: Toni (技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għandu effett sammami u jagħmel il-materjal iżjed iebes.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għandu effett sammami u jagħmel il-materjal iżjed iebes.
messages.zh: 因为它有硬化作用，能让材料变得更硬。
messages.en: Because it has a hardening effect and makes the material harder.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sammami 贴在“能让东西变硬”的处理方法旁，重点记住它描述的是硬化作用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Connected with nails, nailing, or hammering.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与钉子、钉钉子或锤击操作有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-imsiemer, mat-tismir jew mad-daqqiet tal-martell.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与钉子或锤击有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-imsiemer jew mad-daqqiet tal-martell.

collocations.zh: 涉及钉子或锤击的工作
钉钉子或锤击用的设备

formal.mt: Il-kors jinkludi taħriġ fix-xogħol sammari, bl-użu ta' msiemer u martell.
formal.en: The course includes training in work involving nails and hammering, using nails and a hammer.
formal.zh: 课程包含钉钉子与锤击作业的训练，使用钉子和锤子进行练习。

colloquial.mt: Luca: X'għandi nġib għax-xogħol sammari? Sara: Ġib il-martell u l-kaxxa tal-imsiemer.
colloquial.en: Luca: What should I bring for the nailing work? Sara: Bring the hammer and the box of nails.
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：做钉钉子的活儿要带什么？萨拉：带上锤子和那盒钉子。

messages.speaker: Luca (学徒)
messages.zh: 做钉钉子的活儿要带什么？
messages.en: What should I bring for the nailing work?

messages.speaker: Sara (木工师傅)
messages.zh: 带上锤子和那盒钉子。
messages.en: Bring the hammer and the box of nails.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sammari 与“锤子敲钉子”的工作台画面配对，记住它表示与这类工具或操作有关。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Scalding in temperature, or perplexing and difficult to understand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容温度高得烫人的，或形容使人困惑、难以理解的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jaħraq ħafna, jew li jħawwad il-moħħ u jkun diffiċli biex tifhmu.

sense_translations.en_definition: scalding. perplexing. this adjective coined by erin serracino inglott presupposes unused *sammat (form ii)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 滚烫的；令人困惑的。该形容词由 Erin Serracino Inglott 创造，其构词预设了未使用的第二式形式 *sammat。

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi s-suġġett bħala sammati, għax iqajjem mistoqsijiet diffiċli mingħajr tweġibiet ċari.
formal.en: The author describes the topic as perplexing because it raises difficult questions without clear answers.
formal.zh: 作者将这个话题形容为令人困惑，因为它提出了难以回答的问题，却没有明确的答案。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Nista' naqbad dan it-tazza? David: Stenna ftit; il-likwidu fiha għadu sammati.
colloquial.en: Elena: Can I pick up this cup? David: Wait a moment; the liquid in it is still scalding.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：我可以拿起这个杯子吗？戴维：等一下；里面的液体还滚烫呢。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 我可以拿起这个杯子吗？
messages.en: Can I pick up this cup?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Stenna ftit; il-likwidu fiha għadu sammati.
messages.mt_standard: Stenna ftit; il-likwidu fiha għadu sammati.
messages.zh: 等一下；里面的液体还滚烫呢。
messages.en: Wait a moment; the liquid in it is still scalding.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 sammati 画两张记忆卡：一张是滚烫液体，一张是令人挠头的问题，分别记住两个含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Very hard and difficult to dent, cut, or break.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 非常坚硬的，难以压出凹痕、切开或打碎的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iebes ħafna u diffiċli biex tagħmel fih daqqa, taqtgħu jew tkissru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非常硬的；十分坚硬的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iebes ħafna.

formal.mt: Il-materjal huwa sammi, u għalhekk jeħtieġ għodda xierqa biex jinqata'.
formal.en: The material is very hard and therefore requires suitable tools to cut it.
formal.zh: 这种材料非常坚硬，因此需要使用合适的工具进行切割。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex qed iddum biex taqta' dan il-ġebel? Ben: Għax hu sammi; se nipprova b'għodda oħra.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why is it taking you so long to cut this stone? Ben: Because it's very hard; I'll try another tool.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你切这块石头怎么花了这么久？本：因为它非常硬；我换个工具试试。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed iddum biex taqta' dan il-ġebel?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed iddum biex taqta' dan il-ġebel?
messages.zh: 你切这块石头怎么花了这么久？
messages.en: Why is it taking you so long to cut this stone?

messages.speaker: Ben (石匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu sammi; se nipprova b'għodda oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu sammi; se nipprova b'għodda oħra.
messages.zh: 因为它非常硬；我换个工具试试。
messages.en: Because it's very hard; I'll try another tool.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“工具也难以切开的硬石头”记 sammi，重点记它描述物体已经非常坚硬的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A surname used as a person's family name.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 姓氏 Sammut，用作个人姓名中的家族姓。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom li jintuża bħala l-isem tal-familja ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个姓氏：Sammut，可音译为“萨穆特”。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kunjom.

formal.mt: Is-Sur Sammut ippreżenta r-rapport waqt il-laqgħa tal-kumitat.
formal.en: Mr Sammut presented the report during the committee meeting.
formal.zh: 萨穆特先生在委员会会议上提交了报告。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif jinkiteb il-kunjom tiegħek? Daniel: Sammut: S, A, M, M, U, T.
colloquial.en: Anna: How do you spell your surname? Daniel: Sammut: S, A, M, M, U, T.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你的姓怎么拼写？丹尼尔：Sammut：S、A、M、M、U、T。

messages.speaker: Anna (接待员)
messages.zh: 你的姓怎么拼写？
messages.en: How do you spell your surname?

messages.speaker: Daniel (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Sammut: S, A, M, M, U, T.
messages.mt_standard: Sammut: S, A, M, M, U, T.
messages.zh: Sammut：S、A、M、M、U、T。
messages.en: Sammut: S, A, M, M, U, T.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Sammut 写在姓名卡的“姓氏”一栏，记住首字母大写，拼写中间有两个 m。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having brown or dark hair, said of a woman or girl.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容女性长着棕色或深色头发的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandha xagħar kannella jew skur, meta tirreferi għal mara jew tfajla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: （女子）棕发的，深色头发的。

sense_translations.en_definition: (toponymy) tas-samra, a name of an area on the south side of ħamrun in the outskirts of marsa
sense_translations.zh_definition: （地名）Tas-Samra，指位于 Ħamrun 南侧、Marsa 外围的一片地区。

formal.mt: Il-gwida samra laqgħet lill-grupp qabel iż-żjara f'Tas-Samra.
formal.en: The dark-haired female guide welcomed the group before the visit to Tas-Samra.
formal.zh: 参观 Tas-Samra 之前，那位深色头发的女导游接待了团队。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema waħda hi l-gwida tagħna? Rita: Il-mara samra ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which woman is our guide? Rita: The dark-haired woman by the door.
colloquial.zh: Maja：哪位是我们的导游？Rita：门旁那位深色头发的女士。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 哪位是我们的导游？
messages.en: Which woman is our guide?

messages.speaker: Rita (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 门旁那位深色头发的女士。
messages.en: The dark-haired woman by the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 samra 与“深色头发的女导游”画面一起记；遇到 Tas-Samra 时，另开一个地名记忆格。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To delay doing something instead of starting or completing it promptly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把本来要做的事情往后推，迟迟不开始或不完成。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħalla xi ħaġa għal aktar tard minflok beda jew temm ix-xogħol fil-ħin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拖延做某事；把某事留到以后再做。

formal.mt: L-impjegat samsam il-kitba tar-rapport u ma lestiehx fil-ħin.
formal.en: The employee put off writing the report and did not finish it on time.
formal.zh: 那名员工拖延撰写报告，未能按时完成。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex għadek ma bdejtx ix-xogħol? Mark: Samsamt ftit, imma issa se nibda.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why haven't you started the work yet? Mark: I put it off for a while, but I'm going to start now.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你怎么还没开始干活？Mark：我拖了一会儿，不过现在就开始。

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.zh: 你怎么还没开始干活？
messages.en: Why haven't you started the work yet?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Samsamt ftit, imma issa se nibda.
messages.mt_standard: Samsamt ftit, imma issa se nibda.
messages.zh: 我拖了一会儿，不过现在就开始。
messages.en: I put it off for a while, but I'm going to start now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象待办清单被一次次推到明天：samsam 记“拖着不做”这个动作，再用“现在开始”作对照。

gloss_zh: 泄露秘密；居间撮合；经纪人；中间人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To reveal a secret, or to act between parties as an intermediary.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把秘密透露出去；也指在双方之间传话、联系或撮合。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kixef sigriet, jew daħal bejn żewġ naħat biex jgħinhom jikkomunikaw jew jilħqu ftehim.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 泄露秘密；把原本保密的事情说出去。
充当中间人，在双方之间联系、传话或撮合。
经纪人；居间促成交易的人。
中间人；在双方之间传递信息或协调联系的人。

collocations.en: acted as a go-between for the two sides

formal.mt: Ir-rappreżentant samsar bejn iż-żewġ naħat biex jgħinhom jilħqu ftehim.
formal.en: The representative acted as a go-between for the two sides to help them reach an agreement.
formal.zh: 该代表在双方之间居间协调，帮助他们达成协议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex kulħadd jaf bis-sorpriża? Pawlu: Xi ħadd samsar is-sigriet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does everyone know about the surprise? Pawlu: Someone gave away the secret.
colloquial.zh: Maja：怎么大家都知道这个惊喜了？Pawlu：有人把秘密说出去了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 怎么大家都知道这个惊喜了？
messages.en: Why does everyone know about the surprise?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 有人把秘密说出去了。
messages.en: Someone gave away the secret.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画分别记动词：一幅是秘密传出去，一幅是双方有人牵线；作名词时，则记承担牵线工作的人。

gloss_zh: 爱充当经纪人的；倾向于居间撮合的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to act as a broker, bringing people together to arrange transactions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人常愿意充当经纪人，替交易双方牵线撮合。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza jaġixxi bħala samsar u jlaqqa' nies biex isiru tranżazzjonijiet.

sense_translations.en_definition: tending to act as a broker
sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于充当经纪人的；常爱替买卖双方牵线的。

collocations.en: a person inclined to act as a broker
an agent inclined to act as a broker
collocations.zh: 一位倾向于撮合交易的代理人

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi lil Mark bħala bniedem samsari, għax spiss ilaqqa' l-bejjiegħa max-xerrejja.
formal.en: The report describes Mark as someone inclined to act as a broker, because he often brings sellers and buyers together.
formal.zh: 报告把 Mark 描述为一个爱居间撮合的人，因为他经常替买卖双方牵线。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Pawlu jista' jgħinni nsib xerrej għar-rota? Rita: Iva, hu bniedem samsari u jaf ħafna nies.
colloquial.en: Lina: Can Pawlu help me find a buyer for the bicycle? Rita: Yes, he's the sort who likes brokering deals, and he knows a lot of people.
colloquial.zh: Lina：Pawlu 能帮我找个买自行车的人吗？Rita：能，他喜欢替人撮合买卖，而且认识很多人。

messages.speaker: Lina (自行车卖家)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu jista' jgħinni nsib xerrej għar-rota?
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu jista' jgħinni nsib xerrej għar-rota?
messages.zh: Pawlu 能帮我找个买自行车的人吗？
messages.en: Can Pawlu help me find a buyer for the bicycle?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hu bniedem samsari u jaf ħafna nies.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hu bniedem samsari u jaf ħafna nies.
messages.zh: 能，他喜欢替人撮合买卖，而且认识很多人。
messages.en: Yes, he's the sort who likes brokering deals, and he knows a lot of people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 samsari 放进“他这个人爱牵线”的评价句里记，重点是描述人的倾向，而不是给一个职业名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or habit of delaying something that needs to be done.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把需要做的事情不断往后推的行为或习惯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil jew id-drawwa li tħalli għal aktar tard xi ħaġa li għandha ssir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拖延；把应做的事情一再推后的行为或习惯。

formal.mt: Is-samsim fit-tħejjija tar-rapport wassal għal dewmien fil-pubblikazzjoni tiegħu.
formal.en: Procrastination in preparing the report delayed its publication.
formal.zh: 准备报告时的拖延导致报告推迟发布。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għadek qed tħalli kollox għal għada? Mark: Iva, imma biżżejjed samsim; illum nibda.
colloquial.en: Rita: Are you still leaving everything until tomorrow? Mark: Yes, but enough procrastination; I'll start today.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你还在把所有事情都留到明天吗？Mark：是啊，不过不能再拖了；我今天就开始。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadek qed tħalli kollox għal għada?
messages.mt_standard: Għadek qed tħalli kollox għal għada?
messages.zh: 你还在把所有事情都留到明天吗？
messages.en: Are you still leaving everything until tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma biżżejjed samsim; illum nibda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma biżżejjed samsim; illum nibda.
messages.zh: 是啊，不过不能再拖了；我今天就开始。
messages.en: Yes, but enough procrastination; I'll start today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 samsim 当作贴在“明天再做”习惯上的名词标签；配合 biżżejjed samsim“拖延够了”一起记。

gloss_zh: 经纪业务；居间撮合交易

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity or business of arranging transactions between other parties as a broker.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以经纪人身份替交易双方联系并撮合买卖的活动或业务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività jew in-negozju ta' samsar li jlaqqa' żewġ naħat biex issir tranżazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经纪业务；作为中间人促成交易的活动或服务。

collocations.zh: 房地产销售中的经纪业务

formal.mt: Il-ftehim jiddeskrivi s-servizzi ta' samsir li jgħaqqdu lill-bejjiegħ ma' xerrej interessat.
formal.en: The agreement describes the brokerage services that connect the seller with an interested buyer.
formal.zh: 协议说明了把卖家与有意购买者联系起来的经纪服务。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sibt xerrej għall-karozza? Mark: Użajt servizz ta' samsir; xi ħadd laqqagħni max-xerrej.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did you find a buyer for the car? Mark: I used a brokerage service; someone put me in touch with the buyer.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你怎么找到买车的人的？Mark：我用了经纪服务，有人帮我联系了买家。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么找到买车的人的？
messages.en: How did you find a buyer for the car?

messages.speaker: Mark (汽车卖家)
messages.mt_spoken: Użajt servizz ta' samsir; xi ħadd laqqagħni max-xerrej.
messages.mt_standard: Użajt servizz ta' samsir; xi ħadd laqqagħni max-xerrej.
messages.zh: 我用了经纪服务，有人帮我联系了买家。
messages.en: I used a brokerage service; someone put me in touch with the buyer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象卖家和买家之间有一项牵线服务，把这项业务标为 samsir；用“经纪服务”这个整体画面记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A scald from something hot, especially hot liquid; also, a sudden feeling of astonishment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被热物、尤其是热液体烫到或造成的烫伤；也指突然感到十分惊讶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħruq minn xi ħaġa taħraq, speċjalment likwidu jaħraq; ukoll, stagħġib qawwi u f'daqqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 烫伤；被热液体等烫到。
惊愕；出乎意料时产生的强烈惊讶。

collocations.en: was taken aback by the news

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, il-ħaddiem iddeskriva s-samta li ħa meta nxtered l-ilma jaħraq.
formal.en: In the report, the worker described the scald he received when the hot water spilled.
formal.zh: 在报告中，那名工人描述了热水洒出时自己受到的烫伤。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt li Ana rebħet il-premju? Rita: Iva, ħadt samta! Ma kontx qed nistenna dan.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you hear that Ana won the prize? Rita: Yes, I was astonished! I wasn't expecting that.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你听说 Ana 获奖了吗？Rita：听说了，我惊呆了！我完全没想到。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听说 Ana 获奖了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that Ana won the prize?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħadt samta! Ma kontx qed nistenna dan.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħadt samta! Ma kontx qed nistenna dan.
messages.zh: 听说了，我惊呆了！我完全没想到。
messages.en: Yes, I was astonished! I wasn't expecting that.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个独立画面记 samta：热水洒出时的烫伤，以及听到意外消息时的惊愕；这是记忆联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Wheat considered as a crop growing in a field or grown for harvest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为农作物种植、在田间生长或等待收割的小麦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-wiċċ tar-raba' tal-qamħ li jikber fl-għelieqi u jinħasad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小麦作物，尤指田间种植或供收割的小麦。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-wiċċ tar-raba' tal-qamħ.

collocations.en: the harvesting of the wheat crop

formal.mt: Il-bidwi spezzjona s-samħ qabel ma beda l-ħsad.
formal.en: The farmer inspected the wheat crop before starting the harvest.
formal.zh: 农民在开始收割前检查了田里的小麦。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Is-samħ lest għall-ħsad? Ġużeppi: Għadu mhux lest; irridu nistennew ftit ieħor.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is the wheat crop ready for harvesting? Ġużeppi: It's not ready yet; we need to wait a little longer.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：田里的小麦可以收割了吗？朱塞佩：还不行；我们还得再等一等。

messages.speaker: Lara (农场学徒)
messages.zh: 田里的小麦可以收割了吗？
messages.en: Is the wheat crop ready for harvesting?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu mhux lest; irridu nistennew ftit ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu mhux lest; irridu nistennew ftit ieħor.
messages.zh: 还不行；我们还得再等一等。
messages.en: It's not ready yet; we need to wait a little longer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 samħ 就想象整片等待收割的麦田，用“田里的小麦作物”这一画面帮助记忆。

gloss_zh: 做标记以区分；分拣择优；圣（圣人称号）

teaching_sense.en_definition: To mark something so that it can be distinguished, or to separate items and select the best ones.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给事物做标记以便辨认区分；也指把东西分拣开来并挑选其中最好的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel sinjal fuq xi ħaġa biex tingħaraf minn oħrajn, jew fired l-affarijiet u għażel l-aħjar minnhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给某物做标记，使它能与其他东西区分开来。
把东西分拣开来，并挑选其中最好的。

sense_translations.en_definition: appellation used of a saint (short form of 'santu'. E.g. San Ġlormu -- Saint Jerome)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于圣人名字前的称号“圣”，是 santu 的缩略形式，例如 San Ġlormu，意为圣热罗尼莫。

collocations.en: marked the boxes with different signs to distinguish them
collocations.zh: 给箱子做不同标记以便区分

collocations.en: sorted the apples and selected the best
collocations.zh: 分拣苹果并挑出最好的

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem san il-kaxxi b'sinjali differenti biex jagħrafhom minn xulxin.
formal.en: The worker marked the boxes with different signs so that he could distinguish them from one another.
formal.zh: 那名工人给箱子做了不同标记，以便将它们彼此区分。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Min għażel dan it-tuffieħ? Mark: Il-bidwi san it-tuffieħ u poġġa l-aħjar fil-qoffa.
colloquial.en: Lina: Who selected these apples? Mark: The farmer sorted the apples and put the best ones in the basket.
colloquial.zh: Lina：这些苹果是谁挑的？Mark：农夫分拣了苹果，把最好的放进了篮子。

messages.speaker: Lina (顾客)
messages.zh: 这些苹果是谁挑的？
messages.en: Who selected these apples?

messages.speaker: Mark (水果摊主)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-bidwi san it-tuffieħ u poġġa l-aħjar fil-qoffa.
messages.mt_standard: Il-bidwi san it-tuffieħ u poġġa l-aħjar fil-qoffa.
messages.zh: 农夫分拣了苹果，把最好的放进了篮子。
messages.en: The farmer sorted the apples and put the best ones in the basket.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分三格记忆 san：箱子上做标记、苹果中挑精品、圣人名前加 San；最后一格单独记作称号，保持词性区别。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A village and local council in Malta's Northern Region, known in English as St. Paul's Bay.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马耳他北部地区的一个村镇及地方议会辖区，英语称 St. Paul's Bay。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Raħal u kunsill lokali fir-Reġjun tat-Tramuntana ta' Malta.

sense_translations.en_definition: St. Paul's Bay (a village and local council of the Northern Region, Malta)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 圣保罗湾，马耳他北部地区的一个村镇及地方议会辖区。

collocations.mt: il-Kunsill Lokali ta' San Pawl il-Baħar

collocations.en: a visit to St. Paul's Bay

formal.mt: San Pawl il-Baħar jinsab fir-Reġjun tat-Tramuntana ta' Malta.
formal.en: St. Paul's Bay is in Malta's Northern Region.
formal.zh: 圣保罗湾位于马耳他北部地区。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn sejjer illum? Mark: Se mmur San Pawl il-Baħar. Tiġi miegħi?
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are you going today? Mark: I'm going to St. Paul's Bay. Are you coming with me?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你今天去哪儿？马克：我去圣保罗湾。你和我一起去吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天去哪儿？
messages.en: Where are you going today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se mmur San Pawl il-Baħar. Tiġi miegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Se mmur San Pawl il-Baħar. Tiġi miegħi?
messages.zh: 我去圣保罗湾。你和我一起去吗？
messages.en: I'm going to St. Paul's Bay. Are you coming with me?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个名称当作地图标签记忆：San Pawl 对应“圣保罗”，再把 il-Baħar 与海边画面联系起来，整体记为“圣保罗湾”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An open shoe that leaves part of the foot uncovered.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鞋面较开放、让脚部部分露在外面的凉鞋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żarbuna miftuħa li tħalli parti mis-sieq mikxufa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 凉鞋，一种鞋面较开放的鞋。

formal.mt: Il-klijenta talbet sandla tal-ġilda li tkun komda għall-mixi.
formal.en: The customer requested a leather sandal that would be comfortable for walking.
formal.zh: 这位女顾客想要一款适合步行、穿着舒适的皮凉鞋。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hi s-sandla l-oħra tiegħi? Mark: Hawn, taħt is-siġġu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is my other sandal? Mark: Here, under the chair.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我的另一只凉鞋在哪里？马克：在这儿，椅子下面。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我的另一只凉鞋在哪里？
messages.en: Where is my other sandal?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 在这儿，椅子下面。
messages.en: Here, under the chair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sandla 和英语 sandal 对照记忆，再想象椅子下面的一只凉鞋，记住它指单只鞋。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To do something badly and leave it in a confused or unsatisfactory state.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某件事做坏、弄乱或搞得不成样子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa ħażin u jħalliha mħawda jew f'qagħda mhux sodisfaċenti.

sense_translations.en_definition: to make a mess of sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某事弄得一团糟；把事情搞砸。
小商人；经营小本生意的人。

collocations.en: he made a mess of the work
he made a mess of the plan

formal.mt: L-assistent sangat ix-xogħol billi ħallat id-dokumenti taż-żewġ klijenti.
formal.en: The assistant made a mess of the work by mixing up the two clients' documents.
formal.zh: 助理把两位客户的文件混在一起，把工作弄得一团糟。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif mar ix-xogħol ta' Pawlu? Mark: Sangat kollox; issa rridu nibdew mill-ġdid.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did Pawlu's work go? Mark: He made a mess of everything; now we have to start again.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗的工作做得怎么样？马克：他全搞砸了；现在我们得重新开始。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 保罗的工作做得怎么样？
messages.en: How did Pawlu's work go?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Sangat kollox; issa rridu nibdew mill-ġdid.
messages.mt_standard: Sangat kollox; issa rridu nibdew mill-ġdid.
messages.zh: 他全搞砸了；现在我们得重新开始。
messages.en: He made a mess of everything; now we have to start again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张词义卡分开记：动词卡画被搞乱的文件，名词卡画经营小生意的人，避免混淆词性。

gloss_zh: 海七鳃鳗；水蛭；吸血鬼般榨取他人的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sea lamprey or a leech; figuratively, a person who tries to take as much as possible from others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指海七鳃鳗或水蛭；比喻义指尽可能从别人身上榨取好处的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal bħall-Petromyzon marinus jew il-ħanex li jerdgħu d-demm; b'mod figurattiv, persuna li tipprova tieħu kemm tista' mingħand ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海七鳃鳗，学名 Petromyzon marinus。
水蛭；蚂蟥。

sense_translations.en_definition: bloodsucker (one who attempts to take as much from others as possible)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 吸血鬼般的人；竭力从别人身上榨取钱财或其他好处的人。

collocations.zh: 像吸血鬼一样榨取别人

formal.mt: F'dan il-katalgu, l-isem sangisug jirreferi għall-ispeċi Petromyzon marinus.
formal.en: In this catalogue, the name sangisug refers to the species Petromyzon marinus.
formal.zh: 在这份目录中，sangisug 这一名称指海七鳃鳗这个物种。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex sejjaħtlu sangisug? Toni: Għax dejjem jitlob il-flus mingħandi u qatt ma jagħtini xejn lura.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why did you call him a bloodsucker? Toni: Because he always asks me for money and never gives me anything back.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你为什么叫他吸血鬼？托尼：因为他总向我要钱，却从来不给我任何回报。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么叫他吸血鬼？
messages.en: Why did you call him a bloodsucker?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dejjem jitlob il-flus mingħandi u qatt ma jagħtini xejn lura.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dejjem jitlob il-flus mingħandi u qatt ma jagħtini xejn lura.
messages.zh: 因为他总向我要钱，却从来不给我任何回报。
messages.en: Because he always asks me for money and never gives me anything back.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把三个义项画成三格：海七鳃鳗、水蛭、不断索取的人；第三格是比喻用法，语气带批评。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Business dealings conducted on a small scale.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 规模较小的经营活动或买卖往来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Attività ta' negozju jew xiri u bejgħ fuq skala żgħira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小规模的商业往来；小本买卖。

collocations.en: to do a little small-scale trading
to earn some money through small-scale trading

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif xi residenti jaqilgħu dħul addizzjonali bis-sangit.
formal.en: The report describes how some residents earn additional income through small-scale trading.
formal.zh: 报告介绍了一些居民如何通过小本买卖获得额外收入。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'jagħmel ħuk fi tmiem il-ġimgħa? Lara: Jagħmel ftit sangit biex jaqla' xi flus żejda.
colloquial.en: Mark: What does your brother do at weekends? Lara: He does a little small-scale trading to earn some extra money.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你哥哥周末做什么？拉拉：他做点小本买卖，赚些外快。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥周末做什么？
messages.en: What does your brother do at weekends?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jagħmel ftit sangit biex jaqla' xi flus żejda.
messages.mt_standard: Jagħmel ftit sangit biex jaqla' xi flus żejda.
messages.zh: 他做点小本买卖，赚些外快。
messages.en: He does a little small-scale trading to earn some extra money.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象周末摆一个小摊，做几笔小买卖；sangit 记的是经营活动，不是经营者本人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act of making a blade or cutting edge sharp.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把刀刃或其他切削刃磨锋利的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tagħmel xafra jew tarf li jaqta' aktar jaqta'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 磨利的动作；一次磨刀或磨刃。

collocations.en: to give the knife a sharpening

formal.mt: Qabel l-użu, is-sikkina għandha bżonn sanna biex taqta' aħjar.
formal.en: Before use, the knife needs sharpening so that it cuts better.
formal.zh: 使用前，这把刀需要磨一磨，以便切得更顺利。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Din is-sikkina ma taqtax sew. Pawlu: Għandha bżonn sanna; nagħtiha waħda issa.
colloquial.en: Anna: This knife doesn't cut well. Pawlu: It needs sharpening; I'll sharpen it now.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这把刀不太锋利。保罗：需要磨一磨；我现在就磨。

messages.speaker: Anna (家人)
messages.zh: 这把刀不太锋利。
messages.en: This knife doesn't cut well.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandha bżonn sanna; nagħtiha waħda issa.
messages.mt_standard: Għandha bżonn sanna; nagħtiha waħda issa.
messages.zh: 需要磨一磨；我现在就磨。
messages.en: It needs sharpening; I'll sharpen it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sanna 放进“给刀磨一下”的画面，重点记住它是名词，表示磨利这一动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sharpen a blade or cutting edge repeatedly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 多次或反复磨利刀刃等切削部位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xafra jew tarf li jaqta' aktar jaqta' billi jaħdem fuqu darba wara l-oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反复磨利；一遍又一遍地磨刀或磨刃。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem sannan ix-xafra diversi drabi sakemm bdiet taqta' sew.
formal.en: The worker sharpened the blade repeatedly until it began to cut well.
formal.zh: 工人反复磨刀刃，直到它变得锋利好用。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex dam daqshekk bis-sikkina? Toni: Sannan ix-xafra diversi drabi għax ma kinitx taqta' sew.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why did he spend so long on the knife? Toni: He sharpened the blade repeatedly because it wasn't cutting well.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：他为什么花那么久弄那把刀？托尼：因为刀不太锋利，他把刀刃反复磨了好几遍。

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.zh: 他为什么花那么久弄那把刀？
messages.en: Why did he spend so long on the knife?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Sannan ix-xafra diversi drabi għax ma kinitx taqta' sew.
messages.mt_standard: Sannan ix-xafra diversi drabi għax ma kinitx taqta' sew.
messages.zh: 因为刀不太锋利，他把刀刃反复磨了好几遍。
messages.en: He sharpened the blade repeatedly because it wasn't cutting well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象刀刃在磨石上来回多次，把 sannan 连同“反复”一起记；再与名词 sanna 对照。

gloss_zh: 安顿下来；给鱼钩装饵；把鱼钩接到钓线上

teaching_sense.en_definition: To settle down and become established in a place or a stable way of life.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 安顿下来，在某处定居或开始稳定的生活。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joqgħod f'post u jibda jgħix ħajja aktar stabbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 安顿下来；定居并过上稳定的生活。

sense_translations.en_definition: to put bait on a hook for fishing
sense_translations.zh_definition: 给钓鱼用的鱼钩装上鱼饵。

sense_translations.en_definition: to attach a hook to a fishing line
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把鱼钩接到钓鱼线上的动作。

collocations.en: he settled down in a quiet village
collocations.zh: 他在一个安静的村庄安顿下来

collocations.en: he settled down with his family

formal.mt: Wara snin ta' vjaġġar, ir-raġel sannar f'raħal kwiet mal-familja tiegħu.
formal.en: After years of travelling, the man settled down in a quiet village with his family.
formal.zh: 经过多年的旅行，这名男子与家人在一个安静的村庄安顿下来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħuk għadu jivvjaġġa ħafna? Mark: Le, issa sannar f'Għawdex mal-familja tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does your brother still travel a lot? Mark: No, he's now settled down in Gozo with his family.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你哥哥还经常到处旅行吗？马克：不了，他现在已经和家人在戈佐岛安顿下来了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥还经常到处旅行吗？
messages.en: Does your brother still travel a lot?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, issa sannar f'Għawdex mal-familja tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, issa sannar f'Għawdex mal-familja tiegħu.
messages.zh: 不了，他现在已经和家人在戈佐岛安顿下来了。
messages.en: No, he's now settled down in Gozo with his family.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个独立画面记义项：一家人安家、鱼钩装饵、鱼钩接线；这些只是记忆提示，不表示词源关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who sharpens knives.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为刀具磨刃、使其恢复锋利的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħti sanna lis-skieken biex jerġgħu jaqtgħu sew.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 磨刀师；给刀具磨刃的人。

formal.mt: Il-kok ħa s-skieken għand sannien tas-sengħa biex jerġgħu jaqtgħu sew.
formal.en: The cook took the knives to a skilled knife sharpener so that they would cut well again.
formal.zh: 厨师把刀具送到一位手艺熟练的磨刀师那里，让刀具恢复锋利。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Din is-sikkina għadha ma taqtax sew. Pawlu: Ħudha għand is-sannien; jaf jirranġaha.
colloquial.en: Anna: This knife still doesn't cut well. Pawlu: Take it to the knife sharpener; he knows how to fix it.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这把刀还是不太锋利。保罗：拿去给磨刀师吧；他知道怎么处理。

messages.speaker: Anna (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Din is-sikkina għadha ma taqtax sew.
messages.mt_standard: Din is-sikkina għadha ma taqtax sew.
messages.zh: 这把刀还是不太锋利。
messages.en: This knife still doesn't cut well.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.zh: 拿去给磨刀师吧；他知道怎么处理。
messages.en: Take it to the knife sharpener; he knows how to fix it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sannien 想成磨刀摊前的师傅：sanna 是磨一下的动作，sannan 是反复磨，sannien 是做这件事的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of applying soap to something, or of producing foam.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给物体涂抹肥皂的过程，或产生泡沫的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa tinkesa bis-sapun, jew li bih tifforma r-ragħwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涂抹肥皂；给物体打上肥皂的过程。
起泡；产生泡沫的过程。

formal.mt: Wara s-sapnatura tal-idejn, laħlaħhom sew bl-ilma.
formal.en: After soaping your hands, rinse them thoroughly with water.
formal.zh: 给双手打上肥皂后，用水充分冲洗。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex hemm daqshekk ragħwa? Pawlu: Użajt wisq sapun; is-sapnatura kienet qawwija.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is there so much foam? Pawlu: I used too much soap; there was a lot of foaming.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：怎么有这么多泡沫？保罗：我用了太多肥皂，起了很多泡。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 怎么有这么多泡沫？
messages.en: Why is there so much foam?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Użajt wisq sapun; is-sapnatura kienet qawwija.
messages.mt_standard: Użajt wisq sapun; is-sapnatura kienet qawwija.
messages.zh: 我用了太多肥皂，起了很多泡。
messages.en: I used too much soap; there was a lot of foaming.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用连续动作记忆：先给双手涂肥皂，再搓出泡沫；sapnatura 可以指这幅画面中的“涂皂”或“起泡”过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A substance used with water to wash the body or clean things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与水一起使用、用于洗身体或清洁物品的肥皂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sustanza li tintuża mal-ilma biex jinħasel il-ġisem jew jitnaddfu l-oġġetti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肥皂，用于洗涤和清洁的用品。

formal.mt: Aħsel idejk bis-sapun u bl-ilma qabel tiekol.
formal.en: Wash your hands with soap and water before eating.
formal.zh: 吃东西前，用肥皂和水洗手。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn hu s-sapun? Adam: Ħdejn il-vit. Hemm biċċa ġdida.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where's the soap? Adam: Next to the tap. There's a new bar.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：肥皂在哪里？亚当：在水龙头旁边。有一块新的。

messages.speaker: Nina (家人)
messages.zh: 肥皂在哪里？
messages.en: Where's the soap?

messages.speaker: Adam (家人)
messages.zh: 在水龙头旁边。有一块新的。
messages.en: Next to the tap. There's a new bar.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sapun 写在想象中的肥皂包装上，再连读 biċċa sapun“一块肥皂”，用具体物品和常用搭配一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Soap or a liquid cleaning product, including liquid soap and washing-up liquid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 肥皂或液体清洁用品，可指液体皂，也可指洗餐具用的洗洁精。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sapun jew prodott likwidu għat-tindif, li jista' jintuża għall-ħasil tal-idejn jew tal-platti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肥皂。
液体皂，以液态形式使用的肥皂。
洗洁精，用于清洗餐具的液体清洁剂。

formal.mt: Poġġi ftit sapuna tal-platti fuq l-isponża u aħsel it-tazzi.
formal.en: Put a little washing-up liquid on the sponge and wash the cups.
formal.zh: 在海绵上挤少许洗洁精，然后清洗杯子。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għad fadal sapuna tal-platti? Ben: Iva, il-flixkun qiegħed taħt is-sink.
colloquial.en: Rita: Is there any washing-up liquid left? Ben: Yes, the bottle is under the sink.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：还有洗洁精吗？本：有，瓶子在水槽下面。

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.zh: 还有洗洁精吗？
messages.en: Is there any washing-up liquid left?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.zh: 有，瓶子在水槽下面。
messages.en: Yes, the bottle is under the sink.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象清洁用品架上的三个标签：肥皂、液体皂、洗洁精。sapuna 的具体意思要结合场景；遇到 tal-platti 就联想到洗餐具。

gloss_zh: 带护盖的怀表；麝香球（植物名）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pocket watch with a protective cover over its face; in botany, the plant called musk-ball in the expression sapunetta tal-misk.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表盘外带有保护盖的怀表；在植物用语 sapunetta tal-misk 中，指称作 musk-ball 的植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arloġġ tal-but b'għatu li jipproteġi l-wiċċ; fil-botanika, sapunetta tal-misk hija l-pjanta msejħa musk-ball bl-Ingliż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 猎式怀表，表盘外带有可开合保护盖的怀表。
（植物学）sapunetta tal-misk，英语称 Musk-ball 的植物，可按字面记作“麝香球”。

collocations.en: the cover of the hunting watch

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jiddeskrivi sapunetta antika b'għatu li jipproteġi l-wiċċ tal-arloġġ.
formal.en: The catalogue describes an antique hunting watch with a cover that protects the watch face.
formal.zh: 目录介绍了一只古董猎式怀表，其表盖用于保护表盘。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi din is-sapunetta tal-misk fil-ktieb? Toni: Hija pjanta; hawnhekk sapunetta mhix arloġġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's this sapunetta tal-misk in the book? Toni: It's a plant; here sapunetta doesn't mean a watch.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：书里的 sapunetta tal-misk 是什么？托尼：是一种植物；这里的 sapunetta 不是指怀表。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 书里的 sapunetta tal-misk 是什么？
messages.en: What's this sapunetta tal-misk in the book?

messages.speaker: Toni (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija pjanta; hawnhekk sapunetta mhix arloġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Hija pjanta; hawnhekk sapunetta mhix arloġġ.
messages.zh: 是一种植物；这里的 sapunetta 不是指怀表。
messages.en: It's a plant; here sapunetta doesn't mean a watch.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作两张独立记忆卡：单词 sapunetta 配可开盖的怀表图；完整短语 sapunetta tal-misk 配植物标签。用语境区分两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small dish or holder in which a bar of soap is kept.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于放置块状肥皂的小碟或托盒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent żgħir li fih titqiegħed biċċa sapun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肥皂碟；用于放肥皂的小托盒。

collocations.en: put the soap in the soap dish

formal.mt: Poġġi s-sapun fis-sapuniera wara kull użu u żommha nadifa.
formal.en: Put the soap in the soap dish after each use and keep the dish clean.
formal.zh: 每次用完后，把肥皂放回肥皂盒，并保持盒子清洁。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn inpoġġi s-sapun? Mark: Fis-sapuniera l-bajda, ħdejn il-vit.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where should I put the soap? Mark: In the white soap dish, next to the tap.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我把肥皂放哪儿？马克：放在水龙头旁边那个白色肥皂盒里。

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.zh: 我把肥皂放哪儿？
messages.en: Where should I put the soap?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.zh: 放在水龙头旁边那个白色肥皂盒里。
messages.en: In the white soap dish, next to the tap.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sapun“肥皂”和 sapuniera“肥皂盒”画成物品与容器的一对，再记整句 s-sapun fis-sapuniera“盒里的肥皂”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a shape that resembles a roof.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形状像屋顶的；呈屋顶状的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu għamla tixbah lil saqaf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 形状像屋顶的；屋顶状的。

formal.mt: Il-mudell għandu għatu saqqafi, kif jidher fid-disinn.
formal.en: The model has a roof-shaped lid, as shown in the drawing.
formal.zh: 如图所示，这个模型有一个屋顶状的盖子。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Liema għatu rrid nuża għal din il-kaxxa? Ben: Dak saqqafi, li jidher qisu saqaf żgħir.
colloquial.en: Sara: Which lid should I use for this box? Ben: The roof-shaped one, which looks like a little roof.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个盒子该用哪个盖子？本：用那个屋顶状的，看起来像一个小屋顶。

messages.speaker: Sara (手工课学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema għatu rrid nuża għal din il-kaxxa?
messages.mt_standard: Liema għatu rrid nuża għal din il-kaxxa?
messages.zh: 这个盒子该用哪个盖子？
messages.en: Which lid should I use for this box?

messages.speaker: Ben (手工课老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak saqqafi, li jidher qisu saqaf żgħir.
messages.mt_standard: Dak saqqafi, li jidher qisu saqaf żgħir.
messages.zh: 用那个屋顶状的，看起来像一个小屋顶。
messages.en: The roof-shaped one, which looks like a little roof.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个盒子，再给它加上小屋顶形的盖子，在盖子旁写 saqqafi；用“像屋顶的形状”这一画面记住形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who waters or irrigates land and plants.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责给土地或植物供水、进行浇灌的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ssaqqi l-art jew il-pjanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从事灌溉或负责浇灌的人。

collocations.en: a person who irrigates the fields

formal.mt: Is-saqqaj beda jsaqqi l-għalqa kmieni filgħodu biex il-pjanti jkollhom biżżejjed ilma.
formal.en: The irrigation worker began watering the field early in the morning so that the plants would have enough water.
formal.zh: 灌溉工清晨便开始浇灌农田，以确保植物得到充足的水。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jsaqqi l-għalqa llum? Pawlu: Is-saqqaj ġej dalgħodu. Maja: Tajjeb, il-pjanti għandhom bżonn l-ilma.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who will water the field today? Pawlu: The irrigation worker is coming this morning. Maja: Good, the plants need water.
colloquial.zh: Maja：今天谁来浇地？Pawlu：灌溉工今天上午来。Maja：好，植物需要水。

messages.speaker: Maja (农场主)
messages.zh: 今天谁来浇地？
messages.en: Who will water the field today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农场工人)
messages.zh: 灌溉工今天上午来。
messages.en: The irrigation worker is coming this morning.

messages.speaker: Maja (农场主)
messages.zh: 好，植物需要水。
messages.en: Good, the plants need water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 saqqaj 和清晨拿水管浇地的工人联系起来，记住它指负责浇灌的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who asks questions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 提出问题的人，也可指经常向别人发问的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel mistoqsijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 提问的人；向别人发问的人。

collocations.en: a person who asks questions nonstop

formal.mt: Is-saqsieq talab spjegazzjoni oħra biex jifhem aħjar is-suġġett.
formal.en: The questioner requested another explanation to understand the subject better.
formal.zh: 提问者要求进一步解释，以便更好地理解这个主题。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hu dak is-saqsieq ħdejn it-tieqa? Mark: Ħija; dejjem irid ikun jaf kif jaħdmu l-affarijiet. Lara: Mela għandu mistoqsija għal kollox!
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is that questioner by the window? Mark: My brother; he always wants to know how things work. Lara: So he has a question about everything!
colloquial.zh: Lara：窗边那个爱提问的人是谁？Mark：我弟弟，他总想知道事物是怎么运作的。Lara：看来他什么都要问一问！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak is-saqsieq ħdejn it-tieqa?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak is-saqsieq ħdejn it-tieqa?
messages.zh: 窗边那个爱提问的人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that questioner by the window?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija; dejjem irid ikun jaf kif jaħdmu l-affarijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija; dejjem irid ikun jaf kif jaħdmu l-affarijiet.
messages.zh: 我弟弟，他总想知道事物是怎么运作的。
messages.en: My brother; he always wants to know how things work.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 看来他什么都要问一问！
messages.en: So he has a question about everything!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象课堂上不断举手的提问者，把 saqsieq 记成一个会问问题的人，注意它是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Eager to ask questions and find things out, sometimes to an excessive degree.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 喜欢提问、探究事情的；在某些语境中也指好奇过度、爱打听的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħobb jistaqsi u jkun jaf aktar, xi drabi aktar milli jkun xieraq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 好问的；有探究欲、喜欢了解事情的。
过分好奇的；爱打听别人事情的。

collocations.zh: 一个过分爱打听的邻居

formal.mt: L-istudent saqsieqi talab aktar tagħrif dwar l-esperiment u r-raġuni għar-riżultati tiegħu.
formal.en: The inquisitive student requested more information about the experiment and the reason for its results.
formal.zh: 这位好问的学生要求进一步了解实验，以及产生这些结果的原因。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex trid tkun taf ma' min kont qed nitkellem? Toni: Kont biss kurjuż. Nina: Illum int saqsieqi wisq!
colloquial.en: Nina: Why do you want to know who I was talking to? Toni: I was just curious. Nina: You're being too nosy today!
colloquial.zh: Nina：你为什么想知道我刚才在和谁说话？Toni：我只是好奇。Nina：你今天也太爱打听了！

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex trid tkun taf ma' min kont qed nitkellem?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex trid tkun taf ma' min kont qed nitkellem?
messages.zh: 你为什么想知道我刚才在和谁说话？
messages.en: Why do you want to know who I was talking to?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 我只是好奇。
messages.en: I was just curious.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天也太爱打听了！
messages.en: You're being too nosy today!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用同一个爱问问题的人练两种语气：求知时是好问，追问隐私时是过分好奇；saqsieqi 描述人的特点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of struggling or wrestling, involving physical effort against resistance or another person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用身体力量对抗阻力的挣扎，也可指两人相互较力的摔跤活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taqbid jew sforz fiżiku kontra reżistenza jew kontra persuna oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 挣扎；为摆脱阻碍或束缚而进行的用力活动。
摔跤；双方用身体力量相互较量的活动。

collocations.zh: 两名摔跤手之间的角力

formal.mt: Waqt it-taħriġ, is-sarar bejn iż-żewġ lottaturi sar fuq tapit adattat u taħt is-superviżjoni tal-kowċ.
formal.en: During training, the wrestling between the two wrestlers took place on a suitable mat under the coach's supervision.
formal.zh: 训练时，两名摔跤手在合适的垫子上角力，并由教练监督。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Irnexxielek toħroġ mill-ħabel? Ben: Iva, imma wara ħafna sarar. Maja: Ejja nara jekk weġġajtx.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you manage to get free of the rope? Ben: Yes, but only after a lot of struggling. Maja: Let me see if you got hurt.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你成功从绳子里挣脱了吗？Ben：是的，不过挣扎了好一阵。Maja：让我看看你有没有受伤。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你成功从绳子里挣脱了吗？
messages.en: Did you manage to get free of the rope?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，不过挣扎了好一阵。
messages.en: Yes, but only after a lot of struggling.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 让我看看你有没有受伤。
messages.en: Let me see if you got hurt.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sarar 配上两幅用力画面：被绳子缠住时挣扎，在垫子上与对手较量时摔跤；这里都作名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To arrange people or things in a row or queue.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把人或物排列成一行，或安排人排成队列。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqiegħed persuni jew affarijiet f'ringiela jew fi kju.

sense_translations.en_definition: to put in a row or queue
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把人或物排成一行或一个队列。

collocations.en: arranged the chairs in a row

formal.mt: L-organizzatur sarbat is-siġġijiet tul il-ħajt biex iħalli passaġġ fin-nofs tas-sala.
formal.en: The organiser arranged the chairs in a row along the wall to leave an aisle in the middle of the hall.
formal.zh: 组织者把椅子沿墙排成一行，在大厅中央留出通道。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min sarbat it-tfal ħdejn il-bieb? Mark: L-għalliem, għax se joħorġu fil-bitħa. Lara: Tajjeb, issa kulħadd jaf fejn joqgħod.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who lined the children up by the door? Mark: The teacher, because they're going out into the yard. Lara: Good, now everyone knows where to stand.
colloquial.zh: Lara：谁让孩子们在门边排好了队？Mark：老师，因为他们要去院子里。Lara：好，这下大家都知道该站在哪里了。

messages.speaker: Lara (教师)
messages.zh: 谁让孩子们在门边排好了队？
messages.en: Who lined the children up by the door?

messages.speaker: Mark (助教)
messages.zh: 老师，因为他们要去院子里。
messages.en: The teacher, because they're going out into the yard.

messages.speaker: Lara (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, issa kulħadd jaf fejn joqgħod.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, issa kulħadd jaf fejn joqgħod.
messages.zh: 好，这下大家都知道该站在哪里了。
messages.en: Good, now everyone knows where to stand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老师把散站的孩子排成一队，或把零散椅子排成一行；sarbat 记的是安排成行的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to form a row or line.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有聚成一行、排成队列的倾向的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jifforma ringiela.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于形成一行或排成一列的。

collocations.en: a group tending to form a row
collocations.zh: 倾向于排成一行的群体

collocations.en: a tendency to form a row

formal.mt: Il-grupp sarbati kellu tendenza jifforma ringiela waqt il-mixi, anki meta l-passaġġ kien wiesa'.
formal.en: The group, inclined to form a line, tended to walk in a row even when the path was wide.
formal.zh: 这个群体倾向于排成一行，即使道路宽阔，行走时也往往形成队列。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara kif qed jimxu wieħed wara l-ieħor. Toni: Dan il-grupp sarbati; dejjem jifforma ringiela. Nina: Veru, anki hawn fejn hemm ħafna spazju.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look how they're walking one behind the other. Toni: This group tends to form a line; it always makes a row. Nina: True, even here where there's plenty of space.
colloquial.zh: Nina：看，他们一个接一个地走着。Toni：这个群体喜欢排成一行，总会形成队列。Nina：确实，就连这里空间这么大也是这样。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara kif qed jimxu wieħed wara l-ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Ara kif qed jimxu wieħed wara l-ieħor.
messages.zh: 看，他们一个接一个地走着。
messages.en: Look how they're walking one behind the other.

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-grupp sarbati; dejjem jifforma ringiela.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-grupp sarbati; dejjem jifforma ringiela.
messages.zh: 这个群体喜欢排成一行，总会形成队列。
messages.en: This group tends to form a line; it always makes a row.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, anki hawn fejn hemm ħafna spazju.
messages.mt_standard: Veru, anki hawn fejn hemm ħafna spazju.
messages.zh: 确实，就连这里空间这么大也是这样。
messages.en: True, even here where there's plenty of space.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 sarbati 就想一个总爱自动站成一排的群体；重点是成行的倾向，词性是形容词。

gloss_zh: 把东西排成一行的动作

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of arranging something in a row.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物品依次摆放、排列成一行这一行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed iqiegħed xi ħaġa jew għadd ta' affarijiet f'ringiela.

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of putting sth. in a row
sense_translations.zh_definition: 将某物排成一行的行为或过程。

collocations.en: the arranging of the chairs in a row
collocations.zh: 把椅子排成一行的过程

collocations.en: the arranging of the boxes in a row
collocations.zh: 把箱子排成一行的过程

formal.mt: Is-sarbit tal-kaxxi tul il-ħajt ħalla biżżejjed spazju biex jgħaddu l-ħaddiema.
formal.en: Arranging the boxes in a row along the wall left enough space for the workers to pass.
formal.zh: 把箱子沿墙排成一行，为工人通行留出了足够空间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għad baqa' ħafna xogħol fis-sala? Ben: Is-sarbit tas-siġġijiet biss; irridu nqegħduhom f'ringiela. Maja: Mela niġi ngħinek.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is there much work left in the hall? Ben: Only arranging the chairs in a row; we need to line them up. Maja: Then I'll come and help you.
colloquial.zh: Maja：大厅里还剩很多活吗？Ben：只剩把椅子排成一行了，我们得把它们排好。Maja：那我来帮你。

messages.speaker: Maja (活动志愿者)
messages.zh: 大厅里还剩很多活吗？
messages.en: Is there much work left in the hall?

messages.speaker: Ben (活动志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-sarbit tas-siġġijiet biss; irridu nqegħduhom f'ringiela.
messages.mt_standard: Is-sarbit tas-siġġijiet biss; irridu nqegħduhom f'ringiela.
messages.zh: 只剩把椅子排成一行了，我们得把它们排好。
messages.en: Only arranging the chairs in a row; we need to line them up.

messages.speaker: Maja (活动志愿者)
messages.zh: 那我来帮你。
messages.en: Then I'll come and help you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sarbit 想成待办清单上的一项工作：把椅子排成一行。这里用名词给整个排列过程命名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move or shift a heavy object from its position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使沉重的物体离开原来的位置，将其挪动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iċaqlaq xi ħaġa tqila minn postha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 挪动或移动沉重的东西。

collocations.zh: 挪动了一块沉重的石头
挪动了一个沉重的柜子

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem sardan il-ġebla tqila minn quddiem il-bieb biex jiftaħ il-passaġġ.
formal.en: The worker shifted the heavy stone away from the doorway to clear the passage.
formal.zh: 工人把沉重的石头从门前挪开，疏通了通道。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min sardan l-armarju? Kien tqil ħafna! Mark: Pawlu, bl-għajnuna tiegħi. Lara: Issa għandna aktar spazju ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who shifted the cupboard? It was very heavy! Mark: Pawlu, with my help. Lara: Now we have more space by the door.
colloquial.zh: Lara：谁把柜子挪动了？它可沉了！Mark：Pawlu，我帮了他。Lara：现在门边的空间更大了。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min sardan l-armarju? Kien tqil ħafna!
messages.mt_standard: Min sardan l-armarju? Kien tqil ħafna!
messages.zh: 谁把柜子挪动了？它可沉了！
messages.en: Who shifted the cupboard? It was very heavy!

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: Pawlu，我帮了他。
messages.en: Pawlu, with my help.

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa għandna aktar spazju ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Issa għandna aktar spazju ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 现在门边的空间更大了。
messages.en: Now we have more space by the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两个人一起把沉重柜子挪开一点，把 sardan 和重物改变位置的动作绑定，记住重物这一重点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Small fish called sprats, referred to collectively as food or as a catch.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指称黍鲱这类小鱼，可用于谈论鱼获或食材。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħut żgħir magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala sprats, li jista' jissemma bħala qabda jew bħala ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黍鲱；西鲱类小鱼

formal.mt: Il-menu tal-ġurnata jinkludi sardellin moqli, servut mal-ħobż u l-lumi.
formal.en: The day's menu includes fried sprats, served with bread and lemon.
formal.zh: 当日菜单包括炸黍鲱，配面包和柠檬。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għandek sardellin frisk illum? Toni: Iva, kemm trid? Marta: Agħtini nofs kilo, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Marta: Do you have fresh sprats today? Toni: Yes, how much would you like? Marta: Half a kilo, please.
colloquial.zh: Marta：今天有新鲜黍鲱吗？Toni：有，你要多少？Marta：请给我半公斤。

messages.speaker: Marta (顾客)
messages.zh: 今天有新鲜黍鲱吗？
messages.en: Do you have fresh sprats today?

messages.speaker: Toni (鱼贩)
messages.zh: 有，你要多少？
messages.en: Yes, how much would you like?

messages.speaker: Marta (顾客)
messages.zh: 请给我半公斤。
messages.en: Half a kilo, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sardellin 和鱼摊上的一盘小黍鲱联系起来，搭配 frisk 记新鲜，搭配 moqli 记油炸。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fish called sardines, discussed as food or as a catch.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指沙丁鱼，可用于谈论鱼获、新鲜食材或罐装食品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħut magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala sardines, li jintuża bħala ikel frisk jew fil-laned.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沙丁鱼

formal.mt: Għal din ir-riċetta, uża sardin frisk u sajru fil-forn ma' ftit żejt u lumi.
formal.en: For this recipe, use fresh sardines and cook them in the oven with a little oil and lemon.
formal.zh: 做这道菜时，使用新鲜沙丁鱼，加少许油和柠檬后放入烤箱烤制。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'se nieklu llejla? Ben: Għandna sardin fil-laned; nistgħu niekluh mal-ħobż. Lara: Tajjeb, inqatta' ftit tadam ukoll.
colloquial.en: Lara: What are we eating tonight? Ben: We have canned sardines; we can have them with bread. Lara: Good, I'll slice some tomatoes too.
colloquial.zh: Lara：今晚吃什么？Ben：我们有罐装沙丁鱼，可以配面包吃。Lara：好，我再切些番茄。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 今晚吃什么？
messages.en: What are we eating tonight?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna sardin fil-laned; nistgħu niekluh mal-ħobż.
messages.mt_standard: Għandna sardin fil-laned; nistgħu niekluh mal-ħobż.
messages.zh: 我们有罐装沙丁鱼，可以配面包吃。
messages.en: We have canned sardines; we can have them with bread.

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 好，我再切些番茄。
messages.en: Good, I'll slice some tomatoes too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 sardin 就联想英语 sardines 和沙丁鱼罐头，再用 frisk 与 fil-laned 区分新鲜和罐装。

gloss_zh: 两难困境；令人困惑的事

teaching_sense.en_definition: A difficult situation in which deciding what to do is hard, or something that causes perplexity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 难以决定如何应对的困境，也指使人费解、摸不着头绪的事情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sitwazzjoni li fiha jkun diffiċli tiddeċiedi x'għandek tagħmel, jew ħaġa li tħawdek.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 难以作出决定的困境；两难处境
令人困惑或费解的事物

formal.mt: L-għażla bejn żewġ soluzzjonijiet bi żvantaġġi differenti ħalliet lill-kumitat f'sarma.
formal.en: The choice between two solutions with different drawbacks left the committee in a quandary.
formal.zh: 两种解决方案各有不同的缺点，委员会因此陷入了两难。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Ninsab f'sarma: iż-żewġ korsijiet isiru fl-istess ħin. Pawlu: Liema wieħed għandek bżonn aktar? Anna: Dak hu l-inkwiet; it-tnejn huma importanti għalija.
colloquial.en: Anna: I'm in a quandary: the two courses take place at the same time. Pawlu: Which one do you need more? Anna: That's the problem; both are important to me.
colloquial.zh: Anna：我犯难了，两门课在同一时间上。Pawlu：你更需要哪一门？Anna：问题就在这里，两门对我都很重要。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Ninsab f'sarma: iż-żewġ korsijiet isiru fl-istess ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Ninsab f'sarma: iż-żewġ korsijiet isiru fl-istess ħin.
messages.zh: 我犯难了，两门课在同一时间上。
messages.en: I'm in a quandary: the two courses take place at the same time.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 你更需要哪一门？
messages.en: Which one do you need more?

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak hu l-inkwiet; it-tnejn huma importanti għalija.
messages.mt_standard: Dak hu l-inkwiet; it-tnejn huma importanti għalija.
messages.zh: 问题就在这里，两门对我都很重要。
messages.en: That's the problem; both are important to me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sarma 放进两门课撞时间的情景：选哪门都为难就是 f'sarma；看不懂的问题也可是一件 sarma。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Capable of exchanging money from one currency or denomination into another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有兑换钱币的能力，能将钱换成其他币种或面额。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jsarraf il-flus minn munita jew denominazzjoni għal oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 能够兑换钱币的

collocations.en: an agent able to exchange money
collocations.zh: 能够办理钱币兑换的代理人

collocations.en: an employee able to exchange money

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżempju, l-aġent huwa deskritt bħala sarrafi għax jista' jsarraf il-flus minn munita għal oħra.
formal.en: In this example, the agent is described as able to exchange money because he can convert money from one currency to another.
formal.zh: 在这个例子中，代理人被描述为具备钱币兑换能力，因为他能将一种货币兑换成另一种。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Xi jfisser li aġent huwa sarrafi? David: Ifisser li jista' jsarraf il-flus. Rita: Mela qed nitkellmu dwar il-ħila tiegħu li jagħmel il-kambju.
colloquial.en: Rita: What does it mean to say an agent is sarrafi? David: It means he can exchange money. Rita: So we're talking about his ability to handle an exchange.
colloquial.zh: Rita：说一名代理人是 sarrafi，是什么意思？David：意思是他能兑换钱币。Rita：所以说的是他办理兑换的能力。

messages.speaker: Rita (语言学习者)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser li aġent huwa sarrafi?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser li aġent huwa sarrafi?
messages.zh: 说一名代理人是 sarrafi，是什么意思？
messages.en: What does it mean to say an agent is sarrafi?

messages.speaker: David (语言教师)
messages.zh: 意思是他能兑换钱币。
messages.en: It means he can exchange money.

messages.speaker: Rita (语言学习者)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela qed nitkellmu dwar il-ħila tiegħu li jagħmel il-kambju.
messages.mt_standard: Mela qed nitkellmu dwar il-ħila tiegħu li jagħmel il-kambju.
messages.zh: 所以说的是他办理兑换的能力。
messages.en: So we're talking about his ability to handle an exchange.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象柜台职员能把一种钱换成另一种钱，用 sarrafi 标记这种能力；它是描述能力的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a property or effect that muzzles or restricts the use of the mouth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有封嘴、限制嘴部使用或活动的性质或作用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-proprjetà jew l-effett li jrażżan l-użu jew il-moviment tal-ħalq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有封嘴或限制嘴部活动作用的

collocations.en: a device with a muzzling property

formal.mt: Id-deskrizzjoni ssemmi apparat sarrami li jillimita l-ftuħ tal-ħalq tal-annimal.
formal.en: The description mentions a device with a muzzling property that limits how far the animal's mouth can open.
formal.zh: 说明中提到一种具有封嘴作用的装置，可以限制动物嘴部张开的幅度。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi jfisser sarrami f'din id-deskrizzjoni? Ġorġ: Ifisser li l-apparat għandu effett li jrażżan il-ħalq. Sara: Issa fhimt x'jagħmel.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does sarrami mean in this description? Ġorġ: It means the device has an effect that restrains the mouth. Sara: Now I understand what it does.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这段说明里的 sarrami 是什么意思？Ġorġ：意思是这个装置具有限制嘴部活动的作用。Sara：现在我明白它有什么作用了。

messages.speaker: Sara (语言学习者)
messages.zh: 这段说明里的 sarrami 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does sarrami mean in this description?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (语言教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li l-apparat għandu effett li jrażżan il-ħalq.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li l-apparat għandu effett li jrażżan il-ħalq.
messages.zh: 意思是这个装置具有限制嘴部活动的作用。
messages.en: It means the device has an effect that restrains the mouth.

messages.speaker: Sara (语言学习者)
messages.zh: 现在我明白它有什么作用了。
messages.en: Now I understand what it does.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sarrami 与限制嘴部活动的装置画面联系起来，重点记住它描述封嘴作用，是形容词。

gloss_zh: 爱说谎的；倾向于编辫的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to tell lies; in a separate sense, inclined to plait strands together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容有说谎倾向的；另一个义项形容倾向于将条股编成辫状的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza li jigdeb; f'tifsira oħra, li għandu tendenza li jimmalja ħjut jew friegħi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有说谎倾向的；爱说谎的
有编辫倾向的；倾向于将条股交织编结的

collocations.en: a man inclined to tell lies
collocations.zh: 一个有说谎倾向的男人

collocations.en: a worker inclined to plait strands
collocations.zh: 一个倾向于编结条股的工人

formal.mt: Fil-kuntest tax-xogħol bil-ħjut, ħaddiem sarraġi għandu tendenza li jimmalja l-ħjut flimkien.
formal.en: In the context of working with threads, a worker described as sarraġi tends to plait the threads together.
formal.zh: 在处理线材的语境中，用 sarraġi 描述的工人倾向于将线股编结在一起。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Temmnu lil dak ir-raġel? Luqa: Mhux wisq; hu sarraġi u spiss ma jgħidx il-verità. Maja: Mela niċċekkja dak li qalli.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you believe that man? Luqa: Not very much; he's inclined to lie and often doesn't tell the truth. Maja: Then I'll check what he told me.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你相信那个男人吗？Luqa：不太相信，他爱说谎，经常不说实话。Maja：那我核实一下他告诉我的事。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你相信那个男人吗？
messages.en: Do you believe that man?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mhux wisq; hu sarraġi u spiss ma jgħidx il-verità.
messages.mt_standard: Mhux wisq; hu sarraġi u spiss ma jgħidx il-verità.
messages.zh: 不太相信，他爱说谎，经常不说实话。
messages.en: Not very much; he's inclined to lie and often doesn't tell the truth.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我核实一下他告诉我的事。
messages.en: Then I'll check what he told me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 sarraġi 做两张独立情景卡：一张是经常说谎的人，一张是常把线股编成辫的人；靠上下文分辨义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who ties things together into a bundle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把散开的物品扎在一起、捆成一束或一捆的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li torbot affarijiet flimkien biex tagħmel qatta.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who ties into a bundle
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把东西捆成束或扎成捆的人

formal.mt: Is-sarrier rabat il-friegħi f'qatet żgħar biex ikun aktar faċli jinġarru.
formal.en: The person bundling the branches tied them into small bundles so they would be easier to carry.
formal.zh: 负责捆扎的人把树枝扎成小捆，以便搬运。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Min se jorbot dan il-ħatab f'qatet? Pietru: Illum jien is-sarrier; għaddili l-ħabel. Elena: Hawn hu, u nżomm il-friegħi flimkien.
colloquial.en: Elena: Who's going to tie this firewood into bundles? Pietru: I'm the bundler today; pass me the rope. Elena: Here it is, and I'll hold the branches together.
colloquial.zh: Elena：谁来把这些柴火捆起来？Pietru：今天我负责捆扎，把绳子递给我。Elena：给你，我来把树枝拢在一起。

messages.speaker: Elena (劳动伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jorbot dan il-ħatab f'qatet?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jorbot dan il-ħatab f'qatet?
messages.zh: 谁来把这些柴火捆起来？
messages.en: Who's going to tie this firewood into bundles?

messages.speaker: Pietru (捆扎者)
messages.zh: 今天我负责捆扎，把绳子递给我。
messages.en: I'm the bundler today; pass me the rope.

messages.speaker: Elena (劳动伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn hu, u nżomm il-friegħi flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn hu, u nżomm il-friegħi flimkien.
messages.zh: 给你，我来把树枝拢在一起。
messages.en: Here it is, and I'll hold the branches together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人拿绳把散柴扎成一捆：sarrier 指做捆扎动作的人，记忆时把人、绳和柴捆放进同一画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A guy-rope used on a ship to support or steady part of its equipment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 船上用于牵拉、支撑或稳定相关装置的绳索。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħabel fuq vapur li jintuża biex iżomm xi tagħmir sod jew f'postu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 船上的牵索或支索。

formal.mt: Qabel it-tluq, il-baħri ċċekkja s-sarsa biex jiżgura li kienet marbuta sew.
formal.en: Before departure, the sailor checked the guy-rope to ensure that it was securely tied.
formal.zh: 启航前，水手检查了牵索，确保它已牢固系好。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Iċċekkjajt is-sarsa? Pawlu: Iva, hija marbuta sew.
colloquial.en: Mark: Have you checked the guy-rope? Pawlu: Yes, it is securely tied.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你检查过牵索了吗？Pawlu：检查过了，已经系牢了。

messages.speaker: Mark (船员)
messages.zh: 你检查过牵索了吗？
messages.en: Have you checked the guy-rope?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (水手)
messages.zh: 检查过了，已经系牢了。
messages.en: Yes, it is securely tied.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sarsa 放进“水手检查船上牵索”的画面，记住它是船用绳索；这是场景联想，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 织补；曲折缝纫；花言巧语的哄骗者、拖延者或织补者

teaching_sense.en_definition: To repair a hole in fabric by sewing threads across it; also, to sew in a zigzag.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用针线交织修补织物上的破洞；也可指以曲折路线缝纫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isewwi toqba fid-drapp billi jgħaddi l-ħajt minn naħa għal oħra; ukoll, iħit f'żigżag.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 织补；用交织的针线修补织物破洞。
以曲折或之字形路线缝纫。

sense_translations.en_definition: Falzon explains 'a deluder with fair words or promises'. A procrastinator. A darner
sense_translations.zh_definition: Falzon 解释为用好听的话或承诺哄骗别人的人；也指拖延者或从事织补的人。

collocations.en: he darned a hole in the fabric
collocations.zh: 他织补了布料上的一个破洞

formal.mt: Il-ħajjat sarsar it-toqba fil-kalzetta b'ħajt tal-istess kulur.
formal.en: The tailor darned the hole in the sock with thread of the same colour.
formal.zh: 裁缝用同色的线织补了袜子上的破洞。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min sarsar din il-kalzetta? Lara: Pawlu. Issa tista' tilbesha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who darned this sock? Lara: Pawlu did. You can wear it now.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这只袜子是谁织补的？Lara：Pawlu 补的，现在可以穿了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这只袜子是谁织补的？
messages.en: Who darned this sock?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu 补的，现在可以穿了。
messages.en: Pawlu did. You can wear it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sarsar 中重复的字母段想成针线来回穿梭，先记“织补、曲折缝”；遇到名词时，再另记“哄骗者、拖延者、织补者”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Eurasian teal, a species of duck with the scientific name Anas crecca.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 绿翅鸭，又称小水鸭，学名为 Anas crecca 的一种鸭。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' papra magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Anas crecca.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绿翅鸭，又称小水鸭（Anas crecca）。

collocations.en: a picture of a Eurasian teal

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, l-istudenta identifikat l-għasfur bħala sarsella u kitbet l-isem xjentifiku Anas crecca.
formal.en: In the report, the student identified the bird as a Eurasian teal and wrote its scientific name, Anas crecca.
formal.zh: 学生在报告中将这只鸟辨认为绿翅鸭，并写下其学名 Anas crecca。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din sarsella fl-istampa? Mark: Iva, u taħtha hemm l-isem Anas crecca.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is that a Eurasian teal in the picture? Mark: Yes, and the name Anas crecca is written underneath.
colloquial.zh: Maja：图片里这只是绿翅鸭吗？Mark：是的，下面还写着 Anas crecca。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 图片里这只是绿翅鸭吗？
messages.en: Is that a Eurasian teal in the picture?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u taħtha hemm l-isem Anas crecca.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u taħtha hemm l-isem Anas crecca.
messages.zh: 是的，下面还写着 Anas crecca。
messages.en: Yes, and the name Anas crecca is written underneath.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作三栏卡片，把 sarsella、绿翅鸭和 Anas crecca 放在同一行；先牢牢记住单独的 sarsella 对应这个物种。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The marbled teal, a species of duck with the scientific name Marmaronetta angustirostris.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 云石斑鸭，学名为 Marmaronetta angustirostris 的一种鸭。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' papra magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Marmaronetta angustirostris.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 云石斑鸭（Marmaronetta angustirostris）。

collocations.en: a picture of a marbled teal

formal.mt: L-istudenta kitbet l-isem Marmaronetta angustirostris ħdejn it-tpinġija tas-sarsella mnaqqxa.
formal.en: The student wrote the name Marmaronetta angustirostris beside the drawing of the marbled teal.
formal.zh: 学生在云石斑鸭的绘图旁写下了 Marmaronetta angustirostris 这一名称。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Liema stampa turi s-sarsella mnaqqxa? Maja: Din hawn, bit-tikketta Marmaronetta angustirostris.
colloquial.en: Mark: Which picture shows the marbled teal? Maja: This one here, labelled Marmaronetta angustirostris.
colloquial.zh: Mark：哪张图片画的是云石斑鸭？Maja：这里这张，标着 Marmaronetta angustirostris。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.zh: 哪张图片画的是云石斑鸭？
messages.en: Which picture shows the marbled teal?

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这里这张，标着 Marmaronetta angustirostris。
messages.en: This one here, labelled Marmaronetta angustirostris.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张大理石纹样的学习卡，上面写着 sarsella mnaqqxa 和“云石斑鸭”；这是帮助配对名称的想象画面，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The blue-winged teal, a species of duck with the scientific name Spatula discors, also listed as Anas discors.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蓝翅鸭，学名为 Spatula discors，也以 Anas discors 这一同物异名列出的一种鸭。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' papra magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Spatula discors, u wkoll bl-isem sinonimu Anas discors.

sense_translations.en_definition: blue-winged teal (Spatula discors, syn. Anas discors)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 蓝翅鸭（Spatula discors，同物异名为 Anas discors）。

collocations.en: a picture of a blue-winged teal

formal.mt: Il-gwida telenka s-sarsella tal-ġewnaħ ikħal bħala Spatula discors u tagħti Anas discors bħala isem sinonimu.
formal.en: The guide lists the blue-winged teal as Spatula discors and gives Anas discors as a synonymous name.
formal.zh: 指南将蓝翅鸭列为 Spatula discors，并注明 Anas discors 是其同物异名。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din is-sarsella tal-ġewnaħ ikħal? Mark: Iva. Fuq il-karta hemm l-isem Spatula discors.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this the blue-winged teal? Mark: Yes. The name Spatula discors is on the card.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这就是蓝翅鸭吗？Mark：是的，卡片上写着 Spatula discors。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这就是蓝翅鸭吗？
messages.en: Is this the blue-winged teal?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva. Fuq il-karta hemm l-isem Spatula discors.
messages.mt_standard: Iva. Fuq il-karta hemm l-isem Spatula discors.
messages.zh: 是的，卡片上写着 Spatula discors。
messages.en: Yes. The name Spatula discors is on the card.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把长名称分成 sarsella / tal-ġewnaħ ikħal 两段练读，再整体对应“蓝翅鸭”；卡片背面并列两个学名，记住它们指同一物种。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The garganey, a species of duck with the scientific name Anas querquedula.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 白眉鸭，学名为 Anas querquedula 的一种鸭。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' papra magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Anas querquedula.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 白眉鸭（Anas querquedula）。

formal.mt: Fil-gwida, l-istampa tas-sarsella ħamra għandha t-tikketta Anas querquedula.
formal.en: In the guide, the picture of the garganey is labelled Anas querquedula.
formal.zh: 指南中，白眉鸭的图片标注着 Anas querquedula。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif tissejjaħ din il-papra? Pawlu: Sarsella ħamra. Hawn miktub Anas querquedula.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is this duck called? Pawlu: A garganey. It says Anas querquedula here.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这种鸭叫什么？Pawlu：白眉鸭，这里写着 Anas querquedula。

messages.speaker: Lara (游客)
messages.zh: 这种鸭叫什么？
messages.en: What is this duck called?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (导览员)
messages.mt_spoken: Sarsella ħamra. Hawn miktub Anas querquedula.
messages.mt_standard: Sarsella ħamra. Hawn miktub Anas querquedula.
messages.zh: 白眉鸭，这里写着 Anas querquedula。
messages.en: A garganey. It says Anas querquedula here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把完整名称 sarsella ħamra 与“白眉鸭”一起朗读，再用 Anas querquedula 核对；物种名要整体记，不按颜色词猜中文名。

gloss_zh: 花言巧语的哄骗；拖延；织补

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of darning fabric; in other senses, deception through fine words or the act of putting something off.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 织补织物的活动；其他义项分别指用花言巧语哄骗，以及把事情往后拖延。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xogħol ta' tiswija ta' toqob fid-drapp bil-ħajt; f'tifsiriet oħra, qerq bi kliem sabiħ jew dewmien biex issir xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用好听的话哄骗；以花言巧语进行的欺骗。
拖延；把应做的事情推迟。
织补；用针线交织修补织物破洞的活动。

formal.mt: Il-lezzjoni kienet dwar is-sarsir tal-kalzetti u l-għażla ta' ħajt adattat.
formal.en: The lesson covered darning socks and choosing suitable thread.
formal.zh: 这堂课讲解了袜子的织补和合适缝线的选择。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qed titgħallem illum? Lara: Is-sarsir tal-kalzetti. Għandi waħda b'toqba.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you learning today? Lara: How to darn socks. I have one with a hole.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你今天在学什么？Lara：织补袜子，我有一只袜子破了个洞。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天在学什么？
messages.en: What are you learning today?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 织补袜子，我有一只袜子破了个洞。
messages.en: How to darn socks. I have one with a hole.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 sarsir 画三张独立小卡：甜言哄骗、日历拖延、针线织补；用三个场景区分义项，不把它们混成一种意思。

gloss_zh: 系在 lampiera 末端的 V 形绳索

teaching_sense.en_definition: A V-shaped rope tied to the end of the item called a lampiera.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种呈 V 形、系在称为 lampiera 的物件末端的绳索。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħabel f'forma ta' V marbut mat-tarf tal-lampiera.

sense_translations.en_definition: V-shaped rope tied to the end of the 'lampiera'
sense_translations.zh_definition: 系在 lampiera 末端的 V 形绳索。

collocations.zh: 呈 V 形的 sarsja 绳索

collocations.en: the sarsja rope at the end of the lampiera
collocations.zh: lampiera 末端的 sarsja 绳索

formal.mt: Id-dijagramma turi s-sarsja f'forma ta' V marbuta mat-tarf tal-lampiera.
formal.en: The diagram shows the V-shaped sarsja rope tied to the end of the lampiera.
formal.zh: 示意图展示了系在 lampiera 末端的 V 形 sarsja 绳索。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Liema ħabel huwa s-sarsja? Pawlu: Dak f'forma ta' V, marbut mat-tarf tal-lampiera.
colloquial.en: Mark: Which rope is the sarsja? Pawlu: The V-shaped one tied to the end of the lampiera.
colloquial.zh: Mark：哪根绳子是 sarsja？Pawlu：系在 lampiera 末端、呈 V 形的那根。

messages.speaker: Mark (学徒)
messages.zh: 哪根绳子是 sarsja？
messages.en: Which rope is the sarsja?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (指导老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak f'forma ta' V, marbut mat-tarf tal-lampiera.
messages.mt_standard: Dak f'forma ta' V, marbut mat-tarf tal-lampiera.
messages.zh: 系在 lampiera 末端、呈 V 形的那根。
messages.en: The V-shaped one tied to the end of the lampiera.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 sarsja 就画一个 V，并在连接处标上 lampiera 末端；用“形状加位置”一起记，避免与泛指船上牵索的 sarsa 混淆。

gloss_zh: 不知情地卷入问题；无意间牵涉其中

teaching_sense.en_definition: Involvement in an issue or problem without knowing or realizing that one is becoming involved.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在自己不知情或未察觉的情况下，卷入某个问题或纠纷。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Involviment fi kwistjoni jew problema mingħajr ma wieħed ikun jaf jew jinduna li qed jidħol fiha.

sense_translations.en_definition: unwitting involvement in an issue or problem
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在不知情的情况下卷入某个问题或纠纷。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Involviment fi kwistjoni jew problema mingħajr ma wieħed ikun jaf jew jinduna.
