formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi s-sarwil ta' Pawlu fil-kwistjoni u jispjega li ma kien jaf xejn dwarha.
formal.en: The report describes Pawlu's unwitting involvement in the issue and explains that he knew nothing about it.
formal.zh: 报告描述了保罗不知情地卷入此事的经过，并说明他原本对此毫不知情。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif spiċċajt f'din il-problema? Pawlu: Kien sarwil; ma kontx naf x'kien qed jiġri.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did you end up in this problem? Pawlu: I got involved without realizing it; I didn't know what was happening.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你怎么卷进这个问题的？保罗：我是不知情地卷进去的，当时根本不知道发生了什么。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么卷进这个问题的？
messages.en: How did you end up in this problem?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien sarwil; ma kontx naf x'kien qed jiġri.
messages.mt_standard: Kien sarwil; ma kontx naf x'kien qed jiġri.
messages.zh: 我是不知情地卷进去的，当时根本不知道发生了什么。
messages.en: I got involved without realizing it; I didn't know what was happening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己路过一场争执，却糊里糊涂成了当事人；用这个画面记住 sarwil 的“不知情地卷入”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make threads, cords, or similar things tangled or entwined with one another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使线、绳或类似物互相缠结，或使它们交缠在一起。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħabbel ħjut, ħbula jew affarijiet simili, jew idaħħalhom f'xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使缠结；使纠缠成团
使交缠；使互相缠绕

formal.mt: Waqt il-ħidma, l-istudent sarġat żewġ ħbula flimkien biex juri kif jistgħu jidħlu f'xulxin.
formal.en: During the activity, the student entwined two ropes to demonstrate how they can interlace.
formal.zh: 在活动中，学生把两根绳交缠在一起，展示它们如何互相穿绕。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min sarġat il-ħjut kollha? Mark: Jien, waqt li kont infittex il-ħajt l-aħmar. Nina: Ejja nifirduhom bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who tangled all the threads? Mark: I did, while I was looking for the red thread. Nina: Let's separate them slowly.
colloquial.zh: Nina：谁把这些线全弄缠结了？Mark：是我，找红线的时候弄的。Nina：我们慢慢把它们分开吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (手工课同学)
messages.zh: 谁把这些线全弄缠结了？
messages.en: Who tangled all the threads?

messages.speaker: Mark (手工课同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien, waqt li kont infittex il-ħajt l-aħmar.
messages.mt_standard: Jien, waqt li kont infittex il-ħajt l-aħmar.
messages.zh: 是我，找红线的时候弄的。
messages.en: I did, while I was looking for the red thread.

messages.speaker: Nina (手工课同学)
messages.zh: 我们慢慢把它们分开吧。
messages.en: Let's separate them slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两根绳互相绕住：乱成一团对应 tangle，有意交缠对应 entwine，两个画面一起记 sarġat。

gloss_zh: 隐藏的；处于视线之外的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Hidden or positioned where it cannot be seen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被隐藏起来的，或位于视线之外而看不见的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Moħbi jew imqiegħed fejn ma jidhirx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 隐藏的；被遮住或藏起来的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Moħbi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 处于视线之外的；从眼前看不到的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: F'post fejn ma jidhirx.

formal.mt: Il-bieb iż-żgħir baqa' satran wara l-purtiera matul iż-żjara.
formal.en: The small door remained hidden behind the curtain throughout the visit.
formal.zh: 参观期间，那扇小门始终藏在窗帘后面，没有显露出来。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hu l-bieb iż-żgħir? Mark: Qiegħed satran wara l-purtiera.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is the small door? Mark: It's hidden behind the curtain.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那扇小门在哪里？马克：藏在窗帘后面。

messages.speaker: Lara (访客)
messages.zh: 那扇小门在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the small door?

messages.speaker: Mark (主人)
messages.zh: 藏在窗帘后面。
messages.en: It's hidden behind the curtain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 satran 配上“窗帘后面的小门”这个画面：东西还在那里，只是隐藏着、看不见。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone or something to be hidden from view.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人或某物隐藏起来，让其不被看见。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa tinħeba jew ma tidhirx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使躲藏；使隐藏起来。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa tinħeba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 掩藏者；把人或事物隐藏起来的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li taħbi lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa.

collocations.en: he hid the package behind the books

formal.mt: Qabel il-wasla tal-mistednin, Mark sattar il-pakkett wara l-kotba biex ma jidhirx.
formal.en: Before the guests arrived, Mark hid the package behind the books so that it would not be seen.
formal.zh: 客人到来之前，马克把包裹藏在书后面，使它不被看见。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn mar il-pakkett? Lara: Mark sattar il-pakkett wara l-kotba; hemm rigal fih.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where has the package gone? Lara: Mark hid the package behind the books; there's a present inside.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：包裹到哪里去了？拉拉：马克把包裹藏在书后面了，里面有礼物。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 包裹到哪里去了？
messages.en: Where has the package gone?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark sattar il-pakkett wara l-kotba; hemm rigal fih.
messages.mt_standard: Mark sattar il-pakkett wara l-kotba; hemm rigal fih.
messages.zh: 马克把包裹藏在书后面了，里面有礼物。
messages.en: Mark hid the package behind the books; there's a present inside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“把礼物藏到书后”的动作记动词 sattar；遇到名词用法，再把注意力转到“负责掩藏的人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Serving to cover or obscure something so that it is less visible or cannot be seen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有遮盖或遮蔽作用，使某物不易被看见或完全看不见的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jgħatti jew jaħbi xi ħaġa biex ma tidhirx jew tidher inqas.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 遮蔽的；起遮盖、遮掩作用的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jgħatti jew jaħbi.

collocations.en: fabric that conceals what is behind it
collocations.zh: 能遮住后方物品的布料

formal.mt: Id-disinjatur għażel drapp sattari biex l-oġġetti ta' warajh ma jidhrux.
formal.en: The designer chose concealing fabric so that the objects behind it would not be visible.
formal.zh: 设计师选用了具有遮蔽作用的布料，使后面的物品不被看见。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex għażilt dan id-drapp? Maja: Għax hu sattari; jaħbi l-kaxxi ta' warajh.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you choose this fabric? Maja: Because it conceals things; it hides the boxes behind it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么选这种布料？玛雅：因为它能起遮蔽作用，可以遮住后面的箱子。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么选这种布料？
messages.en: Why did you choose this fabric?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu sattari; jaħbi l-kaxxi ta' warajh.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu sattari; jaħbi l-kaxxi ta' warajh.
messages.zh: 因为它能起遮蔽作用，可以遮住后面的箱子。
messages.en: Because it conceals things; it hides the boxes behind it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一块挡住杂物的布，用 sattari 描述它“能遮掩”的作用；重点记遮蔽功能。

gloss_zh: 沙特阿拉伯的；沙特阿拉伯人

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to Saudi Arabia or its people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与沙特阿拉伯或其人民有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Arabja Sawdija jew man-nies tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沙特阿拉伯的；与沙特阿拉伯人有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Arabja Sawdija jew man-nies tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沙特阿拉伯人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna mill-Arabja Sawdija.

formal.mt: Student Sawdi ħa sehem fid-diskussjoni u ppreżenta l-proġett tiegħu lill-klassi.
formal.en: A Saudi student took part in the discussion and presented his project to the class.
formal.zh: 一名沙特阿拉伯学生参加了讨论，并向全班介绍了自己的项目。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn fejn hu l-istudent il-ġdid? Mark: Hu Sawdi, u qed jitgħallem il-Malti magħna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the new student from? Mark: He's Saudi, and he's learning Maltese with us.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：新来的学生是哪里人？马克：他是沙特阿拉伯人，正在和我们一起学马耳他语。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 新来的学生是哪里人？
messages.en: Where is the new student from?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu Sawdi, u qed jitgħallem il-Malti magħna.
messages.mt_standard: Hu Sawdi, u qed jitgħallem il-Malti magħna.
messages.zh: 他是沙特阿拉伯人，正在和我们一起学马耳他语。
messages.en: He's Saudi, and he's learning Maltese with us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Sawdi 和英语 Saudi 并排记忆：修饰学生时是“沙特的”，指称人时是“沙特人”。

gloss_zh: 动物以后腿直立；动物扬起前身的动作

teaching_sense.en_definition: An animal's act of raising the front of its body and standing on its hind legs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 动物抬起身体前部、用后腿支撑而直立的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-moviment ta' annimal li jgħolli l-parti ta' quddiem ta' ġismu u jieqaf fuq saqajh ta' wara.

sense_translations.en_definition: rearing of an animal on its hind legs
sense_translations.zh_definition: 动物抬起前身、以后腿支撑直立的动作。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-qawmien ta' annimal fuq saqajh ta' wara.

collocations.zh: 它扬起前身、以后腿直立

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, iż-żiemel għamel sawla u għal mument waqaf fuq saqajh ta' wara.
formal.en: During the observation, the horse reared up and briefly stood on its hind legs.
formal.zh: 观察期间，那匹马扬起前身，短暂地用后腿支撑着站立。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Rajt iż-żiemel jgħolli saqajh ta' quddiem? Mark: Iva, għamel sawla u mbagħad reġa' niżel.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you see the horse lift its front legs? Mark: Yes, it reared up and then came back down.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你看到那匹马抬起前腿了吗？马克：看到了，它扬起前身站了一下，然后又落下来了。

messages.speaker: Lara (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt iż-żiemel jgħolli saqajh ta' quddiem?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt iż-żiemel jgħolli saqajh ta' quddiem?
messages.zh: 你看到那匹马抬起前腿了吗？
messages.en: Did you see the horse lift its front legs?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għamel sawla u mbagħad reġa' niżel.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għamel sawla u mbagħad reġa' niżel.
messages.zh: 看到了，它扬起前身站了一下，然后又落下来了。
messages.en: Yes, it reared up and then came back down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象马的前蹄抬离地面、后腿撑住身体的一瞬间；sawla 就是这个扬起前身的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The practice of refraining from food, or of abstaining from something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不进食的行为或做法，也可指克制自己、不摄取或不做某事的禁戒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-prattika li wieħed ma jikolx, jew li jżomm lura minn xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 禁食；在一段时间内不进食。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-prattika li wieħed ma jikolx għal xi żmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 禁戒；克制自己而不摄取某物或不做某事。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-prattika li wieħed jastjeni minn xi ħaġa.

formal.mt: L-artiklu jiddeskrivi s-sawm bħala prattika li fiha wieħed ma jikolx għal żmien magħżul.
formal.en: The article describes fasting as a practice in which a person does not eat for a chosen period.
formal.zh: 文章将禁食描述为在选定的一段时间内不进食的做法。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu s-suġġett tal-artiklu tiegħek? Pawlu: Is-sawm; qed nikteb dwar il-prattika li wieħed ma jikolx għal xi żmien.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is your article about? Pawlu: Fasting; I'm writing about the practice of not eating for a period of time.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的文章写什么主题？保罗：禁食，我在写一段时间内不进食这种做法。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你的文章写什么主题？
messages.en: What is your article about?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-sawm; qed nikteb dwar il-prattika li wieħed ma jikolx għal xi żmien.
messages.mt_standard: Is-sawm; qed nikteb dwar il-prattika li wieħed ma jikolx għal xi żmien.
messages.zh: 禁食，我在写一段时间内不进食这种做法。
messages.en: Fasting; I'm writing about the practice of not eating for a period of time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sawm 记作“禁食这件事或这种做法”；看到它时先想到整体行为，也可延伸理解为禁戒。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A particular occasion or period during which a person refrains from eating.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某一次不进食的活动，或一次持续一定时间的禁食、斋戒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Darba jew perjodu partikolari li fih persuna ma tikolx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次禁食；一次斋戒或其持续的一段时间。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Perjodu partikolari ta' sawm.

formal.mt: Fid-djarju tiegħu, Pawlu ddeskriva sawma ta' ġurnata li għamel ix-xahar li għadda.
formal.en: In his diary, Pawlu described a one-day fast that he undertook last month.
formal.zh: 保罗在日记中描述了自己上个月进行的一次为期一天的禁食。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm damet is-sawma li semmejt? Pawlu: Damet ġurnata; ktibt dwarha fid-djarju tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Lara: How long did the fast you mentioned last? Pawlu: It lasted one day; I wrote about it in my diary.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你提到的那次禁食持续了多久？保罗：持续了一天，我在日记里写过这件事。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你提到的那次禁食持续了多久？
messages.en: How long did the fast you mentioned last?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Damet ġurnata; ktibt dwarha fid-djarju tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Damet ġurnata; ktibt dwarha fid-djarju tiegħi.
messages.zh: 持续了一天，我在日记里写过这件事。
messages.en: It lasted one day; I wrote about it in my diary.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给日历上的某次禁食画一个圈，用 sawma 记“这一次禁食”；与表示禁食行为的 sawm 对照学习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Uninformed about a subject or situation; in an obsolete sense, fasting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某个话题或情况不了解的、不知情的；另有现已废弃的“正在禁食的”之义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma għandux tagħrif dwar suġġett jew sitwazzjoni; f'sens li ma għadux jintuża, li jkun qed isum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: （旧义）正在禁食的。
不知情的；缺乏有关信息的。

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju, l-aġġettiv 'sawmien' ifisser 'mhux infurmat'; is-sens ta' 'li jkun qed isum' ma għadux jintuża.
formal.en: In the exercise, the adjective 'sawmien' means 'uninformed'; its sense of 'fasting' is obsolete.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，形容词 sawmien 表示“不知情的”；其“正在禁食的”之义已经废弃。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għadni sawmien dwar din il-kwistjoni. Tista' tispjegahieli? Pawlu: Iva, ngħidlek x'ġara mill-bidu.
colloquial.en: Marta: I'm still uninformed about this issue. Can you explain it to me? Pawlu: Yes, I'll tell you what happened from the beginning.
colloquial.zh: Marta：我还不了解这件事，你能给我解释一下吗？Pawlu：可以，我从头告诉你发生了什么。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni sawmien dwar din il-kwistjoni. Tista' tispjegahieli?
messages.mt_standard: Għadni sawmien dwar din il-kwistjoni. Tista' tispjegahieli?
messages.zh: 我还不了解这件事，你能给我解释一下吗？
messages.en: I'm still uninformed about this issue. Can you explain it to me?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 可以，我从头告诉你发生了什么。
messages.en: Yes, I'll tell you what happened from the beginning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它记成一张双面词卡：正面是“消息还没听到，所以不知情”，背面标明“禁食”为旧义，避免混用。

gloss_zh: 区别性标记的设置；对独立元素的标识

teaching_sense.en_definition: The marking of an individual element so that it can be distinguished from others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为某个独立元素加以标识，使其能够与其他元素区分开来的标记行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-immarkar ta' element individwali biex ikun jista' jingħaraf minn elementi oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对一个可区分的独立元素所作的标记或标识。

formal.mt: Is-sawn ta' kull element fid-dijagramma jippermetti lill-qarrej jiddistingwih mill-elementi l-oħra.
formal.en: The marking of each element in the diagram allows the reader to distinguish it from the other elements.
formal.zh: 图中对每个元素所作的标识，让读者能够将其与其他元素区分开来。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex għandna bżonn is-sawn ta' kull biċċa? Toni: Biex inkunu nafu liema hi liema meta nerġgħu npoġġuhom flimkien.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why do we need to mark each piece? Toni: So we know which is which when we put them back together.
colloquial.zh: Lara：为什么每个零件都需要标识？Toni：这样重新组装时，我们就知道哪个是哪个。

messages.speaker: Lara (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għandna bżonn is-sawn ta' kull biċċa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għandna bżonn is-sawn ta' kull biċċa?
messages.zh: 为什么每个零件都需要标识？
messages.en: Why do we need to mark each piece?

messages.speaker: Toni (师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex inkunu nafu liema hi liema meta nerġgħu npoġġuhom flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Biex inkunu nafu liema hi liema meta nerġgħu npoġġuhom flimkien.
messages.zh: 这样重新组装时，我们就知道哪个是哪个。
messages.en: So we know which is which when we put them back together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给一堆相似零件逐个编号：把 sawn 与“标识以便区分”这个动作画面绑定记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A mark used to indicate or identify something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来指示或辨认某物的一个记号、标记。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sinjal li jintuża biex jindika xi ħaġa jew jgħin biex tingħaraf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个记号；一处标记。

formal.mt: Sawna bil-lapes fuq il-mappa tindika l-post fejn se jsir il-kejl.
formal.en: A pencil mark on the map indicates the location where the measurement will be taken.
formal.zh: 地图上的一个铅笔记号标出了将要进行测量的位置。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhi din is-sawna fuq il-karta? Mark: Għamiltha biex niftakar fejn irrid naqta'.
colloquial.en: Nina: What's this mark on the paper? Mark: I made it to remember where I need to cut.
colloquial.zh: Nina：纸上的这个记号是什么？Mark：是我做的，用来记住要在哪里剪。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 纸上的这个记号是什么？
messages.en: What's this mark on the paper?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għamiltha biex niftakar fejn irrid naqta'.
messages.mt_standard: Għamiltha biex niftakar fejn irrid naqta'.
messages.zh: 是我做的，用来记住要在哪里剪。
messages.en: I made it to remember where I need to cut.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中画一张白纸，再点上一个小记号：sawna 就对应眼前这个具体的“标记”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A shape or formation, used as a cognate object of the corresponding verb; also the texture of a material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形状或成形结果，可作相应动词的同源宾语；也指材料的质地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamla jew forma, użata bħala oġġett tal-verb tal-istess għerq; ukoll il-konsistenza ta' materjal.

sense_translations.en_definition: (used as cognate object of the verb) A shape, formation
sense_translations.zh_definition: （用作该动词的同源宾语）形状；成形结果。
质地；材料表面的触感或组织特征。

formal.mt: L-artist saw war?
formal.en: The artist formed the clay into a round shape.
formal.zh: 艺术家把黏土塑成了圆形。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif inhi s-sawra ta' dan id-drapp? Lina: Ratba ħafna. Ħossu b'idek.
colloquial.en: Sara: What's the texture of this fabric like? Lina: Very soft. Feel it with your hand.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这块布的质地怎么样？Lina：非常柔软，你用手摸摸。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif inhi s-sawra ta' dan id-drapp?
messages.mt_standard: Kif inhi s-sawra ta' dan id-drapp?
messages.zh: 这块布的质地怎么样？
messages.en: What's the texture of this fabric like?

messages.speaker: Lina (店员)
messages.zh: 非常柔软，你用手摸摸。
messages.en: Very soft. Feel it with your hand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用黏土做双重联想：眼睛看塑出的“形状”，手指摸材料的“质地”，两幅画面共同记住 sawra。

gloss_zh: 形成过程；塑造过程；创造过程

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process through which something is formed or created.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物逐步形成、被塑造或被创造出来的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa tieħu forma jew tinħoloq.

sense_translations.en_definition: the process of formation or creation
sense_translations.zh_definition: 形成、塑造或创造的过程。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi s-sawran tal-istatwa, mill-ewwel abbozz sal-forma finali.
formal.en: The report describes the process of forming the statue, from the first sketch to its final shape.
formal.zh: 报告描述了雕像从最初草图到最终形态的塑造过程。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Is-sawran ta' din l-istatwa ħa ħafna żmien? David: Iva, bdejt b'abbozz żgħir u ħdimt fuqha għal xhur.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did forming this statue take a long time? David: Yes, I started with a small sketch and worked on it for months.
colloquial.zh: Maja：塑造这座雕像花了很长时间吗？David：是的，我从一张小草图开始，做了好几个月。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-sawran ta' din l-istatwa ħa ħafna żmien?
messages.mt_standard: Is-sawran ta' din l-istatwa ħa ħafna żmien?
messages.zh: 塑造这座雕像花了很长时间吗？
messages.en: Did forming this statue take a long time?

messages.speaker: David (雕塑家)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, bdejt b'abbozz żgħir u ħdimt fuqha għal xhur.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, bdejt b'abbozz żgħir u ħdimt fuqha għal xhur.
messages.zh: 是的，我从一张小草图开始，做了好几个月。
messages.en: Yes, I started with a small sketch and worked on it for months.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把雕塑制作想成一段延时影片：sawran 关注从无到有、逐步成形的整个过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Capable of pouring a liquid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有倾倒或倒出液体能力的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-ħila jsawwab likwidu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 能够倾倒或倒出液体的。

formal.mt: Ir-robot sawwabi jista' jsawwab l-ilma fit-tazzi mingħajr ma jxerred.
formal.en: The robot capable of pouring can pour water into the cups without spilling.
formal.zh: 这个具备倾倒能力的机器人可以把水倒进杯子里而不洒出来。

colloquial.mt: Ben: Dan ir-robot sawwabi? Rita: Iva, jista' jsawwab l-ilma fit-tazza tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Ben: Can this robot pour? Rita: Yes, it can pour water into your cup.
colloquial.zh: Ben：这个机器人会倒液体吗？Rita：会，它能把水倒进你的杯子里。

messages.speaker: Ben (参观者)
messages.zh: 这个机器人会倒液体吗？
messages.en: Can this robot pour?

messages.speaker: Rita (演示员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jista' jsawwab l-ilma fit-tazza tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jista' jsawwab l-ilma fit-tazza tiegħek.
messages.zh: 会，它能把水倒进你的杯子里。
messages.en: Yes, it can pour water into your cup.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象机器人把水壶倾斜，水准确流进杯子；用“有能力倒液体”的动作画面记住这个形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a wool-like or woolly surface or appearance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面或外观像羊毛一样蓬松、有绒毛的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu wiċċ jew dehra li tixbah lis-suf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 羊毛状的；毛绒绒的。

formal.mt: Il-kampjun għandu kisi sawwafi li jixbah lis-suf fid-dehra u fil-mess.
formal.en: The sample has a woolly covering that resembles wool in appearance and feel.
formal.zh: 该样品带有一层毛绒状的覆盖物，外观和触感都像羊毛。

colloquial.mt: Ella: Dan id-drapp sawwafi. Huwa tas-suf? Marija: Ma nafx minn xiex hu magħmul, imma hu artab ħafna.
colloquial.en: Ella: This fabric is woolly. Is it made of wool? Marija: I don't know what it's made of, but it's very soft.
colloquial.zh: Ella：这块布毛绒绒的，是羊毛做的吗？Marija：我不知道它是什么材质，不过非常柔软。

messages.speaker: Ella (朋友)
messages.zh: 这块布毛绒绒的，是羊毛做的吗？
messages.en: This fabric is woolly. Is it made of wool?

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx minn xiex hu magħmul, imma hu artab ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx minn xiex hu magħmul, imma hu artab ħafna.
messages.zh: 我不知道它是什么材质，不过非常柔软。
messages.en: I don't know what it's made of, but it's very soft.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象指尖摸到蓬松绒毛，把 sawwafi 与“羊毛般的外观和触感”相连，记住它描述的是特征。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To leave someone puzzled or bewildered, or to make something confusing to them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人摸不着头脑、感到困惑，或使其对某事产生混淆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħalli lil xi ħadd imħawwad jew jagħmillu xi ħaġa diffiċli biex jifhimha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使茫然；使迷惑不解。
使困惑；使混淆。

collocations.en: bewildered the student with his words
collocations.zh: 用自己的话把学生弄糊涂了

formal.mt: It-test sawwal lill-qarrej għax uża l-istess kelma għal żewġ ideat differenti.
formal.en: The text confused the reader because it used the same word for two different ideas.
formal.zh: 这篇文字用同一个词表示两种不同的概念，因此使读者感到困惑。

colloquial.mt: Adam: Dak il-kliem sawwalni. X'ried jgħid? Julia: Ried jgħid li l-laqgħa se tibda siegħa wara.
colloquial.en: Adam: Those words confused me. What did he mean? Julia: He meant that the meeting will start an hour later.
colloquial.zh: Adam：那些话把我弄糊涂了，他是什么意思？Julia：他的意思是会议会晚一个小时开始。

messages.speaker: Adam (同事)
messages.zh: 那些话把我弄糊涂了，他是什么意思？
messages.en: Those words confused me. What did he mean?

messages.speaker: Julia (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ried jgħid li l-laqgħa se tibda siegħa wara.
messages.mt_standard: Ried jgħid li l-laqgħa se tibda siegħa wara.
messages.zh: 他的意思是会议会晚一个小时开始。
messages.en: He meant that the meeting will start an hour later.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象听完一段绕口的说明，头顶冒出问号：sawwal 强调“把人弄糊涂”，把动作和困惑表情一起记。

gloss_zh: 斋戒者；使他人斋戒的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who fasts or makes others fast; distinguish the person imposing a fast from the person observing it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 自己斋戒或使别人斋戒的人；学习时应区分施行斋戒要求者与实际斋戒者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ssum jew iġġiegħel lil oħrajn isumu; għandha ssir distinzjoni bejn min jimponi s-sawm u min josservah.

sense_translations.en_definition: one who fasts or makes someone fast. n.b. vassalli explains sawwam as one who makes others fast and sawwiem one who fasts
sense_translations.zh_definition: 斋戒者，或使别人斋戒的人。注意：Vassalli 将 sawwam 解释为使别人斋戒的人，将 sawwiem 解释为自己斋戒的人。

collocations.en: the role of the person who makes others fast

formal.mt: F'dan it-test, is-sawwam huwa l-persuna li ġġiegħel lil oħrajn isumu.
formal.en: In this text, the sawwam is the person who makes others fast.
formal.zh: 在这篇文本中，sawwam 指使别人斋戒的人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hawnhekk, sawwam ifisser xi ħadd li jsum? Pawlu: Hawn ifisser min iġiegħel lil oħrajn isumu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does sawwam mean someone who fasts here? Pawlu: Here it means someone who makes others fast.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这里的 sawwam 是指自己斋戒的人吗？Pawlu：这里指使别人斋戒的人。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk, sawwam ifisser xi ħadd li jsum?
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk, sawwam ifisser xi ħadd li jsum?
messages.zh: 这里的 sawwam 是指自己斋戒的人吗？
messages.en: Does sawwam mean someone who fasts here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn ifisser min iġiegħel lil oħrajn isumu.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn ifisser min iġiegħel lil oħrajn isumu.
messages.zh: 这里指使别人斋戒的人。
messages.en: Here it means someone who makes others fast.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个角色帮助记忆：一个自己斋戒，一个要求别人斋戒；读到 sawwam 时先辨认文本说的是哪一个。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To select something from a group, or to distinguish one thing from another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从一组事物中挑选某物，或辨别不同事物之间的区别。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħżel xi ħaġa minn grupp, jew tagħraf id-differenza bejn ħaġa u oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 挑选；从若干对象中选出所需的对象。
辨别；分清不同对象或特征。

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur sawwan il-kampjuni skont il-kriterji tal-istudju.
formal.en: The researcher selected the samples according to the study criteria.
formal.zh: 研究人员按照研究标准挑选了样本。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser sawwan f'din is-sentenza? Mark: Ifisser għażel; f'sentenza oħra jista' jfisser għaraf id-differenza.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does sawwan mean in this sentence? Mark: It means selected; in another sentence it can mean distinguished.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这句话里的 sawwan 是什么意思？Mark：意思是挑选了；在另一句话中也可以表示辨别了。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这句话里的 sawwan 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does sawwan mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser għażel; f'sentenza oħra jista' jfisser għaraf id-differenza.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser għażel; f'sentenza oħra jista' jfisser għaraf id-differenza.
messages.zh: 意思是挑选了；在另一句话中也可以表示辨别了。
messages.en: It means selected; in another sentence it can mean distinguished.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象先分清桌上的不同样本，再挑出所需样本：用“辨别、挑选”两个动作联记 sawwan。

teaching_sense.en_definition: That forms something or gives it shape.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物形成或赋予其形态的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jifforma xi ħaġa jew jagħtiha forma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 起形成或塑造作用的。

collocations.en: a process that forms or shapes something
collocations.zh: 起形成或塑造作用的过程

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi r-rwol sawwari tal-edukazzjoni fil-karattru tal-bniedem.
formal.en: The author describes the formative role of education in human character.
formal.zh: 作者描述了教育对人的性格所起的塑造作用。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi jfisser rwol sawwari hawn? David: Rwol li jgħin biex jifforma xi ħaġa, bħall-karattru.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does a formative role mean here? David: A role that helps shape something, such as character.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这里说的塑造作用是什么意思？David：就是帮助某种东西形成的作用，比如塑造性格。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 这里说的塑造作用是什么意思？
messages.en: What does a formative role mean here?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Rwol li jgħin biex jifforma xi ħaġa, bħall-karattru.
messages.mt_standard: Rwol li jgħin biex jifforma xi ħaġa, bħall-karattru.
messages.zh: 就是帮助某种东西形成的作用，比如塑造性格。
messages.en: A role that helps shape something, such as character.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sawwari 放在“过程”或“作用”旁边记忆，脑中画出某物逐渐成形的画面，突出主动塑造之意。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Applying lashes or whipping someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 实施鞭打或对他人施以鞭笞的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħti daqqiet ta' frosta jew isawwat lil xi ħadd bil-frosta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 施以鞭打或鞭笞的。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, l-għassies sawwati jagħti daqqiet ta' frosta lill-priġunieri.
formal.en: In the story, the whipping guard administers lashes to the prisoners.
formal.zh: 故事中，那名施行鞭笞的看守用鞭子抽打囚犯。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Sawwati jiddeskrivi lil min jirċievi d-daqqiet? Toni: Le, hawn jiddeskrivi lil min jagħti d-daqqiet tal-frosta.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does sawwati describe the person receiving the lashes? Toni: No, here it describes the person administering them.
colloquial.zh: Sara：sawwati 描述的是挨鞭打的人吗？Toni：不是，这里描述的是施行鞭打的人。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Sawwati jiddeskrivi lil min jirċievi d-daqqiet?
messages.mt_standard: Sawwati jiddeskrivi lil min jirċievi d-daqqiet?
messages.zh: sawwati 描述的是挨鞭打的人吗？
messages.en: Does sawwati describe the person receiving the lashes?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hawn jiddeskrivi lil min jagħti d-daqqiet tal-frosta.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hawn jiddeskrivi lil min jagħti d-daqqiet tal-frosta.
messages.zh: 不是，这里描述的是施行鞭打的人。
messages.en: No, here it describes the person administering them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆 sawwati 时把箭头从持鞭者指向受鞭者，词义对应箭头起点，帮助分清施打与受打。

gloss_zh: 强制斋戒的；要求禁食的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Requiring or enforcing the observance of fasting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 要求他人遵守斋戒或强制实行禁食的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jimponi s-sawm jew jitlob li jiġi osservat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 强制实行斋戒或禁食的。

formal.mt: Fit-test, ir-regolament sawwiemi jobbliga lill-membri josservaw is-sawm.
formal.en: In the text, the fasting regulation obliges the members to observe the fast.
formal.zh: 文本中，这项强制斋戒的规章要求成员遵守斋戒。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex dan ir-regolament jissejjaħ sawwiemi? Ġużeppi: Għax jobbliga lin-nies isumu.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why is this regulation called sawwiemi? Ġużeppi: Because it requires people to fast.
colloquial.zh: Marija：为什么用 sawwiemi 来形容这项规章？Ġużeppi：因为它强制人们斋戒。

messages.speaker: Marija (学生)
messages.zh: 为什么用 sawwiemi 来形容这项规章？
messages.en: Why is this regulation called sawwiemi?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (教师)
messages.zh: 因为它强制人们斋戒。
messages.en: Because it requires people to fast.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张写着“必须斋戒”的规定，用 sawwiemi 描述这张规定的要求，牢牢记住其中的强制意味。

gloss_zh: 人马座（天文学）；射手座（黄道星座）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name Sagittarius, used for a constellation in astronomy and for a zodiac sign in astrology.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: Sagittarius 的名称：在天文学中指人马座，在占星术中指射手座。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem ta' kostellazzjoni fl-astronomija u ta' sinjal taż-żodijaku fl-astroloġija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 人马座，天文学中的星座名称。
射手座，占星术中的黄道星座名称。

formal.mt: Fit-test tal-astronomija, Saġittarju huwa l-isem ta' kostellazzjoni; f'test dwar l-astroloġija, l-istess isem jindika sinjal taż-żodijaku.
formal.en: In the astronomy text, Sagittarius is the name of a constellation; in a text about astrology, the same name denotes a zodiac sign.
formal.zh: 在天文学课文中，Saġittarju 是人马座的名称；在占星术文章中，同一名称指射手座。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Meta tgħid Saġittarju, qed titkellem dwar l-istilel jew iż-żodijaku? Mark: Dwar l-istilel. Qed infittex il-kostellazzjoni fuq din il-mappa.
colloquial.en: Lara: When you say Sagittarius, are you talking about the stars or the zodiac? Mark: The stars. I'm looking for the constellation on this map.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你说 Saġittarju，是在说天上的星座，还是黄道星座？马克：天上的星座。我正在这张图上找人马座。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta tgħid Saġittarju, qed titkellem dwar l-istilel jew iż-żodijaku?
messages.mt_standard: Meta tgħid Saġittarju, qed titkellem dwar l-istilel jew iż-żodijaku?
messages.zh: 你说 Saġittarju，是在说天上的星座，还是黄道星座？
messages.en: When you say Sagittarius, are you talking about the stars or the zodiac?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar l-istilel. Qed infittex il-kostellazzjoni fuq din il-mappa.
messages.mt_standard: Dwar l-istilel. Qed infittex il-kostellazzjoni fuq din il-mappa.
messages.zh: 天上的星座。我正在这张图上找人马座。
messages.en: The stars. I'm looking for the constellation on this map.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 Saġittarju 配两张卡：星图卡写“人马座”，黄道卡写“射手座”，用语境区分同一个名称的两种用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small room in a church where a person makes a confession to a priest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 教堂内供人向神父告解、忏悔的小房间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kamra żgħira fi knisja fejn persuna tmur tqerr għand qassis.

sense_translations.en_definition: confessional (small room where confession is performed)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 告解室；进行告解或忏悔的小房间。

formal.mt: Il-qassis kien fis-saġġa, filwaqt li dawk li riedu jqerru stennew barra fis-skiet.
formal.en: The priest was in the confessional, while those wishing to confess waited quietly outside.
formal.zh: 神父在告解室内，希望告解的人则在外面安静等候。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hi s-saġġa? Pawlu: Hemmhekk, ħdejn il-bieb iż-żgħir. Tista' tistenna barra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the confessional? Pawlu: Over there, by the small door. You can wait outside.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：告解室在哪里？保罗：在那边，小门旁边。你可以在外面等。

messages.speaker: Maja (教堂访客)
messages.zh: 告解室在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the confessional?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教堂志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemmhekk, ħdejn il-bieb iż-żgħir. Tista' tistenna barra.
messages.mt_standard: Hemmhekk, ħdejn il-bieb iż-żgħir. Tista' tistenna barra.
messages.zh: 在那边，小门旁边。你可以在外面等。
messages.en: Over there, by the small door. You can wait outside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 saġġa 记成教堂里一间安静的小房间：门外等候，门内告解，重点记住它是地点名词。

gloss_zh: 天气转好；雨停；平静天气；雨天结束

teaching_sense.en_definition: For the weather to become fine or for rain to stop.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指天气转好，或降雨停止。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta t-temp jitjieb jew tieqaf ix-xita.

sense_translations.en_definition: to become fine (used of the weather)
sense_translations.zh_definition: （天气）转好；放晴。
停止下雨；雨停。
平静、安稳的天气。
雨天的结束；降雨天气的终止。

collocations.en: the weather cleared after the rain

formal.mt: Wara diversi sigħat ta' xita, saħa u l-grupp seta' jkompli l-mixja.
formal.en: After several hours of rain, the weather cleared and the group was able to continue the walk.
formal.zh: 下了几个小时的雨后，天气转好了，队伍得以继续步行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadha nieżla x-xita? Pawlu: Le, fl-aħħar saħa. Nistgħu noħorġu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is it still raining? Pawlu: No, it has finally stopped. We can go out.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：还在下雨吗？保罗：没有，雨终于停了。我们可以出去了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 还在下雨吗？
messages.en: Is it still raining?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 没有，雨终于停了。我们可以出去了。
messages.en: No, it has finally stopped. We can go out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用收起雨伞、天空转晴的连续画面记 saħa；动词记变化，名词另记平静天气或雨天结束。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The geographical name Western Sahara, referring to a territory in North Africa.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 西撒哈拉，北非一片地区的地理专名。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem ġeografiku ta' territorju fl-Afrika ta' Fuq.

sense_translations.en_definition: Western Sahara (a territory and former Spanish colony in North Africa; about 70% is occupied by Morocco, which claims ownership over the territory as its Southern Provinces, while 30% is governed by its native inhabitants as the Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic; official name: Saħara tal-Punent)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 西撒哈拉（北非的一个地区，曾为西班牙殖民地；约70%的地区由摩洛哥占据，摩洛哥将该地区称为其南部省份并主张拥有主权；其余30%由当地居民以阿拉伯撒哈拉民主共和国的形式治理；正式名称：Saħara tal-Punent）。

formal.mt: Fil-lezzjoni tal-ġeografija, l-istudenti sabu s-Saħara tal-Punent fuq mappa tal-Afrika ta' Fuq.
formal.en: In the geography lesson, the students located Western Sahara on a map of North Africa.
formal.zh: 地理课上，学生们在北非地图上找到了西撒哈拉。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hi s-Saħara tal-Punent fuq din il-mappa? Mark: Hawn, fl-Afrika ta' Fuq.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is Western Sahara on this map? Mark: Here, in North Africa.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：西撒哈拉在这张地图的哪里？马克：这里，在北非。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hi s-Saħara tal-Punent fuq din il-mappa?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hi s-Saħara tal-Punent fuq din il-mappa?
messages.zh: 西撒哈拉在这张地图的哪里？
messages.en: Where is Western Sahara on this map?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 这里，在北非。
messages.en: Here, in North Africa.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在北非地图上把 Saħara tal-Punent 与西撒哈拉并排标注，按完整地名记忆，并留意专名的大写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state of anger, or, in a sexual context, a state of sexual arousal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 愤怒、怒气的状态；在性相关语境中也指性兴奋状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' rabja jew, f'kuntest sesswali, stat ta' tqanqil sesswali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 怒气；愤怒的情绪。
性兴奋；受到性刺激而产生的兴奋状态。

collocations.en: in the heat of the moment

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, l-awtur jiddeskrivi s-saħna sesswali tal-karattru b'lingwaġġ diskret.
formal.en: In the novel, the author describes the character's sexual arousal in discreet language.
formal.zh: 在小说中，作者用含蓄的语言描写人物的性兴奋。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għadek irrabjat għal dak li ġara? Luqa: Le, is-saħna għaddietli. Issa nistgħu nitkellmu bil-kalma.
colloquial.en: Anna: Are you still angry about what happened? Luqa: No, my anger has passed. Now we can talk calmly.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你还在为刚才的事生气吗？Luqa：不，气已经消了。现在我们可以平静地谈谈。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadek irrabjat għal dak li ġara?
messages.mt_standard: Għadek irrabjat għal dak li ġara?
messages.zh: 你还在为刚才的事生气吗？
messages.en: Are you still angry about what happened?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, is-saħna għaddietli. Issa nistgħu nitkellmu bil-kalma.
messages.mt_standard: Le, is-saħna għaddietli. Issa nistgħu nitkellmu bil-kalma.
messages.zh: 不，气已经消了。现在我们可以平静地谈谈。
messages.en: No, my anger has passed. Now we can talk calmly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用中文“情绪升温”作学习联想，并分开记两张语境卡：争执时是怒气，明确的性相关语境中是性兴奋；这只是记忆方法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The ending of a period of rainy weather.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一段降雨天气的结束，指雨停下来、天气转好的时候。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tmiem ta' perjodu ta' temp bix-xita.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 降雨天气的结束；雨停。

collocations.en: wait for the rainy weather to end
after the rainy weather has ended

formal.mt: Wara sigħat ta' xita, waslet is-saħwa u l-ħaddiema komplew ix-xogħol barra.
formal.en: After hours of rain, the rainy weather ended and the workers resumed their outdoor work.
formal.zh: 下了几个小时的雨后，雨终于停了，工人们继续户外作业。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Noħorġu issa? Luqa: Nistennew is-saħwa; għadha nieżla x-xita.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we go out now? Luqa: Let's wait for the rain to stop; it's still raining.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们现在出去吗？卢卡：等雨停吧，现在还在下。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们现在出去吗？
messages.en: Shall we go out now?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 等雨停吧，现在还在下。
messages.en: Let's wait for the rain to stop; it's still raining.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 saħwa 放进“收起雨伞、重新出门”的画面里，重点记住它表示一段雨天结束，而不只是天空中出现阳光。

gloss_zh: 使云层覆盖；联结他人的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cover the sky or another area with clouds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使天空或某一区域被云层覆盖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jgħatti s-sema jew żona oħra bis-sħab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使布满云；用云层覆盖。
使他人结成联系或聚到一起的人。

collocations.zh: 使地平线一带被云覆盖

formal.mt: Ir-riħ saħħab is-sema, u ftit wara bdiet nieżla x-xita.
formal.en: The wind covered the sky with clouds, and shortly afterwards it began to rain.
formal.zh: 风使天空布满云层，不久便下起雨来。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Ara kemm saħħab is-sema dan ir-riħ! Toni: Iva, aħjar nieħdu umbrella magħna.
colloquial.en: Anna: Look how this wind has covered the sky with clouds! Toni: Yes, we'd better take an umbrella with us.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：瞧，这阵风把云吹得满天都是！托尼：是啊，我们最好带把伞。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara kemm saħħab is-sema dan ir-riħ!
messages.mt_standard: Ara kemm saħħab is-sema dan ir-riħ!
messages.zh: 瞧，这阵风把云吹得满天都是！
messages.en: Look how this wind has covered the sky with clouds!

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，我们最好带把伞。
messages.en: Yes, we'd better take an umbrella with us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用云层逐渐盖满天空的动画记 saħħab 的动词义；名词义另画一位把大家联结起来的人，分卡记忆。

gloss_zh: 易转多云的；友好的；合群的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to become cloudy; also describing someone who is friendly or enjoys being with other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容天气容易转为多云；也形容人友好、喜欢与他人相处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jissaħħab; ukoll, li hu dħuli jew iħobb ikun ma' nies oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易转为多云的；有趋于云层增多倾向的。
友好的；待人亲切的。
合群的；喜欢与他人相处的。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, Mark huwa deskritt bħala kollega saħħabi li jilqa' lill-membri l-ġodda u jieħu gost jaħdem ma' ħaddieħor.
formal.en: In the report, Mark is described as a friendly, sociable colleague who welcomes new members and enjoys working with others.
formal.zh: 报告将马克描述为一位友好、合群的同事，他欢迎新成员，也乐于与他人共事。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif inhu l-kollega l-ġdid? Pawlu: Saħħabi ħafna; diġà stidinna nieħdu kafè flimkien.
colloquial.en: Sara: What's the new colleague like? Pawlu: Very friendly and sociable; he has already invited us to have coffee together.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：新同事怎么样？保罗：特别友好，也很合群；他已经邀请我们一起喝咖啡了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 新同事怎么样？
messages.en: What's the new colleague like?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Saħħabi ħafna; diġà stidinna nieħdu kafè flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Saħħabi ħafna; diġà stidinna nieħdu kafè flimkien.
messages.zh: 特别友好，也很合群；他已经邀请我们一起喝咖啡了。
messages.en: Very friendly and sociable; he has already invited us to have coffee together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 saħħabi 做两幅情景卡：天气卡画云渐多，人物卡画友好同事邀大家喝咖啡，靠所修饰的对象选义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To force a person or animal to wallow in mud.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 强迫人或动物在泥里翻滚、打滚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil persuna jew annimal jitmiegħek fit-tajn.

sense_translations.en_definition: to force to wallow in mud
sense_translations.zh_definition: 强迫某人或某动物在泥里打滚。

collocations.en: force the animal to wallow in mud
force the pig to wallow in a muddy pool

formal.mt: Fix-xena tar-rakkont, ir-raġel saħħam lill-annimal minkejja li dan ipprova jaħrab.
formal.en: In the scene from the story, the man forced the animal to wallow in mud even though it tried to escape.
formal.zh: 在故事的这一幕中，尽管动物试图逃跑，那个人仍强迫它在泥里打滚。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-ħanżir daħal fit-tajn waħdu? Mark: Le, ir-raġel saħħam lill-ħanżir. Ma ħalliehx joħroġ.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did the pig go into the mud by itself? Mark: No, the man forced the pig to wallow in it. He wouldn't let it out.
colloquial.zh: Nina：那头猪是自己走进泥里的吗？Mark：不是，那个人强迫它在泥里打滚，还不让它出来。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 那头猪是自己走进泥里的吗？
messages.en: Did the pig go into the mud by itself?

messages.speaker: Mark (目击者)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ir-raġel saħħam lill-ħanżir. Ma ħalliehx joħroġ.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ir-raġel saħħam lill-ħanżir. Ma ħalliehx joħroġ.
messages.zh: 不是，那个人强迫它在泥里打滚，还不让它出来。
messages.en: No, the man forced the pig to wallow in it. He wouldn't let it out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记成“泥潭旁有人强迫”的完整画面：这个词同时包含强迫和在泥里打滚两个要点，不能只记成弄脏或自愿玩泥。

gloss_zh: 有使变暖作用的；有使兴奋作用的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to produce warmth or to excite someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有使人或事物变暖，或使人兴奋、激动的倾向的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jsaħħan jew iqanqal eċċitament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有使变暖作用的；倾向于带来暖意的。
具有使人兴奋或激动作用的。

formal.mt: Ir-ritmu saħħani tal-mużika qanqal l-entużjażmu tal-udjenza.
formal.en: The exciting rhythm of the music stirred the audience's enthusiasm.
formal.zh: 音乐中使人兴奋的节奏激起了观众的热情。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Din il-kutra tgħinni nħossni aktar sħuna? Ġanni: Iva, għandha effett saħħani. Poġġiha fuq irkopptejk.
colloquial.en: Marta: Will this blanket help me feel warmer? Ġanni: Yes, it has a warming effect. Put it over your knees.
colloquial.zh: Marta：这条毯子能让我暖和一点吗？Ġanni：能，它有保暖作用。盖在膝盖上吧。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-kutra tgħinni nħossni aktar sħuna?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-kutra tgħinni nħossni aktar sħuna?
messages.zh: 这条毯子能让我暖和一点吗？
messages.en: Will this blanket help me feel warmer?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandha effett saħħani. Poġġiha fuq irkopptejk.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandha effett saħħani. Poġġiha fuq irkopptejk.
messages.zh: 能，它有保暖作用。盖在膝盖上吧。
messages.en: Yes, it has a warming effect. Put it over your knees.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张学习卡记忆：一张是毯子带来暖意，一张是节奏激起兴奋；分别对应身体变暖和情绪被激发的两种作用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having an effect that crushes something through pressure or force.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有通过压力或力量把东西压碎的作用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu effett li jgħaffeġ jew ifarrak xi ħaġa bil-pressjoni jew bil-forza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有压碎、碾碎作用的。

formal.mt: Il-makkinarju għandu effett saħħaqi fuq il-ġebel, li jinbidel f'biċċiet iżgħar.
formal.en: The machinery has a crushing effect on the stone, which is reduced to smaller pieces.
formal.zh: 这套机械对石头有压碎作用，使石头变成更小的碎块。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex dan il-ġebel sar biċċiet żgħar? David: Il-magna għandha effett saħħaqi. Tgħaffeġ il-ġebel.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why has this stone turned into small pieces? David: The machine has a crushing effect. It crushes the stone.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这些石头怎么变成小碎块了？David：这台机器有压碎作用，会把石头碾碎。

messages.speaker: Sara (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan il-ġebel sar biċċiet żgħar?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan il-ġebel sar biċċiet żgħar?
messages.zh: 这些石头怎么变成小碎块了？
messages.en: Why has this stone turned into small pieces?

messages.speaker: David (操作员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-magna għandha effett saħħaqi. Tgħaffeġ il-ġebel.
messages.mt_standard: Il-magna għandha effett saħħaqi. Tgħaffeġ il-ġebel.
messages.zh: 这台机器有压碎作用，会把石头碾碎。
messages.en: The machine has a crushing effect. It crushes the stone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象大石头经过机器后变成碎块，把这个词贴在机器的作用上：它描述有压碎效果，记忆重点是力量造成的破碎。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A female figure who uses magic in a story, understood as a witch, sorceress, or fairy according to context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 故事中施展魔法的女性角色，依语境可指女巫、女术士或仙女。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Figura femminili fi storja li tuża l-maġija, u li tista' tkun mara li tagħmel is-seħer jew figura maġika li tgħin lill-oħrajn, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 女巫；施展巫术或魔法的女性。
仙女；童话中具有魔法力量的女性精灵。

formal.mt: Fil-ħrafa, is-saħħara tajba użat il-maġija biex tgħin lill-prinċipessa ssib it-triq lejn id-dar.
formal.en: In the fairy tale, the good fairy used magic to help the princess find her way home.
formal.zh: 在这个童话中，善良的仙女施展魔法，帮助公主找到回家的路。

colloquial.mt: Ella: Min hi dik fuq ix-xkupa fl-istampa? Omm: Dik saħħara. F'din l-istorja tgħix f'dar fil-bosk.
colloquial.en: Ella: Who is that on the broom in the picture? Mum: That's a witch. In this story, she lives in a house in the woods.
colloquial.zh: Ella：图里骑扫帚的那位是谁？妈妈：那是女巫。在这个故事里，她住在森林中的一所房子里。

messages.speaker: Ella (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hi dik fuq ix-xkupa fl-istampa?
messages.mt_standard: Min hi dik fuq ix-xkupa fl-istampa?
messages.zh: 图里骑扫帚的那位是谁？
messages.en: Who is that on the broom in the picture?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik saħħara. F'din l-istorja tgħix f'dar fil-bosk.
messages.mt_standard: Dik saħħara. F'din l-istorja tgħix f'dar fil-bosk.
messages.zh: 那是女巫。在这个故事里，她住在森林中的一所房子里。
messages.en: That's a witch. In this story, she lives in a house in the woods.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一位会魔法的故事女性，旁边放扫帚和魔杖两种道具；结合具体故事判断是女巫还是仙女，不要只凭词形判断善恶。

gloss_zh: 迷人的；令人入迷的；摄人心神的

teaching_sense.en_definition: So charming or captivating that it holds someone's attention and imagination.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 非常迷人，能够吸引注意力、牵动想象并使人入迷的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiġbed l-attenzjoni u l-immaġinazzjoni tant li wieħed jibqa' affaxxinat bih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 迷人的；富有吸引力、令人喜爱的。
令人入迷的；牢牢吸引注意力的。
摄人心神的；仿佛有魔力般使人着迷的。

formal.mt: Il-kantant, bil-leħen saħħari tiegħu, żamm lill-udjenza attenta sal-aħħar tal-kunċert.
formal.en: With his bewitching voice, the singer held the audience's attention until the end of the concert.
formal.zh: 这位歌手凭借摄人心神的嗓音，让观众一直专注到音乐会结束。

colloquial.mt: Julia: Għoġbok il-post? Ben: Ħafna! Il-pajsaġġ saħħari; stajt nibqa' nħares lejh għal sigħat.
colloquial.en: Julia: Did you like the place? Ben: Very much! The landscape is enchanting; I could have kept looking at it for hours.
colloquial.zh: Julia：你喜欢那个地方吗？Ben：特别喜欢！风景太迷人了，我能看上好几个小时。

messages.speaker: Julia (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢那个地方吗？
messages.en: Did you like the place?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħafna! Il-pajsaġġ saħħari; stajt nibqa' nħares lejh għal sigħat.
messages.mt_standard: Ħafna! Il-pajsaġġ saħħari; stajt nibqa' nħares lejh għal sigħat.
messages.zh: 特别喜欢！风景太迷人了，我能看上好几个小时。
messages.en: Very much! The landscape is enchanting; I could have kept looking at it for hours.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象听到歌声或看到风景后舍不得移开注意力，把“迷人、入迷、摄人心神”排成吸引力逐渐增强的三格学习画面。

gloss_zh: 加强；维持；使强大；使振奋；增强者

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone or something stronger, more effective, or better able to endure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人或事物更加有力、更有效，或更能承受困难。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa aktar b'saħħitha, aktar effettiva jew aktar kapaċi tiflaħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 加强；增强力量、能力或稳固程度。
支持并维持，使其能够继续或保持力量。
使强大；增强实力或影响力。
使振奋；使恢复精神或活力。
增强者；给予他人或事物力量的人。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport saħħaħ l-argument favur aktar investiment fl-edukazzjoni.
formal.en: The report strengthened the argument for greater investment in education.
formal.zh: 这份报告增强了支持加大教育投资的论证力度。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif mar it-taħriġ? Pawlu: Tajjeb ħafna. Saħħaħ il-muskoli ta' saqajja.
colloquial.en: Marija: How did the training go? Pawlu: Very well. It strengthened my leg muscles.
colloquial.zh: Marija：训练怎么样？Pawlu：很好，增强了我的腿部肌肉力量。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 训练怎么样？
messages.en: How did the training go?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb ħafna. Saħħaħ il-muskoli ta' saqajja.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb ħafna. Saħħaħ il-muskoli ta' saqajja.
messages.zh: 很好，增强了我的腿部肌肉力量。
messages.en: Very well. It strengthened my leg muscles.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上“给力量加一格”的画面：肌肉、论证、实力和精神都能得到增强；名词义则指提供这种力量的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to make someone or something stronger.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有使人或事物变得更强的倾向或作用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jagħmel lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa aktar b'saħħitha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于增强的；具有加强作用的。

formal.mt: Dan l-eżerċizzju għandu effett saħħaħi fuq il-muskoli tad-dahar.
formal.en: This exercise has a strengthening effect on the back muscles.
formal.zh: 这项练习对背部肌肉有增强作用。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan l-eżerċizzju jgħinni nsaħħaħ idejja? Toni: Iva, għandu effett saħħaħi fuq il-muskoli ta' dirgħajk.
colloquial.en: Lara: Will this exercise help me strengthen my arms? Toni: Yes, it has a strengthening effect on your arm muscles.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这项练习能帮我增强手臂力量吗？Toni：能，它对你的手臂肌肉有增强作用。

messages.speaker: Lara (学员)
messages.zh: 这项练习能帮我增强手臂力量吗？
messages.en: Will this exercise help me strengthen my arms?

messages.speaker: Toni (教练)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandu effett saħħaħi fuq il-muskoli ta' dirgħajk.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandu effett saħħaħi fuq il-muskoli ta' dirgħajk.
messages.zh: 能，它对你的手臂肌肉有增强作用。
messages.en: Yes, it has a strengthening effect on your arm muscles.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“贴在练习旁边的增强标签”记忆：这个形容词描述某物具有增强作用，重点是作用倾向，不是已经完成的增强动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number 17,000, equal to seventeen groups of one thousand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数值为17,000，即十七个一千。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 17,000, jiġifieri sbatax immultiplikat b'elf.

formal.mt: Il-baġit approvat għall-proġett huwa ta' sbatax-il elf ewro.
formal.en: The approved budget for the project is seventeen thousand euros.
formal.zh: 该项目获批的预算为一万七千欧元。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kemm tiswa l-karozza? Mark: Sbatax-il elf ewro.
colloquial.en: Anna: How much does the car cost? Mark: Seventeen thousand euros.
colloquial.zh: Anna：这辆车多少钱？Mark：一万七千欧元。

messages.speaker: Anna (顾客)
messages.zh: 这辆车多少钱？
messages.en: How much does the car cost?

messages.speaker: Mark (销售员)
messages.zh: 一万七千欧元。
messages.en: Seventeen thousand euros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把数字画成十七包、每包一千：17 × 1000 = 17000，对应中文“一万七千”，避免误读成一千七百。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Pleasant or attractive in appearance; handsome, pretty, or cute according to context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 外貌讨人喜欢或有吸引力的；根据语境可译为俊俏、漂亮或可爱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu dehra sabiħa jew ħelwa u jogħġob fl-apparenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 英俊的；俊俏的。
漂亮的；好看的。
可爱的；模样讨人喜欢的。

formal.mt: L-illustrazzjoni turi tifel sbejjaħ bilqiegħda ħdejn kelb.
formal.en: The illustration shows a handsome little boy sitting beside a dog.
formal.zh: 插图描绘了一个坐在狗旁边的俊俏小男孩。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara dak il-ġeru! Kemm hu sbejjaħ! Ben: Iva, għandu wiċċ ħelu ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look at that puppy! How cute he is! Ben: Yes, he has such a sweet face.
colloquial.zh: Lara：看那只小狗！真可爱！Ben：是啊，它的小脸特别讨人喜欢。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dak il-ġeru! Kemm hu sbejjaħ!
messages.mt_standard: Ara dak il-ġeru! Kemm hu sbejjaħ!
messages.zh: 看那只小狗！真可爱！
messages.en: Look at that puppy! How cute he is!

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，它的小脸特别讨人喜欢。
messages.en: Yes, he has such a sweet face.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张好看面孔联记 sbejjaħ：俊俏男孩、漂亮面容、可爱小狗；译成中文时跟着描述对象选择词语。

gloss_zh: 摘除树叶；剥去树木的叶子

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of stripping the leaves from a tree.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把树上的叶子摘除或剥去这一行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li jitneħħa l-weraq minn fuq siġra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 摘除树上的叶子；将树木去叶的行为。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi s-sbik tas-siġra u jsemmi li l-weraq tneħħa bl-idejn.
formal.en: The report describes the stripping of leaves from the tree and states that the leaves were removed by hand.
formal.zh: 报告描述了给这棵树去叶的过程，并说明树叶是用手摘除的。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Sbik ifisser li tneħħi l-qoxra tas-siġra? Pawlu: Le, ifisser it-tneħħija tal-weraq minn fuq is-siġra.
colloquial.en: Rita: Does sbik mean removing the tree's bark? Pawlu: No, it means removing the leaves from the tree.
colloquial.zh: Rita：sbik 是指剥掉树皮吗？Pawlu：不是，是指摘除树上的叶子。

messages.speaker: Rita (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Sbik ifisser li tneħħi l-qoxra tas-siġra?
messages.mt_standard: Sbik ifisser li tneħħi l-qoxra tas-siġra?
messages.zh: sbik 是指剥掉树皮吗？
messages.en: Does sbik mean removing the tree's bark?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ifisser it-tneħħija tal-weraq minn fuq is-siġra.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ifisser it-tneħħija tal-weraq minn fuq is-siġra.
messages.zh: 不是，是指摘除树上的叶子。
messages.en: No, it means removing the leaves from the tree.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手把枝条上的叶子一片片摘下，留下枝条；用这个动作画面记住 sbik 的对象是树叶。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of doing better than others or going beyond an existing level of achievement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在表现或成就上胜过别人，或超越已有水平的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed imur aħjar minn oħrajn jew jaqbeż livell ta' kisba li jkun diġà ntlaħaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 做得比别人更好；在表现上胜过别人。
超越某人或某个已有水平。

formal.mt: L-għan tat-taħriġ huwa t-titjib personali, mhux biss is-sbiq tal-kompetituri.
formal.en: The aim of training is personal improvement, not only outdoing competitors.
formal.zh: 训练的目标是提升自己，而不只是胜过竞争对手。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għalik, l-isport huwa biss is-sbiq tal-oħrajn? Pawlu: Le, irrid ukoll intejjeb il-ħin tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Maja: For you, is sport only about outdoing others? Pawlu: No, I also want to improve my time.
colloquial.zh: Maja：对你来说，运动就只是胜过别人吗？Pawlu：不是，我也想提高自己的计时成绩。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għalik, l-isport huwa biss is-sbiq tal-oħrajn?
messages.mt_standard: Għalik, l-isport huwa biss is-sbiq tal-oħrajn?
messages.zh: 对你来说，运动就只是胜过别人吗？
messages.en: For you, is sport only about outdoing others?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, irrid ukoll intejjeb il-ħin tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Le, irrid ukoll intejjeb il-ħin tiegħi.
messages.zh: 不是，我也想提高自己的计时成绩。
messages.en: No, I also want to improve my time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sbiq 想成比赛中的超越动作：超过对手是胜过，突破旧水平也是超越。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of allowing someone extra time to make a payment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 允许他人推迟付款、给予额外付款时间的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għoti ta' aktar żmien lil xi ħadd biex iħallas.

sense_translations.en_definition: cutting sb. some slack to delay payment
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在付款期限上通融，允许某人延期付款。

collocations.en: leniency over the timing of payment

formal.mt: Is-sbir fil-ħlas jagħti lill-klijent aktar żmien biex iħallas il-kont.
formal.en: Allowing a delay in payment gives the customer more time to pay the bill.
formal.zh: 准许延期付款，可以让客户有更多时间支付账单。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nista' nitlob ftit sbir fil-ħlas? Rita: Iva, tista' tħallas il-ġimgħa d-dieħla.
colloquial.en: Mark: Could I ask for a little extra time to pay? Rita: Yes, you can pay next week.
colloquial.zh: Mark：付款可以稍微宽限一下吗？Rita：可以，你下周付款就行。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 付款可以稍微宽限一下吗？
messages.en: Could I ask for a little extra time to pay?

messages.speaker: Rita (店主)
messages.zh: 可以，你下周付款就行。
messages.en: Yes, you can pay next week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 sbir 时站在收款方的位置：把付款期限放宽一些，让对方晚一点付。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of putting off payment of money that one owes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把自己应当缴付的款项推迟支付的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed iħalli għal aktar tard il-ħlas ta' dak li għandu jagħti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 推迟缴付自己应付的费用或欠款。

collocations.en: a month's postponement of paying what one owes
collocations.zh: 把应付款项推迟一个月缴付

formal.mt: Is-sbira fil-ħlas tal-miżata ma tneħħix l-obbligu li din titħallas.
formal.en: Putting off payment of the fee does not remove the obligation to pay it.
formal.zh: 延后缴费并不免除缴付这笔费用的义务。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għadek ma ħallastx il-miżata? Toni: Le, għamilt sbira ta' ġimgħa, imma nħallas għada.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have you still not paid the fee? Toni: No, I put it off for a week, but I'll pay tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你还没缴费吗？Toni：还没，我推迟了一个星期，不过明天会付。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你还没缴费吗？
messages.en: Have you still not paid the fee?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għamilt sbira ta' ġimgħa, imma nħallas għada.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għamilt sbira ta' ġimgħa, imma nħallas għada.
messages.zh: 还没，我推迟了一个星期，不过明天会付。
messages.en: No, I put it off for a week, but I'll pay tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 sbira 时站在付款方的位置：轮到自己缴钱，却把付款往后推迟。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of banging something or shutting it forcefully, especially a door.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用力敲撞某物，或猛力将其关上，尤指摔门。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed iħabbat xi ħaġa bil-qawwa jew jagħlaqha b'daqqa qawwija, speċjalment bieb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用力敲打或撞击，发出砰砰声。
猛力关上，尤指摔门。

formal.mt: Is-sbit tal-bibien matul il-lejl jista' jfixkel l-irqad tar-residenti.
formal.en: The slamming of doors during the night can disturb residents' sleep.
formal.zh: 夜间摔门可能会打扰住户睡觉。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu dan is-sbit kollu? Ben: Ir-riħ qed jagħlaq il-bieb bil-qawwa; se nwaħħlu.
colloquial.en: Sara: What's all this banging? Ben: The wind is slamming the door; I'll secure it.
colloquial.zh: Sara：怎么一直砰砰响？Ben：风把门吹得猛关，我去把它固定好。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 怎么一直砰砰响？
messages.en: What's all this banging?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-riħ qed jagħlaq il-bieb bil-qawwa; se nwaħħlu.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-riħ qed jagħlaq il-bieb bil-qawwa; se nwaħħlu.
messages.zh: 风把门吹得猛关，我去把它固定好。
messages.en: The wind is slamming the door; I'll secure it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sbit 配上一幅门被猛力关上的画面，并在脑中加上砰的一声来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The grain-bearing heads of cereal plants, such as wheat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小麦等谷类植物上结有谷粒的穗部，可用于统称谷穗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-partijiet ta' fuq ta' pjanti bħall-qamħ li jġorru l-ħbub, meqjusa flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 谷物的穗；结有谷粒的穗部。

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw is-sbul tal-qamħ u eżaminaw il-ħbub li kien fih.
formal.en: The students observed the ears of wheat and examined the grains they contained.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了麦穗，并检查了其中的麦粒。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Ara kemm hemm sbul misjur f'din l-għalqa! Ġużeppi: Iva, il-bidwi dalwaqt jibda l-ħsad.
colloquial.en: Lina: Look how many ripe ears of grain there are in this field! Ġużeppi: Yes, the farmer will soon start harvesting.
colloquial.zh: Lina：看，这块田里有这么多成熟的谷穗！Ġużeppi：是啊，农民很快就要开始收割了。

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara kemm hemm sbul misjur f'din l-għalqa!
messages.mt_standard: Ara kemm hemm sbul misjur f'din l-għalqa!
messages.zh: 看，这块田里有这么多成熟的谷穗！
messages.en: Look how many ripe ears of grain there are in this field!

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，农民很快就要开始收割了。
messages.en: Yes, the farmer will soon start harvesting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sbul 放进整片麦田的画面中记忆：关注枝头结着谷粒的一片片谷穗。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A single grain-bearing ear of a cereal plant, such as wheat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 谷类植物上一支结有谷粒的穗，例如一支麦穗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti waħda fil-quċċata ta' pjanta bħall-qamħ li ġġorr il-ħbub.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一穗谷物；一支结有谷粒的穗，例如麦穗。

formal.mt: Kull student irċieva sbula tal-qamħ biex josserva kif il-ħbub huma mqassma fiha.
formal.en: Each student received an ear of wheat to observe how the grains are arranged in it.
formal.zh: 每位学生都拿到了一支麦穗，用来观察麦粒在穗中的排列方式。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'għandek f'idek? Adam: Sbula tal-qamħ; ara kemm għandha ħbub!
colloquial.en: Nina: What have you got in your hand? Adam: An ear of wheat; look how many grains it has!
colloquial.zh: Nina：你手里拿着什么？Adam：一支麦穗，你看上面有多少麦粒！

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 你手里拿着什么？
messages.en: What have you got in your hand?

messages.speaker: Adam (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Sbula tal-qamħ; ara kemm għandha ħbub!
messages.mt_standard: Sbula tal-qamħ; ara kemm għandha ħbub!
messages.zh: 一支麦穗，你看上面有多少麦粒！
messages.en: An ear of wheat; look how many grains it has!

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 sbula 时想象手中拿着一支完整麦穗：数的是一支穗，而不是一粒麦子。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being beautiful, whether in appearance, nature, art, or character.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 外貌、自然景物、艺术或品格所具有的美好特质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' dak li hu sabiħ fid-dehra, fin-natura, fl-arti jew fil-karattru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 美；美丽；使人感到赏心悦目或内心美好的特质。

formal.mt: Il-wirja tenfasizza s-sbuħija naturali tal-gżejjer permezz ta' ritratti tal-kosta.
formal.en: The exhibition highlights the islands' natural beauty through photographs of the coast.
formal.zh: 这场展览通过海岸照片展现群岛的自然之美。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara s-sbuħija ta' din il-veduta! Noel: Iva, ejja nieqfu ftit u nieħdu ritratt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at the beauty of this view! Noel: Yes, let's stop for a moment and take a photo.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你看这景色多美！Noel：是啊，我们停一会儿拍张照吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看这景色多美！
messages.en: Look at the beauty of this view!

messages.speaker: Noel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja nieqfu ftit u nieħdu ritratt.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja nieqfu ftit u nieħdu ritratt.
messages.zh: 是啊，我们停一会儿拍张照吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's stop for a moment and take a photo.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sbuħija 写在一张美景照片旁，再联想到人的内在美，记住它表示美这一特质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A family name used to identify a person or family.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用作个人或家族姓氏的专有名称，书写时首字母大写为 Scerri。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom li jidentifika persuna jew familja u jinkiteb Scerri b'ittra kapitali fil-bidu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姓氏 Scerri。

formal.mt: Is-Sinjura Scerri ppreżentat ir-rapport waqt il-laqgħa.
formal.en: Ms Scerri presented the report during the meeting.
formal.zh: Scerri 女士在会议上提交并介绍了报告。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għandi appuntament mas-Sinjura Scerri. Mark: Tajjeb, qiegħda fl-uffiċċju; se ngħidilha li wasalt.
colloquial.en: Rita: I have an appointment with Ms Scerri. Mark: All right, she's in the office; I'll tell her you've arrived.
colloquial.zh: Rita：我和 Scerri 女士有预约。Mark：好的，她在办公室，我去告诉她你到了。

messages.speaker: Rita (访客)
messages.zh: 我和 Scerri 女士有预约。
messages.en: I have an appointment with Ms Scerri.

messages.speaker: Mark (接待员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, qiegħda fl-uffiċċju; se ngħidilha li wasalt.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, qiegħda fl-uffiċċju; se ngħidilha li wasalt.
messages.zh: 好的，她在办公室，我去告诉她你到了。
messages.en: All right, she's in the office; I'll tell her you've arrived.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Scerri 想成门牌上的一家人姓氏，看到大写字母 S 就提醒自己这是专有名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A surname used to identify a person or family.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于标识个人或家族的姓氏 Schembri。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom li jintuża biex jidentifika persuna jew familja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姓氏 Schembri。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kunjom.

formal.mt: Is-Sur Schembri ppreżenta r-rapport waqt il-laqgħa.
formal.en: Mr Schembri presented the report during the meeting.
formal.zh: Schembri 先生在会议期间提交并介绍了报告。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jismu l-għalliem il-ġdid? Mark: Is-Sur Schembri. Għada niltaqgħu miegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's the new teacher's name? Mark: Mr Schembri. We're meeting him tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: Lara：新老师叫什么名字？Mark：Schembri 先生。我们明天会见到他。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 新老师叫什么名字？
messages.en: What's the new teacher's name?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: Schembri 先生。我们明天会见到他。
messages.en: Mr Schembri. We're meeting him tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Schembri 写在姓名卡的姓氏栏，再搭配 is-Sur 练习称呼，记住它表示姓氏。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A surname used to identify a person or family.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于标识个人或家族的姓氏 Sciberras。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom li jintuża biex jidentifika persuna jew familja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姓氏 Sciberras。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kunjom.

formal.mt: Is-Sinjura Sciberras bagħtet it-talba bil-miktub lill-uffiċċju.
formal.en: Ms Sciberras sent the written request to the office.
formal.zh: Sciberras 女士向办公室寄送了书面申请。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandi appuntament mas-Sinjura Sciberras. Paul: Tajjeb, għidilha li wasalt.
colloquial.en: Nina: I have an appointment with Ms Sciberras. Paul: All right, tell her you've arrived.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我和 Sciberras 女士有预约。Paul：好的，告诉她你已经到了。

messages.speaker: Nina (访客)
messages.zh: 我和 Sciberras 女士有预约。
messages.en: I have an appointment with Ms Sciberras.

messages.speaker: Paul (接待员)
messages.zh: 好的，告诉她你已经到了。
messages.en: All right, tell her you've arrived.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象预约名单上写着 Sciberras，并用 is-Sinjura Sciberras 称呼来访者，把姓氏和人物联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A surname used to identify a person or family.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于标识个人或家族的姓氏 Sciriha。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom li jintuża biex jidentifika persuna jew familja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姓氏 Sciriha。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kunjom.

formal.mt: Is-Sur Sciriha ffirma d-dokument quddiem is-segretarju.
formal.en: Mr Sciriha signed the document in front of the secretary.
formal.zh: Sciriha 先生当着秘书的面签署了文件。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Din l-ittra għall-familja Sciriha? David: Iva, ħalliha fil-kaxxa tal-ittri tagħhom.
colloquial.en: Anna: Is this letter for the Sciriha family? David: Yes, leave it in their letterbox.
colloquial.zh: Anna：这封信是给 Sciriha 一家的吗？David：是的，放进他们的信箱吧。

messages.speaker: Anna (邻居)
messages.zh: 这封信是给 Sciriha 一家的吗？
messages.en: Is this letter for the Sciriha family?

messages.speaker: David (邻居)
messages.zh: 是的，放进他们的信箱吧。
messages.en: Yes, leave it in their letterbox.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象信箱上贴着 Sciriha 姓氏标签，再读 il-familja Sciriha，把这个姓与一家人的画面绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element called seaborgium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 名为𬭳的化学元素，英语称 seaborgium。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-element kimiku magħruf bħala seaborgju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 𬭳，一种化学元素。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Element kimiku msejjaħ seaborgju.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinkludi taqsima dwar l-element kimiku seaborgju.
formal.en: The report includes a section on the chemical element seaborgium.
formal.zh: 该报告包含一个介绍化学元素𬭳的章节。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu s-seaborgju? Luke: Huwa element kimiku; rajt ismu fil-ktieb tal-kimika.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is seaborgium? Luke: It's a chemical element; I saw its name in the chemistry book.
colloquial.zh: Maja：𬭳是什么？Luke：它是一种化学元素；我在化学课本里见过它的名字。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 𬭳是什么？
messages.en: What is seaborgium?

messages.speaker: Luke (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa element kimiku; rajt ismu fil-ktieb tal-kimika.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa element kimiku; rajt ismu fil-ktieb tal-kimika.
messages.zh: 它是一种化学元素；我在化学课本里见过它的名字。
messages.en: It's a chemical element; I saw its name in the chemistry book.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张三语元素卡：seaborgju、seaborgium、𬭳；共同的 seaborg 字母串可以帮助对应两种外语拼写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number seven hundred, written as 700.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数词七百，写作 700，表示七个一百。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 700, jiġifieri seba' gruppi ta' mija.

sense_translations.mt_definition: In-numru 700.

formal.mt: L-għadd totali ta' parteċipanti kien ta' seba' mija.
formal.en: The total number of participants was seven hundred.
formal.zh: 参加者总人数为七百人。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kemm kien it-total? Ben: Seba' mija eżatt. Għaddejthom darbtejn.
colloquial.en: Sara: What was the total? Ben: Exactly seven hundred. I counted them twice.
colloquial.zh: Sara：总数是多少？Ben：正好七百。我数过两遍了。

messages.speaker: Sara (活动组织者)
messages.zh: 总数是多少？
messages.en: What was the total?

messages.speaker: Ben (志愿者)
messages.zh: 正好七百。我数过两遍了。
messages.en: Exactly seven hundred. I counted them twice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画七捆卡片，每捆标一百，合起来就是 seba' mija；把整个短语与数字 700 一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number seven thousand, written as 7,000.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数词七千，写作 7,000，表示七个一千。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 7,000, jiġifieri seba' gruppi ta' elf.

sense_translations.mt_definition: In-numru 7,000.

formal.mt: L-ispiża totali tal-proġett kienet ta' sebat elef ewro.
formal.en: The total cost of the project was seven thousand euros.
formal.zh: 该项目的总费用为七千欧元。

colloquial.mt: Julia: Kemm tiswa din il-karozza? Mark: Sebat elef ewro. Trid taraha minn ġewwa?
colloquial.en: Julia: How much does this car cost? Mark: Seven thousand euros. Would you like to see the inside?
colloquial.zh: Julia：这辆车多少钱？Mark：七千欧元。你想看看车内吗？

messages.speaker: Julia (顾客)
messages.zh: 这辆车多少钱？
messages.en: How much does this car cost?

messages.speaker: Mark (售车员)
messages.mt_spoken: Sebat elef ewro. Trid taraha minn ġewwa?
messages.mt_standard: Sebat elef ewro. Trid taraha minn ġewwa?
messages.zh: 七千欧元。你想看看车内吗？
messages.en: Seven thousand euros. Would you like to see the inside?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象七个写着一千的信封，合计七千；把 sebat elef 整体贴在 7,000 旁边，并留意 sebat 末尾的 t。

gloss_zh: 变得破旧衰败；（头发）变浓密

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become shabby or decrepit; when used of hair, to become thicker.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得破旧、衰败；用于头发时，表示变得更浓密。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir mitluq jew fi stat ħażin; meta jingħad għax-xagħar, isir aktar folt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得破旧、衰败或衰颓。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isir mitluq jew fi stat ħażin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: （头发）变得更浓密。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isir aktar folt, meta jingħad għax-xagħar.

formal.mt: Maż-żmien, il-bini sebbel u kellu bżonn tiswija.
formal.en: Over time, the building became dilapidated and needed repair.
formal.zh: 随着时间推移，这座建筑变得破败，需要修缮。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ix-xagħar tiegħek jidher aktar folt! Nina: Iva, sebbel. Hekk jidher anki fir-ritratti.
colloquial.en: Lara: Your hair looks thicker! Nina: Yes, it has become thicker. It looks that way in photos too.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你的头发看起来更浓密了！Nina：是啊，变浓密了。照片里看起来也是这样。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的头发看起来更浓密了！
messages.en: Your hair looks thicker!

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, sebbel. Hekk jidher anki fir-ritratti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, sebbel. Hekk jidher anki fir-ritratti.
messages.zh: 是啊，变浓密了。照片里看起来也是这样。
messages.en: Yes, it has become thicker. It looks that way in photos too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅图分开记忆 sebbel：一幅是逐渐破败的房屋，一幅是变浓密的头发；读句子时先看主语再选义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone or something to become infested with lice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人或某物生虱，或使其染上虱子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimla lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa bil-qamel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使生虱；使染上虱子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jimla bil-qamel.

formal.mt: Fil-glossarju, il-verb 'sebben' huwa definit bħala 'jimla bil-qamel'.
formal.en: In the glossary, the verb 'sebben' is defined as 'to infest with lice'.
formal.zh: 在词汇表中，动词 sebben 被定义为“使生虱”。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'sebben' f'din is-sentenza? Paul: Ifisser li mela bil-qamel, bħal meta ngħidu 'sebben ix-xagħar'.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'sebben' mean in this sentence? Paul: It means that someone or something infested something with lice, as in 'infested the hair with lice'.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这句话里的 sebben 是什么意思？Paul：表示使某人或某物生了虱子，比如 sebben ix-xagħar，就是“使头发染上了虱子”。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这句话里的 sebben 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'sebben' mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Paul (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li mela bil-qamel, bħal meta ngħidu 'sebben ix-xagħar'.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li mela bil-qamel, bħal meta ngħidu 'sebben ix-xagħar'.
messages.zh: 表示使某人或某物生了虱子，比如 sebben ix-xagħar，就是“使头发染上了虱子”。
messages.en: It means that someone or something infested something with lice, as in 'infested the hair with lice'.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sebben 与 bil-qamel（带有虱子）配成记忆卡，想象头发染上虱子的画面，并留意末尾是 n，区别于 sebbel。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who lets their hair grow long.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 让自己的头发留长的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tħalli xagħarha jitwal.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who grows their hair long
sense_translations.zh_definition: 留长发的人；让头发逐渐长长的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tħalli xagħarha jikber fit-tul.

collocations.en: a young person who grows their hair long
a person who has let their hair grow long

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, is-sebbiel żagħżugħ kien iħalli xagħru jitwal u rari kien jaqtgħu.
formal.en: In the story, the young person who grew his hair long let it keep growing and rarely cut it.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个留长发的年轻人一直让头发长长，很少剪发。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ħuk għadu jħalli xagħru jitwal? Ben: Iva, hu sebbiel; irid xagħru sa spallejh.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is your brother still letting his hair grow? Ben: Yes, he likes growing it long; he wants it down to his shoulders.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你哥哥还在留头发吗？Ben：对，他是个留长发的人，想把头发留到肩膀。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥还在留头发吗？
messages.en: Is your brother still letting his hair grow?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hu sebbiel; irid xagħru sa spallejh.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hu sebbiel; irid xagħru sa spallejh.
messages.zh: 对，他是个留长发的人，想把头发留到肩膀。
messages.en: Yes, he likes growing it long; he wants it down to his shoulders.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象日历一页页翻过，一个人的头发慢慢长到肩膀：sebbiel 记作“留长发的人”，重点在人的留发行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A group of flowers growing or gathered closely together as a cluster.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 紧密聚在一起、形成一簇的花。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp ta' fjuri li jinsabu qrib xulxin u jiffurmaw ġemgħa waħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一簇聚集在一起的花。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ġemgħa ta' fjuri qrib xulxin.

formal.mt: Fuq il-fergħa dehret sebbiela fjuri bojod, qrib il-weraq il-ġdid.
formal.en: A cluster of white flowers appeared on the branch, close to the new leaves.
formal.zh: 枝条上新叶的附近出现了一簇白花。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara dik is-sebbiela fuq il-fergħa! Luqa: Iva, il-fjuri bojod jidhru sbieħ ħdejn il-weraq.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look at that flower cluster on the branch! Luqa: Yes, the white flowers look lovely beside the leaves.
colloquial.zh: Nina：看枝条上的那簇花！Luqa：是啊，白花衬着叶子真好看。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 看枝条上的那簇花！
messages.en: Look at that flower cluster on the branch!

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-fjuri bojod jidhru sbieħ ħdejn il-weraq.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-fjuri bojod jidhru sbieħ ħdejn il-weraq.
messages.zh: 是啊，白花衬着叶子真好看。
messages.en: Yes, the white flowers look lovely beside the leaves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sebbiela 画成枝头挤在一起的一簇小花；用“一簇”来记它的整体感，避免只记成单独一朵花。

gloss_zh: 易抽穗的；易变得破旧衰败的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to produce ears of grain; in another sense, tending to become shabby or run-down.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容谷物容易抽穗；另一个义项形容事物容易变得破旧、衰败。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li joħroġ is-sbul; f'sens ieħor, li għandu t-tendenza li jitgħarraq jew jitmermer.

sense_translations.en_definition: tending to grow ears of corn
sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易长出谷穗的；有抽穗倾向的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li joħroġ is-sbul.

sense_translations.en_definition: tending to become seedy or decrepit
sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易变得破旧、衰败或老朽的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jitgħarraq jew jitmermer.

collocations.en: wheat that tends to produce ears
a building prone to becoming run-down

formal.mt: Il-bidwi għażel qamħ sebbieli u osserva l-iżvilupp tas-sbul matul l-istaġun.
formal.en: The farmer chose wheat that tends to produce ears and observed the ears developing during the season.
formal.zh: 农民选用了容易抽穗的小麦，并在生长季中观察麦穗的发育。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Dan il-bini sebbieli jeħtieġ ħafna kura? Ġorġ: Iva, irridu nsewwuh regolarment biex ma jitmermirx.
colloquial.en: Marta: Does this building, which is prone to becoming run-down, need a lot of care? Ġorġ: Yes, we need to repair it regularly so it doesn't deteriorate.
colloquial.zh: Marta：这栋容易破旧的建筑需要经常维护吗？Ġorġ：需要，我们得定期修缮，免得它继续损坏。

messages.speaker: Marta (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-bini sebbieli jeħtieġ ħafna kura?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-bini sebbieli jeħtieġ ħafna kura?
messages.zh: 这栋容易破旧的建筑需要经常维护吗？
messages.en: Does this building, which is prone to becoming run-down, need a lot of care?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (维修人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, irridu nsewwuh regolarment biex ma jitmermirx.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, irridu nsewwuh regolarment biex ma jitmermirx.
messages.zh: 需要，我们得定期修缮，免得它继续损坏。
messages.en: Yes, we need to repair it regularly so it doesn't deteriorate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 sebbieli 做两张情景卡：麦田里“容易抽穗”，旧楼旁“容易衰败”。这是两个义项，靠上下文分别判断。

gloss_zh: 促使人超越他人的人或事物

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or thing that causes people to surpass or outperform others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 促使人们超过他人、取得更好表现的人或事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew ħaġa li ġġiegħel lin-nies jaqbżu lil oħrajn fil-ħila jew fir-riżultati.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. or sth. that causes people to surpass others
sense_translations.zh_definition: 促使人们超越他人的人或事物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew ħaġa li ġġiegħel lin-nies jaqbżu lil oħrajn.

collocations.en: a person or thing that causes students to surpass others
collocations.zh: 促使学生超越他人的人或事物

collocations.en: training as a means of making people outperform others
collocations.zh: 作为促使人超越他人之手段的训练

formal.mt: Il-programm ta' taħriġ serva bħala sebbieq, għax wassal lill-parteċipanti biex jaqbżu lil kompetituri oħra.
formal.en: The training programme served as a means of making people outperform others, as it led participants to surpass other competitors.
formal.zh: 该培训项目起到了促使人超越他人的作用，使参与者超过了其他竞争者。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex issejjaħ lil dan il-kowċ sebbieq? David: Għax bit-taħriġ tiegħu jwassalna biex naqbżu lil timijiet oħra.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why do you call this coach someone who makes people outperform others? David: Because his training gets us to surpass other teams.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你为什么把这位教练称为促使人超越他人的人？David：因为他的训练让我们能够超过其他队伍。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex issejjaħ lil dan il-kowċ sebbieq?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex issejjaħ lil dan il-kowċ sebbieq?
messages.zh: 你为什么把这位教练称为促使人超越他人的人？
messages.en: Why do you call this coach someone who makes people outperform others?

messages.speaker: David (队员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax bit-taħriġ tiegħu jwassalna biex naqbżu lil timijiet oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Għax bit-taħriġ tiegħu jwassalna biex naqbżu lil timijiet oħra.
messages.zh: 因为他的训练让我们能够超过其他队伍。
messages.en: Because his training gets us to surpass other teams.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象教练的训练把队员推向领先位置：sebbieq 指促成超越的人或事物，记忆焦点放在“让别人超越”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who decorates or embellishes something to make it more attractive.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过装饰或修饰，使某物或某个地方更加美观的人。
