teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li żżejjen xi ħaġa jew xi post biex tagħmilhom isbaħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为事物增添装饰、使其更加美观的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li żżejjen u ssebbaħ.

collocations.en: a person who beautifies the garden
a person who decorates the hall

formal.mt: Is-sebbieħ tas-sala għażel fjuri u kuluri li jaqblu mat-tema tal-wirja.
formal.en: The hall's decorator chose flowers and colours that matched the exhibition's theme.
formal.zh: 大厅的装饰者选用了与展览主题相配的花卉和色彩。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min għamel il-ġnien daqshekk sabiħ? Mark: Pawlu; hu s-sebbieħ tal-ġnien tagħna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who made the garden so beautiful? Mark: Pawlu; he's the person who beautifies our garden.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁把花园布置得这么漂亮？Mark：Pawlu，他就是美化我们花园的人。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁把花园布置得这么漂亮？
messages.en: Who made the garden so beautiful?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu，他就是美化我们花园的人。
messages.en: Pawlu; he's the person who beautifies our garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人拿着鲜花装点大厅：把 sebbieħ 和“动手让环境变美的人”一起记，注意它指人。

gloss_zh: 有美化作用的；能增添美感的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to make something more beautiful or attractive.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 倾向于使事物更加美观，具有增添美感作用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jagħmel xi ħaġa isbaħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有美化作用的；倾向于使事物更美观的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jsebbaħ.

formal.mt: Id-dawl il-ġdid għandu effett sebbieħi fuq il-faċċata tal-bini.
formal.en: The new lighting has a beautifying effect on the building's façade.
formal.zh: 新的照明使建筑外立面更加美观。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan id-dawl jagħmel differenza? Toni: Iva, għandu effett sebbieħi; il-kamra tidher ħafna isbaħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does this lighting make a difference? Toni: Yes, it has a beautifying effect; the room looks much nicer.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这种灯光能让房间有变化吗？Toni：能，它有美化效果，房间看起来漂亮多了。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 这种灯光能让房间有变化吗？
messages.en: Does this lighting make a difference?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandu effett sebbieħi; il-kamra tidher ħafna isbaħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandu effett sebbieħi; il-kamra tidher ħafna isbaħ.
messages.zh: 能，它有美化效果，房间看起来漂亮多了。
messages.en: Yes, it has a beautifying effect; the room looks much nicer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“换上灯光，房间变美”的画面记 sebbieħi；它描述美化的作用或倾向，练习时接在 effett 后面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number 97, one more than ninety-six and one less than ninety-eight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数九十七，即比九十六多一、比九十八少一的数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 97, wieħed aktar minn sitta u disgħin u wieħed inqas minn tmienja u disgħin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 九十七；数字97。
sense_translations.mt_definition: In-numru 97.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jippreżenta sebgħa u disgħin każ għall-analiżi.
formal.en: The report presents ninety-seven cases for analysis.
formal.zh: 报告提供了九十七个案例供分析。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Fuq liema paġna qiegħed l-eżerċizzju? Mark: Fuq paġna sebgħa u disgħin, taħt l-istampa.
colloquial.en: Elena: Which page is the exercise on? Mark: On page ninety-seven, below the picture.
colloquial.zh: Elena：练习在第几页？Mark：在第九十七页，图片下面。

messages.speaker: Elena (同学)
messages.zh: 练习在第几页？
messages.en: Which page is the exercise on?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq paġna sebgħa u disgħin, taħt l-istampa.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq paġna sebgħa u disgħin, taħt l-istampa.
messages.zh: 在第九十七页，图片下面。
messages.en: On page ninety-seven, below the picture.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按表达顺序记“七＋和＋九十”：sebgħa 是七，u 是和，disgħin 是九十；合起来对应中文的九十七。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number 47, one more than forty-six and one less than forty-eight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数四十七，即比四十六多一、比四十八少一的数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 47, wieħed aktar minn sitta u erbgħin u wieħed inqas minn tmienja u erbgħin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 四十七；数字47。
sense_translations.mt_definition: In-numru 47.

formal.mt: Għas-seminar irreġistraw sebgħa u erbgħin parteċipant.
formal.en: Forty-seven participants registered for the seminar.
formal.zh: 共有四十七名参与者报名参加研讨会。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Liema kamra għandna għal-lezzjoni? Toni: Kamra sebgħa u erbgħin, fit-tieni sular.
colloquial.en: Sara: Which room do we have for the lesson? Toni: Room forty-seven, on the second floor.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们在哪个房间上课？Toni：四十七号房间，在二层。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 我们在哪个房间上课？
messages.en: Which room do we have for the lesson?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kamra sebgħa u erbgħin, fit-tieni sular.
messages.mt_standard: Kamra sebgħa u erbgħin, fit-tieni sular.
messages.zh: 四十七号房间，在二层。
messages.en: Room forty-seven, on the second floor.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把四十七拆成“七＋和＋四十”来练习：sebgħa 表示七，u 表示和，erbgħin 表示四十，读完再还原成47。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number 27, between twenty-six and twenty-eight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数词二十七，即26之后、28之前的整数，可用于表示数量或读出编号。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 27, li jiġi wara sitta u għoxrin u qabel tmienja u għoxrin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 二十七；27。

formal.mt: Il-ħlas totali għall-kotba huwa sebgħa u għoxrin ewro.
formal.en: The total payment for the books is twenty-seven euros.
formal.zh: 这些书的总费用为二十七欧元。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm jiswew il-kotba kollha? Pawlu: Sebgħa u għoxrin ewro.
colloquial.en: Maja: How much do all the books cost? Pawlu: Twenty-seven euros.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些书一共多少钱？保罗：二十七欧元。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这些书一共多少钱？
messages.en: How much do all the books cost?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店员)
messages.zh: 二十七欧元。
messages.en: Twenty-seven euros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词组按“七＋和＋二十”分块记忆：sebgħa 是七，għoxrin 是二十，合起来读作二十七。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number 77, between seventy-six and seventy-eight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数词七十七，即76之后、78之前的整数，可用于表示数量或读出编号。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 77, li jiġi wara sitta u sebgħin u qabel tmienja u sebgħin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 七十七；77。

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa se ssir f'kamra sebgħa u sebgħin fit-tieni sular.
formal.en: The meeting will take place in room seventy-seven on the second floor.
formal.zh: 会议将在二楼的七十七号房间举行。

colloquial.mt: Nina: F'liema kamra se niltaqgħu? David: F'kamra sebgħa u sebgħin, ħdejn it-taraġ.
colloquial.en: Nina: Which room are we meeting in? David: In room seventy-seven, next to the stairs.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们在哪个房间见面？戴维：在七十七号房间，就在楼梯旁边。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 我们在哪个房间见面？
messages.en: Which room are we meeting in?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: F'kamra sebgħa u sebgħin, ħdejn it-taraġ.
messages.mt_standard: F'kamra sebgħa u sebgħin, ħdejn it-taraġ.
messages.zh: 在七十七号房间，就在楼梯旁边。
messages.en: In room seventy-seven, next to the stairs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个七作视觉提示：sebgħa 表示七，sebgħin 表示七十；把两块连起来，对应数字77。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number 67, between sixty-six and sixty-eight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数词六十七，即66之后、68之前的整数，可用于表示数量或读出编号。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 67, li jiġi wara sitta u sittin u qabel tmienja u sittin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 六十七；67。

formal.mt: L-eżerċizzju jinsab f'paġna sebgħa u sittin tal-ktieb.
formal.en: The exercise is on page sixty-seven of the book.
formal.zh: 这道练习在书的第六十七页。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Liema paġna rridu naqraw illum? Ben: Paġna sebgħa u sittin. Hemm storja qasira.
colloquial.en: Sara: Which page do we need to read today? Ben: Page sixty-seven. There is a short story.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们今天要读哪一页？本：第六十七页。那里有一篇短故事。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 我们今天要读哪一页？
messages.en: Which page do we need to read today?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Paġna sebgħa u sittin. Hemm storja qasira.
messages.mt_standard: Paġna sebgħa u sittin. Hemm storja qasira.
messages.zh: 第六十七页。那里有一篇短故事。
messages.en: Page sixty-seven. There is a short story.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sittin 单独配对“六十”，再接上前面的 sebgħa“七”；看到整组词时，心里写出67。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number 37, between thirty-six and thirty-eight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数词三十七，即36之后、38之前的整数，可用于表示数量或读出编号。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 37, li jiġi wara sitta u tletin u qabel tmienja u tletin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 三十七；37。

formal.mt: Il-prezz tal-biljett huwa sebgħa u tletin ewro għal kull persuna.
formal.en: The ticket price is thirty-seven euros per person.
formal.zh: 票价为每人三十七欧元。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Liema numru għandek fuq il-biljett? Toni: Sebgħa u tletin. Issa jmiss lili!
colloquial.en: Anna: What number do you have on your ticket? Toni: Thirty-seven. It is my turn now!
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你的票上是几号？托尼：三十七号。现在轮到我了！

messages.speaker: Anna (排队顾客)
messages.zh: 你的票上是几号？
messages.en: What number do you have on your ticket?

messages.speaker: Toni (排队顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Sebgħa u tletin. Issa jmiss lili!
messages.mt_standard: Sebgħa u tletin. Issa jmiss lili!
messages.zh: 三十七号。现在轮到我了！
messages.en: Thirty-seven. It is my turn now!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tletin 记在“三十”卡片上，把 sebgħa 记在“七”卡片上；按词组顺序拼读，数字对应37。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number 87, between eighty-six and eighty-eight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数词八十七，即86之后、88之前的整数，可用于表示数量或读出编号。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 87, li jiġi wara sitta u tmenin u qabel tmienja u tmenin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 八十七；87。

formal.mt: L-awtriċi kellha sebgħa u tmenin sena meta ppubblikat dan il-ktieb.
formal.en: The author was eighty-seven years old when she published this book.
formal.zh: 这位女作家出版这本书时已八十七岁。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Kemm għandha żmien in-nanna tiegħek? Luqa: Għandha sebgħa u tmenin sena u għadha tħobb tiżfen.
colloquial.en: Emma: How old is your grandmother? Luqa: She is eighty-seven and still loves dancing.
colloquial.zh: 埃玛：你奶奶多大年纪了？卢卡：她八十七岁了，仍然很喜欢跳舞。

messages.speaker: Emma (朋友)
messages.zh: 你奶奶多大年纪了？
messages.en: How old is your grandmother?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandha sebgħa u tmenin sena u għadha tħobb tiżfen.
messages.mt_standard: Għandha sebgħa u tmenin sena u għadha tħobb tiżfen.
messages.zh: 她八十七岁了，仍然很喜欢跳舞。
messages.en: She is eighty-seven and still loves dancing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画八十七岁生日蜡烛：tmenin 对应八十，sebgħa 对应七；读词时先说七，再说八十。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number 57, between fifty-six and fifty-eight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数词五十七，即56之后、58之前的整数，可用于表示数量或读出编号。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 57, li jiġi wara sitta u ħamsin u qabel tmienja u ħamsin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 五十七；57。

formal.mt: It-tul totali tal-laqgħa kien sebgħa u ħamsin minuta.
formal.en: The total duration of the meeting was fifty-seven minutes.
formal.zh: 会议总时长为五十七分钟。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm dam il-film? Mark: Sebgħa u ħamsin minuta. Spiċċa malajr!
colloquial.en: Lara: How long was the film? Mark: Fifty-seven minutes. It ended quickly!
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：这部电影有多长？马克：五十七分钟。很快就结束了！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这部电影有多长？
messages.en: How long was the film?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sebgħa u ħamsin minuta. Spiċċa malajr!
messages.mt_standard: Sebgħa u ħamsin minuta. Spiċċa malajr!
messages.zh: 五十七分钟。很快就结束了！
messages.en: Fifty-seven minutes. It ended quickly!

cognitive_memory_aid: 先认 sebgħa 的“七”，再认 ħamsin 的“五十”；按“七和五十”组合，就能记住五十七。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An elder plant, a shrub or small tree.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 接骨木，一种灌木或小乔木。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arbuxxell jew siġra żgħira magħrufa bħala sebuqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 接骨木，一种植物。

formal.mt: Fil-ġnien tal-iskola hemm siġra tas-sebuqa ħdejn il-ħajt.
formal.en: There is an elder tree beside the wall in the school garden.
formal.zh: 学校花园的墙边有一棵接骨木。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'inhi dik is-siġra ħdejn il-ħajt? Pawlu: Dik sebuqa; ara kemm għandha fjuri.
colloquial.en: Marija: What is that tree beside the wall? Pawlu: That is an elder; look how many flowers it has.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：墙边那是什么树？保罗：那是接骨木，你看它开了多少花。

messages.speaker: Marija (同学)
messages.zh: 墙边那是什么树？
messages.en: What is that tree beside the wall?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik sebuqa; ara kemm għandha fjuri.
messages.mt_standard: Dik sebuqa; ara kemm għandha fjuri.
messages.zh: 那是接骨木，你看它开了多少花。
messages.en: That is an elder; look how many flowers it has.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sebuqa 和花园里开花的小树联系起来，记住这里的 elder 指接骨木这种植物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The arrival of daylight at the beginning of the day; also, the act of making something more beautiful.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 名词，可指一天开始时天色渐亮的破晓，也可指使某物或某处变得更美观的美化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-bidu tad-dawl ta' filgħodu; ukoll, l-għemil ta' xi ħaġa aktar sabiħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 破晓；天色开始变亮的时刻或过程。
美化；使某物或某处变得更美观的过程。

formal.mt: Is-sebħa tal-jum kixfet il-kuluri tal-għoljiet.
formal.en: The dawning of the day revealed the colours of the hills.
formal.zh: 破晓的晨光显露出山丘的色彩。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tħawlu dawn il-fjuri? Pawlu: Għas-sebħa tal-ġnien. Irridu nagħmluh aktar sabiħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you planting these flowers? Pawlu: For the beautification of the garden. We want to make it more beautiful.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你们为什么种这些花？保罗：为了美化花园。我们想让它更漂亮。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 你们为什么种这些花？
messages.en: Why are you planting these flowers?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园艺志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għas-sebħa tal-ġnien. Irridu nagħmluh aktar sabiħ.
messages.mt_standard: Għas-sebħa tal-ġnien. Irridu nagħmluh aktar sabiħ.
messages.zh: 为了美化花园。我们想让它更漂亮。
messages.en: For the beautification of the garden. We want to make it more beautiful.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 sebħa 配两幅学习图：一幅是天边渐亮，一幅是花园添花；分别提示“破晓”和“美化”，再靠上下文选义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The beginning of daylight, when the sky starts to become light in the morning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指清晨天空开始变亮、白昼逐渐到来的破晓时刻或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-bidu tad-dawl ta' filgħodu, meta s-sema jibda jiċċara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 破晓；天明；清晨天色开始变亮的时刻或过程。

formal.mt: Il-grupp telaq mas-sebħien biex jasal fir-raħal kmieni.
formal.en: The group left at dawn to reach the village early.
formal.zh: 这支队伍在破晓时分出发，以便早些抵达村庄。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Meta se nitilqu għall-mixja? Mark: Mas-sebħien, meta jibda jidher id-dawl.
colloquial.en: Lara: When are we leaving for the walk? Mark: At dawn, when the light starts to appear.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：我们什么时候出发去散步？马克：破晓时，天刚开始亮的时候。

messages.speaker: Lara (徒步伙伴)
messages.zh: 我们什么时候出发去散步？
messages.en: When are we leaving for the walk?

messages.speaker: Mark (徒步伙伴)
messages.zh: 破晓时，天刚开始亮的时候。
messages.en: At dawn, when the light starts to appear.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sebħien 放在清晨出发的画面里：背起行囊时天空刚亮，用“破晓出发”这幅图记住名词含义。

gloss_zh: 认真；真诚；纯朴无诈；坚定不移

teaching_sense.en_definition: Earnestness, sincerity, freedom from deceit, or steadiness in one's attitude and conduct.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 态度或行为中的认真、真诚、无诈与坚定不移；具体含义依语境而定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Serjetà, sinċerità, nuqqas ta' qerq jew fermezza fl-attitudni u fl-imġiba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 认真、郑重的态度。
真诚；表达与内心一致的诚恳。
纯朴无诈；没有欺骗或算计。
坚定不移；态度、感情或行为的始终如一。

collocations.en: to show earnestness in his commitment
collocations.zh: 在投入中表现出认真态度

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħu, l-istudent wera sedaq fix-xewqa li jitgħallem.
formal.en: In his letter, the student showed earnestness in his wish to learn.
formal.zh: 这名学生在信中表现出了认真求学的愿望。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Taħseb li Pawlu veru jrid jgħinna? Rita: Iva, tkellem bis-sedaq u offra li jiġi għada.
colloquial.en: Marija: Do you think Pawlu really wants to help us? Rita: Yes, he spoke sincerely and offered to come tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你觉得保罗是真心想帮我们吗？丽塔：是的，他说得很真诚，还主动提出明天过来。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li Pawlu veru jrid jgħinna?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li Pawlu veru jrid jgħinna?
messages.zh: 你觉得保罗是真心想帮我们吗？
messages.en: Do you think Pawlu really wants to help us?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tkellem bis-sedaq u offra li jiġi għada.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tkellem bis-sedaq u offra li jiġi għada.
messages.zh: 是的，他说得很真诚，还主动提出明天过来。
messages.en: Yes, he spoke sincerely and offered to come tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用四格画面记 sedaq：认真做事、真心说话、待人无诈、坚持到底；再由语境选择具体义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The part of a chair that supports a seated person, or a seat fitted in a vehicle or similar setting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 椅子上供人坐的座面，也指车辆等处安装的座椅。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti ta' siġġu li wieħed joqgħod fuqha, jew post magħmul biex wieħed joqgħod bilqiegħda f'vettura.

sense_translations.en_definition: seat (that part of a chair on which one sits; a chair-like construction in a car etc.)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 座面，即椅子上供人坐的部分；也指汽车等处的座椅。

formal.mt: Qabel tibda ssuq, aġġusta s-sedil tal-karozza biex tkun komdu.
formal.en: Before you start driving, adjust the car seat so that you are comfortable.
formal.zh: 开始驾驶前，请调整汽车座椅，使自己坐得舒适。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan is-sedil wisq 'il quddiem għalija. Rita: Tista' tmexxih ftit lura.
colloquial.en: Mark: This seat is too far forward for me. Rita: You can move it back a little.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这个座椅对我来说太靠前了。丽塔：你可以把它往后移一点。

messages.speaker: Mark (乘客)
messages.zh: 这个座椅对我来说太靠前了。
messages.en: This seat is too far forward for me.

messages.speaker: Rita (司机)
messages.zh: 你可以把它往后移一点。
messages.en: You can move it back a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象上车后先调整 sedil，再坐稳出发；把这个词牢牢记在身体实际坐到的座面上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of telling the truth and giving an honest account of things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说真话、如实陈述事情的品质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' min jgħid il-verità u jirrakkonta l-affarijiet kif tassew ġraw.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诚实；说话符合事实、不作虚假陈述的品质。

formal.mt: Is-sedq tax-xhud huwa essenzjali biex il-qorti tifhem x'ġara.
formal.en: The witness's truthfulness is essential for the court to understand what happened.
formal.zh: 证人如实作证，对于法庭了解事情经过至关重要。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Ngħid li kont jien li ksirt it-tazza? Pawlu: Iva, tkellem bis-sedq u spjega x'ġara.
colloquial.en: Anna: Should I say that I was the one who broke the cup? Pawlu: Yes, speak truthfully and explain what happened.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我要说杯子是我打碎的吗？保罗：要，如实说清事情经过。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ngħid li kont jien li ksirt it-tazza?
messages.mt_standard: Ngħid li kont jien li ksirt it-tazza?
messages.zh: 我要说杯子是我打碎的吗？
messages.en: Should I say that I was the one who broke the cup?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tkellem bis-sedq u spjega x'ġara.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tkellem bis-sedq u spjega x'ġara.
messages.zh: 要，如实说清事情经过。
messages.en: Yes, speak truthfully and explain what happened.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sedq 配上一句提醒：事情怎样发生，就怎样说出来；用真实陈述的画面记住诚实义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being morally upright and acting according to what is right.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 品行正直、按照道义行事的品质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' min jgħix u jaġixxi skont dak li hu moralment tajjeb u ġust.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 正直；行为与品格合乎道义的品质。

formal.mt: L-awtur juri s-sedqa tal-personaġġ permezz tad-deċiżjoni tiegħu li jiddefendi lil min hu dgħajjef.
formal.en: The author shows the character's righteousness through his decision to defend the weak.
formal.zh: 作者通过这个人物决定保护弱者的举动，表现他的正直。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'tfisser 'sedqa' f'din l-istorja? Mark: Tfisser li l-persuna tagħmel dak li hu tajjeb u ġust, anki meta jkun diffiċli.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'sedqa' mean in this story? Mark: It means that the person does what is good and right, even when it is difficult.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个故事里的 sedqa 是什么意思？马克：意思是这个人即使遇到困难，也做合乎道义的事。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这个故事里的 sedqa 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'sedqa' mean in this story?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li l-persuna tagħmel dak li hu tajjeb u ġust, anki meta jkun diffiċli.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li l-persuna tagħmel dak li hu tajjeb u ġust, anki meta jkun diffiċli.
messages.zh: 意思是这个人即使遇到困难，也做合乎道义的事。
messages.en: It means that the person does what is good and right, even when it is difficult.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sedqa 放进道德选择的场景：即使吃亏也坚持做对的事，以此记住正直与合乎道义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become dense or more closely packed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得稠密，组成部分之间的空隙减少。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir dens jew aktar magħqud, b'inqas spazju bejn il-partijiet tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得稠密；由较疏变得较密。

formal.mt: Maż-żmien, il-bosk sefaq u daħal inqas dawl bejn is-siġar.
formal.en: Over time, the woodland became dense and less light passed between the trees.
formal.zh: 随着时间推移，林地变得茂密，树木之间透入的光线减少了。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għadek tara l-għoljiet? Mark: Le, iċ-ċpar sefaq u ma nara kważi xejn.
colloquial.en: Anna: Can you still see the hills? Mark: No, the fog has become dense and I can hardly see anything.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你还看得见那些山丘吗？马克：看不见了，雾变浓了，我几乎什么都看不到。

messages.speaker: Anna (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 你还看得见那些山丘吗？
messages.en: Can you still see the hills?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, iċ-ċpar sefaq u ma nara kważi xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Le, iċ-ċpar sefaq u ma nara kważi xejn.
messages.zh: 看不见了，雾变浓了，我几乎什么都看不到。
messages.en: No, the fog has become dense and I can hardly see anything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象树林空隙逐渐缩小、薄雾逐渐变浓，用这个由疏到密的变化过程记住 sefaq。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To undergo a rocking movement, or to run from one place to another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到摇动而来回晃动；也可指从一个地方跑到另一个地方，四处奔走。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitbandal minħabba moviment li jċaqalqu, jew jiġri minn post għal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被摇动；受到外力作用而来回晃动。

sense_translations.en_definition: to run from place to place
sense_translations.zh_definition: 从一处跑到另一处；四处奔走。

formal.mt: Matul il-maltemp, il-bastiment sefaħ bil-mewġ.
formal.en: During the storm, the ship was rocked by the waves.
formal.zh: 暴风雨期间，船只被海浪摇得来回晃动。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex Pawlu għajjien daqshekk? Rita: Illum sefaħ minn post għal ieħor biex jiġbor kollox għall-festa.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why is Pawlu so tired? Rita: Today he ran from place to place to collect everything for the party.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：保罗怎么这么累？丽塔：他今天为了备齐聚会用品，四处奔走。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗怎么这么累？
messages.en: Why is Pawlu so tired?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum sefaħ minn post għal ieħor biex jiġbor kollox għall-festa.
messages.mt_standard: Illum sefaħ minn post għal ieħor biex jiġbor kollox għall-festa.
messages.zh: 他今天为了备齐聚会用品，四处奔走。
messages.en: Today he ran from place to place to collect everything for the party.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个运动画面记 sefaħ：船被浪摇得来回晃，人为办事跑来跑去；根据主语与场景分辨。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something thicker or denser.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物的质地变稠，或使其结构更加密实。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel xi ħaġa aktar ħoxna jew aktar densa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使变稠；增加厚度或稠度。
使更加密实；增加密度。

collocations.en: made the mixture thicker or denser
collocations.zh: 使混合物变稠或更密实

formal.mt: Il-kok seffaq is-soppa bi ftit dqiq biex tikseb il-konsistenza mixtieqa.
formal.en: The cook thickened the soup with a little flour to achieve the desired consistency.
formal.zh: 厨师用少量面粉使汤变稠，以达到所需的稠度。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex is-soppa daqshekk ħoxna? Mark: Il-kok seffaq is-soppa bi ftit dqiq.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is the soup so thick? Mark: The cook thickened the soup with a little flour.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：汤怎么这么稠？马克：厨师加了少量面粉，把汤调稠了。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 汤怎么这么稠？
messages.en: Why is the soup so thick?

messages.speaker: Mark (服务员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kok seffaq is-soppa bi ftit dqiq.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kok seffaq is-soppa bi ftit dqiq.
messages.zh: 厨师加了少量面粉，把汤调稠了。
messages.en: The cook thickened the soup with a little flour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把一碗清汤变成稠汤的画面记在脑中：seffaq 表示让东西变稠，也可表示让结构更密实。

gloss_zh: 表示动作反复发生的动词

teaching_sense.en_definition: A verb with frequentative force, expressing repeated or recurrent action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有反复义的动词，表示某个动作多次发生或反复进行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Verb b'valur frekwentattiv, li jesprimi azzjoni li ssir ripetutament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反复义：表示动作重复发生或反复进行的动词用法。

collocations.zh: 用 seffaħ 表达反复发生的动作

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, il-verb 'seffaħ' huwa ppreżentat b'valur frekwentattiv, jiġifieri bħala verb li jesprimi azzjoni ripetuta.
formal.en: In this exercise, the verb 'seffaħ' is presented with frequentative force, meaning that it expresses a repeated action.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，动词 seffaħ 以反复义呈现，即表示动作重复发生。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'frequentative' ħdejn 'seffaħ'? Mark: Tindika ripetizzjoni: l-azzjoni ssir diversi drabi.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does the word 'frequentative' beside 'seffaħ' mean? Mark: It indicates repetition: the action happens several times.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：seffaħ 旁边的 frequentative 是什么意思？马克：它表示反复，也就是动作发生多次。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: seffaħ 旁边的 frequentative 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word 'frequentative' beside 'seffaħ' mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tindika ripetizzjoni: l-azzjoni ssir diversi drabi.
messages.mt_standard: Tindika ripetizzjoni: l-azzjoni ssir diversi drabi.
messages.zh: 它表示反复，也就是动作发生多次。
messages.en: It indicates repetition: the action happens several times.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 seffaħ 配上循环播放的图标，提醒自己注意动作的反复发生；这个图像仅作记忆提示，不用于推导构词规则。

gloss_zh: 串在烤叉上烤；插入孔中；疏通孔洞

teaching_sense.en_definition: To roast food on a spit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把食物串在烤叉或烤杆上烤制。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sajjar l-ikel fuq nar billi daħħlu f'virga.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把食物串在烤叉或烤杆上烤。
把某物用力插入孔洞。

sense_translations.en_definition: to remove an obstruction from a hole
sense_translations.zh_definition: 清除孔洞中的堵塞物；疏通孔洞。

collocations.en: roasted the meat on a spit
thrust a rod into the hole
collocations.zh: 把一根杆用力插入孔中

collocations.en: cleared an obstruction from the hole

formal.mt: Il-kok seffed il-laħam fuq in-nar u dawwru regolarment biex jissajjar minn kull naħa.
formal.en: The cook roasted the meat on a spit over the fire and turned it regularly so that it cooked on every side.
formal.zh: 厨师把肉串在烤叉上架火烤，并定时翻转，使各面都能烤熟。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif sajjar il-laħam Mark? Pawlu: Seffed il-laħam fuq in-nar. Għandu riħa tajba!
colloquial.en: Nina: How did Mark cook the meat? Pawlu: He roasted the meat on a spit over the fire. It smells good!
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：马克是怎么做这块肉的？保罗：他把肉串在烤叉上架火烤。闻起来真香！

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克是怎么做这块肉的？
messages.en: How did Mark cook the meat?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Seffed il-laħam fuq in-nar. Għandu riħa tajba!
messages.mt_standard: Seffed il-laħam fuq in-nar. Għandu riħa tajba!
messages.zh: 他把肉串在烤叉上架火烤。闻起来真香！
messages.en: He roasted the meat on a spit over the fire. It smells good!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三幅小图分别记义：烤叉串肉、杆子插孔、清除孔内堵塞物；这是情景记忆，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 用于插入狭窄孔口的物件

teaching_sense.en_definition: An object used to thrust into a narrow opening.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于探入或用力插入狭窄孔口的物件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett li jintuża biex jiddaħħal f'fetħa dejqa.

sense_translations.en_definition: sth. used to thrust into a tight aperture
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于用力插入狭窄孔口的东西。

collocations.en: insert the implement into the hole
an implement for inserting into a narrow opening
collocations.zh: 用于插入狭窄开口的用具

formal.mt: It-tekniku għażel seffied irqiq biżżejjed biex jidħol fil-fetħa dejqa.
formal.en: The technician selected an implement thin enough to fit into the narrow opening.
formal.zh: 技术员选了一件足够细、能伸入狭窄开口的插入用具。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din il-fetħa dejqa wisq. Liema għodda nuża? Toni: Uża dan is-seffied; huwa rqiq biżżejjed biex jidħol.
colloquial.en: Maja: This opening is very narrow. Which tool should I use? Toni: Use this insertion implement; it is thin enough to fit.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个开口太窄了。我该用哪件工具？托尼：用这个插入用具吧，它够细，能伸进去。

messages.speaker: Maja (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-fetħa dejqa wisq. Liema għodda nuża?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-fetħa dejqa wisq. Liema għodda nuża?
messages.zh: 这个开口太窄了。我该用哪件工具？
messages.en: This opening is very narrow. Which tool should I use?

messages.speaker: Toni (师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Uża dan is-seffied; huwa rqiq biżżejjed biex jidħol.
messages.mt_standard: Uża dan is-seffied; huwa rqiq biżżejjed biex jidħol.
messages.zh: 用这个插入用具吧，它够细，能伸进去。
messages.en: Use this insertion implement; it is thin enough to fit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象工具箱里一件能伸进小孔的细工具：seffied 指那件物品，记住它是名词。

gloss_zh: 清除管内堵塞物的尖锐工具

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sharp tool used to clear obstructions from inside a tube.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于清除管子内部堵塞物的尖锐工具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda bil-ponta li tintuża biex tneħħi dak li jkun qed jimblokka tubu.

sense_translations.en_definition: a sharp tool used to remove obstructions from a tube
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于清除管内堵塞物的尖锐工具。

collocations.en: clean the tube with a pointed clearing tool
collocations.zh: 用尖锐的疏通工具清理管子

collocations.en: the tip of the tube-clearing tool

formal.mt: It-tekniku uża seffieda biex neħħa l-materjal li kien qed jimblokka t-tubu.
formal.en: The technician used a sharp clearing tool to remove the material blocking the tube.
formal.zh: 技术员用一件尖锐的疏通工具清除了堵在管内的物料。

colloquial.mt: Sara: L-ilma għadu ma jgħaddix mit-tubu. Toni: Għaddili s-seffieda, jekk jogħġbok, biex inneħħi dak li qed jimblokkah.
colloquial.en: Sara: The water still will not pass through the tube. Toni: Please pass me the pointed clearing tool so I can remove what is blocking it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：水还是流不过这根管子。托尼：请把那件尖头疏通工具递给我，我来清掉里面的堵塞物。

messages.speaker: Sara (助手)
messages.zh: 水还是流不过这根管子。
messages.en: The water still will not pass through the tube.

messages.speaker: Toni (维修师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaddili s-seffieda, jekk jogħġbok, biex inneħħi dak li qed jimblokkah.
messages.mt_standard: Għaddili s-seffieda, jekk jogħġbok, biex inneħħi dak li qed jimblokkah.
messages.zh: 请把那件尖头疏通工具递给我，我来清掉里面的堵塞物。
messages.en: Please pass me the pointed clearing tool so I can remove what is blocking it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把尖头工具清掉管内堵塞物的动作画成小图；记 seffieda 时同时抓住尖锐、管内、疏通三个要点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used for thrusting into a tight space.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容工具等物品用于插入或探入狭窄空间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jintuża biex jiddaħħal fi spazju dejjaq.

sense_translations.en_definition: used to thrust into a tight space
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于用力插入狭窄空间的。

collocations.en: an instrument used for insertion into a tight space
collocations.zh: 用于插入狭窄空间的器具

collocations.en: an implement used for insertion into a tight space
collocations.zh: 用于探入狭窄空间的用具

formal.mt: Għal din il-fetħa dejqa, it-tekniku għażel strument seffiedi ta' daqs adattat.
formal.en: For this narrow opening, the technician selected a suitably sized instrument designed for insertion into tight spaces.
formal.zh: 针对这个狭窄开口，技术员选用了尺寸合适、用于探入狭窄空间的器具。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex għażilt dan l-istrument? Mark: Huwa strument seffiedi; nużah biex nasal f'dak l-ispazju dejjaq.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you choose this instrument? Mark: It is an instrument for insertion into tight spaces; I use it to reach into that narrow space.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么选这件器具？马克：它是用来探入狭窄空间的，我用它够到那个窄小的地方。

messages.speaker: Lara (学徒)
messages.zh: 你为什么选这件器具？
messages.en: Why did you choose this instrument?

messages.speaker: Mark (技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa strument seffiedi; nużah biex nasal f'dak l-ispazju dejjaq.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa strument seffiedi; nużah biex nasal f'dak l-ispazju dejjaq.
messages.zh: 它是用来探入狭窄空间的，我用它够到那个窄小的地方。
messages.en: It is an instrument for insertion into tight spaces; I use it to reach into that narrow space.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给工具贴上用途标签“用于伸进窄处的”，把 seffiedi 当作这张形容词标签来记。

gloss_zh: 吸入物质的东西；吸取装置

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that draws in air, liquid, or other material by suction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过吸力吸入空气、液体或其他物质的东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li tiġbed lejha arja, likwidu jew materjal ieħor permezz tal-ġbid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 能吸入或吸取物质的东西。

formal.mt: Is-seffief tal-ilma ġibed l-ilma mit-tank għal ġo reċipjent ieħor.
formal.en: The water suction device drew the water from the tank into another container.
formal.zh: 吸水装置把水从水箱中吸到了另一个容器里。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif se nneħħu l-ilma minn hawn? Toni: Nużaw dan is-seffief tal-ilma; jiġbed l-ilma għal ġol-barmil.
colloquial.en: Maja: How are we going to remove the water from here? Toni: We will use this water suction device; it draws the water into the bucket.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们怎么把这里的水弄走？托尼：用这个吸水装置吧，它会把水吸进桶里。

messages.speaker: Maja (助手)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif se nneħħu l-ilma minn hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Kif se nneħħu l-ilma minn hawn?
messages.zh: 我们怎么把这里的水弄走？
messages.en: How are we going to remove the water from here?

messages.speaker: Toni (维修师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Nużaw dan is-seffief tal-ilma; jiġbed l-ilma għal ġol-barmil.
messages.mt_standard: Nużaw dan is-seffief tal-ilma; jiġbed l-ilma għal ġol-barmil.
messages.zh: 用这个吸水装置吧，它会把水吸进桶里。
messages.en: We will use this water suction device; it draws the water into the bucket.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象水被吸进装置的画面：seffief 指执行吸取作用的那个东西，重点记住名词身份。

gloss_zh: 有吸入倾向的；易吸取的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to draw things in by suction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有吸入或吸取物质倾向的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jiġbed lejh arja, likwidu jew materjal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于吸入或吸取物质的。

collocations.en: an apparatus tending to draw material in by suction
a mechanism tending to draw material in by suction

formal.mt: L-apparat seffiefi għandu tendenza jiġbed lejh partiċelli ħfief li jkunu qrib il-fetħa tiegħu.
formal.en: The apparatus with a tendency to create suction tends to draw in light particles near its opening.
formal.zh: 这种具有吸取倾向的装置容易把开口附近的轻小颗粒吸进去。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex il-biċċiet tal-karta qed jinġibdu lejn il-fetħa? Pawlu: Dan l-apparat seffiefi; jiġbed lejh affarijiet ħfief.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why are the pieces of paper being drawn towards the opening? Pawlu: This apparatus tends to create suction; it draws light things towards it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这些纸片为什么被吸向开口？保罗：这个装置具有吸取倾向，会把轻的东西吸过来。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-biċċiet tal-karta qed jinġibdu lejn il-fetħa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-biċċiet tal-karta qed jinġibdu lejn il-fetħa?
messages.zh: 这些纸片为什么被吸向开口？
messages.en: Why are the pieces of paper being drawn towards the opening?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-apparat seffiefi; jiġbed lejh affarijiet ħfief.
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-apparat seffiefi; jiġbed lejh affarijiet ħfief.
messages.zh: 这个装置具有吸取倾向，会把轻的东西吸过来。
messages.en: This apparatus tends to create suction; it draws light things towards it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给装置写评语“容易把东西吸进来”：seffiefi 描写吸取倾向，是形容词，不是装置名称。

gloss_zh: 把东西硬塞在一起的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who forces or packs things tightly together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物品紧紧挤在一起或硬塞到一处的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tross l-affarijiet flimkien jew iddaħħalhom bilfors fi spazju żgħir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把东西挤塞在一起的人。

collocations.zh: 把东西硬挤在一起的人

collocations.en: to work like someone who crams everything together
collocations.zh: 干活时把东西一股脑儿硬塞在一起

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, il-ħaddiem ġie deskritt bħala seffieq għax kien iross il-pakketti flimkien mingħajr ma jħalli spazju bejniethom.
formal.en: In the report, the worker was described as someone who crams things together because he packed the parcels without leaving space between them.
formal.zh: 报告把这名工人描述为一个爱把东西硬挤在一起的人，因为他堆放包裹时不留间隙。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed iġġiegħel dawk il-kotba kollha jidħlu f'kaxxa waħda? Pawlu: Għandek raġun, qed naħdem bħal seffieq. Se nuża kaxxa oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you forcing all those books into one box? Pawlu: You're right, I'm cramming everything together. I'll use another box.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么非要把那些书全塞进一个箱子？保罗：你说得对，我这样简直是个硬塞东西的人。我再拿一个箱子。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed iġġiegħel dawk il-kotba kollha jidħlu f'kaxxa waħda?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed iġġiegħel dawk il-kotba kollha jidħlu f'kaxxa waħda?
messages.zh: 你为什么非要把那些书全塞进一个箱子？
messages.en: Why are you forcing all those books into one box?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun, qed naħdem bħal seffieq. Se nuża kaxxa oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun, qed naħdem bħal seffieq. Se nuża kaxxa oħra.
messages.zh: 你说得对，我这样简直是个硬塞东西的人。我再拿一个箱子。
messages.en: You're right, I'm cramming everything together. I'll use another box.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人把一箱书压了又压，记住这个词指硬塞东西的那个人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to make something thicker or more densely packed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有使某物变稠、变厚或变得更加密实的倾向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jagħmel xi ħaġa eħxen jew aktar densa.

sense_translations.en_definition: tending to thicken or make denser
sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于使某物变稠、变厚或增加其密实程度的。

collocations.en: a material that tends to thicken or densify something
collocations.zh: 具有增稠或增密倾向的材料

formal.mt: Matul il-prova, il-materjal kellu effett seffieqi u t-taħlita saret aktar densa.
formal.en: During the trial, the material had a densifying effect and the mixture became denser.
formal.zh: 试验过程中，这种材料产生了增密作用，混合物变得更加密实。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex it-taħlita saret daqshekk ħoxna? Mark: Dak il-materjal għandu effett seffieqi; id-darba li jmiss nużaw inqas.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why has the mixture become so thick? Mark: That material has a thickening effect; next time we'll use less.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：混合物怎么变得这么稠了？马克：那种材料有增稠作用；下次我们少放一点。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 混合物怎么变得这么稠了？
messages.en: Why has the mixture become so thick?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-materjal għandu effett seffieqi; id-darba li jmiss nużaw inqas.
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-materjal għandu effett seffieqi; id-darba li jmiss nużaw inqas.
messages.zh: 那种材料有增稠作用；下次我们少放一点。
messages.en: That material has a thickening effect; next time we'll use less.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用前后两杯混合物作记忆画面：加入材料后更稠更密，便联想到这个形容词。

gloss_zh: 整经者；准备织布经线的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who prepares the warp threads for weaving.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在织布前负责准备和排列经线的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tipprepara l-medd għall-insiġ.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who prepares the warp for waving
sense_translations.zh_definition: 为织布准备经线的人；整经者。

collocations.en: the work of the warp preparer

formal.mt: Is-seffieħ ipprepara l-medd u ċċekkja l-ordni tal-ħjut qabel ma beda l-insiġ.
formal.en: The warp preparer prepared the warp and checked the order of the threads before weaving began.
formal.zh: 整经者准备好经线，并在织布开始前检查了纱线的排列顺序。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min jipprepara dawn il-ħjut qabel jibda l-insiġ? Toni: Is-seffieħ. Huwa jipprepara l-medd u jiċċekkja li l-ħjut ikunu fl-ordni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who prepares these threads before weaving begins? Toni: The warp preparer. He prepares the warp and checks that the threads are in order.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：织布开始前，是谁准备这些纱线？托尼：整经者。他准备经线，并检查纱线是否排列整齐。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: Min jipprepara dawn il-ħjut qabel jibda l-insiġ?
messages.mt_standard: Min jipprepara dawn il-ħjut qabel jibda l-insiġ?
messages.zh: 织布开始前，是谁准备这些纱线？
messages.en: Who prepares these threads before weaving begins?

messages.speaker: Toni (织布工)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-seffieħ. Huwa jipprepara l-medd u jiċċekkja li l-ħjut ikunu fl-ordni.
messages.mt_standard: Is-seffieħ. Huwa jipprepara l-medd u jiċċekkja li l-ħjut ikunu fl-ordni.
messages.zh: 整经者。他准备经线，并检查纱线是否排列整齐。
messages.en: The warp preparer. He prepares the warp and checks that the threads are in order.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象织布前有人把经线一根根排好：seffieħ 就是负责准备经线的那个人，把人物和工作画面一起记。

gloss_zh: 烤叉；串签；爱管闲事的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A rod used to hold food for roasting, or a skewer; also, a person who meddles in other people's affairs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 穿住食物以便烤制的长杆或串签；也指爱插手别人事情的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Virga li fuqha jiddendel jew jiddaħħal l-ikel biex jinxtewa; ukoll persuna li tindaħal fl-affarijiet ta' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 穿住食物以便架起烤制的烤叉或烤肉杆。
用来穿串食物的签子。
爱管闲事、常插手别人事务的人。

collocations.en: meat on a spit or skewer
collocations.zh: 穿在烤叉或串签上的肉

formal.mt: Il-kok daħħal is-seffud fil-laħam u qiegħdu fuq in-nar biex il-laħam jinxtewa b'mod uniformi.
formal.en: The cook inserted the spit into the meat and placed it over the fire so that the meat would roast evenly.
formal.zh: 厨师把烤叉穿入肉中，再架到火上，使肉均匀烤熟。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Toni reġa' daħal fil-pjanijiet tagħna bla ma staqsa. Lara: Kemm hu seffud! Ejja ngħidulu li diġà ddeċidejna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Toni has interfered with our plans again without asking. Lara: What a busybody! Let's tell him we've already decided.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：托尼又没问我们就插手我们的计划了。拉拉：他真爱管闲事！我们告诉他已经决定好了吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Toni reġa' daħal fil-pjanijiet tagħna bla ma staqsa.
messages.mt_standard: Toni reġa' daħal fil-pjanijiet tagħna bla ma staqsa.
messages.zh: 托尼又没问我们就插手我们的计划了。
messages.en: Toni has interfered with our plans again without asking.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu seffud! Ejja ngħidulu li diġà ddeċidejna.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu seffud! Ejja ngħidulu li diġà ddeċidejna.
messages.zh: 他真爱管闲事！我们告诉他已经决定好了吧。
messages.en: What a busybody! Let's tell him we've already decided.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记穿进食物的烤叉，再用爱插手事情的人作联想；这是记忆比喻，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 可被穿透的木制或芦苇制器具

teaching_sense.en_definition: A wooden or reed implement that can be pierced.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种可被穿透的木制或芦苇制器具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument tal-injam jew tal-qasab li jista' jiġi minfud.

sense_translations.en_definition: any penetratable wooden or reed instrument
sense_translations.zh_definition: 任何可被穿透的木制或芦苇制器具。

collocations.zh: 可被穿透的芦苇制器具

formal.mt: L-istudenti eżaminaw seffuda tal-injam u seffuda tal-qasab biex iqabblu ż-żewġ materjali.
formal.en: The students examined a pierceable wooden implement and a pierceable reed implement to compare the two materials.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了一件可被穿透的木制器具和一件可被穿透的芦苇制器具，以比较这两种材料。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Din is-seffuda tal-injam jew tal-qasab? Nina: Din tal-qasab; dik li hemm fuq il-mejda tal-injam.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this implement made of wood or reed? Nina: This one is made of reed; the one on the table is made of wood.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这件器具是木制的还是芦苇制的？妮娜：这件是芦苇制的；桌上那件是木制的。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.zh: 这件器具是木制的还是芦苇制的？
messages.en: Is this implement made of wood or reed?

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Din tal-qasab; dik li hemm fuq il-mejda tal-injam.
messages.mt_standard: Din tal-qasab; dik li hemm fuq il-mejda tal-injam.
messages.zh: 这件是芦苇制的；桌上那件是木制的。
messages.en: This one is made of reed; the one on the table is made of wood.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把木头与芦苇两种材料并排画出，再标注可被穿透的器具，按材料和性质记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state or condition in which a person or thing is found.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人或事物所处的状态或具体状况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istat jew il-kundizzjoni li fiha tkun persuna jew ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 某人或某物所处的状态。
某人或某物的具体状况。

formal.mt: Wara l-ispezzjoni, ġie kkonfermat li l-għamara kienet għadha f'sefgħa tajba.
formal.en: After the inspection, it was confirmed that the furniture was still in good condition.
formal.zh: 检查后确认，这些家具仍然状况良好。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-mejda għadha f'sefgħa tajba? Pawlu: Iva, għandha biss marka żgħira; nistgħu nibqgħu nużawha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is the table still in good condition? Pawlu: Yes, it only has a small mark; we can keep using it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这张桌子还完好吗？保罗：是的，只有一道小印子；我们可以继续用。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 这张桌子还完好吗？
messages.en: Is the table still in good condition?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandha biss marka żgħira; nistgħu nibqgħu nużawha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandha biss marka żgħira; nistgħu nibqgħu nużawha.
messages.zh: 是的，只有一道小印子；我们可以继续用。
messages.en: Yes, it only has a small mark; we can keep using it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象检查旧桌子时填写状况栏，用良好与不佳两种评价记住这个状态名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of drawing something in by sucking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过吸的方式把某物吸入的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tiġbed xi ħaġa 'l ġewwa billi terda'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吸或吸吮的动作。

formal.mt: Fid-deskrizzjoni tal-eżerċizzju, il-kelma sefja tirreferi għall-att li tiġbed il-likwidu 'l ġewwa minn ġo tubu.
formal.en: In the exercise description, the word sefja refers to the act of sucking liquid in through a tube.
formal.zh: 在练习说明中，sefja 指通过管子把液体吸入的动作。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-meraq mhux jitla' mit-tiben. Mark: Ipprova b'sefja qawwija, u ara jekk it-tiben huwiex misdud.
colloquial.en: Lara: The juice isn't coming up through the straw. Mark: Try a strong suck, and check whether the straw is blocked.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：果汁从吸管里吸不上来。马克：试着用力吸一下，再看看吸管是不是堵了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 果汁从吸管里吸不上来。
messages.en: The juice isn't coming up through the straw.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ipprova b'sefja qawwija, u ara jekk it-tiben huwiex misdud.
messages.mt_standard: Ipprova b'sefja qawwija, u ara jekk it-tiben huwiex misdud.
messages.zh: 试着用力吸一下，再看看吸管是不是堵了。
messages.en: Try a strong suck, and check whether the straw is blocked.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象用吸管吸一口果汁，注意记住吸的动作本身，而不是杯子或饮料。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being dense or thick, especially how closely packed or thick a material is.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 材料密实或稠厚的性质，表示其紧密或稠厚的程度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' xi ħaġa li tkun densa jew ħoxna, jiġifieri kemm tkun kompatta jew ħoxna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 密实的性质或紧密程度。
稠厚或厚实的程度。

collocations.en: the dense quality of the material

formal.mt: Matul il-prova, l-istudenti qabblu s-sefqa taż-żewġ taħlitiet billi osservaw kemm kienu ħoxnin.
formal.en: During the trial, the students compared the thickness of the two mixtures by observing how thick they were.
formal.zh: 试验过程中，学生们通过观察两份混合物有多稠，比较了它们的稠厚程度。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Is-sefqa ta' din it-taħlita tajba, jew għadha ħoxna wisq? Pawlu: Għadha ħoxna wisq; żid ftit ilma u ħawwadha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this mixture's thickness right, or is it still too thick? Pawlu: It's still too thick; add a little water and stir it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这份混合物的稠度合适吗，还是仍然太稠？保罗：还是太稠；加一点水搅拌一下。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-sefqa ta' din it-taħlita tajba, jew għadha ħoxna wisq?
messages.mt_standard: Is-sefqa ta' din it-taħlita tajba, jew għadha ħoxna wisq?
messages.zh: 这份混合物的稠度合适吗，还是仍然太稠？
messages.en: Is this mixture's thickness right, or is it still too thick?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadha ħoxna wisq; żid ftit ilma u ħawwadha.
messages.mt_standard: Għadha ħoxna wisq; żid ftit ilma u ħawwadha.
messages.zh: 还是太稠；加一点水搅拌一下。
messages.en: It's still too thick; add a little water and stir it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象勺子在浓稠混合物中移动，借阻力大小记住这个词表示密实或稠厚的程度。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small spit used to hold food while it is roasted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 烘烤食物时用来穿住或固定食物的小烤签或小烤叉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Virga żgħira li żżomm l-ikel waqt li jinxwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小烤签；用来穿烤食物的小烤叉。

formal.mt: Poġġi l-biċċiet tal-laħam fuq sefsfejfed u ixwihom fuq nar baxx.
formal.en: Place the pieces of meat on a small spit and roast them over a low fire.
formal.zh: 把肉块穿在小烤签上，用小火烤熟。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għandek sefsfejfed għall-laħam? Pawlu: Iva, qiegħed fil-kexxun ħdejn il-forn.
colloquial.en: Marta: Do you have a small spit for the meat? Pawlu: Yes, it's in the drawer next to the oven.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你有穿肉用的小烤签吗？保罗：有，在烤箱旁边的抽屉里。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 你有穿肉用的小烤签吗？
messages.en: Do you have a small spit for the meat?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，在烤箱旁边的抽屉里。
messages.en: Yes, it's in the drawer next to the oven.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一根穿着小肉块的迷你烤签，把整个词与这个厨房画面一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of drawing air or liquid inward by sucking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过吸的动作，把空气或液体吸向内部的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li tiġbed arja jew likwidu għal ġewwa billi terda'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向内吸入或吸取的动作。

formal.mt: F'dan l-esperiment, is-sefsif jiġbed l-ilma għal ġewwa t-tubu.
formal.en: In this experiment, sucking draws the water into the tube.
formal.zh: 在这个实验中，吸取动作把水吸进管内。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed jidħol l-ilma fit-tubu? Mark: Bis-sefsif; qed niġbdu għal ġewwa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is the water entering the tube? Mark: Because of the sucking action; I'm drawing it inward.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：水为什么会进入管子？马克：是吸取的作用；我正在把它往里吸。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 水为什么会进入管子？
messages.en: Why is the water entering the tube?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 是吸取的作用；我正在把它往里吸。
messages.en: Because of the sucking action; I'm drawing it inward.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆时画一支指向管内的箭头，把这个词与空气或液体被吸进去的动作相连。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To serve someone by working for them and attending to their needs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过替别人做事、照应其需要来提供服务或服侍。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li taħdem għal xi ħadd u taqdih fil-ħtiġijiet tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 服务；服侍；替别人做事。

formal.mt: Għal ħafna snin, Ġużeppi sefter għand familja fil-belt u ħa ħsieb il-ħtiġijiet ta' kuljum tagħha.
formal.en: For many years, Ġużeppi served in a family's household in the city and attended to its daily needs.
formal.zh: 多年来，朱塞佩在城里一户人家做事，照料他们的日常需要。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn kien jaħdem nannuk? David: Hu sefter għand familja fil-belt għal ħafna snin.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where did your grandfather work? David: He served in a family's household in the city for many years.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你爷爷以前在哪里工作？戴维：他在城里一户人家做了很多年的事。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你爷爷以前在哪里工作？
messages.en: Where did your grandfather work?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu sefter għand familja fil-belt għal ħafna snin.
messages.mt_standard: Hu sefter għand familja fil-belt għal ħafna snin.
messages.zh: 他在城里一户人家做了很多年的事。
messages.en: He served in a family's household in the city for many years.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用替人料理日常事务的画面记忆，并把例句中的词形与他曾服侍别人一起练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The lengthwise threads held on a loom through which the crosswise threads are woven.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 织布时沿纵向排列并固定在织机上、供纬线交织穿过的经线。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħjut imġebbda fit-tul fuq in-newl li bejniethom jgħaddu l-ħjut l-oħra waqt l-insiġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 织物中纵向排列、与纬线交织的经线或经纱。

formal.mt: Qabel beda l-insiġ, il-ħaddiem iċċekkja li l-ħjut tas-sefħa kienu mqassma sew u miġbuda b'mod uniformi.
formal.en: Before weaving began, the worker checked that the warp threads were properly spaced and evenly tensioned.
formal.zh: 开始织布之前，工人检查了经线是否排列妥当、张力是否均匀。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dawn il-ħjut twal huma s-sefħa? Rita: Iva, u waqt l-insiġ ngħaddu l-ħajt l-ieħor minn bejniethom.
colloquial.en: Nina: Are these long threads the warp? Rita: Yes, and while weaving we pass the other thread between them.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这些长长的线就是经线吗？丽塔：是的，织布时我们把另一根线从它们之间穿过去。

messages.speaker: Nina (学员)
messages.zh: 这些长长的线就是经线吗？
messages.en: Are these long threads the warp?

messages.speaker: Rita (织布老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u waqt l-insiġ ngħaddu l-ħajt l-ieħor minn bejniethom.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u waqt l-insiġ ngħaddu l-ħajt l-ieħor minn bejniethom.
messages.zh: 是的，织布时我们把另一根线从它们之间穿过去。
messages.en: Yes, and while weaving we pass the other thread between them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一排纵向绷紧的线，再画横线穿过，把这个词牢牢记在纵向经线的位置。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state in which the mind wanders and attention moves away from the task at hand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 心思游离、注意力离开眼前事情的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat li fih il-ħsieb jitbiegħed minn dak li jkun qed jagħmel wieħed u tonqos l-attenzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 精神分散；心不在焉；走神。

formal.mt: Minħabba mument ta' sehi waqt il-qari, l-istudent qabeż linja sħiħa.
formal.en: Because of a moment of mental distraction while reading, the student skipped an entire line.
formal.zh: 学生阅读时一时走神，漏读了整整一行。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Smajt x'għedtlek? Pawlu: Skużani, kelli mument ta' sehi. Tista' terġa' tgħidli?
colloquial.en: Marija: Did you hear what I told you? Pawlu: Sorry, my mind wandered for a moment. Can you tell me again?
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你听见我刚才说的话了吗？保罗：抱歉，我刚才走神了一下。你能再说一遍吗？

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听见我刚才说的话了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear what I told you?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Skużani, kelli mument ta' sehi. Tista' terġa' tgħidli?
messages.mt_standard: Skużani, kelli mument ta' sehi. Tista' terġa' tgħidli?
messages.zh: 抱歉，我刚才走神了一下。你能再说一遍吗？
messages.en: Sorry, my mind wandered for a moment. Can you tell me again?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象眼睛还停在书页上，心思却已经飘远；这个词指的就是走神这种状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of sharing something with others or taking part in a shared activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与别人分享、分担某事，或参加共同活动的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li taqsam xi ħaġa ma' oħrajn jew tieħu parti f'attività komuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 分享；共同享有或分担。
参与；参加某项活动或事务。

formal.mt: Is-sehim tal-istudenti fid-diskussjoni għen biex jinġabru ideat differenti.
formal.en: The students' participation in the discussion helped bring together different ideas.
formal.zh: 学生参与讨论，有助于汇集不同的想法。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kulħadd se jgħin fix-xogħol? Mark: Iva, is-sehim ta' kulħadd jagħmel ix-xogħol eħfef.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is everyone going to help with the work? Mark: Yes, everyone's participation makes the work easier.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：大家都会来帮忙做这项工作吗？马克：会，大家一起分担，工作就轻松些。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 大家都会来帮忙做这项工作吗？
messages.en: Is everyone going to help with the work?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, is-sehim ta' kulħadd jagħmel ix-xogħol eħfef.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, is-sehim ta' kulħadd jagħmel ix-xogħol eħfef.
messages.zh: 会，大家一起分担，工作就轻松些。
messages.en: Yes, everyone's participation makes the work easier.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用大家各出一份力的画面串联两义：把工作分着做是分担，加入其中就是参与。

gloss_zh: 心不在焉的；走神的；不专心的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Distracted or absent-minded, giving too little attention to what is happening or being done.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 心思游离，对正在发生或正在做的事情注意不足的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun moħħu xi mkien ieħor u ma jagħtix biżżejjed attenzjoni għal dak li jkun qed jiġri jew jagħmel.

sense_translations.en_definition: synonym of sehwien: distracted; absent-minded; inattentive
sense_translations.zh_definition: 与 sehwien 同义：分心的；心不在焉的；不留心的。

collocations.en: to be distracted during the lesson

formal.mt: L-istudent kien sehwieni waqt l-ispjegazzjoni u għalhekk ma fehemx l-istruzzjonijiet.
formal.en: The student was inattentive during the explanation and therefore did not understand the instructions.
formal.zh: 这名学生听讲解时心不在焉，因此没有理解操作要求。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Illum tidher sehwieni. Kollox sew? Pawlu: Iva, imma qed naħseb fuq l-eżami ta' għada.
colloquial.en: Lara: You seem distracted today. Is everything all right? Pawlu: Yes, but I'm thinking about tomorrow's exam.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你今天看起来心不在焉。还好吗？保罗：还好，不过我一直在想明天的考试。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你今天看起来心不在焉。还好吗？
messages.en: You seem distracted today. Is everything all right?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma qed naħseb fuq l-eżami ta' għada.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma qed naħseb fuq l-eżami ta' għada.
messages.zh: 还好，不过我一直在想明天的考试。
messages.en: Yes, but I'm thinking about tomorrow's exam.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它当作贴在人身上的状态标签：人在课堂，心在别处，就是心不在焉的。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sell something at a low price.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以较低的价格出售某件东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tbigħ xi ħaġa bi prezz baxx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 廉价出售；以低价卖出。

formal.mt: Qabel għalaq il-ħanut, is-sid sejjeb il-merkanzija li kien fadallu.
formal.en: Before closing the shop, the owner sold his remaining merchandise cheaply.
formal.zh: 关店之前，店主低价出售了剩余的货物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif xtrajt dak il-mejda daqshekk irħis? Mark: Is-sid sejjeb l-għamara l-qadima għax kien se jiċċaqlaq.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did you buy that table so cheaply? Mark: The owner sold the old furniture cheaply because he was moving.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你怎么买到那么便宜的桌子？Mark：原主人要搬家，所以把旧家具低价卖了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif xtrajt dak il-mejda daqshekk irħis?
messages.mt_standard: Kif xtrajt dak il-mejda daqshekk irħis?
messages.zh: 你怎么买到那么便宜的桌子？
messages.en: How did you buy that table so cheaply?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-sid sejjeb l-għamara l-qadima għax kien se jiċċaqlaq.
messages.mt_standard: Is-sid sejjeb l-għamara l-qadima għax kien se jiċċaqlaq.
messages.zh: 原主人要搬家，所以把旧家具低价卖了。
messages.en: The owner sold the old furniture cheaply because he was moving.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象搬家前给旧家具贴上低价标签，用 sejjeb 记“便宜卖”；与 sejjieb 对照时，特别留意后者多出的字母 i。

gloss_zh: 用剑处决或刺击；磨损；风化

teaching_sense.en_definition: To execute or stab someone with a sword; also, to wear something out or weather its surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用剑处决或刺击某人；也可指使某物磨损，或使其表面受到风化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li toqtol jew taqbad lil xi ħadd b'daqqa ta' xabla; ukoll, li tikkawża xedd jew deterjorament minħabba t-temp.

sense_translations.en_definition: to execute or stab with a sword
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用剑处决或刺击。
使磨损；使因反复使用或摩擦而损耗。
使风化；使因天气作用而逐渐损蚀。

collocations.en: executed or stabbed the prisoner with a sword
collocations.zh: 用剑处决或刺击了囚犯

collocations.en: wore down the surface of the wood

formal.mt: Ir-riħ qawwi sejjef il-wiċċ tal-blat matul is-snin.
formal.en: The strong wind weathered the surface of the rock over the years.
formal.zh: 强风在多年间使岩石表面逐渐风化。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-wiċċ tal-injam m'għadux lixx? Mark: Il-ħabel sejjef il-wiċċ għax baqa' jogħrok miegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the surface of the wood no longer smooth? Mark: The rope wore down the surface because it kept rubbing against it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：木头表面为什么不再光滑了？Mark：绳子一直在上面摩擦，把表面磨损了。

messages.speaker: Maja (学徒)
messages.zh: 木头表面为什么不再光滑了？
messages.en: Why is the surface of the wood no longer smooth?

messages.speaker: Mark (木工师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħabel sejjef il-wiċċ għax baqa' jogħrok miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħabel sejjef il-wiċċ għax baqa' jogħrok miegħu.
messages.zh: 绳子一直在上面摩擦，把表面磨损了。
messages.en: The rope wore down the surface because it kept rubbing against it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张学习卡分别记“剑刺、摩擦磨损、风吹风化”。这里只并列记忆三个义项，不把画面联想当作词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who seeks something or finds something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 寻找或寻求某物的人，也可指实际找到或发现某物的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tfittex xi ħaġa jew li ssibha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 寻找者；寻求某物、答案或目标的人。
找到某物的人；发现者。

formal.mt: F'dan ir-rakkont, il-protagonist huwa sejjieb tal-verità li ma jieqafx jistaqsi.
formal.en: In this narrative, the protagonist is a seeker of truth who never stops asking questions.
formal.zh: 在这篇叙事中，主人公是一位不断提问的真理寻求者。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min sab mod kif insolvu l-problema? Mark: Pawlu! Hu dejjem sejjieb ta' soluzzjonijiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who found a way to solve the problem? Mark: Pawlu! He's always someone who finds solutions.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁找到了解决问题的办法？Mark：Pawlu！他总是能找到解决办法。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Min sab mod kif insolvu l-problema?
messages.mt_standard: Min sab mod kif insolvu l-problema?
messages.zh: 谁找到了解决问题的办法？
messages.en: Who found a way to solve the problem?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu! Hu dejjem sejjieb ta' soluzzjonijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu! Hu dejjem sejjieb ta' soluzzjonijiet.
messages.zh: Pawlu！他总是能找到解决办法。
messages.en: Pawlu! He's always someone who finds solutions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一个人先拿着放大镜寻找，随后举起找到的东西：前一幕记 seeker，后一幕记 finder，两个义项都指人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who makes swords or a person skilled in fighting with a sword.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 制作剑的工匠，或擅长使用剑作战的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel ix-xwabel jew li tkun tas-sengħa fil-ġlied bix-xabla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 制剑师；制作剑的工匠。
剑士；擅长使用剑的人。

formal.mt: Fil-ġrajja, is-sejjief ħadem xabla ġdida fil-ħanut tax-xogħol tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, the sword-maker crafted a new sword in his workshop.
formal.zh: 故事中，制剑师在自己的作坊里制作了一把新剑。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak il-karattru bix-xabla? Mark: Hu sejjief tas-sengħa; fil-ġrajja jgħallem lill-oħrajn kif jużawha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that character with the sword? Mark: He's a skilled swordsman; in the story he teaches others how to use it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那个拿着剑的角色是谁？Mark：他是位技艺娴熟的剑士；故事里他教其他人用剑。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 那个拿着剑的角色是谁？
messages.en: Who is that character with the sword?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu sejjief tas-sengħa; fil-ġrajja jgħallem lill-oħrajn kif jużawha.
messages.mt_standard: Hu sejjief tas-sengħa; fil-ġrajja jgħallem lill-oħrajn kif jużawha.
messages.zh: 他是位技艺娴熟的剑士；故事里他教其他人用剑。
messages.en: He's a skilled swordsman; in the story he teaches others how to use it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两个与剑有关的人：作坊里制作剑的是制剑师，练习场上挥剑的是剑士；用场景区分同一名词的两个义项。

gloss_zh: 使用剑的；具有侵蚀作用的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Using a sword, or producing an erosive effect on a surface or material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容使用剑的活动，或形容会使表面、材料逐渐受到侵蚀的作用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinvolvi l-użu tax-xabla, jew li għandu effett ta' erożjoni fuq wiċċ jew materjal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使用剑的；以剑进行的。
具有侵蚀作用的；会造成逐渐损蚀的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-effett sejjiefi tar-riħ fuq il-wiċċ tal-blat.
formal.en: The report describes the erosive effect of wind on the surface of the rock.
formal.zh: 报告描述了风对岩石表面的侵蚀作用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ifisser 'ġlied sejjiefi' f'din is-silta? Mark: Ifisser ġlied bix-xwabel; hawn l-aġġettiv jiddeskrivi l-mod tal-ġlied.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'ġlied sejjiefi' mean in this passage? Mark: It means fighting with swords; here the adjective describes the manner of fighting.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这段文字里的 ġlied sejjiefi 是什么意思？Mark：意思是用剑作战；这里的形容词描述战斗方式。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这段文字里的 ġlied sejjiefi 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'ġlied sejjiefi' mean in this passage?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser ġlied bix-xwabel; hawn l-aġġettiv jiddeskrivi l-mod tal-ġlied.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser ġlied bix-xwabel; hawn l-aġġettiv jiddeskrivi l-mod tal-ġlied.
messages.zh: 意思是用剑作战；这里的形容词描述战斗方式。
messages.en: It means fighting with swords; here the adjective describes the manner of fighting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个名词搭配固定形容词义：ġlied 配“用剑的”，effett 配“侵蚀性的”；再与指人的 sejjief 对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who lays the foundations of a building.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责铺设建筑物地基的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tqiegħed il-pedamenti ta' bini.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 铺设地基、进行奠基工作的人。

formal.mt: Is-sejjies ħadem skont il-pjanta biex il-pedamenti jkunu sodi.
formal.en: The foundation layer worked according to the plan to ensure that the foundations were solid.
formal.zh: 奠基工按照图纸施工，以确保地基坚固。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nistgħu nibdew nibnu l-ħitan? Anna: L-ewwel irridu nistennew lis-sejjies itemm il-pedamenti.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can we start building the walls? Anna: First we need to wait for the foundation layer to finish the foundations.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我们可以开始砌墙了吗？Anna：我们得先等奠基工把地基做好。

messages.speaker: Mark (建筑工人)
messages.zh: 我们可以开始砌墙了吗？
messages.en: Can we start building the walls?

messages.speaker: Anna (工地主管)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ewwel irridu nistennew lis-sejjies itemm il-pedamenti.
messages.mt_standard: L-ewwel irridu nistennew lis-sejjies itemm il-pedamenti.
messages.zh: 我们得先等奠基工把地基做好。
messages.en: First we need to wait for the foundation layer to finish the foundations.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先有地基才有墙，想象最先进场铺设地基的工人，用这个施工顺序记住 sejjies。

gloss_zh: 起基础作用的；作为根基的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Serving as the foundation or basis on which something else is built or developed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 充当其他事物建立或发展所依靠的基础的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jservi ta' bażi jew ta' pedament għal xi ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 充当基础、起根基作用的。

formal.mt: Dan il-prinċipju sejjiesi jiggwida r-regoli kollha tal-iskola.
formal.en: This foundational principle guides all the school's rules.
formal.zh: 这项基础原则指导着学校所有规章的制定。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex nibdew minn din l-idea? David: Għax għandha rwol sejjiesi; il-pjan kollu jinbena fuqha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are we starting with this idea? David: Because it has a foundational role; the whole plan is built on it.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们为什么从这个想法开始？David：因为它起基础作用，整个计划都建立在它之上。

messages.speaker: Sara (项目组员)
messages.zh: 我们为什么从这个想法开始？
messages.en: Why are we starting with this idea?

messages.speaker: David (项目组员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għandha rwol sejjiesi; il-pjan kollu jinbena fuqha.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għandha rwol sejjiesi; il-pjan kollu jinbena fuqha.
messages.zh: 因为它起基础作用，整个计划都建立在它之上。
messages.en: Because it has a foundational role; the whole plan is built on it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把计划想成一座楼，最底下支撑全局的原则就是 sejjiesi，重点记住“起基础作用”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who calls out to someone or calls people's names.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 呼唤他人或喊出他人姓名的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ssejjaħ lil xi ħadd jew li ssejjaħ l-ismijiet tan-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出呼唤、叫人或叫名的人。

collocations.en: the person calling out the names

formal.mt: Is-sejjieħ sejjaħ lill-parteċipanti biex jidħlu fis-sala.
formal.en: The caller called the participants into the hall.
formal.zh: 叫名者招呼参与者进入大厅。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Min qed isejjaħ l-ismijiet? Pawlu: Is-sejjieħ qiegħed ħdejn il-bieb; stenna sakemm isejjaħlek.
colloquial.en: Marta: Who is calling out the names? Pawlu: The caller is next to the door; wait until he calls you.
colloquial.zh: Marta：谁在叫名字？Pawlu：叫名的人在门旁边，等他叫到你。

messages.speaker: Marta (参与者)
messages.zh: 谁在叫名字？
messages.en: Who is calling out the names?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-sejjieħ qiegħed ħdejn il-bieb; stenna sakemm isejjaħlek.
messages.mt_standard: Is-sejjieħ qiegħed ħdejn il-bieb; stenna sakemm isejjaħlek.
messages.zh: 叫名的人在门旁边，等他叫到你。
messages.en: The caller is next to the door; wait until he calls you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象门口有人拿着名单逐一叫名，把 sejjieħ 与这个呼唤他人的人联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the act of calling someone or calling out.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与呼唤某人或发出叫喊这一行为有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-att li ssejjaħ lil xi ħadd jew li tgħajjat biex issejjaħ.

sense_translations.en_definition: pertaining to the act of calling
sense_translations.zh_definition: 与呼唤、叫人这一行为有关的。

collocations.en: a gesture used to call someone over
a signal used to call someone

formal.mt: Il-ġest sejjieħi tal-għalliem wera lit-tfal li kellhom jersqu lejh.
formal.en: The teacher's calling gesture showed the children that they should come closer to him.
formal.zh: 老师招呼人的手势示意孩子们走近他。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex għamel dak il-ġest? Toni: Kien ġest sejjieħi biex nersqu lejh.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did he make that gesture? Toni: It was a calling gesture for us to come closer to him.
colloquial.zh: Lara：他为什么做那个手势？Toni：那是招呼我们走近他的手势。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 他为什么做那个手势？
messages.en: Why did he make that gesture?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien ġest sejjieħi biex nersqu lejh.
messages.mt_standard: Kien ġest sejjieħi biex nersqu lejh.
messages.zh: 那是招呼我们走近他的手势。
messages.en: It was a calling gesture for us to come closer to him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sejjieħi 放进“招呼人的手势”这个画面，记住它描述与呼唤行为有关的性质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A young hawk or falcon, expressed by the diminutive form of 'seqer'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指幼小的鹰或隼，是 seqer 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Seqer jew falkun żgħir; il-forma diminuttiva ta' 'seqer'.

sense_translations.en_definition: a young hawk or falcon (the diminutive form of 'seqer')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 幼小的鹰或隼；seqer 的指小形式。

collocations.en: a young hawk or falcon in the nest
a young hawk or falcon learning to fly
collocations.zh: 正在学飞的幼鹰或幼隼

formal.mt: L-osservaturi raw sejqer jitgħallem itir qrib il-bejta.
formal.en: The observers saw a young hawk or falcon learning to fly near the nest.
formal.zh: 观察者看到一只幼鹰或幼隼在巢附近学习飞翔。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dak sejqer fil-bejta? Ruben: Iva, għadu żgħir; ejja narawh mill-bogħod.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is that a young hawk or falcon in the nest? Ruben: Yes, it is still young; let's watch it from a distance.
colloquial.zh: Nina：巢里那只是幼鹰或幼隼吗？Ruben：是啊，它还小，我们远远地看吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (观鸟爱好者)
messages.zh: 巢里那只是幼鹰或幼隼吗？
messages.en: Is that a young hawk or falcon in the nest?

messages.speaker: Ruben (观鸟同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadu żgħir; ejja narawh mill-bogħod.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadu żgħir; ejja narawh mill-bogħod.
messages.zh: 是啊，它还小，我们远远地看吧。
messages.en: Yes, it is still young; let's watch it from a distance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 将 seqer 与 sejqer 成对记忆：看到后者就想象巢中尚在学飞的小鹰，突出幼小的形象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of calling to someone or calling for attention, help, or a response.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向某人发出呼叫或召唤，以引起注意、寻求帮助或得到回应的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li ssejjaħ lil xi ħadd jew titlob attenzjoni, għajnuna jew tweġiba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 呼叫或召唤的行为。

formal.mt: Is-sejħ għall-għajnuna ġibed l-attenzjoni tan-nies li kienu fil-qrib.
formal.en: The calling for help attracted the attention of the people nearby.
formal.zh: 呼救引起了附近人们的注意。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt dak is-sejħ? Mark: Iva, xi ħadd qed jitlob l-għajnuna. Ejja naraw x'ġara.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you hear that calling? Mark: Yes, someone is asking for help. Let's see what happened.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你听到刚才的呼喊了吗？Mark：听到了，有人在求助。我们去看看发生了什么。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听到刚才的呼喊了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that calling?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, xi ħadd qed jitlob l-għajnuna. Ejja naraw x'ġara.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, xi ħadd qed jitlob l-għajnuna. Ejja naraw x'ġara.
messages.zh: 听到了，有人在求助。我们去看看发生了什么。
messages.en: Yes, someone is asking for help. Let's see what happened.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sejħ 记成名词性的“呼叫这件事”：脑中播放有人喊救命的声音，再联记 għall-għajnuna 表示呼救目的。

gloss_zh: 耕地者；爱打探隐私的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who ploughs land; also, a person who pries into other people's private affairs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 耕犁土地的人；也指爱打探他人私事的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li taħrat l-art; ukoll persuna li tindaħal fil-ħajja privata ta' ħaddieħor biex issir taf id-dettalji.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 耕地、犁田的人。
爱打探他人私事、窥探隐私的人。

collocations.en: a person who ploughs the fields

collocations.zh: 好奇心过强、爱打探隐私的人

formal.mt: Is-sekkiek beda jaħrat l-għalqa kmieni filgħodu.
formal.en: The ploughman began ploughing the field early in the morning.
formal.zh: 耕地者一大早便开始犁田。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex Pawlu jrid ikun jaf kollox dwarna? Ġorġ: Xi sekkiek! Dejjem jistaqsi dwar affarijiet privati.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why does Pawlu want to know everything about us? Ġorġ: What a prier! He is always asking about private matters.
colloquial.zh: Marija：Pawlu 为什么想知道我们所有的事情？Ġorġ：他可真爱打探隐私！总是问些私事。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu jrid ikun jaf kollox dwarna?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu jrid ikun jaf kollox dwarna?
messages.zh: Pawlu 为什么想知道我们所有的事情？
messages.en: Why does Pawlu want to know everything about us?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi sekkiek! Dejjem jistaqsi dwar affarijiet privati.
messages.mt_standard: Xi sekkiek! Dejjem jistaqsi dwar affarijiet privati.
messages.zh: 他可真爱打探隐私！总是问些私事。
messages.en: What a prier! He is always asking about private matters.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 sekkiek 配两张独立记忆卡：田里犁地的人，以及不停追问私事的人；依语境选择词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to pry into other people's lives or private affairs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 倾向于打探他人生活或私事的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jindaħal fil-ħajja privata ta' ħaddieħor biex isir jaf id-dettalji.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有窥探他人、打探别人隐私倾向的。

collocations.en: a man who tends to pry
collocations.zh: 爱打探他人私事的男子

formal.mt: L-atteġġjament sekkieki tiegħu ġiegħel lill-kollegi jevitaw diskussjonijiet personali.
formal.en: His prying attitude made his colleagues avoid personal discussions.
formal.zh: 他爱打探隐私的态度使同事们避免谈论个人话题。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għaliex ma għedtlu xejn dwar il-familja tiegħek? Simon: Għax hu sekkieki wisq u jistaqsi dwar kull dettall.
colloquial.en: Elena: Why didn't you tell him anything about your family? Simon: Because he is too nosy and asks about every detail.
colloquial.zh: Elena：你为什么一点家里的事都没告诉他？Simon：因为他太爱打探隐私，什么细节都要问。

messages.speaker: Elena (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma għedtlu xejn dwar il-familja tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma għedtlu xejn dwar il-familja tiegħek?
messages.zh: 你为什么一点家里的事都没告诉他？
messages.en: Why didn't you tell him anything about your family?

messages.speaker: Simon (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu sekkieki wisq u jistaqsi dwar kull dettall.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu sekkieki wisq u jistaqsi dwar kull dettall.
messages.zh: 因为他太爱打探隐私，什么细节都要问。
messages.en: Because he is too nosy and asks about every detail.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想到有人连私人生活的每个细节都追问，就用 sekkieki 描述他爱打探隐私的性情或态度。

gloss_zh: 用刀刺人者；持刀行凶者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who attacks or stabs someone with a knife.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用刀袭击或刺伤他人的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tattakka jew taqla' sikkina fuq xi ħadd u tferrih biha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用刀袭击或刺伤他人的行凶者。

collocations.en: the arrest of the knife attacker

formal.mt: Il-pulizija arrestat lis-sekkien wara li xhud identifikah.
formal.en: The police arrested the knife attacker after a witness identified him.
formal.zh: 一名目击者认出持刀行凶者后，警方将其逮捕。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Qrajt l-aħbar dwar is-sekkien? Karl: Iva, il-pulizija arrestatu lbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Rita: Did you read the news about the knife attacker? Karl: Yes, the police arrested him yesterday.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你看了那名持刀行凶者的新闻吗？Karl：看了，警方昨天逮捕了他。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看了那名持刀行凶者的新闻吗？
messages.en: Did you read the news about the knife attacker?

messages.speaker: Karl (朋友)
messages.zh: 看了，警方昨天逮捕了他。
messages.en: Yes, the police arrested him yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sekkien 放进警方逮捕持刀行凶者的新闻句中记忆，牢牢记住这个词指实施袭击的人。

gloss_zh: 持刀伤人的；用刀袭击人的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a person who attacks or wounds someone with a knife.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容用刀袭击或刺伤他人的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jattakka jew iweġġa' lil xi ħadd b'sikkina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用刀袭击或刺伤他人的人；作形容词描述此类人。

collocations.en: a man who attacks people with a knife
an attacker who uses a knife

formal.mt: Ix-xhud iddeskriva lill-aggressur bħala raġel sekkieni li kien weġġa' persuna b'sikkina.
formal.en: The witness described the attacker as a man who had wounded someone with a knife.
formal.zh: 证人将袭击者描述为一名用刀刺伤过他人的男子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'sekkieni'? Mark: Ifisser xi ħadd li jattakka jew iweġġa' lil ħaddieħor b'sikkina.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'sekkieni' mean? Mark: It means someone who attacks or wounds another person with a knife.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：sekkieni 是什么意思？马克：指用刀袭击或刺伤别人的人。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: sekkieni 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'sekkieni' mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser xi ħadd li jattakka jew iweġġa' lil ħaddieħor b'sikkina.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser xi ħadd li jattakka jew iweġġa' lil ħaddieħor b'sikkina.
messages.zh: 指用刀袭击或刺伤别人的人。
messages.en: It means someone who attacks or wounds another person with a knife.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“持刀袭击者”的新闻画面中记忆，重点记住它描述人的伤人行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Second in an order or arrangement, as in a second violin or second tenor part.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在顺序或编排中居第二的，例如第二小提琴或第二男高音声部。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiġi fit-tieni post f'ordni jew f'arranġament, bħal fil-parti tal-vjolin sekond.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 第二的；在顺序或编排中排第二的。

formal.mt: F'dan l-arranġament, il-vjolin sekond jakkumpanja l-melodija tal-vjolin prim.
formal.en: In this arrangement, the second violin accompanies the first violin's melody.
formal.zh: 在这份编曲中，第二小提琴为第一小提琴的旋律伴奏。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema parti se ddoqq illum? Mark: Il-parti tal-vjolin sekond.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which part are you playing today? Mark: The second violin part.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你今天演奏哪个声部？马克：第二小提琴声部。

messages.speaker: Maja (乐团成员)
messages.zh: 你今天演奏哪个声部？
messages.en: Which part are you playing today?

messages.speaker: Mark (小提琴手)
messages.zh: 第二小提琴声部。
messages.en: The second violin part.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象乐谱上标着数字二的声部，把 sekond 与“第二的”直接配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Secondly; used to introduce the second point, reason, or consideration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 其次；用于引出第二个论点、理由或考虑事项。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fit-tieni lok; tintuża biex tintroduċi t-tieni punt, raġuni jew konsiderazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 其次；第二点是，用于按顺序展开说明。

formal.mt: L-ewwel nett, irridu niżguraw is-sigurtà tal-parteċipanti. Sekondarjament, irridu nqisu l-ispiża tal-attività.
formal.en: First, we must ensure the participants' safety. Secondly, we must consider the cost of the activity.
formal.zh: 首先，我们必须确保参与者的安全。其次，我们必须考虑活动的费用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għażilt dan il-kors? Mark: L-ewwel nett, jogħġobni s-suġġett; sekondarjament, il-ħinijiet jaqbluli.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you choose this course? Mark: First, I like the subject; secondly, the times suit me.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么选这门课？马克：首先，我喜欢这个科目；其次，上课时间适合我。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么选这门课？
messages.en: Why did you choose this course?

messages.speaker: Mark (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ewwel nett, jogħġobni s-suġġett; sekondarjament, il-ħinijiet jaqbluli.
messages.mt_standard: L-ewwel nett, jogħġobni s-suġġett; sekondarjament, il-ħinijiet jaqbluli.
messages.zh: 首先，我喜欢这个科目；其次，上课时间适合我。
messages.en: First, I like the subject; secondly, the times suit me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 写理由时先列第一点，再用 sekondarjament 引出第二点，按发言顺序记住“其次”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Secondary: less central than the main thing, or relating to education after primary school.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 次要的、相对于主要事物处于第二位的；也可指小学之后的中等教育。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li huwa ta' importanza inqas minn dak prinċipali, jew li jirrigwarda l-edukazzjoni wara l-iskola primarja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 次要的、辅助的；也指中等教育阶段的。

formal.mt: L-għan prinċipali tal-proġett huwa li jtejjeb is-servizz; it-tnaqqis tal-ispejjeż huwa għan sekondarju.
formal.en: The project's main aim is to improve the service; reducing costs is a secondary aim.
formal.zh: 该项目的主要目标是改善服务；降低成本是次要目标。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kulur huwa importanti għalik? Mark: Huwa sekondarju; l-importanti hu li s-siġġu jkun komdu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the colour important to you? Mark: It's secondary; what matters is that the chair is comfortable.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：颜色对你重要吗？马克：颜色是次要的，重要的是椅子坐着舒服。

messages.speaker: Maja (店员)
messages.zh: 颜色对你重要吗？
messages.en: Is the colour important to you?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa sekondarju; l-importanti hu li s-siġġu jkun komdu.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa sekondarju; l-importanti hu li s-siġġu jkun komdu.
messages.zh: 颜色是次要的，重要的是椅子坐着舒服。
messages.en: It's secondary; what matters is that the chair is comfortable.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“主要目标旁边的次要目标”记一般义，再把“中等教育阶段”单独做成情境卡片。
