teaching_sense.en_definition: The hand on a clock or watch that indicates seconds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 钟表上用来指示秒数的指针，即秒针。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-labra ta' arloġġ li turi s-sekondi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钟或手表上指示秒数的秒针。

formal.mt: Biex tkejjel minuta, osserva s-sekondiera sakemm tagħmel dawra sħiħa.
formal.en: To measure one minute, watch the second hand until it completes a full revolution.
formal.zh: 要计量一分钟，请观察秒针，直到它转完一整圈。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-arloġġ għadu jaħdem? Mark: Naħseb li le; ara, is-sekondiera waqfet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this clock still working? Mark: I don't think so; look, the second hand has stopped.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个钟还在走吗？马克：我觉得没有了；你看，秒针停了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 这个钟还在走吗？
messages.en: Is this clock still working?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħseb li le; ara, is-sekondiera waqfet.
messages.mt_standard: Naħseb li le; ara, is-sekondiera waqfet.
messages.zh: 我觉得没有了；你看，秒针停了。
messages.en: I don't think so; look, the second hand has stopped.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象钟面上逐秒移动的细针，把 sekondiera 与“秒针转一圈是一分钟”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To ask inquisitive questions or pry into matters, especially another person's private affairs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 出于好奇而不断探问，尤其指打探别人的私事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jistaqsi ħafna biex ikun jaf iżjed, speċjalment dwar affarijiet privati ta' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打探、窥探，尤其指探问别人不愿公开的私事。
好奇探问；表现出想弄清更多事情的强烈好奇心。

collocations.en: he pried into her private life
he asked inquisitively to find out more
collocations.zh: 他好奇地追问，想了解更多

formal.mt: Matul il-laqgħa, wieħed mill-mistednin seksef dwar il-ħajja privata tal-kelliem, li għażel li ma jweġibx.
formal.en: During the meeting, one of the guests pried into the speaker's private life, and the speaker chose not to answer.
formal.zh: 会议期间，一名来宾打探发言者的私生活，发言者选择不作回答。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu staqsa tant dwar il-ġirien? Mark: Seksef għax ried ikun jaf kollox dwarhom.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu ask so much about the neighbours? Mark: He was prying because he wanted to know everything about them.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么问了那么多关于邻居的事？马克：他在打探，因为他想知道他们的一切。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu staqsa tant dwar il-ġirien?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu staqsa tant dwar il-ġirien?
messages.zh: 保罗为什么问了那么多关于邻居的事？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu ask so much about the neighbours?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Seksef għax ried ikun jaf kollox dwarhom.
messages.mt_standard: Seksef għax ried ikun jaf kollox dwarhom.
messages.zh: 他在打探，因为他想知道他们的一切。
messages.en: He was prying because he wanted to know everything about them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人连续追问“还有呢、为什么”，用这个画面记好奇探问与打探私事两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To gossip about other people or pry into their affairs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 谈论别人的闲话，或打探别人的事情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitkellem fuq ħaddieħor u l-affarijiet tiegħu, jew jistaqsi biex jiskopri affarijiet privati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 说闲话；议论别人的私事或传闻。
打探、探问别人的私事。

formal.mt: Waqt il-pawża, impjegat seksek dwar il-kollegi tiegħu u xerred informazzjoni li ma kinitx ikkonfermata.
formal.en: During the break, an employee gossiped about his colleagues and spread information that had not been confirmed.
formal.zh: 休息期间，一名员工议论同事，并传播未经证实的信息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel Pawlu waqt li konna barra? Mark: Seksek mal-ġirien dwar min se jmur joqgħod fid-dar ta' ħdejna.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did Pawlu do while we were out? Mark: He gossiped with the neighbours about who was going to move into the house next door.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们出去的时候，保罗做了什么？马克：他和邻居们聊闲话，议论谁会搬进我们隔壁的房子。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: X'għamel Pawlu waqt li konna barra?
messages.mt_standard: X'għamel Pawlu waqt li konna barra?
messages.zh: 我们出去的时候，保罗做了什么？
messages.en: What did Pawlu do while we were out?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Seksek mal-ġirien dwar min se jmur joqgħod fid-dar ta' ħdejna.
messages.mt_standard: Seksek mal-ġirien dwar min se jmur joqgħod fid-dar ta' ħdejna.
messages.zh: 他和邻居们聊闲话，议论谁会搬进我们隔壁的房子。
messages.en: He gossiped with the neighbours about who was going to move into the house next door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“邻居聚在一起议论别人”的场景记说闲话，再联想到为了闲话而打探私事。

gloss_zh: 好奇爱问的人；爱打探私事的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: An inquisitive person, especially someone who pries into other people's private affairs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 好奇心强、爱探问的人，尤其指爱打听别人私事的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tistaqsi ħafna għax trid tkun taf, speċjalment dwar il-ħajja privata ta' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 好奇心强、喜欢追问和探究的人。
爱打探别人私事的人；喜欢刨根问底的人。

collocations.en: an inquisitive person who asks many questions
someone who pries into other people's lives

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ġar jidher bħala seksief li dejjem jipprova jsir jaf id-dettalji tal-ħajja privata tal-oħrajn.
formal.en: In the story, the neighbour appears as a prying person who is always trying to learn the details of other people's private lives.
formal.zh: 故事中的邻居是个爱打探私事的人，总想弄清别人私生活的细节。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex staqsejt kemm jaqla' l-ġar? Mark: Għandek raġun, kont seksief. Ma kellix għalfejn nistaqsi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you ask how much the neighbour earns? Mark: You're right, I was being nosy. I had no reason to ask.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么问邻居挣多少钱？马克：你说得对，我太爱打探了。我没有理由问这个。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么问邻居挣多少钱？
messages.en: Why did you ask how much the neighbour earns?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun, kont seksief. Ma kellix għalfejn nistaqsi.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun, kont seksief. Ma kellix għalfejn nistaqsi.
messages.zh: 你说得对，我太爱打探了。我没有理由问这个。
messages.en: You're right, I was being nosy. I had no reason to ask.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给总爱追问别人私事的故事人物贴上 seksief 标签，记住这个名词指“爱探问的人”。

gloss_zh: 爱探听隐私的；爱说闲话的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to pry into other people's affairs or talk about their private lives.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 喜欢探听别人的私事，或喜欢谈论他人隐私、传播闲话的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħobb jistaqsi dwar il-ħajja privata ta' ħaddieħor jew jitkellem dwarha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱探听他人私事的；好打听隐私的。
爱说闲话的；喜欢议论他人私生活的。

collocations.zh: 爱打听私事或说闲话的邻居

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, il-ġar seksiefi jipprova jsir jaf għaliex il-familja telqet mir-raħal.
formal.en: In the story, the prying neighbour tries to find out why the family left the village.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个爱打听私事的邻居试图弄清这家人为何离开村庄。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex trid tkun taf ma' min ħarġet Sara? Mark: Għandek raġun, qed inkun seksiefi. Aħjar inħalliha fil-kwiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you want to know who Sara went out with? Mark: You're right, I'm being nosy. I'd better leave her alone.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么想知道萨拉跟谁出去了？马克：你说得对，我是在打听她的私事。我还是别烦她了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex trid tkun taf ma' min ħarġet Sara?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex trid tkun taf ma' min ħarġet Sara?
messages.zh: 你为什么想知道萨拉跟谁出去了？
messages.en: Why do you want to know who Sara went out with?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun, qed inkun seksiefi. Aħjar inħalliha fil-kwiet.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun, qed inkun seksiefi. Aħjar inħalliha fil-kwiet.
messages.zh: 你说得对，我是在打听她的私事。我还是别烦她了。
messages.en: You're right, I'm being nosy. I'd better leave her alone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个邻居竖起耳朵听私事，听完又向别人议论；用这个画面同时记住“爱探听”和“爱说闲话”两个形容词义。

gloss_zh: 爱说闲话的人；爱传闲话的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who habitually talks about other people's private affairs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经常议论他人私事或传播闲话的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li spiss titkellem dwar il-ħajja privata ta' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱说闲话、议论他人私事或传播闲话的人。

collocations.zh: 出了名的爱说闲话的人

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, is-seksiek tal-viċinat ixerred stejjer dwar il-familji li jgħixu fl-istess triq.
formal.en: In the novel, the neighbourhood gossiper spreads stories about the families living on the same street.
formal.zh: 小说中，街坊里那个爱传闲话的人散播有关同一条街上各户人家的传闻。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Nista' ngħid lil Pawlu li se nibdel ix-xogħol? Maja: Aħjar tistenna. Hu seksiek u kulħadd isir jaf.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can I tell Pawlu that I'm changing jobs? Maja: You'd better wait. He's a gossiper, and everyone will find out.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我可以告诉保罗我要换工作了吗？玛雅：最好先等等。他爱传闲话，到时候所有人都会知道。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' ngħid lil Pawlu li se nibdel ix-xogħol?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' ngħid lil Pawlu li se nibdel ix-xogħol?
messages.zh: 我可以告诉保罗我要换工作了吗？
messages.en: Can I tell Pawlu that I'm changing jobs?

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar tistenna. Hu seksiek u kulħadd isir jaf.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar tistenna. Hu seksiek u kulħadd isir jaf.
messages.zh: 最好先等等。他爱传闲话，到时候所有人都会知道。
messages.en: You'd better wait. He's a gossiper, and everyone will find out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 seksiek 想成聚会中不断转述别人私事的那个人；记忆时问“是谁在传闲话”，提醒自己这是指人的名词。

gloss_zh: 爱说闲话的；好议论他人的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to gossip about other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有说闲话的倾向，喜欢议论别人的私事的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jitkellem dwar il-ħajja privata ta' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于说闲话的；喜欢议论他人私事的。

collocations.en: a colleague who tends to gossip
a character who tends to gossip
collocations.zh: 爱议论他人私事的角色

formal.mt: L-awtur jippreżenta karattru seksieki li dejjem idawwar il-konversazzjoni lejn il-ħajja privata ta' ħaddieħor.
formal.en: The author presents a character who tends to gossip and always turns the conversation towards other people's private lives.
formal.zh: 作者塑造了一个爱说闲话的角色，他总把话题转向别人的私生活。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex ma tgħidx lil Ġanni dwar il-pjan tiegħek? Sara: Għax hu seksieki, u rrid ngħid lill-oħrajn jien stess.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why don't you tell Ġanni about your plan? Sara: Because he tends to gossip, and I want to tell the others myself.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你为什么不把计划告诉詹尼？萨拉：因为他爱说闲话，而我想亲自告诉其他人。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma tgħidx lil Ġanni dwar il-pjan tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma tgħidx lil Ġanni dwar il-pjan tiegħek?
messages.zh: 你为什么不把计划告诉詹尼？
messages.en: Why don't you tell Ġanni about your plan?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu seksieki, u rrid ngħid lill-oħrajn jien stess.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu seksieki, u rrid ngħid lill-oħrajn jien stess.
messages.zh: 因为他爱说闲话，而我想亲自告诉其他人。
messages.en: Because he tends to gossip, and I want to tell the others myself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 seksieki 写在人物卡的“性格特点”一栏，旁边画一张总在议论别人的嘴，记住它描述“爱说闲话的”倾向。

gloss_zh: 探听私事；好打听；好奇心

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of prying into other people's affairs, or a strong desire to find things out.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 探听他人私事的行为，或想要弄清事情的好奇心理；是否带贬义取决于语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jistaqsi dwar affarijiet privati ta' ħaddieħor, jew ix-xewqa li jkun jaf aktar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 探听、打听他人私事的行为。
好奇心；想要进一步了解事情的心理或倾向。

formal.mt: F'din ix-xena, is-seksif tal-ġar iġiegħel lill-familja tħossha skomda.
formal.en: In this scene, the neighbour's prying makes the family feel uncomfortable.
formal.zh: 在这一幕中，邻居探听私事的行为让这家人感到不自在。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tistaqsini kemm inħallas kera? Mark: Skużani, kien seksif żejjed. M'għandekx għalfejn twieġeb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you asking me how much rent I pay? Mark: Sorry, that was too much prying. You don't have to answer.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么问我付多少房租？马克：对不起，我打听得太多了。你不用回答。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tistaqsini kemm inħallas kera?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tistaqsini kemm inħallas kera?
messages.zh: 你为什么问我付多少房租？
messages.en: Why are you asking me how much rent I pay?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Skużani, kien seksif żejjed. M'għandekx għalfejn twieġeb.
messages.mt_standard: Skużani, kien seksif żejjed. M'għandekx għalfejn twieġeb.
messages.zh: 对不起，我打听得太多了。你不用回答。
messages.en: Sorry, that was too much prying. You don't have to answer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个大问号伸进别人的私人抽屉：问号代表好奇心，伸进抽屉代表探听私事；这两个画面帮助记住两个名词义。

gloss_zh: 闲话；关于他人私事的议论

teaching_sense.en_definition: Informal talk about other people's private affairs, often involving unconfirmed information.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 围绕他人私事展开的闲谈或议论，其中的信息往往未经证实。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Diskors dwar il-ħajja privata ta' ħaddieħor, spiss b'informazzjoni li ma tkunx ġiet ikkonfermata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 闲话；有关他人私生活、往往未经证实的议论。

formal.mt: L-artiklu jiddistingwi bejn informazzjoni kkonfermata u seksik dwar il-ħajja privata tal-atturi.
formal.en: The article distinguishes between confirmed information and gossip about the actors' private lives.
formal.zh: 这篇文章区分了经过证实的信息与关于演员私生活的闲话。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Veru li l-ġirien se jitilqu? Maja: Ma nafx. S'issa smajt biss seksik.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is it true that the neighbours are leaving? Maja: I don't know. So far, I've only heard gossip.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：邻居们真的要搬走吗？玛雅：我不知道。目前我听到的都只是闲话。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.zh: 邻居们真的要搬走吗？
messages.en: Is it true that the neighbours are leaving?

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx. S'issa smajt biss seksik.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx. S'issa smajt biss seksik.
messages.zh: 我不知道。目前我听到的都只是闲话。
messages.en: I don't know. So far, I've only heard gossip.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画几个传话气泡，在气泡里写 seksik：它指传来传去的闲话内容；再与指说闲话者的 seksiek 对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Arranged or carried out in a particular order, with one item or step following another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按照一定次序排列或进行的，各项或各步骤一个接着一个。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun irranġat jew isir f'ordni partikolari, b'ħaġa jew pass wara l-ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 按顺序排列的；依次发生或进行的。

formal.mt: L-istudenti għandhom iqiegħdu l-istampi f'ordni sekwenzjali biex juru kif żviluppat l-istorja.
formal.en: The students should place the pictures in sequential order to show how the story developed.
formal.zh: 学生应按先后顺序排列图片，展示故事的发展过程。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Nista' nibda mit-tielet pass? Pawlu: Le, dan hu proċess sekwenzjali. L-ewwel trid tlesti l-ewwel żewġ passi.
colloquial.en: Lina: Can I start with the third step? Pawlu: No, this is a sequential process. You need to finish the first two steps first.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：我可以从第三步开始吗？保罗：不行，这是一个按顺序进行的过程。你得先完成前两步。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.zh: 我可以从第三步开始吗？
messages.en: Can I start with the third step?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, dan hu proċess sekwenzjali. L-ewwel trid tlesti l-ewwel żewġ passi.
messages.mt_standard: Le, dan hu proċess sekwenzjali. L-ewwel trid tlesti l-ewwel żewġ passi.
messages.zh: 不行，这是一个按顺序进行的过程。你得先完成前两步。
messages.en: No, this is a sequential process. You need to finish the first two steps first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sekwenzjali 写在“一、二、三”连续编号旁，想象沿台阶逐级向上走，记住它强调各项按次序接续。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element called selenium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素硒的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Element kimiku li bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ selenium.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 硒，一种化学元素。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tal-laboratorju jindika l-ammont ta' selenju misjub fil-kampjun.
formal.en: The laboratory report indicates the amount of selenium found in the sample.
formal.zh: 实验室报告标明了样品中检出的硒含量。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Xi tfisser il-kelma selenju f'dan l-eżerċizzju? Pawlu: Hija l-isem ta' element kimiku. Bl-Ingliż ngħidu selenium.
colloquial.en: Lina: What does the word selenju mean in this exercise? Pawlu: It's the name of a chemical element. In English, we say selenium.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：这道练习里的 selenju 是什么意思？保罗：它是一种化学元素的名称，英语叫 selenium，中文叫硒。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser il-kelma selenju f'dan l-eżerċizzju?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser il-kelma selenju f'dan l-eżerċizzju?
messages.zh: 这道练习里的 selenju 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word selenju mean in this exercise?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija l-isem ta' element kimiku. Bl-Ingliż ngħidu selenium.
messages.mt_standard: Hija l-isem ta' element kimiku. Bl-Ingliż ngħidu selenium.
messages.zh: 它是一种化学元素的名称，英语叫 selenium，中文叫硒。
messages.en: It's the name of a chemical element. In English, we say selenium.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张三语元素卡，把 selenju、selenium 和“硒”并排写下；用两个外语词相似的拼写帮助配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A loan of money, or something borrowed with the intention of returning it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 需要归还的一笔借款，也可指借来并打算归还的东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Somma flus mislufa, jew xi ħaġa mislufa li għandha tingħata lura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一笔借款；需按约定归还的款项。
借来的东西；暂时借用、需要归还的物品。

formal.mt: Il-ftehim jispeċifika li s-selfa ta' mitejn ewro għandha titħallas lura sal-aħħar tax-xahar.
formal.en: The agreement specifies that the loan of two hundred euros must be repaid by the end of the month.
formal.zh: 协议规定，这笔二百欧元的借款须在月底前偿还。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-ktieb tiegħek? Mark: Le, huwa selfa mingħand Sara. Se nagħtihulha lura għada.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this book yours? Mark: No, it's something I borrowed from Sara. I'll give it back to her tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这本书是你的吗？马克：不是，是我向萨拉借的。我明天会还给她。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这本书是你的吗？
messages.en: Is this book yours?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa selfa mingħand Sara. Se nagħtihulha lura għada.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa selfa mingħand Sara. Se nagħtihulha lura għada.
messages.zh: 不是，是我向萨拉借的。我明天会还给她。
messages.en: No, it's something I borrowed from Sara. I'll give it back to her tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象钱和一本书都贴着“借来要还”的标签：钱对应“一笔借款”，书对应“借来的东西”，两者都可以联系 selfa 来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To slip away quietly or without attracting attention.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 悄悄离开某个地方，尽量不引起别人的注意。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitlaq bil-kwiet minn xi post mingħajr ma jiġbed l-attenzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 溜走；悄悄离开。

formal.mt: Waqt li l-mistednin kienu qed jitkellmu, Mark sellek bil-kwiet mis-sala.
formal.en: While the guests were talking, Mark quietly slipped away from the hall.
formal.zh: 宾客们交谈时，Mark 悄悄溜出了大厅。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn mar Mark? Toni: Sellek waqt li konna nitkellmu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where did Mark go? Toni: He slipped away while we were talking.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Mark 去哪儿了？Toni：我们说话的时候，他溜走了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did Mark go?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们说话的时候，他溜走了。
messages.en: He slipped away while we were talking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象大家正在聊天，一个人轻轻关门溜走，把 sellek 和这个安静离开的动作一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who lends something, including someone who lends money.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物品或钱借给别人的人，包括放贷人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ssellef xi ħaġa lil ħaddieħor, inklużi l-flus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出借物品或钱款的人；包括放贷人。

formal.mt: Id-dokument jidentifika lil Mark bħala s-sellief u lil Pawlu bħala l-persuna li ssellfet il-flus.
formal.en: The document identifies Mark as the lender and Pawlu as the person who borrowed the money.
formal.zh: 文件注明 Mark 是出借人，Pawlu 是借款人。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min hu s-sellief ta' dan il-ktieb? Mark: Jien; tista' trodduli għada.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who is the lender of this book? Mark: I am; you can return it to me tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这本书是谁借出来的？Mark：是我；你明天还给我就行。

messages.speaker: Nina (借书人)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu s-sellief ta' dan il-ktieb?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu s-sellief ta' dan il-ktieb?
messages.zh: 这本书是谁借出来的？
messages.en: Who is the lender of this book?

messages.speaker: Mark (出借人)
messages.zh: 是我；你明天还给我就行。
messages.en: I am; you can return it to me tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一支从出借人指向借用人的箭头，把 sellief 写在递出书或钱的一端，记牢借出的方向。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to lend things to other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人有把东西借给别人的倾向或习惯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza jsellef affarijiet lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 惯于把东西借给别人的；有出借东西倾向的。

collocations.en: a man inclined to lend things
collocations.zh: 一个惯于出借东西的男人

collocations.en: a neighbour inclined to lend things
collocations.zh: 一位常把东西借给别人的邻居

formal.mt: Mark huwa raġel selliefi li spiss isellef il-kotba tiegħu lill-ħbieb.
formal.en: Mark is a man inclined to lend things, and he often lends his books to friends.
formal.zh: Mark 惯于把东西借给别人，经常把自己的书借给朋友。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Taħseb li Mark isellifni sellum? Toni: Iva, hu selliefi ħafna; spiss isellef l-għodda tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you think Mark will lend me a ladder? Toni: Yes, he is very inclined to lend things; he often lends out his tools.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你觉得 Mark 会借我一把梯子吗？Toni：会的，他很乐于出借东西，经常把工具借给别人。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.zh: 你觉得 Mark 会借我一把梯子吗？
messages.en: Do you think Mark will lend me a ladder?

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hu selliefi ħafna; spiss isellef l-għodda tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hu selliefi ħafna; spiss isellef l-għodda tiegħu.
messages.zh: 会的，他很乐于出借东西，经常把工具借给别人。
messages.en: Yes, he is very inclined to lend things; he often lends out his tools.

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排记 sellief 和 selliefi：前者回答谁在出借，后者描述这个人常把东西借给别人的习惯。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who helps someone else get away.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 帮助另一个人离开或脱身的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tgħin lil ħaddieħor jitlaq jew jaħrab.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who helps another get away
sense_translations.zh_definition: 帮助别人离开、逃脱或脱身的人。

collocations.en: a skilled helper in getting someone away
collocations.zh: 善于帮助别人脱身的人

collocations.en: the role of the person who helps another get away
collocations.zh: 帮助别人脱身者的角色

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, is-selliek għen lil Pawlu joħroġ mingħajr ma nduna ħadd.
formal.en: In the story, the helper enabled Pawlu to get away without anyone noticing.
formal.zh: 故事里，那位帮助者让 Pawlu 在无人察觉的情况下脱了身。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min kien is-selliek ta' Pawlu fid-dramm? Toni: Mark; hu għenu joħroġ mill-kamra.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who helped Pawlu get away in the play? Toni: Mark; he helped him get out of the room.
colloquial.zh: Sara：剧里是谁帮 Pawlu 脱身的？Toni：Mark，是他帮 Pawlu 离开了房间。

messages.speaker: Sara (观众)
messages.mt_spoken: Min kien is-selliek ta' Pawlu fid-dramm?
messages.mt_standard: Min kien is-selliek ta' Pawlu fid-dramm?
messages.zh: 剧里是谁帮 Pawlu 脱身的？
messages.en: Who helped Pawlu get away in the play?

messages.speaker: Toni (观众)
messages.zh: Mark，是他帮 Pawlu 离开了房间。
messages.en: Mark; he helped him get out of the room.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一人替另一人打开出口，把 selliek 写在帮助者身上；与表示溜走动作的 sellek 配成一幅情景图。

gloss_zh: 善于脱困的；能巧妙摆脱麻烦的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to get out of a difficult situation or escape a spot of trouble.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人善于寻找脱身办法，能够巧妙地摆脱麻烦或困境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kapaċi jsib mod kif joħroġ mill-inkwiet jew minn sitwazzjoni diffiċli.

sense_translations.en_definition: having the ability to slip out of a spot of trouble
sense_translations.zh_definition: 有本领巧妙脱身、摆脱一时麻烦的。

collocations.en: a person who is good at getting out of trouble
a boy who can get himself out of trouble
collocations.zh: 有办法从麻烦中脱身的男孩

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-protagonist huwa sellieki u jsib mod kif joħroġ mill-inkwiet mingħajr ma jweġġa' lil ħadd.
formal.en: In the story, the protagonist is good at getting out of trouble and finds a way to do so without hurting anyone.
formal.zh: 故事中的主人公善于脱困，总能找到办法摆脱麻烦，又不伤害任何人。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Kif ħareġ minn dak l-inkwiet Pawlu? Rita: Hu sellieki! Dejjem isib xi mod kif joħroġ minn sitwazzjoni diffiċli.
colloquial.en: Marta: How did Pawlu get out of that trouble? Rita: He's good at getting out of trouble! He always finds some way out of a difficult situation.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：保罗是怎么摆脱那个麻烦的？丽塔：他很会脱困！碰到难办的局面，他总能找到出路。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif ħareġ minn dak l-inkwiet Pawlu?
messages.mt_standard: Kif ħareġ minn dak l-inkwiet Pawlu?
messages.zh: 保罗是怎么摆脱那个麻烦的？
messages.en: How did Pawlu get out of that trouble?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu sellieki! Dejjem isib xi mod kif joħroġ minn sitwazzjoni diffiċli.
messages.mt_standard: Hu sellieki! Dejjem isib xi mod kif joħroġ minn sitwazzjoni diffiċli.
messages.zh: 他很会脱困！碰到难办的局面，他总能找到出路。
messages.en: He's good at getting out of trouble! He always finds some way out of a difficult situation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sellieki 配上“困境中找到出口”的画面，记住它形容善于脱困的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who greets someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向别人问候、打招呼或致意的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ssellem lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向别人打招呼或致意的人。

collocations.zh: 在入口处迎接并问候来客的人

formal.mt: Matul l-attività, is-selliem fid-daħla sellem lil kull mistieden bi tbissima.
formal.en: During the event, the greeter at the entrance greeted every guest with a smile.
formal.zh: 活动期间，入口处的迎宾者微笑着向每位来宾致意。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hu dak li qed jgħid bonġu lil kulħadd? Mark: Dak Pawlu, is-selliem tagħna llum.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who's that saying good morning to everyone? Mark: That's Pawlu, our greeter today.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那个向每个人说早上好的人是谁？马克：那是保罗，今天由他负责迎接大家、打招呼。

messages.speaker: Lara (来宾)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak li qed jgħid bonġu lil kulħadd?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak li qed jgħid bonġu lil kulħadd?
messages.zh: 那个向每个人说早上好的人是谁？
messages.en: Who's that saying good morning to everyone?

messages.speaker: Mark (活动组织者)
messages.zh: 那是保罗，今天由他负责迎接大家、打招呼。
messages.en: That's Pawlu, our greeter today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象门口有人微笑说“你好”，用这位打招呼的人记住名词 selliem。

gloss_zh: 用于问候的；用于告别的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to greet someone or to express a farewell.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于向人问候、致意，也可用于表达告别的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jintuża biex isellem lil xi ħadd, meta jiltaqa' miegħu jew meta jinfired minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于问候、打招呼或致意的。
用于告别、表达临别致意的。

formal.mt: Fi tmiem iż-żjara, id-direttur għamel diskors selliemi u rringrazzja lill-mistednin tal-preżenza tagħhom.
formal.en: At the end of the visit, the director gave a farewell speech and thanked the guests for attending.
formal.zh: 访问结束时，主任发表了告别致辞，感谢来宾到场。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex Mark għolla idu meta wasalna? Lara: Kien ġest selliemi; ried jgħidilna bonġu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did Mark raise his hand when we arrived? Lara: It was a greeting gesture; he wanted to say hello to us.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们到的时候，马克为什么举起了手？拉拉：那是在打招呼；他想向我们问好。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark għolla idu meta wasalna?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark għolla idu meta wasalna?
messages.zh: 我们到的时候，马克为什么举起了手？
messages.en: Why did Mark raise his hand when we arrived?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien ġest selliemi; ried jgħidilna bonġu.
messages.mt_standard: Kien ġest selliemi; ried jgħidilna bonġu.
messages.zh: 那是在打招呼；他想向我们问好。
messages.en: It was a greeting gesture; he wanted to say hello to us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 selliemi 放在见面挥手和临别致辞两个画面中，分别记住问候与告别两义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who takes part in a fight or a fray.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 参与争斗、斗殴或战斗的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tiġġieled jew tieħu sehem fi ġlieda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 参与争斗或斗殴的人。
打斗或作战的人；战斗者。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, is-selliet waqqaf il-ġlied meta ra li l-avversarju tiegħu kien ferut.
formal.en: In the story, the fighter stopped fighting when he saw that his opponent was injured.
formal.zh: 故事中，这名战斗者看到对手受伤后停止了打斗。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min hu dak is-selliet fl-istorja? Ben: Hu r-raġel li jidħol fil-ġlieda biex jiddefendi lil ħabibu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who is that fighter in the story? Ben: He's the man who joins the fight to defend his friend.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：故事里那个战斗者是谁？本：就是那个为了保护朋友而加入打斗的男人。

messages.speaker: Sara (读书小组成员)
messages.zh: 故事里那个战斗者是谁？
messages.en: Who is that fighter in the story?

messages.speaker: Ben (读书小组成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu r-raġel li jidħol fil-ġlieda biex jiddefendi lil ħabibu.
messages.mt_standard: Hu r-raġel li jidħol fil-ġlieda biex jiddefendi lil ħabibu.
messages.zh: 就是那个为了保护朋友而加入打斗的男人。
messages.en: He's the man who joins the fight to defend his friend.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用故事中走进争斗现场的人来记 selliet，重点记它是指人的名词。

gloss_zh: 动辄拔剑的；容易拔剑相向的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to draw one's sword readily when challenged or angered.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人在受到挑衅或动怒时容易拔剑相向，动辄准备以剑交锋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun pront joħroġ ix-xabla tiegħu meta jiġi sfidat jew jirrabja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易拔出佩剑、动辄拔剑相向的。

collocations.en: a knight quick to draw his sword
a soldier inclined to draw his sword

formal.mt: Fil-ġrajja, il-kavallier sellieti resaq lejn l-avversarju b'idu fuq il-manku tax-xabla.
formal.en: In the tale, the knight who was quick to draw his sword approached his opponent with his hand on the sword's hilt.
formal.zh: 故事中，那位动辄拔剑的骑士手按剑柄，走向对手。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex kulħadd joqgħod attent ma' dak il-kavallier? Toni: Għax hu sellieti; malajr joħroġ ix-xabla jekk jirrabja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is everyone careful around that knight? Toni: Because he's quick to draw his sword; he draws it readily if he gets angry.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么大家跟那个骑士相处都很小心？托尼：因为他动辄拔剑；一生气就容易把剑拔出来。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书小组成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex kulħadd joqgħod attent ma' dak il-kavallier?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex kulħadd joqgħod attent ma' dak il-kavallier?
messages.zh: 为什么大家跟那个骑士相处都很小心？
messages.en: Why is everyone careful around that knight?

messages.speaker: Toni (读书小组成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu sellieti; malajr joħroġ ix-xabla jekk jirrabja.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu sellieti; malajr joħroġ ix-xabla jekk jirrabja.
messages.zh: 因为他动辄拔剑；一生气就容易把剑拔出来。
messages.en: Because he's quick to draw his sword; he draws it readily if he gets angry.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象骑士一生气就手按剑柄，用这个动作记住 sellieti 所表示的拔剑倾向。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who is suffering from diarrhoea.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 正在腹泻的人；用作指人的名词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li qed tbati bid-dijarea.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 正在腹泻的人；腹泻者。

collocations.en: a tired person suffering from diarrhoea
a person with diarrhoea in bed

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, is-sellieħ baqa' fis-sodda waqt li ħuh ħareġ jixtri.
formal.en: In the story, the person suffering from diarrhoea stayed in bed while his brother went shopping.
formal.zh: 故事里，那位腹泻者留在床上，他的兄弟则出门购物。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Min hu s-sellieħ f'dan ir-rakkont? Pawlu: It-tifel li baqa' fis-sodda.
colloquial.en: Marta: Who is the person suffering from diarrhoea in this story? Pawlu: The boy who stayed in bed.
colloquial.zh: Marta：这个故事里谁在腹泻？Pawlu：就是那个一直躺在床上的男孩。

messages.speaker: Marta (同学)
messages.zh: 这个故事里谁在腹泻？
messages.en: Who is the person suffering from diarrhoea in this story?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 就是那个一直躺在床上的男孩。
messages.en: The boy who stayed in bed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给人物卡片写上 sellieħ 和腹泻者，记住这里的词指一个人；再与描述状态的 sellieħi 对照。

gloss_zh: 用作钓饵的幼嫩绿海藻

teaching_sense.en_definition: A green seaweed known as ħassa tal-baħar, used before full development as fishing bait.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种称为 ħassa tal-baħar 的绿色海藻，在尚未完全长成时可用作钓饵。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Alka ħadra magħrufa bħala ħassa tal-baħar, li tintuża bħala lixka għas-sajd qabel ma tkun żviluppat għalkollox.

sense_translations.en_definition: (botany) A green seaweed known as ħassa tal-baħar, akind of sea moss before its full formation used as a bait for fishing of salps (xilpa) and sandpipers (girwiel)
sense_translations.zh_definition: （植物学）一种称为 ħassa tal-baħar 的绿色海藻，指其尚未完全形成时的海藻体，可作捕钓 xilpa 和 girwiel 的饵料。

collocations.zh: 用作钓饵的这种绿海藻

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi s-sellieħa bħala alka ħadra li tintuża bħala lixka għas-sajd.
formal.en: The text describes sellieħa as a green seaweed used as fishing bait.
formal.zh: 文章把 sellieħa 描述为一种用作钓饵的绿色海藻。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'għandek f'dik il-kaxxa? Toni: Sellieħa; se nużaha bħala lixka.
colloquial.en: Lara: What have you got in that box? Toni: Sellieħa seaweed; I am going to use it as bait.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你那个盒子里装着什么？Toni：Sellieħa 海藻，我准备拿它当钓饵。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你那个盒子里装着什么？
messages.en: What have you got in that box?

messages.speaker: Toni (钓鱼者)
messages.zh: Sellieħa 海藻，我准备拿它当钓饵。
messages.en: Sellieħa seaweed; I am going to use it as bait.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 sellieħa 画一个装着绿色海藻的钓饵盒，整词联系海藻钓饵，避免与相近拼写的指人词混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone who is suffering from diarrhoea.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人正在腹泻的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li qed ibati bid-dijarea.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 正在腹泻的；用于描述人的身体状态。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tifel kien sellieħi u baqa' d-dar dakinhar.
formal.en: In the story, the boy was suffering from diarrhoea and stayed at home that day.
formal.zh: 故事里，男孩当时正在腹泻，那天便留在家里。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Pawlu ġej magħna llum? Mark: Le, għadu sellieħi u se jibqa' d-dar.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is Pawlu coming with us today? Mark: No, he still has diarrhoea and is going to stay at home.
colloquial.zh: Nina：Pawlu 今天跟我们一起去吗？Mark：不去了，他还在腹泻，准备待在家里。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu 今天跟我们一起去吗？
messages.en: Is Pawlu coming with us today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għadu sellieħi u se jibqa' d-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għadu sellieħi u se jibqa' d-dar.
messages.zh: 不去了，他还在腹泻，准备待在家里。
messages.en: No, he still has diarrhoea and is going to stay at home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用句子 Pawlu għadu sellieħi 记状态：Pawlu 还在腹泻；把 sellieħi 放在人名后练习形容词用法。

gloss_zh: 人字梯；可自行支撑的折梯

teaching_sense.en_definition: A ladder with steps and a supporting section that opens out so it can stand on its own.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有踏级和可展开支架、能够自行站立的人字梯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sellum bi skaluni u b'appoġġ li jinfetaħ biex ikun jista' joqgħod wieqaf waħdu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 人字梯；展开支架后可以自行站立的折梯。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem fetaħ is-sellum bir-riġel fuq art ċatta qabel tela' biex jilħaq l-ixkaffa ta' fuq.
formal.en: The worker opened the stepladder on level ground before climbing it to reach the top shelf.
formal.zh: 工人先在平整地面上展开人字梯，然后登梯去够最上层的架子。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ma nilħaqx dik il-kaxxa fuq l-ixkaffa. Mark: Hemm sellum bir-riġel fil-kamra l-oħra; inġibu hawn.
colloquial.en: Lara: I can't reach that box on the shelf. Mark: There's a stepladder in the other room; I'll bring it here.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我够不到架子上的那个箱子。马克：另一个房间有人字梯，我把它拿过来。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nilħaqx dik il-kaxxa fuq l-ixkaffa.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nilħaqx dik il-kaxxa fuq l-ixkaffa.
messages.zh: 我够不到架子上的那个箱子。
messages.en: I can't reach that box on the shelf.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm sellum bir-riġel fil-kamra l-oħra; inġibu hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm sellum bir-riġel fil-kamra l-oħra; inġibu hawn.
messages.zh: 另一个房间有人字梯，我把它拿过来。
messages.en: There's a stepladder in the other room; I'll bring it here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语配上展开后像“人”字、能自己站立的梯子图像，帮助记住人字梯。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A ladder whose steps or rungs are supported by ropes along its sides.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 两侧以绳索连接并支撑踏级、可以悬挂使用的梯子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sellum li l-iskaluni tiegħu jinżammu minn ħbula mal-ġnub.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绳梯；由两侧绳索连接和支撑踏级的梯子。

collocations.en: to climb up using a rope ladder

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju, it-tim niżżel sellum tal-ħabel mill-pjattaforma biex il-parteċipanti jkunu jistgħu jitilgħu.
formal.en: During the exercise, the team lowered a rope ladder from the platform so that the participants could climb up.
formal.zh: 演练中，团队从平台放下一架绳梯，让参与者能够向上攀爬。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif se nitilgħu fuq dik il-pjattaforma? Ben: Hemm sellum tal-ħabel imdendel mal-ġenb.
colloquial.en: Nina: How are we going to get up onto that platform? Ben: There's a rope ladder hanging at the side.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们怎么爬上那个平台？本：侧面挂着一架绳梯。

messages.speaker: Nina (活动参与者)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif se nitilgħu fuq dik il-pjattaforma?
messages.mt_standard: Kif se nitilgħu fuq dik il-pjattaforma?
messages.zh: 我们怎么爬上那个平台？
messages.en: How are we going to get up onto that platform?

messages.speaker: Ben (活动参与者)
messages.zh: 侧面挂着一架绳梯。
messages.en: There's a rope ladder hanging at the side.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sellum tal-ħabel 整体记成平台边垂下的绳梯，想象双手握绳、双脚踩踏级。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A ladder with ropes along its sides holding the steps or rungs in place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用两侧绳索固定各级踏板或横档、供人攀爬的梯子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sellum magħmul minn ħbula mal-ġnub li jżommu l-iskaluni f'posthom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绳梯；以绳索连接各级踏板或横档的梯子。

collocations.en: to climb down using a rope ladder

formal.mt: L-għalliem tal-avventura ċċekkja li s-sellum tal-ħbula kien marbut sew qabel ma beda l-eżerċizzju.
formal.en: The adventure instructor checked that the rope ladder was securely tied before the exercise began.
formal.zh: 户外探险教练在练习开始前检查了绳梯是否已经系牢。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn qiegħed is-sellum tal-ħbula għall-logħba? Toni: Qiegħed ħdejn is-siġra; l-għalliem għadu se jorbtu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where's the rope ladder for the game? Toni: It's beside the tree; the instructor is about to secure it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：游戏要用的绳梯在哪里？托尼：在树旁边，教练正准备把它系牢。

messages.speaker: Maja (活动参与者)
messages.zh: 游戏要用的绳梯在哪里？
messages.en: Where's the rope ladder for the game?

messages.speaker: Toni (活动参与者)
messages.mt_spoken: Qiegħed ħdejn is-siġra; l-għalliem għadu se jorbtu.
messages.mt_standard: Qiegħed ħdejn is-siġra; l-għalliem għadu se jorbtu.
messages.zh: 在树旁边，教练正准备把它系牢。
messages.en: It's beside the tree; the instructor is about to secure it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两侧绳索串起一排横档，将 sellum tal-ħbula 整体对应“绳梯”，并与另一词条并排复习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To connect separate things into a chain or an ordered sequence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把分开的东西连接成链，或按一定次序串联起来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tgħaqqad affarijiet separati f'katina jew f'sekwenza ordnata.

sense_translations.en_definition: to link up in a chain
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把各部分逐一连接成链。
把多个东西串在一起；把内容依次串联起来。

collocations.en: link the rings into a chain

formal.mt: Selsel l-ideat f'ordni ċara sabiex il-qarrej ikun jista' jsegwi l-argument.
formal.en: Link the ideas in a clear order so that the reader can follow the argument.
formal.zh: 请按清晰的顺序串联各个想法，使读者能够理解论证的脉络。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif nagħmel din il-ġiżirana? Mark: Selsel iż-żibeġ fuq il-ħajta, wieħed wara l-ieħor.
colloquial.en: Maja: How do I make this necklace? Mark: String the beads onto the thread, one after another.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这条项链怎么做？马克：把珠子一颗接一颗地串到线上。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这条项链怎么做？
messages.en: How do I make this necklace?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Selsel iż-żibeġ fuq il-ħajta, wieħed wara l-ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Selsel iż-żibeġ fuq il-ħajta, wieħed wara l-ieħor.
messages.zh: 把珠子一颗接一颗地串到线上。
messages.en: String the beads onto the thread, one after another.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把散落的珠子逐颗串起来：selsel 强调的是“串联”这个动作，也可用来串联想法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of stringing things together or connecting them into a chain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将东西串在一起或逐一连接成链的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih affarijiet jitqiegħdu wara xulxin u jingħaqdu f'sekwenza jew katina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把多个东西串在一起的过程；串联。
把各部分连接起来的过程；连接。

formal.mt: Is-selsil tal-ideat f'dan it-test jgħin lill-qarrej jifhem kif argument iwassal għall-ieħor.
formal.en: The linking of ideas in this text helps the reader understand how one argument leads to the next.
formal.zh: 这篇文章中各个想法的串联，帮助读者理解一个论点如何引出下一个论点。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema parti tax-xogħol togħġbok l-aktar? Mark: Is-selsil taż-żibeġ. Nieħu gost nagħżel il-kuluri u nqiegħed iż-żibeġ wara xulxin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which part of the work do you like most? Mark: Stringing the beads together. I enjoy choosing the colours and putting the beads in sequence.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你最喜欢制作过程中的哪一步？马克：串珠子。我喜欢挑选颜色，再把珠子依次串起来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你最喜欢制作过程中的哪一步？
messages.en: Which part of the work do you like most?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-selsil taż-żibeġ. Nieħu gost nagħżel il-kuluri u nqiegħed iż-żibeġ wara xulxin.
messages.mt_standard: Is-selsil taż-żibeġ. Nieħu gost nagħżel il-kuluri u nqiegħed iż-żibeġ wara xulxin.
messages.zh: 串珠子。我喜欢挑选颜色，再把珠子依次串起来。
messages.en: Stringing the beads together. I enjoy choosing the colours and putting the beads in sequence.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“串珠这件事”记住 selsil：它是名词，指串联的过程；与表示串联动作的 selsel 对照学习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Peeling of the skin, or a small scratch on the skin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 皮肤表层脱落的现象，也可指皮肤上的小擦伤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tqaxxir tal-ġilda, jew ġerħa żgħira u ħafifa fuq il-ġilda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 皮肤表层脱落；脱皮。
皮肤上的一道擦伤或抓痕。

collocations.en: a small scratch on the hand

formal.mt: Fir-rapport ġiet deskritta selħa żgħira fuq id it-tifel.
formal.en: The report described a small scratch on the boy's hand.
formal.zh: 报告描述了男孩手上的一处小擦伤。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'ġara minn idek? Pawlu: Fergħa ħallietli selħa żgħira.
colloquial.en: Marta: What happened to your hand? Pawlu: A branch left me with a small scratch.
colloquial.zh: Marta：你的手怎么了？Pawlu：树枝给我划了一道小伤口。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的手怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to your hand?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 树枝给我划了一道小伤口。
messages.en: A branch left me with a small scratch.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 selħa 配上两张皮肤图：一张脱皮，一张有小擦痕；用两幅图分别记住两个义项。

gloss_zh: 一次听取；被听取意见的机会

teaching_sense.en_definition: An occasion or opportunity for someone to be heard and their words to receive attention.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 让某人陈述，并认真听取其意见的一次机会或场合。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Okkażjoni jew opportunità biex wieħed jinstema' u dak li jgħid jingħata attenzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次听取陈述或意见的机会。

collocations.zh: 给某人陈述并被听取的机会
请求获得陈述意见的机会

formal.mt: Qabel tittieħed deċiżjoni, kull persuna affettwata għandha tingħata semgħa xierqa.
formal.en: Before a decision is made, every person affected should be given a proper hearing.
formal.zh: 作出决定之前，应当给予每位受影响的人充分陈述意见的机会。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Agħtini semgħa qabel tiddeċiedi. Mark: Sewwa, għidli x'ġara. Qed nisma'.
colloquial.en: Maja: Give me a hearing before you decide. Mark: All right, tell me what happened. I'm listening.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你作决定之前，先听我说说。马克：好，告诉我发生了什么。我在听。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你作决定之前，先听我说说。
messages.en: Give me a hearing before you decide.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，告诉我发生了什么。我在听。
messages.en: All right, tell me what happened. I'm listening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 semgħa 放进“先给我一次说话并被听见的机会”这个场景，整句记忆 Agħtini semgħa。

gloss_zh: 命名者；姓名或标题索引

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who gives a name to someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给人、地点或事物起名字的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħti isem lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 命名者；给人或事物起名字的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: an index of names or titles
sense_translations.zh_definition: 姓名、名称或标题的索引，供查找相关条目使用。

collocations.en: the person who named the place
an index of names and titles

formal.mt: Fl-aħħar tal-ktieb hemm semmej tal-ismijiet u t-titli, bin-numri tal-paġni fejn jidhru.
formal.en: At the end of the book there is an index of names and titles, with the numbers of the pages where they appear.
formal.zh: 书末附有姓名及标题索引，并列出它们出现的页码。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min kien is-semmej ta' dan il-post? Mark: Ma nafx min tah dan l-isem. Nistaqsu lin-nannu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who was the person who named this place? Mark: I don't know who gave it this name. Let's ask Grandpa.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个地方是谁命名的？马克：我不知道是谁给它起了这个名字。我们问问爷爷吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min kien is-semmej ta' dan il-post?
messages.mt_standard: Min kien is-semmej ta' dan il-post?
messages.zh: 这个地方是谁命名的？
messages.en: Who was the person who named this place?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx min tah dan l-isem. Nistaqsu lin-nannu.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx min tah dan l-isem. Nistaqsu lin-nannu.
messages.zh: 我不知道是谁给它起了这个名字。我们问问爷爷吧。
messages.en: I don't know who gave it this name. Let's ask Grandpa.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 semmej 配两幅画面：一个人正在起名字，一本书末列着姓名和标题索引；靠语境区分两个名词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone or something to be affected by poison.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人或其他生物受到毒物影响而中毒，或使某物染上毒性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tikkawża li xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa ssirilhom ħsara bil-velenu, jew iddaħħal il-velenu f'xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使中毒；向某物下毒或使其受到毒物污染。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif it-tnixxija tal-kimika semmet l-ilma tax-xmara u kkawżat il-mewt tal-ħut.
formal.en: The report describes how the chemical leak poisoned the river water and caused the fish to die.
formal.zh: 报告描述了化学品泄漏如何使河水受到毒物污染，并导致鱼类死亡。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma nistgħux nużaw l-ilma tal-bir? Mark: Qalu li xi ħadd semmem l-ilma. Għalissa nużaw ilma mill-fliexken.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why can't we use the well water? Mark: They said someone poisoned the water. For now, let's use bottled water.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么不能用井水？马克：听说有人往水里下了毒。我们暂时用瓶装水吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma nistgħux nużaw l-ilma tal-bir?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma nistgħux nużaw l-ilma tal-bir?
messages.zh: 为什么不能用井水？
messages.en: Why can't we use the well water?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Qalu li xi ħadd semmem l-ilma. Għalissa nużaw ilma mill-fliexken.
messages.mt_standard: Qalu li xi ħadd semmem l-ilma. Għalissa nużaw ilma mill-fliexken.
messages.zh: 听说有人往水里下了毒。我们暂时用瓶装水吧。
messages.en: They said someone poisoned the water. For now, let's use bottled water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 semmem 记成带动作的画面：“毒物进入水中，使水染毒”。重点记住它是动词，表示造成中毒或染毒。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Containing poison or capable of causing harm through poison.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 含有毒物，或能够因毒性而对生物造成伤害的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li fih il-velenu jew li jista' jagħmel ħsara minħabba t-tossiċità tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有毒的；具有能使生物中毒或受害的毒性。

formal.mt: It-tikketta tindika li l-kontenitur fih gass semmi u għandu jinżamm magħluq.
formal.en: The label indicates that the container holds poisonous gas and must be kept closed.
formal.zh: 标签表明容器内装有有毒气体，必须保持密闭。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma nistgħux nidħlu hemm? Mark: Hemm duħħan semmi ġewwa. Ejja nibqgħu barra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why can't we go in there? Mark: There's poisonous smoke inside. Let's stay outside.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么我们不能进去？马克：里面有毒烟。我们待在外面吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 为什么我们不能进去？
messages.en: Why can't we go in there?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm duħħan semmi ġewwa. Ejja nibqgħu barra.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm duħħan semmi ġewwa. Ejja nibqgħu barra.
messages.zh: 里面有毒烟。我们待在外面吧。
messages.en: There's poisonous smoke inside. Let's stay outside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 semmi 写在想象中的毒气标签上，与 gass 连成 gass semmi，记住本条表示“有毒的”这一性质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who listens to someone speaking, a broadcast, music, or other sounds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 聆听讲话、广播、音乐或其他声音的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tisma' lil xi ħadd jitkellem, programm, mużika jew ħsejjes oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 听者；收听广播等内容的听众。

formal.mt: Kull semmiegħ jista' jibgħat mistoqsija lill-preżentatur qabel jintemm il-programm.
formal.en: Every listener can send the presenter a question before the programme ends.
formal.zh: 每位听众都可以在节目结束前向主持人提交问题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tisma' dan il-programm kuljum? Mark: Iva, jien semmiegħ regolari. Inħobb l-intervisti li jagħmlu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you listen to this programme every day? Mark: Yes, I'm a regular listener. I like the interviews they do.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你每天都听这个节目吗？马克：是的，我是固定听众。我喜欢他们做的访谈。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你每天都听这个节目吗？
messages.en: Do you listen to this programme every day?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jien semmiegħ regolari. Inħobb l-intervisti li jagħmlu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jien semmiegħ regolari. Inħobb l-intervisti li jagħmlu.
messages.zh: 是的，我是固定听众。我喜欢他们做的访谈。
messages.en: Yes, I'm a regular listener. I like the interviews they do.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个戴耳机听广播的人，在人物旁标上 semmiegħ：这个词指“正在听的人”，可搭配 attent 表示专心。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to hearing or to the perception of sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与听觉、听声音或声音感知有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mas-smigħ jew mal-perċezzjoni tal-ħoss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与听觉或听声音这一感官活动有关的。
听觉的；通过听觉感知的。

formal.mt: L-eżerċizzju juża sinjal semmiegħi biex jindika meta l-istudent għandu jibda jikteb.
formal.en: The exercise uses an auditory signal to indicate when the student should start writing.
formal.zh: 练习通过听觉信号提示学生何时开始书写。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan huwa eżerċizzju semmiegħi? Mark: Iva. Isma' l-kliem u mbagħad agħżel l-istampa t-tajba.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this an auditory exercise? Mark: Yes. Listen to the words and then choose the correct picture.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这是听觉练习吗？马克：是的。听这些词，然后选择正确的图片。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这是听觉练习吗？
messages.en: Is this an auditory exercise?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva. Isma' l-kliem u mbagħad agħżel l-istampa t-tajba.
messages.mt_standard: Iva. Isma' l-kliem u mbagħad agħżel l-istampa t-tajba.
messages.zh: 是的。听这些词，然后选择正确的图片。
messages.en: Yes. Listen to the words and then choose the correct picture.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“耳朵接收信号”的画面记 semmiegħi，并把 sinjal semmiegħi 整体记成“听觉信号”；本条是描述听觉关系的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who poisons someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给人、动物或其他对象下毒的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tivvelena lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 投毒者；给人或其他对象下毒的人。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, id-ditektiv jiskopri min hu s-semmiem wara li jeżamina l-provi.
formal.en: In the novel, the detective discovers who the poisoner is after examining the evidence.
formal.zh: 在小说中，侦探审查证据后查明了投毒者的身份。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu s-semmiem f'dan il-film? Mark: Għadna ma nafux; kulħadd jidher suspettuż.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is the poisoner in this film? Mark: We don't know yet; everyone looks suspicious.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这部电影里的投毒者是谁？Mark：我们还不知道；每个人看起来都很可疑。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这部电影里的投毒者是谁？
messages.en: Who is the poisoner in this film?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadna ma nafux; kulħadd jidher suspettuż.
messages.mt_standard: Għadna ma nafux; kulħadd jidher suspettuż.
messages.zh: 我们还不知道；每个人看起来都很可疑。
messages.en: We don't know yet; everyone looks suspicious.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 semmiem 放进侦探故事：追查的是“谁下毒”，所以它指投毒的人；再与表示“有毒的”的 semmiemi 对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Containing poison or able to cause harm through poisoning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 含有毒性，能够使人或动物中毒并受到伤害的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li fih il-velenu jew li jista' jagħmel ħsara billi jivvelena.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有毒的；能够引起中毒的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-likwidu bħala semmiemi u jitlob li jinżamm f'kontenitur magħluq.
formal.en: The report describes the liquid as poisonous and requests that it be kept in a sealed container.
formal.zh: 报告指出该液体有毒，并要求将其保存在密闭容器中。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex hemm sinjal ta' periklu fuq dan il-flixkun? Pawlu: Għax il-likwidu ta' ġewwa hu semmiemi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is there a danger sign on this bottle? Pawlu: Because the liquid inside is poisonous.
colloquial.zh: Lara：为什么这个瓶子上有危险标志？Pawlu：因为里面的液体有毒。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm sinjal ta' periklu fuq dan il-flixkun?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm sinjal ta' periklu fuq dan il-flixkun?
messages.zh: 为什么这个瓶子上有危险标志？
messages.en: Why is there a danger sign on this bottle?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-likwidu ta' ġewwa hu semmiemi.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-likwidu ta' ġewwa hu semmiemi.
messages.zh: 因为里面的液体有毒。
messages.en: Because the liquid inside is poisonous.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象瓶身上的“有毒”标签，用 semmiemi 描述瓶中液体的性质；和 semmiem“投毒者”配对，记清性质与人物的区别。

gloss_zh: 牲畜育肥者；涂黄油的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who fattens animals, or a person who spreads butter on something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责把动物喂肥的人；也指给食物等对象涂黄油的人，具体意思由语境决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ssemmen l-annimali, jew persuna li tidlek xi ħaġa bil-butir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 牲畜育肥者；负责把动物喂肥的人。
给某物涂黄油的人，例如给面包涂黄油的人。

formal.mt: Fit-test dwar ix-xogħol fir-razzett, is-semmien huwa l-persuna responsabbli mit-tismin tal-annimali.
formal.en: In the text about farm work, the animal fattener is the person responsible for fattening the animals.
formal.zh: 在这篇介绍农场工作的文章中，育肥者指负责把动物喂肥的人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Int is-semmien tal-ħobż illum? Mark: Iva, jien nidlek il-ħobż bil-butir u int tagħmel it-te.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you the one buttering the bread today? Mark: Yes, I'll butter the bread and you make the tea.
colloquial.zh: Maja：今天由你给面包涂黄油吗？Mark：对，我给面包涂黄油，你来泡茶。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 今天由你给面包涂黄油吗？
messages.en: Are you the one buttering the bread today?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jien nidlek il-ħobż bil-butir u int tagħmel it-te.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jien nidlek il-ħobż bil-butir u int tagħmel it-te.
messages.zh: 对，我给面包涂黄油，你来泡茶。
messages.en: Yes, I'll butter the bread and you make the tea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张场景卡记 semmien：农场里有人把动物喂肥，餐桌旁有人给面包涂黄油。两义都指人，靠场景判断。

gloss_zh: 使人或动物发胖的；催肥的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Likely to make a person or animal gain weight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易使人或动物增加体重、变胖的，常用来描述食物或饲料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġiegħel lil persuna jew lil annimal jiżdied fil-piż jew jisمن.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人或动物发胖的；有催肥作用的。

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi l-għalf bħala semmieni għax jgħin lill-annimali jiżdiedu fil-piż.
formal.en: The text describes the feed as fattening because it helps the animals gain weight.
formal.zh: 文章将这种饲料描述为有催肥作用，因为它能帮助动物增加体重。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan l-ikel semmieni? Mark: Iva, speċjalment jekk tiekol ħafna minnu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this food fattening? Mark: Yes, especially if you eat a lot of it.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这种食物容易让人发胖吗？Mark：是的，尤其是吃得多的时候。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这种食物容易让人发胖吗？
messages.en: Is this food fattening?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, speċjalment jekk tiekol ħafna minnu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, speċjalment jekk tiekol ħafna minnu.
messages.zh: 是的，尤其是吃得多的时候。
messages.en: Yes, especially if you eat a lot of it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 semmieni 和食物旁上升的体重秤读数联系起来：它说的是“容易使人发胖”的作用；与指育肥者的 semmien 对照。

gloss_zh: 因发怒而咒骂；气得骂起来

teaching_sense.en_definition: To curse or swear because one has lost one's temper.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因为失去耐性或控制不住怒气而咒骂、说脏话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħid kliem ta' saħta jew dagħa għax ikun tilef il-kalma u rrabja.

sense_translations.en_definition: to curse as a result of losing one's temper
sense_translations.zh_definition: 因失去冷静、大发脾气而咒骂。

collocations.en: he cursed after losing his temper
collocations.zh: 他失去冷静后咒骂起来

formal.mt: Fil-ġrajja, ir-raġel tilef il-kalma u sempel meta ntebaħ li x-xogħol kollu kien għalxejn.
formal.en: In the story, the man lost his temper and cursed when he realized that all the work had been in vain.
formal.zh: 故事中，那名男子发现所有工作都白费了，便失去冷静，咒骂起来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex sempel Mark? Lara: Il-karozza ma riditx tistartja u tilef il-kalma.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark start swearing? Lara: The car wouldn't start and he lost his temper.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark 为什么骂起来了？Lara：汽车怎么也发动不了，他就发火了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 为什么骂起来了？
messages.en: Why did Mark start swearing?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-karozza ma riditx tistartja u tilef il-kalma.
messages.mt_standard: Il-karozza ma riditx tistartja u tilef il-kalma.
messages.zh: 汽车怎么也发动不了，他就发火了。
messages.en: The car wouldn't start and he lost his temper.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“车发动不了→怒气上来→开口咒骂”的连续画面记 sempel；重点同时记住发怒的原因和咒骂的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of making something simpler and easier to understand or use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使事物变得更简单、更容易理解或使用的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa ssir aktar sempliċi u aktar faċli biex tinftiehem jew tintuża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 简化；使复杂事物变得简单的过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li tagħmel xi ħaġa aktar sempliċi.

formal.mt: Is-semplifikazzjoni tal-istruzzjonijiet tgħin lill-qarrejja jifhmu x'għandhom jagħmlu.
formal.en: Simplifying the instructions helps readers understand what they need to do.
formal.zh: 简化说明有助于读者理解自己需要做什么。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-formularju diffiċli biex timlieh. Pawlu: Għandu bżonn semplifikazzjoni; hemm wisq mistoqsijiet li jirrepetu ruħhom.
colloquial.en: Maja: This form is difficult to fill in. Pawlu: It needs simplification; too many questions repeat themselves.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这张表格很难填。保罗：它需要简化，重复的问题太多了。

messages.speaker: Maja (申请人)
messages.zh: 这张表格很难填。
messages.en: This form is difficult to fill in.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu bżonn semplifikazzjoni; hemm wisq mistoqsijiet li jirrepetu ruħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu bżonn semplifikazzjoni; hemm wisq mistoqsijiet li jirrepetu ruħhom.
messages.zh: 它需要简化，重复的问题太多了。
messages.en: It needs simplification; too many questions repeat themselves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一张复杂表格删去重复问题，用“从复杂变简单”的画面记住这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a simple way, or merely, without anything more being involved.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以简单的方式；也可表示只是、仅仅，强调没有更多事情或其他原因。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod sempliċi, jew biss, mingħajr xi ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 简单地；只是；仅仅，具体译法取决于语境。

formal.mt: L-awtriċi tispjega sempliċement kif jaħdem l-apparat, sabiex il-qarrej ikun jista' jifhmu.
formal.en: The author explains simply how the device works so that the reader can understand it.
formal.zh: 作者用简单明白的方式解释设备的工作原理，让读者能够理解。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma ġejtx ilbieraħ? Mark: Sempliċement ma kellix ħin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why didn't you come yesterday? Mark: I simply didn't have time.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你昨天为什么没来？Mark：我只是没时间。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你昨天为什么没来？
messages.en: Why didn't you come yesterday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我只是没时间。
messages.en: I simply didn't have time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 sempliċement 配两句中文提示：“简单地解释”和“我只是没空”。一个表示方式，一个表示仅此而已，都对应 simply。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being simple, easy to understand, or free from unnecessary detail.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 简单易懂、不复杂或没有多余细节的性质，也可指风格上的简洁、朴素。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' xi ħaġa li tkun sempliċi, faċli biex tinftiehem jew mingħajr dettalji żejda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 简单性；简洁；朴素。

formal.mt: Is-sempliċità tal-lingwaġġ tagħmel dan il-ktieb adattat għal qarrejja li għadhom jibdew.
formal.en: The simplicity of the language makes this book suitable for beginning readers.
formal.zh: 这本书语言简单明白，适合初学阅读的人。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jogħġbok f'dan id-disinn? Pawlu: Is-sempliċità tiegħu; kollox ċar u faċli biex tużah.
colloquial.en: Lara: What do you like about this design? Pawlu: Its simplicity; everything is clear and easy to use.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你喜欢这个设计的哪一点？Pawlu：它很简洁；一切都清楚，也容易使用。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 你喜欢这个设计的哪一点？
messages.en: What do you like about this design?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-sempliċità tiegħu; kollox ċar u faċli biex tużah.
messages.mt_standard: Is-sempliċità tiegħu; kollox ċar u faċli biex tużah.
messages.zh: 它很简洁；一切都清楚，也容易使用。
messages.en: Its simplicity; everything is clear and easy to use.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象删去多余装饰后清楚的页面，把 sempliċità 记成页面具有的“简洁性”；它是名词，可说“设计的简洁”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Naive or foolish and easily deceived, describing someone regarded as a simpleton or dupe.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人头脑简单、轻信别人而容易受骗，通常带有贬义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li hu ftit iblah, jemmen lil ħaddieħor malajr u faċli biex jitqarraq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 傻乎乎的、容易受骗的；用于形容被看作傻瓜或受骗者的人，带贬义。

collocations.zh: 头脑简单、容易受骗的男子

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-karattru huwa deskritt bħala sempliċjott għax jemmen kull wegħda mingħajr ma jistaqsi xejn.
formal.en: In the story, the character is described as gullible because he believes every promise without asking any questions.
formal.zh: 故事把这个人物描写得很容易受骗，因为他对每个承诺都深信不疑，从不提出疑问。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Taħseb li Mark hu sempliċjott għax emmen dik l-istorja? Lara: Le, sempliċement ma kellux l-informazzjoni kollha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you think Mark is gullible because he believed that story? Lara: No, he simply didn't have all the information.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark 相信了那个故事，你觉得他很容易受骗吗？Lara：不，他只是没有掌握全部信息。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li Mark hu sempliċjott għax emmen dik l-istorja?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li Mark hu sempliċjott għax emmen dik l-istorja?
messages.zh: Mark 相信了那个故事，你觉得他很容易受骗吗？
messages.en: Do you think Mark is gullible because he believed that story?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, sempliċement ma kellux l-informazzjoni kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Le, sempliċement ma kellux l-informazzjoni kollha.
messages.zh: 不，他只是没有掌握全部信息。
messages.en: No, he simply didn't have all the information.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个听到任何承诺都立即点头的人，用 sempliċjott 形容他的轻信；记住它带贬义，不是称赞生活朴素。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A unit of distance equal to the distance light travels in one year.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 距离单位，等于光在一年内传播的距离。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Unità ta' distanza li hija daqs id-distanza li d-dawl jivvjaġġa f'sena.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 光年；光在一年内传播的距离，是距离单位。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Id-distanza li d-dawl jivvjaġġa f'sena, użata bħala unità ta' kejl.

collocations.en: a distance of one light year

formal.mt: Sena dawl hija unità ta' distanza li tintuża biex jiġu deskritti distanzi kbar fl-ispazju.
formal.en: A light year is a unit of distance used to describe large distances in space.
formal.zh: 光年是一种距离单位，用于描述太空中的遥远距离。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Sena dawl tfisser sena ta' żmien? Mark: Le, tkejjel distanza: kemm jivvjaġġa d-dawl f'sena.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does a light year mean a year of time? Mark: No, it measures distance: how far light travels in a year.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：光年是指一年的时间吗？马克：不是，它衡量距离，也就是光在一年里传播多远。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Sena dawl tfisser sena ta' żmien?
messages.mt_standard: Sena dawl tfisser sena ta' żmien?
messages.zh: 光年是指一年的时间吗？
messages.en: Does a light year mean a year of time?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tkejjel distanza: kemm jivvjaġġa d-dawl f'sena.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tkejjel distanza: kemm jivvjaġġa d-dawl f'sena.
messages.zh: 不是，它衡量距离，也就是光在一年里传播多远。
messages.en: No, it measures distance: how far light travels in a year.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象光连续走了一整年，记住测量的是它走过的距离；看到“年”也要想到距离单位。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To accumulate and keep goods or money in a stored reserve.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物资或钱财不断积存起来，留作储备。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġema' u żamm kwantità ta' oġġetti jew flus bħala riżerva.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 囤积物资或积存钱财。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ġema' u żamm oġġetti jew flus maħżuna.

formal.mt: In-negozjant sendaq kwantità kbira ta' oġġetti fil-maħżen tiegħu minflok offriehom għall-bejgħ.
formal.en: The merchant hoarded a large quantity of goods in his warehouse instead of offering them for sale.
formal.zh: 商人把大量货物囤积在自己的仓库里，没有拿出来出售。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex hemm daqshekk bottijiet fil-kamra? Toni: Ħija sendaq l-ikel għax beża' li jispiċċa.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why are there so many tins in the room? Toni: My brother hoarded food because he was afraid it would run out.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：房间里为什么有这么多罐头？托尼：我哥哥怕食物用完，就囤了起来。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 房间里为什么有这么多罐头？
messages.en: Why are there so many tins in the room?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija sendaq l-ikel għax beża' li jispiċċa.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija sendaq l-ikel għax beża' li jispiċċa.
messages.zh: 我哥哥怕食物用完，就囤了起来。
messages.en: My brother hoarded food because he was afraid it would run out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人把钱和罐头越存越多，直到储物间堆满，用“不断积存”的动作记住这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A country in West Africa whose official name is the Republic of Senegal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于西非的国家，正式名称为塞内加尔共和国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Afrika tal-Punent li l-isem uffiċjali tiegħu huwa r-Repubblika tas-Senegal.

sense_translations.en_definition: Senegal (a country in West Africa; official name: Repubblika tas-Senegal)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 塞内加尔，西非国家；正式名称为塞内加尔共和国。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Afrika tal-Punent; l-isem uffiċjali tiegħu huwa r-Repubblika tas-Senegal.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jidentifika lis-Senegal bħala pajjiż fl-Afrika tal-Punent.
formal.en: The report identifies Senegal as a country in West Africa.
formal.zh: 报告指出，塞内加尔是位于西非的一个国家。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn jinsab is-Senegal fuq il-mappa? Samwel: Fl-Afrika tal-Punent; ejja nsibuh flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is Senegal on the map? Samwel: In West Africa; let's find it together.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：塞内加尔在地图上的什么地方？萨姆韦尔：在西非，我们一起找找吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 塞内加尔在地图上的什么地方？
messages.en: Where is Senegal on the map?

messages.speaker: Samwel (同学)
messages.zh: 在西非，我们一起找找吧。
messages.en: In West Africa; let's find it together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把Senegal和中文“塞内加尔”配对，再在非洲西部画一个定位点，同时记住名称与位置。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To mark lines on a surface, or to plough land in straight rows.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在表面上划出线条，或在耕地时犁出笔直的行垄。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel marki f'għamla ta' linji fuq wiċċ, jew ħarat l-art f'ringieli dritti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 划线；在物体表面标出线条。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għamel marki f'għamla ta' linji fuq wiċċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 犁出笔直的行垄；沿直线成行耕犁。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħarat l-art f'ringieli dritti.

collocations.en: marked lines on the surface of the wood
ploughed the field in straight rows
collocations.zh: 在田里犁出笔直的行垄

formal.mt: Qabel ma qata' l-biċċa tal-injam, il-ħaddiem senneg il-wiċċ tagħha biex juri fejn kellu jaqta'.
formal.en: Before cutting the piece of wood, the worker marked lines on its surface to show where to cut.
formal.zh: 工人在切割木料之前，先在其表面划线，标明切割位置。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Min senneg l-għalqa hekk pulit? Toni: Missieri; ara kemm ħarġu dritti r-ringieli.
colloquial.en: Rita: Who ploughed the field in such neat, straight rows? Toni: My father; look how straight the rows turned out.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：谁把这块田犁得这么整齐？托尼：我父亲，你看这些行垄多直。

messages.speaker: Rita (邻居)
messages.zh: 谁把这块田犁得这么整齐？
messages.en: Who ploughed the field in such neat, straight rows?

messages.speaker: Toni (农户的儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Missieri; ara kemm ħarġu dritti r-ringieli.
messages.mt_standard: Missieri; ara kemm ħarġu dritti r-ringieli.
messages.zh: 我父亲，你看这些行垄多直。
messages.en: My father; look how straight the rows turned out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅图分别记两个义项：木板上划出的线，以及田里犁出的直行；见到宾语再判断具体意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to become hard, especially when describing bread or similar food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易变硬的，尤用于描述面包等食物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jibbies, speċjalment meta jingħad għall-ħobż jew għal ikel simili.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易变硬的；有变硬倾向的，用于面包等。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jibbies, bħall-ħobż.

formal.mt: Dan it-tip ta' ħobż huwa sennieġi u għandu jinżamm f'kontenitur magħluq sew.
formal.en: This type of bread tends to harden and should be kept in a tightly closed container.
formal.zh: 这种面包容易变硬，应放在密闭容器中保存。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-ħobż jibqa' artab sa għada? Pawlu: Huwa sennieġi; aħjar nagħlqu l-borża sew.
colloquial.en: Maja: Will this bread stay soft until tomorrow? Pawlu: It tends to harden; we'd better close the bag properly.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这面包到明天还会软吗？保罗：它容易变硬，我们最好把袋子封好。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ħobż jibqa' artab sa għada?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ħobż jibqa' artab sa għada?
messages.zh: 这面包到明天还会软吗？
messages.en: Will this bread stay soft until tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa sennieġi; aħjar nagħlqu l-borża sew.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa sennieġi; aħjar nagħlqu l-borża sew.
messages.zh: 它容易变硬，我们最好把袋子封好。
messages.en: It tends to harden; we'd better close the bag properly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象刚买的软面包放着放着就硬了，重点记“容易变硬的倾向”，而不只是眼下已经很硬。

gloss_zh: 串物者；把东西串起来的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who strings objects together, for example by threading beads onto a string.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物件串联起来的人，例如用线把珠子串起来的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tgħaqqad oġġetti flimkien, pereżempju billi tgħaddi ħajta miż-żibeġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把东西串起来的人；串联物件的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħadd li jgħaqqad oġġetti flimkien f'sensiela.

formal.mt: Is-sensiel għadda ħajta miż-żibeġ biex jagħmel ġiżirana.
formal.en: The person stringing the beads passed a thread through them to make a necklace.
formal.zh: 串珠者把线穿过珠子，制作一条项链。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min jista' jgħaqqad dawn iż-żibeġ f'ġiżirana? Mark: Is-sensiel jista' jgħaqqadhom b'ħajta għalik.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who can string these beads into a necklace? Mark: The bead stringer can join them with a thread for you.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：谁能把这些珠子串成项链？马克：串珠的人可以帮你用线把它们串起来。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Min jista' jgħaqqad dawn iż-żibeġ f'ġiżirana?
messages.mt_standard: Min jista' jgħaqqad dawn iż-żibeġ f'ġiżirana?
messages.zh: 谁能把这些珠子串成项链？
messages.en: Who can string these beads into a necklace?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.zh: 串珠的人可以帮你用线把它们串起来。
messages.en: The bead stringer can join them with a thread for you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人拿着线逐颗串珠，把目光放在动手串东西的人身上，记住这个名词指人。

gloss_zh: 序列式的；按顺序排列的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Arranged as a sequence, with elements following one another in order.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 呈序列形式的，各个部分依次排列或进行的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jieħu l-forma ta' sekwenza, b'element wieħed wara l-ieħor.

sense_translations.en_definition: taking the form of a sequence
sense_translations.zh_definition: 呈序列形式的；依次排列的。

formal.mt: It-tqassim sensieli tal-eżerċizzji jgħin lill-istudenti jsegwu l-passi wieħed wara l-ieħor.
formal.en: The sequential arrangement of the exercises helps students follow the steps one after another.
formal.zh: 练习按顺序编排，有助于学生依次完成各个步骤。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għażilt tqassim sensieli? Mark: Biex kull pass jiġi wara dak ta' qablu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you choose a sequential arrangement? Mark: So that each step follows the previous one.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么选择按顺序编排？Mark：这样每一步都接在上一步之后。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你为什么选择按顺序编排？
messages.en: Why did you choose a sequential arrangement?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex kull pass jiġi wara dak ta' qablu.
messages.mt_standard: Biex kull pass jiġi wara dak ta' qablu.
messages.zh: 这样每一步都接在上一步之后。
messages.en: So that each step follows the previous one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象编号一二三的卡片依次排开，用 sensieli 描述这种序列式排列。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of joining items into a string or chain, or arranging them in a sequence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物件串在一起、连接成链，或把各项依次排列的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li tgħaqqad oġġetti f'fil jew f'katina, jew tqegħedhom f'sekwenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把多个物件串在一起的行为。
把各个部分连接成链的行为。
把各项按照一定顺序排列的行为。

formal.mt: L-eżerċizzju jiffoka fuq is-sensil tal-avvenimenti skont l-ordni li fih seħħew.
formal.en: The exercise focuses on sequencing events in the order in which they occurred.
formal.zh: 这项练习着重于按照发生顺序排列事件。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Lest is-sensil taż-żibeġ? Nina: Kważi; għad fadal tliet żibeġ x'inżid.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have you finished stringing the beads? Nina: Almost; I still have three beads to add.
colloquial.zh: Lara：珠子串好了吗？Nina：快好了，还要再加三颗。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 珠子串好了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished stringing the beads?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi; għad fadal tliet żibeġ x'inżid.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi; għad fadal tliet żibeġ x'inżid.
messages.zh: 快好了，还要再加三颗。
messages.en: Almost; I still have three beads to add.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用串珠、接链、排事件三个动作记住 sensil，重点是串联或排序这一行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A chain that is a component of a horse's bridle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 构成马笼头一部分的链条。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Katina li tifforma parti mill-ilġiem ta' żiemel.

sense_translations.en_definition: chain that forms part of a bridle
sense_translations.zh_definition: 作为马笼头组成部分的链条。

formal.mt: Qabel ir-rikba, l-għalliem iċċekkja s-sensla tal-ilġiem biex jiżgura li kienet imwaħħla sew.
formal.en: Before the ride, the instructor checked the bridle chain to ensure that it was securely attached.
formal.zh: 骑行前，教练检查了马笼头的链条，确保其固定牢靠。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Iċċekkjajt is-sensla tal-ilġiem? Pawlu: Iva, hija mwaħħla sew.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you check the bridle chain? Pawlu: Yes, it is securely attached.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你检查过马笼头的链条了吗？Pawlu：检查过了，固定得很牢。

messages.speaker: Sara (骑术教练)
messages.zh: 你检查过马笼头的链条了吗？
messages.en: Did you check the bridle chain?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (学员)
messages.zh: 检查过了，固定得很牢。
messages.en: Yes, it is securely attached.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sensla 放进骑马前检查装备的画面，专记马笼头上的那段链条。

gloss_zh: 好说教的；故作警句式的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Expressing moral judgments or wise-sounding sayings in a pompous or self-important way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以自命不凡的口气发表道德训诫，或说出貌似深刻的警句的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jesprimi ġudizzji morali jew kliem li jidher għaref b'ton pompuż jew ta' min jaħseb li jaf kollox.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 好以自命不凡的口气说教或发表貌似深刻的警句的。

collocations.zh: 充满说教和故作深刻之语的讲话

formal.mt: Il-kritiku osserva li t-ton sentenzjuż tal-awtur għamel il-paragrafu aktar moralizzanti milli konvinċenti.
formal.en: The critic observed that the author's sententious tone made the paragraph more moralizing than convincing.
formal.zh: 评论者指出，作者自以为是的说教口吻使这一段训诫有余、说服力不足。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sibt id-diskors? Mark: Kellu ton sentenzjuż; kull parir kien qisu lezzjoni dwar kif għandna ngħixu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did you think of the speech? Mark: It had a sententious tone; every piece of advice sounded like a lesson on how we should live.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你觉得那场讲话怎么样？Mark：说教味很重，每条建议都像在教训我们该怎样生活。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你觉得那场讲话怎么样？
messages.en: What did you think of the speech?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kellu ton sentenzjuż; kull parir kien qisu lezzjoni dwar kif għandna ngħixu.
messages.mt_standard: Kellu ton sentenzjuż; kull parir kien qisu lezzjoni dwar kif għandna ngħixu.
messages.zh: 说教味很重，每条建议都像在教训我们该怎样生活。
messages.en: It had a sententious tone; every piece of advice sounded like a lesson on how we should live.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人每句话都摆出人生导师的架势，用 sentenzjuż 记住这种故作深刻的说教感。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An elephant shrew, a small mammal with a long, slender snout.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 象鼩，一种具有细长口鼻部的小型哺乳动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mammiferu żgħir b'imnieħer twil u rqiq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 象鼩，一种口鼻部细长的小型哺乳动物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Annimal mammiferu żgħir b'imnieħer twil u rqiq.

collocations.en: a photograph of an elephant shrew

formal.mt: Il-paġna dwar is-senġi turi mammiferu żgħir b'imnieħer twil u rqiq.
formal.en: The page about the elephant shrew shows a small mammal with a long, slender snout.
formal.zh: 介绍象鼩的页面展示了一种口鼻部细长的小型哺乳动物。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dan l-annimal fir-ritratt? David: Dan senġi; ara kemm għandu mnieħru twil!
colloquial.en: Lara: What is this animal in the photograph? David: It's an elephant shrew; look how long its snout is!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：照片里这是什么动物？戴维：这是象鼩，你看它的口鼻部多长！

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 照片里这是什么动物？
messages.en: What is this animal in the photograph?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan senġi; ara kemm għandu mnieħru twil!
messages.mt_standard: Dan senġi; ara kemm għandu mnieħru twil!
messages.zh: 这是象鼩，你看它的口鼻部多长！
messages.en: It's an elephant shrew; look how long its snout is!

cognitive_memory_aid: 给senġi配一张“小身体、长口鼻”的动物图，把这个鲜明轮廓与中文“象鼩”一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give someone or an animal something to drink, satisfying their thirst.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给人或动物喝东西，使其解渴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti lil xi ħadd jew lil annimal xi ħaġa x'jixrob biex jaqtagħlu l-għatx.

sense_translations.en_definition: to give drink to, to quench someone’s thirst
sense_translations.zh_definition: 给……喝东西；为某人解渴。

collocations.en: he gave the boy a drink
he gave the dog a drink

formal.mt: Wara l-mixja, il-missier seqa lit-tifel bl-ilma biex jaqtagħlu l-għatx.
formal.en: After the walk, the father gave the boy water to quench his thirst.
formal.zh: 散步后，父亲给男孩喝水解渴。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-kelb għadu bil-għatx? Pawlu: Le, Mark seqa lill-kelb ftit ilu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is the dog still thirsty? Pawlu: No, Mark gave the dog a drink a little while ago.
colloquial.zh: Lara：狗还渴吗？Pawlu：不渴了，Mark 刚才给它喝过水。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 狗还渴吗？
messages.en: Is the dog still thirsty?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, Mark seqa lill-kelb ftit ilu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, Mark seqa lill-kelb ftit ilu.
messages.zh: 不渴了，Mark 刚才给它喝过水。
messages.en: No, Mark gave the dog a drink a little while ago.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把水递到口渴的人或动物面前，用 seqa 记住给对方喝水解渴这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The merlin, a bird of prey with the scientific name Falco columbarius.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 灰背隼，学名为 Falco columbarius 的猛禽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-priża magħruf bl-isem xjentifiku Falco columbarius.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 灰背隼（Falco columbarius）。

formal.mt: Fil-gwida, ir-ritratt tas-seqer ta' denbu jidher ħdejn l-isem xjentifiku Falco columbarius.
formal.en: In the guide, the photograph of the merlin appears beside the scientific name Falco columbarius.
formal.zh: 指南中，灰背隼的照片旁标有学名 Falco columbarius。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan seqer ta' denbu fir-ritratt? Mark: Iva, u taħtu hemm miktub Falco columbarius.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this a merlin in the photograph? Mark: Yes, and Falco columbarius is written underneath it.
colloquial.zh: Nina：照片里这只是灰背隼吗？Mark：是的，下面还写着 Falco columbarius。

messages.speaker: Nina (观鸟初学者)
messages.zh: 照片里这只是灰背隼吗？
messages.en: Is this a merlin in the photograph?

messages.speaker: Mark (观鸟伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u taħtu hemm miktub Falco columbarius.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u taħtu hemm miktub Falco columbarius.
messages.zh: 是的，下面还写着 Falco columbarius。
messages.en: Yes, and Falco columbarius is written underneath it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作三语鸟名卡，把 seqer ta' denbu、merlin 和灰背隼作为完整的一组反复配对。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bird of prey called a goshawk in English.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 英语称为 goshawk 的猛禽，即苍鹰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-priża li bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ goshawk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 苍鹰。

formal.mt: Il-folja tat-tagħlim tqabbel l-isem Malti seqer tal-baħar mal-isem Ingliż goshawk.
formal.en: The teaching sheet pairs the Maltese name seqer tal-baħar with the English name goshawk.
formal.zh: 教学资料将马耳他语名称 seqer tal-baħar 与英语名称 goshawk 配对。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'jissejjaħ seqer tal-baħar bl-Ingliż? Pawlu: Goshawk; hekk hemm miktub ħdejn ir-ritratt.
