colloquial.en: Sara: What is seqer tal-baħar called in English? Pawlu: Goshawk; that is what is written beside the photograph.
colloquial.zh: Sara：seqer tal-baħar 的英语叫什么？Pawlu：Goshawk，照片旁边就是这样写的。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: seqer tal-baħar 的英语叫什么？
messages.en: What is seqer tal-baħar called in English?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Goshawk; hekk hemm miktub ħdejn ir-ritratt.
messages.mt_standard: Goshawk; hekk hemm miktub ħdejn ir-ritratt.
messages.zh: Goshawk，照片旁边就是这样写的。
messages.en: Goshawk; that is what is written beside the photograph.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 seqer tal-baħar 整体写在苍鹰图片背面，再配上 goshawk，用图像记牢完整鸟名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Eurasian hobby, a bird of prey with the scientific name Falco subbuteo.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 燕隼，学名为 Falco subbuteo 的猛禽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-priża magħruf bl-isem xjentifiku Falco subbuteo.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 燕隼（Falco subbuteo）。

collocations.en: a photograph of a Eurasian hobby

formal.mt: Fil-katalgu, is-seqer tal-ħannieqa huwa elenkat bl-isem xjentifiku Falco subbuteo.
formal.en: In the catalogue, the Eurasian hobby is listed under the scientific name Falco subbuteo.
formal.zh: 目录中，燕隼列在学名 Falco subbuteo 之下。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan seqer tal-ħannieqa fl-istampa? Nina: Iva, il-gwida tagħti wkoll l-isem Falco subbuteo.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this a Eurasian hobby in the picture? Nina: Yes, the guide also gives the name Falco subbuteo.
colloquial.zh: Lara：图片里这只是燕隼吗？Nina：是的，指南还给出了 Falco subbuteo 这个名称。

messages.speaker: Lara (观鸟初学者)
messages.zh: 图片里这只是燕隼吗？
messages.en: Is this a Eurasian hobby in the picture?

messages.speaker: Nina (观鸟伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-gwida tagħti wkoll l-isem Falco subbuteo.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-gwida tagħti wkoll l-isem Falco subbuteo.
messages.zh: 是的，指南还给出了 Falco subbuteo 这个名称。
messages.en: Yes, the guide also gives the name Falco subbuteo.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 seqer tal-ħannieqa、Eurasian hobby 和燕隼写成一张配对卡，再用 Falco subbuteo 核对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Hawkish: favouring a forceful or confrontational approach.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 倾向采取强硬、对抗性立场的，常用于描述政治态度或言论。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri jew jappoġġja atteġġjament iebes u favur il-konfront.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鹰派的；主张采取强硬或对抗立场的。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat adotta ton seqri fid-dikjarazzjoni tiegħu dwar it-tilwima.
formal.en: The committee adopted a hawkish tone in its statement about the dispute.
formal.zh: 委员会在关于这场争端的声明中采用了强硬的语气。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif deherlek id-diskors? Mark: It-ton kien seqri wisq; nippreferi aktar djalogu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did you think of the speech? Mark: The tone was too hawkish; I would prefer more dialogue.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你觉得这场讲话怎么样？马克：语气太强硬了；我更希望多一些对话。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你觉得这场讲话怎么样？
messages.en: What did you think of the speech?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-ton kien seqri wisq; nippreferi aktar djalogu.
messages.mt_standard: It-ton kien seqri wisq; nippreferi aktar djalogu.
messages.zh: 语气太强硬了；我更希望多一些对话。
messages.en: The tone was too hawkish; I would prefer more dialogue.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“强硬语气”的场景记忆：听到主张对抗的讲话，就联想到 ton seqri。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Serbia, a country on the Balkan Peninsula in Southeastern Europe.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 塞尔维亚，位于欧洲东南部巴尔干半岛的国家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fil-Peniżola BalkAnika fix-Xlokk tal-Ewropa.

sense_translations.en_definition: Serbia (a country on the Balkan Peninsula in Southeastern Europe)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 塞尔维亚，位于欧洲东南部巴尔干半岛的国家。

formal.mt: L-istudenti identifikaw is-Serbja fuq mappa tal-Peniżola Balkanika.
formal.en: The students identified Serbia on a map of the Balkan Peninsula.
formal.zh: 学生们在巴尔干半岛地图上找出了塞尔维亚。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn sejjer għall-vaganza? Pawlu: Se mmur is-Serbja ma' ħabib tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where are you going on holiday? Pawlu: I'm going to Serbia with a friend.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你要去哪里度假？保罗：我要和一个朋友去塞尔维亚。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where are you going on holiday?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se mmur is-Serbja ma' ħabib tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Se mmur is-Serbja ma' ħabib tiegħi.
messages.zh: 我要和一个朋友去塞尔维亚。
messages.en: I'm going to Serbia with a friend.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Serbja 与英语 Serbia、中文“塞尔维亚”并排记忆，再在巴尔干半岛地图上定位。

gloss_zh: 一排；长队，尤指车流长队

teaching_sense.en_definition: A row of things or a long queue, especially a line of cars in traffic.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 排列成一行的一组事物，也指排得很长的队伍，尤其是交通中的车辆长队。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għadd ta' affarijiet wara xulxin jew ħdejn xulxin f'ringiela, jew kju twil, speċjalment ta' karozzi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一排；排列成一行的一组事物。

sense_translations.en_definition: a long queue (especially of cars in traffic)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 长队，尤指交通中排成长龙的车辆。

formal.mt: Minħabba x-xogħlijiet fit-triq, ifforma serbut twil ta' karozzi quddiem il-pont.
formal.en: Because of the roadworks, a long queue of cars formed in front of the bridge.
formal.zh: 由于道路施工，桥前的车辆排成了长队。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex wasalt tard? David: Kien hemm serbut karozzi u bilkemm imxejna.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did you arrive late? David: There was a queue of cars, and we barely moved.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你怎么迟到了？戴维：汽车排起了长队，我们几乎没往前挪。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 你怎么迟到了？
messages.en: Why did you arrive late?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hemm serbut karozzi u bilkemm imxejna.
messages.mt_standard: Kien hemm serbut karozzi u bilkemm imxejna.
messages.zh: 汽车排起了长队，我们几乎没往前挪。
messages.en: There was a queue of cars, and we barely moved.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想象一排椅子，再把椅子换成堵车中的汽车；两幅画面共同帮助记住“一排、长队”。

gloss_zh: 摆出傲慢姿态；变得趾高气扬

teaching_sense.en_definition: To begin behaving in a haughty or self-important manner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 开始摆出高傲、自以为了不起的态度，对别人显得傲慢。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Beda jġib ruħu bi kburija żejda, bħallikieku kien aqwa minn ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 摆出傲慢的姿态；开始表现得趾高气扬。

collocations.en: he became haughty after the promotion
collocations.zh: 他升职后变得趾高气扬

collocations.en: he adopted a haughty manner towards his companions
collocations.zh: 他对同伴摆出了傲慢的姿态

formal.mt: Wara li nħatar kap, serdaq ma' sħabu u beda jitkellem magħhom b'arroganza.
formal.en: After being appointed leader, he adopted a haughty manner towards his colleagues and began speaking to them arrogantly.
formal.zh: 被任命为负责人后，他对同事摆出了傲慢姿态，说话也开始盛气凌人。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Innutajt kif qed ikellem lil kulħadd? Toni: Iva, minn meta rebaħ il-premju, serdaq sew.
colloquial.en: Sara: Have you noticed how he's talking to everyone? Toni: Yes, since winning the prize, he's become really haughty.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你注意到他跟大家说话的态度了吗？托尼：注意到了，自从得奖后，他就变得很傲慢。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Innutajt kif qed ikellem lil kulħadd?
messages.mt_standard: Innutajt kif qed ikellem lil kulħadd?
messages.zh: 你注意到他跟大家说话的态度了吗？
messages.en: Have you noticed how he's talking to everyone?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, minn meta rebaħ il-premju, serdaq sew.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, minn meta rebaħ il-premju, serdaq sew.
messages.zh: 注意到了，自从得奖后，他就变得很傲慢。
messages.en: Yes, since winning the prize, he's become really haughty.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“得奖后抬高下巴、对人摆架子”的小剧情记忆，抓住这个动词表示开始摆出傲慢态度。

gloss_zh: 爱探听、搬弄是非的女人；船首饰或船首周围装饰

teaching_sense.en_definition: Figuratively, an inquisitive woman who engages in intrigue; in nautical use, a ship's figurehead or decoration around its bows.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 比喻爱探听他人事情、搬弄是非的女人；在航海用语中，指船首饰或船首周围的装饰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod figurattiv, mara li tħobb titkixxef fuq ħaddieħor u tidħol fl-intriċċi; fil-baħar, pulena jew tiżjin madwar il-pruwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: （比喻，复数 serpiet）爱探听他人事情、搬弄是非的女人。

sense_translations.en_definition: (nautical) (pl. serpi) Synonym of pulena, the head of a ship; decoration round the bows of a ship or boat
sense_translations.zh_definition: （航海，复数 serpi）同 pulena，指船首饰，或船舶首部周围的装饰。

collocations.en: a prying woman who noses into everyone's affairs
collocations.zh: 爱探听所有人私事的女人

collocations.en: the ship's figurehead or bow decoration
collocations.zh: 船的船首饰或船首装饰

formal.mt: Il-katalgu tal-mużew jiddeskrivi s-serpa li kienet iżżejjen il-pruwa tal-bastiment.
formal.en: The museum catalogue describes the figurehead that decorated the ship's bow.
formal.zh: 博物馆目录介绍了曾装饰这艘船船首的船首饰。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex sejħilha serpa? Rita: Għax dejjem titkixxef fuq ħaddieħor u tqanqal l-intriċċi.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why did he call her a prying schemer? Rita: Because she is always nosing into other people's affairs and stirring up intrigue.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：他为什么说她是个爱探听、搬弄是非的女人？丽塔：因为她总爱打探别人的事情，还挑起是非。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 他为什么说她是个爱探听、搬弄是非的女人？
messages.en: Why did he call her a prying schemer?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dejjem titkixxef fuq ħaddieħor u tqanqal l-intriċċi.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dejjem titkixxef fuq ħaddieħor u tqanqal l-intriċċi.
messages.zh: 因为她总爱打探别人的事情，还挑起是非。
messages.en: Because she is always nosing into other people's affairs and stirring up intrigue.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分两张场景卡记忆：人物卡写“探听与是非，复数 serpiet”；船首卡写“装饰，复数 serpi”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A serpent or snake, especially a large one.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蛇，尤其指体形较大的蛇。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Serp, speċjalment wieħed kbir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蛇。
大蛇；体形较大的蛇。

formal.mt: L-illustrazzjoni fil-ktieb turi serpent kbir imkebbeb madwar fergħa.
formal.en: The illustration in the book shows a large serpent coiled around a branch.
formal.zh: 书中的插图画着一条盘绕在树枝上的大蛇。

colloquial.mt: Ben: X'hemm fl-istampa? Lea: Serpent kbir imkebbeb ma' siġra.
colloquial.en: Ben: What's in the picture? Lea: A large serpent coiled around a tree.
colloquial.zh: 本：图上有什么？莉娅：一条盘绕在树上的大蛇。

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.zh: 图上有什么？
messages.en: What's in the picture?

messages.speaker: Lea (同学)
messages.zh: 一条盘绕在树上的大蛇。
messages.en: A large serpent coiled around a tree.

cognitive_memory_aid: 这个词与英语 serpent 拼写相同，可直接配上一条盘绕的大蛇图，牢牢记住“蛇、大蛇”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A firework that produces a spiral effect.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 产生螺旋形视觉效果的一种烟花。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' logħob tan-nar li joħloq effett ta' spirali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种呈现螺旋形效果的烟花。

collocations.zh: 螺旋形烟花呈现的效果

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt tal-wirja tal-logħob tan-nar, tidher serpentella li tifforma spirali ta' dawl.
formal.en: In the photograph of the fireworks display, a spiral firework can be seen forming a spiral of light.
formal.zh: 在烟花表演的照片中，可以看到一枚螺旋形烟花形成了螺旋状的光迹。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Rajt dik is-spirali tad-dawl? Karl: Iva, dik kienet serpentella. Kienet sabiħa ħafna!
colloquial.en: Elena: Did you see that spiral of light? Karl: Yes, that was a spiral firework. It was beautiful!
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：你看到那道螺旋状的光了吗？卡尔：看到了，那是螺旋形烟花。真漂亮！

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到那道螺旋状的光了吗？
messages.en: Did you see that spiral of light?

messages.speaker: Karl (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dik kienet serpentella. Kienet sabiħa ħafna!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dik kienet serpentella. Kienet sabiħa ħafna!
messages.zh: 看到了，那是螺旋形烟花。真漂亮！
messages.en: Yes, that was a spiral firework. It was beautiful!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象烟花的光迹画出一个发亮的螺旋，边看画面边念 serpentella，把词与螺旋烟花绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large snake.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 体形很大的蛇。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Serp ta' daqs kbir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大蛇；体形很大的蛇。

collocations.en: a large snake in a cage

formal.mt: Il-gwida spjegat li s-serpentin kien qed jistrieħ taħt il-fergħa.
formal.en: The guide explained that the large snake was resting beneath the branch.
formal.zh: 导游解释说，那条大蛇正在树枝下面休息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dak is-serpentin taħt il-fergħa! Toni: Rajtu! Kemm hu twil!
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that large snake under the branch! Toni: I see it! It's so long!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看树枝下面那条大蛇！托尼：看到了！它可真长！

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 看树枝下面那条大蛇！
messages.en: Look at that large snake under the branch!

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 看到了！它可真长！
messages.en: I see it! It's so long!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 serpentin 和“树枝下面盘着的大蛇”这幅画面一起记，重点记住它指大蛇。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A trap or drain fitting used with a toilet, sink, or similar fixture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于马桶、水槽等设施的排水装置或存水弯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti tal-pajp tad-drenaġġ, bħal dik taħt sink, li żżomm ftit ilma biex ma jitlax ir-riħa.

sense_translations.en_definition: the trap or drain used for toilets, sinks etc.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 马桶、水槽等设施使用的存水弯或排水装置。

formal.mt: Il-plamer naddaf is-serpentina tas-sink biex l-ilma jerġa' jgħaddi sew.
formal.en: The plumber cleaned the sink trap so that the water would flow properly again.
formal.zh: 水管工清理了水槽的存水弯，让水重新顺畅排走。

colloquial.mt: Lara: L-ilma fis-sink qed jinżel bil-mod ħafna. Pawlu: Forsi s-serpentina hi misduda; ħa niċċekkjaha.
colloquial.en: Lara: The water in the sink is draining very slowly. Pawlu: Maybe the trap is blocked; let me check it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：水槽里的水排得特别慢。保罗：可能是存水弯堵了，我来检查一下。

messages.speaker: Lara (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ilma fis-sink qed jinżel bil-mod ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: L-ilma fis-sink qed jinżel bil-mod ħafna.
messages.zh: 水槽里的水排得特别慢。
messages.en: The water in the sink is draining very slowly.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (水管工)
messages.mt_spoken: Forsi s-serpentina hi misduda; ħa niċċekkjaha.
messages.mt_standard: Forsi s-serpentina hi misduda; ħa niċċekkjaha.
messages.zh: 可能是存水弯堵了，我来检查一下。
messages.en: Maybe the trap is blocked; let me check it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象水槽下面弯曲的排水管：看到 serpentina，就联想到需要清理的存水弯。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The serpent, a wind instrument with a curved, snake-like body and a low register.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蛇形号，一种管身弯曲如蛇、音域较低的管乐器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument mużikali tan-nifs b'ġisem mgħawweġ bħal serp u b'ħoss baxx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: （音乐）蛇形号，一种蛇形的低音管乐器。

formal.mt: Waqt il-lezzjoni, l-għalliem daqq is-serpentun biex juri lill-istudenti l-ħoss baxx tiegħu.
formal.en: During the lesson, the teacher played the serpent to demonstrate its low sound to the students.
formal.zh: 课堂上，老师演奏了蛇形号，向学生展示它低沉的声音。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhu dak l-istrument mgħawweġ? Mark: Dak serpentun. Trid tisma' kif idoqq?
colloquial.en: Nina: What's that curved instrument? Mark: That's a serpent. Would you like to hear what it sounds like?
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：那个弯弯曲曲的乐器是什么？马克：那是蛇形号。想听听它的声音吗？

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 那个弯弯曲曲的乐器是什么？
messages.en: What's that curved instrument?

messages.speaker: Mark (音乐教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak serpentun. Trid tisma' kif idoqq?
messages.mt_standard: Dak serpentun. Trid tisma' kif idoqq?
messages.zh: 那是蛇形号。想听听它的声音吗？
messages.en: That's a serpent. Would you like to hear what it sounds like?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 serpentun 记成“能吹出低音的蛇形乐器”，用管身形状和音乐场景一起帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Resembling a snake in shape or movement; winding or sinuous.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形状或运动方式像蛇的；弯曲蜿蜒的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jixbah serp fil-forma jew fil-moviment; li jitgħawweġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 像蛇的；蛇形的；蜿蜒曲折的。

formal.mt: L-artist għażel disinn serpi li jitgħawweġ minn tarf għall-ieħor tal-paġna.
formal.en: The artist chose a snaky design that winds from one end of the page to the other.
formal.zh: 艺术家选用了一个蛇形图案，从纸张的一端蜿蜒延伸到另一端。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif trid id-disinn fuq il-kartolina? Leo: Irridu serpi, bħal serp li jitgħawweġ.
colloquial.en: Sara: What do you want the design on the card to look like? Leo: I want it snaky, like a snake curving along.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你想让卡片上的图案是什么样的？利奥：我想要蛇形的，像蛇那样弯弯曲曲。

messages.speaker: Sara (设计师)
messages.zh: 你想让卡片上的图案是什么样的？
messages.en: What do you want the design on the card to look like?

messages.speaker: Leo (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Irridu serpi, bħal serp li jitgħawweġ.
messages.mt_standard: Irridu serpi, bħal serp li jitgħawweġ.
messages.zh: 我想要蛇形的，像蛇那样弯弯曲曲。
messages.en: I want it snaky, like a snake curving along.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在纸上画一条像蛇一样弯曲的线，旁边写 serpi，记住这里用形容词描述形状。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of stealing another person's property; theft or robbery.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 偷取或抢走他人财物的行为，可指盗窃或抢劫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jieħu xi ħaġa li mhix tiegħu mingħajr permess, bil-moħbi jew bil-forza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 盗窃；未经允许偷取他人财物的行为。
抢劫；以暴力或威胁手段夺取他人财物的行为。

collocations.zh: 报案称遭遇盗窃或抢劫

formal.mt: Il-pulizija qed tinvestiga serq bl-armi li seħħ f'ħanut ilbieraħ filgħaxija.
formal.en: The police are investigating an armed robbery that took place at a shop yesterday evening.
formal.zh: 警方正在调查昨晚发生在一家商店的持械抢劫案。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Xi ħadd ħadli r-rota minn quddiem id-dar. Toni: Dan serq. Irrapportajtu lill-pulizija?
colloquial.en: Marta: Someone took my bicycle from outside the house. Toni: That's theft. Have you reported it to the police?
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：有人把我停在家门口的自行车拿走了。托尼：这是盗窃。你报警了吗？

messages.speaker: Marta (失主)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd ħadli r-rota minn quddiem id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd ħadli r-rota minn quddiem id-dar.
messages.zh: 有人把我停在家门口的自行车拿走了。
messages.en: Someone took my bicycle from outside the house.

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 这是盗窃。你报警了吗？
messages.en: That's theft. Have you reported it to the police?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个场景记 serq：自行车被偷是盗窃，持械夺财是抢劫；这个词覆盖这两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The smew (Mergellus albellus), a small diving duck whose adult male has mainly white plumage with black markings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 白秋沙鸭（Mergellus albellus），一种小型潜水鸭，成年雄鸟羽色以白色为主，带有黑色斑纹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Papra żgħira li togħdos, tal-ispeċi Mergellus albellus; ir-raġel adult għandu rix fil-biċċa l-kbira abjad b'marki suwed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 白秋沙鸭（Mergellus albellus）。

collocations.zh: 池塘水面上的白秋沙鸭

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni tal-għasafar, il-grupp ra serra bajda togħdos fl-għadira.
formal.en: During the birdwatching session, the group saw a smew diving in the pond.
formal.zh: 观鸟时，小组看到一只白秋沙鸭在池塘里潜水。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Dik serra bajda hemm fuq l-ilma? David: Iva, ħares bit-trombi; għadha kemm għaddset.
colloquial.en: Elena: Is that a smew over there on the water? David: Yes, look through the binoculars; it has just dived.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：水面上那只是白秋沙鸭吗？戴维：是的，用双筒望远镜看，它刚潜下去了。

messages.speaker: Elena (观鸟初学者)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik serra bajda hemm fuq l-ilma?
messages.mt_standard: Dik serra bajda hemm fuq l-ilma?
messages.zh: 水面上那只是白秋沙鸭吗？
messages.en: Is that a smew over there on the water?

messages.speaker: David (观鸟向导)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħares bit-trombi; għadha kemm għaddset.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħares bit-trombi; għadha kemm għaddset.
messages.zh: 是的，用双筒望远镜看，它刚潜下去了。
messages.en: Yes, look through the binoculars; it has just dived.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 serra bajda 整组记成白秋沙鸭，配上成年雄鸟黑白相间的图片，帮助区分其他鸭类。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The goosander (Mergus merganser), a large diving duck with a long, narrow bill that feeds mainly on fish.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 普通秋沙鸭（Mergus merganser），一种体形较大、喙细长、主要以鱼为食的潜水鸭。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Papra kbira li togħdos, tal-ispeċi Mergus merganser, b'munqar twil u dejjaq, li tiekol l-aktar ħut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 普通秋沙鸭（Mergus merganser）。

collocations.zh: 正在捕鱼的普通秋沙鸭

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tal-osservazzjoni jsemmi serra prima li dehret taqbad il-ħut fix-xmara.
formal.en: The observation report mentions a goosander that was seen catching fish in the river.
formal.zh: 观察报告提到，有人看到一只普通秋沙鸭在河里捕鱼。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'inhi dik il-papra bil-munqar twil? Karl: Dik serra prima. Ara, qabdet ħuta!
colloquial.en: Anna: What's that duck with the long bill? Karl: That's a goosander. Look, it caught a fish!
colloquial.zh: 安娜：那只喙很长的鸭子是什么？卡尔：那是普通秋沙鸭。看，它抓到一条鱼了！

messages.speaker: Anna (观鸟初学者)
messages.zh: 那只喙很长的鸭子是什么？
messages.en: What's that duck with the long bill?

messages.speaker: Karl (观鸟向导)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik serra prima. Ara, qabdet ħuta!
messages.mt_standard: Dik serra prima. Ara, qabdet ħuta!
messages.zh: 那是普通秋沙鸭。看，它抓到一条鱼了！
messages.en: That's a goosander. Look, it caught a fish!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 serra prima 整组配上“长喙潜水捕鱼”的画面，记成普通秋沙鸭，并与 serra bajda 分开记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To let someone rest, or to ease someone's pain, worry, or burden.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 让某人休息，或减轻某人的疼痛、忧虑或负担。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħalla lil xi ħadd jistrieħ, jew naqqaslu l-uġigħ, l-inkwiet jew it-toqol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 让……休息；使……得到歇息。
缓解；减轻疼痛、忧虑或负担。

collocations.zh: 使他安心；打消他的忧虑

formal.mt: Il-kowċ serraħ lill-plejers għal għaxar minuti qabel kompla t-taħriġ.
formal.en: The coach gave the players a ten-minute rest before continuing the training.
formal.zh: 教练让球员休息了十分钟，然后继续训练。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Il-mixi għajjieni ħafna. Ben: Oqgħod bilqiegħda u serraħ saqajk ftit.
colloquial.en: Rita: All that walking has really tired me out. Ben: Sit down and rest your feet for a bit.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：走了这么多路，我累坏了。本：坐下来，让双脚歇一会儿。

messages.speaker: Rita (徒步者)
messages.zh: 走了这么多路，我累坏了。
messages.en: All that walking has really tired me out.

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Oqgħod bilqiegħda u serraħ saqajk ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Oqgħod bilqiegħda u serraħ saqajk ftit.
messages.zh: 坐下来，让双脚歇一会儿。
messages.en: Sit down and rest your feet for a bit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“让脚歇一歇，让心松一松”：serraħ 既可表示让人休息，也可表示减轻忧虑。

gloss_zh: 使暴露于潮湿或寒冷中

teaching_sense.en_definition: To leave someone or something exposed to damp conditions or cold.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人或物暴露在潮湿或寒冷的环境中。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħalla lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa esposti għall-umdità jew għall-kesħa.

sense_translations.en_definition: to expose to damp or cold
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使暴露在潮湿或寒冷的环境中。

collocations.en: exposed the clothes to damp or cold
exposed the bedding to damp or cold

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem serred il-friex meta ħallieh barra matul il-lejl.
formal.en: The worker exposed the bedding to damp and cold by leaving it outside overnight.
formal.zh: 工人把被褥留在外面过夜，使其暴露在潮湿和寒冷中。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min ħalla l-ħwejjeġ barra billejl? Pawlu: Jien; serred il-ħwejjeġ min ħalliehom hemm, u dak kont jien.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who left the clothes outside overnight? Pawlu: I did; whoever left them there exposed them to damp and cold, and that was me.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：谁把衣服留在外面过夜了？保罗：是我；把衣服留在那里的人让它们受了潮、受了冷，那个人就是我。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 谁把衣服留在外面过夜了？
messages.en: Who left the clothes outside overnight?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien; serred il-ħwejjeġ min ħalliehom hemm, u dak kont jien.
messages.mt_standard: Jien; serred il-ħwejjeġ min ħalliehom hemm, u dak kont jien.
messages.zh: 是我；把衣服留在那里的人让它们受了潮、受了冷，那个人就是我。
messages.en: I did; whoever left them there exposed them to damp and cold, and that was me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象忘收的衣服在夜里变得湿冷，把 serred 和“使东西受潮受冷”这个动作一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wind something around an object or into a coil.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西绕在某物上，或绕成一圈圈。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dawwar xi ħaġa madwar oġġett jew għamilha f'koljatura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 缠绕；把东西绕卷起来。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem serrek il-ħabel madwar ir-rukkell qabel poġġieh fil-maħżen.
formal.en: The worker wound the rope around the reel before putting it in storage.
formal.zh: 工人把绳子绕在线轴上，然后将其收进仓库。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn hu l-ħajt li kien fuq il-mejda? Ġanni: Missieri serrek il-ħajt madwar ir-rukkell; issa jinsab fil-kexxun.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where is the thread that was on the table? Ġanni: My father wound the thread around the spool; it is in the drawer now.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：原来桌上的线在哪里？詹尼：我爸爸把线绕在线轴上了，现在放在抽屉里。

messages.speaker: Anna (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-ħajt li kien fuq il-mejda?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-ħajt li kien fuq il-mejda?
messages.zh: 原来桌上的线在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the thread that was on the table?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Missieri serrek il-ħajt madwar ir-rukkell; issa jinsab fil-kexxun.
messages.mt_standard: Missieri serrek il-ħajt madwar ir-rukkell; issa jinsab fil-kexxun.
messages.zh: 我爸爸把线绕在线轴上了，现在放在抽屉里。
messages.en: My father wound the thread around the spool; it is in the drawer now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中把一根线一圈圈绕上线轴，将 serrek 与手上“绕卷”的动作绑定记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To follow a winding course with repeated bends, as a path or river does.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 像小路或河流一样，沿着多次转弯的路线蜿蜒延伸。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għadda minn naħa għal oħra b'ħafna liwjiet, bħal mogħdija jew xmara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蜿蜒；沿弯曲的路线延伸。
曲折迂回地延伸或流动。

formal.mt: Il-mogħdija kienet dejqa, u l-kors tagħha serrep bejn is-siġar sa tarf il-wied.
formal.en: The path was narrow, and its course wound between the trees to the edge of the valley.
formal.zh: 小路很窄，其路线在树木之间蜿蜒，一直延伸到山谷边缘。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kien dritt il-kors tal-mixja? David: Le, serrep bejn is-siġar, imma kien sabiħ ħafna.
colloquial.en: Nina: Was the walking route straight? David: No, it wound between the trees, but it was very beautiful.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：步行路线是直的吗？戴维：不是，它在树木之间蜿蜒，不过非常漂亮。

messages.speaker: Nina (徒步同伴)
messages.zh: 步行路线是直的吗？
messages.en: Was the walking route straight?

messages.speaker: David (徒步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, serrep bejn is-siġar, imma kien sabiħ ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Le, serrep bejn is-siġar, imma kien sabiħ ħafna.
messages.zh: 不是，它在树木之间蜿蜒，不过非常漂亮。
messages.en: No, it wound between the trees, but it was very beautiful.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用手指在纸上画一条不断转弯的小路，边画边记 serrep，联想“蜿蜒、曲折延伸”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To shine with very bright light.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出非常明亮、强烈的光。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ta dawl qawwi ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出非常明亮的光；强烈地闪耀。

collocations.en: shone very brightly in the dark
shone very brightly during the night

formal.mt: Il-fanal serreġ fid-dlam u dawwal id-daħla tal-port.
formal.en: The beacon shone very brightly in the dark and illuminated the harbour entrance.
formal.zh: 航标灯在黑暗中发出强光，照亮了港口入口。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Rajt dak id-dawl ilbieraħ? Mark: Iva, il-fanal serreġ tant li stajt nara t-triq kollha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you see that light yesterday? Mark: Yes, the lamp shone so brightly that I could see the whole road.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你昨天看见那道光了吗？马克：看见了，那盏灯亮得让我能看清整条路。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你昨天看见那道光了吗？
messages.en: Did you see that light yesterday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-fanal serreġ tant li stajt nara t-triq kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-fanal serreġ tant li stajt nara t-triq kollha.
messages.zh: 看见了，那盏灯亮得让我能看清整条路。
messages.en: Yes, the lamp shone so brightly that I could see the whole road.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象黑夜中一盏亮得照清整条路的灯，用这个画面记住 serreġ 的“发出强光”。

gloss_zh: 把物品置于夜间湿冷中的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who leaves things exposed to the cold and damp of the night.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物品放在外面，使其暴露于夜间寒冷和潮湿中的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tħalli affarijiet esposti għall-kesħa u l-umdità tal-lejl.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who exposes things to nighttime cold and damp
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使物品暴露于夜间寒冷和潮湿中的人。

collocations.en: a person who exposes clothes to nighttime cold and damp
collocations.zh: 使衣服暴露于夜间湿冷中的人

collocations.en: a person who exposes bedding to nighttime cold and damp
collocations.zh: 使被褥暴露于夜间湿冷中的人

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżempju, is-serried huwa r-raġel li ħalla l-friex barra għall-kesħa u l-umdità tal-lejl.
formal.en: In this example, the serried is the man who left the bedding outside, exposed to the cold and damp of the night.
formal.zh: 在这个例子中，serried 指把被褥留在外面、使其暴露于夜间寒冷和潮湿中的男子。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Xi tfisser il-kelma serried hawn? Toni: Tfisser il-persuna li tħalli l-affarijiet barra għall-kesħa u l-umdità tal-lejl.
colloquial.en: Elena: What does the word serried mean here? Toni: It means the person who leaves things outside, exposed to the cold and damp of the night.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：这里的 serried 是什么意思？托尼：指把东西留在外面、使其暴露于夜间寒冷和潮湿中的人。

messages.speaker: Elena (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 serried 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word serried mean here?

messages.speaker: Toni (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser il-persuna li tħalli l-affarijiet barra għall-kesħa u l-umdità tal-lejl.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser il-persuna li tħalli l-affarijiet barra għall-kesħa u l-umdità tal-lejl.
messages.zh: 指把东西留在外面、使其暴露于夜间寒冷和潮湿中的人。
messages.en: It means the person who leaves things outside, exposed to the cold and damp of the night.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画面中既有夜里受潮的被褥，也有把它留在外面的人；serried 要记住的是这个人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing a feeling of cold together with dampness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带来潮湿而寒冷的感觉的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġiegħel lil dak li jkun iħoss kesħa u umdità flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人感到湿冷的；带来阴冷潮湿感的。

collocations.en: a wind that brings a damp chill
a night that brings a damp chill

formal.mt: Riħ serriedi daħal mit-twieqi miftuħa u ġiegħel lill-istudenti jilbsu l-ġkieket.
formal.en: A wind bringing a damp chill came through the open windows and made the students put on their jackets.
formal.zh: 一阵带着湿冷的风从敞开的窗户吹进来，学生们因此穿上了外套。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex għalaqt it-tieqa? Luqa: Hemm riħ serriedi barra; qed inħoss il-kesħa anki bil-ġakketta.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you close the window? Luqa: There is a wind bringing a damp chill outside; I feel cold even with my jacket on.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么把窗户关上了？卢卡：外面的风又湿又冷，我穿着外套都觉得冷。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把窗户关上了？
messages.en: Why did you close the window?

messages.speaker: Luqa (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm riħ serriedi barra; qed inħoss il-kesħa anki bil-ġakketta.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm riħ serriedi barra; qed inħoss il-kesħa anki bil-ġakketta.
messages.zh: 外面的风又湿又冷，我穿着外套都觉得冷。
messages.en: There is a wind bringing a damp chill outside; I feel cold even with my jacket on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象潮湿冷风吹来，穿着外套仍然打寒战；serriedi 描写带来这种湿冷感觉的事物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bout of wrestling or a struggle involving physical effort or difficulty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 摔跤或搏斗的一番较量，也可指需要费力应对的挣扎。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taqbida bejn persuni, jew sforz biex wieħed jegħleb diffikultà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次摔跤或扭打。
一场搏斗、挣扎或艰难的较量。

collocations.zh: 两名搏斗者之间的一场较量

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi serriegħa twila bejn iż-żewġ ġellieda.
formal.en: The report describes a long wrestle between the two fighters.
formal.zh: 报告描述了两名搏斗者之间一场持续很久的较量。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex domt daqshekk? Pawlu: Kelli serriegħa mal-bagalja; ma stajtx nagħlaqha!
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you take so long? Pawlu: I had a struggle with the suitcase; I couldn't close it!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你怎么花了这么久？保罗：我跟行李箱较了半天劲，怎么也关不上！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么花了这么久？
messages.en: Why did you take so long?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kelli serriegħa mal-bagalja; ma stajtx nagħlaqha!
messages.mt_standard: Kelli serriegħa mal-bagalja; ma stajtx nagħlaqha!
messages.zh: 我跟行李箱较了半天劲，怎么也关不上！
messages.en: I had a struggle with the suitcase; I couldn't close it!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两个人扭打，再想象你费力关行李箱：把 serriegħa 的“摔跤”和“挣扎”连成两个画面来记。

gloss_zh: 蜿蜒的；蛇形的；曲折延伸的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Following a winding or meandering course, or resembling a snake in shape.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 沿着弯曲路线延伸的，或形状像蛇一样曲折的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jimxi jew jestendi b'ħafna liwjiet, jew li għandu għamla bħal ta' serp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弯弯曲曲的；蜿蜒的。
像蛇的；呈蛇形的。
迂回曲折地延伸的；蜿蜒而行的。

formal.mt: Il-mappa turi passaġġ serriepi li jitla' mill-wied sal-quċċata tal-għolja.
formal.en: The map shows a winding path rising from the valley to the top of the hill.
formal.zh: 地图显示了一条从山谷蜿蜒上行、通往山顶的小径。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-passaġġ iwassal sal-baħar? Pawlu: Iva, imma huwa serriepi ħafna; trid timxi ftit aktar milli taħseb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this path lead to the sea? Pawlu: Yes, but it's very winding; you'll have to walk a little farther than you think.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这条小径通向海边吗？保罗：是的，不过它弯弯曲曲的，你得比想象中多走一点路。

messages.speaker: Maja (徒步者)
messages.zh: 这条小径通向海边吗？
messages.en: Does this path lead to the sea?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (徒步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma huwa serriepi ħafna; trid timxi ftit aktar milli taħseb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma huwa serriepi ħafna; trid timxi ftit aktar milli taħseb.
messages.zh: 是的，不过它弯弯曲曲的，你得比想象中多走一点路。
messages.en: Yes, but it's very winding; you'll have to walk a little farther than you think.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在词卡上画一条像蛇的小路，把 serriepi 的“蜿蜒、蛇形、曲折延伸”三个意思放进同一幅图。

gloss_zh: 有强迫性偷窃倾向的；不由自主偷窃的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a compulsive urge to steal or repeatedly stealing under such an urge.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有难以控制的偷窃冲动，或在这种冲动下反复偷窃的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu impuls qawwi li jisraq u jsibha diffiċli biex jikkontrollah.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有盗窃癖的；具有难以控制的偷窃冲动的。
在难以控制的冲动下反复偷窃的。

collocations.en: a fictional character who steals compulsively
collocations.zh: 一个有强迫性偷窃倾向的虚构角色

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-karattru serrieqi jieħu oġġetti li ma jeħtieġx u mbagħad jiddispjaċih.
formal.en: In the novel, the character who steals compulsively takes objects he does not need and later regrets it.
formal.zh: 小说中，那个有强迫性偷窃倾向的角色拿走自己并不需要的物品，随后又感到后悔。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser li dan il-karattru huwa serrieqi? Pawlu: Ifisser li jħoss impuls biex jisraq u jsibha diffiċli biex jikkontrollah.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does it mean to say this character is serrieqi? Pawlu: It means he feels an urge to steal and finds it hard to control.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：说这个角色 serrieqi 是什么意思？保罗：就是说他有偷窃的冲动，而且很难控制。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser li dan il-karattru huwa serrieqi?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser li dan il-karattru huwa serrieqi?
messages.zh: 说这个角色 serrieqi 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does it mean to say this character is serrieqi?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (读书会同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li jħoss impuls biex jisraq u jsibha diffiċli biex jikkontrollah.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li jħoss impuls biex jisraq u jsibha diffiċli biex jikkontrollah.
messages.zh: 就是说他有偷窃的冲动，而且很难控制。
messages.en: It means he feels an urge to steal and finds it hard to control.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用小说人物来记 serrieqi：人物反复想偷东西，又难以控制冲动；记忆重点放在“强迫性偷窃倾向”。

gloss_zh: 发出热量或强光的物体

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that emits heat or bright light.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出热量或明亮光线的物体或来源。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li tagħti sħana jew dawl qawwi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出热量或强光的物体；此处作名词，指发热体或发光体。

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżempju, il-lampa tissejjaħ serrieġ għax tagħti dawl qawwi.
formal.en: In this example, the lamp is called a serrieġ because it emits bright light.
formal.zh: 在这个例子中，这盏灯被称为 serrieġ，因为它会发出强光。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'inhu serrieġ? Ben: Xi ħaġa li tagħti sħana jew dawl qawwi, bħal din il-lampa.
colloquial.en: Marta: What is a serrieġ? Ben: Something that emits heat or bright light, like this lamp.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：serrieġ 是什么？本：指发出热量或强光的东西，比如这盏灯。

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.zh: serrieġ 是什么？
messages.en: What is a serrieġ?

messages.speaker: Ben (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħaġa li tagħti sħana jew dawl qawwi, bħal din il-lampa.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħaġa li tagħti sħana jew dawl qawwi, bħal din il-lampa.
messages.zh: 指发出热量或强光的东西，比如这盏灯。
messages.en: Something that emits heat or bright light, like this lamp.

cognitive_memory_aid: 指着一盏发亮的灯记 serrieġ：这里是名词，注意记住“发光或发热的那个物体”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Giving off heat or bright light.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出热量或明亮光线的，用来描述事物的性质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħti sħana jew dawl qawwi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出热量或强光的；此处作形容词。

collocations.en: a source emitting heat or bright light
collocations.zh: 发出热量或强光的来源

collocations.en: an object emitting heat or bright light
collocations.zh: 发热或发出强光的物体

formal.mt: L-oġġett serrieġi ta dawl qawwi biżżejjed biex idawwal il-kamra kollha.
formal.en: The light-emitting object gave off light bright enough to illuminate the entire room.
formal.zh: 这个发光物体发出的光足够明亮，照亮了整个房间。

colloquial.mt: Julia: Għaliex qed issejjaħlu oġġett serrieġi? Adam: Għax jagħti dawl qawwi; il-kelma tista' wkoll tiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li tagħti sħana.
colloquial.en: Julia: Why are you calling it an oġġett serrieġi? Adam: Because it emits bright light; the word can also describe something that gives off heat.
colloquial.zh: 朱莉娅：你为什么称它为 oġġett serrieġi？亚当：因为它发出强光；这个词也可以形容发热的东西。

messages.speaker: Julia (学生)
messages.zh: 你为什么称它为 oġġett serrieġi？
messages.en: Why are you calling it an oġġett serrieġi?

messages.speaker: Adam (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jagħti dawl qawwi; il-kelma tista' wkoll tiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li tagħti sħana.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jagħti dawl qawwi; il-kelma tista' wkoll tiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li tagħti sħana.
messages.zh: 因为它发出强光；这个词也可以形容发热的东西。
messages.en: Because it emits bright light; the word can also describe something that gives off heat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给灯贴上“发强光的”标签来记 serrieġi；它是形容词，用来说明物体发热或发光的性质。

gloss_zh: 使人休息的人或事物；休憩之所

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or thing that gives someone rest or relief from effort.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 让人能够休息、歇息或从劳累中得到缓解的人或事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew ħaġa li tagħti mistrieħ jew tgħin lil xi ħadd jistrieħ.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. or sth. that provides rest
sense_translations.zh_definition: 提供休息或使人得到歇息的人或事物。

collocations.en: a source of rest for the traveller
collocations.zh: 使旅人得到歇息的人或事物

collocations.en: something that provides rest after work
collocations.zh: 工作后让人得到休息的事物

formal.mt: Dan il-ġnien huwa serrieħ għall-vjaġġatur wara mixja twila.
formal.en: This garden provides a resting place for the traveller after a long walk.
formal.zh: 这座花园让长途步行后的旅人有了歇息之所。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tiġi hawn wara x-xogħol? Pawlu: Dan il-ġnien huwa serrieħ għalija; hawn nista' nistrieħ ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you come here after work? Pawlu: This garden gives me rest; I can relax here for a while.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么下班后到这里来？保罗：这座花园让我得到歇息，我可以在这里放松一会儿。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么下班后到这里来？
messages.en: Why do you come here after work?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ġnien huwa serrieħ għalija; hawn nista' nistrieħ ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ġnien huwa serrieħ għalija; hawn nista' nistrieħ ftit.
messages.zh: 这座花园让我得到歇息，我可以在这里放松一会儿。
messages.en: This garden gives me rest; I can relax here for a while.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 serrieħ 配上一张花园长椅的图片：记住它指“让人歇息的人或物”，在本词条中是名词。

gloss_zh: 令人放松的；适合休息的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Giving a feeling of rest, calm, or relaxation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人感到安宁、放松，能够好好休息的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħti sens ta' mistrieħ u kalma u jgħin lil dak li jkun jirrilassa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人安宁放松的；有助于休息的。

formal.mt: Il-ġnien joffri ambjent serrieħi fejn il-viżitaturi jistgħu jaqraw fil-kwiet.
formal.en: The garden offers a restful environment where visitors can read quietly.
formal.zh: 花园提供了令人放松的环境，访客可以在那里安静地阅读。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid noqogħdu hawn ftit? Pawlu: Iva, dan il-post serrieħi ħafna; lanqas jinstema' t-traffiku.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we stay here for a while? Pawlu: Yes, this place is very restful; you can't even hear the traffic.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们在这里待一会儿好吗？保罗：好啊，这地方很让人放松，连车流声都听不见。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们在这里待一会儿好吗？
messages.en: Shall we stay here for a while?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dan il-post serrieħi ħafna; lanqas jinstema' t-traffiku.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dan il-post serrieħi ħafna; lanqas jinstema' t-traffiku.
messages.zh: 好啊，这地方很让人放松，连车流声都听不见。
messages.en: Yes, this place is very restful; you can't even hear the traffic.

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排记 serrieħ 和 serrieħi：前者是让人歇息的人或物，后者用来形容环境“令人放松”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To talk continuously about small matters, or to speak at length without saying much of value.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 接连不断地谈论琐事，或说很多缺少实质内容的话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitkellem ħafna fuq affarijiet żgħar jew jgħid ħafna kliem bla wisq sustanza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喋喋不休地说；絮絮叨叨地谈论。
啰啰嗦嗦地说空话或废话。

collocations.zh: 他絮絮叨叨地谈论琐事

formal.mt: Matul il-laqgħa, wieħed mill-parteċipanti serser fuq affarijiet li ma kellhomx x'jaqsmu mas-suġġett.
formal.en: During the meeting, one participant blathered about matters unrelated to the subject.
formal.zh: 会议期间，一名与会者啰啰嗦嗦地讲了些与主题无关的事情。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadek fuq it-telefon? Pawlu: Iva, ħija ilu jserser fuq il-ġirien għal nofs siegħa!
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you still on the phone? Pawlu: Yes, my brother has been chattering about the neighbours for half an hour!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你还在打电话啊？保罗：是啊，我哥哥已经絮絮叨叨地说了半小时邻居的事了！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还在打电话啊？
messages.en: Are you still on the phone?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħija ilu jserser fuq il-ġirien għal nofs siegħa!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħija ilu jserser fuq il-ġirien għal nofs siegħa!
messages.zh: 是啊，我哥哥已经絮絮叨叨地说了半小时邻居的事了！
messages.en: Yes, my brother has been chattering about the neighbours for half an hour!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 serser 当成“嘴巴一直动”的动作卡：有人不停聊琐事，就是这个动词；用半小时电话聊天的画面帮助记忆。

gloss_zh: 啁啾声；唧唧声；叽叽喳喳的说话声

teaching_sense.en_definition: Chirping sounds, or the sound or activity of continuous chattering.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸟虫发出的啁啾或唧唧声，也指人接连不断说话的声音或活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħsejjes qosra u ripetuti ta' għasafar jew insetti, jew taħdit kontinwu bejn in-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸟虫的啁啾声或唧唧声。
叽叽喳喳的说话声；接连不断的闲谈。

collocations.zh: 孩子们叽叽喳喳的说话声

formal.mt: Filgħodu, is-sersir tal-għasafar jinstema' mill-ġnien biswit il-librerija.
formal.en: In the morning, the chirping of birds can be heard from the garden beside the library.
formal.zh: 早晨，可以听见图书馆旁的花园里传来鸟儿的啁啾声。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dak il-ħoss fil-bitħa? Pawlu: Dak is-sersir tat-tfal; qed jitkellmu kollha f'daqqa!
colloquial.en: Maja: What's that noise in the courtyard? Pawlu: That's the children's chattering; they're all talking at once!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：院子里是什么声音？保罗：是孩子们叽叽喳喳的说话声，他们全都在同时说话！

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 院子里是什么声音？
messages.en: What's that noise in the courtyard?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak is-sersir tat-tfal; qed jitkellmu kollha f'daqqa!
messages.mt_standard: Dak is-sersir tat-tfal; qed jitkellmu kollha f'daqqa!
messages.zh: 是孩子们叽叽喳喳的说话声，他们全都在同时说话！
messages.en: That's the children's chattering; they're all talking at once!

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 sersir 配两段想象录音：一段是鸟叫，一段是孩子们叽叽喳喳。记住本词是名词，关注“声音或闲谈活动”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who chatters a lot; also, a cricket, an insect that makes chirping sounds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 爱喋喋不休地说话的人；也指会发出唧唧声的昆虫蟋蟀。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li titkellem ħafna; ukoll insett li jagħmel ħoss ripetut, spiss jinstema' bil-lejl.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱喋喋不休地说话的人；爱絮叨的人。
一只蟋蟀。

collocations.mt: sersur li ma jieqaf qatt jitkellem
collocations.en: a chatterer who never stops talking
collocations.zh: 一个说起话来没完没了的人

formal.mt: L-istudenti semgħu sersur fil-ħaxix u ppruvaw isibu minn fejn kien ġej il-ħoss.
formal.en: The students heard a cricket in the grass and tried to locate the source of the sound.
formal.zh: 学生们听到草丛里有一只蟋蟀在叫，便试着寻找声音的来源。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħuk għadu jitkellem dwar il-logħba? Pawlu: Iva, illum sersur! Ilu siegħa jirrakkonta kull dettall.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is your brother still talking about the match? Pawlu: Yes, he's a real chatterer today! He's been recounting every detail for an hour.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你哥哥还在说那场比赛吗？保罗：是啊，他今天可真能絮叨！每个细节都要讲，已经讲了一小时了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥还在说那场比赛吗？
messages.en: Is your brother still talking about the match?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, illum sersur! Ilu siegħa jirrakkonta kull dettall.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, illum sersur! Ilu siegħa jirrakkonta kull dettall.
messages.zh: 是啊，他今天可真能絮叨！每个细节都要讲，已经讲了一小时了。
messages.en: Yes, he's a real chatterer today! He's been recounting every detail for an hour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 sersur 画两张角色卡：一张是说个不停的人，一张是草丛里的蟋蟀。再与 sersir 的“声音”对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who serves another, especially as a household servant; also a serf bound to work for a lord.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为他人服役的人，尤指家庭中的仆人；也可指受领主束缚、为其劳动的农奴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li taqdi lil ħaddieħor, speċjalment f'dar; ukoll persuna marbuta li taħdem għal sid fewdali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 仆人；为主人料理家务或提供其他服务的人。
农奴；受封建领主束缚并须为其劳动的人。

collocations.en: a serf bound to the land

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, is-serv iħejji l-kamra għall-mistednin qabel ma jasal sid id-dar.
formal.en: In the novel, the servant prepares the room for the guests before the master of the house arrives.
formal.zh: 小说中，仆人在屋主到来之前为客人准备房间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-karattru huwa serv fil-palazz? Mark: Iva, u fil-bidu tal-istorja jiftaħ il-bieb lill-mistednin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this character a servant in the palace? Mark: Yes, and at the beginning of the story he opens the door for the guests.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个角色是宫殿里的仆人吗？Mark：是的，故事开头就是他为客人开门。

messages.speaker: Maja (读者)
messages.zh: 这个角色是宫殿里的仆人吗？
messages.en: Is this character a servant in the palace?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u fil-bidu tal-istorja jiftaħ il-bieb lill-mistednin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u fil-bidu tal-istorja jiftaħ il-bieb lill-mistednin.
messages.zh: 是的，故事开头就是他为客人开门。
messages.en: Yes, and at the beginning of the story he opens the door for the guests.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 serv 放进两个故事画面：宫殿里服侍客人的是“仆人”，受领主束缚耕地的是“农奴”；结合场景区分两义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Useful for a purpose or in a condition that allows something to continue being used.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能发挥实际作用的，或状况尚可、能够继续使用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jintuża għal xi skop jew li għadu f'kundizzjoni tajba biżżejjed biex jintuża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有用的；能满足需要或帮助完成某事的。
可用的；状态足以满足实际使用要求的。

formal.mt: Minkejja li ilu jintuża għal ħafna snin, dan it-tagħmir għadu servibbli għax-xogħol ta' kuljum.
formal.en: Although it has been used for many years, this equipment is still serviceable for everyday work.
formal.zh: 这套设备虽然已经使用多年，但仍能满足日常工作的需要。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Se tarmi dan il-mejda? Pawlu: Le, għadu servibbli; irrid biss innaddfu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are you going to throw away this table? Pawlu: No, it is still usable; I just need to clean it.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你要把这张桌子扔掉吗？Pawlu：不，它还能用；我只需要清理一下。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 你要把这张桌子扔掉吗？
messages.en: Are you going to throw away this table?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għadu servibbli; irrid biss innaddfu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għadu servibbli; irrid biss innaddfu.
messages.zh: 不，它还能用；我只需要清理一下。
messages.en: No, it is still usable; I just need to clean it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看见旧物先问“还能用吗”：还能用就是 servibbli；谈工具能帮上忙时，也可用它表示“有用的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Excessively submissive or eager to please someone, especially a person with power.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对他人，尤其是有权势者，过分顺从或刻意讨好的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri sottomissjoni żejda jew ħerqa eċċessiva li jogħġob lil xi ħadd, speċjalment lil min għandu l-poter.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 卑躬屈膝的；缺乏自主立场、过分顺从他人的。
谄媚的；为了讨好他人而表现得过分恭顺的。

formal.mt: Il-kritiku jiddeskrivi l-imġiba tal-karattru bħala servili, għax dejjem jaqbel mal-mexxej biex jikseb il-favur tiegħu.
formal.en: The critic describes the character's behaviour as servile because he always agrees with the leader to gain his favour.
formal.zh: 评论者认为这个角色的行为卑躬屈膝，因为他总是附和领导，以博取对方的好感。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex sejjaħtlu servili? David: Għax ifaħħar kull deċiżjoni tal-kap, anki meta jkun qalilna li ma jaqbilx magħha.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did you call him servile? David: Because he praises every decision the boss makes, even when he has told us he disagrees with it.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你为什么说他卑躬屈膝？David：因为老板做什么决定他都夸，哪怕他之前跟我们说过自己不赞同。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 你为什么说他卑躬屈膝？
messages.en: Why did you call him servile?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ifaħħar kull deċiżjoni tal-kap, anki meta jkun qalilna li ma jaqbilx magħha.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ifaħħar kull deċiżjoni tal-kap, anki meta jkun qalilna li ma jaqbilx magħha.
messages.zh: 因为老板做什么决定他都夸，哪怕他之前跟我们说过自己不赞同。
messages.en: Because he praises every decision the boss makes, even when he has told us he disagrees with it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人面对权势者不停点头、刻意奉承；用 servili 描述这种过分顺从的态度，记住它通常带贬义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Excessive submission or flattering behaviour intended to please someone, especially someone powerful.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对他人，尤其是有权势者，过分顺从或奉承讨好的态度与行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sottomissjoni żejda jew imġiba mimlija tifħir biex wieħed jogħġob lil xi ħadd, speċjalment lil min għandu l-poter.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 奴性；卑躬屈膝的态度或行为。
谄媚；为了讨好他人而过分恭顺、奉承的表现。

collocations.zh: 表现出卑躬屈膝的态度

formal.mt: L-awtur jikkritika s-serviliżmu tal-konsulent, li jfaħħar kull proposta tal-mexxej mingħajr ma jeżaminaha.
formal.en: The author criticises the adviser's servility, as he praises every proposal from the leader without examining it.
formal.zh: 作者批评这位顾问的奴性：领导提出任何建议，他都不加审视地赞扬。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan it-tifħir kollu lill-kap jidher esaġerat. Toni: Iva, għalija huwa serviliżmu; qatt ma jgħid x'jaħseb tassew.
colloquial.en: Sara: All this praise for the boss seems exaggerated. Toni: Yes, to me it is obsequiousness; he never says what he really thinks.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这么夸老板，感觉有些过头了。Toni：是啊，在我看来这就是谄媚；他从来不说自己的真实想法。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-tifħir kollu lill-kap jidher esaġerat.
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-tifħir kollu lill-kap jidher esaġerat.
messages.zh: 这么夸老板，感觉有些过头了。
messages.en: All this praise for the boss seems exaggerated.

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għalija huwa serviliżmu; qatt ma jgħid x'jaħseb tassew.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għalija huwa serviliżmu; qatt ma jgħid x'jaħseb tassew.
messages.zh: 是啊，在我看来这就是谄媚；他从来不说自己的真实想法。
messages.en: Yes, to me it is obsequiousness; he never says what he really thinks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用词性配对记忆：servili 描述“谄媚的”人或态度，serviliżmu 则把这种“卑躬屈膝、奉承讨好”作为名词来谈。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In an excessively submissive or flattering way, especially towards someone with power.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以过分顺从或奉承讨好的方式，尤指对待有权势者时。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li juri sottomissjoni żejda jew xewqa eċċessiva li jogħġob lil min għandu l-poter.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以卑躬屈膝、过分顺从的方式。
谄媚地；以过分恭顺、刻意奉承的方式。

collocations.en: to behave in a servile manner

formal.mt: Fix-xena, il-konsulent iwieġeb servilment lill-mexxej u jfaħħar id-deċiżjoni tiegħu mingħajr ebda mistoqsija.
formal.en: In the scene, the adviser answers the leader obsequiously and praises his decision without asking any questions.
formal.zh: 这一幕中，顾问谄媚地回答领导，并毫不质疑地赞扬他的决定。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif tkellem mal-kap? Mark: Tkellem servilment; qabel ma sema' l-proposta kollha, diġà beda jfaħħarha.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did he speak to the boss? Mark: He spoke obsequiously; before hearing the whole proposal, he had already started praising it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：他是怎么跟老板说话的？Mark：说得很谄媚；建议还没听完，他就已经开始夸了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 他是怎么跟老板说话的？
messages.en: How did he speak to the boss?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Tkellem servilment; qabel ma sema' l-proposta kollha, diġà beda jfaħħarha.
messages.mt_standard: Tkellem servilment; qabel ma sema' l-proposta kollha, diġà beda jfaħħarha.
messages.zh: 说得很谄媚；建议还没听完，他就已经开始夸了。
messages.en: He spoke obsequiously; before hearing the whole proposal, he had already started praising it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住“怎样做”来记副词：怎样说话？servilment，谄媚地说；怎样行事？servilment，卑躬屈膝地行事。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A condition in which a person is deprived of freedom and compelled to serve another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 个人被剥夺自由、被迫为他人服役的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qagħda li fiha persuna tkun imċaħħda mil-libertà u mġiegħla taqdi lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 奴役；失去自由并被迫为他人服役的处境。

formal.mt: Ir-rakkont juri kif il-protagonist jinħeles mis-servitù u jibda jieħu d-deċiżjonijiet tiegħu stess.
formal.en: The story shows how the protagonist is freed from servitude and begins to make his own decisions.
formal.zh: 故事展现了主人公如何摆脱奴役，开始自己作决定。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għaliex il-karattru jrid jaħrab? Pawlu: Għax jgħix fis-servitù u jrid ikun ħieles.
colloquial.en: Elena: Why does the character want to escape? Pawlu: Because he lives in servitude and wants to be free.
colloquial.zh: Elena：这个角色为什么想逃走？Pawlu：因为他处于受奴役的状态，想获得自由。

messages.speaker: Elena (学生)
messages.zh: 这个角色为什么想逃走？
messages.en: Why does the character want to escape?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jgħix fis-servitù u jrid ikun ħieles.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jgħix fis-servitù u jrid ikun ħieles.
messages.zh: 因为他处于受奴役的状态，想获得自由。
messages.en: Because he lives in servitude and wants to be free.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 servitù 与“失去自由、被迫服役”的画面相连；练习“生活在奴役中”和“摆脱奴役”两个方向来巩固词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A procedure in which liquid is introduced into the rectum, usually to help empty the bowel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将液体注入直肠的操作，通常用于帮助排空肠道。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċedura li fiha jiddaħħal likwidu fir-rektum, ġeneralment biex jgħin fl-iżvojtar tal-musrana.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 灌肠；将液体注入直肠，通常以帮助排空肠道的操作。

formal.mt: Qabel ma ngħata s-servizzjal, il-pazjent talab spjegazzjoni tal-proċedura.
formal.en: Before being given the enema, the patient asked for an explanation of the procedure.
formal.zh: 接受灌肠之前，患者要求了解这项操作的过程。

colloquial.mt: Anna: It-tabib semma servizzjal? Ġanni: Iva, imma għad irrid nitolbu jispjegali l-proċedura.
colloquial.en: Anna: Did the doctor mention an enema? Ġanni: Yes, but I still need to ask him to explain the procedure to me.
colloquial.zh: Anna：医生提到灌肠了吗？Ġanni：提到了，不过我还得请他给我解释一下操作过程。

messages.speaker: Anna (家属)
messages.zh: 医生提到灌肠了吗？
messages.en: Did the doctor mention an enema?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (患者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma għad irrid nitolbu jispjegali l-proċedura.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma għad irrid nitolbu jispjegali l-proċedura.
messages.zh: 提到了，不过我还得请他给我解释一下操作过程。
messages.en: Yes, but I still need to ask him to explain the procedure to me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用医院里的词义卡片记忆 servizzjal：正面写这个词，背面写“灌肠”，并配上“患者先询问操作过程”的完整场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A male nurse who provides nursing care to patients.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为患者提供护理服务的男性护士。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Raġel li jaħdem bħala infermier u jieħu ħsieb il-pazjenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 男护士；从事患者护理工作的男性。

collocations.en: a male nurse at the hospital
the male nurse cares for the patient

formal.mt: Is-servjent għen lill-pazjent joqgħod bilqiegħda u staqsieh jekk kienx komdu.
formal.en: The male nurse helped the patient sit up and asked whether he was comfortable.
formal.zh: 男护士帮助患者坐起来，并询问他是否舒服。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min għenek toqgħod bilqiegħda? Ġużeppi: Is-servjent li kien hawn dalgħodu; kien paċenzjuż ħafna.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who helped you sit up? Ġużeppi: The male nurse who was here this morning; he was very patient.
colloquial.zh: Marija：谁帮你坐起来的？Ġużeppi：今天早上在这里的那位男护士；他很有耐心。

messages.speaker: Marija (探病亲友)
messages.zh: 谁帮你坐起来的？
messages.en: Who helped you sit up?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (患者)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-servjent li kien hawn dalgħodu; kien paċenzjuż ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Is-servjent li kien hawn dalgħodu; kien paċenzjuż ħafna.
messages.zh: 今天早上在这里的那位男护士；他很有耐心。
messages.en: The male nurse who was here this morning; he was very patient.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 servjent 贴到“男护士帮助患者坐起”的人物画面上，同时记住男性身份与护理职业两个信息，避免只记成泛指服务人员。

gloss_zh: 用于固定短语：可移动餐用边桌；杂役

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun used in the expressions 'servu mutu', a movable serving table, and 'servu di pjazza', a person who does miscellaneous jobs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于固定短语的名词：servu mutu 指可移动的餐用边桌；servu di pjazza 指承接各种零杂工作的杂役。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom li jintuża fl-espressjonijiet 'servu mutu', mejda li tista' titmexxa biex jitqiegħdu fuqha platti u ikel, u 'servu di pjazza', persuna li tagħmel diversi xogħlijiet żgħar.

sense_translations.en_definition: Occurring in 'servu mutu', dumbwaiter (a kind of movable table); 'servu di pjazza', odd man
sense_translations.zh_definition: 见于 servu mutu，指一种可移动的餐用边桌；也见于 servu di pjazza，指做各种零杂工作的杂役。

collocations.zh: 杂役；承接零杂工作的人

formal.mt: Fil-kamra tal-ikel hemm servu mutu li fuqu jitqiegħdu l-platti qabel ma jitressqu fuq il-mejda.
formal.en: In the dining room there is a movable serving table on which plates are placed before being brought to the dining table.
formal.zh: 餐厅里有一张可移动的餐用边桌，盘子先放在那里，再送到餐桌上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'servu di pjazza'? Mark: Ifisser xi ħadd li jagħmel diversi xogħlijiet żgħar.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'servu di pjazza' mean? Mark: It means someone who does various odd jobs.
colloquial.zh: Maja：servu di pjazza 是什么意思？Mark：就是做各种零杂工作的人。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: servu di pjazza 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'servu di pjazza' mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser xi ħadd li jagħmel diversi xogħlijiet żgħar.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser xi ħadd li jagħmel diversi xogħlijiet żgħar.
messages.zh: 就是做各种零杂工作的人。
messages.en: It means someone who does various odd jobs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个固定短语配图记忆：servu mutu 配餐用边桌，servu di pjazza 配杂役；不要只凭单词猜整句意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Rest: a period of stopping work or effort to recover.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 休息，指暂停工作或活动、让身体或精神恢复的时间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Waqfa mix-xogħol jew mit-taħbit biex il-ġisem jew il-moħħ jirkupra.

gloss_zh: 一场；一次活动；会议时段

teaching_sense.en_definition: A period of time set aside for a particular activity, meeting, or lesson.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为某项活动、会议或课程安排的一段时间，也可指这一次活动本身。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Perjodu ta' ħin iddedikat għal attività, laqgħa jew lezzjoni partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为特定活动、会议或课程安排的一个时段；一场或一次活动。

formal.mt: Is-sessjoni ta' taħriġ tibda fid-disgħa u tintemm fil-ħdax.

messages.en: At four. Shall we meet a little earlier?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象日历上圈出的一段活动时间：一次培训或一次学习都可叫 sessjoni；中文量词要随活动调整。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A specialist who studies human sexuality.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 性学家，专门研究人类性与性相关现象的学者或专家。

formal.mt: Is-sessologu mistieden ippreżenta r-riċerka tiegħu dwar is-sesswalità tal-bniedem.
formal.en: The guest sexologist presented his research on human sexuality.
formal.zh: 受邀性学家介绍了他关于人类性的研究。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jitkellem fil-laqgħa? Mark: Sessologu. Se jispjega x'jistudja fix-xogħol tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is going to speak at the meeting? Mark: A sexologist. He will explain what he studies in his work.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁要在会上发言？Mark：一位性学家。他会介绍自己的研究内容。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The aspects of a person's life and experience connected with sexual feelings, attraction, identity, and expression.

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number 10^36, called a sextillion in British long-scale terminology or an undecillion in US terminology.

colloquial.zh: 莉娜：一个 septillion 是很大的数吗？亚当：是的！要知道确切数值，我们得查看采用的是哪种计数体系。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.zh: 一个 septillion 是很大的数吗？
messages.en: Is a septillion a very large number?

messages.speaker: Adam (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! Biex inkunu nafu l-valur eżatt, irridu niċċekkjaw is-sistema tan-numri.
messages.mt_standard: Iva! Biex inkunu nafu l-valur eżatt, irridu niċċekkjaw is-sistema tan-numri.
messages.zh: 是的！要知道确切数值，我们得查看采用的是哪种计数体系。
messages.en: Yes! To know its exact value, we need to check the numbering scale.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 settiljun 与英语 septillion 配对记忆，再给词卡加上“先确认计数体系”，避免把数名直接记成固定零的个数。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A level platform between flights of stairs or at the top of a staircase.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 楼梯两段之间或楼梯顶端供人站立、转向的平坦平台。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Spazju ċatt bejn żewġ partijiet ta' taraġ jew fil-quċċata tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 楼梯平台；楼梯中间或顶端的平坦区域。

formal.mt: Is-setħa tat-taraġ għandha tinżamm ħielsa minn oġġetti biex in-nies ikunu jistgħu jgħaddu.
formal.en: The staircase landing should be kept clear of objects so that people can pass.
formal.zh: 楼梯平台应保持畅通，不应堆放物品，以便人们通行。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn ħallejt il-kaxxa? Ġanni: Fuq is-setħa tat-taraġ, ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where did you leave the box? Ġanni: On the staircase landing, beside the window.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你把箱子放在哪里了？詹尼：在楼梯平台上，窗户旁边。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 你把箱子放在哪里了？
messages.en: Where did you leave the box?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (室友)
messages.zh: 在楼梯平台上，窗户旁边。
messages.en: On the staircase landing, beside the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象爬完一段楼梯后停下来转弯的那块平地，用这个具体位置记住 setħa 是楼梯平台。

gloss_zh: 暗色的；阴沉的；略暗的；近黑的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Somewhat dark in colour, sometimes approaching black, or somber in appearance or mood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 颜色偏暗、有时接近黑色的；也可形容外观或气氛阴沉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu kulur kemxejn skur jew qrib l-iswed, jew dehra jew atmosfera ta' niket.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 暗色的；颜色较深的。
阴沉的；带有沉重或忧郁气氛的。
有些暗的；颜色略深的。
接近黑色的；深得近乎发黑的。

formal.mt: Il-pittur uża kulur sewdieni biex jagħti lix-xena atmosfera ta' niket.
formal.en: The painter used a dark, almost black colour to give the scene a somber atmosphere.
formal.zh: 画家使用了偏暗、近乎黑色的颜色，给画面营造出忧郁的气氛。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan id-drapp iswed? Karl: Mhux għal kollox; hu sewdieni, imma fid-dawl jidher kannella.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this cloth black? Karl: Not completely; it is almost black, but in the light it looks brown.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这块布是黑色的吗？卡尔：不完全是；它接近黑色，不过在光线下看起来是棕色的。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这块布是黑色的吗？
messages.en: Is this cloth black?

messages.speaker: Karl (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Mhux għal kollox; hu sewdieni, imma fid-dawl jidher kannella.
messages.mt_standard: Mhux għal kollox; hu sewdieni, imma fid-dawl jidher kannella.
messages.zh: 不完全是；它接近黑色，不过在光线下看起来是棕色的。
messages.en: Not completely; it is almost black, but in the light it looks brown.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一块在暗处近黑、灯下显棕的布来记颜色义，再用阴沉天空连接 sewdieni 的忧郁气氛义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity or skill of controlling and operating a vehicle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 操纵车辆行驶的活动或技能，即驾驶、开车。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività jew il-ħila li tikkontrolla u tmexxi vettura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 驾驶；操纵车辆行驶的活动。

formal.mt: Is-sewqan jitlob attenzjoni kontinwa u rispett għar-regoli tat-traffiku.
formal.en: Driving requires constant attention and respect for traffic rules.
formal.zh: 驾驶需要持续集中注意力，并遵守交通规则。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Kif marret il-lezzjoni tas-sewqan? Luqa: Tajjeb! Illum tgħallimt nipparkja bejn żewġ karozzi.
colloquial.en: Emma: How did the driving lesson go? Luqa: Well! Today I learned to park between two cars.
colloquial.zh: 艾玛：驾驶课上得怎么样？卢卡：挺好！今天我学会了把车停在两辆车之间。

messages.speaker: Emma (朋友)
messages.zh: 驾驶课上得怎么样？
messages.en: How did the driving lesson go?

messages.speaker: Luqa (学车的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb! Illum tgħallimt nipparkja bejn żewġ karozzi.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb! Illum tgħallimt nipparkja bejn żewġ karozzi.
messages.zh: 挺好！今天我学会了把车停在两辆车之间。
messages.en: Well! Today I learned to park between two cars.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sewqan 和“上驾驶课、拿驾驶执照”两个生活场景一起记，注意它是表示驾驶活动的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To guide water so that it flows in a particular direction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 引导水沿指定方向流动，使水流向某处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel l-ilma jgħaddi f'direzzjoni partikolari jew lejn post mixtieq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 引导水流；使水沿指定方向流动。

collocations.en: directed the water towards the field
directed the water through the channel

formal.mt: Il-bidwi sewwaq l-ilma lejn l-għalqa permezz ta' kanal żgħir.
formal.en: The farmer directed the water towards the field through a small channel.
formal.zh: 农民通过一条小水渠把水引向田地。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif wasal l-ilma sa hawn? Pawlu: Ġanni sewwaq l-ilma lejn il-ġnien minn ġol-kanal.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did the water get here? Pawlu: Ġanni directed the water towards the garden through the channel.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：水是怎么流到这里的？保罗：詹尼通过水渠把水引向了花园。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 水是怎么流到这里的？
messages.en: How did the water get here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园主)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġanni sewwaq l-ilma lejn il-ġnien minn ġol-kanal.
messages.mt_standard: Ġanni sewwaq l-ilma lejn il-ġnien minn ġol-kanal.
messages.zh: 詹尼通过水渠把水引向了花园。
messages.en: Ġanni directed the water towards the garden through the channel.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个动词放进开渠导水的画面：水本来直流，人让它转向田地，就记住“引导水流”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Exactly or precisely; also used to affirm that something is indeed true.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示时间、位置或内容十分准确，也可用来肯定某事确实如此。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod eżatt jew preċiż; jintuża wkoll biex jikkonferma li xi ħaġa tassew hi hekk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 确切地；准确地；恰好。
的确；确实如此，用于肯定或加强语气。

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa bdiet sewwasew fit-tmienja, kif kien indikat fl-avviż.
formal.en: The meeting began at precisely eight o'clock, as stated in the notice.
formal.zh: 会议按照通知所写的时间，恰好在八点整开始。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Allura l-problema kienet fil-kejbil? Mark: Sewwasew! Bdilna l-kejbil u kollox ħadem.
colloquial.en: Lara: So the problem was in the cable? Mark: Indeed! We changed the cable and everything worked.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：所以问题出在电缆上？马克：的确如此！我们换了电缆，一切就正常了。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 所以问题出在电缆上？
messages.en: So the problem was in the cable?

messages.speaker: Mark (技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwasew! Bdilna l-kejbil u kollox ħadem.
messages.mt_standard: Sewwasew! Bdilna l-kejbil u kollox ħadem.
messages.zh: 的确如此！我们换了电缆，一切就正常了。
messages.en: Indeed! We changed the cable and everything worked.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象钟表指针准确对齐八点，再点头说“确实如此”：一个画面记住“恰好”和“的确”两个用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something black or darker, or to make someone sad.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使物体变黑或颜色变深，也可表示使人感到悲伤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa sewda jew aktar skura, jew iġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħoss id-dwejjaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使变黑；把某物弄黑或染黑。
使变暗；使颜色变深。
使悲伤；使人心情沉重。

formal.mt: Id-duħħan sewwed il-ħajt ta' fuq il-fuklar.
formal.en: The smoke blackened the wall above the stove.
formal.zh: 烟把炉灶上方的墙熏黑了。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex int daqshekk imdejjaq? David: Dak li smajt illum sewwed qalbi.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why are you so upset? David: What I heard today saddened me.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么这么难过？戴维：今天听到的事让我心里很难受。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么这么难过？
messages.en: Why are you so upset?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak li smajt illum sewwed qalbi.
messages.mt_standard: Dak li smajt illum sewwed qalbi.
messages.zh: 今天听到的事让我心里很难受。
messages.en: What I heard today saddened me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个教学画面串联：白墙被熏黑、颜色逐渐变深、心情变得阴沉，分别对应三个义项。

gloss_zh: 修补者；调解人；有纠正作用的

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who mends damaged things or helps people resolve a disagreement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 修补损坏物品的人，也可指帮助他人化解争执、恢复和睦的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ssewwi affarijiet bil-ħsara jew tgħin lin-nies isolvu tilwima u jerġgħu jiftiehmu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 修补者；修理损坏物品的人。
调解人；促成和解、平息争执的人。
有纠正作用的；能够帮助改正问题的。

formal.mt: Is-sewwej tal-arloġġi eżamina l-mekkaniżmu qabel beda x-xogħol.
formal.en: The clock repairer examined the mechanism before starting work.
formal.zh: 钟表修理者在开始工作前检查了机械装置。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Int u Lara għadkom miġġieldin? Toni: Le, Pawlu kien is-sewwej bejnietna u issa qed nitkellmu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you and Lara still arguing? Toni: No, Pawlu was the peacemaker between us, and now we are talking.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你和拉拉还在闹矛盾吗？托尼：没有了，保罗在我们之间做了调解，现在我们已经能说上话了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你和拉拉还在闹矛盾吗？
messages.en: Are you and Lara still arguing?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, Pawlu kien is-sewwej bejnietna u issa qed nitkellmu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, Pawlu kien is-sewwej bejnietna u issa qed nitkellmu.
messages.zh: 没有了，保罗在我们之间做了调解，现在我们已经能说上话了。
messages.en: No, Pawlu was the peacemaker between us, and now we are talking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把修好钟表和修复关系并排记忆：名词指做这件事的人；另把形容词义单独记为“有纠正作用的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become infested with worms; also to provoke someone or instigate an action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指物品生虫，也可表示挑动他人情绪或唆使他人采取行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimtela bid-dud; jista' jfisser ukoll li jipprovoka lil xi ħadd jew iħeġġu biex jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生虫；变得有虫蛀。
挑衅；刺激或挑动某人，引起其反应。
唆使；挑动他人去做某事。

formal.mt: L-injam sewwes, u għalhekk kellu jinbidel qabel seta' jintuża l-għamara.
formal.en: The wood became worm-infested and therefore had to be replaced before the furniture could be used.
formal.zh: 木材生了虫，因此必须先更换，家具才能使用。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex bdew jargumentaw? Mark: Toni sewwes lil sħabu biex jargumentaw mal-ġar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did they start arguing? Mark: Toni instigated his companions to argue with the neighbour.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：他们为什么吵起来了？马克：托尼唆使同伴们去跟邻居争吵。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 他们为什么吵起来了？
messages.en: Why did they start arguing?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Toni sewwes lil sħabu biex jargumentaw mal-ġar.
messages.mt_standard: Toni sewwes lil sħabu biex jargumentaw mal-ġar.
messages.zh: 托尼唆使同伴们去跟邻居争吵。
messages.en: Toni instigated his companions to argue with the neighbour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分两张词义卡记忆：木材卡写“生虫”，人物卡写“挑衅、唆使”；看句中对象来选择义项。

gloss_zh: 使物品变黑的人；染黑者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who makes something black or gives it a black finish.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物品弄黑、染黑或涂成黑色的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel xi ħaġa sewda jew tagħtiha kisja sewda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物变黑的人；染黑者或涂黑者。

collocations.en: the work of the person who blackens things

formal.mt: Is-sewwied tal-injam applika kisja sewda fuq il-wiċċ kollu tal-biċċa.
formal.en: The person blackening the wood applied a black coating over the entire surface of the piece.
formal.zh: 给木材染黑的人在整块材料的表面涂了一层黑色涂层。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min ta dak il-kulur iswed lill-injam? Pawlu: Is-sewwied għamel dak ix-xogħol ilbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who gave the wood that black colour? Pawlu: The person who blackens it did that work yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：是谁把木材弄成那种黑色的？保罗：负责染黑的人昨天做了这项工作。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Min ta dak il-kulur iswed lill-injam?
messages.mt_standard: Min ta dak il-kulur iswed lill-injam?
messages.zh: 是谁把木材弄成那种黑色的？
messages.en: Who gave the wood that black colour?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (工匠)
messages.zh: 负责染黑的人昨天做了这项工作。
messages.en: The person who blackens it did that work yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位手拿黑色涂料的人，把注意力放在“谁在染黑”：这个名词记的是人，而不是动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having an effect that makes something darker in colour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有使某物颜色变深或变暗的作用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu effett li jagħmel il-kulur ta' xi ħaġa aktar skur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有使颜色变暗或变深作用的。

collocations.en: a treatment that darkens the colour

formal.mt: Il-prodott għandu effett sewwiedi fuq l-injam; għalhekk, għandha ssir prova fuq biċċa żgħira qabel l-użu.
formal.en: The product has a darkening effect on wood; therefore, it should be tested on a small piece before use.
formal.zh: 该产品会使木材颜色变深，因此使用前应先在一小块材料上试用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan it-trattament għandu effett sewwiedi? Mark: Iva, jagħmel l-injam aktar skur wara li jinxef.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this treatment have a darkening effect? Mark: Yes, it makes the wood darker after it dries.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这种处理会使颜色变深吗？马克：会，干了以后，木材的颜色会更深。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这种处理会使颜色变深吗？
messages.en: Does this treatment have a darkening effect?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jagħmel l-injam aktar skur wara li jinxef.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jagħmel l-injam aktar skur wara li jinxef.
messages.zh: 会，干了以后，木材的颜色会更深。
messages.en: Yes, it makes the wood darker after it dries.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一块木材处理前后颜色变深，用“有变暗效果的”整块记忆，并提醒自己这是描述作用的形容词。

gloss_zh: 有驱动倾向的；起推动作用的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to drive something forward or prompt action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有驱动、促使前进或促进行动的倾向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jagħti spinta lil xi ħaġa jew iħeġġeġ l-azzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于驱动的；具有推动或促进行动作用的。

collocations.zh: 促进行动的冲动或动力

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jidentifika l-ħtieġa ta' ilma nadif bħala fattur sewwieqi wara l-proġett.
formal.en: The report identifies the need for clean water as a driving factor behind the project.
formal.zh: 报告指出，对清洁用水的需求是推动该项目的一个因素。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed tagħmel dan il-proġett? Toni: Għalija, ix-xewqa li ngħin hija l-fattur sewwieqi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you doing this project? Toni: For me, the desire to help is the driving factor.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么要做这个项目？托尼：对我来说，想帮助别人就是推动我去做的因素。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么要做这个项目？
messages.en: Why are you doing this project?

messages.speaker: Toni (志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għalija, ix-xewqa li ngħin hija l-fattur sewwieqi.
messages.mt_standard: Għalija, ix-xewqa li ngħin hija l-fattur sewwieqi.
messages.zh: 对我来说，想帮助别人就是推动我去做的因素。
messages.en: For me, the desire to help is the driving factor.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一支向前推动项目的箭头，旁边写“推动因素”；把该词作为形容驱动力量的形容词来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who provokes others or encourages them to cause trouble or conflict.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 挑动他人情绪，或怂恿他人制造麻烦、引发冲突的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tipprovoka lil oħrajn jew tħeġġiġhom joħolqu l-inkwiet jew il-ġlied.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 挑衅、挑唆或煽动他人的人。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, ix-xhud iddeskriva lir-raġel bħala sewwies li ħeġġeġ lill-oħrajn jibdew il-ġlied.
formal.en: In the report, the witness described the man as an instigator who encouraged the others to start fighting.
formal.zh: 在报告中，证人将该男子描述为怂恿他人开始打斗的挑唆者。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex qed tħeġġiġhom jiġġieldu? Qed taġixxi ta' sewwies! Pawlu: Għandek raġun. Aħjar ngħinhom jiftiehmu.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why are you encouraging them to fight? You're acting as an instigator! Pawlu: You're right. I'd better help them reach an understanding.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你为什么怂恿他们打架？你这就是在挑唆！保罗：你说得对。我还是帮他们好好沟通吧。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tħeġġiġhom jiġġieldu? Qed taġixxi ta' sewwies!
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tħeġġiġhom jiġġieldu? Qed taġixxi ta' sewwies!
messages.zh: 你为什么怂恿他们打架？你这就是在挑唆！
messages.en: Why are you encouraging them to fight? You're acting as an instigator!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 你说得对。我还是帮他们好好沟通吧。
messages.en: You're right. I'd better help them reach an understanding.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sewwies 配上一个在人群旁煽风点火的人物画面，记住它指挑唆的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Susceptible to attack by woodworm, especially when describing wood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易受到蛀木虫侵害的，尤其用于描述木材。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jintlaqat faċilment mis-susa, speċjalment meta jingħad għall-injam.

sense_translations.en_definition: liable to be attacked by woodworm
sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易遭到蛀木虫侵害的。

collocations.zh: 容易遭蛀木虫侵害的材料

formal.mt: Ir-rapport dwar l-għamara jindika li dan l-injam huwa sewwiesi u jirrakkomanda trattament protettiv.
formal.en: The furniture report indicates that this wood is susceptible to woodworm and recommends protective treatment.
formal.zh: 家具报告指出，这种木材容易遭蛀木虫侵害，并建议进行防护处理。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan l-injam sewwiesi? Toni: Iva, jista' jintlaqat mis-susa. Nagħżlu injam ieħor għal din l-ixkaffa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this wood susceptible to woodworm? Toni: Yes, it can be attacked by woodworm. Let's choose different wood for this shelf.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这种木材容易遭虫蛀吗？托尼：是的，可能会遭蛀木虫侵害。这个架子我们换一种木材吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 这种木材容易遭虫蛀吗？
messages.en: Is this wood susceptible to woodworm?

messages.speaker: Toni (木匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jista' jintlaqat mis-susa. Nagħżlu injam ieħor għal din l-ixkaffa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jista' jintlaqat mis-susa. Nagħżlu injam ieħor għal din l-ixkaffa.
messages.zh: 是的，可能会遭蛀木虫侵害。这个架子我们换一种木材吧。
messages.en: Yes, it can be attacked by woodworm. Let's choose different wood for this shelf.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一块可能被蛀出小孔的木板，用 injam sewwiesi 整组记住；这里表示易受虫害，并不表示已经虫蛀。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A family name used to identify a person or members of a family.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 姓氏，用于标识某个人或某个家族的成员，书写时首字母大写为 Seychell。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom li jidentifika persuna jew membri ta' familja u jinkiteb b'ittra kapitali fil-bidu: Seychell.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姓氏：Seychell。

formal.mt: Is-Sur Seychell ikkonferma bil-miktub li se jattendi l-laqgħa.
formal.en: Mr Seychell confirmed in writing that he would attend the meeting.
formal.zh: Seychell 先生已书面确认将出席会议。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Il-prenotazzjoni fuq liema kunjom? David: Fuq Seychell. Jien David Seychell.
colloquial.en: Anna: What surname is the reservation under? David: Seychell. I'm David Seychell.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：预订登记的姓氏是什么？戴维：Seychell。我叫 David Seychell。

messages.speaker: Anna (接待员)
messages.zh: 预订登记的姓氏是什么？
messages.en: What surname is the reservation under?

messages.speaker: David (顾客)
messages.zh: Seychell。我叫 David Seychell。
messages.en: Seychell. I'm David Seychell.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Seychell 放进酒店登记表的姓氏一栏记忆，注意实际姓名中首字母 S 要大写。

gloss_zh: 合作伙伴关系；成员身份

teaching_sense.en_definition: A partnership between people or organizations, or the status of belonging to a group as a member.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 个人或组织之间的合作关系，或作为成员隶属于某个团体的身份。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Relazzjoni ta' ħidma flimkien bejn persuni jew għaqdiet, jew l-istat li tkun membru ta' grupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 合作伙伴关系；团体的成员身份或会员资格。

collocations.zh: 两个组织之间的合作关系

formal.mt: Is-seħba bejn iż-żewġ skejjel tippermetti lill-istudenti jaħdmu flimkien fuq proġetti komuni.
formal.en: The partnership between the two schools enables students to work together on shared projects.
formal.zh: 两所学校之间的合作关系使学生能够共同开展项目。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Ġeddidt is-seħba tiegħek fil-klabb? Mark: Iva, issa nista' nieħu sehem fl-attivitajiet kollha ta' din is-sena.
colloquial.en: Anna: Did you renew your club membership? Mark: Yes, now I can take part in all of this year's activities.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你续办俱乐部会员资格了吗？马克：续了，现在我可以参加今年的所有活动了。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你续办俱乐部会员资格了吗？
messages.en: Did you renew your club membership?

messages.speaker: Mark (俱乐部会员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa nista' nieħu sehem fl-attivitajiet kollha ta' din is-sena.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa nista' nieħu sehem fl-attivitajiet kollha ta' din is-sena.
messages.zh: 续了，现在我可以参加今年的所有活动了。
messages.en: Yes, now I can take part in all of this year's activities.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两种连接：组织之间握手合作，个人拿着会员卡加入团体，分别对应两个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of joining with others as partners or associating with them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与他人结成伙伴、共同参与活动，或与他人交往联系的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li tingħaqad ma' oħrajn bħala sieħeb jew li jkollok kuntatt u relazzjonijiet magħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 结成伙伴或建立合作关系的行为。
与他人交往、联系或共同参与活动的行为。

collocations.zh: 与其他团体的交往联系
