formal.mt: Is-seħib bejn iż-żewġ gruppi għen biex il-proġett jitlesta fil-ħin.
formal.en: Partnering between the two groups helped the project to be completed on time.
formal.zh: 两个团体之间的合作帮助项目按时完成。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għenkom l-aktar fil-proġett? Mark: Is-seħib mal-grupp l-ieħor; qsamna x-xogħol bejnietna.
colloquial.en: Maja: What helped you most with the project? Mark: Partnering with the other group; we divided the work among ourselves.
colloquial.zh: Maja：做项目时，什么对你们帮助最大？Mark：与另一个小组合作；我们把工作分着做。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 做项目时，什么对你们帮助最大？
messages.en: What helped you most with the project?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-seħib mal-grupp l-ieħor; qsamna x-xogħol bejnietna.
messages.mt_standard: Is-seħib mal-grupp l-ieħor; qsamna x-xogħol bejnietna.
messages.zh: 与另一个小组合作；我们把工作分着做。
messages.en: Partnering with the other group; we divided the work among ourselves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两组人围坐一起分工：一起做事记“结伴合作”，保持往来记“交往联系”，两义都着眼于活动过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The realization or accomplishment of something planned, or its coming into effect.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 计划之事得到实现或完成，或某项安排开始生效。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-twettiq ta' xi ħaġa ppjanata, jew il-bidu tal-validità ta' ftehim jew miżura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 实现；计划、努力等终于取得预期成果。
完成；达成某项任务或目标。
生效；开始具有实际效力。

collocations.en: the coming into effect of the agreement

formal.mt: Is-seħħa tal-pjan tiddependi fuq il-ħidma koordinata tal-parteċipanti kollha.
formal.en: The realization of the plan depends on the coordinated work of all participants.
formal.zh: 计划的实现有赖于所有参与者协调开展工作。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'hemm bżonn għas-seħħa tal-pjan tagħna? David: Irridu naqsmu x-xogħol u nibdew din il-ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is needed to bring our plan to fruition? David: We need to divide up the work and start this week.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：要实现我们的计划，需要做些什么？戴维：我们得分好工，这周就开始。

messages.speaker: Sara (项目伙伴)
messages.zh: 要实现我们的计划，需要做些什么？
messages.en: What is needed to bring our plan to fruition?

messages.speaker: David (项目伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Irridu naqsmu x-xogħol u nibdew din il-ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Irridu naqsmu x-xogħol u nibdew din il-ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 我们得分好工，这周就开始。
messages.en: We need to divide up the work and start this week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用从纸面走进现实的画面串联三义：愿望实现、任务完成、协议生效。

gloss_zh: 诅咒；希望某人遭遇厄运

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wish bad luck or misfortune on someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 希望某人倒霉或遭受不幸，表达对他人的恶意。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tixtieq xorti ħażina jew sfortuna lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诅咒某人；希望某人遭遇厄运。

collocations.en: wished misfortune on whoever had deceived him

formal.mt: Fil-ġrajja, ir-raġel seħħet lil min kien qarraq bih, iżda dan ma naqqaslux ir-rabja.
formal.en: In the story, the man wished misfortune on the person who had deceived him, but this did not lessen his anger.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个男人诅咒了欺骗他的人，但这并没有减轻他的怒气。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-karattru seħħet lil sieħbu? Mark: Għax kien irrabjat miegħu u xtaqlu xorti ħażina.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the character wish misfortune on his companion? Mark: Because he was angry with him and wished him bad luck.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个角色为什么诅咒他的同伴？Mark：因为他生同伴的气，希望同伴倒霉。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这个角色为什么诅咒他的同伴？
messages.en: Why did the character wish misfortune on his companion?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kien irrabjat miegħu u xtaqlu xorti ħażina.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kien irrabjat miegħu u xtaqlu xorti ħażina.
messages.zh: 因为他生同伴的气，希望同伴倒霉。
messages.en: Because he was angry with him and wished him bad luck.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把本词条与“希望别人倒霉”的故事画面绑定记忆，再用搭配 lil min qarraq bih 记住恶意指向的对象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small whistle; the diminutive form of suffara.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小哨子，是 suffara 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Suffara żgħira; il-forma diminuttiva ta' suffara.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small whistle (the diminutive form of 'suffara')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小哨子，suffara 的指小形式。

formal.mt: Fil-bidu tal-logħba, l-għalliem daqq l-isfajfra biex jiġbed l-attenzjoni tat-tfal.
formal.en: At the start of the game, the teacher blew the small whistle to get the children's attention.
formal.zh: 游戏开始时，老师吹响小哨子，以引起孩子们的注意。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn hi l-isfajfra tiegħi? Omm: Fil-but tal-basket. Jekk jogħġbok, iddoqqhiex ġewwa.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where's my little whistle? Mum: In the bag's pocket. Please don't blow it indoors.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我的小哨子在哪儿？妈妈：在包的口袋里。请别在屋里吹。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.zh: 我的小哨子在哪儿？
messages.en: Where's my little whistle?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-but tal-basket. Jekk jogħġbok, iddoqqhiex ġewwa.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-but tal-basket. Jekk jogħġbok, iddoqqhiex ġewwa.
messages.zh: 在包的口袋里。请别在屋里吹。
messages.en: In the bag's pocket. Please don't blow it indoors.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 suffara 和 sfajfra 画成一大一小两只哨子，用大小对照记住 sfajfra 是小哨子。

gloss_zh: 面色蜡黄的；脸色发黄的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a yellowish, unhealthy-looking complexion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人的面色发黄、显得不健康的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu lewn safrani fil-wiċċ u jidher mhux f'saħħtu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 面色蜡黄、呈现不健康的黄色的。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-karattru jidħol fil-kamra b'wiċċ sfajjar u b'pass kajman.
formal.en: In the novel, the character enters the room with a sallow face and a slow step.
formal.zh: 在小说中，这个人物面色蜡黄，步履缓慢地走进房间。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Illum tidher sfajjar. Kif qed tħossok? Mark: Għajjien ħafna. Ilbieraħ ma rqadtx sew.
colloquial.en: Sara: You look sallow today. How are you feeling? Mark: Very tired. I didn't sleep well last night.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你今天脸色有点蜡黄。感觉怎么样？马克：很累。我昨晚没睡好。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum tidher sfajjar. Kif qed tħossok?
messages.mt_standard: Illum tidher sfajjar. Kif qed tħossok?
messages.zh: 你今天脸色有点蜡黄。感觉怎么样？
messages.en: You look sallow today. How are you feeling?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għajjien ħafna. Ilbieraħ ma rqadtx sew.
messages.mt_standard: Għajjien ħafna. Ilbieraħ ma rqadtx sew.
messages.zh: 很累。我昨晚没睡好。
messages.en: Very tired. I didn't sleep well last night.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 sfajjar 就想象一张面色蜡黄的脸，把它与描述脸色的 wiċċ 搭配记忆。

gloss_zh: 变黄；面色变蜡黄；脸色变苍白

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become yellow, or, when referring to a person's complexion, to become sallow or pale.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变成黄色；用于人的面色时，也可表示变得蜡黄或苍白。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir isfar; meta jingħad għall-wiċċ ta' persuna, jieħu lewn safrani jew isir pallidu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变黄，呈现黄色。
面色变得蜡黄，显出不健康的黄色。
脸色变得苍白，失去血色。

collocations.en: his face became sallow or pale
collocations.zh: 他的脸色变得蜡黄或苍白

formal.mt: Matul is-snin, il-karta tal-ittra sfaret, iżda l-kitba baqgħet ċara.
formal.en: Over the years, the paper of the letter turned yellow, but the writing remained clear.
formal.zh: 这些年来，信纸变黄了，但字迹依然清晰。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Malli smajt il-ħoss, wiċċek sfar! Pawlu: Iva, bżajt. Ħsibt li kien waqa' xi ħadd.
colloquial.en: Lara: Your face went pale as soon as you heard the noise! Pawlu: Yes, I got scared. I thought someone had fallen.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你一听见那声音，脸色就变白了！保罗：是啊，我吓了一跳。我以为有人摔倒了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你一听见那声音，脸色就变白了！
messages.en: Your face went pale as soon as you heard the noise!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, bżajt. Ħsibt li kien waqa' xi ħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, bżajt. Ħsibt li kien waqa' xi ħadd.
messages.zh: 是啊，我吓了一跳。我以为有人摔倒了。
messages.en: Yes, I got scared. I thought someone had fallen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅变化图记 sfar：白纸逐渐变黄，人的脸色突然变白；遇到面色情境，再判断是蜡黄还是苍白。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lose organisation or coordination and become disorganised.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 失去原有的组织或协调，变得混乱无序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitlef l-organizzazzjoni jew il-koordinazzjoni u jsir diżorganizzat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得组织涣散、混乱无序。

formal.mt: Meta ma baqax hemm koordinatur, ix-xogħol sfaxxa u l-kompiti ma baqgħux jitqassmu b'mod ċar.
formal.en: When there was no longer a coordinator, the work became disorganised and tasks were no longer assigned clearly.
formal.zh: 失去协调员后，工作陷入混乱，任务分配也不再清晰。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex ħadd ma jaf x'għandu jagħmel? Toni: Il-grupp sfaxxa meta telaq Mark. Ejja nqassmu l-kompiti mill-ġdid.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why does nobody know what to do? Toni: The group became disorganised when Mark left. Let's assign the tasks again.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：怎么谁都不知道该做什么？托尼：马克走后，小组就乱了。我们重新分配任务吧。

messages.speaker: Marija (小组成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ħadd ma jaf x'għandu jagħmel?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ħadd ma jaf x'għandu jagħmel?
messages.zh: 怎么谁都不知道该做什么？
messages.en: Why does nobody know what to do?

messages.speaker: Toni (小组成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-grupp sfaxxa meta telaq Mark. Ejja nqassmu l-kompiti mill-ġdid.
messages.mt_standard: Il-grupp sfaxxa meta telaq Mark. Ejja nqassmu l-kompiti mill-ġdid.
messages.zh: 马克走后，小组就乱了。我们重新分配任务吧。
messages.en: The group became disorganised when Mark left. Let's assign the tasks again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小组的任务卡原本排得整齐，后来散成一团，用这个变化画面记住 sfaxxa 表示变得混乱。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process or result of dismantling, collapse, ruin, or break-up.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拆解、崩塌、毁坏或解体的过程或结果，具体含义由上下文决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess jew ir-riżultat ta' żarmar, kollass, rovina jew tifrik.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拆解、崩塌、毁坏或解体的过程或结果。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif in-nuqqas ta' kooperazzjoni wassal għas-sfaxxament tal-organizzazzjoni.
formal.en: The report describes how the lack of cooperation led to the break-up of the organisation.
formal.zh: 报告描述了缺乏合作如何导致该组织解体。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'wassal għas-sfaxxament tal-grupp? Mark: Ma bqajniex naħdmu flimkien, u kull wieħed mar għal rasu.
colloquial.en: Lara: What led to the break-up of the group? Mark: We stopped working together, and everyone went their own way.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：是什么导致小组解体的？马克：我们不再一起合作，后来大家就各走各的路了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 是什么导致小组解体的？
messages.en: What led to the break-up of the group?

messages.speaker: Mark (原小组成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma bqajniex naħdmu flimkien, u kull wieħed mar għal rasu.
messages.mt_standard: Ma bqajniex naħdmu flimkien, u kull wieħed mar għal rasu.
messages.zh: 我们不再一起合作，后来大家就各走各的路了。
messages.en: We stopped working together, and everyone went their own way.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sfaxxament 放在事件名称的位置记忆：结构会崩塌，组织会解体；它指这种过程或结果，译法要看对象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the shape of a sphere, or relating to a spherical surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形状像球体的，或与球面有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu forma ta' sfera jew li għandu x'jaqsam ma' wiċċ ta' sfera.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 球形的；球面的。

formal.mt: Il-mudell għandu forma sferikali u wiċċ lixx.
formal.en: The model has a spherical shape and a smooth surface.
formal.zh: 这个模型呈球形，表面光滑。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Liema waħda hi l-lampa sferikali? Pawlu: Dik li għandha forma ta' ballun, ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Which one is the spherical lamp? Pawlu: The one shaped like a ball, next to the window.
colloquial.zh: Lara：哪一盏是球形灯？Pawlu：窗边那盏像圆球的。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 哪一盏是球形灯？
messages.en: Which one is the spherical lamp?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik li għandha forma ta' ballun, ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.mt_standard: Dik li għandha forma ta' ballun, ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.zh: 窗边那盏像圆球的。
messages.en: The one shaped like a ball, next to the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到圆球就练习描述“球形的”：这个词是形容词，用来说明物体的形状。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A court, room, or designated area used for playing ball games.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供进行球类游戏使用的场地或房间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post, sala jew qorti maħsuba għal-logħob tal-ballun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 球戏场或球戏室，即供进行球类游戏的专用场所。

collocations.en: the plan of the ball-game court
the entrance to the ball-game court

formal.mt: Il-pjanta turi sferisterju b'daħla fuq in-naħa tal-punent.
formal.en: The plan shows a ball-game court with an entrance on the western side.
formal.zh: 平面图显示了一处球戏场，其入口位于西侧。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser sferisterju fuq din il-pjanta? David: Huwa post maħsub għal-logħob tal-ballun.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does sferisterju mean on this plan? David: It is a place intended for playing ball games.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这张平面图上的 sferisterju 是什么意思？David：指供人进行球类游戏的场所。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser sferisterju fuq din il-pjanta?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser sferisterju fuq din il-pjanta?
messages.zh: 这张平面图上的 sferisterju 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does sferisterju mean on this plan?

messages.speaker: David (老师)
messages.zh: 指供人进行球类游戏的场所。
messages.en: It is a place intended for playing ball games.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把平面图上一块写着“打球专用”的区域当作记忆画面：记场所，不记球体。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The degree to which an object's shape resembles a perfect sphere.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体的形状接近理想球体的程度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-grad li fih il-forma ta' oġġett tkun tixbah sfera perfetta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 球形度；物体接近理想球形的程度。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport iqabbel is-sferiċità tal-partiċelli fi tliet kampjuni differenti.
formal.en: The report compares the sphericity of the particles in three different samples.
formal.zh: 报告比较了三个不同样本中颗粒的球形度。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tfisser sferiċità għolja? Mark: Tfisser li l-oġġett ikun kważi bħal ballun perfett.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does high sphericity mean? Mark: It means the object is almost like a perfectly round ball.
colloquial.zh: Maja：球形度高是什么意思？Mark：就是物体的形状几乎像一个完美的圆球。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 球形度高是什么意思？
messages.en: What does high sphericity mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li l-oġġett ikun kważi bħal ballun perfett.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li l-oġġett ikun kważi bħal ballun perfett.
messages.zh: 就是物体的形状几乎像一个完美的圆球。
messages.en: It means the object is almost like a perfectly round ball.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给石子打一个“像球程度”的分数：越接近圆球，球形度就越高。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a rounded shape like a sphere that is slightly flattened or elongated along one axis.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 呈椭球状的，即类似球体，但沿一个轴略微压扁或拉长的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu forma simili għal sfera, iżda kemxejn iċċattjata jew imtawla tul assi wieħed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 椭球状的；形似略被压扁或拉长的球体的。

formal.mt: Il-mudell sferojdali huwa kemxejn iċċattjat fil-parti ta' fuq u fil-parti ta' isfel.
formal.en: The spheroidal model is slightly flattened at the top and bottom.
formal.zh: 这个椭球状模型的顶部和底部略微扁平。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex issejjaħlu sferojdali? Mark: Għax jixbah ballun, iżda huwa kemxejn iċċattjat.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why do you call it spheroidal? Mark: Because it looks like a ball, but it is slightly flattened.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你为什么说它是椭球状的？Mark：因为它像个圆球，但稍微有点扁。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 你为什么说它是椭球状的？
messages.en: Why do you call it spheroidal?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jixbah ballun, iżda huwa kemxejn iċċattjat.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jixbah ballun, iżda huwa kemxejn iċċattjat.
messages.zh: 因为它像个圆球，但稍微有点扁。
messages.en: Because it looks like a ball, but it is slightly flattened.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把软球轻轻压扁，再用形容词描述它“呈椭球状”，便能记住这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A rounded solid formed by rotating an ellipse about one of its principal axes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 椭圆绕其一条主轴旋转形成的立体，可呈扁球状或长球状。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Solidu li jinkiseb meta ellissi ddur madwar wieħed mill-assi prinċipali tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 旋转椭球体；由椭圆绕一条主轴旋转形成的椭球体。

formal.mt: Meta ellissi ddur madwar l-assi l-qasir tagħha, tifforma sferojdi ċċattjat.
formal.en: When an ellipse rotates about its shorter axis, it forms an oblate spheroid.
formal.zh: 椭圆绕其短轴旋转时，会形成扁球体。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan sferojdi jew sfera? Pawlu: Sferojdi, għax huwa usa' fin-nofs u ċċattjat fuq u taħt.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this a spheroid or a sphere? Pawlu: A spheroid, because it is wider in the middle and flattened at the top and bottom.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这是椭球体还是球体？Pawlu：是椭球体，因为它中间较宽，上下较扁。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这是椭球体还是球体？
messages.en: Is this a spheroid or a sphere?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Sferojdi, għax huwa usa' fin-nofs u ċċattjat fuq u taħt.
messages.mt_standard: Sferojdi, għax huwa usa' fin-nofs u ċċattjat fuq u taħt.
messages.zh: 是椭球体，因为它中间较宽，上下较扁。
messages.en: A spheroid, because it is wider in the middle and flattened at the top and bottom.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中让一个椭圆绕轴转一圈，形成的立体就是这里要记的“旋转椭球体”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become free from something that holds or restrains someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从捆绑、固定或其他束缚中挣脱出来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinħeles minn xi ħaġa li tkun qed iżżommu marbut jew miżmum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 挣脱；摆脱捆绑、固定或束缚。

formal.mt: Iż-żiemel sferra mill-irbit u ħareġ mill-istalla.
formal.en: The horse broke loose from its tether and left the stable.
formal.zh: 马挣脱了拴系，跑出了马厩。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn mar iż-żiemel? David: Sferra u ħarab lejn l-għalqa.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where did the horse go? David: It broke loose and ran off towards the field.
colloquial.zh: Mark：马到哪里去了？David：它挣脱后朝田地跑去了。

messages.speaker: Mark (农场主)
messages.zh: 马到哪里去了？
messages.en: Where did the horse go?

messages.speaker: David (农场工人)
messages.zh: 它挣脱后朝田地跑去了。
messages.en: It broke loose and ran off towards the field.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一匹马挣开绳子跑出去，把“原先被拴住，随后挣脱”的动作连起来记。

gloss_zh: 精疲力竭的；虚弱无力的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Very tired and lacking physical or mental energy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 十分疲惫，体力或精神明显不足的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għajjien ħafna u bla saħħa jew enerġija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 衰弱无力的；精力耗尽的；疲惫不堪的。

formal.mt: Wara sigħat twal ta' xogħol fiżiku, il-ħaddiem kien sfibrat u kellu bżonn jistrieħ.
formal.en: After long hours of physical work, the worker was exhausted and needed to rest.
formal.zh: 经过长时间的体力劳动，这名工人已经精疲力竭，需要休息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid toħroġ magħna llejla? Mark: Illum le, jien sfibrat wara x-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want to go out with us tonight? Mark: Not today, I'm exhausted after work.
colloquial.zh: Maja：今晚想和我们一起出去吗？Mark：今天不去了，我下班后累得一点力气都没有。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 今晚想和我们一起出去吗？
messages.en: Do you want to go out with us tonight?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum le, jien sfibrat wara x-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Illum le, jien sfibrat wara x-xogħol.
messages.zh: 今天不去了，我下班后累得一点力气都没有。
messages.en: Not today, I'm exhausted after work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象下班后像电量耗尽的手机，连出门的力气都没有，用这个画面记“精疲力竭”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who challenges an opponent, especially in a contest or competition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向对手发起挑战的人，尤其指比赛或竞赛中的挑战者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tisfida lil avversarju, speċjalment f'logħba jew kompetizzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 挑战者；向对手或现任冠军发起挑战的人。
具有挑战性的；带有挑战意味的。

formal.mt: L-isfidant għat-titlu wera atteġġjament sfidant waqt il-konferenza tal-aħbarijiet.
formal.en: The challenger for the title displayed a challenging attitude during the press conference.
formal.zh: 这位冠军头衔的挑战者在新闻发布会上表现出带有挑战意味的态度。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hu l-isfidant il-ġdid? Pawlu: Dak il-plejer ħdejn il-kowċ; illum se jilgħab kontra ċ-ċampjin.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is the new challenger? Pawlu: That player next to the coach; today he will play against the champion.
colloquial.zh: Lara：谁是新来的挑战者？Pawlu：教练旁边的那位选手；今天他要和冠军交手。

messages.speaker: Lara (观众)
messages.zh: 谁是新来的挑战者？
messages.en: Who is the new challenger?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (观众)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-plejer ħdejn il-kowċ; illum se jilgħab kontra ċ-ċampjin.
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-plejer ħdejn il-kowċ; illum se jilgħab kontra ċ-ċampjin.
messages.zh: 教练旁边的那位选手；今天他要和冠军交手。
messages.en: That player next to the coach; today he will play against the champion.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象擂台上挑战冠军的人：指人时记“挑战者”，描述态度时记“带有挑战意味的”。

gloss_zh: 陷入某种状态；落到某种境地

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process or result of being brought into, or ending up in, a particular condition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被置于某种状况，或最终落到某种境地的过程或结果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess jew ir-riżultat li xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa jitqiegħed jew jispiċċa f'kundizzjoni partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被置于某种状况；沦落到某种境地。
最终进入某种状态；落得某种处境。

collocations.en: ending up in a bad condition
ending up in a state of neglect
collocations.zh: 最终陷入无人照管的状态

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi s-sfigħ tal-bini f'kundizzjoni ħażina wara snin ta' abbandun.
formal.en: The report describes how the building ended up in poor condition after years of neglect.
formal.zh: 报告描述了这栋建筑在多年无人照管后陷入破败状态的过程。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tifhem b''sfigħ' hawn? Mark: Li l-post spiċċa f'dan l-istat għax ħadd ma ħa ħsiebu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What do you mean by 'sfigħ' here? Mark: That the place ended up in this state because nobody looked after it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的 sfigħ 是什么意思？马克：就是说，这地方因为没人照管，最后落到了这种境地。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 sfigħ 是什么意思？
messages.en: What do you mean by 'sfigħ' here?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Li l-post spiċċa f'dan l-istat għax ħadd ma ħa ħsiebu.
messages.mt_standard: Li l-post spiċċa f'dan l-istat għax ħadd ma ħa ħsiebu.
messages.zh: 就是说，这地方因为没人照管，最后落到了这种境地。
messages.en: That the place ended up in this state because nobody looked after it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一栋房屋从完好到失修的前后对照图，用“最后落到这种状态”记住 sfigħ；重点是状态的形成或结局。

gloss_zh: 抽出线；解下串物；列队经过

teaching_sense.en_definition: To remove a thread or string from something, or to pass by in an organized procession or parade.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从物件中抽出线、解除串连，或以有组织的队列行进经过。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Neħħa ħajta jew spaga minn xi ħaġa, jew għadda f'purċissjoni jew f'parata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抽出穿好的线；解开串线或把串上的物件取下。
列队行进经过；参加游行或列队展示。

collocations.en: removed the thread from the needle

formal.mt: Il-grupp sfila minn quddiem il-mistednin waqt iċ-ċerimonja.
formal.en: The group paraded past the guests during the ceremony.
formal.zh: 仪式期间，这支队伍列队从来宾面前经过。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel Mark bil-labra? Rita: Sfila l-ħajt minnha biex ibiddel il-kulur.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did Mark do with the needle? Rita: He removed the thread from it to change the colour.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克对那根针做了什么？丽塔：他把线抽出来了，准备换一种颜色。

messages.speaker: Maja (缝纫学徒)
messages.zh: 马克对那根针做了什么？
messages.en: What did Mark do with the needle?

messages.speaker: Rita (缝纫老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Sfila l-ħajt minnha biex ibiddel il-kulur.
messages.mt_standard: Sfila l-ħajt minnha biex ibiddel il-kulur.
messages.zh: 他把线抽出来了，准备换一种颜色。
messages.en: He removed the thread from it to change the colour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个独立画面记 sfila：一幅是从针眼抽线，一幅是队伍经过看台；这是义项联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organized march past spectators or an official viewing point.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 队伍有组织地从观众或检阅地点前行进通过的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mixja organizzata li fiha grupp jgħaddi minn quddiem l-ispettaturi jew post uffiċjali tal-wiri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 队伍列队通过；供观众观看或接受检阅的分列式。

collocations.en: a march-past along the main street
collocations.zh: 沿主街进行的列队行进

formal.mt: Iċ-ċerimonja ntemmet bi sfilata militari minn quddiem il-mistednin.
formal.en: The ceremony ended with a military march-past in front of the guests.
formal.zh: 仪式以军队从来宾面前列队通过的分列式结束。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Meta tibda s-sfilata? Maja: Fl-għaxra; ejja noqogħdu ħdejn il-pjazza biex narawha.
colloquial.en: Mark: When does the march-past start? Maja: At ten; let's stand near the square so we can watch it.
colloquial.zh: 马克：列队行进什么时候开始？玛雅：十点；我们站到广场旁边去看吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 列队行进什么时候开始？
messages.en: When does the march-past start?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-għaxra; ejja noqogħdu ħdejn il-pjazza biex narawha.
messages.mt_standard: Fl-għaxra; ejja noqogħdu ħdejn il-pjazza biex narawha.
messages.zh: 十点；我们站到广场旁边去看吧。
messages.en: At ten; let's stand near the square so we can watch it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象节目单上写着 sfilata，随后整支队伍从眼前走过；把它记成一次“列队通过”活动的名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being dense or thick, with material or parts closely packed together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 材料或各部分排列紧密所呈现的稠密、密实或厚实性质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' xi ħaġa densa jew ħoxna, b'materjal jew partijiet qrib ħafna ta' xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 稠密、密集的性质；各部分之间空隙很小。
厚实、浓厚的性质；具有较厚或较密的质地。

collocations.en: the thickness or density of the fabric
collocations.zh: 布料的厚实或密实程度

formal.mt: Is-sfiq tal-veġetazzjoni għamel il-mogħdija diffiċli biex tgħaddi minnha.
formal.en: The density of the vegetation made the path difficult to pass through.
formal.zh: 植被的稠密使这条小径难以通行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għażilt dan id-drapp għall-purtieri? Rita: Minħabba s-sfiq tiegħu; jgħaddi inqas dawl minnu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you choose this fabric for the curtains? Rita: Because of its thickness; less light passes through it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么选这种布做窗帘？丽塔：因为它厚实，透过的光比较少。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 你为什么选这种布做窗帘？
messages.en: Why did you choose this fabric for the curtains?

messages.speaker: Rita (裁缝)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba s-sfiq tiegħu; jgħaddi inqas dawl minnu.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba s-sfiq tiegħu; jgħaddi inqas dawl minnu.
messages.zh: 因为它厚实，透过的光比较少。
messages.en: Because of its thickness; less light passes through it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用密林和厚窗帘两个画面记 sfiq：树木挤得密，布料织得实；分别对应稠密与厚实两个理解方向。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Thread used as the warp or weft in weaving cloth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 织布时沿纵向或横向排列、构成经线或纬线的纱线。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħajt li jgħaddi fit-tul jew fil-wisa' tad-drapp waqt l-insiġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 织物的经线或纬线。

formal.mt: Għall-insiġ ta' dan id-drapp intuża sfiħ tal-qoton.
formal.en: Cotton thread was used for the warp or weft in weaving this cloth.
formal.zh: 织造这块布时，经线或纬线采用了棉纱。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tip ta' sfiħ intuża għal dan id-drapp? Pawlu: Tal-qoton; ara kif il-ħjut jaqsmu lil xulxin.
colloquial.en: Maja: What kind of warp or weft was used for this cloth? Pawlu: Cotton; look at how the threads cross one another.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这块布用的是什么经纬纱？保罗：棉纱；你看这些线怎样相互交织。

messages.speaker: Maja (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: X'tip ta' sfiħ intuża għal dan id-drapp?
messages.mt_standard: X'tip ta' sfiħ intuża għal dan id-drapp?
messages.zh: 这块布用的是什么经纬纱？
messages.en: What kind of warp or weft was used for this cloth?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (织工)
messages.mt_spoken: Tal-qoton; ara kif il-ħjut jaqsmu lil xulxin.
messages.mt_standard: Tal-qoton; ara kif il-ħjut jaqsmu lil xulxin.
messages.zh: 棉纱；你看这些线怎样相互交织。
messages.en: Cotton; look at how the threads cross one another.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sfiħ 写在一张经纬交织的布料示意图旁，纵线横线一起记；注意词尾 ħ，与 sfigħ 的 għ 区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An outlet or way out through which something can escape or feelings can be expressed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物得以排出、脱离，或使情绪得以表达和宣泄的出口或途径。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħruġ jew mezz li minnu xi ħaġa tista' toħroġ, jew li bih wieħed jista' jesprimi dak li jħoss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出口；出路；可供释放压力或表达情绪的渠道。

formal.mt: Il-kitba toffri sfog għall-emozzjonijiet li kultant ikun diffiċli tesprimi bil-kliem waqt konversazzjoni.
formal.en: Writing offers an outlet for emotions that can sometimes be difficult to express in conversation.
formal.zh: 写作为那些有时难以在交谈中表达的情绪提供了宣泄渠道。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex tpinġi wara x-xogħol? Maja: Għax il-pittura tagħtini sfog wara ġurnata diffiċli.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why do you paint after work? Maja: Because painting gives me an outlet after a difficult day.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你为什么下班后画画？玛雅：因为辛苦一天后，画画能给我一个宣泄的出口。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么下班后画画？
messages.en: Why do you paint after work?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-pittura tagħtini sfog wara ġurnata diffiċli.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-pittura tagħtini sfog wara ġurnata diffiċli.
messages.zh: 因为辛苦一天后，画画能给我一个宣泄的出口。
messages.en: Because painting gives me an outlet after a difficult day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sfog 想成压力容器上的出口，再把出口换成画笔或日记，就能从实际出口联想到情绪的宣泄渠道。

gloss_zh: 表现出来；宣泄；得到宽慰；自行消退

teaching_sense.en_definition: To express or release something such as emotion, to find relief, or to die out after running its course.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把情绪等表现或释放出来，获得宽慰或缓解，或在发展一段时间后自行消退。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wera jew ħareġ dak li kien iħoss, sab serħan, jew naqas u spiċċa wara li għadda ż-żmien tiegħu.

sense_translations.en_definition: to manifest, to unleash, to vent, to manifest
sense_translations.zh_definition: 显现；表现出来；释放或宣泄情绪、力量等。

sense_translations.en_definition: to find solace, to find relief
sense_translations.zh_definition: 获得慰藉；得到宽慰或缓解。

sense_translations.en_definition: to die out, to run its course
sense_translations.zh_definition: 逐渐消退或平息；经历自身的发展过程后结束。

collocations.en: found relief by opening up to a friend
collocations.zh: 向朋友倾诉后得到宽慰

formal.mt: Wara l-laqgħa, ir-raġel sfoga r-rabja tiegħu bil-kitba u mbagħad seta' jiddiskuti l-kwistjoni bil-kalma.
formal.en: After the meeting, the man vented his anger through writing and was then able to discuss the issue calmly.
formal.zh: 会议结束后，这名男子通过写作宣泄了怒气，随后便能够平静地讨论这个问题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark għadu rrabjat? Pawlu: Le, sfoga miegħi u issa qed iħossu aħjar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is Mark still angry? Pawlu: No, he opened up to me and now he feels better.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克还在生气吗？保罗：没有了，他向我倾诉了一番，现在感觉好多了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克还在生气吗？
messages.en: Is Mark still angry?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, sfoga miegħi u issa qed iħossu aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Le, sfoga miegħi u issa qed iħossu aħjar.
messages.zh: 没有了，他向我倾诉了一番，现在感觉好多了。
messages.en: No, he opened up to me and now he feels better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三格图记 sfoga：先把怒气表达出来，再因倾诉得到宽慰，最后另画一场逐渐平息的风暴，分别对应三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make an image or part of an image lose sharp focus and appear blurred.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使图像或其中一部分失去清晰焦点，呈现模糊效果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel immaġni jew parti minnha mċajpra billi neħħielha l-fokus ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使失去焦点；使影像失焦、变得模糊。

collocations.en: put the image out of focus

formal.mt: Il-fotografu sfoka l-isfond biex il-wiċċ tal-persuna jidher aktar ċar.
formal.en: The photographer blurred the background so that the person's face would stand out more clearly.
formal.zh: 摄影师将背景虚化，使人物的面部更加清晰突出。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex l-isfond ma jidhirx ċar? Mark: Il-fotografu sfoka l-isfond apposta biex wiċċek jiġbed l-attenzjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why doesn't the background look clear? Mark: The photographer deliberately blurred the background so that your face would draw attention.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么背景看不清楚？马克：摄影师特意把背景虚化了，让你的脸更引人注意。

messages.speaker: Maja (被拍摄者)
messages.zh: 为什么背景看不清楚？
messages.en: Why doesn't the background look clear?

messages.speaker: Mark (摄影助理)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-fotografu sfoka l-isfond apposta biex wiċċek jiġbed l-attenzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Il-fotografu sfoka l-isfond apposta biex wiċċek jiġbed l-attenzjoni.
messages.zh: 摄影师特意把背景虚化了，让你的脸更引人注意。
messages.en: The photographer deliberately blurred the background so that your face would draw attention.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象转动镜头后背景从清楚变成模糊，把这个动作贴上 sfoka 标签；同时注意它写 k，别与 sfoga 的 g 混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lack of visual sharpness that makes details or edges unclear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 图像或视觉细节不清晰、边缘模糊的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' ċarezza f'immaġni, fejn id-dettalji jew it-truf ma jidhrux sew.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 模糊；不清晰的状态

formal.mt: Is-sfokatura fl-immaġni tagħmilha diffiċli biex jinqraw l-ittri żgħar.
formal.en: The fuzziness in the image makes the small letters difficult to read.
formal.zh: 图像中的模糊使小字难以辨认。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex wiċċi mhux ċar f'dan ir-ritratt? Mark: Hemm ftit sfokatura. Ejja nieħdu ritratt ieħor.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why isn't my face clear in this photo? Mark: There's a little blur. Let's take another photo.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么这张照片里我的脸不清楚？马克：有一点模糊。我们再拍一张吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex wiċċi mhux ċar f'dan ir-ritratt?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex wiċċi mhux ċar f'dan ir-ritratt?
messages.zh: 为什么这张照片里我的脸不清楚？
messages.en: Why isn't my face clear in this photo?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm ftit sfokatura. Ejja nieħdu ritratt ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm ftit sfokatura. Ejja nieħdu ritratt ieħor.
messages.zh: 有一点模糊。我们再拍一张吧。
messages.en: There's a little blur. Let's take another photo.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sfokatura 和一张没对好焦的照片一起记：脸和字的边缘都糊了，就是“模糊状态”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To turn the pages of a book, magazine, or similar text and look through them without necessarily reading everything.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 翻动书籍、杂志等的页面进行浏览，不一定逐字阅读。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dawwar il-paġni ta' ktieb, rivista jew test ieħor biex tagħti daqqa t'għajn lejn il-kontenut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 翻阅；翻看书刊等的页面

formal.mt: Qabel għażel il-ktieb, l-istudent sfolja xi paġni biex jara jekk il-kontenut kienx adattat għalih.
formal.en: Before choosing the book, the student leafed through some pages to see whether the content suited him.
formal.zh: 选书之前，这名学生翻看了几页，看看内容是否适合自己。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nista' nara r-rivista tiegħek? Pawlu: Żgur, sfolja ftit waqt li nagħmel il-kafè.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can I look at your magazine? Pawlu: Sure, leaf through it while I make the coffee.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我能看看你的杂志吗？保罗：当然，趁我煮咖啡，你翻翻吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我能看看你的杂志吗？
messages.en: Can I look at your magazine?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur, sfolja ftit waqt li nagħmel il-kafè.
messages.mt_standard: Żgur, sfolja ftit waqt li nagħmel il-kafè.
messages.zh: 当然，趁我煮咖啡，你翻翻吧。
messages.en: Sure, leaf through it while I make the coffee.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 sfolja 时想象在书店随手翻几页：重点是“翻阅浏览”，不要求从头读到尾。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pastry dough that rises into thin, crisp layers when baked.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 烘烤后会膨起并形成多层薄脆结构的面团或酥皮。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għaġina li waqt il-ħami tintefaħ u tifforma saffi rqaq u tqarmeċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 酥皮面团；烘烤后形成多层薄脆结构的千层酥皮

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta titlob saff ta' sfoll fuq il-mili tal-ħaxix.
formal.en: The recipe calls for a layer of puff pastry over the vegetable filling.
formal.zh: 这份食谱要求在蔬菜馅上覆盖一层酥皮。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandna sfoll biex nagħmlu t-torta? Omm: Iva, hemm pakkett fil-friża.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do we have puff pastry to make the pie? Mum: Yes, there's a packet in the freezer.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们有做馅饼用的酥皮吗？妈妈：有，冷冻室里有一包。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.zh: 我们有做馅饼用的酥皮吗？
messages.en: Do we have puff pastry to make the pie?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.zh: 有，冷冻室里有一包。
messages.en: Yes, there's a packet in the freezer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sfoll 配上一张千层酥皮的截面图来记：烤后层层鼓起、薄脆分明，就是这里的酥皮。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause people gathered in one place to move apart or leave.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使聚集在同一地点的人散开或离开。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġiegħel lin-nies miġbura f'post wieħed jitferrqu jew jitilqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使散开；使聚集的人群散去

collocations.en: disperse the people from the square

formal.mt: Wara t-tmiem tal-attività, l-organizzatur sfolla n-nies minn quddiem id-daħla.
formal.en: After the event ended, the organiser dispersed the people gathered in front of the entrance.
formal.zh: 活动结束后，组织者疏散了聚集在入口前的人群。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn marru n-nies kollha? Toni: Ix-xita sfollat lil kulħadd. Daħlu fil-ħwienet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did everyone go? Toni: The rain dispersed everyone. They went into the shops.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：大家都去哪儿了？托尼：雨把大家都赶散了。他们进商店去了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 大家都去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did everyone go?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ix-xita sfollat lil kulħadd. Daħlu fil-ħwienet.
messages.mt_standard: Ix-xita sfollat lil kulħadd. Daħlu fil-ħwienet.
messages.zh: 雨把大家都赶散了。他们进商店去了。
messages.en: The rain dispersed everyone. They went into the shops.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 sfolla 时想象广场上的人群因下雨四散离开，把这个动作固定为“使人群散去”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To damage or distort the shape or appearance of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物的形状扭曲，或使其外观受到损坏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għawweġ il-forma ta' xi ħaġa jew ħassar id-dehra tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使变形；损坏外观；使毁容

formal.mt: Is-sħana qawwija sformat il-kontenitur tal-plastik u ma baqax jingħalaq sew.
formal.en: The intense heat deformed the plastic container, and it no longer closed properly.
formal.zh: 高温使塑料容器变形，导致它无法再正常盖紧。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex l-għatu ma jidħolx? Mark: Is-sħana sformat il-kaxxa. Irridu waħda oħra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why doesn't the lid fit? Mark: The heat deformed the box. We need another one.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：盖子为什么盖不上？马克：热把盒子弄变形了。我们得换一个。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 盖子为什么盖不上？
messages.en: Why doesn't the lid fit?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-sħana sformat il-kaxxa. Irridu waħda oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Is-sħana sformat il-kaxxa. Irridu waħda oħra.
messages.zh: 热把盒子弄变形了。我们得换一个。
messages.en: The heat deformed the box. We need another one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用受热歪掉的塑料盒记 sforma：原来的形状或外观被破坏，便是“使变形、损坏外观”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The breaking of something into many pieces, especially something fragile.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物破裂成许多碎片的过程或事件，尤其指易碎物品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tkissir ta' xi ħaġa f'ħafna biċċiet, speċjalment ta' oġġett fraġli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 粉碎；破裂成许多碎片

formal.mt: Is-sfrakass tal-ħġieġ ħalla ħafna biċċiet żgħar mal-art.
formal.en: The shattering of the glass left many small pieces on the floor.
formal.zh: 玻璃碎裂后，地上留下了许多小碎片。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'ġara fil-kċina? Pawlu: Waqa' vażun u sar sfrakass. Oqgħod attenta għall-biċċiet.
colloquial.en: Nina: What happened in the kitchen? Pawlu: A vase fell and shattered. Watch out for the pieces.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：厨房里发生什么了？保罗：一个花瓶掉下来摔碎了。小心碎片。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 厨房里发生什么了？
messages.en: What happened in the kitchen?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Waqa' vażun u sar sfrakass. Oqgħod attenta għall-biċċiet.
messages.mt_standard: Waqa' vażun u sar sfrakass. Oqgħod attenta għall-biċċiet.
messages.zh: 一个花瓶掉下来摔碎了。小心碎片。
messages.en: A vase fell and shattered. Watch out for the pieces.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sfrakass 和花瓶落地后满地碎片的画面绑定，记住它表示“碎裂、粉碎”这件事。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A breakdown of organisation or order that disrupts an activity or group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 组织或秩序遭到破坏，使活动陷入混乱或使群体失去原有组织状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taħwid jew tfixkil li jkisser l-ordni ta' attività jew ta' grupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 解体；组织瓦解；混乱无序

formal.mt: In-nuqqas ta' koordinazzjoni wassal għal sfratt fl-organizzazzjoni tal-attività.
formal.en: The lack of coordination led to disorganisation in the running of the activity.
formal.zh: 缺乏协调导致活动组织陷入混乱。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif marret il-laqgħa? Toni: Kien hemm sfratt sħiħ; kulħadd beda jitkellem fl-istess ħin.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did the meeting go? Toni: It was complete disorder; everyone started talking at the same time.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：会议开得怎么样？托尼：完全乱套了，大家同时开始说话。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 会议开得怎么样？
messages.en: How did the meeting go?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hemm sfratt sħiħ; kulħadd beda jitkellem fl-istess ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Kien hemm sfratt sħiħ; kulħadd beda jitkellem fl-istess ħin.
messages.zh: 完全乱套了，大家同时开始说话。
messages.en: It was complete disorder; everyone started talking at the same time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 sfratt 时想象会议上人人抢话、无人协调：原有秩序散了，便出现“组织混乱或瓦解”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who disrupts an activity or causes a group to lose order or organisation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 干扰活动进行，或使群体失去秩序与组织性的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tfixkel attività jew iġġib taħwid u nuqqas ta' ordni fi grupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扰乱者；破坏组织或秩序的人

formal.mt: Iċ-chairperson talab lill-isfrattatur biex ma jinterrompix aktar lill-kelliema.
formal.en: The chairperson asked the disrupter to stop interrupting the speakers.
formal.zh: 会议主席要求这名扰乱者不要再打断发言者。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex sejjaħtlu sfrattatur? Mark: Għax baqa' jinterrompi u ma ħalla lil ħadd jitkellem.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you call him a disrupter? Mark: Because he kept interrupting and wouldn't let anyone speak.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么说他是扰乱者？马克：因为他一直插话，不让任何人说话。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 你为什么说他是扰乱者？
messages.en: Why did you call him a disrupter?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax baqa' jinterrompi u ma ħalla lil ħadd jitkellem.
messages.mt_standard: Għax baqa' jinterrompi u ma ħalla lil ħadd jitkellem.
messages.zh: 因为他一直插话，不让任何人说话。
messages.en: Because he kept interrupting and wouldn't let anyone speak.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sfrattatur 记成会议中不断插话、把秩序搅乱的那个人；与表示混乱状态的 sfratt 配对区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state of poor organisation, or a disturbance that disrupts an orderly activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 缺乏组织而形成的混乱，或打断正常活动秩序的扰乱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' ordni jew ta' organizzazzjoni, jew tfixkil li jħarbat attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 组织混乱；秩序受到扰乱。

formal.mt: Minħabba sfrattatura fl-organizzazzjoni, il-laqgħa bdiet nofs siegħa tard.
formal.en: Because of disorganisation in the arrangements, the meeting started half an hour late.
formal.zh: 由于组织安排混乱，会议晚了半小时才开始。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għadna ma bdejniex? Toni: Kien hemm sfrattatura fil-preparazzjoni, imma issa kollox lest.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why haven't we started yet? Toni: There was some disorganisation in the preparations, but everything is ready now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们为什么还没开始？托尼：准备工作有些混乱，不过现在一切都准备好了。

messages.speaker: Maja (参与者)
messages.zh: 我们为什么还没开始？
messages.en: Why haven't we started yet?

messages.speaker: Toni (组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hemm sfrattatura fil-preparazzjoni, imma issa kollox lest.
messages.mt_standard: Kien hemm sfrattatura fil-preparazzjoni, imma issa kollox lest.
messages.zh: 准备工作有些混乱，不过现在一切都准备好了。
messages.en: There was some disorganisation in the preparations, but everything is ready now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sfrattatura 和会议迟迟不开场的画面联系起来：名单没排好、流程被打断，记住“组织混乱、秩序受扰”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A very large amount of disorder, with things badly mixed up or out of place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 东西严重杂乱、摆放失序而形成的一大团混乱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Diżordni kbira ħafna, b'affarijiet imħawdin jew barra minn posthom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大混乱；严重杂乱的状态。

collocations.en: a huge mess in the room

formal.mt: Wara ċ-ċaqliq tal-għamara, kien hemm sfrattetu sħiħ fil-maħżen.
formal.en: After the furniture was moved, there was a complete mess in the storeroom.
formal.zh: 家具搬动后，储藏室里乱成了一团。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'sfrattetu hawn! Fejn se noqgħod? Mark: Stenna ftit, inneħħi dawn il-kaxxi minn fuq is-siġġu.
colloquial.en: Lara: What a huge mess in here! Where am I going to sit? Mark: Wait a moment; I'll take these boxes off the chair.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这里也太乱了！我要坐哪儿？马克：等一下，我把椅子上的这些箱子搬开。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这里也太乱了！我要坐哪儿？
messages.en: What a huge mess in here! Where am I going to sit?

messages.speaker: Mark (房主)
messages.mt_spoken: Stenna ftit, inneħħi dawn il-kaxxi minn fuq is-siġġu.
messages.mt_standard: Stenna ftit, inneħħi dawn il-kaxxi minn fuq is-siġġu.
messages.zh: 等一下，我把椅子上的这些箱子搬开。
messages.en: Wait a moment; I'll take these boxes off the chair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想到箱子堆满房间、连椅子都不能坐的场景，用 sfrattetu 记住程度很重的“大混乱”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To act freely without controlling one's behaviour or holding oneself back.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不控制自己的行为，任由自己放纵或尽情行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġib ruħu mingħajr rażan u mingħajr ma jżomm lura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 毫无节制；放纵自己；不加约束地行动。

collocations.en: to let loose during the party

formal.mt: Malli bdiet il-mużika, iż-żagħżugħ sfrena fiż-żfin.
formal.en: As soon as the music began, the young man let loose on the dance floor.
formal.zh: 音乐一响起，那个年轻人便放开自己尽情跳舞。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Rajtu lil Mark ilbieraħ? Sfrena fiż-żfin! Nina: Iva, baqa' jiżfen sa tard billejl.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you see Mark yesterday? He really let loose dancing! Nina: Yes, he kept dancing until late at night.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你昨天看见马克了吗？他跳舞跳得可放得开了！妮娜：是啊，他一直跳到深夜。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtu lil Mark ilbieraħ? Sfrena fiż-żfin!
messages.mt_standard: Rajtu lil Mark ilbieraħ? Sfrena fiż-żfin!
messages.zh: 你昨天看见马克了吗？他跳舞跳得可放得开了！
messages.en: Did you see Mark yesterday? He really let loose dancing!

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, baqa' jiżfen sa tard billejl.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, baqa' jiżfen sa tard billejl.
messages.zh: 是啊，他一直跳到深夜。
messages.en: Yes, he kept dancing until late at night.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sfrena 放进舞会画面：一个人完全放开、不再收着动作；借此记住“毫无节制地行动”。

gloss_zh: 不受约束的；放纵的；狂放的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not controlled or held back; expressed or carried out with great freedom or intensity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不受控制或约束的；表现得十分强烈、奔放或毫无节制的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bla rażan jew kontroll; li jintwera jew isir b'libertà jew b'intensità kbira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不受约束的；毫无节制的；奔放的。

formal.mt: L-aħbar tar-rebħa qanqlet entużjażmu sfrenat fost il-partitarji.
formal.en: The news of the victory sparked unbridled enthusiasm among the supporters.
formal.zh: 获胜的消息在支持者中激起了无比高涨的热情。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Kif kienet il-festa? Maja: Kien hemm żfin sfrenat; ħadd ma ried jieqaf!
colloquial.en: Toni: How was the party? Maja: There was wild dancing; nobody wanted to stop!
colloquial.zh: 托尼：聚会怎么样？玛雅：大家跳得特别疯，谁都不想停下来！

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 聚会怎么样？
messages.en: How was the party?

messages.speaker: Maja (聚会参与者)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hemm żfin sfrenat; ħadd ma ried jieqaf!
messages.mt_standard: Kien hemm żfin sfrenat; ħadd ma ried jieqaf!
messages.zh: 大家跳得特别疯，谁都不想停下来！
messages.en: There was wild dancing; nobody wanted to stop!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“热情高涨到收不住”记 sfrenat，再搭配 żfin“舞蹈”，形成“不受约束、十分奔放”的共同画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To damage the appearance of a person or thing by leaving an ugly mark, cut, or other visible damage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过留下难看的痕迹、伤口或其他可见损伤，破坏人或物原有的外观。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel ħsara lid-dehra ta' persuna jew ta' ħaġa billi jħalli marka, qatgħa jew ħsara oħra li tidher.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使毁容；损毁或污损外观。

formal.mt: Xi ħadd sfreġja l-monument billi kiteb fuqu biż-żebgħa.
formal.en: Someone defaced the monument by writing on it with paint.
formal.zh: 有人用油漆在纪念碑上写字，损毁了它的外观。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Rajt il-bieb? Xi ħadd sfreġja l-injam b'sikkina. Pawlu: Iva, ħalla marki fondi ħafna.
colloquial.en: Nina: Have you seen the door? Someone defaced the wood with a knife. Pawlu: Yes, they left very deep marks.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你看见那扇门了吗？有人用刀把木头表面划坏了。保罗：看见了，留下的划痕很深。

messages.speaker: Nina (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt il-bieb? Xi ħadd sfreġja l-injam b'sikkina.
messages.mt_standard: Rajt il-bieb? Xi ħadd sfreġja l-injam b'sikkina.
messages.zh: 你看见那扇门了吗？有人用刀把木头表面划坏了。
messages.en: Have you seen the door? Someone defaced the wood with a knife.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.zh: 看见了，留下的划痕很深。
messages.en: Yes, they left very deep marks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“原本完好的表面被划花”这一画面记 sfreġja；关注外观遭到破坏，可用于人的面部或物体。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A visible scar left by an injury, or a slash made by a sharp object.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受伤后留下的明显伤疤，或尖锐物体造成的划伤、割痕。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marka li tibqa' wara ferita, jew qatgħa magħmula b'oġġett jaqta'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 伤疤；划伤或割痕。

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt jidher sfreġju fuq ħaddejn ir-raġel.
formal.en: A scar is visible on the man's cheek in the photograph.
formal.zh: 照片中可以看到那名男子脸颊上的一道伤疤。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn fejn ġie dak l-isfreġju fuq idek? Toni: Qtajt idi meta kont żgħir, u baqgħet il-marka.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did you get that scar on your hand? Toni: I cut my hand when I was little, and the mark remained.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你手上的那道疤是怎么来的？托尼：我小时候割伤过手，后来就留下了痕迹。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fejn ġie dak l-isfreġju fuq idek?
messages.mt_standard: Minn fejn ġie dak l-isfreġju fuq idek?
messages.zh: 你手上的那道疤是怎么来的？
messages.en: How did you get that scar on your hand?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qtajt idi meta kont żgħir, u baqgħet il-marka.
messages.mt_standard: Qtajt idi meta kont żgħir, u baqgħet il-marka.
messages.zh: 我小时候割伤过手，后来就留下了痕迹。
messages.en: I cut my hand when I was little, and the mark remained.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住手上那道看得见的痕迹：sfreġju 可以说留下的“伤疤”，也可以说尖物造成的“割痕”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To use an opportunity, resource, or situation to obtain as much benefit as possible.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 利用机会、资源或某种局面，尽可能从中获得益处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Juża opportunità, riżorsa jew sitwazzjoni biex jikseb l-akbar benefiċċju possibbli.

sense_translations.en_definition: to make the most of, to take advantage of
sense_translations.zh_definition: 充分利用；利用某种机会、条件或局面。

collocations.en: to make the most of an opportunity
to make the most of the available time

formal.mt: L-istudent sfrutta l-ħin disponibbli biex jipprattika l-Malti kuljum.
formal.en: The student made the most of the available time to practise Maltese every day.
formal.zh: 这名学生充分利用可用的时间，每天练习马耳他语。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandna għaxar minuti qabel il-karozza tal-linja. Mark: Sfrutta l-ħin biex tirrevedi l-kliem; nista' nistaqsik jien.
colloquial.en: Nina: We've got ten minutes before the bus comes. Mark: Make the most of the time to review the vocabulary; I can quiz you.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：公交车来之前，我们还有十分钟。马克：利用这点时间复习单词吧，我可以考考你。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna għaxar minuti qabel il-karozza tal-linja.
messages.mt_standard: Għandna għaxar minuti qabel il-karozza tal-linja.
messages.zh: 公交车来之前，我们还有十分钟。
messages.en: We've got ten minutes before the bus comes.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Sfrutta l-ħin biex tirrevedi l-kliem; nista' nistaqsik jien.
messages.mt_standard: Sfrutta l-ħin biex tirrevedi l-kliem; nista' nistaqsik jien.
messages.zh: 利用这点时间复习单词吧，我可以考考你。
messages.en: Make the most of the time to review the vocabulary; I can quiz you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想到等车的十分钟也拿来复习，把 sfrutta 与“把现有机会和时间用足”相连，记住“充分利用”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The use of resources or opportunities for benefit, or the unfair use of people and their work for someone else's gain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为获得利益而利用资源或机会，也指为他人获利而不公平地利用人及其劳动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-użu ta' riżorsi jew opportunitajiet biex jinkiseb benefiċċju, jew l-użu inġust ta' nies u ta' xogħolhom għall-qligħ ta' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 利用；开发利用；剥削，尤指为获利而不公平地利用他人的劳动。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi sfruttament tal-ħaddiema permezz ta' pagi baxxi ħafna u sigħat twal ta' xogħol.
formal.en: The report describes the exploitation of workers through very low wages and long working hours.
formal.zh: 报告描述了以极低工资和长时间工作剥削工人的情况。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Jaħdmu tant sigħat għal paga daqshekk baxxa? Dan sfruttament! Pawlu: Iva, jagħmlu ħafna xogħol u jitħallsu ftit wisq.
colloquial.en: Lara: They work so many hours for such low pay? That's exploitation! Pawlu: Yes, they do a lot of work and get paid far too little.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：他们工作那么多小时，工资却这么低？这就是剥削！保罗：是啊，他们干很多活，拿到的钱却少得可怜。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jaħdmu tant sigħat għal paga daqshekk baxxa? Dan sfruttament!
messages.mt_standard: Jaħdmu tant sigħat għal paga daqshekk baxxa? Dan sfruttament!
messages.zh: 他们工作那么多小时，工资却这么低？这就是剥削！
messages.en: They work so many hours for such low pay? That's exploitation!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jagħmlu ħafna xogħol u jitħallsu ftit wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jagħmlu ħafna xogħol u jitħallsu ftit wisq.
messages.zh: 是啊，他们干很多活，拿到的钱却少得可怜。
messages.en: Yes, they do a lot of work and get paid far too little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sfruttament 放进两个场景记忆：谈自然资源时是“开发利用”，谈工人付出多而报酬极少时是“剥削”。

gloss_zh: 剥削者；利用他人谋利的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who unfairly uses other people or their work for personal benefit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为了自身利益而不公平地利用他人或他人劳动的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tieħu vantaġġ minn ħaddieħor jew mix-xogħol tiegħu b'mod inġust għall-benefiċċju tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 剥削者；不公平地利用他人谋取利益的人。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, sid il-fabbrika jidher bħala sfruttatur li jimpurtah biss mill-profitt.
formal.en: In the novel, the factory owner is portrayed as an exploiter who cares only about profit.
formal.zh: 小说把工厂老板描写成一个只关心利润的剥削者。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-kap iġegħelna naħdmu sigħat żejda bla ħlas. Mark: Qed iġib ruħu ta' sfruttatur.
colloquial.en: Lara: The boss makes us work extra hours without pay. Mark: He's behaving like an exploiter.
colloquial.zh: Lara：老板让我们无偿加班。Mark：他的行为就像个剥削者。

messages.speaker: Lara (员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kap iġegħelna naħdmu sigħat żejda bla ħlas.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kap iġegħelna naħdmu sigħat żejda bla ħlas.
messages.zh: 老板让我们无偿加班。
messages.en: The boss makes us work extra hours without pay.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 他的行为就像个剥削者。
messages.en: He's behaving like an exploiter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sfruttatur 和“让别人白干、自己获利”的人物画面绑定，记住它指剥削者。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An eruption or a release of pent-up feelings, especially anger or frustration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一次突然的爆发，也可指把积压的愤怒或烦闷宣泄出来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tifqigħa jew ħruġ ta' emozzjonijiet miżmuma ġewwa, speċjalment rabja jew frustrazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喷发；突然的爆发。
发泄情绪；释放积压的怒气或压力。

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi r-reazzjoni tal-personaġġ bħala sfugatura ta' rabja wara silenzju twil.
formal.en: The author describes the character's reaction as an outburst of anger after a long silence.
formal.zh: 作者把这个人物的反应描写成长久沉默之后的一次怒气爆发。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kelli bżonn sfugatura wara ġurnata daqshekk twila. Pawlu: Tkellem, qed nisimgħek.
colloquial.en: Nina: I needed to let off steam after such a long day. Pawlu: Go ahead, I'm listening.
colloquial.zh: Nina：熬了这么漫长的一天，我需要发泄一下。Pawlu：说吧，我听着。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kelli bżonn sfugatura wara ġurnata daqshekk twila.
messages.mt_standard: Kelli bżonn sfugatura wara ġurnata daqshekk twila.
messages.zh: 熬了这么漫长的一天，我需要发泄一下。
messages.en: I needed to let off steam after such a long day.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 说吧，我听着。
messages.en: Go ahead, I'm listening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象压力积满后终于释放的画面，用它串起“爆发”和“宣泄”两个义项；这只是记忆联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make puff pastry, preparing dough that forms thin, flaky layers when baked.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 制作烘烤后会形成薄脆层次的酥皮面团。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel għaġina li tifforma saffi rqaq u tqarmeċ meta tinħema.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 制作酥皮面团。

collocations.en: he made puff pastry for the pastries
collocations.zh: 他为糕点制作了酥皮面团

formal.mt: Matul il-lezzjoni, il-furnar sfuljura l-għaġina u spjega kull pass lill-istudenti.
formal.en: During the lesson, the baker made puff pastry dough and explained each step to the students.
formal.zh: 课堂上，面包师制作了酥皮面团，并向学生解释了每一个步骤。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel il-furnar dalgħodu? Toni: Sfuljura l-għaġina għall-pasti ta' għada.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did the baker do this morning? Toni: He made puff pastry dough for tomorrow's pastries.
colloquial.zh: Maja：面包师今天早上做了什么？Toni：他为明天的糕点制作了酥皮面团。

messages.speaker: Maja (学徒)
messages.zh: 面包师今天早上做了什么？
messages.en: What did the baker do this morning?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.zh: 他为明天的糕点制作了酥皮面团。
messages.en: He made puff pastry dough for tomorrow's pastries.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 sfuljura，就想象面包师把面团反复折叠成酥皮；用制作动作帮助记住这个动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Yellow colour, especially a sallow or waxy yellow appearance of the face.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 黄色，尤其指脸上显出的暗黄或蜡黄色。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Lewn isfar, speċjalment dehra safranija jew bħal tax-xama' fil-wiċċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黄色；黄色的色泽。
面色暗黄；肤色缺乏红润而发黄的状态。
蜡黄的面容；呈现蜡样色泽的脸色。

collocations.en: a yellowish or sallow appearance in the face
the yellow colour of the leaves

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt, is-sfura ta' wiċċ il-persuna tikkuntrasta mal-kulur aħmar tal-isfond.
formal.en: In the portrait, the sallowness of the person's face contrasts with the red background.
formal.zh: 肖像中，人物暗黄的脸色与红色背景形成对比。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex wiċċi jidher b'din is-sfura fir-ritratt? Samwel: Naħseb li hu minħabba d-dawl isfar tal-kamra.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why does my face look so yellow in the photo? Samwel: I think it's because of the room's yellow light.
colloquial.zh: Rita：为什么照片里我的脸这么黄？Samwel：我觉得是房间里的黄色灯光造成的。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex wiċċi jidher b'din is-sfura fir-ritratt?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex wiċċi jidher b'din is-sfura fir-ritratt?
messages.zh: 为什么照片里我的脸这么黄？
messages.en: Why does my face look so yellow in the photo?

messages.speaker: Samwel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħseb li hu minħabba d-dawl isfar tal-kamra.
messages.mt_standard: Naħseb li hu minħabba d-dawl isfar tal-kamra.
messages.zh: 我觉得是房间里的黄色灯光造成的。
messages.en: I think it's because of the room's yellow light.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记一片黄叶，再记一张蜡黄的脸：sfura 的共同线索是“黄色的色泽”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small or slight cough.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 轻微的一声咳嗽，或程度很轻的咳嗽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sogħla żgħira jew ħafifa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻咳；轻微的一声咳嗽。

formal.mt: Waqt id-diskors instemgħet sgħajla qasira minn wara tas-sala.
formal.en: During the speech, a brief little cough was heard from the back of the hall.
formal.zh: 演讲期间，大厅后方传来短促的一声轻咳。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Smajtek tisgħol. Trid ftit ilma? Ben: Iva, grazzi. Kienet biss sgħajla.
colloquial.en: Anna: I heard you cough. Would you like some water? Ben: Yes, thanks. It was just a little cough.
colloquial.zh: Anna：我听见你咳嗽了。要喝点水吗？Ben：好，谢谢。只是轻轻咳了一声。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 我听见你咳嗽了。要喝点水吗？
messages.en: I heard you cough. Would you like some water?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，谢谢。只是轻轻咳了一声。
messages.en: Yes, thanks. It was just a little cough.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象安静大厅里轻轻一声“咳”，把 sgħajla 记成小而轻的咳嗽，突出程度轻。

gloss_zh: 旧式指小名词，现存于地名 Is-Sgħajtar

teaching_sense.en_definition: An obsolete diminutive noun preserved in Maltese place names, including Is-Sgħajtar.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个已废用的指小名词形式，现保留在 Is-Sgħajtar 等马耳他地名中。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma diminuttiva li m'għadhiex tintuża fil-lingwa ta' kuljum, iżda baqgħet f'ismijiet ta' nħawi bħal Is-Sgħajtar.

sense_translations.en_definition: obsolete diminutive form surviving in (toponymy) Is-Sgħajtar, meadowland on the south-east of Mosta beyond Imlit; also name of another area in Malta in the neighbourhood of It-Torri tal-Marfa known as the Mosta Palace
sense_translations.zh_definition: 已废用的指小形式，现存于地名 Is-Sgħajtar，指莫斯塔东南方、越过 Imlit 的一片草地；也是马耳他另一处地区的名称，该地区位于 It-Torri tal-Marfa 附近，称为 Mosta Palace。

formal.mt: Fl-istudju tal-ismijiet tal-postijiet, il-forma sgħajtar tiġi diskussa permezz tal-isem Is-Sgħajtar.
formal.en: In the study of place names, the form sgħajtar is discussed through the name Is-Sgħajtar.
formal.zh: 在地名研究中，sgħajtar 这一形式通过地名 Is-Sgħajtar 得到讨论。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu Is-Sgħajtar f'dan it-test? Mark: Huwa isem ta' post; il-forma sgħajtar baqgħet tintuża fl-ismijiet tal-postijiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is Is-Sgħajtar in this text? Mark: It's a place name; the form sgħajtar has survived in place names.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这篇文章里的 Is-Sgħajtar 是什么？Mark：是一个地名；sgħajtar 这个形式保留在地名里。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的 Is-Sgħajtar 是什么？
messages.en: What is Is-Sgħajtar in this text?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa isem ta' post; il-forma sgħajtar baqgħet tintuża fl-ismijiet tal-postijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa isem ta' post; il-forma sgħajtar baqgħet tintuża fl-ismijiet tal-postijiet.
messages.zh: 是一个地名；sgħajtar 这个形式保留在地名里。
messages.en: It's a place name; the form sgħajtar has survived in place names.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sgħajtar 写在地图标签 Is-Sgħajtar 旁，记住这是保留在地名里的旧形式，不猜测其原始词义。

gloss_zh: 咳嗽；咳嗽的动作或过程

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of coughing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 咳嗽这一动作或持续、反复咳嗽的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li wieħed jisgħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 咳嗽；咳嗽的动作或过程。

formal.mt: Is-sgħil ripetut waqqaf il-qari għal ftit, u l-għalliem stenna sakemm reġa' kien hemm il-kwiet.
formal.en: Repeated coughing briefly interrupted the reading, and the teacher waited until it was quiet again.
formal.zh: 反复的咳嗽使朗读短暂停顿，老师等到重新安静下来才继续。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex waqqaft il-qari? Luqa: Kelli attakk ta' sgħil u ma stajtx inkompli.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you stop reading? Luqa: I had a bout of coughing and couldn't continue.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你为什么停止朗读了？Luqa：我咳嗽了一阵，没法继续。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你为什么停止朗读了？
messages.en: Why did you stop reading?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kelli attakk ta' sgħil u ma stajtx inkompli.
messages.mt_standard: Kelli attakk ta' sgħil u ma stajtx inkompli.
messages.zh: 我咳嗽了一阵，没法继续。
messages.en: I had a bout of coughing and couldn't continue.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一段反复咳嗽的声音记 sgħil，关注咳嗽这个过程；与 sgħajla 的轻轻一咳对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state of leaning or being tilted to one side.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体向一侧倾斜、偏离直立位置的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qagħda ta' ħaġa li tkun imxaqilba lejn naħa waħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾斜；向一侧偏斜的状态。

formal.mt: Is-sgħin tal-arblu lejn il-lemin jidher ċar fir-ritratt.
formal.en: The pole's leaning to the right is clearly visible in the photograph.
formal.zh: 照片中可以清楚看出杆子向右倾斜的状态。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed tara s-sgħin tal-arblu? Mark: Iva, mhux wieqaf dritt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you see the pole's leaning? Mark: Yes, it isn't standing straight.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看出杆子倾斜了吗？马克：看出来了，它没有立直。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看出杆子倾斜了吗？
messages.en: Can you see the pole's leaning?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 看出来了，它没有立直。
messages.en: Yes, it isn't standing straight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一根向右歪的杆子，把 sgħin 与“倾斜的状态”一起记住。

gloss_zh: 短时间的守候；短暂值守

teaching_sense.en_definition: A short period of keeping watch over someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为照看某人或留意某物而进行的一小段时间的守候。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żmien qasir ta' għassa jew ta' attenzjoni fuq xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 短时间的守候或值守。

collocations.en: a short watch beside the baby

formal.mt: Il-missier għamel shajra ħdejn it-tarbija waqt li l-omm kienet qed tistrieħ.
formal.en: The father kept a short watch beside the baby while the mother was resting.
formal.zh: 母亲休息时，父亲在婴儿身旁守候了一小会儿。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Tista' tagħmel shajra ħdejn it-tarbija? Pawlu: Iva, noqgħod hawn sakemm terġa' tiġi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you keep a short watch beside the baby? Pawlu: Yes, I'll stay here until you come back.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你能在宝宝旁边看一会儿吗？保罗：可以，我待在这里，等你回来。

messages.speaker: Lara (母亲)
messages.zh: 你能在宝宝旁边看一会儿吗？
messages.en: Can you keep a short watch beside the baby?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, noqgħod hawn sakemm terġa' tiġi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, noqgħod hawn sakemm terġa' tiġi.
messages.zh: 可以，我待在这里，等你回来。
messages.en: Yes, I'll stay here until you come back.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 shajra 想成“替家人看一小会儿宝宝”，重点记住守候时间很短。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small share of something, or a small part of a larger whole.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物中分得的一小份，或较大整体中的一小部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sehem żgħir minn xi ħaġa jew parti żgħira minn ħaġa sħiħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 分配所得的一小份；较小的份额。
整体中的一小部分。

collocations.en: a small share of the profit
a small part of the work

formal.mt: Kull parteċipant irċieva shejjem mill-qligħ tal-attività.
formal.en: Each participant received a small share of the profit from the event.
formal.zh: 每位参与者都分到了活动利润中的一小份。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm fadal mix-xogħol? Mark: Shejjem biss; nistgħu nlestuh illum.
colloquial.en: Maja: How much of the work is left? Mark: Only a small part; we can finish it today.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：工作还剩多少？马克：只剩一小部分了，我们今天就能完成。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 工作还剩多少？
messages.en: How much of the work is left?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 只剩一小部分了，我们今天就能完成。
messages.en: Only a small part; we can finish it today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个大圆，再圈出很小的一块：分给某人是“一小份”，属于整体是“一小部分”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small or brief lapse of attention.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 程度较轻或持续时间很短的注意力分散。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Distrazzjoni żgħira jew ta' mument.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small distraction (the diminutive form of 'sehwa')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小小的分心；短暂走神，是 sehwa 的指小形式。

formal.mt: Minħabba shejwa waqt il-qari, l-istudenta qabżet linja fit-test.
formal.en: Because of a brief lapse of attention while reading, the student skipped a line in the text.
formal.zh: 由于阅读时短暂走神，这名女学生漏读了文中的一行。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex qbiżt dik il-linja? Nina: Kelli shejwa; nerġa' naqraha issa.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why did you skip that line? Nina: I lost focus for a moment; I'll read it again now.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你怎么跳过了那一行？妮娜：我刚才走了一下神，现在重新读。

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.zh: 你怎么跳过了那一行？
messages.en: Why did you skip that line?

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 我刚才走了一下神，现在重新读。
messages.en: I lost focus for a moment; I'll read it again now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象读书时眼神飘开一瞬，漏掉一行；用这个小画面记住 shejwa 的短暂分心。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Work that continues until late or beyond normal working hours.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 持续到很晚的工作，或超出正常工作时间的加班。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xogħol li jibqa' sejjer sa tard jew lil hinn mill-ħin normali tax-xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 工作到很晚；持续到晚间的工作。
加班；超出正常工作时间继续工作。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema kellhom bżonn jagħmlu shir biex ilestu l-proġett fil-ħin.
formal.en: The workers needed to work overtime to complete the project on time.
formal.zh: 工人们需要加班，才能按时完成项目。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Illejla se nerġgħu nagħmlu shir? Pawlu: Iva, irridu nlestu r-rapport qabel għada.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are we working late again tonight? Pawlu: Yes, we need to finish the report before tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们今晚又要工作到很晚吗？保罗：是的，得在明天之前完成报告。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 我们今晚又要工作到很晚吗？
messages.en: Are we working late again tonight?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, irridu nlestu r-rapport qabel għada.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, irridu nlestu r-rapport qabel għada.
messages.zh: 是的，得在明天之前完成报告。
messages.en: Yes, we need to finish the report before tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象天黑后办公室的灯还亮着：shir 可联系“工作到很晚”和“超过工时加班”。

gloss_zh: 惯于剥掉叶子的；有剥叶倾向的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to strip leaves from plants or branches.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容容易或惯于把植物、枝条上的叶子剥掉的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jneħħi l-weraq minn fuq il-pjanti jew il-friegħi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有剥叶倾向的；惯于把叶子剥掉的。

collocations.en: an animal inclined to strip leaves
collocations.zh: 一只惯于剥掉叶子的动物

collocations.en: wind that tends to strip leaves

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ġardinar jibża' mir-riħ sibbieki għax jista' jħalli l-friegħi bla weraq.
formal.en: In the story, the gardener fears the leaf-stripping wind because it may leave the branches bare.
formal.zh: 故事里的园丁害怕这种容易刮掉叶子的风，因为它可能让枝条变得光秃秃的。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Għaliex ċaqlaqt il-pjanti? Ġużeppi: Għax dan l-annimal sibbieki; dejjem ineħħilhom il-weraq.
colloquial.en: Lina: Why did you move the plants? Ġużeppi: Because this animal tends to strip leaves; it keeps removing their leaves.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：你为什么把植物搬走了？朱塞佩：因为这只动物爱剥叶子，总把它们的叶子弄掉。

messages.speaker: Lina (邻居)
messages.zh: 你为什么把植物搬走了？
messages.en: Why did you move the plants?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dan l-annimal sibbieki; dejjem ineħħilhom il-weraq.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dan l-annimal sibbieki; dejjem ineħħilhom il-weraq.
messages.zh: 因为这只动物爱剥叶子，总把它们的叶子弄掉。
messages.en: Because this animal tends to strip leaves; it keeps removing their leaves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象枝条上的叶子老被剥掉，用“惯于剥叶”记住它描述的是一种倾向。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pirate or corsair: a person who attacks or plunders ships at sea.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指在海上袭击或劫掠船只的人，可表示海盗或私掠者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tattakka jew tisraq bastimenti fuq il-baħar; pirata jew kursar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海盗。
私掠者；海上劫掠者。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, is-sibbien jersaq lejn il-port bil-vapur tiegħu, filwaqt li l-abitanti josservawh mix-xatt.
formal.en: In the novel, the pirate approaches the harbour in his ship while the inhabitants watch him from the shore.
formal.zh: 小说中，海盗驾着自己的船驶近港口，居民们则在岸上注视着他。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min hu dak fil-ktieb, bil-kappell kbir? Ben: Dak sibbien. Il-vapur tiegħu jidher fil-paġna li jmiss.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who is that in the book, with the big hat? Ben: That is a pirate. His ship appears on the next page.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：书里那个戴大帽子的人是谁？本：那是个海盗，下一页就能看到他的船。

messages.speaker: Marija (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak fil-ktieb, bil-kappell kbir?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak fil-ktieb, bil-kappell kbir?
messages.zh: 书里那个戴大帽子的人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that in the book, with the big hat?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak sibbien. Il-vapur tiegħu jidher fil-paġna li jmiss.
messages.mt_standard: Dak sibbien. Il-vapur tiegħu jidher fil-paġna li jmiss.
messages.zh: 那是个海盗，下一页就能看到他的船。
messages.en: That is a pirate. His ship appears on the next page.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象故事书里海盗站在船头的画面，把这个词牢牢记在“海上劫掠者”这一人物类别中。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To strip leaves away; also, to be drawn.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指剥去叶子；另有“被拉动”的义项。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ineħħi l-weraq; f'tifsira oħra, jinġibed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 剥去、除去叶子。
被拉动；被牵引。

collocations.en: stripped the branch of its leaves
the wind stripped the tree of its leaves

formal.mt: Ir-riħ qawwi sibek is-siġra, u l-weraq inġabar mal-ħajt tal-ġnien.
formal.en: The strong wind stripped the tree of its leaves, and the leaves collected against the garden wall.
formal.zh: 强风刮掉了树上的叶子，落叶堆积在花园的围墙边。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex din il-fergħa bla weraq? David: Ħija sibek il-fergħa waqt li kien jilgħab magħha.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why does this branch have no leaves? David: My brother stripped its leaves off while playing with it.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这根枝条怎么没有叶子？戴维：我弟弟拿它玩的时候，把叶子剥掉了。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 这根枝条怎么没有叶子？
messages.en: Why does this branch have no leaves?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija sibek il-fergħa waqt li kien jilgħab magħha.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija sibek il-fergħa waqt li kien jilgħab magħha.
messages.zh: 我弟弟拿它玩的时候，把叶子剥掉了。
messages.en: My brother stripped its leaves off while playing with it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用手中光秃秃的枝条记“剥叶”，再单列“被拉动”义项，避免混淆动作方向。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For a cereal plant to produce an ear; also, for a person to become irascible or lose their temper.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指谷类植物长出穗；也可指人变得易怒或发起脾气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ is-sbul, meta jingħad għall-qamħ; ukoll, isir malajr għar-rabja jew jitlef il-kalma.

sense_translations.en_definition: to grow an ear of corn
sense_translations.zh_definition: 长出谷穗；抽穗。
变得易怒；变得容易发脾气。
发脾气；失去冷静。

collocations.en: lost his temper when he heard the news

formal.mt: Skont in-noti tal-bidwi, il-qamħ f'din l-għalqa sibel qabel dak fl-għalqa l-oħra.
formal.en: According to the farmer's notes, the wheat in this field produced ears before the wheat in the other field.
formal.zh: 根据农夫的记录，这块田里的小麦比另一块田里的更早抽穗。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għaliex Mark beda jgħajjat? Ruben: Sibel meta sema' li l-laqgħa kienet tħassret.
colloquial.en: Elena: Why did Mark start shouting? Ruben: He lost his temper when he heard that the meeting had been cancelled.
colloquial.zh: 埃琳娜：马克为什么喊起来了？鲁本：他听说会议取消了，就发了脾气。

messages.speaker: Elena (同事)
messages.zh: 马克为什么喊起来了？
messages.en: Why did Mark start shouting?

messages.speaker: Ruben (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Sibel meta sema' li l-laqgħa kienet tħassret.
messages.mt_standard: Sibel meta sema' li l-laqgħa kienet tħassret.
messages.zh: 他听说会议取消了，就发了脾气。
messages.en: He lost his temper when he heard that the meeting had been cancelled.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按主语分成两组记忆：谷物是“抽穗”，人是“变得易怒或发脾气”；这是记忆分类，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of plundering, including raiding and taking property at sea.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 抢夺财物的活动，也可指海上的劫掠活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività ta' ħtif u serq ta' ġid, inkluż il-ħtif fuq il-baħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抢掠；以强力夺取财物的活动。
海上劫掠；海盗式的袭击与抢夺活动。

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi s-sibi fuq il-baħar u t-telf li ġarrbu l-vittmi tiegħu.
formal.en: The text describes plundering at sea and the losses suffered by its victims.
formal.zh: 这篇文章描述了海上劫掠及其受害者遭受的损失。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hawnhekk, 'sibi' jfisser serq fuq il-baħar? Lara: Iva, f'dan il-kuntest jirreferi għal ħtif u serq fuq il-baħar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does 'sibi' mean robbery at sea here? Lara: Yes, in this context it refers to raiding and stealing at sea.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这里的 sibi 是指海上抢劫吗？Lara：是的，在这个语境中，它指海上的袭击与抢掠。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 sibi 是指海上抢劫吗？
messages.en: Does 'sibi' mean robbery at sea here?

messages.speaker: Lara (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, f'dan il-kuntest jirreferi għal ħtif u serq fuq il-baħar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, f'dan il-kuntest jirreferi għal ħtif u serq fuq il-baħar.
messages.zh: 是的，在这个语境中，它指海上的袭击与抢掠。
messages.en: Yes, in this context it refers to raiding and stealing at sea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sibi 配上财物遭抢和船只遭劫两幅画面，分别记住一般抢掠与海上劫掠两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A louse, or a nit: the egg of a louse attached to a hair.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 虱子，或附着在毛发上的虱卵；具体所指需结合上下文判断。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qamla, jew bajda ta' qamla mwaħħla ma' xagħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一只虱子，即寄生在身体或毛发上的小昆虫。
一枚虱卵，通常附着在毛发上。

collocations.en: a louse or nit in the hair
to remove a louse or nit with a comb
collocations.zh: 用梳子去除虱子或虱卵

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni tax-xagħar instabet sibiena mwaħħla ma' xagħra; f'dan il-każ, il-kelma tirreferi għal bajda ta' qamla.
formal.en: During the hair inspection, a nit was found attached to a hair; in this case, the word refers to a louse's egg.
formal.zh: 检查头发时发现了一枚附着在发丝上的虱卵；在这里，这个词指虱子的卵。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Sibt sibiena fix-xagħar. Tista' tgħinni nneħħiha? Omm: Iva, ġib il-moxt fin u noqogħdu ħdejn id-dawl.
colloquial.en: Nina: I found a louse or nit in my hair. Can you help me remove it? Mum: Yes, bring the fine-toothed comb and let's sit near the light.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我在头发里发现了虱子或虱卵，你能帮我弄掉吗？妈妈：可以，把细齿梳拿来，我们坐到亮一点的地方。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Sibt sibiena fix-xagħar. Tista' tgħinni nneħħiha?
messages.mt_standard: Sibt sibiena fix-xagħar. Tista' tgħinni nneħħiha?
messages.zh: 我在头发里发现了虱子或虱卵，你能帮我弄掉吗？
messages.en: I found a louse or nit in my hair. Can you help me remove it?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġib il-moxt fin u noqogħdu ħdejn id-dawl.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġib il-moxt fin u noqogħdu ħdejn id-dawl.
messages.zh: 可以，把细齿梳拿来，我们坐到亮一点的地方。
messages.en: Yes, bring the fine-toothed comb and let's sit near the light.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象用细齿梳检查头发：会爬的是虱子，黏在发丝上的是虱卵，sibiena 的两个义项一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of looting: taking property by force or during disorder.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 抢掠或洗劫，即以强力或趁混乱夺取财物的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att ta' serq ta' ġid bil-forza jew waqt id-diżordni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抢掠；洗劫；以强力或趁混乱抢走财物的行为。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddokumenta s-sibja tal-ħwienet u l-ħsara li saret lill-proprjetà.
formal.en: The report documents the looting of shops and the damage caused to property.
formal.zh: 这份报告记录了商店遭洗劫的情况及财产受到的损害。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Xi tfisser 'sibja' f'dan ir-rapport? Lara: Tfisser ħtif ta' ġid; hawn qed jitkellmu dwar ħwienet li nsterqu waqt id-diżordni.
colloquial.en: Mark: What does 'sibja' mean in this report? Lara: It means looting; here they are talking about shops robbed during the disorder.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这份报告里的 sibja 是什么意思？Lara：意思是抢掠；这里说的是混乱期间遭到洗劫的商店。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.zh: 这份报告里的 sibja 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'sibja' mean in this report?

messages.speaker: Lara (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser ħtif ta' ġid; hawn qed jitkellmu dwar ħwienet li nsterqu waqt id-diżordni.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser ħtif ta' ġid; hawn qed jitkellmu dwar ħwienet li nsterqu waqt id-diżordni.
messages.zh: 意思是抢掠；这里说的是混乱期间遭到洗劫的商店。
messages.en: It means looting; here they are talking about shops robbed during the disorder.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sibja 写在一幅商店被洗劫的练习图旁，重点记住它表示抢掠行为，不是被抢走的物品。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun used as a cognate object of its related verb; its specific meaning must be understood from that verb and the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用作相关动词的同源宾语的名词；具体含义须结合该动词及上下文理解。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom li jintuża bħala oġġett ta' verb tal-istess għerq; it-tifsira speċifika tiddependi mill-verb u mill-kuntest.

sense_translations.en_definition: (used as cognate object of the verb)
sense_translations.zh_definition: （用作该动词的同源宾语，即与动词具有同源关系的名词性宾语。）

collocations.en: 'sibka' as the object of the verb

formal.mt: Fin-nota grammatikali, 'sibka' hija deskritta bħala nom li jintuża bħala oġġett ta' verb tal-istess għerq.
formal.en: In the grammatical note, 'sibka' is described as a noun used as the object of a verb with the same root.
formal.zh: 在这条语法说明中，sibka 被描述为用作同根动词宾语的名词。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tgħid in-nota dwar 'sibka'? Lara: Tgħid li tintuża bħala oġġett ta' verb tal-istess għerq. Biex nifhmu t-tifsira preċiża, irridu naraw il-verb u l-kuntest.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the note say about 'sibka'? Lara: It says it is used as the object of a verb with the same root. To understand the precise meaning, we need to look at the verb and the context.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这条说明怎么解释 sibka？Lara：它说这个词用作同根动词的宾语。要理解确切含义，还得看动词和上下文。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这条说明怎么解释 sibka？
messages.en: What does the note say about 'sibka'?

messages.speaker: Lara (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tgħid li tintuża bħala oġġett ta' verb tal-istess għerq. Biex nifhmu t-tifsira preċiża, irridu naraw il-verb u l-kuntest.
messages.mt_standard: Tgħid li tintuża bħala oġġett ta' verb tal-istess għerq. Biex nifhmu t-tifsira preċiża, irridu naraw il-verb u l-kuntest.
messages.zh: 它说这个词用作同根动词的宾语。要理解确切含义，还得看动词和上下文。
messages.en: It says it is used as the object of a verb with the same root. To understand the precise meaning, we need to look at the verb and the context.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 sibka 画一条指向动词的箭头，记住这里提供的是同源宾语用法；先找动词，再判断具体词义。

gloss_zh: 一阵怒气爆发；大发脾气

teaching_sense.en_definition: An outburst of anger, expressed by a noun used as a cognate object of its related verb.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一阵突然爆发的怒气或大发脾气；该名词用作相关动词的同源宾语。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żbroff ta' rabja, espress b'nom li jintuża bħala oġġett ta' verb tal-istess għerq.

sense_translations.en_definition: (used as a cognate object of the verb) An outburst of anger
sense_translations.zh_definition: （用作该动词的同源宾语）一阵怒气爆发；一次大发脾气。

formal.mt: L-awtur juża l-kelma 'sibla' biex jiddeskrivi żbroff ta' rabja tal-karattru.
