formal.en: The author uses the word 'sibla' to describe an outburst of anger by the character.
formal.zh: 作者用 sibla 这个词描述人物的一次怒气爆发。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Hawn 'sibla' tfisser li kien irrabjat il-ġurnata kollha? Lara: Le, tfisser żbroff ta' rabja, jiġifieri mument meta r-rabja faqqgħet f'daqqa.
colloquial.en: Mark: Does 'sibla' here mean that he was angry all day? Lara: No, it means an angry outburst: a moment when his anger suddenly erupted.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这里的 sibla 是说他一整天都在生气吗？Lara：不是，它指一阵怒气爆发，也就是怒火突然发作的那一下。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn 'sibla' tfisser li kien irrabjat il-ġurnata kollha?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn 'sibla' tfisser li kien irrabjat il-ġurnata kollha?
messages.zh: 这里的 sibla 是说他一整天都在生气吗？
messages.en: Does 'sibla' here mean that he was angry all day?

messages.speaker: Lara (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tfisser żbroff ta' rabja, jiġifieri mument meta r-rabja faqqgħet f'daqqa.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tfisser żbroff ta' rabja, jiġifieri mument meta r-rabja faqqgħet f'daqqa.
messages.zh: 不是，它指一阵怒气爆发，也就是怒火突然发作的那一下。
messages.en: No, it means an angry outburst: a moment when his anger suddenly erupted.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sibla 想成情绪温度计突然冲高的一瞬间，记住它强调怒气爆发，而不是长时间闷闷不乐。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Saturday, the day between Friday and Sunday; also the Sabbath in a religious context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 星期六，即星期五之后、星期日之前的一天；在宗教语境中也指安息日。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-jum bejn il-Ġimgħa u l-Ħadd; f'kuntest reliġjuż, ukoll il-jum tal-mistrieħ imsejjaħ Sabbath.

sense_translations.en_definition: Saturday, the cessation or last day of the week.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 星期六，作为停止劳作或一周最后一天来表述的日子。
安息日；宗教传统中用于休息与敬拜的日子。

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa se ssir nhar is-Sibt fid-disgħa ta' filgħodu.
formal.en: The meeting will take place on Saturday at nine in the morning.
formal.zh: 会议将于星期六上午九点举行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Niltaqgħu s-Sibt filgħodu? Mark: Iva, fid-disgħa quddiem il-kafetterija.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we meet on Saturday morning? Mark: Yes, at nine in front of the café.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们星期六早上见面好吗？Mark：好，九点在咖啡馆门口见。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们星期六早上见面好吗？
messages.en: Shall we meet on Saturday morning?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，九点在咖啡馆门口见。
messages.en: Yes, at nine in front of the café.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在日历星期六那格写上 Sibt，再给宗教语境加上安息日标签，用两个场景区分同一词的义项。

gloss_zh: 吾主；我主（对耶稣基督的尊称）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Our Lord, an honorific title used for Jesus Christ.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对耶稣基督使用的尊称，意为“吾主”或“我主”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Titlu ta' ġieħ li jintuża għal Ġesù Kristu.

sense_translations.en_definition: Our Lord (honorific title of Jesus Christ).
sense_translations.zh_definition: 吾主；我主（对耶稣基督的尊称）。

formal.mt: Fit-test tat-talb, it-titlu Sidna jirreferi għal Ġesù Kristu u jesprimi rispett lejh.
formal.en: In the prayer text, the title Our Lord refers to Jesus Christ and expresses respect for him.
formal.zh: 在这篇祷文中，“吾主”这一称号指耶稣基督，表达对他的敬意。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għal min qed tirreferi l-kelma Sidna f'din it-talba? Pawlu: Qed tirreferi għal Ġesù Kristu; hawn tintuża bħala titlu ta' rispett.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who does the word Sidna refer to in this prayer? Pawlu: It refers to Jesus Christ; here it is used as a respectful title.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这篇祷文里的 Sidna 指谁？Pawlu：指耶稣基督；这里用它作为尊称。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal min qed tirreferi l-kelma Sidna f'din it-talba?
messages.mt_standard: Għal min qed tirreferi l-kelma Sidna f'din it-talba?
messages.zh: 这篇祷文里的 Sidna 指谁？
messages.en: Who does the word Sidna refer to in this prayer?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tirreferi għal Ġesù Kristu; hawn tintuża bħala titlu ta' rispett.
messages.mt_standard: Qed tirreferi għal Ġesù Kristu; hawn tintuża bħala titlu ta' rispett.
messages.zh: 指耶稣基督；这里用它作为尊称。
messages.en: It refers to Jesus Christ; here it is used as a respectful title.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Sidna 放进“吾主耶稣基督”的完整称呼中记忆，联想到祷文里的庄重尊称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A breast; also an armored plate worn over the chest for protection.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 乳房；也指覆盖胸部、起保护作用的胸甲。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sider; ukoll biċċa armatura li tintlibes fuq is-sider biex tipproteġih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 乳房。
胸甲；盔甲中保护胸部的甲片。

collocations.en: the breastplate of a suit of armor

formal.mt: Il-katalgu tal-mużew jiddeskrivi s-sidra bħala l-biċċa tal-armatura li tipproteġi s-sider.
formal.en: The museum catalogue describes the breastplate as the piece of armor that protects the chest.
formal.zh: 博物馆目录将胸甲描述为盔甲中保护胸部的部分。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din il-biċċa tal-armatura tissejjaħ sidra? Mark: Iva, tintlibes fuq is-sider biex tipproteġih.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this piece of armor called a sidra? Mark: Yes, it is worn over the chest to protect it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这件盔甲部件叫 sidra 吗？Mark：对，它穿在胸部外面，起保护作用。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.zh: 这件盔甲部件叫 sidra 吗？
messages.en: Is this piece of armor called a sidra?

messages.speaker: Mark (博物馆讲解员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tintlibes fuq is-sider biex tipproteġih.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tintlibes fuq is-sider biex tipproteġih.
messages.zh: 对，它穿在胸部外面，起保护作用。
messages.en: Yes, it is worn over the chest to protect it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“胸部与护胸甲”这组画面记 sidra：身体语境想到乳房，盔甲语境想到胸甲。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a beard.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 长有胡须或蓄着胡子的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu d-daqna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有胡须的；蓄着胡子的。

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt jidher raġel siefi bilqiegħda ħdejn tieqa, b'ktieb miftuħ f'idejh.
formal.en: The photograph shows a bearded man sitting beside a window with an open book in his hands.
formal.zh: 照片中，一位蓄着胡子的男人坐在窗边，手里拿着一本打开的书。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema wieħed hu ħuk f'dan ir-ritratt? Mark: Dak ir-raġel siefi ħdejn it-tieqa; għandu ktieb f'idu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which one is your brother in this photograph? Mark: That bearded man beside the window; he has a book in his hand.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这张照片里哪个是你哥哥？Mark：窗边那个蓄着胡子的男人；他手里拿着一本书。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema wieħed hu ħuk f'dan ir-ritratt?
messages.mt_standard: Liema wieħed hu ħuk f'dan ir-ritratt?
messages.zh: 这张照片里哪个是你哥哥？
messages.en: Which one is your brother in this photograph?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ir-raġel siefi ħdejn it-tieqa; għandu ktieb f'idu.
messages.mt_standard: Dak ir-raġel siefi ħdejn it-tieqa; għandu ktieb f'idu.
messages.zh: 窗边那个蓄着胡子的男人；他手里拿着一本书。
messages.en: That bearded man beside the window; he has a book in his hand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给照片里的人画上一圈胡须，再配上 raġel siefi，用人物外貌把词义牢牢记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Peaceful, with a sense of calm and freedom from disturbance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 宁静、平和的，呈现安宁而不受打扰的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li fih hemm il-paċi u l-kalma, mingħajr taqlib.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宁静的；平和的；安宁的。

formal.mt: Ir-raħal huwa post sielem fejn il-viżitaturi jistgħu jimxu bil-mod u jgawdu l-kalma tal-inħawi.
formal.en: The village is a peaceful place where visitors can walk at an easy pace and enjoy the calm surroundings.
formal.zh: 这个村庄是个宁静的地方，游客可以缓步而行，享受周围的安宁。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nixtieq post sielem fejn nista' naqra ftit. Mark: Ejja noqogħdu f'din ir-rokna tal-ġnien; hawn kwiet ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: I'd like a peaceful place where I can read for a while. Mark: Let's sit in this corner of the garden; it's very quiet here.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我想找个宁静的地方读会儿书。Mark：我们坐在花园这个角落吧，这里很安静。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nixtieq post sielem fejn nista' naqra ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Nixtieq post sielem fejn nista' naqra ftit.
messages.zh: 我想找个宁静的地方读会儿书。
messages.en: I'd like a peaceful place where I can read for a while.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja noqogħdu f'din ir-rokna tal-ġnien; hawn kwiet ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja noqogħdu f'din ir-rokna tal-ġnien; hawn kwiet ħafna.
messages.zh: 我们坐在花园这个角落吧，这里很安静。
messages.en: Let's sit in this corner of the garden; it's very quiet here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象在宁静花园里慢慢读书，把 post sielem“宁静的地方”与放松安宁的感受绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noria or waterwheel used to raise water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来将水提送到较高位置的水轮或水车。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rota li tintuża biex ittella' l-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 提水轮；水车。

formal.mt: Id-dijagramma turi kif is-sienja ddur u ttella' l-ilma minn livell aktar baxx għal wieħed ogħla.
formal.en: The diagram shows how the waterwheel turns and raises water from a lower level to a higher one.
formal.zh: 示意图展示了水车如何转动，并将水从较低的位置提送到较高的位置。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed iddur dik ir-rota fil-mudell? Pawlu: Dik hi sienja; ara kif ittella' l-ilma meta ddur.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is that wheel turning in the model? Pawlu: That's a waterwheel; look how it raises the water as it turns.
colloquial.zh: Maja：模型里的那个轮子为什么在转？Pawlu：那是水车，你看它转动时怎样把水提上来。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed iddur dik ir-rota fil-mudell?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed iddur dik ir-rota fil-mudell?
messages.zh: 模型里的那个轮子为什么在转？
messages.en: Why is that wheel turning in the model?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik hi sienja; ara kif ittella' l-ilma meta ddur.
messages.mt_standard: Dik hi sienja; ara kif ittella' l-ilma meta ddur.
messages.zh: 那是水车，你看它转动时怎样把水提上来。
messages.en: That's a waterwheel; look how it raises the water as it turns.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中播放水轮转动、把水向上提的画面，看到 sienja 就回想这架提水水车。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The plant known in English as rabbit-foot aeluropus, scientifically named Aeluropus lagopoides.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种植物的名称，指兔足獐毛，学名为 Aeluropus lagopoides。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta bl-isem xjentifiku Aeluropus lagopoides.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 兔足獐毛，学名 Aeluropus lagopoides。

collocations.en: the plant known as rabbit-foot aeluropus

formal.mt: Il-kampjun huwa mniżżel fil-katalgu bħala sieq il-qattus, bl-isem xjentifiku Aeluropus lagopoides fuq it-tikketta.
formal.en: The specimen is listed in the catalogue as rabbit-foot aeluropus, with the scientific name Aeluropus lagopoides on the label.
formal.zh: 这份标本在目录中登记为兔足獐毛，标签上写有学名 Aeluropus lagopoides。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jisimha din il-pjanta fuq it-tikketta? Pawlu: Sieq il-qattus; ħdejha hemm ukoll l-isem xjentifiku, Aeluropus lagopoides.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this plant called on the label? Pawlu: Rabbit-foot aeluropus; beside it is the scientific name too, Aeluropus lagopoides.
colloquial.zh: Maja：标签上写的这株植物叫什么？Pawlu：兔足獐毛；旁边还写着学名 Aeluropus lagopoides。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 标签上写的这株植物叫什么？
messages.en: What is this plant called on the label?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Sieq il-qattus; ħdejha hemm ukoll l-isem xjentifiku, Aeluropus lagopoides.
messages.mt_standard: Sieq il-qattus; ħdejha hemm ukoll l-isem xjentifiku, Aeluropus lagopoides.
messages.zh: 兔足獐毛；旁边还写着学名 Aeluropus lagopoides。
messages.en: Rabbit-foot aeluropus; beside it is the scientific name too, Aeluropus lagopoides.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做一张三语植物标签，把 sieq il-qattus、兔足獐毛和 Aeluropus lagopoides 并排记忆，以学名核对同一种植物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To call someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 呼唤某人；出声叫某人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isejjaħ lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 呼唤；叫。

formal.mt: Qabel ma beda l-qari, Pawlu sieħ lil ħuh biex jiġi ħdejh u jisma' l-istorja.
formal.en: Before the reading began, Pawlu called his brother to come beside him and listen to the story.
formal.zh: 朗读开始前，Pawlu 叫他的兄弟过来坐在身边听故事。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ġie ħuk ħdejn il-bieb? Pawlu: Mark sieħ lil ħuh, u ħija ħaseb li kien qed isejjaħ lilu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did your brother come over to the door? Pawlu: Mark called his own brother, and my brother thought he was calling him.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你哥哥为什么走到门边来了？Pawlu：Mark 叫了他自己的兄弟，我哥哥以为是在叫他。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥为什么走到门边来了？
messages.en: Why did your brother come over to the door?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark sieħ lil ħuh, u ħija ħaseb li kien qed isejjaħ lilu.
messages.mt_standard: Mark sieħ lil ħuh, u ħija ħaseb li kien qed isejjaħ lilu.
messages.zh: Mark 叫了他自己的兄弟，我哥哥以为是在叫他。
messages.en: Mark called his own brother, and my brother thought he was calling him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象站在门口出声叫人的动作，用 sieħ lil ħuh“叫了他的兄弟”把动词和对象一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fine or fair, when describing the weather.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容天气晴好、宜人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun sabiħ, meta jingħad għat-temp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 晴好的；天气好的（用于描述天气）。

formal.mt: It-temp baqa' sieħi matul il-ġurnata kollha, u l-attivitajiet fil-beraħ saru skont il-programm.
formal.en: The weather remained fine throughout the day, and the outdoor activities took place as scheduled.
formal.zh: 全天的天气一直晴好，户外活动按计划举行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-temp sieħi llum; immorru mixja ħdejn il-baħar? Mark: Iva, nieħu ftit ilma u niltaqgħu ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: The weather is fine today; shall we go for a walk by the sea? Mark: Yes, I'll get some water and we'll meet by the door.
colloquial.zh: Maja：今天天气晴好，我们去海边散步吧？Mark：好，我拿点水，咱们在门口见。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-temp sieħi llum; immorru mixja ħdejn il-baħar?
messages.mt_standard: It-temp sieħi llum; immorru mixja ħdejn il-baħar?
messages.zh: 今天天气晴好，我们去海边散步吧？
messages.en: The weather is fine today; shall we go for a walk by the sea?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nieħu ftit ilma u niltaqgħu ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nieħu ftit ilma u niltaqgħu ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 好，我拿点水，咱们在门口见。
messages.en: Yes, I'll get some water and we'll meet by the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sieħi 固定搭配 temp“天气”来记，想到晴好天气适合散步，避免脱离天气语境泛用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small roll of tobacco wrapped in paper for smoking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用纸卷起烟草制成、供人吸用的香烟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Romblu żgħir tat-tabakk imgeżwer fil-karta li jitpejjep.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 香烟；卷烟。

formal.mt: Jekk jogħġbok, itfi s-sigarrett qabel tidħol fil-bini.
formal.en: Please put out your cigarette before entering the building.
formal.zh: 请在进入大楼前熄灭香烟。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dan is-sigarrett tiegħek? Pawlu: Iva, se nitfih issa.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is this cigarette yours? Pawlu: Yes, I'll put it out now.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：这支香烟是你的吗？保罗：是的，我现在就把它熄灭。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 这支香烟是你的吗？
messages.en: Is this cigarette yours?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，我现在就把它熄灭。
messages.en: Yes, I'll put it out now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sigarrett 放进“抽一支、熄灭一支”的动作画面中记忆，看到这个词就联想到一支纸卷香烟。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The hand on a clock or watch that indicates the hour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 钟表上指示小时的指针，即时针。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-labra ta' arloġġ li turi s-siegħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 时针；钟表上指示小时的指针。

collocations.en: the hour hand of the clock
the hour hand points to three

formal.mt: Meta l-arloġġ juri t-tlieta eżatt, is-sigħatiera tindika n-numru tlieta.
formal.en: When the clock shows exactly three o'clock, the hour hand points to the number three.
formal.zh: 当钟表显示三点整时，时针指向数字三。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Liema labra turi s-siegħa? Mark: Is-sigħatiera. Fuq dan l-arloġġ hija l-labra l-qasira.
colloquial.en: Lara: Which hand shows the hour? Mark: The hour hand. On this clock, it is the short hand.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：哪根指针表示小时？马克：时针。这只钟上较短的那根就是。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 哪根指针表示小时？
messages.en: Which hand shows the hour?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-sigħatiera. Fuq dan l-arloġġ hija l-labra l-qasira.
messages.mt_standard: Is-sigħatiera. Fuq dan l-arloġġ hija l-labra l-qasira.
messages.zh: 时针。这只钟上较短的那根就是。
messages.en: The hour hand. On this clock, it is the short hand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象钟面上较短的指针缓慢走向三点，把 sigħatiera 和“负责报小时的指针”这一画面绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A conjunction linking two possibilities, either including both or presenting them as alternatives, according to context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 连接两个项目或可能性的连词；依语境可表示两者兼有，也可表示两者择一。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Konġunzjoni li tgħaqqad żewġ elementi jew possibbiltajiet, biex tinkludihom it-tnejn jew tippreżentahom bħala għażliet, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 既……又……；……和……都，表示两个项目均包括在内。
或者……或者……；要么……要么……，表示两个可能选项。

collocations.en: both in Maltese and in English
collocations.zh: 既用马耳他语，也用英语

formal.mt: L-informazzjoni hija disponibbli sija bil-Malti u sija bl-Ingliż.
formal.en: The information is available in both Maltese and English.
formal.zh: 这些信息同时提供马耳他语版和英语版。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Meta nistgħu niltaqgħu? Ben: Nistgħu niltaqgħu sija llum jew għada; agħżel int. Anna: Mela għada.
colloquial.en: Anna: When can we meet? Ben: We can meet either today or tomorrow; you choose. Anna: Tomorrow, then.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我们什么时候可以见面？本：今天或明天都可以，你选吧。安娜：那就明天。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们什么时候可以见面？
messages.en: When can we meet?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu niltaqgħu sija llum jew għada; agħżel int.
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu niltaqgħu sija llum jew għada; agħżel int.
messages.zh: 今天或明天都可以，你选吧。
messages.en: We can meet either today or tomorrow; you choose.

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 那就明天。
messages.en: Tomorrow, then.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sija 想成连接两个选项的桥：语境说“两边都包括”时译为既又，说“选一个”时译为或者或者。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To row or move a boat or other seafaring vessel backwards.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向后划船，或使船只朝后方移动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qadef jew mexxa dgħajsa jew bastiment lura.

sense_translations.en_definition: to row or move a seafaring vessel backwards
sense_translations.zh_definition: 向后划船；使航海船只向后移动。

collocations.en: rowed or moved the vessel backwards slowly
collocations.zh: 缓慢地向后划船或使船后退

formal.mt: Il-baħħar sijja d-dgħajsa bil-mod biex jitbiegħed mill-moll.
formal.en: The sailor moved the boat backwards slowly to move away from the quay.
formal.zh: 水手缓缓地使小船后退，以便离开码头。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif tbiegħdet id-dgħajsa mill-moll? Toni: Il-baħħar sijja d-dgħajsa bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did the boat move away from the quay? Toni: The sailor slowly moved the boat backwards.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：小船是怎么离开码头的？托尼：水手慢慢地使小船后退。

messages.speaker: Lara (游客)
messages.zh: 小船是怎么离开码头的？
messages.en: How did the boat move away from the quay?

messages.speaker: Toni (导游)
messages.zh: 水手慢慢地使小船后退。
messages.en: The sailor slowly moved the boat backwards.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 sijja 时想象船头仍朝前、整条船却缓缓向后退；把“船只后退”作为核心动作，注意它比 sija 多一个 j。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing annoyance or irritation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人感到烦恼、不耐烦或受到干扰的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jdejjaq jew jirrita lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 烦人的；令人厌烦或不耐烦的。

formal.mt: Il-ħoss sikkanti tal-allarm fixkel il-konċentrazzjoni tal-istudenti.
formal.en: The annoying sound of the alarm disrupted the students' concentration.
formal.zh: 警报器烦人的声音干扰了学生们的注意力。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-ħoss sikkanti ġej mit-telefon tiegħek? Mark: Iva, se nagħlaq l-allarm issa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is that annoying sound coming from your phone? Mark: Yes, I'll turn off the alarm now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这烦人的声音是你的手机发出来的吗？马克：是的，我现在就关掉闹钟。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ħoss sikkanti ġej mit-telefon tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ħoss sikkanti ġej mit-telefon tiegħek?
messages.zh: 这烦人的声音是你的手机发出来的吗？
messages.en: Is that annoying sound coming from your phone?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 是的，我现在就关掉闹钟。
messages.en: Yes, I'll turn off the alarm now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手机提示音反复响起，让人皱眉说“真烦”；用这份不耐烦的感受记住形容词 sikkanti。

gloss_zh: 使别人安静下来的人；要求他人噤声的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who makes or requires other people to be silent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 要求或使其他人停止说话、保持安静的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ġġiegħel lil ħaddieħor jiskot jew titlob li jinżamm is-skiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 要求或迫使他人保持安静的人；使别人噤声的人。

collocations.en: the person who imposes silence on the group
collocations.zh: 让小组成员安静下来的人

collocations.en: the role of the person who imposes silence
collocations.zh: 要求别人保持安静这一角色

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-kap għandu r-rwol ta' sikkiet: kull meta xi ħadd jitkellem, jordnalu jiskot.
formal.en: In the story, the leader has the role of the person who imposes silence: whenever someone speaks, he orders them to be quiet.
formal.zh: 故事中，首领扮演要求他人噤声的角色：每当有人开口，他就命令对方安静。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex issejjaħlu s-sikkiet tal-grupp? Pawlu: Għax kull darba li nibdew nitkellmu, jgħidilna nisk onotu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why do you call him the person who silences the group? Pawlu: Because every time we start talking, he tells us to be quiet.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么说他是那个让全组噤声的人？保罗：因为我们每次刚开始说话，他就叫我们安静。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 你为什么说他是那个让全组噤声的人？
messages.en: Why do you call him the person who silences the group?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kull darba li nibdew nitkellmu, jgħidilna biex ma nitkellmux.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kull darba li nibdew nitkellmu, jgħidilna biex ma nitkellmux.
messages.zh: 因为我们每次刚开始说话，他就叫我们别说话。
messages.en: Because every time we start talking, he tells us not to speak.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 sikkiet 配上一张“有人竖起手指叫大家安静”的人物卡；重点记住它指人，而不是安静这种状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device used to reduce or suppress sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于减弱或抑制声音的装置，即消音器或消声装置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat li jintuża biex inaqqas jew irażżan il-ħoss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 消音器；用于减弱声音的消声装置。

formal.mt: It-tikketta tal-esebit tidentifika l-apparat bħala sikkieta tal-arma.
formal.en: The exhibit label identifies the device as a firearm silencer.
formal.zh: 展品标签将这个装置标明为枪械消音器。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu dak l-apparat fil-vetrina? David: Dik sikkieta; tintuża biex tnaqqas il-ħoss.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is that device in the display case? David: That is a silencer; it is used to reduce sound.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：展柜里的那个装置是什么？戴维：那是消音器，用来减弱声音。

messages.speaker: Sara (参观者)
messages.zh: 展柜里的那个装置是什么？
messages.en: What is that device in the display case?

messages.speaker: David (讲解员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik sikkieta; tintuża biex tnaqqas il-ħoss.
messages.mt_standard: Dik sikkieta; tintuża biex tnaqqas il-ħoss.
messages.zh: 那是消音器，用来减弱声音。
messages.en: That is a silencer; it is used to reduce sound.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sikkieta 画成一个旁边标着“音量降低”的装置；与指人的 sikkiet 分开记，这个词的重点是消声器具。

gloss_zh: 使人安静下来的；令人噤声的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing people to stop speaking so that silence falls.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人停止说话、令周围安静下来的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġiegħel lin-nies jieqfu jitkellmu u jħalli s-skiet jaqa'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使现场安静下来的；令人停止说话、陷入沉默的。

collocations.en: a tone that makes people fall silent
an effect that causes silence to fall
collocations.zh: 使现场安静下来的效果

formal.mt: Il-kliem tad-direttur kellu effett sikkieti: il-parteċipanti kollha waqfu jitkellmu.
formal.en: The director's words had a silencing effect: all the participants stopped speaking.
formal.zh: 主管的话产生了令人噤声的效果：所有与会者都停止了交谈。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex waqaf jitkellem kulħadd? Mark: L-għalliem tkellem b'ton sikkieti, u kulħadd beda jisma'.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did everyone stop talking? Mark: The teacher spoke in a tone that made everyone fall silent, and they all started listening.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：大家为什么都不说话了？马克：老师用一种令人安静下来的语气开了口，大家就开始听了。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 大家为什么都不说话了？
messages.en: Why did everyone stop talking?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: L-għalliem tkellem b'ton sikkieti, u kulħadd beda jisma'.
messages.mt_standard: L-għalliem tkellem b'ton sikkieti, u kulħadd beda jisma'.
messages.zh: 老师用一种令人安静下来的语气开了口，大家就开始听了。
messages.en: The teacher spoke in a tone that made everyone fall silent, and they all started listening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“原本大家交谈，某种语气一出现，全场安静”的前后画面记 sikkieti；它形容产生安静的效果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state of being very thin, especially with a gaunt or wasted appearance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体或面容明显消瘦、瘦削的状态，也可指严重的羸瘦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qagħda ta' persuna rqiqa ħafna, b'dehra ta' ġisem jew wiċċ nieqes mill-milja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 面容或体态的瘦削、憔悴。
身体严重消瘦、羸瘦的状态。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, is-sikma fil-wiċċ tal-protagonist turi t-tbatija li għadda minnha.
formal.en: In the story, the gauntness in the protagonist's face shows the suffering he has endured.
formal.zh: 在故事中，主人公瘦削的面容表现了他曾经遭受的苦难。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tinnota fil-wiċċ ta' dan ir-raġel fir-ritratt? Mark: Is-sikma tiegħu; ħaddejh jidhru vojta.
colloquial.en: Maja: What do you notice about this man's face in the photograph? Mark: His gauntness; his cheeks look hollow.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你注意到照片里这个男人的脸有什么特点？马克：他很瘦削，脸颊看起来都凹下去了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: X'tinnota fil-wiċċ ta' dan ir-raġel fir-ritratt?
messages.mt_standard: X'tinnota fil-wiċċ ta' dan ir-raġel fir-ritratt?
messages.zh: 你注意到照片里这个男人的脸有什么特点？
messages.en: What do you notice about this man's face in the photograph?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 他很瘦削，脸颊看起来都凹下去了。
messages.en: His gauntness; his cheeks look hollow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象肖像中凹陷的脸颊，把 sikma 和“瘦削的状态”一起记；它是名词，不是“瘦的”这个形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The absence of sound or speech.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 没有声音或没有人说话的状态；寂静或沉默。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qagħda meta ma jinstema' ebda ħoss jew meta ħadd ma jitkellem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 寂静；无声；无人说话时的沉默。

formal.mt: Wara l-aħħar kliem tal-kelliem, waqa' sikt profond fis-sala.
formal.en: After the speaker's final words, a deep silence fell over the hall.
formal.zh: 发言人说完最后几句话后，大厅陷入了深深的寂静。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'sikt hawn illum! Pawlu: Iva, kulħadd telaq u lanqas ir-radju mhu mixgħul.
colloquial.en: Lara: It's so quiet here today! Pawlu: Yes, everyone has left, and even the radio is off.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：今天这里真安静！保罗：是啊，大家都走了，连收音机也没开。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 今天这里真安静！
messages.en: It's so quiet here today!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kulħadd telaq u lanqas ir-radju mhu mixgħul.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kulħadd telaq u lanqas ir-radju mhu mixgħul.
messages.zh: 是啊，大家都走了，连收音机也没开。
messages.en: Yes, everyone has left, and even the radio is off.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sikt 配上一张“声音归零”的画面：人不说话，收音机也关闭，重点记住听觉上的寂静。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state of calm in which there is little or no movement or disturbance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 几乎没有运动或扰动的平静状态；静止或静谧。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qagħda ta' kalma li fiha ma jkun hemm kważi ebda ċaqliq jew tfixkil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 静止；没有明显活动或扰动的静谧状态。

formal.mt: Id-deskrizzjoni tas-sikta tal-ġnien tagħti lill-qarrej sens ta' kalma.
formal.en: The description of the garden's stillness gives the reader a sense of calm.
formal.zh: 对花园静谧状态的描写让读者感到平静。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara x'sikta fil-ġnien; lanqas werqa ma tiċċaqlaq. Ġanni: Iva, ejja noqogħdu bilqiegħda hawn ftit.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look how still the garden is; not even a leaf is moving. Ġanni: Yes, let's sit here for a while.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你看，花园多么静谧，连一片叶子都不动。詹尼：是啊，我们在这里坐一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara x'sikta fil-ġnien; lanqas werqa ma tiċċaqlaq.
messages.mt_standard: Ara x'sikta fil-ġnien; lanqas werqa ma tiċċaqlaq.
messages.zh: 你看，花园多么静谧，连一片叶子都不动。
messages.en: Look how still the garden is; not even a leaf is moving.

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja noqogħdu bilqiegħda hawn ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja noqogħdu bilqiegħda hawn ftit.
messages.zh: 是啊，我们在这里坐一会儿吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's sit here for a while.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“一片叶子也不动”的花园记 sikta，突出整体静止的画面；与强调没有声音的 sikt 对照学习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel remorse for wrongdoing and turn away from it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为自己的过错感到悔恨，并决意改正；悔悟或悔改。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddispjaċih għall-ħażin li jkun għamel u jiddeċiedi li ma jerġax jagħmlu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 悔悟；为所犯过错忏悔并决意改正。

collocations.zh: 他为自己的所作所为悔悟

formal.mt: Fl-aħħar tar-rakkont, ir-raġel sila minn għemilu u fittex li jpatti għall-ħsara li kien għamel.
formal.en: At the end of the story, the man repented of his actions and sought to make amends for the harm he had caused.
formal.zh: 故事结尾，那个男人为自己的行为悔悟，并设法弥补自己造成的伤害。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fit-test hemm miktub li r-raġel sila. Xi jfisser? Mark: Li ddispjaċieh għall-ħażin li għamel u ried jinbidel.
colloquial.en: Maja: The text says that the man repented. What does that mean? Mark: That he felt sorry for the wrong he had done and wanted to change.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：课文说那个男人悔悟了，是什么意思？马克：就是说他为自己做过的错事感到悔恨，想要改正。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Fit-test hemm miktub li r-raġel sila. Xi jfisser?
messages.mt_standard: Fit-test hemm miktub li r-raġel sila. Xi jfisser?
messages.zh: 课文说那个男人悔悟了，是什么意思？
messages.en: The text says that the man repented. What does that mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Li ddispjaċieh għall-ħażin li għamel u ried jinbidel.
messages.mt_standard: Li ddispjaċieh għall-ħażin li għamel u ried jinbidel.
messages.zh: 就是说他为自己做过的错事感到悔恨，想要改正。
messages.en: That he felt sorry for the wrong he had done and wanted to change.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sila 记成“做错事后回头改正”的动作链：认错、悔恨、改变；这样能记住它是表示悔改的动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of fastening a person to a cross as a form of execution.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把人固定在十字架上处死的行为或刑罚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li persuna titwaħħal ma' salib bħala forma ta' qtil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钉十字架处死；十字架刑。

formal.mt: Il-pittura turi xena tas-silbien, u t-test ħdejha jispjega s-suġġett tagħha.
formal.en: The painting depicts a crucifixion scene, and the accompanying text explains its subject.
formal.zh: 这幅画描绘了钉十字架的场景，旁边的文字解释了画作的主题。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'turi din il-pittura? Pawlu: Turi s-silbien ta' Ġesù; ejja naqraw it-tikketta.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does this painting show? Pawlu: It shows the crucifixion of Jesus; let's read the label.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这幅画画的是什么？保罗：画的是耶稣被钉十字架，我们读读说明牌吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (参观者)
messages.zh: 这幅画画的是什么？
messages.en: What does this painting show?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Turi s-silbien ta' Ġesù; ejja naqraw it-tikketta.
messages.mt_standard: Turi s-silbien ta' Ġesù; ejja naqraw it-tikketta.
messages.zh: 画的是耶稣被钉十字架，我们读读说明牌吧。
messages.en: It shows the crucifixion of Jesus; let's read the label.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象博物馆画作旁的主题标签，用 silbien 标记“钉十字架这一事件”，把事件名和十字架物件本身分开记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To leave quietly or unobtrusively, without attracting attention.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不引人注意地悄悄离开；溜走。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitlaq bil-kwiet mingħajr ma jiġbed l-attenzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 悄悄离开；不引人注意地溜走。

collocations.en: he slipped away from the crowd
he slipped away without anyone noticing
collocations.zh: 他趁没人注意悄悄离开了

formal.mt: Waqt li l-mistednin kienu jitkellmu, ir-raġel silek mis-sala mingħajr ma ġibed l-attenzjoni.
formal.en: While the guests were talking, the man slipped away from the hall without attracting attention.
formal.zh: 宾客们交谈时，那个男人悄悄离开了大厅，没有引起注意。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn mar Mark? Ġanni: Silek waqt li konna nitkellmu; lanqas indunajt bih.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where did Mark go? Ġanni: He slipped away while we were talking; I didn't even notice him leave.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：马克去哪儿了？詹尼：我们说话的时候他悄悄走了，我都没注意到。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did Mark go?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Silek waqt li konna nitkellmu; lanqas indunajt bih.
messages.mt_standard: Silek waqt li konna nitkellmu; lanqas indunajt bih.
messages.zh: 我们说话的时候他悄悄走了，我都没注意到。
messages.en: He slipped away while we were talking; I didn't even notice him leave.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用聚会中突然空下来的座位记 silek：刚才人还在，转眼已悄悄离开，重点是离开时没有引人注意。

gloss_zh: 姻兄弟；姐夫、妹夫或配偶的兄弟

teaching_sense.en_definition: A male relative by marriage, such as a spouse's brother or a sibling's husband.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过婚姻形成的男性亲属，如配偶的兄弟或兄弟姐妹的丈夫；具体中文称谓由亲属关系决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qarib raġel permezz taż-żwieġ, bħal ħu l-mara jew ir-raġel tal-oħt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姻兄弟；按具体关系可译为姐夫、妹夫，或丈夫、妻子的兄弟。

formal.mt: Fl-ittra, l-awtur irringrazzja lil silfu għall-għajnuna fl-organizzazzjoni tal-laqgħa tal-familja.
formal.en: In the letter, the author thanked his brother-in-law for helping to organize the family gathering.
formal.zh: 作者在信中感谢自己的姻兄弟帮忙组织家庭聚会。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jiġi miegħek għall-ikel? Mark: Is-silf tiegħi, Pawlu. Diġà tafu?
colloquial.en: Maja: Who's coming with you for the meal? Mark: My brother-in-law, Pawlu. Do you already know him?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁会和你一起来吃饭？马克：我的姻兄弟保罗。你已经认识他了吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁会和你一起来吃饭？
messages.en: Who's coming with you for the meal?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我的姻兄弟保罗。你已经认识他了吗？
messages.en: My brother-in-law, Pawlu. Do you already know him?

cognitive_memory_aid: 在家庭关系图上画一条婚姻连线，再找到相关的男性亲属，把 silf 与英语 brother-in-law 配对记忆，中文按关系细分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The duck species known as the northern pintail, Anas acuta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种名为针尾鸭的鸭类，学名为 Anas acuta。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' papra magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Anas acuta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 针尾鸭（Anas acuta）。

collocations.en: a sighting of a northern pintail
a photograph of a northern pintail

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinkludi osservazzjoni ta' silfjun u jagħti l-isem xjentifiku tiegħu, Anas acuta.
formal.en: The report includes a sighting of a northern pintail and gives its scientific name, Anas acuta.
formal.zh: 报告收录了一次针尾鸭目击记录，并列出了它的学名 Anas acuta。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jismu dan l-għasfur fir-ritratt? Pawlu: Silfjun. Fil-gwida hemm miktub ukoll Anas acuta.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's the bird in this photograph called? Pawlu: A northern pintail. The guide also lists Anas acuta.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：照片里的这只鸟叫什么？保罗：针尾鸭。图鉴里还写着 Anas acuta。

messages.speaker: Lara (观鸟初学者)
messages.zh: 照片里的这只鸟叫什么？
messages.en: What's the bird in this photograph called?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (观鸟同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Silfjun. Fil-gwida hemm miktub ukoll Anas acuta.
messages.mt_standard: Silfjun. Fil-gwida hemm miktub ukoll Anas acuta.
messages.zh: 针尾鸭。图鉴里还写着 Anas acuta。
messages.en: A northern pintail. The guide also lists Anas acuta.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张三语鸟名卡，把 silfjun、针尾鸭和 northern pintail 放在同一面，再用 Anas acuta 核对它们指的是同一物种。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A species of duck called the falcated duck, identified here as Anas falcata.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种称为罗纹鸭的鸭类，本词条所列学名为 Anas falcata。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' papra magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Anas falcata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 罗纹鸭（Anas falcata）。

collocations.en: a photograph of a falcated duck

formal.mt: Il-gwida tinkludi ritratt tas-silfjun Asjatiku u tagħti l-isem xjentifiku tiegħu, Anas falcata.
formal.en: The guide includes a photograph of the falcated duck and gives its scientific name, Anas falcata.
formal.zh: 这本指南收录了罗纹鸭的照片，并列出其学名 Anas falcata。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jisimha din il-papra fir-ritratt? Pawlu: Din hija silfjun Asjatiku; ara l-isem taħt ir-ritratt.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is this duck in the photograph called? Pawlu: It is a falcated duck; look at the name under the photograph.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：照片里的这只鸭叫什么？保罗：这是罗纹鸭，你看照片下面的名称。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 照片里的这只鸭叫什么？
messages.en: What is this duck in the photograph called?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Din hija silfjun Asjatiku; ara l-isem taħt ir-ritratt.
messages.mt_standard: Din hija silfjun Asjatiku; ara l-isem taħt ir-ritratt.
messages.zh: 这是罗纹鸭，你看照片下面的名称。
messages.en: It is a falcated duck; look at the name under the photograph.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组词和罗纹鸭图片配对记忆：Asjatiku 提示“亚洲的”，但整个鸟名应对应“罗纹鸭”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A species of duck called the Eurasian wigeon, identified as Mareca penelope and also known by the scientific name Anas penelope.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种称为赤颈鸭的鸭类，学名为 Mareca penelope，也使用过 Anas penelope 这一学名。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' papra magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Mareca penelope, jew bis-sinonimu Anas penelope.

sense_translations.en_definition: Eurasian wigeon (Mareca penelope, syn. Anas penelope)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 赤颈鸭（Mareca penelope，异名 Anas penelope）。

collocations.en: a photograph of the Eurasian wigeon

formal.mt: F'dan il-katalgu, is-silfjun Ewropew huwa elenkat taħt l-isem xjentifiku Mareca penelope.
formal.en: In this catalogue, the Eurasian wigeon is listed under the scientific name Mareca penelope.
formal.zh: 在这份目录中，赤颈鸭列在学名 Mareca penelope 之下。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Din il-papra hija silfjun Ewropew? Ġanni: Iva, hekk jgħid il-ktieb; l-isem xjentifiku huwa Mareca penelope.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is this duck a Eurasian wigeon? Ġanni: Yes, that is what the book says; its scientific name is Mareca penelope.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：这只鸭是赤颈鸭吗？詹尼：是的，书上是这样写的，学名是 Mareca penelope。

messages.speaker: Marija (观鸟爱好者)
messages.zh: 这只鸭是赤颈鸭吗？
messages.en: Is this duck a Eurasian wigeon?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (观鸟同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hekk jgħid il-ktieb; l-isem xjentifiku huwa Mareca penelope.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hekk jgħid il-ktieb; l-isem xjentifiku huwa Mareca penelope.
messages.zh: 是的，书上是这样写的，学名是 Mareca penelope。
messages.en: Yes, that is what the book says; its scientific name is Mareca penelope.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张鸭类图卡对照记忆：silfjun Ewropew 对应赤颈鸭，silfjun Asjatiku 对应罗纹鸭，连同修饰词一起背。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Silicon dioxide, a compound of silicon and oxygen with the formula SiO2.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 二氧化硅，由硅和氧组成的化合物，化学式为 SiO2。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-diossidu tas-siliċju, kompost tas-siliċju u l-ossiġnu bil-formula kimika SiO2.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 二氧化硅，亦称硅石。

formal.mt: It-tikketta tidentifika l-materjal bħala silika u tagħti l-formula kimika SiO2.
formal.en: The label identifies the material as silica and gives the chemical formula SiO2.
formal.zh: 标签将该材料标为二氧化硅，并列出化学式 SiO2。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Silika u siliċju huma l-istess ħaġa? Samwel: Le, is-siliċju huwa element, waqt li s-silika hija kompost tas-siliċju u l-ossiġnu.
colloquial.en: Rita: Are silica and silicon the same thing? Samwel: No, silicon is an element, while silica is a compound of silicon and oxygen.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：二氧化硅和硅是一回事吗？萨姆韦尔：不是，硅是元素，而二氧化硅是由硅和氧组成的化合物。

messages.speaker: Rita (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Silika u siliċju huma l-istess ħaġa?
messages.mt_standard: Silika u siliċju huma l-istess ħaġa?
messages.zh: 二氧化硅和硅是一回事吗？
messages.en: Are silica and silicon the same thing?

messages.speaker: Samwel (化学老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, is-siliċju huwa element, waqt li s-silika hija kompost tas-siliċju u l-ossiġnu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, is-siliċju huwa element, waqt li s-silika hija kompost tas-siliċju u l-ossiġnu.
messages.zh: 不是，硅是元素，而二氧化硅是由硅和氧组成的化合物。
messages.en: No, silicon is an element, while silica is a compound of silicon and oxygen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作对照卡：siliċju 配 Si，silika 配 SiO2；看到 silika 就想到“硅加氧形成的化合物”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to silicon, especially as used in the chemical term silicic acid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与硅有关的，尤其用于“硅酸”等化学名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mas-siliċju, speċjalment fit-terminu kimiku aċidu siliċiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 硅的；硅酸的，用于相关化学术语。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tal-laboratorju, it-terminu aċidu siliċiku għandu jinkiteb b'mod ċar.
formal.en: In the laboratory report, the term silicic acid should be written clearly.
formal.zh: 在实验室报告中，应清楚写出“硅酸”这一术语。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif ngħid silicic acid bil-Malti? David: Ngħidu aċidu siliċiku; siliċiku hawnhekk huwa aġġettiv.
colloquial.en: Nina: How do I say silicic acid in Maltese? David: We say aċidu siliċiku; siliċiku is an adjective here.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：silicic acid 用马耳他语怎么说？戴维：说 aċidu siliċiku，这里的 siliċiku 是形容词。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: silicic acid 用马耳他语怎么说？
messages.en: How do I say silicic acid in Maltese?

messages.speaker: David (化学老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ngħidu aċidu siliċiku; siliċiku hawnhekk huwa aġġettiv.
messages.mt_standard: Ngħidu aċidu siliċiku; siliċiku hawnhekk huwa aġġettiv.
messages.zh: 说 aċidu siliċiku，这里的 siliċiku 是形容词。
messages.en: We say aċidu siliċiku; siliċiku is an adjective here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 aċidu siliċiku 整体记成“硅酸”，再标出 siliċiku 的形容词身份，避免与名词 siliċju 混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element silicon, represented by the symbol Si.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素硅，元素符号为 Si。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-element kimiku li għandu s-simbolu Si.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 硅，一种化学元素，符号为 Si。

formal.mt: Is-siliċju huwa element kimiku bis-simbolu Si u jintuża fil-manifattura ta' ċipep elettroniċi.
formal.en: Silicon is a chemical element with the symbol Si and is used in the manufacture of electronic chips.
formal.zh: 硅是一种元素符号为 Si 的化学元素，用于制造电子芯片。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Din iċ-ċippa hija magħmula mis-siliċju? Mark: Iva, u s-simbolu kimiku tas-siliċju huwa Si.
colloquial.en: Anna: Is this chip made of silicon? Mark: Yes, and the chemical symbol for silicon is Si.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这块芯片是用硅做的吗？马克：是的，硅的化学符号是 Si。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.zh: 这块芯片是用硅做的吗？
messages.en: Is this chip made of silicon?

messages.speaker: Mark (电子学老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u s-simbolu kimiku tas-siliċju huwa Si.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u s-simbolu kimiku tas-siliċju huwa Si.
messages.zh: 是的，硅的化学符号是 Si。
messages.en: Yes, and the chemical symbol for silicon is Si.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在元素符号 Si 旁写上 siliċju，再画一块芯片，把“元素硅”和常见用途连起来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act of slipping away quietly and secretly so that other people do not notice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 趁别人没有注意而悄悄离开或偷偷脱身的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħarba bil-moħbi, mingħajr ma wieħed jiġbed l-attenzjoni ta' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次悄悄溜走或偷偷脱身的行为。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-mistieden għamel silka waqt li l-oħrajn kienu qed jitkellmu.
formal.en: In the story, the guest slipped away unnoticed while the others were talking.
formal.zh: 故事中，那位客人趁其他人正在交谈时悄悄溜走了。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Fejn mar Pawlu? Toni: Għamel silka 'l barra waqt li konna nitkellmu.
colloquial.en: Marta: Where did Pawlu go? Toni: He slipped out unnoticed while we were talking.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：保罗去哪儿了？托尼：我们说话的时候，他悄悄溜出去了。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did Pawlu go?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għamel silka 'l barra waqt li konna nitkellmu.
messages.mt_standard: Għamel silka 'l barra waqt li konna nitkellmu.
messages.zh: 我们说话的时候，他悄悄溜出去了。
messages.en: He slipped out unnoticed while we were talking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象聚会中有人轻轻关门溜走，用 għamel silka 配这幅画面；silka 是名词，整组表达表示“悄悄脱身”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The plant Hedysarum coronarium, known in English as French honeysuckle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 植物冠状岩黄耆，学名 Hedysarum coronarium，英语名称为 French honeysuckle。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-pjanta magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Hedysarum coronarium u bl-isem Ingliż French honeysuckle.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 冠状岩黄耆（Hedysarum coronarium），英语俗名为 French honeysuckle。

formal.mt: L-istudenti ħadu ritratti tas-silla u niżżlu l-isem xjentifiku Hedysarum coronarium fin-noti tagħhom.
formal.en: The students took photographs of French honeysuckle and recorded the scientific name Hedysarum coronarium in their notes.
formal.zh: 学生们拍摄了冠状岩黄耆，并在笔记中记录了学名 Hedysarum coronarium。

colloquial.mt: Elena: X'inhi din il-pjanta fl-għalqa? Ġużeppi: Dik hija s-silla; nista' nurik isimha fil-gwida tal-pjanti.
colloquial.en: Elena: What is this plant in the field? Ġużeppi: That is French honeysuckle; I can show you its name in the plant guide.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：田里的这种植物是什么？朱泽佩：那是冠状岩黄耆，我可以在植物指南里把它的名称指给你看。

messages.speaker: Elena (学生)
messages.zh: 田里的这种植物是什么？
messages.en: What is this plant in the field?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (自然导赏员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik hija s-silla; nista' nurik isimha fil-gwida tal-pjanti.
messages.mt_standard: Dik hija s-silla; nista' nurik isimha fil-gwida tal-pjanti.
messages.zh: 那是冠状岩黄耆，我可以在植物指南里把它的名称指给你看。
messages.en: That is French honeysuckle; I can show you its name in the plant guide.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 silla 写在冠状岩黄耆的植物图卡上，再配短语 fjuri tas-silla；用具体植物照片固定词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A Maltese name for the plant species Hedysarum glomeratum.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 植物 Hedysarum glomeratum 的一个马耳他语名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem bil-Malti għall-pjanta tal-ispeċi Hedysarum glomeratum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 学名为 Hedysarum glomeratum 的植物。

collocations.zh: 对 Hedysarum glomeratum 的鉴定

formal.mt: F'din il-lista, l-isem silla qatranija jirreferi għall-ispeċi Hedysarum glomeratum.
formal.en: In this list, the name silla qatranija refers to the species Hedysarum glomeratum.
formal.zh: 在这份名录中，silla qatranija 这个名称指物种 Hedysarum glomeratum。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif niktibha t-tikketta għal dan ir-ritratt? Toni: Ikteb silla qatranija u żid l-isem xjentifiku Hedysarum glomeratum.
colloquial.en: Nina: How should I label this photograph? Toni: Write silla qatranija and add the scientific name Hedysarum glomeratum.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这张照片的标签该怎么写？托尼：写上 silla qatranija，再加上学名 Hedysarum glomeratum。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif niktibha t-tikketta għal dan ir-ritratt?
messages.mt_standard: Kif niktibha t-tikketta għal dan ir-ritratt?
messages.zh: 这张照片的标签该怎么写？
messages.en: How should I label this photograph?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ikteb silla qatranija u żid l-isem xjentifiku Hedysarum glomeratum.
messages.mt_standard: Ikteb silla qatranija u żid l-isem xjentifiku Hedysarum glomeratum.
messages.zh: 写上 silla qatranija，再加上学名 Hedysarum glomeratum。
messages.en: Write silla qatranija and add the scientific name Hedysarum glomeratum.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作双面植物卡，正面写完整名称 silla qatranija，背面写学名，成对复习以免混淆近似名称。

gloss_zh: 植物名：Hedysarum glomeratum；亦指 Anthyllis vulneraria

teaching_sense.en_definition: A Maltese plant name used for Hedysarum glomeratum and also for kidney vetch, Anthyllis vulneraria.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个马耳他语植物名称，可指 Hedysarum glomeratum，也可指英文俗称 kidney vetch 的 Anthyllis vulneraria。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem bil-Malti li jintuża kemm għal Hedysarum glomeratum kif ukoll għal Anthyllis vulneraria.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 学名为 Hedysarum glomeratum 的植物。
学名为 Anthyllis vulneraria、英文俗称 kidney vetch 的植物。

collocations.en: the identification of a plant called silla salvaġġa
collocations.zh: 对称作 silla salvaġġa 的植物的鉴定

formal.mt: L-isem silla salvaġġa jista' jirreferi għal Hedysarum glomeratum jew għal Anthyllis vulneraria; għalhekk għandu jingħata wkoll l-isem xjentifiku.
formal.en: The name silla salvaġġa can refer to Hedysarum glomeratum or Anthyllis vulneraria; the scientific name should therefore also be provided.
formal.zh: silla salvaġġa 可指 Hedysarum glomeratum 或 Anthyllis vulneraria，因此还应注明学名。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Hawn miktub silla salvaġġa. Liema speċi hi? Luqa: Ħares lejn l-isem xjentifiku: hawn qed jirreferu għal Anthyllis vulneraria.
colloquial.en: Sara: It says silla salvaġġa here. Which species is it? Luqa: Look at the scientific name: here they mean Anthyllis vulneraria.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这里写着 silla salvaġġa。它是哪一个物种？卢卡：看一下学名，这里指的是 Anthyllis vulneraria。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn miktub silla salvaġġa. Liema speċi hi?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn miktub silla salvaġġa. Liema speċi hi?
messages.zh: 这里写着 silla salvaġġa。它是哪一个物种？
messages.en: It says silla salvaġġa here. Which species is it?

messages.speaker: Luqa (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħares lejn l-isem xjentifiku: hawn qed jirreferu għal Anthyllis vulneraria.
messages.mt_standard: Ħares lejn l-isem xjentifiku: hawn qed jirreferu għal Anthyllis vulneraria.
messages.zh: 看一下学名，这里指的是 Anthyllis vulneraria。
messages.en: Look at the scientific name: here they mean Anthyllis vulneraria.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给这个名称画两条连线，分别连接两个学名；记住一名两指，阅读时靠学名确认具体植物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A Maltese name for kidney vetch, the plant species Anthyllis vulneraria.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 植物 Anthyllis vulneraria 的一个马耳他语名称；其英文俗称为 kidney vetch。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem bil-Malti għall-pjanta tal-ispeċi Anthyllis vulneraria, magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala kidney vetch.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 学名为 Anthyllis vulneraria、英文俗称 kidney vetch 的植物。

collocations.en: the scientific name of kidney vetch
collocations.zh: silla tal-blat 所指植物的学名

formal.mt: It-tikketta tagħti l-isem bil-Malti, silla tal-blat, u l-isem xjentifiku, Anthyllis vulneraria.
formal.en: The label gives the Maltese name, silla tal-blat, and the scientific name, Anthyllis vulneraria.
formal.zh: 标签列出了马耳他语名称 silla tal-blat 和学名 Anthyllis vulneraria。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu l-isem xjentifiku tas-silla tal-blat? Ben: Anthyllis vulneraria; bl-Ingliż jgħidulha kidney vetch.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is the scientific name of silla tal-blat? Ben: Anthyllis vulneraria; in English it is called kidney vetch.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：silla tal-blat 的学名是什么？本：Anthyllis vulneraria，英文叫 kidney vetch。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: silla tal-blat 的学名是什么？
messages.en: What is the scientific name of silla tal-blat?

messages.speaker: Ben (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Anthyllis vulneraria; bl-Ingliż jgħidulha kidney vetch.
messages.mt_standard: Anthyllis vulneraria; bl-Ingliż jgħidulha kidney vetch.
messages.zh: Anthyllis vulneraria，英文叫 kidney vetch。
messages.en: Anthyllis vulneraria; in English it is called kidney vetch.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把完整短语、英文名和学名排成三列卡片，遮住任意一列练习对应，记牢这个植物名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A Maltese name for pitch trefoil, the plant species Bituminaria bituminosa.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 植物 Bituminaria bituminosa 的一个马耳他语名称；其英文俗称为 pitch trefoil。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem bil-Malti għall-pjanta tal-ispeċi Bituminaria bituminosa, magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala pitch trefoil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 学名为 Bituminaria bituminosa、英文俗称 pitch trefoil 的植物。

collocations.zh: 对 Bituminaria bituminosa 的鉴定

formal.mt: Fil-lista tal-pjanti, silla tal-gidien hija marbuta mal-isem xjentifiku Bituminaria bituminosa.
formal.en: In the plant list, silla tal-gidien is linked to the scientific name Bituminaria bituminosa.
formal.zh: 在植物名录中，silla tal-gidien 对应学名 Bituminaria bituminosa。

colloquial.mt: Eva: Kif ngħid silla tal-gidien bl-Ingliż? Toni: Pitch trefoil; l-isem xjentifiku huwa Bituminaria bituminosa.
colloquial.en: Eva: How do I say silla tal-gidien in English? Toni: Pitch trefoil; the scientific name is Bituminaria bituminosa.
colloquial.zh: 伊娃：silla tal-gidien 用英语怎么说？托尼：Pitch trefoil，学名是 Bituminaria bituminosa。

messages.speaker: Eva (学生)
messages.zh: silla tal-gidien 用英语怎么说？
messages.en: How do I say silla tal-gidien in English?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Pitch trefoil; l-isem xjentifiku huwa Bituminaria bituminosa.
messages.mt_standard: Pitch trefoil; l-isem xjentifiku huwa Bituminaria bituminosa.
messages.zh: Pitch trefoil，学名是 Bituminaria bituminosa。
messages.en: Pitch trefoil; the scientific name is Bituminaria bituminosa.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它与 sillet il-mogħoż 并排写在同一张卡上，再共同连到 Bituminaria bituminosa，记住两名同指。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A set or system of written signs in which each sign represents a syllable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一套以符号表示音节的书写系统，或这套音节符号的集合。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sistema jew sett ta' sinjali tal-kitba li fih kull sinjal jirrappreżenta sillaba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 音节文字；以音节为单位的文字符号系统或符号表。

formal.mt: F'sillabarju, kull sinjal jirrappreżenta sillaba; għalhekk l-istudent għandu jitgħallem ir-rabta bejn is-sinjal u l-ħoss tiegħu.
formal.en: In a syllabary, each sign represents a syllable; the student should therefore learn the connection between the sign and its sound.
formal.zh: 在音节文字中，每个符号表示一个音节，因此学生应学习符号与其读音之间的对应关系。

colloquial.mt: Maja: F'dan is-sillabarju, kull sinjal jirrappreżenta sillaba? Daniel: Iva, ejja naqraw is-sinjali flimkien u nipprattikaw il-ħsejjes tagħhom.
colloquial.en: Maja: In this syllabary, does each sign represent a syllable? Daniel: Yes, let's read the signs together and practise their sounds.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：在这套音节文字里，每个符号都表示一个音节吗？丹尼尔：是的，我们一起读这些符号，练习它们的发音吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (语言学习者)
messages.mt_spoken: F'dan is-sillabarju, kull sinjal jirrappreżenta sillaba?
messages.mt_standard: F'dan is-sillabarju, kull sinjal jirrappreżenta sillaba?
messages.zh: 在这套音节文字里，每个符号都表示一个音节吗？
messages.en: In this syllabary, does each sign represent a syllable?

messages.speaker: Daniel (语言老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja naqraw is-sinjali flimkien u nipprattikaw il-ħsejjes tagħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja naqraw is-sinjali flimkien u nipprattikaw il-ħsejjes tagħhom.
messages.zh: 是的，我们一起读这些符号，练习它们的发音吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's read the signs together and practise their sounds.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一张“一个符号对应一个音节”的表，在表头写 sillabarju；用整张符号表记住这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The division of a word into syllables.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把一个词划分成音节的过程或方法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qsim ta' kelma f'sillabi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 音节划分；将词语分成音节。

formal.mt: L-eżerċizzju tas-sillabazzjoni jgħin lill-istudenti jaqsmu l-kliem f'sillabi.
formal.en: The syllabification exercise helps students divide words into syllables.
formal.zh: 音节划分练习帮助学生把词语分成音节。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għandna nagħmlu f'dan l-eżerċizzju? Pawlu: Irridu nagħmlu s-sillabazzjoni ta' kull kelma.
colloquial.en: Maja: What do we have to do in this exercise? Pawlu: We have to divide each word into syllables.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这道练习要我们做什么？保罗：我们要把每个词划分成音节。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这道练习要我们做什么？
messages.en: What do we have to do in this exercise?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Irridu nagħmlu s-sillabazzjoni ta' kull kelma.
messages.mt_standard: Irridu nagħmlu s-sillabazzjoni ta' kull kelma.
messages.zh: 我们要把每个词划分成音节。
messages.en: We have to divide each word into syllables.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象读词时逐拍击掌，每一拍对应一个音节，用这个动作记住“音节划分”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to syllables or organized in syllables.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与音节有关的，或以音节为单位组织的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mas-sillabi jew li huwa organizzat f'sillabi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 音节的；与音节有关的；以音节为单位的。

formal.mt: Il-qsim sillabiku tal-kliem huwa parti minn dan l-eżerċizzju tal-qari.
formal.en: The syllabic division of words is part of this reading exercise.
formal.zh: 按音节划分词语是这项阅读练习的一部分。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jiġifieri qsim sillabiku? Mark: Tfisser li taqsam kelma f'sillabi.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does syllabic division mean? Mark: It means dividing a word into syllables.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：按音节划分是什么意思？马克：意思是把一个词分成音节。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 按音节划分是什么意思？
messages.en: What does syllabic division mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.zh: 意思是把一个词分成音节。
messages.en: It means dividing a word into syllables.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“音节结构、音节划分”这样的短语里记忆，提醒自己这是描述音节特征的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A Maltese name for pitch trefoil, the plant species Bituminaria bituminosa.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 植物 Bituminaria bituminosa 的一个马耳他语名称；其英文俗称为 pitch trefoil。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem bil-Malti għall-pjanta tal-ispeċi Bituminaria bituminosa, magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala pitch trefoil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 学名为 Bituminaria bituminosa、英文俗称 pitch trefoil 的植物。

collocations.en: the plant known as sillet il-mogħoż
collocations.zh: 称作 sillet il-mogħoż 的植物

formal.mt: L-ismijiet sillet il-mogħoż u silla tal-gidien jirreferu għall-istess speċi, Bituminaria bituminosa.
formal.en: The names sillet il-mogħoż and silla tal-gidien refer to the same species, Bituminaria bituminosa.
formal.zh: sillet il-mogħoż 和 silla tal-gidien 这两个名称指同一物种 Bituminaria bituminosa。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Sillet il-mogħoż u silla tal-gidien huma l-istess pjanta? Pawlu: Iva, iż-żewġ ismijiet jirreferu għal Bituminaria bituminosa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are sillet il-mogħoż and silla tal-gidien the same plant? Pawlu: Yes, both names refer to Bituminaria bituminosa.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：sillet il-mogħoż 和 silla tal-gidien 是同一种植物吗？保罗：是的，两个名称都指 Bituminaria bituminosa。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Sillet il-mogħoż u silla tal-gidien huma l-istess pjanta?
messages.mt_standard: Sillet il-mogħoż u silla tal-gidien huma l-istess pjanta?
messages.zh: sillet il-mogħoż 和 silla tal-gidien 是同一种植物吗？
messages.en: Are sillet il-mogħoż and silla tal-gidien the same plant?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iż-żewġ ismijiet jirreferu għal Bituminaria bituminosa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iż-żewġ ismijiet jirreferu għal Bituminaria bituminosa.
messages.zh: 是的，两个名称都指 Bituminaria bituminosa。
messages.en: Yes, both names refer to Bituminaria bituminosa.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用同一张植物卡收录两个名称，并完整抄写 sillet il-mogħoż，避免把相近名称的拼写混在一起。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A series of connected links forming a chain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由一连串相互连接的环节组成的链条。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għadd ta' ħoloq imqabbda ma' xulxin biex jiffurmaw katina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 链；由相互连接的环节组成的链条。

formal.mt: Il-bieb huwa marbut b'silsla tal-ħadid biex jibqa' magħluq.
formal.en: The gate is secured with an iron chain to keep it closed.
formal.zh: 大门用铁链拴住，以保持关闭。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex il-bieb ma jinfetaħx? Rita: Hemm silsla marbuta miegħu; irridu nħolluha l-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why won't the gate open? Rita: There is a chain fastened to it; we need to undo it first.
colloquial.zh: 马克：大门怎么打不开？丽塔：上面拴着一条链子，我们得先把它解开。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 大门怎么打不开？
messages.en: Why won't the gate open?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm silsla marbuta miegħu; irridu nħolluha l-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm silsla marbuta miegħu; irridu nħolluha l-ewwel.
messages.zh: 上面拴着一条链子，我们得先把它解开。
messages.en: There is a chain fastened to it; we need to undo it first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一串铁环首尾相扣，再用手指逐环描画，把整个词与连续相连的链条形象绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a way that uses something to represent an idea or meaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以某种事物代表一个观念或含义的方式；象征性地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li juża xi ħaġa biex jirrappreżenta idea jew tifsira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 象征性地；以象征的方式。

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti ħawlu siġra biex jirrappreżentaw simbolikament bidu ġdid.
formal.en: The participants planted a tree to symbolically represent a new beginning.
formal.zh: 参与者种下一棵树，以此象征新的开始。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan id-dawl xi jfisser? Lara: Jirrappreżenta simbolikament it-tama.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does this light mean? Lara: It symbolically represents hope.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这盏灯有什么含义？拉拉：它象征着希望。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这盏灯有什么含义？
messages.en: What does this light mean?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 它象征着希望。
messages.en: It symbolically represents hope.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象种树来表达新开始：重点是动作怎样传意，记住它是副词“象征性地”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An artist or writer who follows symbolism and uses symbols to express ideas.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 采用象征主义手法、运用象征表达观念的艺术家或作家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Artist jew kittieb li jħaddan is-simboliżmu u juża simboli biex jesprimi ideat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 象征主义者；采用象征主义手法的艺术家或作家。

formal.mt: Il-poeta simbolista juża l-immaġni tal-baħar biex jesprimi x-xewqa għal-libertà.
formal.en: The symbolist poet uses the image of the sea to express a longing for freedom.
formal.zh: 这位象征主义诗人用大海的意象表达对自由的渴望。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan il-pittur huwa simbolista? Mark: Iva, juża l-għasafar biex jirrappreżenta l-libertà.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this painter a symbolist? Mark: Yes, he uses birds to represent freedom.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这位画家是象征主义者吗？马克：是的，他用鸟来象征自由。

messages.speaker: Nina (参观者)
messages.zh: 这位画家是象征主义者吗？
messages.en: Is this painter a symbolist?

messages.speaker: Mark (导览员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, juża l-għasafar biex jirrappreżenta l-libertà.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, juża l-għasafar biex jirrappreżenta l-libertà.
messages.zh: 是的，他用鸟来象征自由。
messages.en: Yes, he uses birds to represent freedom.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上一位用鸟表达自由的画家：它指运用象征主义的“人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The use of symbols to express ideas, especially in art and literature, or the artistic approach based on this use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 借助象征表达观念的手法，尤用于艺术和文学；也指以此为基础的象征主义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-użu ta' simboli biex jiġu espressi ideat, speċjalment fl-arti u fil-letteratura, jew l-approċċ artistiku mibni fuq dan l-użu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 象征手法；象征意义的运用；象征主义。

formal.mt: L-istudju janalizza s-simboliżmu tal-bieb magħluq fil-poeżija bħala xbieha ta' opportunità mitlufa.
formal.en: The study analyses the symbolism of the closed door in the poem as an image of a lost opportunity.
formal.zh: 这项研究分析诗中关闭的门所具有的象征意义，将其视为失去机会的意象。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex hemm tant bibien magħluqa f'dan ir-rakkont? Pawlu: Naħseb li huwa simboliżmu: jirrappreżentaw opportunitajiet mitlufa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are there so many closed doors in this story? Pawlu: I think it is symbolism: they represent lost opportunities.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个故事里为什么有这么多关着的门？保罗：我觉得这是象征手法，它们代表失去的机会。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm tant bibien magħluqa f'dan ir-rakkont?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm tant bibien magħluqa f'dan ir-rakkont?
messages.zh: 这个故事里为什么有这么多关着的门？
messages.en: Why are there so many closed doors in this story?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħseb li huwa simboliżmu: jirrappreżentaw opportunitajiet mitlufa.
messages.mt_standard: Naħseb li huwa simboliżmu: jirrappreżentaw opportunitajiet mitlufa.
messages.zh: 我觉得这是象征手法，它们代表失去的机会。
messages.en: I think it is symbolism: they represent lost opportunities.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到故事里的关门，想到失去的机会；把这种借具体形象传意的手法记作象征。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The study of symbols and their meanings, or a system of symbols used in a particular field.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 研究符号及其含义的学问，或某一领域使用的一套符号体系。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istudju tas-simboli u t-tifsiriet tagħhom, jew is-sistema ta' simboli użata f'qasam partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 符号及其含义的研究；特定领域的符号体系。

formal.mt: Il-manwal jispjega s-simboloġija tal-mappa, inklużi s-sinjali għat-toroq, ix-xmajjar u l-bini.
formal.en: The manual explains the map's symbology, including the signs for roads, rivers and buildings.
formal.zh: 这本手册说明地图的符号体系，包括表示道路、河流和建筑物的符号。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif nista' nifhem dawn is-sinjali fuq il-mappa? Toni: Ħares lejn il-leġġenda; tispjega s-simboloġija tal-mappa.
colloquial.en: Lara: How can I understand these signs on the map? Toni: Look at the legend; it explains the map's symbology.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：怎样才能看懂地图上的这些符号？托尼：看看图例，它说明了地图的符号体系。

messages.speaker: Lara (徒步伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif nista' nifhem dawn is-sinjali fuq il-mappa?
messages.mt_standard: Kif nista' nifhem dawn is-sinjali fuq il-mappa?
messages.zh: 怎样才能看懂地图上的这些符号？
messages.en: How can I understand these signs on the map?

messages.speaker: Toni (徒步伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħares lejn il-leġġenda; tispjega s-simboloġija tal-mappa.
messages.mt_standard: Ħares lejn il-leġġenda; tispjega s-simboloġija tal-mappa.
messages.zh: 看看图例，它说明了地图的符号体系。
messages.en: Look at the legend; it explains the map's symbology.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把地图图例当作记忆画面：每个图形都有约定含义，合起来就是一套符号体系。

gloss_zh: 水泥铺地；水泥覆盖的地面

teaching_sense.en_definition: An area of ground covered with cement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面铺有水泥的一片地面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Medda art miksija bis-siment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 铺有水泥的土地；水泥覆盖的地面。

formal.mt: Wara x-xita, is-simenta fil-bitħa tista' tiżloq u għandha tintuża b'attenzjoni.
formal.en: After rain, the cement-covered ground in the courtyard can be slippery and should be used with care.
formal.zh: 下雨后，院子里的水泥地面可能很滑，行走时应当小心。

colloquial.mt: Omm: Timxix tiġri fuq is-simenta mxarrba. Ben: Tajjeb, nimxi bil-mod biex ma niżloqx.
colloquial.en: Mum: Don't run on the wet cement-covered ground. Ben: Okay, I'll walk slowly so I don't slip.
colloquial.zh: 妈妈：别在湿水泥地上跑。本：好，我会慢慢走，免得滑倒。

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.zh: 别在湿水泥地上跑。
messages.en: Don't run on the wet cement-covered ground.

messages.speaker: Ben (儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, nimxi bil-mod biex ma niżloqx.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, nimxi bil-mod biex ma niżloqx.
messages.zh: 好，我会慢慢走，免得滑倒。
messages.en: Okay, I'll walk slowly so I don't slip.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象雨后院子里湿滑的一片水泥地，把词义牢牢落在脚下的地面上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A factory where cement is manufactured.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 生产水泥的工厂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fabbrika fejn jiġi prodott is-siment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 水泥厂；制造水泥的工厂。

collocations.en: to work in a cement factory

formal.mt: Is-simenterija tipproduċi siment li jintuża fi proġetti ta' kostruzzjoni.
formal.en: The cement factory produces cement used in construction projects.
formal.zh: 这家水泥厂生产用于建筑工程的水泥。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn jaħdem ħuk? Mark: Jaħdem f'simenterija, fejn jipproduċu s-siment.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where does your brother work? Mark: He works in a cement factory, where they produce cement.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你哥哥在哪里工作？马克：他在一家生产水泥的水泥厂工作。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥在哪里工作？
messages.en: Where does your brother work?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 他在一家生产水泥的水泥厂工作。
messages.en: He works in a cement factory, where they produce cement.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一座把水泥生产出来的工厂，用厂房、机器和水泥袋串起这个词的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having matching parts on opposite sides of a line or around a centre.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在一条线两侧或围绕中心具有相互对应部分的；对称的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu partijiet li jaqblu fuq iż-żewġ naħat ta' linja jew madwar ċentru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对称的；两侧或围绕中心的各部分相互对应的。

formal.mt: Id-disinn huwa simetriku għax il-parti fuq ix-xellug taqbel ma' dik fuq il-lemin.
formal.en: The design is symmetrical because the part on the left matches the part on the right.
formal.zh: 这个设计是对称的，因为左边的部分与右边的部分相互对应。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan id-disinn huwa simetriku? Leo: Iva, iż-żewġ naħat jaqblu bħal f'mera.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this design symmetrical? Leo: Yes, the two sides match like mirror images.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个设计是对称的吗？利奥：是的，两边像镜像一样相互对应。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这个设计是对称的吗？
messages.en: Is this design symmetrical?

messages.speaker: Leo (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iż-żewġ naħat jaqblu bħal f'mera.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iż-żewġ naħat jaqblu bħal f'mera.
messages.zh: 是的，两边像镜像一样相互对应。
messages.en: Yes, the two sides match like mirror images.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在图案中间放一面想象的镜子，两边对应就是“对称的”；本词拼写只有一个 m。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a way that places or forms matching parts on opposite sides of a line or around a centre.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以使各部分在线两侧或围绕中心相互对应的方式；对称地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li jqiegħed jew jifforma partijiet li jaqblu fuq iż-żewġ naħat ta' linja jew madwar ċentru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对称地；以各部分相互对应的方式。

formal.mt: Il-pjanti tqiegħdu simmetrikament fuq iż-żewġ naħat tad-daħla.
formal.en: The plants were placed symmetrically on both sides of the entrance.
formal.zh: 植物被对称地摆放在入口两侧。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn inpoġġi dawn iż-żewġ vażuni? Toni: Poġġihom simmetrikament, wieħed fuq kull naħa tal-mera.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where should I put these two vases? Toni: Place them symmetrically, one on each side of the mirror.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这两个花瓶应该放在哪里？托尼：把它们对称地摆好，镜子两边各放一个。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 这两个花瓶应该放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put these two vases?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Poġġihom simmetrikament, wieħed fuq kull naħa tal-mera.
messages.mt_standard: Poġġihom simmetrikament, wieħed fuq kull naħa tal-mera.
messages.zh: 把它们对称地摆好，镜子两边各放一个。
messages.en: Place them symmetrically, one on each side of the mirror.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象镜子两边各摆一个花瓶，记住它说明“怎样摆”；本词开头的双 m 要写全。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Small edible seeds used in cooking and baking, for example on bread.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于烹饪和烘焙的细小可食用种子，例如撒在面包上的芝麻。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żrieragħ żgħar li jittieklu u jintużaw fit-tisjir u fil-ħami, pereżempju fuq il-ħobż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 芝麻；可用于烹饪或撒在面包等食物上的细小种子。

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta titlob li jitferrex ftit simsem fuq il-ħobż qabel il-ħami.
formal.en: The recipe calls for a little sesame to be sprinkled on the bread before baking.
formal.zh: 食谱要求在烘烤前往面包上撒少许芝麻。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid il-ħobż bis-simsem? Mark: Iva, jogħġobni s-simsem fuq il-ħobż.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like the bread with sesame seeds? Mark: Yes, I like sesame seeds on bread.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你要芝麻面包吗？Mark：要，我喜欢面包上有芝麻。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要芝麻面包吗？
messages.en: Would you like the bread with sesame seeds?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 要，我喜欢面包上有芝麻。
messages.en: Yes, I like sesame seeds on bread.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 simsem 和撒满芝麻的面包画面一起记，再用“芝麻面包、芝麻油”两个搭配巩固。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A drawn line, or a dash or hyphen used in writing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 画出的线；也指书写中使用的破折号或连字符。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Linja mpinġija, jew marka fil-kitba li tintuża biex tifred jew tgħaqqad kliem jew partijiet ta' sentenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 线；画出或写出的线条。
破折号；连字符。

formal.mt: L-istudent għandu jiġbed sing taħt it-titlu u jikteb ismu taħtu.
formal.en: The student should draw a line under the title and write their name below it.
formal.zh: 学生应在标题下画一条线，并在线下写上自己的姓名。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif nikteb 'tal-iskola'? Mark: Ikteb 'tal', imbagħad sing, u wara 'iskola'.
colloquial.en: Maja: How do I write 'tal-iskola'? Mark: Write 'tal', then a hyphen, and then 'iskola'.
colloquial.zh: Maja：“tal-iskola”怎么写？Mark：先写“tal”，再加一个连字符，最后写“iskola”。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: “tal-iskola”怎么写？
messages.en: How do I write 'tal-iskola'?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.zh: 先写“tal”，再加一个连字符，最后写“iskola”。
messages.en: Write 'tal', then a hyphen, and then 'iskola'.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在纸上依次画直线、破折号和连字符，每画一种就读一次 sing，用形状串起三个中文义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An island and city-state in Southeast Asia, located off the southern tip of the Malay Peninsula.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于东南亚、马来半岛南端外海的岛屿和城市国家，中文名为新加坡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Gżira u belt-stat fix-Xlokk tal-Asja, qrib it-tarf tan-nofsinhar tal-Peniżola Malajana.

sense_translations.en_definition: Singapore (an island and city-state in Southeast Asia, located off the southernmost tip of the Malay Peninsula; a former British crown colony and state of Malaysia (1963-1965); official name: Repubblika ta’ Singapore)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 新加坡：位于东南亚、马来半岛最南端外海的岛屿和城市国家；曾为英国直辖殖民地，并于1963至1965年间为马来西亚的一个邦；正式名称为新加坡共和国。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi lil Singapore bħala gżira u belt-stat fix-Xlokk tal-Asja.
formal.en: The report describes Singapore as an island and city-state in Southeast Asia.
formal.zh: 报告将新加坡描述为位于东南亚的岛屿和城市国家。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn sejjer għall-vaganzi? Mark: Se mmur Singapore għal ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are you going on holiday? Mark: I'm going to Singapore for a week.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你要去哪里度假？Mark：我要去新加坡待一周。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where are you going on holiday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我要去新加坡待一周。
messages.en: I'm going to Singapore for a week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Singapore 标在马来半岛南端外海，再配上“去新加坡旅行”的句子，同时记住地名和方位。

gloss_zh: 新加坡的；新加坡人（通常指男性）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of, from, or relating to Singapore.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 新加坡的、来自新加坡的，或与新加坡有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li hu minn Singapore jew għandu x'jaqsam ma' Singapore.

sense_translations.en_definition: Singaporean (of, from or relating to Singapore)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 新加坡的；来自新加坡的；与新加坡有关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: Singaporean (native or inhabitant of Singapore) (usually male)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 新加坡人；新加坡的本地人或居民，通常指男性。

formal.mt: L-istudent Singaporjan ippreżenta proġett dwar il-ħajja f'Singapore.
formal.en: The Singaporean student presented a project about life in Singapore.
formal.zh: 这名新加坡学生展示了一项关于新加坡生活的专题作业。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn fejn hu l-istudent il-ġdid? Mark: Hu Singaporjan, minn Singapore.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the new student from? Mark: He's Singaporean, from Singapore.
colloquial.zh: Maja：新来的学生是哪里人？Mark：他是新加坡人，来自新加坡。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 新来的学生是哪里人？
messages.en: Where is the new student from?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 他是新加坡人，来自新加坡。
messages.en: He's Singaporean, from Singapore.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张卡片区分词性：“新加坡学生”中修饰学生，“一位新加坡人”中直接指人；都联系 Singaporjan。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The grammatical number used to refer to one person, thing, or entity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 语法中的单数，表示一个人、事物或其他实体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru grammatikali li jindika persuna waħda, ħaġa waħda jew entità waħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 单数；语法上表示一个人或事物的数。

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, l-istudenti jibdlu l-kliem mis-singulari għall-plural.
formal.en: In this exercise, the students change words from singular to plural.
formal.zh: 在这项练习中，学生将词语从单数改为复数。

colloquial.mt: Maja: 'Ktieb' hija fil-forma tas-singulari? Mark: Iva, għax qed nitkellmu dwar ktieb wieħed.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is 'ktieb' in the singular form? Mark: Yes, because we're talking about one book.
colloquial.zh: Maja：“ktieb”是单数形式吗？Mark：是的，因为我们说的是一本书。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: “ktieb”是单数形式吗？
messages.en: Is 'ktieb' in the singular form?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għax qed nitkellmu dwar ktieb wieħed.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għax qed nitkellmu dwar ktieb wieħed.
messages.zh: 是的，因为我们说的是一本书。
messages.en: Yes, because we're talking about one book.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象桌上只有一本书，把“一个”与 singulari 连在一起，再用单数变复数的练习加深记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Important or large enough to deserve attention or make a noticeable difference.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 重要到值得关注，或程度大到足以产生明显影响的；显著的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu importanza jew hu kbir biżżejjed biex jistħoqqlu attenzjoni jew jagħmel differenza ċara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 显著的；重要的；具有明显意义或影响的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri żieda sinjifikanti fin-numru ta' studenti li temmew il-kors.
formal.en: The report shows a significant increase in the number of students who completed the course.
formal.zh: 报告显示，完成课程的学生人数显著增加。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sejjer bl-istudju tal-Malti? Mark: Għamilt progress sinjifikanti; issa nifhem ħafna aktar.
colloquial.en: Maja: How is your Maltese study going? Mark: I've made significant progress; I understand much more now.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你的马耳他语学得怎么样？Mark：我有了显著进步，现在能听懂和看懂的内容多多了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的马耳他语学得怎么样？
messages.en: How is your Maltese study going?

messages.speaker: Mark (学习者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għamilt progress sinjifikanti; issa nifhem ħafna aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Għamilt progress sinjifikanti; issa nifhem ħafna aktar.
messages.zh: 我有了显著进步，现在能听懂和看懂的内容多多了。
messages.en: I've made significant progress; I understand much more now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sinjifikanti 放在学习进度图旁：进步明显到值得指出，就说 progress sinjifikanti。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small amount of liquid taken into the mouth in one drink.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一次喝进嘴里的少量液体；一小口饮料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ammont żgħir ta' likwidu li wieħed jieħu f'ħalqu meta jixrob darba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一小口；一次少量喝下的液体。

formal.mt: Qabel beda d-diskors, il-kelliem ħa sipp ilma.
formal.en: Before beginning the speech, the speaker took a sip of water.
formal.zh: 开始演讲前，演讲者喝了一小口水。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-te għadu jaħraq? Mark: Iva, ħu sipp żgħir l-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the tea still hot? Mark: Yes, take a small sip first.
colloquial.zh: Maja：茶还烫吗？Mark：是的，先小小地喝一口。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 茶还烫吗？
messages.en: Is the tea still hot?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，先小小地喝一口。
messages.en: Yes, take a small sip first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象试喝热茶时只轻轻喝一小口，把这个小动作配上 sipp；本条词性是名词，表示那“一口”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To supply water to crops or cultivated land so that plants can grow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向作物或耕地供水，使植物能够生长；给作物浇水或进行灌溉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħti l-ilma lill-uċuħ tar-raba' jew lill-art ikkultivata biex il-pjanti jkunu jistgħu jikbru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给农作物浇水；向作物提供生长所需的水。
灌溉；向耕地或农作物供水。

formal.mt: Fil-lezzjoni dwar il-biedja, il-verb 'siqa' jirreferi għall-għoti tal-ilma lill-uċuħ tar-raba'.
formal.en: In the lesson on farming, the verb 'siqa' refers to supplying water to crops.
formal.zh: 在农业主题的课程中，动词“siqa”指给农作物供水。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qrajt il-kelma 'siqa' fil-lezzjoni dwar il-biedja. Xi tfisser? Mark: Hawn tfisser li tagħti l-ilma lill-uċuħ tar-raba', speċjalment meta l-art tkun niexfa.
colloquial.en: Maja: I read the word 'siqa' in the farming lesson. What does it mean? Mark: Here it means supplying water to crops, especially when the soil is dry.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我在农业课程里读到了“siqa”这个词。它是什么意思？Mark：这里指给农作物供水，尤其是在土壤干燥的时候。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Qrajt il-kelma 'siqa' fil-lezzjoni dwar il-biedja. Xi tfisser?
messages.mt_standard: Qrajt il-kelma 'siqa' fil-lezzjoni dwar il-biedja. Xi tfisser?
messages.zh: 我在农业课程里读到了“siqa”这个词。它是什么意思？
messages.en: I read the word 'siqa' in the farming lesson. What does it mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser li tagħti l-ilma lill-uċuħ tar-raba', speċjalment meta l-art tkun niexfa.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser li tagħti l-ilma lill-uċuħ tar-raba', speċjalment meta l-art tkun niexfa.
messages.zh: 这里指给农作物供水，尤其是在土壤干燥的时候。
messages.en: Here it means supplying water to crops, especially when the soil is dry.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 siqa 配上干燥农田得到供水的画面：近处是给作物浇水，放眼整片田地就是灌溉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The watering of crops or agricultural land to supply the moisture needed for growth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给农作物或农田供水，使作物获得生长所需水分的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għoti tal-ilma lill-uċuħ tar-raba' jew lill-għelieqi biex il-pjanti jkollhom l-ilma meħtieġ għat-tkabbir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给农作物浇水。
灌溉；向农田或作物输送所需水分。

formal.mt: Fi żmien in-nixfa, is-siqi tal-għelieqi għandu jiġi ppjanat bir-reqqa biex ma jinħeliex l-ilma.
formal.en: During a drought, field irrigation should be carefully planned to avoid wasting water.
formal.zh: 干旱期间，应仔细安排农田灌溉，以免浪费水。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Meta se nibdew is-siqi? Pawlu: Kmieni filgħodu, qabel ma tisħon ix-xemx.
colloquial.en: Marija: When shall we start watering the crops? Pawlu: Early in the morning, before the sun gets hot.
colloquial.zh: Marija：我们什么时候开始给作物浇水？Pawlu：一大早，趁太阳还没晒热。

messages.speaker: Marija (农场帮工)
messages.zh: 我们什么时候开始给作物浇水？
messages.en: When shall we start watering the crops?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Kmieni filgħodu, qabel ma tisħon ix-xemx.
messages.mt_standard: Kmieni filgħodu, qabel ma tisħon ix-xemx.
messages.zh: 一大早，趁太阳还没晒热。
messages.en: Early in the morning, before the sun gets hot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 siqi 放进清晨给田地浇水的画面：水流进田沟，作物得到灌溉，两个义项一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of cold, especially a sudden chill felt by the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体感受到的寒冷，尤其指突然袭来的寒意。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensazzjoni ta' kesħa fil-ġisem, speċjalment meta tinħass għal għarrieda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 寒意；身体感到的一阵冷。
