formal.mt: Meta nfetħet it-tieqa, l-arja kiesħa daħlet fil-kamra u ħassejt sirda.
formal.en: When the window was opened, cold air entered the room and I felt a chill.
formal.zh: 窗户打开后，冷空气进入房间，我感到一阵寒意。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ħassejt sirda. Tista' tagħlaq it-tieqa? Mark: Iva, nagħlaqha issa.
colloquial.en: Lara: I felt a chill. Can you close the window? Mark: Yes, I'll close it now.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我觉得一阵冷。你能关上窗户吗？Mark：好，我这就关。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 我觉得一阵冷。你能关上窗户吗？
messages.en: I felt a chill. Can you close the window?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 好，我这就关。
messages.en: Yes, I'll close it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 sirda 时想象窗户突然打开，冷风让你缩起肩膀；这个身体画面对应“一阵寒意”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wind something around an object or entwine flexible things with one another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物绕在另一物体上，或使柔软、细长的东西相互缠绕。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dawwar xi ħaġa ma' oġġett ieħor jew għaqqad affarijiet flessibbli billi dawwarthom ma' xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 缠绕；把绳、线等绕在某物上。
使交缠；把两条或多条细长的东西相互缠在一起。

collocations.en: he wound the rope around the pole

collocations.zh: 他把几条丝带相互缠在一起

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem sirek il-ħabel madwar il-lasta u rabat it-tarf sew.
formal.en: The worker wound the rope around the pole and tied the end securely.
formal.zh: 工人把绳子绕在杆子上，并将绳端系牢。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min sirek dawn iż-żigarelli ma' xulxin? Luqa: Jien, biex nagħmel dekorazzjoni għall-kaxxa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who entwined these ribbons? Luqa: I did, to make a decoration for the box.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁把这些丝带缠在一起了？Luqa：是我，我想给盒子做个装饰。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min sirek dawn iż-żigarelli ma' xulxin?
messages.mt_standard: Min sirek dawn iż-żigarelli ma' xulxin?
messages.zh: 谁把这些丝带缠在一起了？
messages.en: Who entwined these ribbons?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 是我，我想给盒子做个装饰。
messages.en: I did, to make a decoration for the box.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用手模拟 sirek：一条绳绕杆是“缠绕”，两条丝带互绕是“交缠”，用同一动作串起两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of winding something around an object or twining things together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物绕在另一物体上，或把几样东西相互缠绕的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li ddawwar xi ħaġa ma' oġġett ieħor jew li ddawwar affarijiet ma' xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 缠绕或交缠的动作；将某物绕在别物上或使几样东西相互绕合。

formal.mt: Is-sirka tal-ħabel madwar il-lasta għandha ssir bil-mod biex il-ħabel ma jitħabbilx.
formal.en: The winding of the rope around the pole should be done slowly so that the rope does not become tangled.
formal.zh: 应慢慢地把绳子绕在杆子上，以免绳子缠乱。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Din is-sirka taż-żigarelli tidher diffiċli. Ġanni: Ibda b'żewġ żigarelli biss, u ara kif nagħmilha jien.
colloquial.en: Rita: This twining of the ribbons looks difficult. Ġanni: Start with just two ribbons, and watch how I do it.
colloquial.zh: Rita：这样交缠丝带看起来挺难。Ġanni：先只用两条丝带，看看我是怎么做的。

messages.speaker: Rita (手工课学生)
messages.zh: 这样交缠丝带看起来挺难。
messages.en: This twining of the ribbons looks difficult.

messages.speaker: Ġanni (手工课教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ibda b'żewġ żigarelli biss, u ara kif nagħmilha jien.
messages.mt_standard: Ibda b'żewġ żigarelli biss, u ara kif nagħmilha jien.
messages.zh: 先只用两条丝带，看看我是怎么做的。
messages.en: Start with just two ribbons, and watch how I do it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sirka 当成给“绕绳子这个动作”贴的名词标签；脑中播放绕绳过程，记住它指动作本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A shine or bright light, especially one that dazzles the eyes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 光亮或明亮的光芒，尤其指使眼睛感到耀眼的光。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dija jew dawl qawwi, speċjalment meta jgħammex l-għajnejn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 耀眼的光芒；令人目眩的强光。
光亮；物体发出或反射的光辉。

formal.mt: Is-sirġa tax-xemx fuq l-ilma għamlitha diffiċli biex naraw id-dgħajsa.
formal.en: The dazzle of the sun on the water made it difficult to see the boat.
formal.zh: 水面上耀眼的日光让我们很难看清那条船。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Qed tara dik is-sirġa fuq l-ilma? Ben: Iva, ejja noqogħdu fid-dell biex naraw aħjar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can you see that dazzle on the water? Ben: Yes, let's stand in the shade so we can see better.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你看到水面上那片耀眼的光了吗？Ben：看到了，我们到阴凉处站着，好看得清楚些。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tara dik is-sirġa fuq l-ilma?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tara dik is-sirġa fuq l-ilma?
messages.zh: 你看到水面上那片耀眼的光了吗？
messages.en: Can you see that dazzle on the water?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja noqogħdu fid-dell biex naraw aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja noqogħdu fid-dell biex naraw aħjar.
messages.zh: 看到了，我们到阴凉处站着，好看得清楚些。
messages.en: Yes, let's stand in the shade so we can see better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sirġa 想成水面上的一片反光：平常看是“光亮”，亮得眯起眼睛就是“耀眼光芒”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A term expressing very bright or dazzling light.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示光线极其明亮、耀眼的词；本词条保留所给的名词词性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tindika dawl qawwi ħafna jew li jgħammex l-għajnejn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 极其明亮；亮度很高。
耀眼；光线强烈得令人目眩。

collocations.en: the dazzling brightness of the sun
the dazzling brightness of the lights

formal.mt: F'din id-deskrizzjoni, il-kelma 'sirġien' tindika dawl qawwi ħafna li jgħammex l-għajnejn.
formal.en: In this description, the word 'sirġien' indicates very bright light that dazzles the eyes.
formal.zh: 在这段描写中，sirġien 一词表示十分明亮、令人目眩的光。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi tfisser 'sirġien' hawn? Adam: Tindika dawl qawwi ħafna, bħal dak li jġiegħlek tagħlaq għajnejk ftit.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does 'sirġien' mean here? Adam: It indicates very bright light, like light that makes you partly close your eyes.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这里的 sirġien 是什么意思？Adam：表示非常耀眼的光，就是会让你眯起眼睛的那种。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 sirġien 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'sirġien' mean here?

messages.speaker: Adam (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tindika dawl qawwi ħafna, bħal dak li jġiegħlek tagħlaq għajnejk ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Tindika dawl qawwi ħafna, bħal dak li jġiegħlek tagħlaq għajnejk ftit.
messages.zh: 表示非常耀眼的光，就是会让你眯起眼睛的那种。
messages.en: It indicates very bright light, like light that makes you partly close your eyes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 sirġien 时想象舞台灯一下全亮，你立刻眯眼；用“极亮、耀眼”的感受记词，不从词尾推断词性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to earthquakes or the vibrations they produce in the Earth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与地震或地震在地球内部及表面产生的振动有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mat-terremoti jew mal-vibrazzjonijiet li dawn jipproduċu fl-art.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 地震的；与地震或地震振动有关的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina r-riskju sismiku fiż-żona u jipproponi miżuri biex tittejjeb is-sigurtà tal-bini.
formal.en: The report examines seismic risk in the area and proposes measures to improve building safety.
formal.zh: 该报告评估了该地区的地震风险，并提出改善建筑安全的措施。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Xi jfisser 'sismiku' f'dan ir-rapport? David: Ifisser li għandu x'jaqsam mat-terremoti, bħal fir-riskju sismiku.
colloquial.en: Elena: What does 'sismiku' mean in this report? David: It means related to earthquakes, as in seismic risk.
colloquial.zh: Elena：这份报告里的 sismiku 是什么意思？David：意思是与地震有关，比如“地震风险”里的“地震的”。

messages.zh: 这份报告里的 sismiku 是什么意思？

messages.zh: 意思是与地震有关，比如“地震风险”里的“地震的”。
messages.en: It means related to earthquakes, as in seismic risk.

gloss_zh: 地震描记；地震记录技术

teaching_sense.en_definition: The recording of earthquake vibrations using instruments, including the methods used to produce those records.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用仪器记录地震振动的过程，以及制作这些记录所用的技术和方法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ir-reġistrazzjoni tal-vibrazzjonijiet tat-terremoti permezz ta' strumenti, inklużi l-metodi użati biex isiru dawn ir-reġistrazzjonijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 地震描记；用仪器记录地震振动的技术或过程。

formal.mt: Is-sismografija tippermetti li l-vibrazzjonijiet tat-terremoti jiġu rreġistrati u mqabbla bejn stazzjonijiet differenti.
formal.en: Seismography allows earthquake vibrations to be recorded and compared across different stations.
formal.zh: 地震描记使人们能够记录地震振动，并比较不同观测站的记录。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'inhi s-sismografija? Karl: Hija r-reġistrazzjoni tal-vibrazzjonijiet tat-terremoti bl-istrumenti, bħal dawk li rajna fil-laboratorju.
colloquial.en: Marta: What is seismography? Karl: It is the recording of earthquake vibrations with instruments, like the ones we saw in the laboratory.
colloquial.zh: Marta：什么是地震描记？Karl：就是用仪器记录地震振动，比如我们在实验室里见到的那些仪器。

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.zh: 什么是地震描记？
messages.en: What is seismography?

messages.speaker: Karl (实验课教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija r-reġistrazzjoni tal-vibrazzjonijiet tat-terremoti bl-istrumenti, bħal dawk li rajna fil-laboratorju.
messages.mt_standard: Hija r-reġistrazzjoni tal-vibrazzjonijiet tat-terremoti bl-istrumenti, bħal dawk li rajna fil-laboratorju.
messages.zh: 就是用仪器记录地震振动，比如我们在实验室里见到的那些仪器。
messages.en: It is the recording of earthquake vibrations with instruments, like the ones we saw in the laboratory.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象地面一震，仪器就在记录纸上画出波线；把“振动变成记录”的完整画面与 sismografija 绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to a seismograph or to the recording of ground movements.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与地震仪或地面运动的记录有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mas-sismografu jew mar-reġistrazzjoni tal-movimenti tal-art.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 地震记录的；与地震仪有关的。

formal.mt: It-tagħmir sismografiku fl-istazzjon jirreġistra l-movimenti tal-art għal aktar analiżi.
formal.en: The seismographic equipment at the station records ground movements for further analysis.
formal.zh: 观测站的地震记录设备记录地面运动，以供进一步分析。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għandkom dan it-tagħmir sismografiku hawn? Pawlu: Biex nirreġistraw il-movimenti tal-art, anki dawk żgħar ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you have this seismographic equipment here? Pawlu: To record ground movements, even very small ones.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你们为什么在这里放这些地震记录设备？保罗：为了记录地面运动，连非常微小的运动也记录下来。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għandkom dan it-tagħmir sismografiku hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għandkom dan it-tagħmir sismografiku hawn?
messages.zh: 你们为什么在这里放这些地震记录设备？
messages.en: Why do you have this seismographic equipment here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (观测站工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex nirreġistraw il-movimenti tal-art, anki dawk żgħar ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Biex nirreġistraw il-movimenti tal-art, anki dawk żgħar ħafna.
messages.zh: 为了记录地面运动，连非常微小的运动也记录下来。
messages.en: To record ground movements, even very small ones.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个形容词放进“地震记录设备”的画面中记忆：tagħmir sismografiku。再配对记住阴性形式 reġistrazzjoni sismografika，看到不同词尾时仍联想到“与地震记录有关”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An instrument that records ground movements, especially those caused by earthquakes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 记录地面运动，尤其是地震所引起的地面运动的仪器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument li jirreġistra l-movimenti tal-art, speċjalment dawk ikkawżati mit-terremoti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 地震仪；用于记录地面震动的仪器。

formal.mt: Is-sismografu rreġistra l-movimenti tal-art matul it-terremot, u r-riċerkaturi analizzaw id-data.
formal.en: The seismograph recorded ground movements during the earthquake, and the researchers analysed the data.
formal.zh: 地震仪记录了地震期间的地面运动，研究人员随后分析了这些数据。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dan l-istrument? Mark: Dan sismografu. Jirreġistra l-movimenti tal-art.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is this instrument? Mark: This is a seismograph. It records ground movements.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这是什么仪器？马克：这是地震仪，用来记录地面运动。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这是什么仪器？
messages.en: What is this instrument?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.zh: 这是地震仪，用来记录地面运动。
messages.en: This is a seismograph. It records ground movements.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象桌上一台仪器正把地面震动画成曲线，给它贴上 sismografu 标签。配合句子 Dan sismografu，记住这个名词指的是记录震动的仪器本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A recorded trace showing ground motion measured by a seismic instrument.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由地震观测仪器测得并记录的地面运动曲线。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Traċċa rreġistrata li turi l-moviment tal-art imkejjel minn strument sismiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 地震图；记录地面振动的曲线图。

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur analizza s-sismogramma biex jistudja l-moviment tal-art waqt it-terremot.
formal.en: The researcher analysed the seismogram to study ground motion during the earthquake.
formal.zh: 研究人员分析了地震图，以研究地震期间的地面运动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'turi din is-sismogramma? Mark: Turi kif l-art ivvibrat waqt it-terremot.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does this seismogram show? Mark: It shows how the ground vibrated during the earthquake.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这张地震图显示什么？Mark：它显示地震期间地面是怎样振动的。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这张地震图显示什么？
messages.en: What does this seismogram show?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Turi kif l-art ivvibrat waqt it-terremot.
messages.mt_standard: Turi kif l-art ivvibrat waqt it-terremot.
messages.zh: 它显示地震期间地面是怎样振动的。
messages.en: It shows how the ground vibrated during the earthquake.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sismogramma 和屏幕上一条起伏的地震记录曲线联想起来：它指记录下来的图，记忆重点是“看图读振动”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A scientist who studies earthquakes and seismic waves.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 研究地震及地震波的科学家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xjenzat li jistudja t-terremoti u l-mewġ sismiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 地震学家；专门研究地震及地震波的科学家。

formal.mt: Is-sismologu ppreżenta analiżi tad-data miġbura wara t-terremot.
formal.en: The seismologist presented an analysis of the data collected after the earthquake.
formal.zh: 这位地震学家展示了对地震后所收集数据的分析。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jitkellem dwar it-terremoti fl-iskola? Mark: Sismologu li jaħdem fl-università. Maja: Nixtieq nistaqsih kif ikejlu s-saħħa ta' terremot.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is going to talk about earthquakes at school? Mark: A seismologist who works at the university. Maja: I'd like to ask him how they measure the strength of an earthquake.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁要来学校讲地震？马克：一位在大学工作的地震学家。玛雅：我想问问他，人们怎样测量地震的强度。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jitkellem dwar it-terremoti fl-iskola?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jitkellem dwar it-terremoti fl-iskola?

messages.en: Who is going to talk about earthquakes at school?

messages.en: A seismologist who works at the university.

messages.mt_standard: Nixtieq nistaqsih kif ikejlu s-saħħa ta' terremot.
messages.zh: 我想问问他，人们怎样测量地震的强度。
messages.en: I'd like to ask him how they measure the strength of an earthquake.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sismologu 想成站在地震波图前作解释的科学家；再与“地震学的”sismoloġiku 配对记忆：前者指人，后者用来修饰报告或研究。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The scientific study of earthquakes and the propagation of seismic waves through the Earth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 研究地震以及地震波在地球内部传播的科学。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xjenza li tistudja t-terremoti u l-propagazzjoni tal-mewġ sismiku fid-Dinja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 地震学；研究地震及地震波传播的学科。

formal.mt: Ir-riċerka fis-sismoloġija tgħinna nifhmu aħjar kif jinfirex il-mewġ sismiku fid-Dinja.
formal.en: Research in seismology helps us better understand how seismic waves propagate through the Earth.
formal.zh: 地震学研究帮助我们更好地理解地震波如何在地球内部传播。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'qed tistudja dan is-semestru? Luqa: Qed nistudja s-sismoloġija; irrid nifhem aħjar it-terremoti.
colloquial.en: Sara: What are you studying this semester? Luqa: I'm studying seismology; I want to understand earthquakes better.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你这学期在学什么？Luqa：我在学地震学；我想更好地了解地震。

messages.zh: 你这学期在学什么？

messages.speaker: Luqa (学生)

messages.mt_standard: Qed nistudja s-sismoloġija; irrid nifhem aħjar it-terremoti.
messages.zh: 我在学地震学；我想更好地了解地震。
messages.en: I'm studying seismology; I want to understand earthquakes better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sismoloġija 想成一门研究地震的大学课程：课堂里分析地震和地震波，看到这个词就想到“研究地震的学科”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the scientific study of earthquakes and seismic waves.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与地震及地震波的科学研究有关的，用来修饰研究、报告等。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marbut mal-istudju xjentifiku tat-terremoti u tal-mewġ sismiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 地震学的；与地震及地震波的科学研究有关的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport sismoloġiku jinkludi analiżi tad-data miġbura wara t-terremot.
formal.en: The seismological report includes an analysis of the data collected after the earthquake.
formal.zh: 这份地震学报告包含对地震后所收集数据的分析。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qed taqra? Mark: Rapport sismoloġiku dwar it-terremot tal-bieraħ. Maja: Jispjega fejn beda t-terremot?
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you reading? Mark: A seismological report about yesterday's earthquake. Maja: Does it explain where the earthquake started?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你在读什么？马克：一份关于昨天地震的地震学报告。玛雅：里面解释了地震是从哪里开始的吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 里面解释了地震是从哪里开始的吗？
messages.en: Does it explain where the earthquake started?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rapport sismoloġiku 整体记成“地震学报告”：想象报告里画着地震波曲线，用它提醒自己，这个词表示“地震学的”，修饰事物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The science and practice of measuring ground movements caused by earthquakes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 研究并实际测量地震所引起的地面运动的学科与技术。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xjenza u l-prattika tal-kejl tal-movimenti tal-art ikkawżati mit-terremoti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 地震测量学；对地震引起的地面运动进行测量的技术。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kejl tal-movimenti tal-art ikkawżati mit-terremoti.

formal.mt: Is-sismometrija tipprovdi kejl preċiż tal-movimenti tal-art waqt terremot.
formal.en: Seismometry provides precise measurements of ground movements during an earthquake.
formal.zh: 地震测量能够提供地震期间地面运动的精确测量数据。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qed tistudja fil-kors tas-sismometrija? Mark: Qed nitgħallem kif jitkejlu l-movimenti tal-art waqt terremot.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you studying in the seismometry course? Mark: I'm learning how ground movements are measured during an earthquake.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你在地震测量学课上学什么？Mark：我在学怎样测量地震期间的地面运动。

messages.mt_standard: Qed nitgħallem kif jitkejlu l-movimenti tal-art waqt terremot.
messages.zh: 我在学怎样测量地震期间的地面运动。

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sismometrija 联想成一门“给地面震动量尺寸”的课：重点是测量震动，看到课程、方法和测量数据时就回想这个名词。

gloss_zh: 地震测量的；与地震测量有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the measurement of ground movements caused by earthquakes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与测量地震所引起的地面运动有关的，用于描述相关测量、仪器或技术。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-kejl tal-movimenti tal-art ikkawżati mit-terremoti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 地震测量的；与地震引起的地面运动的测量有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Relatat mal-kejl tal-movimenti tal-art ikkawżati mit-terremoti.

formal.mt: It-tagħmir sismometriku jintuża biex ikejjel il-movimenti tal-art waqt terremot.
formal.en: Seismometric equipment is used to measure ground movements during an earthquake.
formal.zh: 地震测量设备用于测量地震期间的地面运动。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għal xiex jintuża dan it-tagħmir sismometriku? Pawlu: Biex ikejjel kemm tiċċaqlaq l-art waqt terremot.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is this seismometric equipment used for? Pawlu: To measure how much the ground moves during an earthquake.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这套地震测量设备是做什么用的？Pawlu：用来测量地震时地面移动的幅度。

messages.mt_standard: Għal xiex jintuża dan it-tagħmir sismometriku?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sismometriku 记成贴在测量设备上的“地震测量的”标签；搭配 tagħmir sismometriku 一起读，提醒自己它是描述设备用途的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An instrument that measures ground motion caused by earthquakes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 测量地震引起的地面运动的仪器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument li jkejjel il-moviment tal-art ikkawżat mit-terremoti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 地震仪；测量地面震动的仪器。

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkaturi użaw sismometru biex ikejlu l-moviment tal-art waqt it-terremot.

formal.zh: 研究人员用地震仪测量地震期间的地面运动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An instrument that indicates the occurrence of an earthquake.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于显示是否发生地震的仪器，称为验震器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument li jindika li seħħ terremot.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 验震器；用于指示地震发生的仪器。

formal.mt: Fil-lezzjoni, l-għalliem spjega kif sismoskopju jindika li seħħ terremot.
formal.en: During the lesson, the teacher explained how a seismoscope indicates that an earthquake has occurred.
formal.zh: 课堂上，老师讲解了验震器如何指示地震的发生。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex għandna dan il-mudell? Pawlu: Biex naraw kif jaħdem sismoskopju. Jindika li seħħ terremot.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why do we have this model? Pawlu: To see how a seismoscope works. It indicates that an earthquake has occurred.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们为什么要用这个模型？保罗：为了了解验震器如何工作。它能指示地震的发生。

messages.en: To see how a seismoscope works. It indicates that an earthquake has occurred.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象模型一震就给出提示，把 sismoskopju 记成回答“发生地震了吗”的验震器。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Sun and the planets and other celestial bodies that orbit it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由太阳及围绕太阳运行的行星和其他天体组成的系统。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-Xemx flimkien mal-pjaneti u l-korpi ċelesti l-oħra li jduru madwarha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 太阳系。

collocations.en: the planets of the Solar System
a model of the Solar System

formal.mt: L-istudenti ħejjew mudell tas-Sistema Solari biex juru l-pjaneti li jduru madwar ix-Xemx.
formal.en: The students prepared a model of the Solar System to show the planets that orbit the Sun.
formal.zh: 学生们制作了太阳系模型，展示围绕太阳运行的行星。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'qed tpinġi? Samwel: Is-Sistema Solari. Issa se nżid id-Dinja.
colloquial.en: Nina: What are you drawing? Samwel: The Solar System. Now I'm going to add Earth.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你在画什么？塞缪尔：太阳系。我现在要把地球画上去。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 你在画什么？
messages.en: What are you drawing?

messages.speaker: Samwel (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-Sistema Solari. Issa se nżid id-Dinja.
messages.mt_standard: Is-Sistema Solari. Issa se nżid id-Dinja.
messages.zh: 太阳系。我现在要把地球画上去。
messages.en: The Solar System. Now I'm going to add Earth.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画太阳和围绕它运行的行星，再把整幅图标为 Sistema Solari，整体记住“太阳系”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In an organized way, following a clear method or plan.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按照清楚的方法或计划，有组织、有条理地做某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod organizzat, skont metodu jew pjan ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 系统地；按照一定方法、有条理地。

formal.mt: It-tim eżamina sistematikament id-dokumenti kollha qabel kiteb ir-rapport.
formal.en: The team systematically examined all the documents before writing the report.
formal.zh: 团队在撰写报告之前，系统地审查了全部文件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif se nsibu l-iżball? Mark: Ejja niċċekkjaw kollox sistematikament, pass pass.
colloquial.en: Maja: How are we going to find the mistake? Mark: Let's check everything systematically, step by step.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们怎么找出错误？马克：我们按步骤，有条理地把所有内容检查一遍吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 我们怎么找出错误？
messages.en: How are we going to find the mistake?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja niċċekkjaw kollox sistematikament, pass pass.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja niċċekkjaw kollox sistematikament, pass pass.
messages.zh: 我们按步骤，有条理地把所有内容检查一遍吧。
messages.en: Let's check everything systematically, step by step.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拿着清单逐项打勾：每一步都有安排，这种做事方式就是 sistematikament。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of arranging information, ideas, or procedures into an organized system.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将信息、想法或程序整理成有组织的系统的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih informazzjoni, ideat jew proċeduri jiġu organizzati f'sistema.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 系统化；把事物按一定体系组织起来的过程。

formal.mt: Is-sistemazzjoni tal-informazzjoni skont kategoriji ċari għamlet ir-riċerka aktar faċli.
formal.en: The systematization of information into clear categories made the research easier.
formal.zh: 将信息按照明确类别进行系统化整理，使研究工作更加容易。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed niġbru n-noti skont is-suġġett? Pawlu: Din is-sistemazzjoni tgħinna nsibu l-informazzjoni aktar malajr.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are we grouping the notes by subject? Pawlu: This systematization helps us find information faster.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们为什么要按主题把笔记归在一起？保罗：这样系统化整理，能帮助我们更快找到信息。

messages.speaker: Lara (学习伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed niġbru n-noti skont is-suġġett?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed niġbru n-noti skont is-suġġett?
messages.zh: 我们为什么要按主题把笔记归在一起？
messages.en: Why are we grouping the notes by subject?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (学习伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Din is-sistemazzjoni tgħinna nsibu l-informazzjoni aktar malajr.
messages.mt_standard: Din is-sistemazzjoni tgħinna nsibu l-informazzjoni aktar malajr.
messages.zh: 这样系统化整理，能帮助我们更快找到信息。
messages.en: This systematization helps us find information faster.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把散乱笔记变成分类清楚的资料体系；用这整个整理过程来记 sistemazzjoni“系统化”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number 10²¹, written as 1 followed by twenty-one zeros.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示10²¹的数，即1后面有二十一个零。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 10²¹, miktub bħala 1 b'wieħed u għoxrin żero warajh.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 十的二十一次方，即10²¹，写作1后面加二十一个零。

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, sistiljun jinkiteb bħala 10²¹, jiġifieri 1 b'wieħed u għoxrin żero warajh.
formal.en: In this exercise, a sextillion is written as 10²¹, meaning 1 followed by twenty-one zeros.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，sistiljun 写作10²¹，也就是1后面加二十一个零。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kemm għandu żerijiet sistiljun? Samwel: Wieħed u għoxrin żero wara l-1.
colloquial.en: Nina: How many zeros does a sextillion have? Samwel: Twenty-one zeros after the 1.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：sistiljun 有多少个零？塞缪尔：1后面有二十一个零。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: sistiljun 有多少个零？
messages.en: How many zeros does a sextillion have?

messages.speaker: Samwel (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Wieħed u għoxrin żero wara l-1.
messages.mt_standard: Wieħed u għoxrin żero wara l-1.
messages.zh: 1后面有二十一个零。
messages.en: Twenty-one zeros after the 1.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作数字卡：正面写 sistiljun，背面写10²¹；记住指数二十一就是1后面的零的个数。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number six thousand (6,000), equal to six times one thousand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数字六千（6,000），即六个一千。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 6,000, jiġifieri sitt darbiet elf.

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, fir-raħal jgħixu sitt elef persuna.
formal.en: According to the report, six thousand people live in the village.
formal.zh: 根据报告，这个村庄有六千名居民。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Kemm hemm siġġijiet fis-sala l-kbira? Ben: Hemm sitt elef siġġu.
colloquial.en: Marta: How many chairs are there in the large hall? Ben: There are six thousand chairs.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：大厅里有多少把椅子？本：有六千把。

messages.speaker: Marta (参观者)
messages.zh: 大厅里有多少把椅子？
messages.en: How many chairs are there in the large hall?

messages.speaker: Ben (场馆工作人员)
messages.zh: 有六千把椅子。
messages.en: There are six thousand chairs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sitt elef 配上一幅六组座位的图，每组一千把；六个一千就是六千，整组词一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number six hundred (600), equal to six times one hundred.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数字六百（600），即六个一百。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 600, jiġifieri sitt darbiet mija.

formal.mt: Id-distanza bejn l-iskola u l-istazzjon hija sitt mija metru.
formal.en: The distance between the school and the station is six hundred metres.
formal.zh: 学校与车站之间的距离是六百米。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Kemm jiswa dan il-kompjuter? Toni: Jiswa sitt mija ewro.
colloquial.en: Rita: How much does this computer cost? Tony: It costs six hundred euros.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这台电脑多少钱？托尼：六百欧元。

messages.speaker: Rita (顾客)
messages.zh: 这台电脑多少钱？
messages.en: How much does this computer cost?

messages.speaker: Toni (电脑店店员)
messages.zh: 六百欧元。
messages.en: It costs six hundred euros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mija 记作一百，想象六张百元钞票来记 sitt mija；再与 sitt elef（六千）对照，分清百和千。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number 46, equal to forty plus six.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数字46，即四十加六。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 46, jiġifieri erbgħin u sitta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 四十六；数字46。

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, għal-laqgħa attendew sitta u erbgħin persuna.
formal.en: According to the report, forty-six people attended the meeting.
formal.zh: 根据报告，共有四十六人参加了会议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm jiswa dan? Mark: Sitta u erbgħin ewro.
colloquial.en: Maja: How much does this cost? Mark: Forty-six euros.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个多少钱？马克：四十六欧元。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个多少钱？
messages.en: How much does this cost?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.zh: 四十六欧元。
messages.en: Forty-six euros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按词序记“六和四十”：sitta 是六，u 是和，erbgħin 是四十，合起来就是四十六。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number 26, equal to twenty plus six.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数字26，即二十加六。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 26, jiġifieri għoxrin u sitta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 二十六；数字26。

formal.mt: Id-dokument fih sitta u għoxrin paġna u jinkludi sommarju tar-riżultati.
formal.en: The document contains twenty-six pages and includes a summary of the results.
formal.zh: 这份文件共有二十六页，其中包括结果摘要。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm għandek żmien? Pawlu: Għandi sitta u għoxrin sena.
colloquial.en: Lara: How old are you? Pawlu: I'm twenty-six years old.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你多大了？保罗：我二十六岁。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你多大了？
messages.en: How old are you?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我二十六岁。
messages.en: I'm twenty-six years old.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按词序记“六和二十”：sitta 是六，u 是和，għoxrin 是二十，合起来就是二十六。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number seventy-six (76), equal to seventy plus six.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数字七十六（76），即七十加六。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 76, jiġifieri sebgħin u sitta flimkien.

formal.mt: Sitta u sebgħin student ħadu sehem fil-kompetizzjoni.
formal.en: Seventy-six students took part in the competition.
formal.zh: 七十六名学生参加了比赛。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm fadal biljetti għall-kunċert? Pawlu: Fadal sitta u sebgħin biljett.
colloquial.en: Lara: How many tickets are left for the concert? Paul: There are seventy-six tickets left.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：音乐会还剩多少张票？保罗：还剩七十六张。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 音乐会还剩多少张票？
messages.en: How many tickets are left for the concert?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (售票员)
messages.zh: 还剩七十六张票。
messages.en: There are seventy-six tickets left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先认出 sitta 是六，再认 sebgħin 是七十；中间用 u 连接，脑中算六加七十就是七十六。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number sixty-six (66), equal to sixty plus six.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数字六十六（66），即六十加六。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 66, jiġifieri sittin u sitta flimkien.

formal.mt: Id-distanza bejn iż-żewġ bliet hija sitta u sittin kilometru.
formal.en: The distance between the two cities is sixty-six kilometres.
formal.zh: 这两座城市之间的距离是六十六公里。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kemm għandna siġġijiet għas-serata? David: Għandna sitta u sittin siġġu.
colloquial.en: Maria: How many chairs do we have for the evening event? David: We have sixty-six chairs.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：晚上的活动我们有多少把椅子？戴维：我们有六十六把。

messages.speaker: Marija (活动组织者)
messages.zh: 晚上的活动我们有多少把椅子？
messages.en: How many chairs do we have for the evening event?

messages.speaker: David (活动志愿者)
messages.zh: 我们有六十六把椅子。
messages.en: We have sixty-six chairs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个六来记：sitta 表示个位的六，sittin 表示六十；sitta u sittin 合起来就是六十六。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number thirty-six (36), equal to thirty plus six.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数字三十六（36），即三十加六。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 36, jiġifieri tletin u sitta flimkien.

formal.mt: Il-proġett tlesta fi żmien sitta u tletin siegħa.
formal.en: The project was completed within thirty-six hours.
formal.zh: 该项目在三十六小时内完成。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kemm għandna bajd għall-kejkijiet? Ġanni: Għandna sitta u tletin bajda.
colloquial.en: Sara: How many eggs do we have for the cakes? John: We have thirty-six eggs.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们有多少个鸡蛋可以做蛋糕？约翰：我们有三十六个。

messages.speaker: Sara (糕点师)
messages.zh: 我们有多少个鸡蛋可以做蛋糕？
messages.en: How many eggs do we have for the cakes?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (厨房助手)
messages.zh: 我们有三十六个鸡蛋。
messages.en: We have thirty-six eggs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象先放六个鸡蛋，再放三十个：sitta 是六，tletin 是三十，u 把两部分连成三十六。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number eighty-six (86), equal to eighty plus six.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数字八十六（86），即八十加六。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 86, jiġifieri tmenin u sitta flimkien.

collocations.zh: 八十六年；用于年龄时指八十六岁

formal.mt: Il-wirja tinkludi sitta u tmenin ritratt tal-belt.
formal.en: The exhibition includes eighty-six photographs of the city.
formal.zh: 展览包括八十六张这座城市的照片。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kemm għandu żmien in-nannu tiegħek? Luqa: Għandu sitta u tmenin sena.
colloquial.en: Nina: How old is your grandfather? Luke: He is eighty-six years old.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你爷爷多大年纪了？卢克：他八十六岁了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你爷爷多大年纪了？
messages.en: How old is your grandfather?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 他八十六岁了。
messages.en: He is eighty-six years old.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把八十六倒过来拆读成“六和八十”：sitta 对应六，tmenin 对应八十，中间的 u 表示和。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number fifty-six (56), equal to fifty plus six.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数字五十六（56），即五十加六。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 56, jiġifieri ħamsin u sitta flimkien.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinkludi sitta u ħamsin paġna.
formal.en: The report contains fifty-six pages.
formal.zh: 这份报告共有五十六页。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kemm jiswa dan il-ktieb? Mark: Jiswa sitta u ħamsin ewro.
colloquial.en: Anna: How much does this book cost? Mark: It costs fifty-six euros.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这本书多少钱？马克：五十六欧元。

messages.speaker: Anna (顾客)
messages.zh: 这本书多少钱？
messages.en: How much does this book cost?

messages.speaker: Mark (书店店员)
messages.zh: 五十六欧元。
messages.en: It costs fifty-six euros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个数拆成 sitta（六）＋u（和）＋ħamsin（五十），按“六和五十”的顺序记住五十六。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number sixteen thousand (16,000), equal to sixteen times one thousand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数字一万六千（16,000），即十六个一千。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 16,000, jiġifieri sittax-il darba elf.

formal.mt: Il-librerija għandha sittax-il elf ktieb fil-kollezzjoni tagħha.
formal.en: The library has sixteen thousand books in its collection.
formal.zh: 这座图书馆收藏了一万六千本书。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Kemm trid tfaddal biex tixtri karozza? Simon: Irrid infaddal sittax-il elf ewro.
colloquial.en: Elena: How much do you want to save to buy a car? Simon: I want to save sixteen thousand euros.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：你想存多少钱买车？西蒙：我想存一万六千欧元。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm trid tfaddal biex tixtri karozza?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm trid tfaddal biex tixtri karozza?
messages.zh: 你想存多少钱买车？
messages.en: How much do you want to save to buy a car?

messages.speaker: Simon (朋友)
messages.zh: 我想存一万六千欧元。
messages.en: I want to save sixteen thousand euros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象十六叠钞票，每叠一千：sittax-il elf 就是十六个一千，换成中文计数是一万六千。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The value, usefulness, or worth that something has.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某事物具有的价值、用处或值得重视的程度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-valur jew l-utilità li għandha xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 价值；某事物所具有的用处或重要性。
值得的程度；某事物值得肯定、珍惜或付出努力的价值。

formal.mt: Dan ir-rapport huwa ta' siwi għall-istudenti li qed jistudjaw is-suġġett.
formal.en: This report is useful to students who are studying the subject.
formal.zh: 这份报告对正在学习这一课题的学生很有用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-ktieb huwa ta' siwi? Mark: Iva, fih ħafna eżempji li jgħinuk tifhem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this book useful? Mark: Yes, it has many examples that help you understand.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这本书有用吗？马克：有，里面有很多帮助你理解的例子。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这本书有用吗？
messages.en: Is this book useful?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, fih ħafna eżempji li jgħinuk tifhem.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, fih ħafna eżempji li jgħinuk tifhem.
messages.zh: 有，里面有很多帮助你理解的例子。
messages.en: Yes, it has many examples that help you understand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把一本能帮你解题的书想成“有价值、有用处”：ta' siwi 表示有用，bla siwi 表示无用，成对记忆更牢。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An assessment made to judge the quality, value, or results of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为判断某事物的质量、价值或成果而作出的评价或评估。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġudizzju dwar il-kwalità, il-valur jew ir-riżultati ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次评价或评估；对某事物的质量、价值或成果作出的判断。

formal.mt: Is-siwja tal-proġett tinkludi kummenti dwar il-kwalità tax-xogħol u r-riżultati tiegħu.
formal.en: The evaluation of the project includes comments on the quality of the work and its results.
formal.zh: 该项目的评估包括对工作质量及其成果的评论。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qrajt is-siwja tal-proġett tagħna? Mark: Iva, il-kummenti jgħidulna x'nistgħu ntejbu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you read the evaluation of our project? Mark: Yes, the comments tell us what we can improve.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你读过我们项目的评估了吗？马克：读过，评语告诉我们哪些地方可以改进。

messages.speaker: Maja (项目组同学)
messages.zh: 你读过我们项目的评估了吗？
messages.en: Have you read the evaluation of our project?

messages.speaker: Mark (项目组同学)
messages.zh: 读过，评语告诉我们哪些地方可以改进。
messages.en: Yes, the comments tell us what we can improve.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 siwja 和一张写有优点、问题及改进建议的评价表联系起来，记住它表示一次“评估”。

gloss_zh: 西西里岛；西西里自治区

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sicily, the largest island in the Mediterranean Sea and an autonomous region of Italy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 西西里，地中海最大的岛屿，也是意大利的一个自治区。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-akbar gżira fil-Baħar Mediterran u reġjun awtonomu tal-Italja.

sense_translations.en_definition: Sicily (the largest island in the Mediterranean Sea, an autonomous region of Italy, close to Africa and separated from Tunisia and Libya by the Strait of Sicily)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 西西里岛（地中海最大的岛屿，为意大利的一个自治区，靠近非洲，与突尼斯和利比亚之间隔着西西里海峡）。

collocations.zh: 一次前往西西里的旅行

formal.mt: Siċilja hija l-akbar gżira fil-Baħar Mediterran u reġjun awtonomu tal-Italja.
formal.en: Sicily is the largest island in the Mediterranean Sea and an autonomous region of Italy.
formal.zh: 西西里岛是地中海最大的岛屿，也是意大利的一个自治区。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn tixtieq tmur għall-vaganzi? Mark: Nixtieq immur Siċilja u nqatta' ftit jiem hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where would you like to go on holiday? Mark: I'd like to go to Sicily and spend a few days there.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你想去哪里度假？Mark：我想去西西里，在那里待几天。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where would you like to go on holiday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nixtieq immur Siċilja u nqatta' ftit jiem hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Nixtieq immur Siċilja u nqatta' ftit jiem hemm.
messages.zh: 我想去西西里，在那里待几天。
messages.en: I'd like to go to Sicily and spend a few days there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Siċilja 写在地中海地图的西西里岛旁，并与中文地名配对；注意 ċ 上的小点也是拼写的一部分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to Sicily or its people and culture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 西西里的；与西西里岛、当地居民或文化有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' Siċilja, man-nies tagħha jew mal-kultura tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 西西里的；与西西里岛、当地居民或文化有关的。
西西里人；来自西西里的人。

collocations.en: a Sicilian who lives in Malta
collocations.zh: 一位住在马耳他的西西里人

formal.mt: L-artiklu jiddeskrivi l-ikel Siċiljan u jinkludi intervista ma' Siċiljan li jgħix Malta.
formal.en: The article describes Sicilian food and includes an interview with a Sicilian who lives in Malta.
formal.zh: 这篇文章介绍了西西里食物，并收录了对一位住在马耳他的西西里人的采访。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qed issajjar illum? Mark: Ikel Siċiljan. Il-ħabib tiegħi hu Siċiljan u tani r-riċetta.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you cooking today? Mark: Sicilian food. My friend is Sicilian and gave me the recipe.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你今天在做什么菜？Mark：西西里菜。我朋友是西西里人，食谱是他给我的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天在做什么菜？
messages.en: What are you cooking today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ikel Siċiljan. Il-ħabib tiegħi hu Siċiljan u tani r-riċetta.
messages.mt_standard: Ikel Siċiljan. Il-ħabib tiegħi hu Siċiljan u tani r-riċetta.
messages.zh: 西西里菜。我朋友是西西里人，食谱是他给我的。
messages.en: Sicilian food. My friend is Sicilian and gave me the recipe.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个词组分开记：ikel Siċiljan 是西西里食物，Siċiljan li jgħix Malta 是住在马耳他的西西里人；修饰事物与指人分别对应两个词性。

gloss_zh: 国际象棋棋子；国际象棋

teaching_sense.en_definition: A piece used in chess; also the game of chess itself.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 国际象棋中使用的棋子；也可指国际象棋这一游戏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa li tintuża fil-logħba tal-iskakk; ukoll il-logħba nnifisha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 国际象棋棋子；在国际象棋棋盘上移动的一枚棋子。
国际象棋；双方按照规则在棋盘上移动棋子进行的游戏。

collocations.zh: 一枚白色国际象棋棋子

formal.mt: L-istudent poġġa skakk abjad fuq l-iskakkiera qabel ma bdiet il-logħba.
formal.en: The student placed a white chess piece on the chessboard before the game began.
formal.zh: 学生在棋局开始前，把一枚白色国际象棋棋子放到了棋盘上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tilgħab logħba tal-iskakk? Mark: Iva, imma l-ewwel għinni npoġġi l-biċċiet f'posthom.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want to play a game of chess? Mark: Yes, but first help me put the pieces in their places.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想下一局国际象棋吗？马克：想，不过先帮我把棋子摆好。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想下一局国际象棋吗？
messages.en: Do you want to play a game of chess?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma l-ewwel għinni npoġġi l-biċċiet f'posthom.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma l-ewwel għinni npoġġi l-biċċiet f'posthom.
messages.zh: 想，不过先帮我把棋子摆好。
messages.en: Yes, but first help me put the pieces in their places.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象先拿起一枚棋子，再开始一局棋：skakk 可指手中的“棋子”，也可指正在玩的“国际象棋”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The board on which a game of chess is played.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 进行国际象棋对弈时，用来摆放和移动棋子的棋盘。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-bord li fuqu jitqiegħdu u jitmexxew il-biċċiet fil-logħba tal-iskakk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 国际象棋棋盘；国际象棋对弈中用于摆放和移动棋子的方格棋盘。

formal.mt: L-għalliem poġġa l-iskakkiera fuq il-mejda biex juri lill-istudenti kif jitqiegħdu l-biċċiet.
formal.en: The teacher placed the chessboard on the table to show the students how the pieces are arranged.
formal.zh: 老师把国际象棋棋盘放在桌上，向学生展示棋子的摆放方法。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hi l-iskakkiera? Mark: Fil-kaxxa ħdejn il-mejda; ġibha biex nilagħbu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the chessboard? Mark: In the box beside the table; bring it so we can play.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：国际象棋棋盘在哪里？马克：在桌子旁边的盒子里，拿过来，我们下棋吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 国际象棋棋盘在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the chessboard?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-kaxxa ħdejn il-mejda; ġibha biex nilagħbu.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-kaxxa ħdejn il-mejda; ġibha biex nilagħbu.
messages.zh: 在桌子旁边的盒子里，拿过来，我们下棋吧。
messages.en: In the box beside the table; bring it so we can play.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 skakkiera 想成承托所有棋子的方格舞台；与 skakk“棋子”一起记，区分棋子和棋盘。

gloss_zh: 将死；国际象棋中的绝杀局面

teaching_sense.en_definition: A position in chess in which a king is under attack and there is no legal move that can save it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 国际象棋中王受到攻击，且没有任何合法走法可以解除这一威胁的将死局面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qagħda fil-logħba tal-iskakk fejn ir-re jkun mhedded u ma jkun hemm ebda mossa legali li ssalvah.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将死；国际象棋中王被将军，且无法通过任何合法走法解除威胁的局面。

formal.mt: Il-logħba ntemmet bi skakkumattu, għax ma kien hemm ebda mossa legali li setgħet issalva lir-re.
formal.en: The game ended in checkmate because there was no legal move that could save the king.
formal.zh: 棋局以将死结束，因为已经没有任何合法走法能够救王。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan skakkumattu? Mark: Iva, ir-re tiegħek huwa mhedded u ma tista' ssalvah b'ebda mossa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this checkmate? Mark: Yes, your king is under attack and you cannot save it with any move.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这是将死了吗？马克：是的，你的王正受到攻击，而且你无论怎么走都救不了它。

messages.speaker: Maja (棋友)
messages.zh: 这是将死了吗？
messages.en: Is this checkmate?

messages.speaker: Mark (棋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ir-re tiegħek huwa mhedded u ma tista' ssalvah b'ebda mossa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ir-re tiegħek huwa mhedded u ma tista' ssalvah b'ebda mossa.
messages.zh: 是的，你的王正受到攻击，而且你无论怎么走都救不了它。
messages.en: Yes, your king is under attack and you cannot save it with any move.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象棋盘上的王受到攻击，所有合法解围办法都失败了；把这个终局画面与 skakkumattu“将死”绑定。

gloss_zh: 桨销；桨架；船肋构件；狗母鱼

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fitting on a boat that supports an oar while rowing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 船上用于支承船桨、帮助划桨的桨销或桨架。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa mwaħħla ma' dgħajsa li żżomm il-moqdief waqt il-qdif.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 船舶用语：桨销、桨架或桨叉，即支承船桨的装置；也指船肋构件。
狗母鱼；一种鱼的名称。

collocations.en: a lizardfish caught in the net
collocations.zh: 网中捕获的一条狗母鱼

formal.mt: Qabel ma bdiet il-ħarġa bid-dgħajsa, l-għalliem iċċekkja li l-iskalm kien imwaħħal sew.
formal.en: Before the boat outing began, the instructor checked that the oarlock was securely attached.
formal.zh: 乘船活动开始前，教练检查了桨架是否安装牢固。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-moqdief qed jiċċaqlaq daqshekk? Mark: L-iskalm mhux imwaħħal sew; ejja niċċekkjawh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the oar moving so much? Mark: The oarlock is not securely attached; let's check it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：船桨为什么晃得这么厉害？马克：桨架没有固定好，我们检查一下吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (划船学员)
messages.zh: 船桨为什么晃得这么厉害？
messages.en: Why is the oar moving so much?

messages.speaker: Mark (划船教练)
messages.mt_spoken: L-iskalm mhux imwaħħal sew; ejja niċċekkjawh.
messages.mt_standard: L-iskalm mhux imwaħħal sew; ejja niċċekkjawh.
messages.zh: 桨架没有固定好，我们检查一下吧。
messages.en: The oarlock is not securely attached; let's check it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 skalm 做两张情境卡：船边固定船桨的装置，以及渔网里的狗母鱼；用场景区分两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element called scandium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素钪的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Element kimiku magħruf bl-isem ta' skandju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钪；一种化学元素。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tal-laboratorju jsemmi l-iskandju fost l-elementi identifikati fil-kampjun.
formal.en: The laboratory report lists scandium among the elements identified in the sample.
formal.zh: 实验室报告将钪列为样品中检测出的元素之一。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu l-iskandju? Mark: Huwa element kimiku; qed naqra dwaru għall-lezzjoni tal-kimika.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is scandium? Mark: It is a chemical element; I am reading about it for chemistry class.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：钪是什么？马克：是一种化学元素，我正在为化学课阅读有关它的资料。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 钪是什么？
messages.en: What is scandium?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa element kimiku; qed naqra dwaru għall-lezzjoni tal-kimika.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa element kimiku; qed naqra dwaru għall-lezzjoni tal-kimika.
messages.zh: 是一种化学元素，我正在为化学课阅读有关它的资料。
messages.en: It is a chemical element; I am reading about it for chemistry class.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张三语元素卡，把 skandju、scandium 和“钪”并排写下，再用“钪样品”这个短语巩固记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device that scans paper documents to create digital copies.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 扫描纸质文件并生成数字副本的设备。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat li jiskennja dokumenti fuq il-karta biex joħloq kopji diġitali tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扫描仪；用于扫描文件并将其转换成数字形式的设备。

formal.mt: L-uffiċċju juża skaner biex joħloq kopji diġitali tad-dokumenti qabel ma jaħżinhom.
formal.en: The office uses a scanner to create digital copies of the documents before storing them.
formal.zh: 办公室使用扫描仪，在存放文件前制作其数字副本。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nista' nuża l-iskaner għal dan id-dokument? Mark: Iva, poġġih fuq il-ħġieġ u agħfas il-buttuna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can I use the scanner for this document? Mark: Yes, place it on the glass and press the button.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我可以用扫描仪扫描这份文件吗？马克：可以，把文件放在玻璃板上，然后按下按钮。

messages.speaker: Maja (办公室职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nuża l-iskaner għal dan id-dokument?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nuża l-iskaner għal dan id-dokument?
messages.zh: 我可以用扫描仪扫描这份文件吗？
messages.en: Can I use the scanner for this document?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, poġġih fuq il-ħġieġ u agħfas il-buttuna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, poġġih fuq il-ħġieġ u agħfas il-buttuna.
messages.zh: 可以，把文件放在玻璃板上，然后按下按钮。
messages.en: Yes, place it on the glass and press the button.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 skaner 与英语 scanner 对照着读，再想象纸质文件经过设备变成电脑里的数字副本，记住“扫描仪”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A digital image of a document or picture made by scanning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过扫描文件或图片得到的数字图像，即扫描件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Immaġni diġitali ta' dokument jew stampa magħmula permezz ta' skannjar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扫描；扫描所得的图像或文件。

formal.mt: Jekk jogħġbok ibgħat skann ċar tad-dokument mal-applikazzjoni.
formal.en: Please send a clear scan of the document with the application.
formal.zh: 请随申请一并发送该文件的清晰扫描件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek skann tad-dokument? Mark: Iva, nibgħathulek issa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have a scan of the document? Mark: Yes, I'll send it to you now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你有那份文件的扫描件吗？马克：有，我现在发给你。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 你有那份文件的扫描件吗？
messages.en: Do you have a scan of the document?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 有，我现在发给你。
messages.en: Yes, I'll send it to you now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 skann 与英文 scan 对照记，再想象纸张变成手机里的扫描件；本条把它作为名词使用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To use a scanner to make a digital copy of a document or picture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用扫描设备，把文件或图片转换成数字副本。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Juża skaner biex jagħmel kopja diġitali ta' dokument jew stampa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扫描；用扫描设备读取文件或图像。

formal.mt: L-impjegat skannja d-dokument u bagħat il-kopja diġitali lill-klijent.
formal.en: The employee scanned the document and sent the digital copy to the client.
formal.zh: 员工扫描了文件，并把数字副本发送给客户。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Skannja dan ir-ritratt, jekk jogħġbok. Mark: Tajjeb, u nibgħatlek il-kopja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Scan this photograph, please. Mark: All right, and I'll send you the copy.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：请扫描一下这张照片。马克：好的，我再把副本发给你。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 请扫描一下这张照片。
messages.en: Scan this photograph, please.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 好的，我再把副本发给你。
messages.en: All right, and I'll send you the copy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用动作区分这两个词：skann 是扫描件，skannja 是进行扫描；想象手指按下扫描按钮。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who is lazy and avoids work or effort.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不愿工作或付出力气、总想躲开事情的懒人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna għażżiena li tevita x-xogħol jew l-isforz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 懒人；不愿干活或付出努力的人。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-karattru ewlieni huwa skansafaċendi li jħalli x-xogħol kollu f'idejn ħaddieħor.
formal.en: In the story, the main character is a lazy person who leaves all the work to others.
formal.zh: 故事中的主人公是个懒人，把所有工作都留给别人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tkunx skansafaċendi; għinni nnaddaf il-mejda. Mark: Tajjeb, niġi ngħinek issa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Don't be lazy; help me clean the table. Mark: All right, I'll come and help you now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：别当懒人，帮我把桌子擦干净。马克：好，我现在就来帮你。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 别当懒人，帮我把桌子擦干净。
messages.en: Don't be lazy; help me clean the table.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 好，我现在就来帮你。
messages.en: All right, I'll come and help you now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给这个长词配一幅画：大家忙着收拾，一个人却躺着不动；把整词记成对这个懒人的称呼。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of keeping away from something or preventing involvement in it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 避开某事物或避免卷入某事的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jevita xi ħaġa jew iżomm ruħu 'l bogħod minnha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 回避；避免；有意避开某事物的行为。

formal.mt: L-iskansament ta' konflitti bla bżonn jgħin biex jinżamm ambjent ta' xogħol kalm.
formal.en: Avoiding unnecessary conflicts helps maintain a calm working environment.
formal.zh: 避免不必要的冲突有助于维持平静的工作环境。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan hu skansament tar-responsabbiltà! Mark: Għandek raġun; nitkellem magħhom illum stess.
colloquial.en: Maja: This is avoiding responsibility! Mark: You're right; I'll speak to them today.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这就是在逃避责任！马克：你说得对，我今天就和他们谈。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 这就是在逃避责任！
messages.en: This is avoiding responsibility!

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun; nitkellem magħhom illum stess.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun; nitkellem magħhom illum stess.
messages.zh: 你说得对，我今天就和他们谈。
messages.en: You're right; I'll speak to them today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象遇见冲突时绕路走，把这种回避行为整体记作 skansament；这里指行为，不是某个人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small knife; the diminutive form of sikkina.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尺寸较小的刀；是 sikkina 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sikkina żgħira; il-forma diminuttiva ta' sikkina.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small knife (the diminutive form of 'sikkina')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小刀；sikkina（刀）的指小形式。

formal.mt: Għal dan ix-xogħol fil-kċina, uża skejkna biex tqaxxar it-tuffieħ.
formal.en: For this kitchen task, use a small knife to peel the apples.
formal.zh: 做这项厨房工作时，请用小刀给苹果削皮。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hi l-iskejkna? Mark: Fil-kexxun, ħdejn l-imgħaref.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the small knife? Mark: In the drawer, next to the spoons.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：小刀在哪儿？马克：在抽屉里，勺子旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 小刀在哪儿？
messages.en: Where is the small knife?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 在抽屉里，勺子旁边。
messages.en: In the drawer, next to the spoons.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sikkina 和 skejkna 配成大小两把刀：前者是刀，后者是小刀，用尺寸画面记住指小关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Saying little; not inclined to speak much.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说话不多、不爱多言的，用于描述人的寡言特点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jitkellem ftit u ma jħobbx jgħid ħafna kliem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 寡言的；话不多的。

formal.mt: Il-karattru ewlieni huwa raġel skieti li jisma' b'attenzjoni qabel iwieġeb.
formal.en: The main character is a man of few words who listens carefully before answering.
formal.zh: 主人公是个寡言的男子，回答前会认真倾听。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħuk dejjem daqshekk skieti? Mark: Iva, jitkellem ftit, imma jisma' kollox.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is your brother always so quiet? Mark: Yes, he says little, but he listens to everything.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你兄弟总是这么寡言吗？马克：是啊，他话少，但什么都听着。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你兄弟总是这么寡言吗？
messages.en: Is your brother always so quiet?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jitkellem ftit, imma jisma' kollox.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jitkellem ftit, imma jisma' kollox.
messages.zh: 是啊，他话少，但什么都听着。
messages.en: Yes, he says little, but he listens to everything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个认真听人讲话、自己只说几句的人，把 skieti 贴在他身上，记作形容人的寡言。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small rodent with a bushy tail that often climbs trees and eats nuts or seeds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种尾巴蓬松、常爬树并以坚果或种子等为食的小型啮齿动物，即松鼠。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal gerriem żgħir b'denb folt li spiss jitla' mas-siġar u jiekol ġewż jew żrieragħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 松鼠。

formal.mt: Waqt iż-żjara fil-park, l-istudenti raw skojjattlu jitla' ma' siġra.
formal.en: During the visit to the park, the students saw a squirrel climbing a tree.
formal.zh: 参观公园时，学生们看见一只松鼠正在爬树。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dak l-iskojjattlu fuq il-fergħa! Mark: Rajtu! Għandu denb folt ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that squirrel on the branch! Mark: I see it! It has a very bushy tail.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看树枝上的那只松鼠！马克：看见了！它的尾巴真蓬松。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看树枝上的那只松鼠！
messages.en: Look at that squirrel on the branch!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 看见了！它的尾巴真蓬松。
messages.en: I see it! It has a very bushy tail.

cognitive_memory_aid: 朗读 skojjattlu 时，想象一只大尾巴松鼠跳上树枝；把整词、树枝和蓬松尾巴一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small rodent with a bushy tail that often climbs trees and eats nuts or seeds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种尾巴蓬松、常爬树并以坚果或种子等为食的小型啮齿动物，即松鼠。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal gerriem żgħir b'denb folt li spiss jitla' mas-siġar u jiekol ġewż jew żrieragħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 松鼠。

formal.mt: L-istudent pinġa skwiril fuq fergħa u ta attenzjoni speċjali lid-denb tiegħu.
formal.en: The student drew a squirrel on a branch and paid special attention to its tail.
formal.zh: 学生画了一只站在树枝上的松鼠，并特别注意描绘它的尾巴。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt skwiril fil-park illum. Mark: Fejn kien? Maja: Taħt siġra, jiekol.
colloquial.en: Maja: I saw a squirrel in the park today. Mark: Where was it? Maja: Under a tree, eating.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我今天在公园看见一只松鼠。马克：它在哪儿？玛雅：在树下吃东西。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我今天在公园看见一只松鼠。
messages.en: I saw a squirrel in the park today.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 它在哪儿？
messages.en: Where was it?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 在树下吃东西。
messages.en: Under a tree, eating.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 skwiril 与英文 squirrel 对照朗读，再配上松鼠抱着坚果的画面；与 skojjattlu 记在同一张动物词卡上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small cross; the diminutive form of salib.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小十字架；salib（十字架）的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Salib żgħir; il-forma diminuttiva ta' salib.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小十字架（salib 的指小形式）。

collocations.en: a small cross on a chain

formal.mt: Fil-vetrina hemm slajleb tal-fidda ħdejn żewġ ċrieki.
formal.en: In the display case, there is a small silver cross beside two rings.
formal.zh: 陈列柜里有一个银制小十字架，旁边放着两枚戒指。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn xtrajt dak is-slajleb? Rita: Minn ħanut żgħir fil-Belt. Nilbsu fuq katina.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did you buy that small cross? Rita: From a small shop in Valletta. I wear it on a chain.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那个小十字架是在哪里买的？Rita：在瓦莱塔的一家小店里。我把它挂在链子上戴。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那个小十字架是在哪里买的？
messages.en: Where did you buy that small cross?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn ħanut żgħir fil-Belt. Nilbsu fuq katina.
messages.mt_standard: Minn ħanut żgħir fil-Belt. Nilbsu fuq katina.
messages.zh: 在瓦莱塔的一家小店里。我把它挂在链子上戴。
messages.en: From a small shop in Valletta. I wear it on a chain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 slajleb 与 salib 配对记忆：想象掌心里的小十字架，用大小对照记住指小义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A young king; the diminutive form of sultan.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 年幼的国王或小国王；sultan 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sultan ta' età żgħira; il-forma diminuttiva ta' sultan.

sense_translations.en_definition: a young king (the diminutive form of 'sultan')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 年幼的国王；小国王（sultan 的指小形式）。

collocations.en: a young king with a gold crown

formal.mt: F'dan ir-rakkont, is-slajten jitgħallem jisma' l-pariri qabel jieħu deċiżjoni.
formal.en: In this story, the young king learns to listen to advice before making a decision.
formal.zh: 在这个故事中，小国王学会了在作决定前听取建议。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hu dak it-tifel bil-kuruna fl-istampa? Pawlu: Dak is-slajten tal-istorja. Għadu żgħir, imma diġà għandu palazz.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is that boy wearing a crown in the picture? Pawlu: That is the young king in the story. He is still young, but he already has a palace.
colloquial.zh: Lara：图上那个戴王冠的男孩是谁？Pawlu：那是故事里的小国王。他年纪还小，却已经有一座宫殿了。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak it-tifel bil-kuruna fl-istampa?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak it-tifel bil-kuruna fl-istampa?
messages.zh: 图上那个戴王冠的男孩是谁？
messages.en: Who is that boy wearing a crown in the picture?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak is-slajten tal-istorja. Għadu żgħir, imma diġà għandu palazz.
messages.mt_standard: Dak is-slajten tal-istorja. Għadu żgħir, imma diġà għandu palazz.
messages.zh: 那是故事里的小国王。他年纪还小，却已经有一座宫殿了。
messages.en: That is the young king in the story. He is still young, but he already has a palace.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位王冠略显太大的小国王，把 slajten 与 sultan 配对，记住这里强调国王年幼。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small kingdom; the diminutive form of saltna.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 规模较小的王国；saltna（王国）的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Saltna żgħira; il-forma diminuttiva ta' saltna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小王国（saltna 的指小形式）。

collocations.en: the borders of the small kingdom
the capital of the small kingdom

formal.mt: Fuq il-mappa tar-rakkont, is-slajtna tinsab bejn il-baħar u l-muntanji.
formal.en: On the map accompanying the story, the small kingdom lies between the sea and the mountains.
formal.zh: 在故事所附的地图上，这个小王国位于大海与群山之间。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Din is-slajtna kollha kemm hi fuq il-mappa? Mark: Iva, għandha belt waħda u ftit irħula biss.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this the whole small kingdom on the map? Mark: Yes, it has only one town and a few villages.
colloquial.zh: Nina：地图上这一块就是整个小王国吗？Mark：是的，它只有一座城镇和几个村庄。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Din is-slajtna kollha kemm hi fuq il-mappa?
messages.mt_standard: Din is-slajtna kollha kemm hi fuq il-mappa?
messages.zh: 地图上这一块就是整个小王国吗？
messages.en: Is this the whole small kingdom on the map?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandha belt waħda u ftit irħula biss.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandha belt waħda u ftit irħula biss.
messages.zh: 是的，它只有一座城镇和几个村庄。
messages.en: Yes, it has only one town and a few villages.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 slajtna 想成地图上可用手掌盖住的小王国；与 saltna 配对记忆，并与表示小国王的 slajten 区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A filament: a very thin, threadlike strand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 细丝或丝状物，指非常纤细、形状像线的一缕物质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħajta fina ħafna jew materjal irqiq b'għamla ta' ħajta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一根细丝；丝状物。

formal.mt: Taħt il-mikroskopju, tidher slejta rqiqa fit-tarf tal-kampjun.
formal.en: Under the microscope, a thin filament is visible at the edge of the sample.
formal.zh: 在显微镜下，可以看到样本边缘有一根细丝。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Qed tara dik is-slejta fl-istampa? David: Iva, tidher qisha ħajta fina ħafna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can you see that filament in the picture? David: Yes, it looks like a very fine thread.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你看到图片里的那根细丝了吗？David：看到了，看起来像一根非常细的线。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你看到图片里的那根细丝了吗？
messages.en: Can you see that filament in the picture?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tidher qisha ħajta fina ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tidher qisha ħajta fina ħafna.
messages.zh: 看到了，看起来像一根非常细的线。
messages.en: Yes, it looks like a very fine thread.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读到 slejta 就想象显微镜下的一根细线，把词与细长丝状的画面绑定，记住“细丝”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A slash: the written mark / used to separate items or parts of an expression.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 斜线符号“/”，用于分隔项目或表达式中的部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-sinjal /, li jintuża biex jifred elementi jew partijiet ta' espressjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 斜线；斜杠符号“/”。

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, poġġi slexx bejn iż-żewġ għażliet: iva/le.
formal.en: In this exercise, put a slash between the two options: yes/no.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，在两个选项之间加上斜杠：是/否。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'inhu dak is-sinjal bejn iż-żewġ kelmiet? Anna: Dak slexx. Ikteb iva, imbagħad slexx, u wara le.
colloquial.en: Mark: What is that symbol between the two words? Anna: That is a slash. Write yes, then a slash, and then no.
colloquial.zh: Mark：两个词之间那个符号是什么？Anna：那是斜杠。先写“是”，再写斜杠，最后写“否”。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dak is-sinjal bejn iż-żewġ kelmiet?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dak is-sinjal bejn iż-żewġ kelmiet?
messages.zh: 两个词之间那个符号是什么？
messages.en: What is that symbol between the two words?

messages.speaker: Anna (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak slexx. Ikteb iva, imbagħad slexx, u wara le.
messages.mt_standard: Dak slexx. Ikteb iva, imbagħad slexx, u wara le.
messages.zh: 那是斜杠。先写“是”，再写斜杠，最后写“否”。
messages.en: That is a slash. Write yes, then a slash, and then no.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 slexx 写在符号“/”旁边，每读一次就画一道斜线，用手写动作记住“斜杠”。

gloss_zh: 悄悄溜走；偷偷离开这一行为

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of slipping away quietly and trying not to be noticed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 悄悄溜走、尽量不引人注意地离开这一行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jitlaq bil-kwiet u jipprova ma jiġbidx l-attenzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 悄悄溜走；偷偷离开的行为。

collocations.en: slinking off through the back door

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, is-slik tal-karattru mill-bieb ta' wara juri li ma jridx jiġbed l-attenzjoni.
formal.en: In the story, the character's slinking off through the back door shows that he does not want to attract attention.
formal.zh: 在故事中，这个人物从后门悄悄溜走，表明他不想引人注意。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajtu jitlaq mingħajr ma jgħid xejn? Toni: Iva, dak kien slik! Ħareġ mill-bieb ta' wara.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see him leave without saying anything? Toni: Yes, that was slinking off! He went out through the back door.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你看见他一声不吭地走了吗？Toni：看见了，那可真是偷偷溜走！他从后门出去了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtu jitlaq mingħajr ma jgħid xejn?
messages.mt_standard: Rajtu jitlaq mingħajr ma jgħid xejn?
messages.zh: 你看见他一声不吭地走了吗？
messages.en: Did you see him leave without saying anything?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dak kien slik! Ħareġ mill-bieb ta' wara.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dak kien slik! Ħareġ mill-bieb ta' wara.
messages.zh: 看见了，那可真是偷偷溜走！他从后门出去了。
messages.en: Yes, that was slinking off! He went out through the back door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人趁大家聊天时贴着墙从后门溜走；slik 给“悄悄离开这件事”命名，按名词记。

gloss_zh: 居住在斯利马的；斯利马居民的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone who lives in Sliema.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容某人居住在斯利马，表示其居民身份。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li joqgħod f'Tas-Sliema, meta jingħad għal persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 居住在斯利马的，用于描述某人的居民身份。

collocations.en: a man who lives in Sliema
collocations.zh: 一位住在斯利马的男子

collocations.en: a friend who lives in Sliema
collocations.zh: 一位住在斯利马的朋友

formal.mt: Raġel slimiż ħa sehem fl-intervista u tkellem dwar il-ħajja f'Tas-Sliema.
formal.en: A man who lives in Sliema took part in the interview and spoke about life in Sliema.
formal.zh: 一位住在斯利马的男子参加了采访，谈到了当地的生活。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Pawlu slimiż? Mark: Iva, joqgħod f'Tas-Sliema, qrib il-baħar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does Pawlu live in Sliema? Mark: Yes, he lives in Sliema, near the sea.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Pawlu 是斯利马的居民吗？Mark：是的，他住在斯利马，靠近海边。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu 是斯利马的居民吗？
messages.en: Does Pawlu live in Sliema?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，他住在斯利马，靠近海边。
messages.en: Yes, he lives in Sliema, near the sea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在学习卡上把 Sliema 与 slimiż 并排写，再画一位当地居民；用“住在斯利马的人”记住这个形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Diarrhoea: a condition involving frequent loose or watery stools.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 腹泻，指频繁排出稀便或水样便的情况，口语称拉肚子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kundizzjoni li fiha wieħed jipporga ta' spiss u l-ippurgar ikun maħlul jew bħall-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 腹泻；拉肚子。

formal.mt: Il-pazjent irrapporta sliħ u uġigħ ta' żaqq li bdew ilbieraħ.
formal.en: The patient reported diarrhoea and a stomach ache that began yesterday.
formal.zh: 患者报告说，腹泻和腹痛是从昨天开始的。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għandi s-sliħ minn dalgħodu. Marija: Kemm ilek hekk? Rita: Minn meta qomt.
colloquial.en: Rita: I have had diarrhoea since this morning. Marija: How long have you been like this? Rita: Since I woke up.
colloquial.zh: Rita：我今天早上开始拉肚子了。Marija：这样有多久了？Rita：从起床时就开始了。

messages.speaker: Rita (患者)
messages.zh: 我今天早上开始拉肚子了。
messages.en: I have had diarrhoea since this morning.

messages.speaker: Marija (护士)
messages.zh: 这样有多久了？
messages.en: How long have you been like this?

messages.speaker: Rita (患者)
messages.zh: 从起床时就开始了。
messages.en: Since I woke up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sliħ 放进 Għandi s-sliħ 这句里记忆，配上反复跑厕所的画面，意思就是“我拉肚子了”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Slovakia, a country in Central Europe whose official name is the Slovak Republic.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 斯洛伐克，中欧国家，正式名称为斯洛伐克共和国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Ewropa Ċentrali li l-isem uffiċjali tiegħu huwa r-Repubblika Slovakka.

sense_translations.en_definition: Slovakia (a country in Central Europe; official name: Repubblika Slovakka)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 斯洛伐克，中欧国家；正式名称为斯洛伐克共和国。

collocations.zh: 在斯洛伐克的访问或游览

formal.mt: Il-programm taż-żjara fis-Slovakkja jinkludi laqgħa mal-istudenti.
formal.en: The programme for the visit to Slovakia includes a meeting with students.
formal.zh: 此次访问斯洛伐克的日程包括与学生会面。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se tmur għall-vaganza? Mark: Se mmur is-Slovakkja ma' ħabib.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are you going on holiday? Mark: I'm going to Slovakia with a friend.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你准备去哪里度假？马克：我要和一位朋友去斯洛伐克。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你准备去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where are you going on holiday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我要和一位朋友去斯洛伐克。
messages.en: I'm going to Slovakia with a friend.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Slovakkja 中的双写 kk 当作拼写识别点，整词对应“斯洛伐克”；与 Slovenja 成对比较，避免混淆两个国名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Slovenia, a country on the Balkan Peninsula in Central Europe.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 斯洛文尼亚，位于中欧巴尔干半岛的国家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fil-Peniżola Balkana fl-Ewropa Ċentrali.

sense_translations.en_definition: Slovenia (a country on the Balkan Peninsula in Central Europe)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 斯洛文尼亚，位于中欧巴尔干半岛的国家。

collocations.zh: 前往斯洛文尼亚的旅行

formal.mt: L-istudenti se jippreparaw preżentazzjoni dwar is-Slovenja.
formal.en: The students will prepare a presentation about Slovenia.
formal.zh: 学生们将准备一场介绍斯洛文尼亚的报告。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn ħadt dawn ir-ritratti? Luca: Fis-Slovenja, waqt il-vaganza.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where did you take these photos? Luca: In Slovenia, while on holiday.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这些照片是你在哪里拍的？卢卡：在斯洛文尼亚度假的时候拍的。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这些照片是你在哪里拍的？
messages.en: Where did you take these photos?

messages.speaker: Luca (朋友)
messages.zh: 在斯洛文尼亚度假的时候拍的。
messages.en: In Slovenia, while on holiday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用 Slovenja 中的 ven 作为视觉提示，把整词与“斯洛文尼亚”一起记；再与带双写 kk 的 Slovakkja 对照辨认。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Somewhat dark or brown in colour, including a person's complexion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 颜色略深或略呈棕色的，也可形容人的肤色。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu lewn kemxejn skur jew kannella, ukoll meta wieħed jitkellem dwar il-karnaġġjon.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 略深色的；略呈棕色的。

formal.mt: Fid-deskrizzjoni tal-personaġġ, l-awtur isemmi l-karnaġġjon smajjar tiegħu.
formal.en: In the description of the character, the author mentions his somewhat dark complexion.
formal.zh: 在人物描写中，作者提到了他略深的肤色。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema kulur trid għall-bieb? Ben: Nixtieq kulur smajjar, iżda mhux skur wisq.
colloquial.en: Maja: What colour do you want for the door? Ben: I'd like a brownish colour, but not too dark.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想把门漆成什么颜色？本：我想要略带棕色的，但别太深。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你想把门漆成什么颜色？
messages.en: What colour do you want for the door?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nixtieq kulur smajjar, iżda mhux skur wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Nixtieq kulur smajjar, iżda mhux skur wisq.
messages.zh: 我想要略带棕色的，但别太深。
messages.en: I'd like a brownish colour, but not too dark.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把色卡轻轻调深、添一点棕色：smajjar 强调“略带深色或棕色”，记住程度较轻，不要直接理解成漆黑。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Somewhat fat or plump; the diminutive form of smin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有点胖、微胖的；是 smin 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li hu xi ftit oħxon; il-forma diminuttiva ta' smin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有点胖的，微胖的；是 smin 的指小形式。

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, qattus smejjen jorqod ħdejn it-tieqa kull wara nofsinhar.
formal.en: In the story, a plump cat sleeps beside the window every afternoon.
formal.zh: 故事中，一只微胖的猫每天下午都睡在窗边。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Liema hu l-qattus tiegħek? Sam: Dak il-qattus smejjen ħdejn is-siġġu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Which one is your cat? Sam: That plump cat beside the chair.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：哪只是你的猫？萨姆：椅子旁边那只有点胖的猫。

messages.speaker: Nina (来访朋友)
messages.zh: 哪只是你的猫？
messages.en: Which one is your cat?

messages.speaker: Sam (猫主人)
messages.zh: 椅子旁边那只有点胖的猫。
messages.en: That plump cat beside the chair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 smin 与 smejjen 配成一组记忆：前者表示“胖的”，本词表示“有点胖的”；脑中配上一只圆润的小猫，突出程度较轻。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the sky or to celestial bodies such as stars and planets.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与天空或恒星、行星等天体有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mas-sema jew ma' oġġetti bħall-kwiekeb u l-pjaneti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 天空的；天体的。

formal.mt: L-istudenti għażlu ġisem smewwi u kitbu deskrizzjoni qasira tiegħu.
formal.en: The students chose a celestial body and wrote a short description of it.
formal.zh: 学生们选取了一个天体，并写下了简短描述。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dak l-oġġett smewwi fir-ritratt? Pawlu: Huwa pjaneta; ejja naqraw l-isem taħt ir-ritratt.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is that celestial object in the photo? Pawlu: It's a planet; let's read the name below the photo.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：照片里的那个天体是什么？保罗：是一颗行星；我们来读读照片下面的名字。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 照片里的那个天体是什么？
messages.en: What is that celestial object in the photo?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa pjaneta; ejja naqraw l-isem taħt ir-ritratt.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa pjaneta; ejja naqraw l-isem taħt ir-ritratt.
messages.zh: 是一颗行星；我们来读读照片下面的名字。
messages.en: It's a planet; let's read the name below the photo.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 smewwi 放进 ġisem smewwi“天体”这个词组中记忆，脑中画出星星和行星，让“与天空、天体有关”的意思具体可见。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of heaven, or so beautiful and delightful that it suggests heaven.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 天上的、属于天堂的；也可形容美好得如同天堂一般。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-ġenna, jew li hu tant sabiħ u pjaċevoli li jfakkar fil-ġenna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 天上的；天堂般美好的。

formal.mt: Fil-poeżija, il-ġnien huwa deskritt bħala post ta' ġmiel smewwieti.
formal.en: In the poem, the garden is described as a place of heavenly beauty.
formal.zh: 诗中把花园描写成一个具有天堂般美景的地方。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Għoġbok il-kant? Toni: Iva, il-kantant għandu leħen smewwieti!
colloquial.en: Emma: Did you like the singing? Toni: Yes, the singer has a heavenly voice!
colloquial.zh: 艾玛：你喜欢刚才的演唱吗？托尼：喜欢，那位歌手的嗓音简直如同天籁！

messages.speaker: Emma (听众)
messages.zh: 你喜欢刚才的演唱吗？
messages.en: Did you like the singing?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 喜欢，那位歌手的嗓音简直如同天籁！
messages.en: Yes, the singer has a heavenly voice!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象听到美妙歌声后赞叹“像从天堂传来”：用 leħen smewwieti“天籁般的嗓音”记住本词的“天堂般美好”之意。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The ability or act of hearing; also an audition in which someone performs so that their suitability can be assessed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 听觉或聆听这一行为；也指通过表演来接受选拔的试音或试演。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħila jew l-att li tisma'; ukoll prova li fiha persuna tkanta jew tagħti prestazzjoni biex jiġi deċiż jekk tintgħażilx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 听觉；听取声音、聆听。
为接受表演选拔而进行的试音或试演。

formal.mt: It-test tas-smigħ jevalwa l-ħila tal-persuna li tisma' ħsejjes differenti.
formal.en: The hearing test assesses a person's ability to hear different sounds.
formal.zh: 听力测试评估一个人听到不同声音的能力。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex qed tipprattika din il-kanzunetta? Dan: Għada għandi smigħ għall-kor u rrid inkun lest.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why are you practising this song? Dan: I have an audition for the choir tomorrow, and I want to be ready.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你为什么在练习这首歌？丹：明天我要参加合唱团试音，想提前准备好。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么在练习这首歌？
messages.en: Why are you practising this song?

messages.speaker: Dan (合唱团应征者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għada għandi smigħ għall-kor u rrid inkun lest.
messages.mt_standard: Għada għandi smigħ għall-kor u rrid inkun lest.
messages.zh: 明天我要参加合唱团试音，想提前准备好。
messages.en: I have an audition for the choir tomorrow, and I want to be ready.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 smigħ 配两幅图：一幅是耳朵接受听力测试，另一幅是歌手参加试音；分别记住“听觉”和“试音”两个名词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Scalding: exposure to very hot liquid or steam, especially when it burns the skin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被高温液体或蒸汽烫到，尤指由此造成皮肤烫伤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew l-effett li wieħed jinstamat b'likwidu jaħraq ħafna jew bil-fwar, speċjalment meta jweġġa' l-ġilda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 高温液体或蒸汽造成的烫灼、烫伤。

formal.mt: L-avviż ħdejn il-kitla jwissi dwar ir-riskju ta' smit bl-ilma jagħli.
formal.en: The notice beside the kettle warns of the risk of scalding with boiling water.
formal.zh: 水壶旁的告示提醒人们注意沸水烫伤的风险。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Nista' niftaħ l-għatu tal-borma? Mark: Stenna ftit; hemm riskju ta' smit bil-fwar.
colloquial.en: Rita: Can I open the lid of the pot? Mark: Wait a moment; there's a risk of scalding from the steam.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：我可以打开锅盖吗？马克：等一下，有被蒸汽烫伤的风险。

messages.speaker: Rita (家人)
messages.zh: 我可以打开锅盖吗？
messages.en: Can I open the lid of the pot?

messages.speaker: Mark (正在做饭的家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Stenna ftit; hemm riskju ta' smit bil-fwar.
messages.mt_standard: Stenna ftit; hemm riskju ta' smit bil-fwar.
messages.zh: 等一下，有被蒸汽烫伤的风险。
messages.en: Wait a moment; there's a risk of scalding from the steam.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 smit 与冒着热气的水壶联系起来，再默念 riskju ta' smit“烫伤风险”；用热水和蒸汽的画面记住这个名词。

gloss_zh: 听得见的；与听觉有关的；听觉的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing something that can be heard, or something connected with hearing and the perception of sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容可以被听见的事物，或与听觉及声音感知有关的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jinstema', jew li għandu x'jaqsam mas-smigħ u mal-perċezzjoni tal-ħsejjes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可以听见的；能够被耳朵听到的。
与听觉或听声音的能力有关的。
听觉的；涉及声音接收和感知的。

formal.mt: Fl-esperiment, kull parteċipant irċieva stimolu smugħi u mbagħad għafas buttuna.
formal.en: In the experiment, each participant received an auditory stimulus and then pressed a button.
formal.zh: 实验中，每位参与者听到一个听觉刺激后，便按下按钮。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan is-sinjal smugħi jfisser li l-ħin spiċċa? Mark: Iva, meta tisma' l-ħoss, ieqaf tikteb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this auditory signal mean that time is up? Mark: Yes, when you hear the sound, stop writing.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个声音信号表示时间到了吗？马克：对，听到声音就停止书写。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan is-sinjal smugħi jfisser li l-ħin spiċċa?
messages.mt_standard: Dan is-sinjal smugħi jfisser li l-ħin spiċċa?
messages.zh: 这个声音信号表示时间到了吗？
messages.en: Does this auditory signal mean that time is up?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, meta tisma' l-ħoss, ieqaf tikteb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, meta tisma' l-ħoss, ieqaf tikteb.
messages.zh: 对，听到声音就停止书写。
messages.en: Yes, when you hear the sound, stop writing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象耳朵旁亮起声音信号灯，把 smugħi 同时记成“听得见的”和“与听觉有关的”形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality or appearance of being brown in colour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 呈现棕色或棕褐色色泽的性质或外观。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità jew id-dehra ta' xi ħaġa li għandha kulur kannella.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 棕色的性质或状态；物体呈现的棕褐色色泽。

collocations.en: the brownness of the bread crust
collocations.zh: 面包外皮的棕褐色色泽

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi s-smurija tal-injam u jqabbel il-kulur tiegħu ma' dak tal-kampjun l-ieħor.
formal.en: The report describes the brownness of the wood and compares its colour with that of the other sample.
formal.zh: 报告描述了木材的棕褐色色泽，并将其颜色与另一份样本进行比较。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara s-smurija tal-qoxra ta' dan il-ħobż! Mark: Iva, il-kulur jidher sabiħ ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at the brownness of this bread's crust! Mark: Yes, the colour looks lovely.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看看这个面包外皮的棕褐色！马克：是啊，这颜色真好看。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara s-smurija tal-qoxra ta' dan il-ħobż!
messages.mt_standard: Ara s-smurija tal-qoxra ta' dan il-ħobż!
messages.zh: 看看这个面包外皮的棕褐色！
messages.en: Look at the brownness of this bread's crust!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，这颜色真好看。
messages.en: Yes, the colour looks lovely.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一块棕色木板和一片棕色面包皮，把它们共有的“棕褐色色泽”贴上 smurija 标签。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small trunk or chest for keeping belongings; the diminutive form of senduq.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于存放物品的小箱子或小衣箱，是 senduq 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Senduq żgħir biex jinżammu fih oġġetti; il-forma diminuttiva ta' senduq.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small trunk (the diminutive form of 'senduq')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小箱子或小衣箱；senduq 的指小形式。

collocations.en: a small trunk full of letters

formal.mt: Il-mużew jesebixxi snejdaq tal-injam li fih kienu jinżammu ittri u ritratti tal-familja.
formal.en: The museum displays a small wooden trunk in which family letters and photographs used to be kept.
formal.zh: 博物馆展出了一只小木箱，里面过去存放着家书和家庭照片。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn poġġejt l-ittri tan-nanna? Mark: Fis-snejdaq ħdejn is-sodda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did you put Grandma's letters? Mark: In the small trunk beside the bed.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你把奶奶的信放在哪里了？马克：放在床边的小箱子里。

messages.speaker: Maja (姐姐)
messages.zh: 你把奶奶的信放在哪里了？
messages.en: Where did you put Grandma's letters?

messages.speaker: Mark (弟弟)
messages.zh: 放在床边的小箱子里。
