messages.en: In the small trunk beside the bed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 senduq 大箱子在脑中缩成床边装信的小箱子：这个小一号的箱子就是 snejdaq。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small trade or modest craft occupation; the diminutive form of sengħa.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 规模较小的手艺营生或小行当，是 sengħa 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sengħa żgħira jew xogħol ta' sengħa fuq skala żgħira; il-forma diminuttiva ta' sengħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小手艺或小行当；sengħa 的指小形式。

collocations.en: to earn something from a small trade

formal.mt: Il-kors jgħin lill-parteċipanti jitgħallmu snejgħa u jaqilgħu xi ħaġa mix-xogħol tagħhom.
formal.en: The course helps participants learn a small trade and earn something from their work.
formal.zh: 这门课程帮助参与者学一门小手艺，并通过自己的劳动挣些钱。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nixtieq nitgħallem snejgħa fil-ħin liberu tiegħi. Mark: Tista' tibda bit-tiswija ta' basktijiet sempliċi.
colloquial.en: Maja: I'd like to learn a small trade in my spare time. Mark: You could start by repairing simple bags.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我想利用空闲时间学一门小手艺。马克：你可以从修理简单的包袋开始。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nixtieq nitgħallem snejgħa fil-ħin liberu tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Nixtieq nitgħallem snejgħa fil-ħin liberu tiegħi.
messages.zh: 我想利用空闲时间学一门小手艺。
messages.en: I'd like to learn a small trade in my spare time.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tibda bit-tiswija ta' basktijiet sempliċi.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tibda bit-tiswija ta' basktijiet sempliċi.
messages.zh: 你可以从修理简单的包袋开始。
messages.en: You could start by repairing simple bags.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sengħa 的手艺概念想成一张小工作台上的营生，记住 snejgħa 是“小手艺、小行当”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of baking something until it becomes hard.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过烘烤使食物或其他物品变硬的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess ta' ħami ta' xi ħaġa sakemm issir iebsa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 持续烘烤直至变硬；把东西烤硬的过程。

collocations.en: the process of baking until hard

formal.mt: Waqt is-sniġ tal-ħobż, il-furnar iżommu fil-forn sakemm isir iebes.
formal.en: During the baking of bread until hard, the baker keeps it in the oven until it becomes hard.
formal.zh: 在把面包烤硬的过程中，面包师将其留在烤箱中，直至面包变硬。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ħallejt il-ħobż fil-forn? Mark: Għas-sniġ; irridu li jsir iebes.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you leave the bread in the oven? Mark: To bake it until hard; we want it to become hard.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么把面包留在烤箱里？马克：为了把它烤硬；我们要让它变硬。

messages.speaker: Maja (烘焙学徒)
messages.zh: 你为什么把面包留在烤箱里？
messages.en: Why did you leave the bread in the oven?

messages.speaker: Mark (面包师)
messages.zh: 为了把它烤硬；我们要让它变硬。
messages.en: To bake it until hard; we want it to become hard.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象面包在烤箱里逐渐变硬，把整个“烤到硬”的过程记作 sniġ，注意它是过程名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of rotting or becoming rancid, especially when food or fat deteriorates.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物质腐烂或发生酸败的过程，尤其用于食物、油脂等变质的情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa titħassar jew tiżviluppa riħa u togħma ħżiena, speċjalment ikel jew xaħam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 腐烂；物质逐渐腐坏的过程。
酸败；油脂或含油食物变质并产生不良气味、滋味的过程。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi s-sniħ tax-xaħam u l-bidla fir-riħa tiegħu.
formal.en: The report describes the fat going rancid and the change in its smell.
formal.zh: 报告描述了油脂的酸败过程及其气味的变化。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din ir-riħa ġejja mis-sniħ tal-butir? Mark: Iva, il-butir tħassar; ħa narmih.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this smell coming from the butter going rancid? Mark: Yes, the butter has gone bad; I'll throw it away.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这股气味是黄油酸败产生的吗？马克：对，黄油变质了，我把它扔掉。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 这股气味是黄油酸败产生的吗？
messages.en: Is this smell coming from the butter going rancid?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 对，黄油变质了，我把它扔掉。
messages.en: Yes, the butter has gone bad; I'll throw it away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排想象腐烂水果和有异味的黄油，用 sniħ 串起“腐烂”与“油脂酸败”两种变质过程。

gloss_zh: 鸡奸；肛交（用语可能带贬义）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A term for anal intercourse or certain other sexual acts; it can carry a disapproving or stigmatizing tone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指肛交或某些其他性行为的用语，可能带有否定或污名化色彩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Terminu għal sess anali jew ċerti atti sesswali oħra; jista' jkollu ton ta' kundanna jew jistigmatizza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸡奸；可指肛交或某些其他性行为，具体范围依语境而定，用语可能带贬义。

formal.mt: Fit-traduzzjoni, it-terminu 'sodomija' għandu jiġi interpretat skont il-kuntest u t-ton tat-test.
formal.en: In translation, the term 'sodomy' should be interpreted according to the context and tone of the text.
formal.zh: 翻译时，应根据文本的语境和语气理解“鸡奸”这一术语。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'sodomija' f'din is-sentenza? Mark: Tista' tirreferi għal sess anali, iżda rridu naqraw il-kuntest biex nifhmu t-tifsira preċiża.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'sodomy' mean in this sentence? Mark: It can refer to anal intercourse, but we need to read the context to understand the precise meaning.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这句话里的 sodomija 是什么意思？Mark：它可以指肛交，但我们需要阅读上下文，才能理解确切含义。

messages.speaker: Maja (语言学习者)
messages.zh: 这句话里的 sodomija 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'sodomy' mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Mark (语言教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tirreferi għal sess anali, iżda rridu naqraw il-kuntest biex nifhmu t-tifsira preċiża.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tirreferi għal sess anali, iżda rridu naqraw il-kuntest biex nifhmu t-tifsira preċiża.
messages.zh: 它可以指肛交，但我们需要阅读上下文，才能理解确切含义。
messages.en: It can refer to anal intercourse, but we need to read the context to understand the precise meaning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 将这个词放进“术语指什么行为”的学习卡片，记住它是行为名词，并留意语境中的评价色彩。

gloss_zh: 鸡奸者（可能带侮辱性的人物称谓）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person described as engaging in sodomy; the label can be derogatory or stigmatizing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被称为从事鸡奸等相关性行为的人；这一人物称谓可能带有贬损或污名化色彩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna deskritta bħala li tipprattika s-sodomija; din it-tikketta tista' tkun dispreġġjattiva jew tistigmatizza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸡奸者；指被称为从事鸡奸等相关性行为的人，可能是带侮辱性或污名化色彩的称谓。

formal.mt: L-analiżi tiddiskuti kif it-tikketta 'sodomita' tesprimi l-ġudizzju tal-kelliem dwar persuna.
formal.en: The analysis discusses how the label 'sodomite' expresses the speaker's judgment about a person.
formal.zh: 这篇分析讨论了“鸡奸者”这一标签如何表达说话者对某人的评判。

colloquial.mt: Maja: 'Sodomita' tfisser att jew persuna? Mark: Persuna; iżda l-kelma tista' tkun offensiva, għalhekk oqgħod attent kif tużaha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does 'sodomite' mean an act or a person? Mark: A person; but the word can be offensive, so be careful how you use it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：sodomita 指行为还是人？Mark：指人；不过这个词可能具有冒犯性，所以使用时要注意。

messages.speaker: Maja (语言学习者)
messages.zh: sodomita 指行为还是人？
messages.en: Does 'sodomite' mean an act or a person?

messages.speaker: Mark (语言教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Persuna; iżda l-kelma tista' tkun offensiva, għalhekk oqgħod attent kif tużaha.
messages.mt_standard: Persuna; iżda l-kelma tista' tkun offensiva, għalhekk oqgħod attent kif tużaha.
messages.zh: 指人；不过这个词可能具有冒犯性，所以使用时要注意。
messages.en: A person; but the word can be offensive, so be careful how you use it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sodomita 放在“称呼某个人”的卡片栏，与表示行为的 sodomija 对照记忆，同时标注可能冒犯。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to or characterized as sodomy; the adjective may convey a disapproving judgment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与鸡奸等相关性行为有关的，或被描述为具有此性质的；可能带有否定性评判。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mas-sodomija jew jiġi deskritt bħala tali; l-aġġettiv jista' jesprimi ġudizzju ta' kundanna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸡奸的；与鸡奸等相关性行为有关的，可能带有贬义或谴责色彩。

collocations.zh: 被描述为鸡奸性质的行为

formal.mt: Fl-espressjoni 'att sodomitiku', l-aġġettiv jiddeskrivi l-att u jista' jagħtih ton ta' kundanna.
formal.en: In the expression 'a sodomitic act', the adjective describes the act and may give it a condemnatory tone.
formal.zh: 在“鸡奸行为”这一表达中，该形容词修饰行为，并可能赋予其谴责色彩。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hawn miktub 'imġiba sodomitika' u mhux 'imġiba sodomitiku'? Mark: Għax 'imġiba' hija nom femminili, u l-aġġettiv jaqbel magħha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does it say 'imġiba sodomitika' here rather than 'imġiba sodomitiku'? Mark: Because 'imġiba' is a feminine noun, and the adjective agrees with it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：为什么这里写 imġiba sodomitika，而不是 imġiba sodomitiku？Mark：因为 imġiba 是阴性名词，形容词要与它保持一致。

messages.speaker: Maja (语言学习者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hawn miktub 'imġiba sodomitika' u mhux 'imġiba sodomitiku'?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hawn miktub 'imġiba sodomitika' u mhux 'imġiba sodomitiku'?
messages.zh: 为什么这里写 imġiba sodomitika，而不是 imġiba sodomitiku？
messages.en: Why does it say 'imġiba sodomitika' here rather than 'imġiba sodomitiku'?

messages.speaker: Mark (语言教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax 'imġiba' hija nom femminili, u l-aġġettiv jaqbel magħha.
messages.mt_standard: Għax 'imġiba' hija nom femminili, u l-aġġettiv jaqbel magħha.
messages.zh: 因为 imġiba 是阴性名词，形容词要与它保持一致。
messages.en: Because 'imġiba' is a feminine noun, and the adjective agrees with it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 att sodomitiku 整体记为名词加形容词，看到这个词就想“具有相关性质的”，并留意评价语气。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sedge: any plant belonging to the genus Carex.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 薹草属（Carex）的任一种植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kwalunkwe pjanta li tagħmel parti mill-ġeneru Carex.

sense_translations.en_definition: sedge (any plant of the genus Carex)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 薹草，指薹草属（Carex）的任一种植物。

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw il-weraq tas-sogħda u qabbluhom ma' dawk ta' pjanti oħra.
formal.en: The students observed the sedge's leaves and compared them with those of other plants.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了薹草的叶片，并将其与其他植物的叶片进行比较。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jisimha din il-pjanta? Mark: Din sogħda; fuq it-tikketta hemm l-isem tal-ġeneru, Carex.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's this plant called? Mark: This is a sedge; the label gives the genus name, Carex.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这株植物叫什么？Mark：这是薹草；标签上写着它的属名 Carex。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.zh: 这株植物叫什么？
messages.en: What's this plant called?

messages.speaker: Mark (植物园讲解员)
messages.mt_spoken: Din sogħda; fuq it-tikketta hemm l-isem tal-ġeneru, Carex.
messages.mt_standard: Din sogħda; fuq it-tikketta hemm l-isem tal-ġeneru, Carex.
messages.zh: 这是薹草；标签上写着它的属名 Carex。
messages.en: This is a sedge; the label gives the genus name, Carex.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象植物园里一株挂着 Carex 标签的植物，把 sogħda 与“薹草属植物”配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The sedge species Carex hispida, known in English as hispid sedge.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种薹草，学名为 Carex hispida，英语称为 hispid sedge。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta tal-ispeċi Carex hispida, magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala hispid sedge.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 糙毛薹草，学名为 Carex hispida。

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jelenka s-sogħda tat-tafal bl-isem xjentifiku Carex hispida.
formal.en: The catalogue lists hispid sedge under the scientific name Carex hispida.
formal.zh: 目录以学名 Carex hispida 收录糙毛薹草。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jisimha din il-pjanta? Pawlu: Skont it-tikketta, hija sogħda tat-tafal.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is this plant called? Pawlu: According to the label, it is hispid sedge.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这种植物叫什么？保罗：根据标签，它叫糙毛薹草。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这种植物叫什么？
messages.en: What is this plant called?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 根据标签，它叫糙毛薹草。
messages.en: According to the label, it is hispid sedge.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词组当作植物标签来记，和学名 Carex hispida 配成一对，不必拆词猜义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Soccer: a team sport in which players mainly use their feet to move a ball and score goals.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 足球运动：两队主要用脚控制球，并通过把球踢入对方球门得分的运动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Logħba bejn żewġ timijiet li fiha l-plejers jużaw l-aktar saqajhom biex imexxu l-ballun u jiskurjaw.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 足球；足球运动。

formal.mt: Il-programm sportiv tal-iskola jinkludi taħriġ fis-soker darbtejn fil-ġimgħa.
formal.en: The school's sports programme includes soccer training twice a week.
formal.zh: 学校的体育计划包括每周两次足球训练。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Trid tilgħab is-soker magħna llum? Sara: Iva, imma niġi wara l-ħamsa.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you want to play soccer with us today? Sara: Yes, but I'll come after five.
colloquial.zh: 马克：今天想和我们一起踢足球吗？萨拉：想，不过我五点以后才来。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 今天想和我们一起踢足球吗？
messages.en: Do you want to play soccer with us today?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 想，不过我五点以后才来。
messages.en: Yes, but I'll come after five.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 soker 和英语 soccer 放在同一张足球图片旁，看到词就想起踢球的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of shutting or locking something up; also the state of being drunk after drinking alcohol.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指关闭或锁闭的行为；也指饮酒后处于醉酒、酒醉的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għeluq ta' xi ħaġa, ukoll biċ-ċavetta; jew l-istat ta' min ikun fis-sakra wara li jkun xorob l-alkoħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 关闭；使门窗等合上的行为。
锁闭；把人或物锁起来。
醉酒；因饮酒而处于酒醉状态。
酒醉；酒精导致的醉态。

collocations.en: the locking up of the cell

formal.mt: Id-dokument jiddeskrivi l-proċedura għas-sokor taċ-ċella wara l-ispezzjoni.
formal.en: The document describes the procedure for locking up the cell after the inspection.
formal.zh: 文件说明了检查结束后锁闭牢房的程序。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex qed jitkellem hekk? Toni: Naħseb li hu minħabba s-sokor; xorob wisq.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why is he talking like that? Toni: I think it's because he's drunk; he drank too much.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：他为什么这样说话？托尼：我想是因为喝醉了；他喝得太多了。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 他为什么这样说话？
messages.en: Why is he talking like that?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħseb li hu minħabba s-sokor; xorob wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Naħseb li hu minħabba s-sokor; xorob wisq.
messages.zh: 我想是因为喝醉了；他喝得太多了。
messages.en: I think it's because he's drunk; he drank too much.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 sokor 配两幅图：一幅是门被关上锁住，一幅是人喝醉；依靠上下文选择词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A portable lock with a curved bar, used to secure something such as a gate, chain, or box.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种带弯曲锁环、可移动使用的锁，用于锁住大门、链条或箱子等物品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Serratura li tista' tinġarr, b'parti mgħawġa li tingħalaq biex torbot u tissakkar xi ħaġa, bħal katina jew kaxxa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一把挂锁。

formal.mt: Il-bieb tal-maħżen għandu jinżamm magħluq b'katina u sokra.
formal.en: The storeroom door must be kept secured with a chain and a padlock.
formal.zh: 储藏室的门必须用链条和挂锁锁好。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn hi ċ-ċavetta tas-sokra? David: Fil-kexxun, ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where is the key to the padlock? David: In the drawer, next to the door.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：挂锁的钥匙在哪里？戴维：在门旁边的抽屉里。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 挂锁的钥匙在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the key to the padlock?

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.zh: 在门旁边的抽屉里。
messages.en: In the drawer, next to the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sokra 写在挂锁图旁，再配上一把钥匙；本词条记具体锁具，避免和 sokor 的状态义混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The step or threshold at a doorway, or the horizontal base of a window opening.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 门口的台阶或门槛，也可指窗洞底部的横向台面，即窗台。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tarġa jew il-parti t'isfel fid-daħla ta' bieb, jew il-parti orizzontali fil-qiegħ ta' tieqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 门阶；门槛，即门口供人跨过或踏上的部分。
窗台；窗户底部的横向台面。

formal.mt: Waqt ix-xogħol ta' restawr, is-soll tal-bieb għandu jitnaddaf b'attenzjoni.
formal.en: During the restoration work, the doorstep must be cleaned carefully.
formal.zh: 修复施工期间，应仔细清洁门阶。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn inpoġġi din il-pjanta? Ben: Poġġiha fuq is-soll tat-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where should I put this plant? Ben: Put it on the windowsill.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这盆植物放在哪里？本：放在窗台上吧。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 这盆植物放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put this plant?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.zh: 放在窗台上吧。
messages.en: Put it on the windowsill.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象门底和窗底各有一条横边，两个位置都可用 soll，再靠 bieb 或 tieqa 分清。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to meet financial obligations and pay debts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有履行财务义务、偿还债务的能力的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-mezzi finanzjarji biex iħallas id-djun u jissodisfa l-obbligi finanzjarji tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有偿付能力的；能够偿还债务的。

collocations.zh: 一家有偿付能力的公司

formal.mt: Ir-rapport finanzjarju jikkonferma li l-kumpanija hija solventi u kapaċi tħallas id-djun tagħha.
formal.en: The financial report confirms that the company is solvent and able to pay its debts.
formal.zh: 财务报告确认，该公司具有偿付能力，能够偿还债务。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Il-kumpanija għadha solventi? Mark: Iva, għandha biżżejjed fondi biex tħallas id-djun tagħha.
colloquial.en: Rita: Is the company still solvent? Mark: Yes, it has enough funds to pay its debts.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：公司还有偿付能力吗？马克：有，它有足够的资金偿还债务。

messages.speaker: Rita (公司合伙人)
messages.zh: 公司还有偿付能力吗？
messages.en: Is the company still solvent?

messages.speaker: Mark (会计)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandha biżżejjed fondi biex tħallas id-djun tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandha biżżejjed fondi biex tħallas id-djun tagħha.
messages.zh: 有，它有足够的资金偿还债务。
messages.en: Yes, it has enough funds to pay its debts.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 solventi 放进“公司能还债”的句子里记；它是形容词，用来描述公司或人的偿付能力。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The financial ability of a person or organisation to meet obligations and pay debts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 个人或机构履行财务义务、偿还债务的能力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kapaċità finanzjarja ta' persuna jew organizzazzjoni li tħallas id-djun u tissodisfa l-obbligi finanzjarji tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 偿付能力；个人或机构偿还债务、履行财务义务的能力。

formal.mt: Qabel ma jagħti s-self, il-bank iwettaq valutazzjoni tas-solvibilità tal-kumpanija.
formal.en: Before granting the loan, the bank carries out an assessment of the company's solvency.
formal.zh: 银行在发放贷款之前，会评估公司的偿付能力。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser solvibilità? Pawlu: Tfisser il-kapaċità li tħallas id-djun tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does solvency mean? Pawlu: It means the ability to pay your debts.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：偿付能力是什么意思？保罗：就是偿还自己债务的能力。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 偿付能力是什么意思？
messages.en: What does solvency mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser il-kapaċità li tħallas id-djun tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser il-kapaċità li tħallas id-djun tiegħek.
messages.zh: 就是偿还自己债务的能力。
messages.en: It means the ability to pay your debts.

cognitive_memory_aid: 成对记忆：solventi 表示“有偿付能力的”，solvibilità 表示“偿付能力”，分别对应性质和能力名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Somalia, a country in East Africa in the Horn of Africa, officially called the Federal Republic of Somalia.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 索马里，位于东非非洲之角的国家，正式国名为索马里联邦共和国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Afrika tal-Lvant, fil-Qarn tal-Afrika, li l-isem uffiċjali tiegħu huwa r-Repubblika Federali tas-Somalja.

sense_translations.en_definition: Somalia (a country in East Africa, in the Horn of Africa; official name: Repubblika Federali tas-Somalja)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 索马里，位于东非非洲之角的国家；正式国名为索马里联邦共和国。

formal.mt: Is-Somalja tinsab fl-Afrika tal-Lvant, fir-reġjun magħruf bħala l-Qarn tal-Afrika.
formal.en: Somalia is located in East Africa, in the region known as the Horn of Africa.
formal.zh: 索马里位于东非，地处称为非洲之角的地区。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn tinsab is-Somalja? Adam: Fil-Qarn tal-Afrika. Ejja nfittxuha fuq il-mappa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is Somalia? Adam: In the Horn of Africa. Let's find it on the map.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：索马里在哪里？亚当：在非洲之角。我们在地图上找一找吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 索马里在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Somalia?

messages.speaker: Adam (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-Qarn tal-Afrika. Ejja nfittxuha fuq il-mappa.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-Qarn tal-Afrika. Ejja nfittxuha fuq il-mappa.
messages.zh: 在非洲之角。我们在地图上找一找吧。
messages.en: In the Horn of Africa. Let's find it on the map.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Somalja、Somalia 和“索马里”并排写在非洲之角的地图旁，连同国家名首字母大写一起记。

gloss_zh: 索马里的；索马里男子；索马里语

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of, from, or connected with Somalia, its people, or its culture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自索马里的，或与索马里、索马里人及其文化有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej mis-Somalja jew li għandu x'jaqsam mas-Somalja, man-nies tagħha jew mal-kultura tagħha.

sense_translations.en_definition: Somali (of, from or relating to Somalia)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 索马里的；来自索马里或与索马里有关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: Somali (native or inhabitant of Somalia) (usually male)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 索马里人，即索马里的本地人或居民，通常指男性。
索马里语。

formal.mt: Il-kittieb Somalu tkellem dwar il-letteratura ta' pajjiżu waqt il-konferenza.
formal.en: The Somali writer spoke about his country's literature during the conference.
formal.zh: 这位索马里作家在会议上谈到了自己国家的文学。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak il-kittieb Somalu? Mark: Iva, u jitkellem bis-Somalu u bl-Ingliż.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is that writer Somali? Mark: Yes, and he speaks Somali and English.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那位作家是索马里人吗？Mark：是的，而且他会说索马里语和英语。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那位作家是索马里人吗？
messages.en: Is that writer Somali?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u jitkellem bis-Somalu u bl-Ingliż.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u jitkellem bis-Somalu u bl-Ingliż.
messages.zh: 是的，而且他会说索马里语和英语。
messages.en: Yes, and he speaks Somali and English.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Somalu 连到三张学习卡：索马里的作家、索马里男子、索马里语；看它修饰人还是表示语言来辨义。

gloss_zh: 简要地；径直地；未经充分程序地

teaching_sense.en_definition: Briefly and without detail, or immediately without the usual full procedure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 简短而不展开细节地；也可指未经过通常的完整程序便立即采取行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fil-qosor u mingħajr ħafna dettalji, jew minnufih mingħajr ma tiġi segwita l-proċedura sħiħa tas-soltu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 简要地、概括地；也指径直地、未经通常完整程序地。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi sommarjament il-bidliet ewlenin fil-proġett.
formal.en: The report briefly describes the main changes to the project.
formal.zh: 报告简要描述了项目的主要变化。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Tista' tispjegali sommarjament x'ġara? Pawlu: Iva, il-laqgħa ġiet posposta għax il-kelliem ma setax jiġi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you briefly explain what happened? Pawlu: Yes, the meeting was postponed because the speaker could not come.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你能简要告诉我发生了什么吗？Pawlu：可以，会议延期了，因为发言人来不了。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 你能简要告诉我发生了什么吗？
messages.en: Can you briefly explain what happened?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-laqgħa ġiet posposta għax il-kelliem ma setax jiġi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-laqgħa ġiet posposta għax il-kelliem ma setax jiġi.
messages.zh: 可以，会议延期了，因为发言人来不了。
messages.en: Yes, the meeting was postponed because the speaker could not come.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住两个场景：说明时省去细节，处置时省去程序；用动词搭配判断 sommarjament 的具体含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Internal animal fat, especially the fat around a pig's kidneys; also a layer of fatty tissue.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 动物体内的脂肪，尤指猪肾周围的板油；也可指一层脂肪组织。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xaħam minn ġewwa l-ġisem ta' annimal, speċjalment madwar il-kliewi tal-ħanżir; ukoll saff ta' tessut xaħmi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 板油，尤指猪肾周围可供熬油的成片脂肪。
脂肪层，尤指皮下呈层状分布的脂肪组织。

collocations.en: a layer of fat beneath the skin

formal.mt: Waqt il-preparazzjoni tal-laħam, il-biċċier warrab is-sonża tal-ħanżir biex tintuża separatament.
formal.en: While preparing the meat, the butcher set aside the pig's leaf fat for separate use.
formal.zh: 处理肉类时，肉贩把猪板油另行留出，以便单独使用。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għandek sonża tal-ħanżir? Toni: Iva, kemm trid? Marija: Nofs kilo, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Marija: Do you have pig leaf fat? Toni: Yes, how much would you like? Marija: Half a kilo, please.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你有猪板油吗？Toni：有，你要多少？Marija：请给我半公斤。

messages.speaker: Marija (顾客)
messages.zh: 你有猪板油吗？
messages.en: Do you have pig leaf fat?

messages.speaker: Toni (肉贩)
messages.zh: 有，你要多少？
messages.en: Yes, how much would you like?

messages.speaker: Marija (顾客)
messages.zh: 请给我半公斤。
messages.en: Half a kilo, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sonża 画成一片白色脂肪：肉铺场景记板油，身体组织场景记脂肪层；这是记忆图像，不是词源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cloth used to cover an altar.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 铺在祭台上、用于覆盖祭台的布。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Drapp li jintuża biex jgħatti l-artal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 祭台布；铺盖祭台的布。

collocations.en: to spread the altar cloth over the altar

formal.mt: Qabel iċ-ċerimonja, is-sagristan firex sopraterħa nadifa fuq l-artal.
formal.en: Before the ceremony, the sacristan spread a clean altar cloth over the altar.
formal.zh: 仪式开始前，教堂司事把一块干净的祭台布铺在祭台上。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn hi s-sopraterħa nadifa? Ġużeppi: Fil-kexxun ta' fuq; tista' ġġibha biex inħejju l-artal?
colloquial.en: Anna: Where is the clean altar cloth? Ġużeppi: In the top drawer; can you bring it so we can prepare the altar?
colloquial.zh: Anna：干净的祭台布在哪里？Ġużeppi：在最上面的抽屉里；你能拿过来，让我们布置祭台吗？

messages.speaker: Anna (教堂志愿者)
messages.zh: 干净的祭台布在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the clean altar cloth?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (教堂司事)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-kexxun ta' fuq; tista' ġġibha biex inħejju l-artal?
messages.mt_standard: Fil-kexxun ta' fuq; tista' ġġibha biex inħejju l-artal?
messages.zh: 在最上面的抽屉里；你能拿过来，让我们布置祭台吗？
messages.en: In the top drawer; can you bring it so we can prepare the altar?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象仪式前把白布平整铺上祭台的动作，让 sopraterħa 始终和祭台上的覆盖布联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For a vessel to lie at anchor; also for a person to sit down.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指船只下锚后停泊；也可指人坐下。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bastiment jibqa' wieqaf fuq l-ankra; ukoll persuna toqgħod bilqiegħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 下锚停泊；处于锚泊状态。
坐下；落座。

collocations.en: lay at anchor in the bay

formal.mt: Il-bastiment sorġa fil-bajja sakemm għaddiet il-maltempata.
formal.en: The vessel lay at anchor in the bay until the storm had passed.
formal.zh: 船只在海湾里锚泊，直到风暴过去。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu n-nannu? Mark: Sorġa fuq siġġu ħdejn it-tieqa biex jistrieħ ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is Grandpa? Mark: He sat down on a chair by the window to rest for a while.
colloquial.zh: Maja：爷爷在哪里？Mark：他在窗边的椅子上坐下，休息一会儿。

messages.speaker: Maja (孙女)
messages.zh: 爷爷在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Grandpa?

messages.speaker: Mark (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: Sorġa fuq siġġu ħdejn it-tieqa biex jistrieħ ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Sorġa fuq siġġu ħdejn it-tieqa biex jistrieħ ftit.
messages.zh: 他在窗边的椅子上坐下，休息一会儿。
messages.en: He sat down on a chair by the window to rest for a while.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个停下来的画面记 sorġa：船停在锚上，人坐到椅子上；先看主语是船还是人，再选择词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An anchor used to hold a ship in place when it is moored.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 船只系泊时用来固定船位、防止漂移的锚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ankra li tintuża biex iżżomm bastiment f'postu waqt l-irmiġġ.

sense_translations.en_definition: an anchor used to moor a ship
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于船只系泊、固定船位的锚。

formal.mt: L-ekwipaġġ eżamina l-katina tas-sorġitur qabel ma l-bastiment telaq mill-port.
formal.en: The crew inspected the mooring anchor's chain before the vessel left the port.
formal.zh: 船只离港前，船员检查了系泊锚的锚链。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Dan is-sorġitur tqil ħafna! Pawlu: Iva, ejja nerfgħuh flimkien.
colloquial.en: Toni: This mooring anchor is very heavy! Pawlu: Yes, let's lift it together.
colloquial.zh: Toni：这个系泊锚真重！Pawlu：是啊，我们一起抬吧。

messages.speaker: Toni (船员)
messages.zh: 这个系泊锚真重！
messages.en: This mooring anchor is very heavy!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (船员)
messages.zh: 是啊，我们一起抬吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's lift it together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sorġitur 记成船底连着锚链的沉重铁锚，核心用途是固定船位；配合锚链的画面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The ability of an activity or system to continue over the long term without exhausting the resources it depends on.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某项活动或某个系统能够长期维持，同时不耗尽其所依赖资源的性质或能力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kapaċità ta' attività jew sistema li tibqa' għaddejja fit-tul mingħajr ma teżawrixxi r-riżorsi li tiddependi fuqhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可持续性；在资源、环境或经济条件允许下长期维持的能力。

formal.mt: L-istudju jevalwa s-sostenibbiltà ambjentali u finanzjarja tal-proġett fuq medda ta' għaxar snin.
formal.en: The study evaluates the project's environmental and financial sustainability over a ten-year period.
formal.zh: 这项研究评估了该项目在十年期间的环境与财务可持续性。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed tixtri inqas affarijiet ġodda? Maja: Qed naħseb aktar fis-sostenibbiltà u nipprova nuża dak li diġà għandi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you buying fewer new things? Maja: I'm thinking more about sustainability and trying to use what I already have.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你为什么买的新东西变少了？Maja：我现在更关注可持续性，尽量使用自己已有的东西。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tixtri inqas affarijiet ġodda?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tixtri inqas affarijiet ġodda?
messages.zh: 你为什么买的新东西变少了？
messages.en: Why are you buying fewer new things?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed naħseb aktar fis-sostenibbiltà u nipprova nuża dak li diġà għandi.
messages.mt_standard: Qed naħseb aktar fis-sostenibbiltà u nipprova nuża dak li diġà għandi.
messages.zh: 我现在更关注可持续性，尽量使用自己已有的东西。
messages.en: I'm thinking more about sustainability and trying to use what I already have.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sostenibbiltà 放进“这个做法能长期维持吗”的问题里，记它是表示可持续性这一性质的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to continue over the long term without exhausting necessary resources or causing lasting environmental harm.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够长期维持，而不耗尽必要资源或造成持久环境损害的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jibqa' għaddej fit-tul mingħajr ma jeżawrixxi r-riżorsi meħtieġa jew jikkawża ħsara dejjiema lill-ambjent.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可持续的；能够在资源、环境或经济条件允许下长期维持的。

formal.mt: Il-pjan jipproponi sistema ta' trasport sostenibbli li tnaqqas it-tniġġis u l-konsum tal-enerġija.
formal.en: The plan proposes a sustainable transport system that reduces pollution and energy consumption.
formal.zh: 该计划提出建立一种可持续的交通系统，以减少污染和能源消耗。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Immorru b'karozza waħda minflok tnejn? Lara: Iva, hekk ikun aktar sostenibbli u niffrankaw il-fjuwil ukoll.
colloquial.en: Mark: Shall we take one car instead of two? Lara: Yes, that would be more sustainable, and we'd save fuel too.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我们合乘一辆车，不开两辆，好吗？Lara：好，这样更可持续，还能节省燃油。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 我们合乘一辆车，不开两辆，好吗？
messages.en: Shall we take one car instead of two?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hekk ikun aktar sostenibbli u niffrankaw il-fjuwil ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hekk ikun aktar sostenibbli u niffrankaw il-fjuwil ukoll.
messages.zh: 好，这样更可持续，还能节省燃油。
messages.en: Yes, that would be more sustainable, and we'd save fuel too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“可持续的交通”记 sostenibbli 的修饰作用；再与名词 sostenibbiltà“可持续性”成对复习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who supports a person, group, cause, or proposal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 支持某个人、团体、事业或提议的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tappoġġja persuna oħra, grupp, kawża jew proposta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 支持者；拥护者；提供支持的人。

formal.mt: Bħala sostenitur tal-proġett, is-Sur Borg offra l-għajnuna tiegħu fit-tħejjija tal-attivitajiet.
formal.en: As a supporter of the project, Mr Borg offered his help in preparing the activities.
formal.zh: 博尔格先生作为该项目的支持者，主动帮助筹备活动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Int sostenitur ta' dan it-tim? Mark: Iva, immur nara l-logħob tiegħu kull meta nista'.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you a supporter of this team? Mark: Yes, I go to watch their matches whenever I can.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你是这支球队的支持者吗？马克：是啊，只要有空，我就去看他们的比赛。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你是这支球队的支持者吗？
messages.en: Are you a supporter of this team?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, immur nara l-logħob tiegħu kull meta nista'.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, immur nara l-logħob tiegħu kull meta nista'.
messages.zh: 是啊，只要有空，我就去看他们的比赛。
messages.en: Yes, I go to watch their matches whenever I can.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象看台上一直为球队加油的人，把 sostenitur 与“站在某一方、给予支持的人”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of presenting something for consideration, or of accepting another person's authority or control.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将材料交付审议的行为；也指接受他人的权威或控制，表现为顺从或屈服。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jippreżenta xi ħaġa biex tiġi kkunsidrata, jew li jaċċetta l-awtorità jew il-kontroll ta' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 提交、呈交；也可指对权威或控制的顺从、屈服。

formal.mt: Is-sottomissjoni tad-dokumenti kollha għandha ssir qabel id-data tal-għeluq.
formal.en: All documents must be submitted before the closing date.
formal.zh: 所有文件均须在截止日期前提交。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta hi l-aħħar data għas-sottomissjoni tad-dokumenti? Mark: Il-Ġimgħa, imma jien se nibgħathom illum.
colloquial.en: Maja: When is the deadline for submitting the documents? Mark: Friday, but I'm going to send them today.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：提交文件的截止日期是什么时候？马克：星期五，不过我打算今天就发过去。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta hi l-aħħar data għas-sottomissjoni tad-dokumenti?
messages.mt_standard: Meta hi l-aħħar data għas-sottomissjoni tad-dokumenti?
messages.zh: 提交文件的截止日期是什么时候？
messages.en: When is the deadline for submitting the documents?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-Ġimgħa, imma jien se nibgħathom illum.
messages.mt_standard: Il-Ġimgħa, imma jien se nibgħathom illum.
messages.zh: 星期五，不过我打算今天就发过去。
messages.en: Friday, but I'm going to send them today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面区分语境：把文件交上去是“提交”，接受别人支配是“顺从”；两者都可对应 sottomissjoni。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of learning to participate in society and relate to others, including interaction that develops social relationships.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 学习参与社会生活、与他人相处的过程，也指有助于建立社会关系的交往活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih persuna titgħallem tgħix u taġixxi ma' oħrajn fis-soċjetà, kif ukoll l-interazzjoni li tibni relazzjonijiet soċjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 社会化，即学习社会生活方式和交往规范的过程；也可指与他人交往、建立关系的社交活动。

formal.mt: L-iskola tippromwovi s-soċjalizzazzjoni tat-tfal permezz ta' logħob u attivitajiet fi gruppi.
formal.en: The school promotes children's socialization through play and group activities.
formal.zh: 学校通过游戏和小组活动促进儿童的社会化。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex trid tmur fil-klabb il-ġdid? Mark: Għas-soċjalizzazzjoni; nixtieq niltaqa' ma' nies ġodda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you want to go to the new club? Mark: To socialize; I'd like to meet new people.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么想去那个新俱乐部？马克：为了社交，我想认识一些新朋友。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么想去那个新俱乐部？
messages.en: Why do you want to go to the new club?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għas-soċjalizzazzjoni; nixtieq niltaqa' ma' nies ġodda.
messages.mt_standard: Għas-soċjalizzazzjoni; nixtieq niltaqa' ma' nies ġodda.
messages.zh: 为了社交，我想认识一些新朋友。
messages.en: To socialize; I'd like to meet new people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象孩子从独自玩耍走向小组合作，再联想到成人认识新朋友，用 soċjalizzazzjoni 记住社会化与社交过程。

gloss_zh: 在社交上；从社会层面看

teaching_sense.en_definition: In relation to social interaction, relationships with other people, or life in society.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在与他人的交往、社会关系或社会生活方面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fir-rigward tal-interazzjoni ma' nies oħra, tar-relazzjonijiet magħhom jew tal-ħajja fis-soċjetà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在社交方面；就社会关系或社会生活而言；从社会层面看。

formal.mt: Il-programm jgħin lil persuni li huma iżolati soċjalment biex jibnu relazzjonijiet fil-komunità.
formal.en: The programme helps people who are socially isolated build relationships in the community.
formal.zh: 该项目帮助在社会交往上孤立的人在社区中建立人际关系。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-aħħar sirt attiv ħafna soċjalment! Mark: Iva, issa niltaqa' ma' sħabi darbtejn fil-ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: You've become very socially active lately! Mark: Yes, I now meet my friends twice a week.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你最近社交很活跃啊！马克：是的，我现在每周和朋友见两次面。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-aħħar sirt attiv ħafna soċjalment!
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-aħħar sirt attiv ħafna soċjalment!
messages.zh: 你最近社交很活跃啊！
messages.en: You've become very socially active lately!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa niltaqa' ma' sħabi darbtejn fil-ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa niltaqa' ma' sħabi darbtejn fil-ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 是的，我现在每周和朋友见两次面。
messages.en: Yes, I now meet my friends twice a week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 soċjalment，就在句中补上“在社交方面”：attiv soċjalment 是“在社交方面很活跃”，借此记住它是副词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The sphere of voluntary groups, associations and organizations outside government through which people pursue shared interests and participate in public life.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人们通过政府之外的自愿团体、协会和组织追求共同利益、参与公共生活所形成的社会领域。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qasam ta' gruppi, għaqdiet u organizzazzjonijiet volontarji barra mill-gvern li permezz tagħhom in-nies jaħdmu għal interessi komuni u jieħdu sehem fil-ħajja pubblika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公民社会；由政府之外的自愿团体、协会等组成、供公众参与公共事务的社会领域。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jenfasizza l-importanza tal-parteċipazzjoni tas-soċjetà ċivili fid-diskussjoni dwar l-ambjent.
formal.en: The report emphasizes the importance of civil society participation in the discussion about the environment.
formal.zh: 报告强调公民社会参与环境议题讨论的重要性。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jieħu sehem fil-laqgħa? Mark: Se jkun hemm ukoll rappreżentanti tas-soċjetà ċivili, fosthom membri ta' għaqdiet ambjentali.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who will take part in the meeting? Mark: There will also be civil society representatives, including members of environmental organizations.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁会参加会议？Mark：也会有公民社会代表，包括环保组织的成员。

messages.speaker: Maja (社区居民)
messages.zh: 谁会参加会议？
messages.en: Who will take part in the meeting?

messages.speaker: Mark (社区活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Se jkun hemm ukoll rappreżentanti tas-soċjetà ċivili, fosthom membri ta' għaqdiet ambjentali.
messages.mt_standard: Se jkun hemm ukoll rappreżentanti tas-soċjetà ċivili, fosthom membri ta' għaqdiet ambjentali.
messages.zh: 也会有公民社会代表，包括环保组织的成员。
messages.en: There will also be civil society representatives, including members of environmental organizations.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词组配上一幅居民通过协会参与公共讨论的画面，记住它指公民社会这一领域。

gloss_zh: 合群性；乐于交往的性格

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of enjoying other people's company and being willing to interact with them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 喜欢与他人相处、愿意交流交往的性格特点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' persuna li tieħu gost tkun ma' oħrajn u titkellem magħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 合群性；喜欢与人相处、乐于交往的性格特点。

formal.mt: L-għalliema faħħret is-soċjevolezza ta' Lara u l-mod kif tinkludi lil sħabha fil-logħob.
formal.en: The teacher praised Lara's sociability and the way she includes her classmates in games.
formal.zh: 老师表扬了拉拉乐于交往的性格，以及她邀请同学一起玩游戏的做法。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif mar ħuk mal-grupp il-ġdid? Mark: Tajjeb ħafna! Is-soċjevolezza tiegħu għenitu jagħmel ħbieb malajr.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did your brother get on with the new group? Mark: Very well! His sociability helped him make friends quickly.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你兄弟和新团队相处得怎么样？Mark：很好！他乐于交往的性格让他很快就交到了朋友。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你兄弟和新团队相处得怎么样？
messages.en: How did your brother get on with the new group?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb ħafna! Is-soċjevolezza tiegħu għenitu jagħmel ħbieb malajr.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb ħafna! Is-soċjevolezza tiegħu għenitu jagħmel ħbieb malajr.
messages.zh: 很好！他乐于交往的性格让他很快就交到了朋友。
messages.en: Very well! His sociability helped him make friends quickly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个主动加入聊天、很快交到朋友的人；这个名词给他乐于交往的性格命名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Enjoying the company of other people and readily talking or spending time with them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 喜欢与他人相处，愿意聊天或一起活动的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jieħu gost ikun ma' nies oħra u jkun lest jitkellem jew iqatta' ħin magħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 合群的；喜欢与人相处、乐于交往的。

formal.mt: L-istudent huwa soċjevoli u jieħu sehem b'entużjażmu fl-attivitajiet tal-grupp.
formal.en: The student is sociable and takes part enthusiastically in group activities.
formal.zh: 这名学生很合群，积极热情地参加小组活动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif inhu l-ġar il-ġdid? Mark: Soċjevoli ħafna; dejjem jieqaf jitkellem magħna.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's the new neighbor like? Mark: Very sociable; he always stops to chat with us.
colloquial.zh: Maja：新邻居怎么样？Mark：很爱与人交往，总会停下来和我们聊聊。

messages.speaker: Maja (居民)
messages.zh: 新邻居怎么样？
messages.en: What's the new neighbor like?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Soċjevoli ħafna; dejjem jieqaf jitkellem magħna.
messages.mt_standard: Soċjevoli ħafna; dejjem jieqaf jitkellem magħna.
messages.zh: 很爱与人交往，总会停下来和我们聊聊。
messages.en: Very sociable; he always stops to chat with us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用来回答一个人是否爱与人相处：给主动聊天的人贴上 soċjevoli，记住这是形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who works with another person in a business or shared undertaking as a partner or associate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在生意或共同事业中与他人合作的合伙人或伙伴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li taħdem ma' persuna oħra bħala sieħeb f'negozju jew f'ħidma komuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 合伙人；在业务或共同事业中合作的伙伴。

formal.mt: Kull soċju għandu jaqra l-ftehim qabel ma jiffirmah.
formal.en: Each partner should read the agreement before signing it.
formal.zh: 每位合伙人在签署协议之前都应阅读协议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se tiftaħ il-ħanut waħdek? Mark: Le, se niftħu ma' soċju li għandu esperjenza fil-bejgħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you going to open the shop on your own? Mark: No, I'll open it with a partner who has experience in sales.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你打算独自开店吗？Mark：不，我会和一位有销售经验的合伙人一起开。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你打算独自开店吗？
messages.en: Are you going to open the shop on your own?

messages.speaker: Mark (创业者)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, se niftħu ma' soċju li għandu esperjenza fil-bejgħ.
messages.mt_standard: Le, se niftħu ma' soċju li għandu esperjenza fil-bejgħ.
messages.zh: 不，我会和一位有销售经验的合伙人一起开。
messages.en: No, I'll open it with a partner who has experience in sales.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两个人共同开店、一起商量经营事务；其中与你合伙的那个人就是 soċju。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bird of prey called the American kestrel, with the scientific name Falco sparverius.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 称为美洲隼的猛禽，学名为 Falco sparverius。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-priża magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala American kestrel, bl-isem xjentifiku Falco sparverius.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 美洲隼，学名 Falco sparverius。

collocations.en: a photograph of an American kestrel
the identification of an American kestrel

formal.mt: Il-paġna turi ritratt ta' spanjulett Amerikan u tagħti l-isem xjentifiku tiegħu, Falco sparverius.
formal.en: The page shows a photograph of an American kestrel and gives its scientific name, Falco sparverius.
formal.zh: 这一页展示了美洲隼的照片，并列出了它的学名 Falco sparverius。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan fir-ritratt hu spanjulett Amerikan? Mark: Iva, hekk hemm miktub taħt ir-ritratt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this bird in the photo an American kestrel? Mark: Yes, that's what it says under the photo.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：照片里的这只鸟是美洲隼吗？马克：是的，照片下面是这样写的。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 照片里的这只鸟是美洲隼吗？
messages.en: Is this bird in the photo an American kestrel?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hekk hemm miktub taħt ir-ritratt.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hekk hemm miktub taħt ir-ritratt.
messages.zh: 是的，照片下面是这样写的。
messages.en: Yes, that's what it says under the photo.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作“美洲隼—spanjulett Amerikan—Falco sparverius”三栏卡片，用 Amerikan 提醒自己对应的是美洲隼。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bird of prey called the lesser kestrel, with the scientific name Falco naumanni.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 称为黄爪隼的猛禽，学名为 Falco naumanni。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-priża magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala lesser kestrel, bl-isem xjentifiku Falco naumanni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黄爪隼，学名 Falco naumanni。

collocations.en: a photograph of a lesser kestrel
the identification of a lesser kestrel

formal.mt: Fil-gwida, l-isem spanjulett sekond jidher ħdejn l-isem xjentifiku Falco naumanni.
formal.en: In the guide, the name spanjulett sekond appears beside the scientific name Falco naumanni.
formal.zh: 在这本指南中，马耳他语名称 spanjulett sekond 列在学名 Falco naumanni 旁边。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif insib l-ispanjulett sekond f'din il-gwida? Mark: Fittex Falco naumanni fl-indiċi.
colloquial.en: Maja: How do I find the lesser kestrel in this guide? Mark: Look for Falco naumanni in the index.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我怎么在这本指南里找到黄爪隼？马克：在索引里查 Falco naumanni。

messages.speaker: Maja (观鸟初学者)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif insib l-ispanjulett sekond f'din il-gwida?
messages.mt_standard: Kif insib l-ispanjulett sekond f'din il-gwida?
messages.zh: 我怎么在这本指南里找到黄爪隼？
messages.en: How do I find the lesser kestrel in this guide?

messages.speaker: Mark (观鸟伙伴)
messages.zh: 在索引里查 Falco naumanni。
messages.en: Look for Falco naumanni in the index.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 spanjulett sekond、lesser kestrel、黄爪隼写在同一张识鸟卡上，再用 Falco naumanni 核对，整组记忆避免混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bird of prey called the Eurasian sparrowhawk, with the scientific name Accipiter nisus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 称为雀鹰的猛禽，学名为 Accipiter nisus。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-priża magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala Eurasian sparrowhawk, bl-isem xjentifiku Accipiter nisus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 雀鹰，学名 Accipiter nisus。

formal.mt: Għall-eżerċizzju, l-istudenti għandhom isibu ritratt ta' sparvier u jiktbu l-isem xjentifiku tiegħu, Accipiter nisus.
formal.en: For the exercise, students should find a photograph of a Eurasian sparrowhawk and write its scientific name, Accipiter nisus.
formal.zh: 在这项练习中，学生应找一张雀鹰的照片，并写出它的学名 Accipiter nisus。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-għasfur hu sparvier? Mark: M'iniex ċert. Ejja nqabblu r-ritratt mal-istampa fil-gwida.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this bird a sparrowhawk? Mark: I'm not sure. Let's compare the photo with the picture in the guide.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这只鸟是雀鹰吗？马克：我不确定。我们把照片和指南里的图片对照一下吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (观鸟初学者)
messages.zh: 这只鸟是雀鹰吗？
messages.en: Is this bird a sparrowhawk?

messages.speaker: Mark (观鸟伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: M'iniex ċert. Ejja nqabblu r-ritratt mal-istampa fil-gwida.
messages.mt_standard: M'iniex ċert. Ejja nqabblu r-ritratt mal-istampa fil-gwida.
messages.zh: 我不确定。我们把照片和指南里的图片对照一下吧。
messages.en: I'm not sure. Let's compare the photo with the picture in the guide.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在雀鹰图片下同时标注 sparvier 和 Accipiter nisus，练习看到图片说出鸟名，再看到鸟名回想图片。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bird of prey known in English as a goshawk.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种猛禽，中文称苍鹰，英语称 goshawk。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-priża magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala goshawk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 苍鹰。

formal.mt: Il-materjal tat-tagħlim jinkludi ritratt ta' sparvier tal-ħamiem bl-isem tiegħu bil-Malti u bl-Ingliż.
formal.en: The teaching material includes a photograph of a goshawk with its name in Maltese and English.
formal.zh: 教学材料中包含一张苍鹰的照片，并标有它的马耳他语和英语名称。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif ngħid goshawk bil-Malti? Mark: Sparvier tal-ħamiem. Ikteb l-isem kollu ħdejn ir-ritratt.
colloquial.en: Maja: How do I say goshawk in Maltese? Mark: Sparvier tal-ħamiem. Write the whole name beside the photo.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：goshawk 用马耳他语怎么说？马克：Sparvier tal-ħamiem。把完整名称写在照片旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: goshawk 用马耳他语怎么说？
messages.en: How do I say goshawk in Maltese?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Sparvier tal-ħamiem. Ikteb l-isem kollu ħdejn ir-ritratt.
messages.mt_standard: Sparvier tal-ħamiem. Ikteb l-isem kollu ħdejn ir-ritratt.
messages.zh: Sparvier tal-ħamiem。把完整名称写在照片旁边。
messages.en: Sparvier tal-ħamiem. Write the whole name beside the photo.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sparvier tal-ħamiem 整体框起来记作“苍鹰”；另做 sparvier“雀鹰”卡，提醒自己完整短语对应不同鸟名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To arrange things with gaps or intervals between them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 安排事物的位置，使它们彼此之间留有空隙或间隔。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqiegħed affarijiet b'ċertu spazju jew intervall bejniethom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使事物之间留出间隔；按一定间距排列。

formal.mt: Spazja l-ittri tat-titlu b'mod uniformi biex it-test ikun aktar faċli biex jinqara.
formal.en: Space the letters of the title evenly to make the text easier to read.
formal.zh: 将标题中的字母间距调整均匀，使文字更易阅读。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Spazja s-siġġijiet ftit aktar, jekk jogħġbok. Mark: Hekk tajjeb, jew trid aktar spazju bejniethom?
colloquial.en: Maja: Space the chairs a little farther apart, please. Mark: Is this okay, or do you want more space between them?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：请把椅子之间的距离再拉开一点。马克：这样可以吗，还是要再多留一点空隙？

messages.speaker: Maja (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Spazja s-siġġijiet ftit aktar, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Spazja s-siġġijiet ftit aktar, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 请把椅子之间的距离再拉开一点。
messages.en: Space the chairs a little farther apart, please.

messages.speaker: Mark (志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Hekk tajjeb, jew trid aktar spazju bejniethom?
messages.mt_standard: Hekk tajjeb, jew trid aktar spazju bejniethom?
messages.zh: 这样可以吗，还是要再多留一点空隙？
messages.en: Is this okay, or do you want more space between them?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把挤在一起的字母或椅子逐个拉开，边做边说 spazja，把这个动词和“留间距”的动作绑定。

gloss_zh: 空间的；与空间位置有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to space, positions, or the arrangement of things in space.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与空间、位置或事物在空间中的排列有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-ispazju, mal-pożizzjonijiet jew mal-arranġament tal-affarijiet fl-ispazju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 空间的；涉及空间位置、关系或排列的。

formal.mt: L-eżerċizzju jgħin lill-istudenti jifhmu r-relazzjonijiet spazjali bejn l-oġġetti fid-dijagramma.
formal.en: The exercise helps students understand the spatial relationships between the objects in the diagram.
formal.zh: 这项练习帮助学生理解示意图中各物体之间的空间关系。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser relazzjoni spazjali? Mark: Fejn tkun ħaġa meta tqabbilha ma' oħra, bħal meta l-kaxxa tkun taħt il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does a spatial relationship mean? Mark: Where one thing is in relation to another, like when the box is under the table.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：空间关系是什么意思？马克：就是一个东西相对于另一个东西的位置，比如箱子在桌子下面。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 空间关系是什么意思？
messages.en: What does a spatial relationship mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn tkun ħaġa meta tqabbilha ma' oħra, bħal meta l-kaxxa tkun taħt il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Fejn tkun ħaġa meta tqabbilha ma' oħra, bħal meta l-kaxxa tkun taħt il-mejda.
messages.zh: 就是一个东西相对于另一个东西的位置，比如箱子在桌子下面。
messages.en: Where one thing is in relation to another, like when the box is under the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一张桌子和桌下的箱子，把“上、下、旁边”等位置关系圈起来，并标注 spazjali，记住它描述空间关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The amount or arrangement of space between letters, words, lines, or other elements.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 字母、词语、行或其他元素之间的距离及其安排。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-distanza jew l-arranġament tal-ispazji bejn ittri, kliem, linji jew elementi oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 间距；各元素之间空隙的安排。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Id-distanza bejn elementi u l-mod kif jitħallew l-ispazji bejniethom.

formal.mt: Spazjatura xierqa bejn il-linji tagħmel id-dokument aktar faċli biex jinqara.
formal.en: Appropriate spacing between lines makes the document easier to read.
formal.zh: 适当的行间距能使文件更易阅读。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dan it-test diffiċli biex jinqara? Mark: L-ispazjatura bejn il-linji hija żgħira wisq. Se nżidha ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is this text hard to read? Mark: The spacing between the lines is too small. I'll increase it a little.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这段文字为什么读起来这么费劲？马克：行间距太小了。我把它调大一点。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan it-test diffiċli biex jinqara?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan it-test diffiċli biex jinqara?
messages.zh: 这段文字为什么读起来这么费劲？
messages.en: Why is this text hard to read?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ispazjatura bejn il-linji hija żgħira wisq. Se nżidha ftit.
messages.mt_standard: L-ispazjatura bejn il-linji hija żgħira wisq. Se nżidha ftit.
messages.zh: 行间距太小了。我把它调大一点。
messages.en: The spacing between the lines is too small. I'll increase it a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把拥挤的文字行拉开，留出舒适空隙；用这个排版画面记住 spazjatura 表示间距。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A short summary that presents the main points of a story, work, or subject.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 简要呈现故事、作品或主题主要内容的梗概。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sommarju qasir li jippreżenta l-punti ewlenin ta' storja, xogħol jew suġġett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 梗概；概述主要情节或要点的内容提要。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sommarju tal-ġrajja jew tal-punti ewlenin.

formal.mt: L-istudenti għandhom jiktbu spekkjett tar-rumanz li jippreżenta l-ġrajjiet ewlenin b'mod ċar.
formal.en: Students should write a synopsis of the novel that presents the main events clearly.
formal.zh: 学生应撰写小说梗概，清楚地概述主要情节。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qrajt l-istorja kollha? Mark: Għadni le, imma qrajt spekkjett tagħha u naf x'jiġri fil-qosor.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you read the whole story? Mark: Not yet, but I've read a synopsis of it and know roughly what happens.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你读完整个故事了吗？马克：还没有，不过我读了梗概，大致知道发生了什么。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你读完整个故事了吗？
messages.en: Have you read the whole story?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni le, imma qrajt spekkjett tagħha u naf x'jiġri fil-qosor.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni le, imma qrajt spekkjett tagħha u naf x'jiġri fil-qosor.
messages.zh: 还没有，不过我读了梗概，大致知道发生了什么。
messages.en: Not yet, but I've read a synopsis of it and know roughly what happens.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把一本厚小说想象成压缩后的一页情节提要；用这张只留主要事件的小纸页记住 spekkjett。

gloss_zh: 即兴地；脱口而出地；即兴编词的马耳他歌唱形式

teaching_sense.en_definition: In an improvised manner, using words or ideas that have not been prepared in advance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 即兴地表达，使用事先未准备好的话语或想法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod improvviżat, bi kliem jew ideat li ma jkunux tħejjew minn qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 即兴地；临场构思并表达地。
sense_translations.mt_definition: B'mod improvviżat, mingħajr tħejjija minn qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 未经事先准备地；随口地；当场作答地。
sense_translations.mt_definition: B'mod spontanju, mingħajr kliem imħejji minn qabel.

sense_translations.en_definition: a form of Maltese għana where singers improvise their lyrics
sense_translations.zh_definition: 马耳他传统歌唱 għana 的一种形式，歌手在演唱时即兴编创歌词。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Forma ta' għana Malti li fiha l-għannejja jivvintaw il-kliem waqt li jkunu qed jgħannu.

collocations.zh: 即兴编词的马耳他 għana 歌唱

formal.mt: Matul id-diskussjoni, il-kelliem wieġeb bi spirtu pront għall-mistoqsijiet tal-udjenza.
formal.en: During the discussion, the speaker answered the audience's questions off the cuff.
formal.zh: 讨论期间，发言人即兴回答了听众的问题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kont ħejjejt dik it-tweġiba minn qabel? Mark: Le, weġibt bi spirtu pront meta staqsewni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Had you prepared that answer beforehand? Mark: No, I answered off the cuff when they asked me.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个回答是你事先准备好的吗？马克：不是，他们问我时，我当场即兴回答的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kont ħejjejt dik it-tweġiba minn qabel?
messages.mt_standard: Kont ħejjejt dik it-tweġiba minn qabel?
messages.zh: 那个回答是你事先准备好的吗？
messages.en: Had you prepared that answer beforehand?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, weġibt bi spirtu pront meta staqsewni.
messages.mt_standard: Le, weġibt bi spirtu pront meta staqsewni.
messages.zh: 不是，他们问我时，我当场即兴回答的。
messages.en: No, I answered off the cuff when they asked me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住两个临场画面：发言人当场回答，歌手当场编词；前者帮助记副词义，后者帮助记歌唱形式的名词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A surname of Sicilian origin, written Spiteri with an initial capital letter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 源自西西里的姓氏，书写为首字母大写的 Spiteri，可音译为“斯皮泰里”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom ta' oriġini Sqallija, miktub Spiteri b'ittra kapitali fil-bidu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 源自西西里的姓氏 Spiteri，音译为“斯皮泰里”。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kunjom ta' oriġini Sqallija.

formal.mt: Is-Sur Spiteri se jippreżenta r-rapport waqt il-laqgħa ta' għada.
formal.en: Mr Spiteri will present the report at tomorrow's meeting.
formal.zh: 斯皮泰里先生将在明天的会议上介绍报告。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jismu l-għalliem il-ġdid? Mark: Jismu Paul Spiteri. Għandna l-ewwel lezzjoni miegħu għada.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's the new teacher's name? Mark: His name is Paul Spiteri. We have our first lesson with him tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：新老师叫什么名字？马克：他叫保罗·斯皮泰里。明天我们上他的第一节课。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 新老师叫什么名字？
messages.en: What's the new teacher's name?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Jismu Paul Spiteri. Għandna l-ewwel lezzjoni miegħu għada.
messages.mt_standard: Jismu Paul Spiteri. Għandna l-ewwel lezzjoni miegħu għada.
messages.zh: 他叫保罗·斯皮泰里。明天我们上他的第一节课。
messages.en: His name is Paul Spiteri. We have our first lesson with him tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张写着 Paul Spiteri 的姓名牌，把后半部分圈出标为姓氏，并记住实际书写时 S 要大写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to be explained or made understandable by giving reasons or information.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够通过提供原因或相关信息得到解释、使人理解的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jiġi spjegat jew jinftiehem billi jingħataw raġunijiet jew informazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可解释的；能够说明其原因或道理的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jista' jiġi spjegat.

formal.mt: Id-dewmien huwa spjegabbli minħabba l-ħsara fit-tagħmir.
formal.en: The delay can be explained by the equipment failure.
formal.zh: 设备故障可以解释这次延误。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hemm differenza bejn iż-żewġ riżultati? Mark: Huwa spjegabbli: użajna metodi differenti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is there a difference between the two results? Mark: It can be explained: we used different methods.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么两个结果有差别？马克：这可以解释：我们用了不同的方法。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm differenza bejn iż-żewġ riżultati?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm differenza bejn iż-żewġ riżultati?
messages.zh: 为什么两个结果有差别？
messages.en: Why is there a difference between the two results?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 这可以解释：我们用了不同的方法。
messages.en: It can be explained: we used different methods.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到一个问号后面补上清楚的原因，问号就变成了说明；用“能讲清楚为什么”记住 spjegabbli。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To burst apart suddenly and violently, usually with a loud noise.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 突然猛烈地炸开或爆裂，通常伴随很大的声响。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinfaqa' f'daqqa u b'qawwa, ġeneralment b'ħoss qawwi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爆炸；突然猛烈地爆裂。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jinfaqa' b'qawwa u f'daqqa.

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, il-kontenitur sploda ftit wara li bdiet in-nar.
formal.en: According to the report, the container exploded shortly after the fire started.
formal.zh: 报告称，起火后不久，容器发生了爆炸。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'kien dak il-ħoss qawwi? Mark: Tajer tar-rota sploda. Għalhekk waqaft.
colloquial.en: Maja: What was that loud noise? Mark: A bicycle tyre burst. That's why I stopped.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：刚才那声巨响是什么？马克：自行车的一个轮胎爆了，所以我停下来了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 刚才那声巨响是什么？
messages.en: What was that loud noise?

messages.speaker: Mark (骑车的朋友)
messages.zh: 自行车的一个轮胎爆了，所以我停下来了。
messages.en: A bicycle tyre burst. That's why I stopped.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sploda 和轮胎突然“砰”地爆裂的画面一起记；核心动作是突然炸开，并常伴随很大的声响。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small roof; the diminutive form of the Maltese noun saqaf.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小型屋顶；是马耳他语名词 saqaf（屋顶）的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Saqaf żgħir; il-forma diminuttiva tal-kelma saqaf.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small roof (the diminutive form of 'saqaf')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小屋顶，名词 saqaf（屋顶）的指小形式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Saqaf żgħir, jiġifieri l-forma diminuttiva ta' saqaf.

collocations.en: a small roof over the door

formal.mt: Il-pjanta turi sqajjaf fuq il-bieb tad-dħul biex jipproteġi d-daħla mix-xita.
formal.en: The plan shows a small roof over the entrance door to protect the entrance from rain.
formal.zh: 图纸显示，入口门上方设有一个小屋顶，用于遮挡雨水。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn nistgħu noqogħdu sakemm tieqaf ix-xita? Mark: Taħt dak is-sqajjaf ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where can we wait until the rain stops? Mark: Under that small roof by the door.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们可以在哪里等雨停？马克：就在门旁边那个小屋顶下面。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn nistgħu noqogħdu sakemm tieqaf ix-xita?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn nistgħu noqogħdu sakemm tieqaf ix-xita?
messages.zh: 我们可以在哪里等雨停？
messages.en: Where can we wait until the rain stops?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 就在门旁边那个小屋顶下面。
messages.en: Under that small roof by the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先画一个 saqaf 屋顶，再把它缩小成门口挡雨的小屋顶；用大小对照记住 sqajjaf 的指小意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sicily, the largest island in the Mediterranean Sea and an autonomous region of Italy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 西西里，地中海最大的岛屿，也是意大利的一个自治区。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-akbar gżira fil-Baħar Mediterran u reġjun awtonomu tal-Italja.

sense_translations.en_definition: Sicily (the largest island in the Mediterranean Sea, an autonomous region of Italy, close to Africa and separated from Tunisia and Libya by the Strait of Sicily)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 西西里岛：地中海最大的岛屿，属于意大利的自治区，靠近非洲，与突尼斯和利比亚之间隔着西西里海峡。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sqallija: l-akbar gżira fil-Baħar Mediterran, reġjun awtonomu tal-Italja qrib l-Afrika, mifruda mit-Tuneżija u mil-Libja mill-Istrett ta' Sqallija.

formal.mt: Sqallija hija l-akbar gżira fil-Baħar Mediterran u reġjun awtonomu tal-Italja.
formal.en: Sicily is the largest island in the Mediterranean Sea and an autonomous region of Italy.
formal.zh: 西西里岛是地中海最大的岛屿，也是意大利的一个自治区。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn sejjer għall-vaganzi? Mark: Sejjer Sqallija. Nixtieq inqatta' ftit jiem ħdejn il-baħar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are you going on holiday? Mark: I'm going to Sicily. I'd like to spend a few days by the sea.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你打算去哪里度假？马克：我要去西西里。我想在海边待几天。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你打算去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where are you going on holiday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sejjer Sqallija. Nixtieq inqatta' ftit jiem ħdejn il-baħar.
messages.mt_standard: Sejjer Sqallija. Nixtieq inqatta' ftit jiem ħdejn il-baħar.
messages.zh: 我要去西西里。我想在海边待几天。
messages.en: I'm going to Sicily. I'd like to spend a few days by the sea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在地中海地图上给西西里岛贴上 Sqallija 标签，把地名和岛屿位置一起记，并注意专名开头的 S 大写。

gloss_zh: 有顶门廊；房屋入口处的遮蔽空间

teaching_sense.en_definition: A roofed space at the entrance to a house.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 房屋入口处有屋顶遮蔽的空间，可供进出或暂时停留。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Spazju msaqqaf fid-daħla ta' dar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 房屋入口处有顶遮蔽的门廊。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Daħla msaqqfa ta' dar.

collocations.en: the roofed entrance of the house
to wait in the roofed entrance

formal.mt: Il-viżitaturi jistgħu jistennew fis-sqifa tad-dar sakemm jinfetaħ il-bieb.
formal.en: Visitors may wait in the roofed entrance of the house until the door is opened.
formal.zh: 访客可以在房屋的有顶门廊里等候，直到有人开门。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed tagħmel ix-xita. Fejn nistennew? Pawlu: Ejja nistennew fis-sqifa, ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: It's raining. Where shall we wait? Pawlu: Let's wait in the roofed entrance, beside the door.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：下雨了，我们在哪儿等？保罗：我们到门旁边的有顶门廊里等吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 下雨了，我们在哪儿等？
messages.en: It's raining. Where shall we wait?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们到门旁边的有顶门廊里等吧。
messages.en: Let's wait in the roofed entrance, beside the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sqifa 和“下雨时在门口屋顶下等人”的画面绑定，记住它是有顶的房屋入口。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sex or the activity of having sex.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指性或发生性行为这一活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività sesswali jew l-att li wieħed ikollu x'jaqsam sesswalment ma' persuna oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 性，指性活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Attività sesswali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发生性行为这一活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed ikollu x'jaqsam sesswalment ma' persuna oħra.

formal.mt: F'dan il-kors, is-sraf jiġi diskuss fil-kuntest tar-rispett u tal-kunsens bejn adulti.
formal.en: In this course, sex is discussed in the context of respect and consent between adults.
formal.zh: 本课程在成年人之间相互尊重和同意的背景下讨论性。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta titkellem dwar is-sraf, x'inhu l-aktar importanti għalik? Mark: Li t-tnejn ikunu jridu u jħossuhom komdi.
colloquial.en: Maja: When you talk about sex, what matters most to you? Mark: That both people want it and feel comfortable.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谈到性，你最看重什么？马克：双方都愿意，而且都感到自在。

messages.speaker: Maja (成年朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta titkellem dwar is-sraf, x'inhu l-aktar importanti għalik?
messages.mt_standard: Meta titkellem dwar is-sraf, x'inhu l-aktar importanti għalik?
messages.zh: 谈到性，你最看重什么？
messages.en: When you talk about sex, what matters most to you?

messages.speaker: Mark (成年朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Li t-tnejn ikunu jridu u jħossuhom komdi.
messages.mt_standard: Li t-tnejn ikunu jridu u jħossuhom komdi.
messages.zh: 双方都愿意，而且都感到自在。
messages.en: That both people want it and feel comfortable.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sraf 放进成年人讨论亲密关系的场景中，分别记住“性”和“发生性行为”两个释义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small saddle placed on an animal's back to support a load.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 放在驮畜背上、用于承托货物的小型驮鞍。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sarġ żgħir li jitqiegħed fuq dahar annimal biex iġorr tagħbija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供驮畜承载货物使用的小型驮鞍。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sarġ żgħir għall-ġarr tat-tagħbija fuq annimal.

collocations.en: a small pack saddle for a donkey
to place the small pack saddle on the donkey's back

formal.mt: Qabel għabba l-ħmar, il-bidwi qiegħed is-srajjeġ fuq dahru.
formal.en: Before loading the donkey, the farmer placed the small pack saddle on its back.
formal.zh: 给驴装货之前，农夫先把小驮鞍放到它的背上。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn hu s-srajjeġ għall-ħmar? Pawlu: Ħdejn il-bieb. Ġibu qabel inpoġġu t-tagħbija.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where is the small pack saddle for the donkey? Pawlu: Beside the door. Bring it before we put the load on.
colloquial.zh: 马克：给驴用的小驮鞍在哪儿？保罗：在门旁边。我们放货物之前，先把它拿来。

messages.speaker: Mark (农场帮工)
messages.zh: 给驴用的小驮鞍在哪儿？
messages.en: Where is the small pack saddle for the donkey?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农夫)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn il-bieb. Ġibu qabel inpoġġu t-tagħbija.
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn il-bieb. Ġibu qabel inpoġġu t-tagħbija.
messages.zh: 在门旁边。我们放货物之前，先把它拿来。
messages.en: Beside the door. Bring it before we put the load on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象驴背上的小鞍承托着两侧货物，把 srajjeġ 记成“为驮货准备的小驮鞍”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A short row or line of people or things; the diminutive of serbut.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由人或物组成的一小排或短队列，是 serbut 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Serbut żgħir jew qasir ta' nies jew affarijiet.

sense_translations.en_definition: a short row of people or things (the diminutive form of 'serbut')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一小排人或物；serbut 的指小形式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ringiela qasira ta' nies jew affarijiet; il-forma diminuttiva ta' serbut.

formal.mt: Quddiem il-mejda kien hemm srejbet ta' siġġijiet għall-mistednin.
formal.en: In front of the table there was a short row of chairs for the guests.
formal.zh: 桌子前面摆着一小排供来宾就座的椅子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif inpoġġi s-siġġijiet? Rita: Agħmel srejbet ta' erbgħa ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Maja: How shall I arrange the chairs? Rita: Make a short row of four beside the window.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：椅子怎么摆？丽塔：在窗边摆一小排，放四把。

messages.speaker: Maja (活动志愿者)
messages.zh: 椅子怎么摆？
messages.en: How shall I arrange the chairs?

messages.speaker: Rita (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Agħmel srejbet ta' erbgħa ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.mt_standard: Agħmel srejbet ta' erbgħa ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.zh: 在窗边摆一小排，放四把。
messages.en: Make a short row of four beside the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 serbut 想成一排，再把画面缩成只有几个人或几把椅子的一小排，帮助记住 srejbet。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small rooster; the diminutive of serduk.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 体形小的公鸡，是 serduk 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Serduk żgħir; il-forma diminuttiva ta' serduk.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small cock (the diminutive form of 'serduk')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小公鸡；serduk 的指小形式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Serduk żgħir; il-forma diminuttiva ta' serduk.

collocations.en: a small rooster on the farm

formal.mt: Fit-tarzna tar-razzett, srejdek kien ifittex l-ikel ħdejn it-tiġieġ.
formal.en: In the farmyard, a small rooster was looking for food beside the hens.
formal.zh: 在农场院子里，一只小公鸡正在母鸡旁边觅食。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Dak is-srejdek qed jidden? Pawlu: Iva, għadu żgħir imma diġà jinstema' sew!
colloquial.en: Lina: Is that small rooster crowing? Pawlu: Yes, he's still small, but you can already hear him clearly!
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：是那只小公鸡在打鸣吗？保罗：是啊，它个头还小，叫声已经很响亮了！

messages.speaker: Lina (农场访客)
messages.zh: 是那只小公鸡在打鸣吗？
messages.en: Is that small rooster crowing?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农夫)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadu żgħir imma diġà jinstema' sew!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadu żgħir imma diġà jinstema' sew!
messages.zh: 是啊，它个头还小，叫声已经很响亮了！
messages.en: Yes, he's still small, but you can already hear him clearly!

cognitive_memory_aid: 将 serduk 的公鸡画面缩小，想象小公鸡昂头打鸣，把这个画面与 srejdek 配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small snake; the diminutive of serp.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 体形小的蛇，是 serp 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Serp żgħir; il-forma diminuttiva ta' serp.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small snake (the diminutive form of 'serp')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小蛇；serp 的指小形式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Serp żgħir; il-forma diminuttiva ta' serp.

collocations.en: a small snake in the grass
a small snake under a stone

formal.mt: Waqt il-mixja, il-grupp ra srejjep jiċċaqlaq bejn il-ġebel.
formal.en: During the walk, the group saw a small snake moving between the stones.
formal.zh: 散步时，大家看见一条小蛇在石头之间移动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt dak is-srejjep fil-ħaxix? Mark: Iva, ħareġ minn taħt il-ġebla u mbagħad sparixxa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see that small snake in the grass? Mark: Yes, it came out from under the stone and then disappeared.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看见草丛里的那条小蛇了吗？马克：看见了，它从石头下面钻出来，然后就不见了。

messages.speaker: Maja (散步的朋友)
messages.zh: 你看见草丛里的那条小蛇了吗？
messages.en: Did you see that small snake in the grass?

messages.speaker: Mark (散步的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħareġ minn taħt il-ġebla u mbagħad sparixxa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħareġ minn taħt il-ġebla u mbagħad sparixxa.
messages.zh: 看见了，它从石头下面钻出来，然后就不见了。
messages.en: Yes, it came out from under the stone and then disappeared.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 serp 是蛇，再用一条从小石头下面钻出的小蛇来记 srejjep 的指小含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small grasshopper.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 体形小的蚱蜢，即一种会跳跃的昆虫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġurat żgħir li jaqbeż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小蚱蜢；体形小的蝗虫。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ġurat żgħir.

collocations.en: a small grasshopper in the grass

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni fil-ġnien, l-istudenti raw srejser fuq werqa.
formal.en: During their observation in the garden, the students saw a small grasshopper on a leaf.
formal.zh: 在花园里进行观察时，学生们看见一片叶子上有一只小蚱蜢。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Ara, hemm srejser fuq il-werqa! Maja: Rajtu! Qabeż fuq il-ħaxix.
colloquial.en: Lina: Look, there's a small grasshopper on the leaf! Maja: I saw it! It jumped onto the grass.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：看，叶子上有一只小蚱蜢！玛雅：我看见了！它跳到草上去了。

messages.speaker: Lina (园艺爱好者)
messages.zh: 看，叶子上有一只小蚱蜢！
messages.en: Look, there's a small grasshopper on the leaf!

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我看见了！它跳到草上去了。
messages.en: I saw it! It jumped onto the grass.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 srejser 时想象叶子上一只小蚱蜢突然跳进草里，用“小、草丛、跳跃”三个提示巩固词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Very wet mud, a semi-solid substance, or slush made of melting snow and water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指湿软的泥浆、介于固体和液体之间的半固态物质，或融雪与水形成的雪泥。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tajn imxarrab ħafna, sustanza nofsha solida, jew taħlita ta' borra li bdiet iddub u ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 泥泞；湿软黏稠的泥浆。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tajn imxarrab ħafna u art ratba mimlija tajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 半固态物质；介于固體和液体之间的物质。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sustanza li mhijiex kompletament solida u lanqas kompletament likwida.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 雪泥；部分融化的雪与水混合形成的湿软物质。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Taħlita mxarrba ta' borra li bdiet iddub u ilma.

formal.mt: Wara x-xita qawwija, is-srew għatta parti mill-mogħdija u għamel il-mixi aktar diffiċli.
formal.en: After the heavy rain, mire covered part of the path and made walking more difficult.
formal.zh: 大雨过后，泥浆覆盖了部分小路，使行走更加困难。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-borra bdiet iddub, imma t-triq għadha mxarrba ħafna. Mark: Iva, hemm is-srew ħdejn il-bankina. Oqgħod attent fejn tirfes.
colloquial.en: Maja: The snow has started melting, but the road is still very wet. Mark: Yes, there's slush beside the pavement. Watch where you step.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：雪开始化了，可路上还是很湿。马克：是啊，人行道旁边有雪泥。留意脚下。

messages.speaker: Maja (同行的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-borra bdiet iddub, imma t-triq għadha mxarrba ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Il-borra bdiet iddub, imma t-triq għadha mxarrba ħafna.
messages.zh: 雪开始化了，可路上还是很湿。
messages.en: The snow has started melting, but the road is still very wet.

messages.speaker: Mark (同行的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm is-srew ħdejn il-bankina. Oqgħod attent fejn tirfes.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm is-srew ħdejn il-bankina. Oqgħod attent fejn tirfes.
messages.zh: 是啊，人行道旁边有雪泥。留意脚下。
messages.en: Yes, there's slush beside the pavement. Watch where you step.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张画面记 srew：雨后泥浆、半凝固的物质、融雪形成的雪泥；共同联想是湿软的半固态质感。

gloss_zh: 斯里兰卡的；斯里兰卡人（通常指男性）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of, from, or relating to Sri Lanka.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 属于、来自斯里兰卡，或与斯里兰卡有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li hu minn Sri Lanka jew għandu x'jaqsam ma' Sri Lanka.

sense_translations.en_definition: Sri Lankan (of, from or relating to Sri Lanka)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 斯里兰卡的；来自斯里兰卡的；与斯里兰卡有关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: Sri Lankan (native or inhabitant of Sri Lanka) (usually male)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 斯里兰卡本地人或居民，通常指男性。

collocations.en: a Sri Lankan man who lives in Malta
collocations.zh: 一位住在马耳他的斯里兰卡男子

formal.mt: L-avveniment jinkludi wirja ta' arti Sri Lankan u diskussjoni mal-artisti.
formal.en: The event includes an exhibition of Sri Lankan art and a discussion with the artists.
formal.zh: 该活动包括斯里兰卡艺术展，以及与艺术家的座谈。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu l-ġar il-ġdid tiegħek? Lara: Hu Sri Lankan li ġie jgħix Malta ma' familtu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is your new neighbour? Lara: He's a Sri Lankan man who moved to Malta with his family.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的新邻居是谁？拉拉：他是一位和家人搬来马耳他居住的斯里兰卡男子。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的新邻居是谁？
messages.en: Who is your new neighbour?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu Sri Lankan li ġie jgħix Malta ma' familtu.
messages.mt_standard: Hu Sri Lankan li ġie jgħix Malta ma' familtu.
messages.zh: 他是一位和家人搬来马耳他居住的斯里兰卡男子。
messages.en: He's a Sri Lankan man who moved to Malta with his family.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Sri Lankan 放进两个词组记：修饰食物时是“斯里兰卡的”，直接指人时是“斯里兰卡人”。

gloss_zh: 入夜后的湿冷；暮后寒湿

teaching_sense.en_definition: The damp chill that settles in after dusk.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 黄昏过后降临、使人感到寒意的湿冷。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kesħa niedja li tinħass wara li jidlam.

sense_translations.en_definition: the damp chill that falls after dusk
sense_translations.zh_definition: 黄昏过后降临的湿冷。

collocations.en: to protect yourself from the damp chill
collocations.zh: 保护自己，免受暮后湿冷侵袭

formal.mt: Il-viżitaturi għandhom iġibu ġakketta biex jipproteġu ruħhom mis-sried ta' filgħaxija.
formal.en: Visitors should bring a jacket to protect themselves from the damp evening chill.
formal.zh: 游客应携带外套，以抵御傍晚的湿冷。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Daħal is-sried; qed inħoss il-bard. Lara: Ejja nidħlu ġewwa u nagħmlu ftit te.
colloquial.en: Maja: The damp evening chill has set in; I'm feeling cold. Lara: Let's go inside and make some tea.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：入夜的湿冷来了，我觉得冷。拉拉：我们进去泡点茶吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 入夜的湿冷来了，我觉得冷。
messages.en: The damp evening chill has set in; I'm feeling cold.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nidħlu ġewwa u nagħmlu ftit te.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nidħlu ġewwa u nagħmlu ftit te.
messages.zh: 我们进去泡点茶吧。
messages.en: Let's go inside and make some tea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sried 配上日落后披外套的画面：重点同时记住“入夜、潮湿、寒冷”三个特征。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of twining strands together or winding something around an object.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使线等相互缠绕，或将某物绕在另一物体上的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li ddawwar ħjut ma' xulxin jew li tkebbeb xi ħaġa madwar oġġett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 缠绕；使线、细条等相互绕合。
卷绕；将某物绕在另一物体上。

collocations.en: the winding of rope onto the reel

formal.mt: L-eżerċizzju juri s-srik ta' żewġ ħjut ma' xulxin biex jiffurmaw korda.
formal.en: The exercise demonstrates twining two threads together to form a cord.
formal.zh: 这项练习示范如何将两根线相互缠绕，制成一根细绳。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Tista' tgħinni fis-srik tal-ħabel fuq ir-rukkell? Pawlu: Iva, jien inżomm ir-rukkell u int dawwar il-ħabel.
colloquial.en: Rita: Can you help me wind the rope onto the reel? Pawlu: Yes, I'll hold the reel and you wind the rope.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你能帮我把绳子卷到卷轴上吗？保罗：可以，我拿住卷轴，你来绕绳子。

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tgħinni fis-srik tal-ħabel fuq ir-rukkell?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tgħinni fis-srik tal-ħabel fuq ir-rukkell?
messages.zh: 你能帮我把绳子卷到卷轴上吗？
messages.en: Can you help me wind the rope onto the reel?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jien inżomm ir-rukkell u int dawwar il-ħabel.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jien inżomm ir-rukkell u int dawwar il-ħabel.
messages.zh: 可以，我拿住卷轴，你来绕绳子。
messages.en: Yes, I'll hold the reel and you wind the rope.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 srik 时画两种绕法：两根线互绕是“缠绕”，一根绳绕卷轴是“卷绕”，都突出绕的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of confusing someone or making something difficult to understand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人混淆，或使事情变得难以理解的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li tħawwad lil xi ħadd jew tagħmel xi ħaġa diffiċli biex tinftiehem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人混淆、造成理解混乱的行为。

collocations.en: the act of confusing the reader

formal.mt: L-awtur għandu juża ismijiet konsistenti biex jevita s-srim tal-qarrej.
formal.en: The author should use consistent names to avoid confusing the reader.
formal.zh: 作者应使用一致的名称，以免使读者混淆。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Se nuża l-istess isem kull darba biex nevita s-srim. Nina: Tajjeb, hekk kulħadd jifhem dwar xiex qed nitkellmu.
colloquial.en: Mark: I'll use the same name every time to avoid causing confusion. Nina: Good, that way everyone will understand what we're talking about.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我每次都会用同一个名称，避免造成混淆。妮娜：好，这样大家就明白我们在说什么了。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nuża l-istess isem kull darba biex nevita s-srim.
messages.mt_standard: Se nuża l-istess isem kull darba biex nevita s-srim.
messages.zh: 我每次都会用同一个名称，避免造成混淆。
messages.en: I'll use the same name every time to avoid causing confusion.

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, hekk kulħadd jifhem dwar xiex qed nitkellmu.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, hekk kulħadd jifhem dwar xiex qed nitkellmu.
messages.zh: 好，这样大家就明白我们在说什么了。
messages.en: Good, that way everyone will understand what we're talking about.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 srim 想成同一件事被换了好几个名字，听者越听越糊涂；按名词记“造成混淆这一行为”。

gloss_zh: 为灌溉而将农田划分成小块

teaching_sense.en_definition: The division of farmland into smaller sections for irrigation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为了灌溉，将农田划分为较小区域的做法或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qsim ta' art agrikola f'partijiet iżgħar biex jissaqqew.

sense_translations.en_definition: division of farmland into smaller areas to be irrigated
sense_translations.zh_definition: 为了灌溉而将农田划分为较小区域。

collocations.en: the division of the field into irrigation sections
