collocations.zh: 将田地划分成灌溉小区

collocations.en: the subdivision of farmland for irrigation
collocations.zh: 为灌溉而进行的农田分区

formal.mt: Il-pjan jinkludi s-sriġ tal-għalqa f'partijiet iżgħar biex kull parti tkun tista' tissaqqa' separatament.
formal.en: The plan includes dividing the field into smaller irrigation sections so that each section can be watered separately.
formal.zh: 该方案包括将田地划分为较小的灌溉区域，以便各区分别浇灌。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Għaliex qed taqsam l-għalqa f'partijiet żgħar? Rita: Qed nagħmel is-sriġ biex insaqqi kull parti għaliha.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Why are you dividing the field into small sections? Rita: I'm dividing it into irrigation sections so I can water each part separately.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：你为什么把田地分成小块？丽塔：我在做灌溉分区，好分别浇灌每一块。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed taqsam l-għalqa f'partijiet żgħar?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed taqsam l-għalqa f'partijiet żgħar?
messages.zh: 你为什么把田地分成小块？
messages.en: Why are you dividing the field into small sections?

messages.speaker: Rita (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nagħmel is-sriġ biex insaqqi kull parti għaliha.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nagħmel is-sriġ biex insaqqi kull parti għaliha.
messages.zh: 我在做灌溉分区，好分别浇灌每一块。
messages.en: I'm dividing it into irrigation sections so I can water each part separately.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sriġ 想成一张画着小格的农田图，每格都有水流进去，连记“分田小块，方便灌溉”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of resting or taking a break from exertion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 停止劳作或其他费力活动，让身体得到休息的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-waqfien mix-xogħol jew mill-isforz biex wieħed jistrieħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 休息；歇息这一行为。

formal.mt: L-iskeda tinkludi ħin għas-sriħ wara kull siegħa ta' xogħol fiżiku.
formal.en: The schedule includes time for resting after every hour of physical work.
formal.zh: 时间表规定，每进行一小时体力劳动后都安排休息时间。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Ilna naħdmu minn filgħodu; wasal il-ħin għas-sriħ. Nina: Iva, ejja noqogħdu bilqiegħda ftit.
colloquial.en: Mark: We've been working since this morning; it's time for a rest. Nina: Yes, let's sit down for a bit.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我们从早上一直干到现在，该歇一歇了。妮娜：好，我们坐一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ilna naħdmu minn filgħodu; wasal il-ħin għas-sriħ.
messages.mt_standard: Ilna naħdmu minn filgħodu; wasal il-ħin għas-sriħ.
messages.zh: 我们从早上一直干到现在，该歇一歇了。
messages.en: We've been working since this morning; it's time for a rest.

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 好，我们坐一会儿吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's sit down for a bit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 sriħ，就想象放下工具坐到椅子上；把这个名词和“休息这一行为”连在一起记。

gloss_zh: 安适宁静；暂离烦忧的喘息

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of restful ease, or a period of relief from troubles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 安适宁静的感觉，或暂时摆脱烦恼、得以喘息的一段时间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sens ta' mistrieħ u kalma, jew żmien ta' serħan mill-inkwiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 安适宁静；使人感到放松、得到休息的状态。
暂时摆脱烦恼或困扰而获得的喘息。

formal.mt: Il-kwiet tal-ġnien jagħti sens ta' sriħa lill-viżitaturi.
formal.en: The quiet of the garden gives visitors a feeling of restful ease.
formal.zh: 花园的幽静让游客感到安适宁静。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din il-mixja tatni ftit sriħa mill-inkwiet. Maja: Jien ukoll ħassejtni aħjar; nerġgħu noħorġu għada.
colloquial.en: Lara: This walk gave me a little respite from my worries. Maja: I felt better too; let's go out again tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这次散步让我暂时放下了烦恼。玛雅：我也觉得好多了，我们明天再出来吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-mixja tatni ftit sriħa mill-inkwiet.
messages.mt_standard: Din il-mixja tatni ftit sriħa mill-inkwiet.
messages.zh: 这次散步让我暂时放下了烦恼。
messages.en: This walk gave me a little respite from my worries.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien ukoll ħassejtni aħjar; nerġgħu noħorġu għada.
messages.mt_standard: Jien ukoll ħassejtni aħjar; nerġgħu noħorġu għada.
messages.zh: 我也觉得好多了，我们明天再出来吧。
messages.en: I felt better too; let's go out again tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画记 sriħa：安静花园代表“安适”，暂放烦恼的散步代表“喘息”，对应两个名词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Resting, or a state of being free from trouble or worry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 休息这一行为，或没有烦扰、心中无忧的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-mistrieħ, jew stat mingħajr inkwiet jew tħassib.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 休息；歇息。
没有烦扰、心中无忧的状态。

collocations.en: a sense of being free from worry

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-ġurnata jħalli ħin għas-sriħan bejn l-attivitajiet.
formal.en: The day's programme allows time for resting between activities.
formal.zh: 当天的活动安排在各项活动之间留出了休息时间。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Issa li solvejna l-problema, għandi sens ta' sriħan. Mark: Jien ukoll; fl-aħħar nistgħu ngawdu l-lejla.
colloquial.en: Nina: Now that we've solved the problem, I feel free from worry. Mark: Me too; we can finally enjoy the evening.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：现在问题解决了，我觉得安心了。马克：我也是，我们终于可以好好享受这个晚上了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa li solvejna l-problema, għandi sens ta' sriħan.
messages.mt_standard: Issa li solvejna l-problema, għandi sens ta' sriħan.
messages.zh: 现在问题解决了，我觉得安心了。
messages.en: Now that we've solved the problem, I feel free from worry.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien ukoll; fl-aħħar nistgħu ngawdu l-lejla.
messages.mt_standard: Jien ukoll; fl-aħħar nistgħu ngawdu l-lejla.
messages.zh: 我也是，我们终于可以好好享受这个晚上了。
messages.en: Me too; we can finally enjoy the evening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sriħan 配成“身在休息、心无烦忧”的双画面；两个义项都按本词条的名词用法记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To receive comfort that eases sadness, grief, or disappointment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在悲伤、失落或失望时得到安慰，使心情有所缓解。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jirċievi faraġ li jtaffi n-niket, id-dwejjaq jew id-diżappunt tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 得到安慰；因受到宽慰而减轻悲伤。

collocations.en: was consoled by a friend's words
collocations.zh: 因朋友的话而得到安慰

formal.mt: Wara t-telfa fil-kompetizzjoni, it-tifel ssabbar bil-kliem ta' inkoraġġiment tal-għalliem.
formal.en: After losing the competition, the boy was consoled by his teacher's encouraging words.
formal.zh: 比赛失利后，男孩从老师鼓励的话语中得到了安慰。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Pawlu għadu mdejjaq bir-riżultat? Luqa: Għadu ftit, imma ssabbar meta tkellimna miegħu.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is Pawlu still upset about the result? Luqa: A little, but he was consoled when we talked to him.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：保罗还在为结果难过吗？卢卡：还有一点，不过我们和他聊过以后，他得到了些安慰。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗还在为结果难过吗？
messages.en: Is Pawlu still upset about the result?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu ftit, imma ssabbar meta tkellimna miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu ftit, imma ssabbar meta tkellimna miegħu.
messages.zh: 还有一点，不过我们和他聊过以后，他得到了些安慰。
messages.en: A little, but he was consoled when we talked to him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ssabbar 和朋友安慰失落者的画面连在一起：重点是难过的人得到了安慰。

gloss_zh: 被撞击；被猛地关上；猛地倒下；累垮或醉倒

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be banged or slammed; to throw oneself down; or to be very tired or drunk.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指受到猛烈撞击或被猛地关上，也可指猛地躺倒、累垮或醉倒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintlaqat jew jingħalaq b'saħħa; jintefa' mal-art jew fuq xi ħaġa; jew ikun għajjien ħafna jew fis-sakra ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被猛撞；受到猛烈撞击。
被猛地摔上或关上；被用力摔碰。
使自己猛地倒下；一下子扑倒或躺倒。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be very tired or drunk
sense_translations.zh_definition: 非常疲惫，累得瘫倒；或醉得厉害。

collocations.en: threw himself down on the sofa

formal.mt: Il-bieb ssabbat b'saħħa minħabba r-riħ, u l-ħoss instema' fil-kuritur kollu.
formal.en: The door was slammed shut by the wind, and the noise was heard throughout the corridor.
formal.zh: 风把门猛地关上，响声传遍了整条走廊。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn hu Pawlu? Luqa: Ssabbat fuq is-sufan malli wasal; kien għajjien mejjet wara l-mixja.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where is Pawlu? Luqa: He threw himself down on the sofa as soon as he arrived; he was exhausted after the walk.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：保罗在哪儿？卢卡：他一回来就倒在沙发上了；走完那段路，他累坏了。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 保罗在哪儿？
messages.en: Where is Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Luqa (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ssabbat fuq is-sufan malli wasal; kien għajjien mejjet wara l-mixja.
messages.mt_standard: Ssabbat fuq is-sufan malli wasal; kien għajjien mejjet wara l-mixja.
messages.zh: 他一回来就倒在沙发上了；走完那段路，他累坏了。
messages.en: He threw himself down on the sofa as soon as he arrived; he was exhausted after the walk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记 ssabbat：门砰地关上，人扑通倒下；再联想到累垮或醉倒的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To develop rust on a metal surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指金属表面出现锈迹，发生锈蚀。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiżviluppa s-sadid fuq il-wiċċ tal-metall.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生锈；金属表面形成锈层。

formal.mt: Il-bieb tal-ħadid ssaddad wara li baqa' espost għax-xita għal żmien twil.
formal.en: The iron gate rusted after being left exposed to rain for a long time.
formal.zh: 铁门长期暴露在雨水中，后来生锈了。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex il-katnazz ma jinfetaħx? Pawlu: Ssaddad; ħallejnieh barra fix-xita.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why won't the padlock open? Pawlu: It rusted; we left it outside in the rain.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：这把挂锁怎么打不开了？保罗：它生锈了；我们把它留在外面淋雨了。

messages.speaker: Marija (家人)
messages.zh: 这把挂锁怎么打不开了？
messages.en: Why won't the padlock open?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.zh: 它生锈了；我们把它留在外面淋雨了。
messages.en: It rusted; we left it outside in the rain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 ssaddad，就想象雨后的铁门长出褐色锈斑，把这个动作记成生锈。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have impurities removed, including by being passed through a filter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指杂质被去除而得到净化，也包括通过过滤去除杂质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitneħħew minnu l-impuritajiet, inkluż billi jgħaddi minn filtru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被净化；其中的杂质被去除。
被过滤；通过滤器等去除其中的杂质。

formal.mt: Il-likwidu ssaffa minn filtru biex jitneħħew il-partiċelli solidi qabel l-analiżi.
formal.en: The liquid was passed through a filter to remove solid particles before analysis.
formal.zh: 分析之前，液体经过过滤，以去除其中的固体颗粒。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex l-ilma jidher aktar ċar issa? Pawlu: Għax ssaffa meta għadda mill-filtru.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why does the water look clearer now? Pawlu: Because it was filtered when it passed through the filter.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：这水现在怎么看起来更清了？保罗：因为它经过滤器过滤了。

messages.speaker: Marija (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex l-ilma jidher aktar ċar issa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex l-ilma jidher aktar ċar issa?
messages.zh: 这水现在怎么看起来更清了？
messages.en: Why does the water look clearer now?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.zh: 因为它经过滤器过滤了。
messages.en: Because it was filtered when it passed through the filter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用浑水经过滤器变清的画面记 ssaffa：液体接受处理，杂质被去除。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be arranged or formed in successive layers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指材料被一层层排列或铺放，形成有层次的结构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi rranġat jew iffurmat f'saffi fuq xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被分层排列或铺放；形成一层叠一层的结构。

collocations.en: the sand was layered in the jar
collocations.zh: 沙子在罐中被分层铺放

formal.mt: Ir-ramel ikkulurit ssaffaf fil-vażett, b'kulur differenti f'kull saff.
formal.en: The coloured sand was layered in the jar, with a different colour in each layer.
formal.zh: 彩沙在罐中被分层铺放，每层的颜色都不同。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif għamilt dawk l-istrixxi fil-vażett? Pawlu: Ir-ramel ssaffaf ftit ftit; kull darba żidt kulur differenti.
colloquial.en: Marija: How did you make those stripes in the jar? Pawlu: The sand was layered little by little; I added a different colour each time.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你怎么在罐子里做出那些条纹的？保罗：沙子是一点点分层铺进去的；我每次都加一种不同的颜色。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么在罐子里做出那些条纹的？
messages.en: How did you make those stripes in the jar?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (手工爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-ramel ssaffaf ftit ftit; kull darba żidt kulur differenti.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-ramel ssaffaf ftit ftit; kull darba żidt kulur differenti.
messages.zh: 沙子是一点点分层铺进去的；我每次都加一种不同的颜色。
messages.en: The sand was layered little by little; I added a different colour each time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ssaffaf 记成彩沙瓶的横向条纹：一层铺好，再叠一层，重点在层次。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For a tune or musical phrase to be produced by whistling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指曲调或乐句被人用口哨吹出来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal motiv jew frażi mużikali li tindaqq bis-suffara tal-ħalq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被用口哨吹出，通常指曲调或乐句。

collocations.en: was whistled by one of the actors
collocations.zh: 由其中一名演员用口哨吹出

formal.mt: Fil-bidu tax-xena, il-motiv ssaffar minn wieħed mill-atturi qabel ma bdiet il-mużika.
formal.en: At the beginning of the scene, the tune was whistled by one of the actors before the music began.
formal.zh: 场景开始时，在音乐响起之前，其中一名演员用口哨吹出了那段曲调。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dak il-motiv kien fuq ir-radju? Pawlu: Le, ssaffar minn Luqa fil-kċina!
colloquial.en: Marija: Was that tune on the radio? Pawlu: No, it was whistled by Luqa in the kitchen!
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：刚才那段曲调是收音机里放的吗？保罗：不是，是卢卡在厨房里用口哨吹的！

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 刚才那段曲调是收音机里放的吗？
messages.en: Was that tune on the radio?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 不是，是卢卡在厨房里用口哨吹的！
messages.en: No, it was whistled by Luqa in the kitchen!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ssaffar 和一串被口哨吹出的音符相连：学习时让曲调作主语，记住被吹出的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lower one's own standing or dignity, or to humiliate oneself.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指使自己的地位或尊严降低，表现得卑下，或使自己受辱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ibaxxi l-pożizzjoni jew id-dinjità tiegħu stess, jew jumilja lilu nnifsu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自降身份；使自己处于卑下的地位。
使自己受辱；做出有损自身尊严的举动。

collocations.en: humiliated himself in front of everyone
collocations.zh: 在众人面前使自己受辱

collocations.en: lowered himself to obtain a favour
collocations.zh: 为了得到帮助而自降身份

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ir-raġel ssaffel quddiem min kellu l-poter biex jikseb favur.
formal.en: In the story, the man lowered himself before those in power to obtain a favour.
formal.zh: 故事中，那名男子为了得到帮助，在掌权者面前自降身份。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex Pawlu baqa' jitlobhom u jaċċetta l-insulti? Luqa: Ried ix-xogħol, imma ssaffel quddiemhom.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why did Pawlu keep begging them and accepting the insults? Luqa: He wanted the job, but he humiliated himself in front of them.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：保罗为什么一直求他们，还忍受那些侮辱？卢卡：他想要那份工作，可他在他们面前委屈了自己的尊严。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu baqa' jitlobhom u jaċċetta l-insulti?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu baqa' jitlobhom u jaċċetta l-insulti?
messages.zh: 保罗为什么一直求他们，还忍受那些侮辱？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu keep begging them and accepting the insults?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 他想要那份工作，可他在他们面前委屈了自己的尊严。
messages.en: He wanted the job, but he humiliated himself in front of them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用尊严刻度向下移动的画面记 ssaffel：自己降低身份，严重时就是自取其辱。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To swear or utter curses, especially when angry or frustrated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因生气或懊恼而咒骂、说诅咒的话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħid kliem ta' saħta, speċjalment meta jkun irrabjat jew imdejjaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 咒骂；说诅咒的话。

formal.mt: Meta ntebaħ li l-għodda kienet nieqsa, il-ħaddiem ssagramenta minn taħt ilsienu.
formal.en: When he noticed that the tools were missing, the worker cursed under his breath.
formal.zh: 工人发现工具不见了，便低声咒骂起来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ssagramenta Mark? Lara: Waqagħlu t-telefown u nkiser l-iskrin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark swear? Lara: He dropped his phone and the screen broke.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么骂起来了？拉拉：他的手机掉了，屏幕摔坏了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么骂起来了？
messages.en: Why did Mark swear?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他的手机掉了，屏幕摔坏了。
messages.en: He dropped his phone and the screen broke.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“手机摔坏后气得咒骂”的场景中记忆；这里的 swear 指骂人或诅咒，不是郑重宣誓。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For a place or patch of ground to become overgrown with thyme.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某处地方或一块土地逐渐长满百里香。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimtela bis-sagħtar li jikber fih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得长满百里香；被丛生的百里香覆盖。

collocations.en: a garden that has become overgrown with thyme
a field that has become overgrown with thyme

formal.mt: Il-ġnien mitluq ssagħtar, u l-pjanti koprew parti kbira mill-art.
formal.en: The neglected garden became overgrown with thyme, and the plants covered much of the ground.
formal.zh: 无人照料的花园长满了百里香，植株覆盖了大部分地面。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Rajt kif ssagħtar il-ġnien? Maja: Iva, is-sagħtar kiber sa ħdejn il-bieb!
colloquial.en: Mark: Have you seen how the garden has become overgrown with thyme? Maja: Yes, the thyme has grown right up to the door!
colloquial.zh: 马克：你看到花园都长满百里香了吗？玛雅：看到了，百里香都长到门边了！

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.zh: 你看到花园都长满百里香了吗？
messages.en: Have you seen how the garden has become overgrown with thyme?

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, is-sagħtar kiber sa ħdejn il-bieb!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, is-sagħtar kiber sa ħdejn il-bieb!
messages.zh: 看到了，百里香都长到门边了！
messages.en: Yes, the thyme has grown right up to the door!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象打开花园门，眼前到处都是百里香；用“整片土地长满百里香”的画面记住这个具体的变化动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For food to be cooked through the application of heat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指食物经过加热烹调，被煮、烤等处理而熟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ikel isir imsajjar permezz tas-sħana.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被烹调；被煮熟或烤熟。

formal.mt: Il-ħut issajjar fil-forn għal għoxrin minuta u ġie servut mal-ħaxix.
formal.en: The fish was cooked in the oven for twenty minutes and served with vegetables.
formal.zh: 鱼在烤箱中烤了二十分钟，随后配蔬菜上桌。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Ir-ross issajjar sew? Maja: Iva, sar artab u lest biex nieklu.
colloquial.en: Mark: Did the rice cook properly? Maja: Yes, it is soft and ready to eat.
colloquial.zh: 马克：米饭煮好了吗？玛雅：煮好了，已经软了，可以吃了。

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.zh: 米饭煮好了吗？
messages.en: Did the rice cook properly?

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, sar artab u lest biex nieklu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, sar artab u lest biex nieklu.
messages.zh: 煮好了，已经软了，可以吃了。
messages.en: Yes, it is soft and ready to eat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象镜头始终对着锅里的食物：米饭变软、鱼肉烤熟；记住这里说的是食物被烹调，而不是厨师主动做饭。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become drunk after drinking alcohol.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 饮酒后进入醉酒状态；喝醉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir fis-sakra wara li jixrob l-alkoħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喝醉；因饮酒而变得醉醺醺。

collocations.en: got drunk after drinking too much

formal.mt: Ir-raġel issakar waqt l-ikla, u ħabib tiegħu akkumpanjah id-dar.
formal.en: The man got drunk during the meal, and a friend accompanied him home.
formal.zh: 那名男子在用餐期间喝醉了，一位朋友陪他回了家。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark telaq kmieni mill-festa? Lara: Issakar u ħuh ħadu d-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark leave the party early? Lara: He got drunk, and his brother took him home.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么提前离开聚会了？拉拉：他喝醉了，他兄弟带他回家了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么提前离开聚会了？
messages.en: Why did Mark leave the party early?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他喝醉了，他兄弟带他回家了。
messages.en: He got drunk, and his brother took him home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和“聚会中喝多了，最后由朋友陪回家”的完整情景绑定；重点记住从清醒变成醉酒的状态变化。

gloss_zh: 把自己锁起来；把自己反锁在里面

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lock oneself inside a room or another enclosed place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把自己锁在房间或其他封闭空间里。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħlaq il-bieb bis-serratura waqt li jkun ġewwa, u b'hekk jissakkar fil-post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把自己锁起来；把自己反锁在里面。

collocations.zh: 把自己锁在自己的房间里

formal.mt: Wara l-argument, Pawlu ssakkar f'kamartu u talab li jitħalla waħdu għal ftit ħin.
formal.en: After the argument, Pawlu locked himself in his room and asked to be left alone for a little while.
formal.zh: 争执之后，保罗把自己锁在房间里，请求让他独处一会儿。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu Pawlu? Mark: Ssakkar f'kamartu. Qal li għandu bżonn ftit kwiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is Pawlu? Mark: He locked himself in his room. He said he needs some quiet.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗在哪里？马克：他把自己锁在房间里了。他说需要安静一会儿。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ssakkar f'kamartu. Qal li għandu bżonn ftit kwiet.
messages.mt_standard: Ssakkar f'kamartu. Qal li għandu bżonn ftit kwiet.
messages.zh: 他把自己锁在房间里了。他说需要安静一会儿。
messages.en: He locked himself in his room. He said he needs some quiet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ssakkar 和“人在屋内转动钥匙”的画面一起记：重点是把自己锁在里面，可连同 f'kamartu 整组练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To violently rob a place of its possessions, especially during war or disorder.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尤指在战争或动乱中，以暴力洗劫某地并夺走财物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jisraq oġġetti u ġid minn post bil-vjolenza, speċjalment waqt gwerra jew taqlib.

sense_translations.en_definition: to sack, to plunder, to pillage
sense_translations.zh_definition: 洗劫、掠夺或劫掠某地的财物。

formal.mt: L-eżerċtu ssakkeġġa l-belt wara l-assedju u ħa ħafna mill-ġid li sab fid-djar.
formal.en: The army sacked the city after the siege and took much of the wealth it found in the houses.
formal.zh: 围城结束后，军队洗劫了这座城市，夺走了在民宅中发现的大量财物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel l-eżerċtu wara li daħal fil-belt? Mark: Ssakkeġġa l-ħwienet u ħa kull ma sab.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did the army do after entering the city? Mark: It looted the shops and took everything it found.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：军队进城以后做了什么？马克：洗劫了商店，把找到的东西全都拿走了。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'għamel l-eżerċtu wara li daħal fil-belt?
messages.mt_standard: X'għamel l-eżerċtu wara li daħal fil-belt?
messages.zh: 军队进城以后做了什么？
messages.en: What did the army do after entering the city?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ssakkeġġa l-ħwienet u ħa kull ma sab.
messages.mt_standard: Ssakkeġġa l-ħwienet u ħa kull ma sab.
messages.zh: 洗劫了商店，把找到的东西全都拿走了。
messages.en: It looted the shops and took everything it found.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“进城后把商店财物抢空”的场景记 ssakkeġġa，并搭配 l-belt、l-ħwienet 练习，抓住暴力洗劫的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To drink an excessive amount of alcohol during one occasion or a short period.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在一次场合或短时间内过量饮酒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jixrob ammont eċċessiv ta' alkoħol f'okkażjoni waħda jew fi żmien qasir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在短时间内大量饮酒；暴饮酒精饮料。

collocations.zh: 在庆祝活动中过量饮酒

formal.mt: Matul il-festa, Mark ssakran u l-għada ma setax jattendi l-laqgħa ta' filgħodu.
formal.en: During the celebration, Mark drank excessively and could not attend the morning meeting the next day.
formal.zh: 马克在庆祝活动中过量饮酒，第二天无法参加上午的会议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark ma ġiex għall-kolazzjon? Pawlu: Ilbieraħ ssakran waqt il-festa u llum għadu fis-sodda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why didn't Mark come to breakfast? Pawlu: He drank excessively at the party yesterday and is still in bed today.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克怎么没来吃早饭？保罗：他昨天在聚会上喝了太多酒，今天还躺在床上。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克怎么没来吃早饭？
messages.en: Why didn't Mark come to breakfast?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ilbieraħ ssakran waqt il-festa u llum għadu fis-sodda.
messages.mt_standard: Ilbieraħ ssakran waqt il-festa u llum għadu fis-sodda.
messages.zh: 他昨天在聚会上喝了太多酒，今天还躺在床上。
messages.en: He drank excessively at the party yesterday and is still in bed today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 ssakran 时想象一次聚会上接连喝下很多杯酒：关键词是“短时间内过量”，不能仅理解成普通喝一杯。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be saved from danger or harm, including being rescued from a dangerous situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从危险或伤害中获救，包括被人从险境中救出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinħeles minn periklu jew ħsara, jew jinħareġ minn sitwazzjoni perikoluża bl-għajnuna ta' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 获救；免遭危险、损害或毁灭。
被营救；被从险境中救出。

formal.mt: Is-sajjied ssalva mill-għarqa grazzi għall-intervent rapidu tat-tim tas-salvataġġ.
formal.en: The fisherman was saved from drowning thanks to the rescue team's swift intervention.
formal.zh: 由于救援队迅速采取行动，这名渔民获救，免于溺亡。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Is-sajjied li waqa' l-baħar ssalva? Mark: Iva, tim tas-salvataġġ wasal fil-ħin u ħarġu mill-ilma.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was the fisherman who fell into the sea rescued? Mark: Yes, a rescue team arrived in time and got him out of the water.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个掉进海里的渔民获救了吗？马克：获救了，救援队及时赶到，把他救出了水面。

messages.speaker: Maja (居民)
messages.zh: 那个掉进海里的渔民获救了吗？
messages.en: Was the fisherman who fell into the sea rescued?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tim tas-salvataġġ wasal fil-ħin u ħarġu mill-ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tim tas-salvataġġ wasal fil-ħin u ħarġu mill-ilma.
messages.zh: 获救了，救援队及时赶到，把他救出了水面。
messages.en: Yes, a rescue team arrived in time and got him out of the water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ssalva 配上“落水的人被拉上救生艇”的画面：句中主语是获救者，两个义项分别强调免遭危险与被营救。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To protect something valuable, such as rights, interests, or heritage, from harm or loss.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 保护权利、利益、遗产等重要事物，使其免受损害或损失。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħares xi ħaġa ta' valur, bħal drittijiet, interessi jew wirt, minn ħsara jew telf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 保障；维护；保护某事物免受损害或损失。

formal.mt: Il-ftehim il-ġdid ssalvagwardja d-drittijiet tal-ħaddiema billi żamm il-kundizzjonijiet eżistenti tax-xogħol.
formal.en: The new agreement safeguarded workers' rights by retaining the existing working conditions.
formal.zh: 新协议保留了现有的劳动条件，从而保障了劳动者的权利。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-ftehim il-ġdid ipproteġa d-drittijiet tagħna? Mark: Iva, ssalvagwardja d-dritt tagħna għall-leave.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did the new agreement protect our rights? Mark: Yes, it safeguarded our right to leave.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：新协议保护了我们的权利吗？马克：是的，它保障了我们的休假权。

messages.speaker: Maja (员工)
messages.zh: 新协议保护了我们的权利吗？
messages.en: Did the new agreement protect our rights?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 是的，它保障了我们的休假权。
messages.en: Yes, it safeguarded our right to leave.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ssalvagwardja 想成给“权利、利益、文化遗产”撑起保护伞；背诵时配上 d-drittijiet，记住“保障权利”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made hard or firm through a process or treatment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经过某种过程或处理而变硬、变坚实。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir iebes jew sod permezz ta' proċess jew trattament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被硬化；经处理而变得坚硬或坚实。

formal.mt: Il-kampjun ssammam wara t-trattament u sar aktar reżistenti għall-pressjoni.
formal.en: The sample was hardened after treatment and became more resistant to pressure.
formal.zh: 样品经处理后硬化，变得更加耐压。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-materjal għadu artab? Mark: Le, ssammam wara t-trattament. Issa huwa iebes.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this material still soft? Mark: No, it was hardened after treatment. It is hard now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这种材料还软吗？马克：不软了，处理后已经硬化。现在是硬的。

messages.speaker: Maja (学徒)
messages.zh: 这种材料还软吗？
messages.en: Is this material still soft?

messages.speaker: Mark (工匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ssammam wara t-trattament. Issa huwa iebes.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ssammam wara t-trattament. Issa huwa iebes.
messages.zh: 不软了，处理后已经硬化。现在是硬的。
messages.en: No, it was hardened after treatment. It is hard now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“处理前能按下，处理后按不动”的材料对比记 ssammam；把词义固定在“被硬化、变坚实”的状态变化上。

gloss_zh: 被钉住；被锤打；惊得说不出话

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be fastened with nails or struck with a hammer; figuratively, to become speechless with shock.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被钉子固定或受到锤打；比喻因震惊而一时说不出话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitwaħħal bl-imsiemer jew jintlaqat bil-martell; b'mod figurattiv, jibqa' bla kliem minħabba xokk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被钉住；用钉子固定。
被锤打；受到锤子的敲击。
因震惊而说不出话；惊得呆住。

collocations.en: was struck dumb as soon as he heard the news
collocations.zh: 一听到消息就惊得说不出话

formal.mt: Il-pannell tal-injam ssammar mal-ħajt biex jibqa' mwaħħal sew.
formal.en: The wooden panel was nailed to the wall so that it would remain firmly attached.
formal.zh: 木板被钉在墙上，以确保牢固固定。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qal Pawlu meta sema' l-aħbar? Mark: Ma qal xejn. Ssammar għal mument, imbagħad talab aktar dettalji.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did Pawlu say when he heard the news? Mark: He said nothing. He was struck dumb for a moment, then asked for more details.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗听到消息时说了什么？马克：他什么也没说。他一时惊得说不出话，随后才询问更多细节。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗听到消息时说了什么？
messages.en: What did Pawlu say when he heard the news?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma qal xejn. Ssammar għal mument, imbagħad talab aktar dettalji.
messages.mt_standard: Ma qal xejn. Ssammar għal mument, imbagħad talab aktar dettalji.
messages.zh: 他什么也没说。他一时惊得说不出话，随后才询问更多细节。
messages.en: He said nothing. He was struck dumb for a moment, then asked for more details.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张学习画面记 ssammar：木板被锤子钉住，以及人听到消息后像被定住般说不出话；这是助记联想，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 被传开而成为闲话；经中间人撮合

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be divulged and become a subject of gossip, or to be arranged through a broker.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指事情被泄露并成为闲谈话题，或指交易经由经纪人、中间人撮合。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinkixef u jsir suġġett ta' tpaċpiċ, jew jiġi rranġat permezz ta' sensar.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be divulged (to become the object of gossip)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被泄露、传开，并成为人们议论的闲话话题。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be mediated by a broker
sense_translations.zh_definition: 经由经纪人或中间人居间撮合、安排。

collocations.en: the secret became gossip among the neighbours
collocations.zh: 秘密传开，成了邻居间的闲话

collocations.en: the sale was arranged through a broker
collocations.zh: 这笔买卖经由经纪人撮合

formal.mt: Il-bejgħ tad-dar ssamsar permezz ta' sensar li laqqa' lix-xerrej mas-sid.
formal.en: The sale of the house was arranged through a broker who brought the buyer and the owner together.
formal.zh: 房屋买卖由一名经纪人撮合，他安排买方与业主接洽。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sar jaf kulħadd bis-sigriet? Mark: Ssamsar mal-ġirien, u issa kulħadd qed jitkellem fuqu.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did everyone find out about the secret? Mark: It became gossip among the neighbours, and now everyone is talking about it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：大家怎么都知道这个秘密了？马克：它在邻居间传开成了闲话，现在人人都在议论。

messages.speaker: Maja (居民)
messages.zh: 大家怎么都知道这个秘密了？
messages.en: How did everyone find out about the secret?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Ssamsar mal-ġirien, u issa kulħadd qed jitkellem fuqu.
messages.mt_standard: Ssamsar mal-ġirien, u issa kulħadd qed jitkellem fuqu.
messages.zh: 它在邻居间传开成了闲话，现在人人都在议论。
messages.en: It became gossip among the neighbours, and now everyone is talking about it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ssamsar 做两张情境卡：“秘密传到邻居耳里”和“房屋买卖由经纪人撮合”；根据主语是秘密还是交易来选择义项。

gloss_zh: 被挂到钩上；被穿到鱼钩上

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be attached to a hook, for example when bait is put on a fishing hook.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被挂在或穿在钩子上，例如鱼饵被穿到鱼钩上。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitwaħħal ma' sunnara, bħalma jiġri meta jitqiegħed il-lixka għas-sajd.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be put on a hook
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被挂到钩上；被穿到鱼钩上。

collocations.en: the worm was put on the hook
was put on the hook as bait
collocations.zh: 被作为鱼饵穿到鱼钩上

formal.mt: Id-dudu ssannar bħala lixka qabel ma s-sajjied tefa' s-sunnara fl-ilma.
formal.en: The worm was put on the hook as bait before the fisherman cast the hook into the water.
formal.zh: 渔夫把鱼钩抛入水中之前，蚯蚓已被作为鱼饵穿到了钩上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Id-dudu lest għas-sajd? Mark: Iva, diġà ssannar. Issa nistgħu nibdew.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the worm ready for fishing? Mark: Yes, it has already been put on the hook. Now we can start.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：蚯蚓准备好用来钓鱼了吗？马克：好了，已经穿到鱼钩上了。现在可以开始了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 蚯蚓准备好用来钓鱼了吗？
messages.en: Is the worm ready for fishing?

messages.speaker: Mark (钓鱼者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, diġà ssannar. Issa nistgħu nibdew.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, diġà ssannar. Issa nistgħu nibdew.
messages.zh: 好了，已经穿到鱼钩上了。现在可以开始了。
messages.en: Yes, it has already been put on the hook. Now we can start.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“蚯蚓已经穿上鱼钩”的画面记住 ssannar，重点是某物被放到钩上的状态变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To apply soap to a person, a body part, or an object, usually for washing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把肥皂涂在身体部位或物品上，通常是为了清洗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqiegħed jew jidlek is-sapun fuq parti tal-ġisem jew fuq xi ħaġa biex jaħsilha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给……涂肥皂；用肥皂擦洗。

formal.mt: Qabel laħlaħ il-flokk, Pawlu ssapna l-parti fejn kien hemm it-tebgħa.
formal.en: Before rinsing the shirt, Pawlu applied soap to the stained area.
formal.zh: 保罗在漂洗衬衫之前，先给有污渍的部位涂了肥皂。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu uża s-sapun biex jaħsel idejh? Mark: Iva, ssapna jdejh sew u mbagħad laħlaħhom.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Pawlu use soap to wash his hands? Mark: Yes, he soaped his hands thoroughly and then rinsed them.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗洗手时用肥皂了吗？马克：用了，他把双手仔细打上肥皂，然后冲洗干净了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu uża s-sapun biex jaħsel idejh?
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu uża s-sapun biex jaħsel idejh?
messages.zh: 保罗洗手时用肥皂了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu use soap to wash his hands?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ssapna jdejh sew u mbagħad laħlaħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ssapna jdejh sew u mbagħad laħlaħhom.
messages.zh: 用了，他把双手仔细打上肥皂，然后冲洗干净了。
messages.en: Yes, he soaped his hands thoroughly and then rinsed them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ssapna 配上“双手抹肥皂、搓出泡沫”的动作记忆，突出清洗时涂肥皂这一步。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bear or tolerate something unpleasant, difficult, or annoying.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 忍受或承受令人不快、困难或烦扰的事情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiflaħ jew jittollera xi ħaġa diffiċli, spjaċevoli jew li ddejqu.

sense_translations.en_definition: to stand, to endure, to tolerate
sense_translations.zh_definition: 忍受；承受；容忍，其中 stand 指忍受，并非站立。

formal.mt: Matul ix-xogħol ta' tiswija, ir-resident ssaporta l-istorbju għal diversi sigħat.
formal.en: During the repair work, the resident endured the noise for several hours.
formal.zh: 维修期间，这位居民忍受了好几个小时的噪声。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif għamel Mark b'dak l-istorbju kollu? Lara: Għall-ewwel ssaporta l-istorbju, imma mbagħad għalaq it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did Mark cope with all that noise? Lara: At first he put up with the noise, but then he closed the window.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那么吵，马克怎么受得了？拉拉：一开始他忍着噪声，后来就把窗户关上了。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif għamel Mark b'dak l-istorbju kollu?
messages.mt_standard: Kif għamel Mark b'dak l-istorbju kollu?
messages.zh: 那么吵，马克怎么受得了？
messages.en: How did Mark cope with all that noise?

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għall-ewwel ssaporta l-istorbju, imma mbagħad għalaq it-tieqa.
messages.mt_standard: Għall-ewwel ssaporta l-istorbju, imma mbagħad għalaq it-tieqa.
messages.zh: 一开始他忍着噪声，后来就把窗户关上了。
messages.en: At first he put up with the noise, but then he closed the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象旁边一直有噪声，自己仍耐着性子待着，用这个“忍得住”的场景记住 ssaporta。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become thoroughly wet as liquid soaks into something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因液体浸入而变得很湿或完全湿透。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jixxarrab ħafna jew għal kollox hekk kif jidħol fih l-ilma jew likwidu ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被浸湿；被浸透；湿透。

collocations.en: the shirt became soaked in the rain

formal.mt: Il-flokk ssappap bl-ilma meta l-barmil inqaleb fuqu.
formal.en: The shirt became soaked with water when the bucket tipped over onto it.
formal.zh: 水桶翻倒，水泼在衬衫上，把它浸透了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tbiddel il-flokk? Mark: Għax ssappap bix-xita u issa qed inħoss il-bard.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you changing your shirt? Mark: Because it got soaked in the rain, and now I feel cold.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么要换衬衫？马克：因为衬衫被雨淋透了，我现在觉得冷。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么要换衬衫？
messages.en: Why are you changing your shirt?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ssappap bix-xita u issa qed inħoss il-bard.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ssappap bix-xita u issa qed inħoss il-bard.
messages.zh: 因为衬衫被雨淋透了，我现在觉得冷。
messages.en: Because it got soaked in the rain, and now I feel cold.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“衬衫吸满雨水，拧一下就滴水”的画面记住 ssappap，强调水已经浸进去了。

gloss_zh: 被加盖屋顶；盖上了屋顶

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have a roof built or placed over it, as happens to a building during construction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指建筑物被修建或安装屋顶，从而有了屋顶覆盖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinkesa b'saqaf, bħalma jiġri lil bini waqt il-kostruzzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被加盖屋顶；被屋顶覆盖。

collocations.zh: 在冬季到来之前盖上了屋顶

formal.mt: Il-bini l-ġdid ssaqqaf qabel ix-xitwa, u mbagħad beda x-xogħol fuq ġewwa.
formal.en: The new building was roofed before winter, and work on the interior then began.
formal.zh: 新建筑在冬季到来之前盖好了屋顶，随后开始了内部施工。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-garaxx għadu bla saqaf? Mark: Le, ssaqqaf ilbieraħ. Illum qed inaddfu minn ġewwa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does the garage still have no roof? Mark: No, it was roofed yesterday. Today we are cleaning the inside.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：车库还没有屋顶吗？马克：已经有了，昨天盖好的。今天我们在清理里面。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 车库还没有屋顶吗？
messages.en: Does the garage still have no roof?

messages.speaker: Mark (屋主)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ssaqqaf ilbieraħ. Illum qed inaddfu minn ġewwa.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ssaqqaf ilbieraħ. Illum qed inaddfu minn ġewwa.
messages.zh: 已经有了，昨天盖好的。今天我们在清理里面。
messages.en: No, it was roofed yesterday. Today we are cleaning the inside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象只有四面墙的车库终于盖上屋顶，用“建筑物有顶了”的前后变化记住 ssaqqaf。

gloss_zh: 挣扎；艰难应对；奋力争取

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a strong effort while facing difficulty, resistance, or an obstacle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 面对困难、阻力或障碍时费力应对，努力完成某事或摆脱困境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel sforz kbir quddiem diffikultà, reżistenza jew ostaklu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 挣扎；吃力地应对；奋力争取或努力做某事。

collocations.zh: 为取得成功而艰苦努力

formal.mt: L-istudent ssara biex jifhem it-test, iżda bl-għajnuna tal-għalliem irnexxielu jlestih.
formal.en: The student struggled to understand the text, but with the teacher's help he managed to finish it.
formal.zh: 这名学生费了很大劲才理解课文，但在老师的帮助下，他终于读完了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark ġarr il-kaxxa waħdu? Lara: Iva, imma ssara magħha għax kienet tqila ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Mark carry the box on his own? Lara: Yes, but he struggled with it because it was very heavy.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克一个人搬了那个箱子吗？拉拉：是的，不过他搬得很吃力，因为箱子特别重。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克一个人搬了那个箱子吗？
messages.en: Did Mark carry the box on his own?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ssara magħha għax kienet tqila ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ssara magħha għax kienet tqila ħafna.
messages.zh: 是的，不过他搬得很吃力，因为箱子特别重。
messages.en: Yes, but he struggled with it because it was very heavy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ssara 想成“抱着重箱子，挪一步都费力”的动作，再迁移到学习或生活中的艰难努力。

gloss_zh: 被排成一列；被排列成行

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be arranged in a row or line together with others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与其他人或物一起被安排成一行或一列。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitqiegħed f'ringiela jew f'linja ma' oħrajn.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be put in a row
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被排成一行或一列。

collocations.en: the group was arranged in a row
collocations.zh: 这一组人被排成了一行

collocations.en: was lined up in front of the door
collocations.zh: 被安排在门前排成一列

formal.mt: Il-grupp ta' studenti ssarbat f'ringiela quddiem il-bieb qabel ma daħal fis-sala.
formal.en: The group of students was lined up in front of the door before entering the hall.
formal.zh: 这组学生进入大厅之前，被安排在门前排成了一列。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-grupp lest għar-ritratt? Mark: Iva, diġà ssarbat f'ringiela ħdejn il-ħajt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the group ready for the photo? Mark: Yes, it has already been arranged in a row beside the wall.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：大家准备好拍照了吗？马克：好了，已经在墙边排成一行了。

messages.speaker: Maja (摄影师)
messages.zh: 大家准备好拍照了吗？
messages.en: Is the group ready for the photo?

messages.speaker: Mark (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, diġà ssarbat f'ringiela ħdejn il-ħajt.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, diġà ssarbat f'ringiela ħdejn il-ħajt.
messages.zh: 好了，已经在墙边排成一行了。
messages.en: Yes, it has already been arranged in a row beside the wall.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“拍集体照之前，大家被安排站成整齐一行”的画面记住 ssarbat，关注排列后的队形。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For a young child to become untidy in appearance as a result of being held or handled.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 专指幼儿因被人抱、搂或摆弄，衣服、头发等外表变得凌乱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal tifel żgħir li jsir imħarbat fid-dehra minħabba li jkun intmess jew inġarr fid-dirgħajn.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be made untidy as a result of being handled (said of a young child)
sense_translations.zh_definition: （指幼儿）因被人抱弄而变得衣服、头发等凌乱。

collocations.en: the young child became dishevelled from being handled
collocations.zh: 小孩被抱弄得衣发凌乱了

collocations.en: became dishevelled after everyone hugged him
collocations.zh: 被大家抱过之后衣发都乱了

formal.mt: Waqt iż-żjara tal-qraba, it-tifel iż-żgħir ssardan wara li għadda minn dirgħajn persuna għal oħra.
formal.en: During the relatives' visit, the young child became dishevelled after being passed from one person's arms to another's.
formal.zh: 亲戚来访时，小孩被这个抱完又交给那个抱，结果衣服和头发都弄乱了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex it-tifel għandu xagħru u ħwejġu kollha mħarbtin? Marija: Għax kulħadd ħaddnu u ssardan. Issa nirranġalu xagħru u l-flokk.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are the child's hair and clothes all messy? Marija: Because everyone hugged him and he got dishevelled. I'll straighten his hair and shirt now.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：孩子的头发和衣服怎么都乱了？玛丽亚：大家都抱了他，把他抱得乱糟糟的。我现在给他理理头发，整整上衣。

messages.speaker: Lara (姨妈)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex it-tifel għandu xagħru u ħwejġu kollha mħarbtin?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex it-tifel għandu xagħru u ħwejġu kollha mħarbtin?
messages.zh: 孩子的头发和衣服怎么都乱了？
messages.en: Why are the child's hair and clothes all messy?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kulħadd ħaddnu u ssardan. Issa nirranġalu xagħru u l-flokk.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kulħadd ħaddnu u ssardan. Issa nirranġalu xagħru u l-flokk.
messages.zh: 大家都抱了他，把他抱得乱糟糟的。我现在给他理理头发，整整上衣。
messages.en: Because everyone hugged him and he got dishevelled. I'll straighten his hair and shirt now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象幼儿被亲友轮流抱过，头发翘起、上衣歪斜；用“被抱弄乱的小孩”记住 ssardan 的特定使用对象和原因。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become confused or to be troubled by something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指因事情难以理解而陷入困惑，或因某件事而感到困扰、烦恼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jitħawwad jew ikun imħasseb minħabba xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得困惑；弄糊涂。
受到困扰；感到烦恼或不安。

collocations.zh: 因这则消息而感到困扰

formal.mt: Pawlu ssarram bl-aħbar dwar l-għeluq tal-fabbrika u talab aktar informazzjoni.
formal.en: Pawlu was troubled by the news about the factory closure and requested more information.
formal.zh: 保罗因工厂关闭的消息而感到不安，并要求了解更多情况。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Mark waqaf jimla l-formola? Ben: Ssarram bl-istruzzjonijiet. Se naqrawhom flimkien.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Mark stop filling in the form? Ben: He got confused by the instructions. We'll read them together.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克为什么不继续填表了？本：他被说明弄糊涂了。我们会一起读一遍。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 马克为什么不继续填表了？
messages.en: Why did Mark stop filling in the form?

messages.speaker: Ben (同事)
messages.zh: 他被说明弄糊涂了。我们会一起读一遍。
messages.en: He got confused by the instructions. We'll read them together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住两幅相邻画面：读说明时脑中打结，听坏消息后心里烦恼，分别对应困惑和困扰。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be gathered and wrapped or tied into a bundle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指物品被收拢后包起或捆扎，形成一个包或一捆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinġabar u jitgeżwer jew jintrabat f'qatta'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被包成一包；被捆扎成一捆。

collocations.en: was bundled up and tied with string
collocations.zh: 被打成包并用细绳捆好

formal.mt: Id-drapp ssarrar f'qatta' u ntrabat bi spaga qabel it-trasport.
formal.en: The cloth was gathered into a bundle and tied with string before transport.
formal.zh: 布料在运输前被收拢成一捆，并用细绳扎好。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn hu d-drapp li rridu nieħdu? Sam: Ssarrar u tqiegħed ħdejn il-bieb. Kollox lest.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where is the cloth we need to take? Sam: It was bundled up and put beside the door. Everything is ready.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们要带走的布料在哪里？萨姆：已经打成包放在门边了。都准备好了。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu d-drapp li rridu nieħdu?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu d-drapp li rridu nieħdu?
messages.zh: 我们要带走的布料在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the cloth we need to take?

messages.speaker: Sam (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ssarrar u tqiegħed ħdejn il-bieb. Kollox lest.
messages.mt_standard: Ssarrar u tqiegħed ħdejn il-bieb. Kollox lest.
messages.zh: 已经打成包放在门边了。都准备好了。
messages.en: It was bundled up and put beside the door. Everything is ready.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把散开的布料收拢、包起、扎紧，连看这三个动作，就能记住“被打成一包”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be sewn using leather.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某物用皮革材料缝合，强调物品受到缝制的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun meħjut bl-użu tal-ġilda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用皮革缝合；以皮革材料缝制。

collocations.en: was sewn with strips of leather
the edge of the bag was sewn with leather
collocations.zh: 袋子的边缘用皮革缝合了

formal.mt: It-tarf tal-borża ssarraġ bi strixxi rqaq tal-ġilda biex iżomm sod.
formal.en: The edge of the bag was sewn with thin strips of leather to keep it firm.
formal.zh: 袋子的边缘用细皮革条缝合，以保持牢固。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif issewwa t-tarf tal-borża? Toni: Ssarraġ bi strixxi tal-ġilda, u issa jidher sod.
colloquial.en: Maja: How was the edge of the bag repaired? Toni: It was sewn with strips of leather, and now it looks sturdy.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：袋子的边缘是怎么修好的？托尼：用皮革条缝合的，现在看起来很牢固。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 袋子的边缘是怎么修好的？
messages.en: How was the edge of the bag repaired?

messages.speaker: Toni (修理师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Ssarraġ bi strixxi tal-ġilda, u issa jidher sod.
messages.mt_standard: Ssarraġ bi strixxi tal-ġilda, u issa jidher sod.
messages.zh: 用皮革条缝合的，现在看起来很牢固。
messages.en: It was sewn with strips of leather, and now it looks sturdy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象袋口被细皮条一针针缝牢，把这个词与“用皮革缝合”的画面绑定。

gloss_zh: 释义待核：所给英文为不完整的“to fine-dra”

teaching_sense.en_definition: A verb supplied with the incomplete gloss 'to fine-dra'; its precise meaning cannot be established from this packet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 这是一个动词，但所给英文释义“to fine-dra”不完整，无法仅凭本词条材料确定其具体动作含义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Verb mogħti bit-tifsira Ingliża mhux kompluta 'to fine-dra'; il-materjal mogħti ma jippermettix li tiġi stabbilita t-tifsira preċiża tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原英文释义不完整，具体中文义待核；不能据此确定所指动作。

formal.mt: Il-verb 'ssarsa' jidher fil-lista, iżda t-tifsira Ingliża mogħtija mhix kompluta u teħtieġ verifika.
formal.en: The verb 'ssarsa' appears in the list, but the supplied English gloss is incomplete and requires verification.
formal.zh: 动词 ssarsa 出现在词表中，但所给英文释义不完整，需要核实。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'ssarsa'? Toni: Hawn it-tifsira mhix kompluta. Ejja nivverifikawha qabel nużaw il-verb.

messages.zh: ssarsa 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'ssarsa' mean?

messages.mt_standard: Hawn it-tifsira mhix kompluta. Ejja nivverifikawha qabel nużaw il-verb.
