cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词暂记在“释义待核”卡片上：先认词形和动词词性，英文缺尾时不要猜补词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wear loose, baggy trousers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指穿着裤腿或整体剪裁宽松肥大的裤子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jilbes qliezet wesgħin u laxki.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 穿宽松肥大的裤子。

collocations.en: wore baggy trousers for the celebration
collocations.zh: 为参加庆祝活动穿了宽松裤子

formal.mt: Għall-ewwel xena, l-attur ssarwal bi qliezet blu wesgħin li kienu parti mill-kostum.
formal.en: For the first scene, the actor wore blue baggy trousers that formed part of the costume.
formal.zh: 在第一场戏中，演员穿了作为戏服组成部分的蓝色宽松裤子。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'libes Mark għall-festa? Ben: Ssarwal bi qliezet blu. Kien jidher komdu ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did Mark wear to the celebration? Ben: He wore blue baggy trousers. He looked very comfortable.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克穿什么去参加庆祝活动了？本：他穿了蓝色宽松裤子，看起来很自在。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克穿什么去参加庆祝活动了？
messages.en: What did Mark wear to the celebration?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ssarwal bi qliezet blu. Kien jidher komdu ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Ssarwal bi qliezet blu. Kien jidher komdu ħafna.
messages.zh: 他穿了蓝色宽松裤子，看起来很自在。
messages.en: He wore blue baggy trousers. He looked very comfortable.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人穿着裤腿宽宽、走路晃动的裤子，用整幅穿着画面记住这个动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become covered with wool.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指身体或表面被羊毛覆盖，形成一层毛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinkesa bis-suf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被羊毛覆盖；表面覆有羊毛。

collocations.en: the body became covered with wool
became covered with a thick layer of wool
collocations.zh: 被一层厚厚的羊毛覆盖了

formal.mt: Hekk kif kiber il-ħaruf, il-ġisem tiegħu ssawwaf b'saff aktar oħxon ta' suf.
formal.en: As the lamb grew, its body became covered with a thicker layer of wool.
formal.zh: 随着小羊长大，它的身体覆上了更厚的一层羊毛。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara kemm kiber il-ħaruf! Sam: Iva, u ssawwaf sew. Issa għandu ħafna suf.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look how much the lamb has grown! Sam: Yes, and it has become well covered with wool. It has lots of wool now.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：看，小羊长大了这么多！萨姆：是啊，身上也长满羊毛了。现在它的毛可多了。

messages.speaker: Nina (农场访客)
messages.zh: 看，小羊长大了这么多！
messages.en: Look how much the lamb has grown!

messages.speaker: Sam (牧羊人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u ssawwaf sew. Issa għandu ħafna suf.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u ssawwaf sew. Issa għandu ħafna suf.
messages.zh: 是啊，身上也长满羊毛了。现在它的毛可多了。
messages.en: Yes, and it has become well covered with wool. It has lots of wool now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小羊披上一件厚厚的羊毛外衣，看到“表面覆满羊毛”的画面就回忆这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be given a shape or to be created.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指材料或事物被赋予形状，也可指某个事物被创造出来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jingħata forma jew jinħoloq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被赋予形状；被塑造成形。
被创造出来；被创作出来。

collocations.en: the clay was shaped into a vase
the character was created by the writer
collocations.zh: 这个角色由作家创造出来

formal.mt: It-tafal ssawwar f'vażun u tħalla jinxef qabel it-tiżjin.
formal.en: The clay was shaped into a vase and left to dry before decoration.
formal.zh: 黏土被塑成花瓶，并在装饰前放置晾干。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-karattru ġdid fl-istorja? Toni: Iva, ssawwar waqt li konna niktbu t-tieni kapitlu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this character new to the story? Toni: Yes, he was created while we were writing the second chapter.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个角色是故事里新加入的吗？托尼：是的，是我们写第二章时创造出来的。

messages.speaker: Maja (读者)
messages.zh: 这个角色是故事里新加入的吗？
messages.en: Is this character new to the story?

messages.speaker: Toni (作者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ssawwar waqt li konna niktbu t-tieni kapitlu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ssawwar waqt li konna niktbu t-tieni kapitlu.
messages.zh: 是的，是我们写第二章时创造出来的。
messages.en: Yes, he was created while we were writing the second chapter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想黏土被塑成花瓶，再想人物被写进故事：一个获得形状，一个被创造出来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be lashed, or to treat oneself badly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指遭到鞭打，也可指以不善待自己的方式行事，苛待自己。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jintlaqat bil-frosta, jew jittratta lilu nnifsu ħażin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 遭鞭打；受到鞭笞。
苛待自己；不好好对待自己。

collocations.mt: ssawwat billi ċaħħad lilu nnifsu mill-mistrieħ
collocations.en: treated himself badly by depriving himself of rest
collocations.zh: 不让自己休息，以此苛待自己

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-priġunier ssawwat bil-frosta qabel ma nħeles.
formal.en: In the story, the prisoner was lashed with a whip before being released.
formal.zh: 在这个故事中，囚犯获释前遭到了鞭打。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Pawlu reġa' ħadem il-lejl kollu? Ben: Iva, ssawwat billi ċaħħad lilu nnifsu mill-mistrieħ. Se ngħidlu jieħu pawża.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did Pawlu work all night again? Ben: Yes, he treated himself badly by depriving himself of rest. I'll tell him to take a break.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：保罗又工作了一整夜吗？本：是啊，他不让自己休息，太苛待自己了。我会叫他歇一会儿。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗又工作了一整夜吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu work all night again?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ssawwat billi ċaħħad lilu nnifsu mill-mistrieħ. Se ngħidlu jieħu pawża.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ssawwat billi ċaħħad lilu nnifsu mill-mistrieħ. Se ngħidlu jieħu pawża.
messages.zh: 是啊，他不让自己休息，太苛待自己了。我会叫他歇一会儿。
messages.en: Yes, he treated himself badly by depriving himself of rest. I'll tell him to take a break.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张学习卡分开记：一张画鞭子表示遭鞭打，一张画熬夜的人表示苛待自己。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To go without food, either deliberately by fasting or because there is not enough food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不进食，可指主动斋戒，也可指因食物不足而挨饿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħaddi żmien bla ma jiekol, jew b'għażla waqt sawm jew minħabba nuqqas ta' ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 斋戒；在一段时间内主动不进食
挨饿；因缺少食物而受饥饿之苦

collocations.en: went hungry because of a lack of food

formal.mt: Matul il-ġurnata ta' talb, Mark ssawwem u xorob biss ilma.
formal.en: During the day of prayer, Mark fasted and drank only water.
formal.zh: 在祈祷日当天，马克斋戒，只喝了水。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark ma kielx magħna llum? Pawlu: Għax illum ssawwem; se jiekol aktar tard.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why didn't Mark eat with us today? Pawlu: Because he fasted today; he'll eat later.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克今天怎么没跟我们一起吃饭？保罗：因为他今天斋戒，晚些时候才吃。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark ma kielx magħna llum?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark ma kielx magħna llum?
messages.zh: 马克今天怎么没跟我们一起吃饭？
messages.en: Why didn't Mark eat with us today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax illum ssawwem; se jiekol aktar tard.
messages.mt_standard: Għax illum ssawwem; se jiekol aktar tard.
messages.zh: 因为他今天斋戒，晚些时候才吃。
messages.en: Because he fasted today; he'll eat later.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上空餐盘来记：主动暂时不吃是斋戒，缺少食物而没得吃是挨饿，靠上下文区分。

gloss_zh: 长成林地；逐渐长满树木

teaching_sense.en_definition: For a place to become covered with trees and develop into wooded land.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某个地方逐渐长满树木，成为有林木覆盖的土地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal post li jimtela bis-siġar u jsir art bis-siġar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逐渐长满树木；变成林地。

formal.mt: Il-wied ssaġġar matul is-snin, u llum hemm ħafna siġar fejn qabel kien hemm art vojta.
formal.en: The valley became wooded over the years, and today many trees grow where there used to be bare land.
formal.zh: 多年间，山谷逐渐长满了树木，如今从前的空地上已经生长着许多树。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Tiftakar kemm kien vojt dan il-post? Pawlu: Iva, ssaġġar minn dak iż-żmien; ara kemm hemm siġar issa!
colloquial.en: Marija: Do you remember how bare this place was? Pawlu: Yes, it has become wooded since then; look how many trees there are now!
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你还记得这里以前有多空旷吗？保罗：记得，从那以后这里逐渐长满了树；看看现在有多少树！

messages.speaker: Marija (散步的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tiftakar kemm kien vojt dan il-post?
messages.mt_standard: Tiftakar kemm kien vojt dan il-post?
messages.zh: 你还记得这里以前有多空旷吗？
messages.en: Do you remember how bare this place was?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (散步的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ssaġġar minn dak iż-żmien; ara kemm hemm siġar issa!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ssaġġar minn dak iż-żmien; ara kemm hemm siġar issa!
messages.zh: 记得，从那以后这里逐渐长满了树；看看现在有多少树！
messages.en: Yes, it has become wooded since then; look how many trees there are now!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ssaġġar 配上空地逐年变绿的连续画面：树木越来越多，最后形成林地。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become angry in response to something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因某件事而生气、发怒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jirrabja minħabba xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生气；发怒。

formal.mt: Il-klijent ssaħan meta sar jaf li l-ordni tiegħu kienet għadha ma ntbagħtitx.
formal.en: The customer became angry when he learned that his order had still not been sent.
formal.zh: 顾客得知自己的订单仍未发出时，生气了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ssaħan Pawlu? Maja: Ħadd ma ħallieh jitkellem.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Pawlu get angry? Maja: Nobody let him speak.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：保罗为什么生气了？玛雅：大家都不让他说话。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么生气了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu get angry?

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 大家都不让他说话。
messages.en: Nobody let him speak.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“讨论中被打断，于是气上心头”的场景记忆 ssaħan；特别留意单个 ħ，避免与 ssaħħan 的拼写混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For the sky to become cloudy or covered with cloud.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指天空开始多云，或逐渐被云层覆盖而变阴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-sema jimtela bis-sħab jew jinkesa bis-sħab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得多云；开始有云聚集。
变得阴云密布；天空被云层覆盖。

formal.mt: Wara nofsinhar is-sema ssaħħab għal kollox, u ftit wara bdiet nieżla x-xita.
formal.en: In the afternoon the sky became completely overcast, and shortly afterwards it began to rain.
formal.zh: 下午天空完全阴了下来，不久便开始下雨。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara kif ssaħħab is-sema! Mark: Ħu l-umbrella, forsi tagħmel ix-xita.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look how cloudy the sky has become! Mark: Take the umbrella; it might rain.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看，天空都阴下来了！马克：带上雨伞吧，可能会下雨。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看，天空都阴下来了！
messages.en: Look how cloudy the sky has become!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 带上雨伞吧，可能会下雨。
messages.en: Take the umbrella; it might rain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把天空想成逐渐拉上的云幕：先是云变多，再到整片天空被盖住，分别对应 cloudy 和 overcast 两个教学义项。

gloss_zh: 使自己暖和起来；兴奋起来

teaching_sense.en_definition: To warm oneself up, or to become excited about something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使自己的身体暖和起来；也指因某事而兴奋起来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir aktar sħun billi jsaħħan lilu nnifsu, jew jitħeġġeġ u jsir eċċitat dwar xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使自己暖和起来；让身体热起来。
兴奋起来；情绪变得热烈。

collocations.en: warmed himself up by the fire

formal.mt: Waqt il-finali, il-pubbliku ssaħħan bil-logħba u beda jċapċap b'entużjażmu.
formal.en: During the final, the crowd became excited about the match and began to applaud enthusiastically.
formal.zh: 决赛期间，观众因比赛而兴奋起来，开始热烈鼓掌。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark għadu qed jirgħod bil-bard? Lara: Le, ssaħħan ħdejn in-nar u issa jinsab aħjar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is Mark still shivering with cold? Lara: No, he warmed himself up by the fire and feels better now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克还冷得发抖吗？拉拉：没有了，他在火边暖和了一下，现在好多了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克还冷得发抖吗？
messages.en: Is Mark still shivering with cold?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ssaħħan ħdejn in-nar u issa jinsab aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ssaħħan ħdejn in-nar u issa jinsab aħjar.
messages.zh: 没有了，他在火边暖和了一下，现在好多了。
messages.en: No, he warmed himself up by the fire and feels better now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把双写的 ħħ 当作视觉提醒：一幅图是身体暖起来，另一幅图是看比赛兴奋起来；这是记忆提示，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made stronger or to become powerful.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 得到加强、变得更牢固，或变得有实力、有影响力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir aktar b'saħħtu jew jikseb aktar qawwa u influwenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 得到加强；被加固；变得更有力。
变得强大；变得有实力或有影响力。

formal.mt: Il-pont issaħħaħ permezz ta' xogħol strutturali biex ikun jista' jiflaħ tagħbijiet akbar.
formal.en: The bridge was strengthened through structural work so that it could withstand heavier loads.
formal.zh: 桥梁经过结构加固，以便承受更大的荷载。

colloquial.mt: Lara: It-tim issaħħaħ din is-sena? Mark: Iva, daħlu żewġ plejers tajbin u issa qed jirbaħ aktar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Has the team become stronger this year? Mark: Yes, two good players joined, and now it is winning more often.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：球队今年实力增强了吗？马克：是啊，来了两名好球员，现在赢球的次数更多了。

messages.speaker: Lara (球迷)
messages.zh: 球队今年实力增强了吗？
messages.en: Has the team become stronger this year?

messages.speaker: Mark (球迷)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, daħlu żewġ plejers tajbin u issa qed jirbaħ aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, daħlu żewġ plejers tajbin u issa qed jirbaħ aktar.
messages.zh: 是啊，来了两名好球员，现在赢球的次数更多了。
messages.en: Yes, two good players joined, and now it is winning more often.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面一起记：桥梁加固后更牢，团队加入强手后更强；两者都把注意力放在主体得到加强这一变化上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be surpassed by someone or something that performs better.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在表现、成绩或能力等方面被别人或其他事物超过。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi megħlub minn xi ħadd jew minn xi ħaġa li tikseb riżultat aħjar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被超过；在表现或成就上被比下去

formal.mt: Fil-kompetizzjoni, it-tim ssebbaq mill-avversarju fil-preċiżjoni u fil-ħeffa.
formal.en: In the competition, the team was outdone by its opponent in accuracy and speed.
formal.zh: 在比赛中，这支队伍在准确度和速度上都被对手超过。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark rebaħ il-kompetizzjoni tat-tisjir? Pawlu: Le, din id-darba ssebbaq minn ħuh; id-deżerta ta' ħuh kienet aħjar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Mark win the cooking competition? Pawlu: No, this time he was outdone by his brother; his brother's dessert was better.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克赢了烹饪比赛吗？保罗：没有，这回他被兄弟比下去了，他兄弟做的甜点更好。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克赢了烹饪比赛吗？
messages.en: Did Mark win the cooking competition?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, din id-darba ssebbaq minn ħuh; id-deżerta ta' ħuh kienet aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Le, din id-darba ssebbaq minn ħuh; id-deżerta ta' ħuh kienet aħjar.
messages.zh: 没有，这回他被兄弟比下去了，他兄弟做的甜点更好。
messages.en: No, this time he was outdone by his brother; his brother's dessert was better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象成绩榜上有人排到自己前面，自己被比下去；记忆重点是主语属于被超过的一方。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become or be made more beautiful, or to be praised or glorified.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得更美或经过修饰而变美；也可指受到赞美或颂扬。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir isbaħ jew jiġi mżejjen; jista' wkoll jiġi mfaħħar jew jingħata ġieħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被美化；经过装饰或改善而变得更美
被装扮得美丽；被修饰得好看
受到赞美或颂扬；被赋予荣耀

collocations.en: was glorified with words of praise

formal.mt: Il-ġnien pubbliku ssebbaħ bi fjuri ġodda u mogħdijiet imsewwija.
formal.en: The public garden was beautified with new flowers and repaired paths.
formal.zh: 公共花园增添了鲜花，修缮了小径，变得更加美丽。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm ssebbaħ il-bitħa! Mark: Iva, il-fjuri u ż-żebgħa l-ġdida għamlu differenza kbira.
colloquial.en: Maja: The courtyard looks so much prettier! Mark: Yes, the flowers and the fresh paint made a big difference.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：院子变漂亮了好多！马克：是啊，鲜花和新刷的油漆让这里大不一样了。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 院子变漂亮了好多！
messages.en: The courtyard looks so much prettier!

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-fjuri u ż-żebgħa l-ġdida għamlu differenza kbira.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-fjuri u ż-żebgħa l-ġdida għamlu differenza kbira.
messages.zh: 是啊，鲜花和新刷的油漆让这里大不一样了。
messages.en: Yes, the flowers and the fresh paint made a big difference.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住两幅画面：花园经过装点变美，一个人受到众人赞颂；分别对应外观变美与受到赞扬。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For hair to become thicker or denser.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指头发或其他毛发变得更加浓密。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għax-xagħar meta jsir aktar folt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变浓密、变厚实，专指毛发

collocations.en: grew thicker over the months, referring to hair
collocations.zh: 毛发在几个月间变得浓密

formal.mt: Matul ix-xhur, ix-xagħar tat-tifel ssebbel u sar aktar folt.
formal.en: Over the months, the boy's hair thickened and became denser.
formal.zh: 几个月间，男孩的头发逐渐变得更加浓密。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Innutajt kemm ssebbel xagħar it-tifel? Mark: Iva, issa jidher ħafna aktar folt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you noticed how much thicker the boy's hair has become? Mark: Yes, it looks much denser now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你注意到孩子的头发浓密了多少吗？马克：注意到了，现在看着浓密多了。

messages.speaker: Maja (母亲)
messages.zh: 你注意到孩子的头发浓密了多少吗？
messages.en: Have you noticed how much thicker the boy's hair has become?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa jidher ħafna aktar folt.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa jidher ħafna aktar folt.
messages.zh: 注意到了，现在看着浓密多了。
messages.en: Yes, it looks much denser now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用头发由稀变密的前后照片来记这个词；所给义项专指毛发，别套用到浓汤或浓雾。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become infested with lice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身上或头发里出现虱子，受到虱子侵扰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimtela bil-qamel jew jibda jkollu l-qamel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生虱子；染上虱子并受到侵扰

collocations.en: the boy became infested with lice
became infested with lice after close contact
collocations.zh: 在密切接触后染上了虱子

formal.mt: It-tifel ssebben, u waqt l-eżami nstab qamel f'xagħru.
formal.en: The boy became infested with lice, and lice were found in his hair during the examination.
formal.zh: 男孩染上了虱子，检查时在他的头发里发现了虱子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed jiħokk rasu daqshekk it-tifel? Mark: Ssebben; sibt il-qamel f'xagħru.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the boy scratching his head so much? Mark: He's got lice; I found them in his hair.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：孩子怎么一直挠头？马克：他生虱子了，我在他头发里找到了虱子。

messages.speaker: Maja (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed jiħokk rasu daqshekk it-tifel?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed jiħokk rasu daqshekk it-tifel?
messages.zh: 孩子怎么一直挠头？
messages.en: Why is the boy scratching his head so much?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.zh: 他生虱子了，我在他头发里找到了虱子。
messages.en: He's got lice; I found them in his hair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把挠头和梳子上发现虱子的画面连起来记；这个词表示生了虱子，单凭头痒还不能确定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be shown to be virtuous and truthful through one's conduct or supporting evidence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过行为或相关证据，被证实品行正直、为人诚实。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintwera li hu bniedem ta' virtù u li jgħid il-verità, permezz ta' għemilu jew tal-provi.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be shown to be virtuous and true
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被证明品德端正且诚实可信

collocations.en: was shown to be virtuous and true through his deeds
collocations.zh: 以自身行为证明了正直诚实

collocations.en: was shown by testimony to be virtuous and true
collocations.zh: 经证言证实为人正直诚实

formal.mt: Ir-raġel sseddaq bix-xhieda ta' dawk li rawh jirritorna l-flus lil sidhom.
formal.en: The man was shown to be virtuous and true by the testimony of those who saw him return the money to its owner.
formal.zh: 有人亲眼见到这名男子将钱归还失主，他们的证言证实了他的正直与诚实。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kont għadek tiddubita minn Mark? Pawlu: Le, sseddaq b'għemilu; irritorna l-flus kollha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Were you still doubting Mark? Pawlu: No, his actions showed him to be virtuous and true; he returned all the money.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你之前还在怀疑马克吗？保罗：没有了，他的行为证明了他的正直诚实，他把钱全数归还了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你之前还在怀疑马克吗？
messages.en: Were you still doubting Mark?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, sseddaq b'għemilu; irritorna l-flus kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Le, sseddaq b'għemilu; irritorna l-flus kollha.
messages.zh: 没有了，他的行为证明了他的正直诚实，他把钱全数归还了。
messages.en: No, his actions showed him to be virtuous and true; he returned all the money.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人受到怀疑，归还失物的行为随后证明了他的品德；抓住正直诚实得到证实这一层意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become dense, thick, or closely packed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从较稀疏的状态变得稠密、浓厚或紧密。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir aktar dens jew folt, b'inqas spazju bejn il-partijiet tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得稠密；变得浓厚或密集

formal.mt: Matul il-lejl, iċ-ċpar sseffaq u l-viżibbiltà naqset ħafna.
formal.en: During the night, the fog became dense and visibility decreased considerably.
formal.zh: 夜间雾气变浓，能见度大幅下降。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadek tara t-triq sew? Mark: Le, iċ-ċpar sseffaq; ejja nieqfu f'post sigur.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you still see the road clearly? Mark: No, the fog has thickened; let's stop somewhere safe.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你还能看清路吗？马克：看不清了，雾变浓了，我们找个安全的地方停下吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (乘客)
messages.zh: 你还能看清路吗？
messages.en: Can you still see the road clearly?

messages.speaker: Mark (司机)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, iċ-ċpar sseffaq; ejja nieqfu f'post sigur.
messages.mt_standard: Le, iċ-ċpar sseffaq; ejja nieqfu f'post sigur.
messages.zh: 看不清了，雾变浓了，我们找个安全的地方停下吧。
messages.en: No, the fog has thickened; let's stop somewhere safe.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象薄雾逐渐加浓，远处景物慢慢消失；用由稀到密的变化画面记住这个动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be shoved into something, or to behave arrogantly or with excessive forwardness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被用力塞进某处；也可指表现得傲慢、冒失或过分放肆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mbuttat ġewwa xi ħaġa; jista' wkoll iġib ruħu b'arroganza jew b'kunfidenza żejda bla rispett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被用力塞进某物或某个空间
表现得傲慢、冒失或过分放肆

collocations.en: behaved arrogantly or presumptuously towards the guests
collocations.zh: 对客人表现得傲慢放肆

formal.mt: Waqt ix-xogħol, il-bastun sseffed fit-toqba u baqa' mwaħħal hemm.
formal.en: During the work, the stick was shoved into the hole and remained stuck there.
formal.zh: 作业时，木棍被用力塞进孔里，随后卡在了里面。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex telqu l-mistednin daqshekk kmieni? Mark: Pawlu sseffed magħhom; interrompiehom u beda jagħtihom l-ordnijiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the guests leave so early? Mark: Pawlu was arrogant and presumptuous with them; he interrupted them and started giving them orders.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：客人怎么这么早就走了？马克：保罗对他们太放肆了，打断他们说话，还开始对他们发号施令。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 客人怎么这么早就走了？
messages.en: Why did the guests leave so early?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu sseffed magħhom; interrompiehom u beda jagħtihom l-ordnijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu sseffed magħhom; interrompiehom u beda jagħtihom l-ordnijiet.
messages.zh: 保罗对他们太放肆了，打断他们说话，还开始对他们发号施令。
messages.en: Pawlu was arrogant and presumptuous with them; he interrupted them and started giving them orders.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分两张记忆卡：一张画木棍被硬塞进孔里，一张画有人傲慢地抢话；这是义项联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be drawn inward by suction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到吸力作用而被吸到某物内部。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinġibed lejn ġewwa bil-ġbid tal-arja jew ta' likwidu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被吸入；被吸进去。

collocations.en: to be sucked into the pipe
to be sucked in with the air

formal.mt: Matul il-prova, it-trab issefsef fil-pajp flimkien mal-arja.
formal.en: During the test, the dust was sucked into the pipe together with the air.
formal.zh: 测试过程中，灰尘随空气一起被吸入管道。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn mar it-trab li kien hawn? Mark: Issefsef fil-pajp meta xgħelt il-magna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did the dust that was here go? Mark: It was sucked into the pipe when I switched on the machine.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：刚才这里的灰尘去哪儿了？马克：我打开机器时，它被吸进管道了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn mar it-trab li kien hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn mar it-trab li kien hawn?
messages.zh: 刚才这里的灰尘去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did the dust that was here go?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我打开机器时，它被吸进管道了。
messages.en: It was sucked into the pipe when I switched on the machine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象灰尘顺着吸力进入管道，用画面记住“被吸入”，并注意主语是被吸进去的东西。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To separate people or things into distinct groups and keep them apart.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把人或事物分成不同群体，并使其彼此隔开。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jifred nies jew affarijiet fi gruppi distinti u jżommhom separati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将人或事物隔离；使不同群体分开。

formal.mt: Id-direttur issegrega l-istudenti skont l-oriġini tagħhom, u l-ġenituri oġġezzjonaw għal din id-deċiżjoni.
formal.en: The director segregated the students according to their origin, and the parents objected to this decision.
formal.zh: 校长按学生的出身将他们隔离分组，家长们反对这一决定。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-ġenituri lmentaw? Pawlu: Għax id-direttur issegrega lit-tfal skont l-oriġini tagħhom.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did the parents complain? Pawlu: Because the director segregated the children according to their origin.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：家长们为什么投诉？保罗：因为校长按孩子们的出身把他们隔离分组了。

messages.speaker: Lara (家长)
messages.zh: 家长们为什么投诉？
messages.en: Why did the parents complain?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家长)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax id-direttur issegrega lit-tfal skont l-oriġini tagħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Għax id-direttur issegrega lit-tfal skont l-oriġini tagħhom.
messages.zh: 因为校长按孩子们的出身把他们隔离分组了。
messages.en: Because the director segregated the children according to their origin.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一道隔板把不同群体分开，记住这个动词强调把群体隔开并维持分离。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be given or referred to by a particular name or designation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被赋予某个名称，或被人用某个名称称呼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħata isem jew titlu, jew jintuża isem partikolari biex jirreferu għalih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被称为；被叫作。

collocations.en: to be called by his name

formal.mt: Il-proġett il-ġdid issejjaħ 'Pont' biex jenfasizza r-rabta bejn iż-żewġ komunitajiet.
formal.en: The new project was called 'Bridge' to emphasize the connection between the two communities.
formal.zh: 这个新项目被命名为“桥梁”，以突出两个社区之间的联系。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-proġett issejjaħ 'Pont'? Mark: Għax jgħaqqad żewġ komunitajiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why was the project called 'Bridge'? Mark: Because it brings two communities together.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个项目为什么叫“桥梁”？马克：因为它把两个社区联系起来。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这个项目为什么叫“桥梁”？
messages.en: Why was the project called 'Bridge'?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.zh: 因为它把两个社区联系起来。
messages.en: Because it brings two communities together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把事物和它的名称标签连在一起，记成“它被叫作什么”，注意被称呼者作主语。

gloss_zh: 被廉价出售；被低价卖出

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be sold at a low price.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以较低的价格被出售。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinbiegħ bi prezz baxx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被廉价出售；被低价卖出。

collocations.en: to be sold cheaply at the market
to be sold cheaply for a few euros
collocations.zh: 仅以几欧元的低价售出

formal.mt: L-armarju l-antik issejjeb għal għaxar ewro minħabba l-ħsara fil-bieb.
formal.en: The old cupboard was sold cheaply for ten euros because of the damage to its door.
formal.zh: 那个旧柜子因为柜门损坏，仅以十欧元的低价售出。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm inbiegħ l-armarju? Pawlu: Issejjeb għal għaxar ewro għax il-bieb kien miksur.
colloquial.en: Lara: How much did the cupboard sell for? Pawlu: It was sold cheaply for ten euros because the door was broken.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：柜子卖了多少钱？保罗：因为柜门坏了，只低价卖了十欧元。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 柜子卖了多少钱？
messages.en: How much did the cupboard sell for?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (卖家)
messages.mt_spoken: Issejjeb għal għaxar ewro għax il-bieb kien miksur.
messages.mt_standard: Issejjeb għal għaxar ewro għax il-bieb kien miksur.
messages.zh: 因为柜门坏了，只低价卖了十欧元。
messages.en: It was sold cheaply for ten euros because the door was broken.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象旧柜子贴着很低的价签被买走，连记“东西作主语、低价成交”两个要点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be executed with a sword or stabbed with one.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被人用剑处决，或遭到剑刺。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinqatel bħala kastig permezz ta' sejf, jew jintlaqat b'daqqa ta' sejf li tinfidlu ġismu.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be executed or stabbed with a sword
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被用剑处决，或被剑刺伤。

collocations.en: to be stabbed with a sword during the fighting
to be executed with a sword on the sultan's orders
collocations.zh: 奉苏丹之命被用剑处决

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-priġunier issejjef b'ordni tas-sultan.
formal.en: In the story, the prisoner was executed with a sword on the sultan's orders.
formal.zh: 在故事中，囚犯奉苏丹之命被用剑处决。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara lill-priġunier fl-aħħar tar-rakkont? Mark: Issejjef b'ordni tas-sultan.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened to the prisoner at the end of the story? Mark: He was executed with a sword on the sultan's orders.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：故事最后那个囚犯怎么样了？马克：他奉苏丹之命被用剑处决了。

messages.speaker: Maja (读者)
messages.zh: 故事最后那个囚犯怎么样了？
messages.en: What happened to the prisoner at the end of the story?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 他奉苏丹之命被用剑处决了。
messages.en: He was executed with a sword on the sultan's orders.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用故事中的剑作记忆画面：既可能指被剑处决，也可能指被剑刺伤，须看上下文。

gloss_zh: 被铺设为地基；以……为依据

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be laid as foundations, or to have something as a basis.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被铺设成地基；也指某事物建立在某种依据或基础之上。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitqiegħed bħala pedament, jew ikollu xi ħaġa bħala bażi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被铺设为地基；被安放作为基础。
以……为基础；建立在……之上；以……为依据。

collocations.en: the stones were laid as foundations

formal.mt: Il-ġebel issejjes bħala pedament għall-ħajt il-ġdid. Il-pjan tal-bini issejjes fuq studju tal-art.
formal.en: The stones were laid as foundations for the new wall. The building plan was based on a study of the ground.
formal.zh: 石块被铺设为新墙的地基。建筑方案以地质勘察为依据。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fuq xiex issejjes il-pjan tiegħek? Pawlu: Fuq dak li qalulna r-residenti.
colloquial.en: Lara: What was your plan based on? Pawlu: On what the residents told us.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你的方案是根据什么制定的？保罗：根据居民告诉我们的情况。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 你的方案是根据什么制定的？
messages.en: What was your plan based on?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (项目负责人)
messages.zh: 根据居民告诉我们的情况。
messages.en: On what the residents told us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个义项画成上下两层：石头成为房屋地基，事实成为计划依据；用“基础”串联记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To formally support a proposal already put forward by another person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在他人提出提案后，作为另一人正式表示支持，即附议。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti appoġġ formali lil proposta li tkun diġà tressqet minn persuna oħra.

sense_translations.en_definition: to second (to agree as a second person to a proposal)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 附议；作为第二人对他人提出的提案表示赞同。

formal.mt: Matul il-laqgħa, Mark issekonda l-proposta ta' Maja biex jinfetaħ ċentru ġdid.
formal.en: During the meeting, Mark seconded Maja's proposal to open a new centre.
formal.zh: 会议期间，马克附议了玛雅关于开设新中心的提案。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi ħadd issekonda l-proposta tiegħi? Pawlu: Iva, Mark issekondaha waqt il-laqgħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did anyone second my proposal? Pawlu: Yes, Mark seconded it during the meeting.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：有人附议我的提案吗？保罗：有，马克在会上附议了。

messages.speaker: Lara (委员会成员)
messages.zh: 有人附议我的提案吗？
messages.en: Did anyone second my proposal?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (会议秘书)
messages.zh: 有，马克在会上附议了。
messages.en: Yes, Mark seconded it during the meeting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象会议上第一人提出建议，第二人举手说“我支持”，把这个动作记作“附议”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be the subject of gossip or informal talk about one's personal affairs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 成为别人闲谈或议论个人私事的对象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun is-suġġett ta' tqassis jew ta' diskors informali dwar ħajtu privata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被人说闲话；成为别人议论或传播八卦的对象。

collocations.en: to be gossiped about in the neighbourhood
collocations.zh: 在街坊邻里间被说闲话

collocations.en: to be gossiped about because of a rumour
collocations.zh: 因一则传言而被人议论

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, Pawlu sseksek fil-viċinat wara li nfirxet xnigħa dwar il-ħajja privata tiegħu.
formal.en: In the novel, Pawlu was gossiped about in the neighbourhood after a rumour spread about his private life.
formal.zh: 在小说中，一则关于保罗私生活的传言散开后，街坊邻里纷纷议论他。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu kien imdejjaq? Mark: Għax isseksek fil-viċinat minħabba xnigħa li ma kinitx vera.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why was Pawlu upset? Mark: Because he was gossiped about in the neighbourhood because of a rumour that was not true.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么心情不好？马克：因为一则不实传言，街坊邻里都在说他的闲话。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么心情不好？
messages.en: Why was Pawlu upset?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax isseksek fil-viċinat minħabba xnigħa li ma kinitx vera.
messages.mt_standard: Għax isseksek fil-viċinat minħabba xnigħa li ma kinitx vera.
messages.zh: 因为一则不实传言，街坊邻里都在说他的闲话。
messages.en: Because he was gossiped about in the neighbourhood because of a rumour that was not true.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象几个人交头接耳，话题中心的人就是主语；记住这里表示“被说闲话”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To receive a greeting from another person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到别人的问候或招呼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jirċievi tislima mingħand xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到问候；有人向其打招呼。

formal.mt: Il-mistieden ssellem b'rispett meta daħal fis-sala.
formal.en: The guest was greeted respectfully when he entered the hall.
formal.zh: 客人走进大厅时，受到了恭敬的问候。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark ssellem bil-qalb fil-festa. Rita: Kemm hu sabiħ! Żgur ħassu milqugħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Mark was greeted warmly at the party. Rita: How lovely! He must have felt welcome.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克在聚会上受到了热情的问候。丽塔：真好！他一定感到很受欢迎。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克在聚会上受到了热情的问候。
messages.en: Mark was greeted warmly at the party.

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu sabiħ! Żgur ħassu milqugħ.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu sabiħ! Żgur ħassu milqugħ.
messages.zh: 真好！他一定感到很受欢迎。
messages.en: How lovely! He must have felt welcome.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象客人进门，大家转身向他问好；把 ssellem 和“受到问候”的接收者视角一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To develop loose threads as the edge or surface of fabric wears.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指布料等因磨损而出现散开的线头或脱线的边缘。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibda jinħall f'ħjut mit-tarf jew mill-wiċċ minħabba l-użu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 磨损后散线；布边等变得毛散、脱线。

formal.mt: It-tarf tad-drapp ssellet wara ħafna ħasil.
formal.en: The edge of the fabric became frayed after repeated washing.
formal.zh: 经过多次洗涤，布料的边缘磨散脱线了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara, it-tarf tal-kmiem ssellet. Nina: Iva, se nieħu l-qmis għand il-ħajjata.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look, the edge of the sleeve has become frayed. Nina: Yes, I'll take the shirt to the dressmaker.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你看，袖口边缘脱线了。妮娜：是啊，我要把衬衫拿去给裁缝修。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看，袖口边缘脱线了。
messages.en: Look, the edge of the sleeve has become frayed.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se nieħu l-qmis għand il-ħajjata.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se nieħu l-qmis għand il-ħajjata.
messages.zh: 是啊，我要把衬衫拿去给裁缝修。
messages.en: Yes, I'll take the shirt to the dressmaker.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ssellet 记成旧袖口冒出一根根线头的画面，重点是“原本完整的边缘逐渐磨散”。

gloss_zh: 接连聚集；尤指云层陆续聚拢

teaching_sense.en_definition: To gather one after another, especially when clouds collect in the sky.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个接一个地聚集，尤其用来描述云朵在天空中陆续聚拢。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinġabar wieħed wara l-ieħor, speċjalment meta s-sħab jinġabar fis-sema.

sense_translations.en_definition: to gather in succession (used especially of clouds)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 接连聚集、陆续聚拢，尤其用于描述云层。

collocations.en: the clouds gathered in succession over the sea
collocations.zh: 云朵在海面上空接连聚集

collocations.en: the clouds gathered in succession over the hills
collocations.zh: 云朵在山丘上空陆续聚拢

formal.mt: Matul waranofsinhar, is-sħab ssemlaħ fuq l-għoljiet u għatta x-xemx.
formal.en: During the afternoon, clouds gathered in succession over the hills and covered the sun.
formal.zh: 下午，云朵在山丘上空接连聚集，遮住了太阳。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Ara kif is-sħab ssemlaħ fuq il-baħar. Sara: Iva, ftit ilu s-sema kien ċar!
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Look how the clouds have gathered one after another over the sea. Sara: Yes, the sky was clear just a little while ago!
colloquial.zh: 保罗：你看，云朵在海面上空一片接一片地聚起来了。萨拉：是啊，刚才天空还很晴朗呢！

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara kif is-sħab ssemlaħ fuq il-baħar.
messages.mt_standard: Ara kif is-sħab ssemlaħ fuq il-baħar.
messages.zh: 你看，云朵在海面上空一片接一片地聚起来了。
messages.en: Look how the clouds have gathered one after another over the sea.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ftit ilu s-sema kien ċar!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ftit ilu s-sema kien ċar!
messages.zh: 是啊，刚才天空还很晴朗呢！
messages.en: Yes, the sky was clear just a little while ago!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象天空中的云朵排队报到，一片接着一片聚拢；用这个连续画面记住 ssemlaħ 的“接连聚集”。

gloss_zh: 被命名；被提及；变得知名

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be given a name, to be referred to in speech or writing, or to become well-known.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被赋予名称，在言谈或文字中被提到，或逐渐为人所知。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħata isem, jissemma f'diskors jew f'kitba, jew isir magħruf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被命名；被取名。
被提到；在言谈或文字中被提及。
变得知名；逐渐为人所熟知。

collocations.en: to be named after his grandfather
to be mentioned in the report
to become well-known for his skill

formal.mt: Il-proġett ssemma fir-rapport annwali bħala eżempju ta' kollaborazzjoni tajba.
formal.en: The project was mentioned in the annual report as an example of good collaboration.
formal.zh: 该项目在年度报告中被提及，作为良好合作的实例。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex it-tifel ssemma Pawlu? Mark: Ssemma għal nannuh.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why was the boy named Pawlu? Mark: He was named after his grandfather.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：为什么给这个男孩取名保罗？马克：他是随祖父的名字取名的。

messages.speaker: Rita (家人)
messages.zh: 为什么给这个男孩取名保罗？
messages.en: Why was the boy named Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.zh: 他是随祖父的名字取名的。
messages.en: He was named after his grandfather.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个场景串记 ssemma：出生时被取名、报告里被提到、后来变得出名；再靠上下文区分三义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To listen with close attention, or to listen secretly to other people's conversation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 集中注意力仔细听，或暗中听取他人的谈话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jisma' b'attenzjoni kbira, jew jisma' bil-moħbi dak li jgħidu oħrajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 仔细听；留神倾听。
偷听；暗中听取别人的谈话。

formal.mt: L-istudent ssemma' b'attenzjoni waqt li l-għalliem spjega l-istruzzjonijiet.
formal.en: The student listened carefully while the teacher explained the instructions.
formal.zh: 老师讲解要求时，学生仔细倾听。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Mark kien wara l-bieb? Pawlu: Ssemma' biex jisma' x'konna qed ngħidu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why was Mark behind the door? Pawlu: He was eavesdropping to hear what we were saying.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克为什么待在门后？保罗：他在偷听，想知道我们在说什么。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么待在门后？
messages.en: Why was Mark behind the door?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ssemma' biex jisma' x'konna qed ngħidu.
messages.mt_standard: Ssemma' biex jisma' x'konna qed ngħidu.
messages.zh: 他在偷听，想知道我们在说什么。
messages.en: He was eavesdropping to hear what we were saying.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把耳朵凑近：课堂上是仔细听，门后则可能是偷听；书写时记住 ssemma' 末尾还有一个撇号。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be harmed by poison entering the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因毒物进入体内而受到伤害，即中毒或被毒害。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġarrab ħsara minħabba velenu li jidħol fil-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 中毒；受到毒物侵害或被人毒害。

collocations.en: to be poisoned by a toxic substance

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi każ fejn kelb ssemmem wara li kiel ikel li kien fih il-velenu.
formal.en: The report describes a case in which a dog was poisoned after eating food containing poison.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一起狗吃下含有毒物的食物后中毒的事件。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex ħadu l-qattus għand il-veterinarju? Lara: Għax ssemmem. Issa qiegħed taħt il-kura tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did they take the cat to the vet? Lara: Because it was poisoned. It's under his care now.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：他们为什么把猫送去看兽医？拉拉：因为它中毒了，现在正由兽医照料。

messages.speaker: Nina (邻居)
messages.zh: 他们为什么把猫送去看兽医？
messages.en: Why did they take the cat to the vet?

messages.speaker: Lara (猫主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ssemmem. Issa qiegħed taħt il-kura tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ssemmem. Issa qiegħed taħt il-kura tiegħu.
messages.zh: 因为它中毒了，现在正由兽医照料。
messages.en: Because it was poisoned. It's under his care now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ssemmem 配上“误食有毒食物后中毒”的情景，记住主语是受到毒物伤害的人或动物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To gain body fat, or figuratively to become wealthy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体长胖；也可比喻财富增加、变得富有。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iżid fix-xaħam tal-ġisem jew, b'mod figurattiv, isir għani.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 长胖；身体脂肪增加。
变得富有；财富逐渐增加。

formal.mt: Tul is-snin, in-negozjant ssemmen bil-kummerċ u xtara diversi proprjetajiet.
formal.en: Over the years, the merchant became wealthy through trade and bought several properties.
formal.zh: 多年来，这位商人通过贸易积累财富，并购置了多处房产。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-qattus ssemmen ħafna dan l-aħħar. Rita: Veru, u ċ-ċinga tiegħu saret issikkata.
colloquial.en: Mark: The cat has grown much fatter lately. Rita: True, and its collar has become tight.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这只猫最近胖了很多。丽塔：确实，它的项圈都变紧了。

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.zh: 这只猫最近胖了很多。
messages.en: The cat has grown much fatter lately.

messages.speaker: Rita (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, u ċ-ċinga tiegħu saret issikkata.
messages.mt_standard: Veru, u ċ-ċinga tiegħu saret issikkata.
messages.zh: 确实，它的项圈都变紧了。
messages.en: True, and its collar has become tight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个“增加”场景记 ssemmen：身体脂肪增加是长胖，财富增加是变富；这是记忆联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To reduce complexity so that something is easier to understand or carry out.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 减少复杂程度，使事情更容易理解或执行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Inaqqas il-kumplessità biex xi ħaġa tkun aktar faċli biex tinftiehem jew titwettaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 简化；使复杂程度降低，变得更容易理解或操作。

formal.mt: Il-proċess ssemplifika wara li tneħħew żewġ passi bla bżonn.
formal.en: The process became simpler after two unnecessary steps were removed.
formal.zh: 去掉两个不必要的步骤后，流程得到了简化。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ix-xogħol ssemplifika minn meta bdejna nużaw formola waħda. Pawlu: Veru, issa ma rridux nimlew tliet formoli differenti.
colloquial.en: Sara: The work has become simpler since we started using one form. Pawlu: True, now we don't have to fill in three different forms.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：自从开始只用一张表格，工作就变简单了。保罗：确实，现在不用填写三张不同的表格了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ix-xogħol ssemplifika minn meta bdejna nużaw formola waħda.
messages.mt_standard: Ix-xogħol ssemplifika minn meta bdejna nużaw formola waħda.
messages.zh: 自从开始只用一张表格，工作就变简单了。
messages.en: The work has become simpler since we started using one form.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, issa ma rridux nimlew tliet formoli differenti.
messages.mt_standard: Veru, issa ma rridux nimlew tliet formoli differenti.
messages.zh: 确实，现在不用填写三张不同的表格了。
messages.en: True, now we don't have to fill in three different forms.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ssemplifika 和“三张表格合成一张”的画面配对：步骤更少、操作更容易，就是简化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become hard, especially when bread or another baked food loses its softness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指面包或其他烘焙食品失去原有的松软，变得坚硬。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir iebes, speċjalment meta l-ħobż jew ikel ieħor moħmi jitlef l-irtubija tiegħu.

sense_translations.en_definition: to harden (used of bread or other baking)
sense_translations.zh_definition: （指面包或其他烘焙食品）变硬。

formal.mt: Il-ħobż ssenneġ wara li tħalla barra mill-borża matul il-lejl.
formal.en: The bread hardened after being left out of the bag overnight.
formal.zh: 面包放在袋子外过了一夜，变硬了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-ħobż għadu artab? Pawlu: Le, ssenneġ. Aħjar nieħdu ħobż frisk.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this bread still soft? Pawlu: No, it has hardened. We'd better get fresh bread.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这面包还软吗？保罗：不软了，已经变硬了。我们还是拿新鲜面包吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.zh: 这面包还软吗？
messages.en: Is this bread still soft?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ssenneġ. Aħjar nieħdu ħobż frisk.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ssenneġ. Aħjar nieħdu ħobż frisk.
messages.zh: 不软了，已经变硬了。我们还是拿新鲜面包吧。
messages.en: No, it has hardened. We'd better get fresh bread.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象昨天的软面包今天一按就硬：把 ssenneġ 和“烘焙食品失去松软”一起记。

gloss_zh: 被串起；连成链；依次排列

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be strung together, connected in a chain, or arranged in a sequence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指若干东西被串在一起、连接成链，或按一定先后次序排列。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitqiegħed fuq ħajta, jingħaqad f'katina, jew jitqiegħed f'ordni wieħed wara l-ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被穿在一起；被串起来。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be linked up in a chain
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被连接成链；环环相连。
被按先后次序排列；被编排成序列。

formal.mt: Il-kurall ssensel fuq ħajta biex saret ġiżirana.
formal.en: The coral was strung on a thread to make a necklace.
formal.zh: 珊瑚被穿在线上，做成了一条项链。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Il-kurall għadu fil-kaxxa? Mark: Le, diġà ssensel fuq ħajta. Il-ġiżirana kważi lesta.
colloquial.en: Rita: Is the coral still in the box? Mark: No, it has already been strung on a thread. The necklace is almost ready.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：珊瑚还在盒子里吗？马克：不在了，已经穿在线上了。项链快做好了。

messages.speaker: Rita (手工课学员)
messages.zh: 珊瑚还在盒子里吗？
messages.en: Is the coral still in the box?

messages.speaker: Mark (手工课同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, diġà ssensel fuq ħajta. Il-ġiżirana kważi lesta.
messages.mt_standard: Le, diġà ssensel fuq ħajta. Il-ġiżirana kważi lesta.
messages.zh: 不在了，已经穿在线上了。项链快做好了。
messages.en: No, it has already been strung on a thread. The necklace is almost ready.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个连续画面记 ssensel：珠子穿线、链环相连、卡片排序，共同点都是“一个接一个”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To formally declare the punishment that a court imposes on someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由法庭正式宣布对某人判处的刑罚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti sentenza li tistabbilixxi l-piena ta' persuna fil-qorti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宣判；对某人判处刑罚。

collocations.en: sentenced the offender to two years in prison

formal.mt: L-imħallef ssentenzja lill-ħati għal sentejn ħabs.
formal.en: The judge sentenced the offender to two years in prison.
formal.zh: 法官判处罪犯两年监禁。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'ġara fil-qorti llum? David: L-imħallef ssentenzja lill-ħati għal sentejn ħabs.
colloquial.en: Anna: What happened in court today? David: The judge sentenced the offender to two years in prison.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：今天法庭上发生了什么？戴维：法官判处罪犯两年监禁。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 今天法庭上发生了什么？
messages.en: What happened in court today?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-imħallef ssentenzja lill-ħati għal sentejn ħabs.
messages.mt_standard: L-imħallef ssentenzja lill-ħati għal sentejn ħabs.
messages.zh: 法官判处罪犯两年监禁。
messages.en: The judge sentenced the offender to two years in prison.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ssentenzja 放进“法官宣布刑罚”的画面，连着记“判谁”与“判多少年”两个信息。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To separate people or things from one another, or to become separate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人或事物彼此分开，或与他人、其他事物分离。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jifred nies jew affarijiet minn xulxin, jew jinfired minn xi ħadd jew minn xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 分开；分离；使彼此分开。

formal.mt: Waqt iż-żjara, wieħed mill-parteċipanti ssepara mill-grupp u mar lura lejn id-daħla.
formal.en: During the visit, one of the participants separated from the group and went back towards the entrance.
formal.zh: 参观期间，一名参与者离开队伍，返回入口处。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn mar Pawlu? Toni: Ssepara mill-grupp biex jixtri l-ilma. Se niltaqgħu miegħu ħdejn id-daħla.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did Pawlu go? Toni: He separated from the group to buy water. We'll meet him near the entrance.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗去哪儿了？托尼：他离开队伍去买水了。我们会在入口附近跟他碰面。

messages.speaker: Maja (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did Pawlu go?

messages.speaker: Toni (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ssepara mill-grupp biex jixtri l-ilma. Se niltaqgħu miegħu ħdejn id-daħla.
messages.mt_standard: Ssepara mill-grupp biex jixtri l-ilma. Se niltaqgħu miegħu ħdejn id-daħla.
messages.zh: 他离开队伍去买水了。我们会在入口附近跟他碰面。
messages.en: He separated from the group to buy water. We'll meet him near the entrance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象原本站在一起的人分向两边，用这个“由合到分”的动作记 ssepara；搭配 minn 记离开谁或什么。

gloss_zh: 摆出傲慢姿态；变得趾高气扬

teaching_sense.en_definition: To adopt a proud, haughty manner towards other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对别人摆出自高自大、傲慢的态度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibda jġib ruħu b'kburija żejda u jittratta lill-oħrajn minn fuq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 摆出傲慢的姿态；表现得趾高气扬。

formal.mt: Wara l-promozzjoni, il-maniġer sserdaq u ma baqax jisma' l-opinjonijiet tal-kollegi.
formal.en: After the promotion, the manager became haughty and stopped listening to his colleagues' opinions.
formal.zh: 升职后，这位经理变得傲慢，不再听取同事的意见。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex Mark qed ikellem lil kulħadd minn fuq? Anna: Minn meta sar kap, sserdaq.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why is Mark talking down to everyone? Anna: Since he became the boss, he has become haughty.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：马克为什么对谁说话都高高在上？安娜：他当了主管以后，就变得趾高气扬了。

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark qed ikellem lil kulħadd minn fuq?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark qed ikellem lil kulħadd minn fuq?
messages.zh: 马克为什么对谁说话都高高在上？
messages.en: Why is Mark talking down to everyone?

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.zh: 他当了主管以后，就变得趾高气扬了。
messages.en: Since he became the boss, he has become haughty.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“升职后昂着头、听不进别人意见”的人物画面记 sserdaq，重点是傲慢的待人姿态。

gloss_zh: 获准休息；得到解脱；被减轻负担

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be allowed to rest or to be relieved of a burden or duty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 得到休息的机会，或因负担、职责被解除而得到解脱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitħalla jistrieħ jew jinħeles minn piż jew minn dmir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 获准休息；得到休息的机会。
得到解脱；被解除负担或职责。

collocations.en: was allowed to rest for a short while
was relieved of the burden of work

formal.mt: Meta wasal il-kollega biex jieħu postu, il-ħaddiem sserraħ għal ftit ħin.
formal.en: When his colleague arrived to take over, the worker was allowed to rest for a short while.
formal.zh: 同事来接替他以后，这名工人得以休息片刻。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu għadu jaħdem? Toni: Le, sserraħ għal ftit. Mark qed jagħmel ix-xogħol minfloku.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is Pawlu still working? Toni: No, he has been given a short rest. Mark is doing the work in his place.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗还在工作吗？托尼：没有，他得到了一点休息时间。马克正在替他干活。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 保罗还在工作吗？
messages.en: Is Pawlu still working?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, sserraħ għal ftit. Mark qed jagħmel ix-xogħol minfloku.
messages.mt_standard: Le, sserraħ għal ftit. Mark qed jagħmel ix-xogħol minfloku.
messages.zh: 没有，他得到了一点休息时间。马克正在替他干活。
messages.en: No, he has been given a short rest. Mark is doing the work in his place.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sserraħ 记成“有人接班，终于能歇一歇”：既可想到获准休息，也可想到卸下负担。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To follow a winding course with repeated bends.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 沿着不断弯曲的路线延伸或行进。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimxi jew jestendi f'mogħdija b'ħafna liwjiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蜿蜒；沿曲折的路线延伸或行进。

formal.mt: Il-passaġġ sserrep bejn l-għoljiet sakemm wasal ħdejn il-baħar.
formal.en: The path wound between the hills until it reached the sea.
formal.zh: 小路在山丘之间蜿蜒，最终延伸到海边。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kif kien il-passaġġ sal-bajja? Rita: Sserrep ħafna bejn is-siġar. Ħadna aktar ħin milli ħsibna.
colloquial.en: Mark: What was the path to the beach like? Rita: It wound a lot between the trees. It took us longer than we expected.
colloquial.zh: 马克：去海滩的小路怎么样？丽塔：它在树木之间绕了好多弯。我们花的时间比预想的长。

messages.speaker: Mark (徒步同伴)
messages.zh: 去海滩的小路怎么样？
messages.en: What was the path to the beach like?

messages.speaker: Rita (徒步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Sserrep ħafna bejn is-siġar. Ħadna aktar ħin milli ħsibna.
messages.mt_standard: Sserrep ħafna bejn is-siġar. Ħadna aktar ħin milli ħsibna.
messages.zh: 它在树木之间绕了好多弯。我们花的时间比预想的长。
messages.en: It wound a lot between the trees. It took us longer than we expected.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画一条连续左右转弯的小路，用这条弯曲路线记 sserrep 的“蜿蜒延伸”。

gloss_zh: 自行取用；自助取食；（委婉语）如厕

teaching_sense.en_definition: To serve oneself or help oneself to something, especially food or drink; also, euphemistically, to use the toilet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 自己取用东西，尤其指自助取食或取饮料；也可委婉地表示如厕。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu l-ikel jew ix-xorb għalih innifsu; jintuża wkoll bħala mod indirett biex jingħad li xi ħadd mar it-tojlit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自行取用；自己为自己盛取食物或饮料。
自行拿取所需的东西；自便取用。

sense_translations.en_definition: to use the loo (a euphemistic usage)
sense_translations.zh_definition: （委婉用法）上厕所；如厕。

collocations.en: helped himself to food from the buffet

collocations.zh: 去了厕所方便（委婉说法）

formal.mt: Waqt il-pawża, kull parteċipant sserva mill-buffet u mbagħad reġa' lura fis-sala.
formal.en: During the break, each participant helped themselves to food from the buffet and then returned to the hall.
formal.zh: 休息期间，每位参与者都在自助餐台取了食物，然后返回大厅。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Mark għadu ma kielx? Rita: Iva, diġà sserva mill-buffet. Issa qiegħed jiekol ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Anna: Has Mark not eaten yet? Rita: Yes, he's already helped himself to food from the buffet. He's eating by the window now.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：马克还没吃东西吗？丽塔：他已经在自助餐台取了食物，现在正坐在窗边吃呢。

messages.speaker: Anna (聚会来宾)
messages.zh: 马克还没吃东西吗？
messages.en: Has Mark not eaten yet?

messages.speaker: Rita (聚会主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, diġà sserva mill-buffet. Issa qiegħed jiekol ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, diġà sserva mill-buffet. Issa qiegħed jiekol ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.zh: 他已经在自助餐台取了食物，现在正坐在窗边吃呢。
messages.en: Yes, he's already helped himself to food from the buffet. He's eating by the window now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“端着盘子自己取餐”记 sserva 的自助义；遇到厕所语境，再切换到委婉的“方便一下”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be spread out over a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指布料等被展开、铺开在某个表面上。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li xi ħaġa tinfirex fuq wiċċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被铺开；被展开。

collocations.en: The cloth was spread over the table.
The carpet was spread out on the floor.

formal.mt: Qabel bdiet l-attività, id-drapp ssettaħ fuq il-mejda biex jipproteġi l-wiċċ tagħha.
formal.en: Before the activity began, the cloth was spread over the table to protect its surface.
formal.zh: 活动开始前，桌面上铺好了布，以保护桌子的表面。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu t-tapit il-ġdid? Pawlu: Ssettaħ mal-art fil-kamra tas-salott.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the new carpet? Pawlu: It has been spread out on the living room floor.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：新地毯在哪里？保罗：已经铺在客厅地板上了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 新地毯在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the new carpet?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 已经铺在客厅地板上了。
messages.en: It has been spread out on the living room floor.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一块布从折叠状态变成铺满桌面，用这个画面记住“被铺开”。

gloss_zh: 被修好；被修补；得到赎罪补偿；被阉割

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be repaired or mended so that something damaged becomes usable again.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指损坏的东西被修理或修补，恢复可使用的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li xi ħaġa bil-ħsara tissewwa u terġa' tkun tista' tintuża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被修理；被修好。
被修补；破损处得到补好。
指过错或罪过得到补赎。
指雄性动物被阉割。

formal.mt: Il-bieb ssewwa wara li nstabet ħsara fis-serratura.
formal.en: The door was repaired after a fault was found in the lock.
formal.zh: 发现门锁有故障后，门得到了修理。

colloquial.mt: Lara: L-arloġġ għadu ma jaħdimx? Mark: Le, ssewwa lbieraħ u issa jaħdem tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is the clock still not working? Mark: No, it was repaired yesterday and now it works well.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：钟还是不能用吗？马克：不是，昨天修好了，现在走得很好。

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.zh: 钟还是不能用吗？
messages.en: Is the clock still not working?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ssewwa lbieraħ u issa jaħdem tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ssewwa lbieraħ u issa jaħdem tajjeb.
messages.zh: 不是，昨天修好了，现在走得很好。
messages.en: No, it was repaired yesterday and now it works well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“坏钟修好、破衣补好”记住常用义；补赎与动物阉割两个义项另配场景记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To turn black or become darker in colour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指物体的颜色变黑，或比原来的颜色更深。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li xi ħaġa ssir sewda jew tieħu kulur aktar skur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变黑；呈现黑色。

sense_translations.en_definition: to become of a darker colour
sense_translations.zh_definition: 颜色变深；变得更暗。

collocations.en: The bread turned black in the oven.
The wall turned black from the smoke.

formal.mt: Il-ħajt ta' fuq il-fuklar ssewwed minħabba d-duħħan.
formal.en: The wall above the stove turned black because of the smoke.
formal.zh: 炉灶上方的墙由于烟熏而变黑了。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex ħriġt il-ħobż mill-forn? Toni: Għax ssewwed minn taħt.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did you take the bread out of the oven? Toni: Because it turned black underneath.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么把面包从烤箱里拿出来了？托尼：因为底部烤黑了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把面包从烤箱里拿出来了？
messages.en: Why did you take the bread out of the oven?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 因为底部烤黑了。
messages.en: Because it turned black underneath.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象面包在烤箱中由浅变深直到发黑，把这个颜色变化过程与词义相连。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become damaged by worms or wood-boring insects eating into the material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指木材等材料受到虫子蛀食，出现孔洞或损坏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li materjal, bħall-injam, jittiekel mid-dud u ssirlu ħsara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得虫蛀；因虫子蛀食而受损。

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni nstab li l-injam tas-saqaf ssewwes u kien jeħtieġ jinbidel.
formal.en: During the inspection, the roof timber was found to have become worm-eaten and to need replacement.
formal.zh: 检查时发现，屋顶木料已经虫蛀，需要更换。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex hemm dawn it-toqob żgħar fil-bieb? Ġanni: L-injam ssewwes; irridu nsejħu mastrudaxxa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are there these little holes in the door? Ġanni: The wood has become worm-eaten; we need to call a carpenter.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：门上为什么有这些小洞？詹尼：木头被虫蛀了，我们得找个木匠。

messages.speaker: Sara (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm dawn it-toqob żgħar fil-bieb?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm dawn it-toqob żgħar fil-bieb?
messages.zh: 门上为什么有这些小洞？
messages.en: Why are there these little holes in the door?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (家人)
messages.zh: 木头被虫蛀了，我们得找个木匠。
messages.en: The wood has become worm-eaten; we need to call a carpenter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把旧木门上密密的小虫孔当作记忆图像，看到孔洞就联想到“变得虫蛀”。

gloss_zh: 四处游荡；漫无目的地走动

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wander from place to place without a clear destination.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指没有明确目的地，在不同地方随意走动或游荡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jimxi minn post għal ieħor mingħajr destinazzjoni ċara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 四处游荡；没有明确目的地地走来走去。

formal.mt: Il-vjaġġatur ssiefaħ fit-toroq tal-belt għal siegħa qabel irritorna lejn il-lukanda.
formal.en: The traveller wandered about the city streets for an hour before returning to the hotel.
formal.zh: 那位旅客在城里的街道上闲逛了一个小时，随后返回酒店。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn mar Pawlu wara l-ikel? Lara: Ssiefaħ ftit fil-belt, imbagħad ġie lura.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did Pawlu go after the meal? Lara: He wandered about town for a while, then came back.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗吃完饭去哪儿了？拉拉：他在城里随意逛了一会儿，然后就回来了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗吃完饭去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did Pawlu go after the meal?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ssiefaħ ftit fil-belt, imbagħad ġie lura.
messages.mt_standard: Ssiefaħ ftit fil-belt, imbagħad ġie lura.
messages.zh: 他在城里随意逛了一会儿，然后就回来了。
messages.en: He wandered about town for a while, then came back.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象地图上没有终点、只有随意绕行的脚印，用来记住“四处游荡”的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lean against something for support.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指身体靠在墙、树等物体上，借其支撑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jistrieħ b'ġismu ma' xi ħaġa biex isostni ruħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倚靠某物；把身体靠在某物上。

formal.mt: Wara l-mixja twila, il-vjaġġatur ssiegħen ma' siġra biex jistrieħ għal ftit.
formal.en: After the long walk, the traveller leaned against a tree to rest for a while.
formal.zh: 长途步行后，那位旅客靠着一棵树休息了一会儿。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn hu Mark? Toni: Hemm ħdejn il-bieb; ssiegħen mal-ħajt għax għajjien.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where is Mark? Toni: Over there by the door; he leaned against the wall because he is tired.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：马克在哪里？托尼：就在门边，他累了，便靠在墙上。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Mark?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm ħdejn il-bieb; ssiegħen mal-ħajt għax għajjien.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm ħdejn il-bieb; ssiegħen mal-ħajt għax għajjien.
messages.zh: 就在门边，他累了，便靠在墙上。
messages.en: Over there by the door; he leaned against the wall because he is tired.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象走累后把背靠在墙上，让墙分担身体重量，以此记住“倚靠某物”。

gloss_zh: 挣扎；奋力应对；努力抗争

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a strong effort against difficulty or resistance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指面对困难或阻力时奋力挣扎、努力应对或抗争。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jagħmel sforz qawwi biex jegħleb diffikultà jew reżistenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 挣扎；奋力克服困难或抵抗阻力。

formal.mt: Il-baħri ssielet kontra r-riħ qawwi biex iżomm id-dgħajsa qrib ix-xatt.
formal.en: The sailor struggled against the strong wind to keep the boat close to the shore.
formal.zh: 那名水手奋力抵抗强风，努力让小船保持在岸边附近。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif mar l-eżami ta' Pawlu? Mark: Ssielet mal-aħħar mistoqsija, imma fl-aħħar sab it-tweġiba.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did Pawlu's exam go? Mark: He struggled with the last question, but eventually found the answer.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗考得怎么样？马克：最后一道题让他费了很大劲，不过最后还是找到了答案。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 保罗考得怎么样？
messages.en: How did Pawlu's exam go?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ssielet mal-aħħar mistoqsija, imma fl-aħħar sab it-tweġiba.
messages.mt_standard: Ssielet mal-aħħar mistoqsija, imma fl-aħħar sab it-tweġiba.
messages.zh: 最后一道题让他费了很大劲，不过最后还是找到了答案。
messages.en: He struggled with the last question, but eventually found the answer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象顶着强风一步步前进，再联想到费力解题；两种画面都突出“遇到阻力仍努力”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To spend time relaxing or enjoying recreational activities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 花时间放松身心或参加休闲娱乐活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qatta' ħin jistrieħ jew jieħu pjaċir b'attivitajiet ta' rikreazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 花时间消遣或进行休闲娱乐活动。

collocations.en: spent leisure time by the sea

formal.mt: Wara ġimgħa ta' xogħol, Pawlu ssieraħ fil-kampanja mal-familja tiegħu.
formal.en: After a week of work, Pawlu spent leisure time in the countryside with his family.
formal.zh: 工作一周后，保罗与家人到乡间休闲。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel Pawlu l-Ħadd? Lara: Ssieraħ ħdejn il-baħar mal-ħbieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did Pawlu do on Sunday? Lara: He spent some leisure time by the sea with friends.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗星期天做了什么？拉拉：他和朋友在海边休闲。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗星期天做了什么？
messages.en: What did Pawlu do on Sunday?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他和朋友在海边休闲。
messages.en: He spent some leisure time by the sea with friends.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和“忙完一周，去海边与朋友放松”的画面绑定，记住它强调把时间用来休闲消遣。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To curse repeatedly, saying curses again and again.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指接连说出咒骂或诅咒的话，强调反复发生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jisħet darba wara l-oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反复咒骂；一再诅咒。

collocations.en: kept cursing for a long time

formal.mt: Meta sar jaf bil-ħsara, ir-raġel ssieħet bir-rabja u mbagħad ħareġ mill-kamra.
formal.en: When he learned about the damage, the man cursed repeatedly in anger and then left the room.
formal.zh: 得知损坏的情况后，那名男子愤怒地连声咒骂，随后离开了房间。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'għamel Toni meta tilef iċ-ċwievet? Ġanni: Ss ieħet għal ftit, imbagħad beda jfittixhom.
colloquial.en: Sara: What did Toni do when he lost his keys? Ġanni: He cursed repeatedly for a while, then started looking for them.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：托尼丢了钥匙以后做了什么？詹尼：他连着咒骂了一阵，然后开始找钥匙。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 托尼丢了钥匙以后做了什么？
messages.en: What did Toni do when he lost his keys?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ssieħet għal ftit, imbagħad beda jfittixhom.
messages.mt_standard: Ssieħet għal ftit, imbagħad beda jfittixhom.
messages.zh: 他连着咒骂了一阵，然后开始找钥匙。
messages.en: He cursed repeatedly for a while, then started looking for them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把一个接一个冒出的愤怒对话框连成画面，记住这个词强调“反复咒骂”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made to stop speaking or making a sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因他人的行为或外在因素而停止说话或发声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġie mġiegħel jieqaf jitkellem jew jagħmel ħoss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被迫停止说话或发声；被压制而沉默。

collocations.zh: 因受到威胁而被迫沉默

collocations.en: was silenced by the crowd's shouting
collocations.zh: 被人群的喊叫声压得无法继续说话

formal.mt: Il-kelliem ssikket bl-għajjat tal-folla u ma setax ikompli d-diskors tiegħu.
formal.en: The speaker was silenced by the crowd's shouting and could not continue his speech.
formal.zh: 演讲者被人群的喊叫声压得无法继续讲话。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex waqaf jitkellem il-kelliem? Mark: Ssikket bl-għajjat tal-folla; ħadd ma seta' jisimgħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the speaker stop talking? Mark: He was silenced by the crowd's shouting; nobody could hear him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：演讲者为什么停止讲话了？马克：人群的喊叫声把他的声音压下去了，谁也听不见他说话。

messages.speaker: Maja (观众)
messages.zh: 演讲者为什么停止讲话了？
messages.en: Why did the speaker stop talking?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行观众)
messages.mt_spoken: Ssikket bl-għajjat tal-folla; ħadd ma seta' jisimgħu.
messages.mt_standard: Ssikket bl-għajjat tal-folla; ħadd ma seta' jisimgħu.
messages.zh: 人群的喊叫声把他的声音压下去了，谁也听不见他说话。
messages.en: He was silenced by the crowd's shouting; nobody could hear him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个正在讲话的人被周围的喊声迫使停下，用“声音被压下去”的场景记住这个被动意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To divide a word into syllables or pronounce it syllable by syllable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把一个词分成音节，或逐个音节地读出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qasam kelma f'sillabi jew lissen kull sillaba tagħha separatament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把词划分成音节；按音节逐一读出。

collocations.en: pronounced the name slowly, syllable by syllable
collocations.zh: 逐个音节慢慢读出名字

formal.mt: L-għalliem ssillaba l-kelma fuq il-bord biex juri lill-istudenti kif tinqasam f'sillabi.
formal.en: The teacher divided the word on the board into syllables to show the students how it is segmented.
formal.zh: 老师把黑板上的词划分成音节，向学生展示它的音节划分方式。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif irnexxielu jaqra dik il-kelma twila? Ben: L-ewwel ssillaba l-kelma, imbagħad qaraha kollha.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did he manage to read that long word? Ben: First he sounded it out syllable by syllable, then he read the whole word.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：他是怎么读出那个长词的？本：他先逐个音节读，再把整个词读出来。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif irnexxielu jaqra dik il-kelma twila?
messages.mt_standard: Kif irnexxielu jaqra dik il-kelma twila?
messages.zh: 他是怎么读出那个长词的？
messages.en: How did he manage to read that long word?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ewwel ssillaba l-kelma, imbagħad qaraha kollha.
messages.mt_standard: L-ewwel ssillaba l-kelma, imbagħad qaraha kollha.
messages.zh: 他先逐个音节读，再把整个词读出来。
messages.en: First he sounded it out syllable by syllable, then he read the whole word.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象读长词时每读一个音节就拍一下手：一拍一节，帮助记住“划分音节、逐节读出”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To show or depict something as a dark outline against a lighter background.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以较亮的背景衬出物体的暗色轮廓，或把物体表现为剪影。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wera jew pinġa xi ħaġa bħala għamla skura fuq sfond aktar ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把人或物表现为剪影；以明亮背景衬出暗色轮廓。

collocations.en: silhouetted the tree against the sky
collocations.zh: 以天空为背景表现树木的剪影

collocations.en: depicted the figure in silhouette against a light background
collocations.zh: 在浅色背景上表现人物的剪影

formal.mt: Il-fotografu ssilwetta s-siġra kontra s-sema ta' filgħaxija, u b'hekk enfasizza l-għamla tal-friegħi.
formal.en: The photographer silhouetted the tree against the evening sky, thereby emphasizing the shape of its branches.
formal.zh: 摄影师以傍晚的天空为背景拍出树的剪影，从而突出枝条的形状。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ma jidhrux id-dettalji tas-siġra? Mark: Il-fotografu ssilwetta s-siġra apposta; ried juri biss l-għamla tagħha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why can't we see the details of the tree? Mark: The photographer deliberately silhouetted it; he wanted to show only its shape.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：为什么看不见树的细节？马克：摄影师特意把树拍成了剪影，只想表现它的形状。

messages.speaker: Lara (摄影课学生)
messages.zh: 为什么看不见树的细节？
messages.en: Why can't we see the details of the tree?

messages.speaker: Mark (摄影课同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-fotografu ssilwetta s-siġra apposta; ried juri biss l-għamla tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Il-fotografu ssilwetta s-siġra apposta; ried juri biss l-għamla tagħha.
messages.zh: 摄影师特意把树拍成了剪影，只想表现它的形状。
messages.en: The photographer deliberately silhouetted it; he wanted to show only its shape.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象夕阳前的一棵黑树：看得到轮廓，看不到内部细节，用这幅画面记住“表现为剪影”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To represent something through an emblem or symbol, or to stand for an idea.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用徽记或符号表现某事物，或作为某种观念的象征。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Irrappreżenta xi ħaġa permezz ta' emblema jew simbolu, jew serva bħala simbolu ta' idea.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用徽记或标志表现某事物；使其获得象征性的表现。
象征；以符号、形象或事物代表某种意义。

collocations.en: represented courage through the emblem of a lion
collocations.zh: 用狮子的标志表现勇气

formal.mt: Fid-disinn tal-emblema, l-artist ssimboleġġa l-kuraġġ b'iljun u l-għaqda b'ċirku.
formal.en: In the emblem's design, the artist represented courage with a lion and unity with a circle.
formal.zh: 在徽记设计中，艺术家用狮子表现勇气，用圆环表现团结。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex hemm iljun fuq l-emblema? Ben: Id-disinjatur ssimboleġġa l-kuraġġ b'dak l-iljun.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is there a lion on the emblem? Ben: The designer used that lion to symbolize courage.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：徽记上为什么有一头狮子？本：设计师用那头狮子象征勇气。

messages.speaker: Sara (参观者)
messages.zh: 徽记上为什么有一头狮子？
messages.en: Why is there a lion on the emblem?

messages.speaker: Ben (导览员)
messages.zh: 设计师用那头狮子象征勇气。
messages.en: The designer used that lion to symbolize courage.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“抽象的勇气”画成徽记中的狮子：由观念想到图形，帮助同时记住“用标志表现”和“象征”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To represent an idea, quality, or feeling through a symbol or meaningful image.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过符号或具有特定意义的形象，代表某种观念、品质或情感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Irrappreżenta idea, kwalità jew sentiment permezz ta' simbolu jew xbieha b'tifsira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 象征；通过某种符号、形象或事物代表另一层意义。

formal.mt: Fil-pittura, il-bieb miftuħ ssimbolizza bidu ġdid għall-familja.
formal.en: In the painting, the open door symbolized a new beginning for the family.
formal.zh: 在这幅画中，敞开的门象征着这个家庭的新开始。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex l-artist pinġa bieb miftuħ? Lara: B'dak il-bieb ssimbolizza bidu ġdid.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the artist paint an open door? Lara: He used that door to symbolize a new beginning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：艺术家为什么画了一扇敞开的门？拉拉：他用那扇门象征新的开始。

messages.speaker: Maja (美术课学生)
messages.zh: 艺术家为什么画了一扇敞开的门？
messages.en: Why did the artist paint an open door?

messages.speaker: Lara (美术课同学)
messages.zh: 他用那扇门象征新的开始。
messages.en: He used that door to symbolize a new beginning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给画中的敞开大门贴上“新的开始”这张意义标签，用“具体画面代表抽象意义”记住象征。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To join or secure something with cement, or figuratively to make a relationship or arrangement stronger.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用水泥连接或固定物体，也可比喻使关系或安排更加牢固。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għaqqad jew waħħal xi ħaġa bis-siment, jew, b'mod figurattiv, saħħaħ rabta jew ftehim.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用水泥黏合或固定；比喻巩固关系、合作或协议。

collocations.en: cemented the posts into the ground
collocations.zh: 用水泥把立柱固定在地里

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem ssimenta l-lasti fl-art biex iċ-ċint jibqa' sod.
formal.en: The worker cemented the posts into the ground so that the fence would remain firm.
formal.zh: 工人用水泥把立柱固定在地里，使围栏保持稳固。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-lasti għadhom jiċċaqalqu? Ben: Le, il-ħaddiem ssimenta l-lasti fl-art, u issa huma sodi.
colloquial.en: Mark: Are the posts still moving? Ben: No, the worker cemented them into the ground, and now they're firm.
colloquial.zh: 马克：立柱还在晃吗？本：不晃了，工人用水泥把它们固定在地里，现在很稳。

messages.speaker: Mark (屋主)
messages.zh: 立柱还在晃吗？
messages.en: Are the posts still moving?

messages.speaker: Ben (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, il-ħaddiem ssimenta l-lasti fl-art, u issa huma sodi.
messages.mt_standard: Le, il-ħaddiem ssimenta l-lasti fl-art, u issa huma sodi.
messages.zh: 不晃了，工人用水泥把它们固定在地里，现在很稳。
messages.en: No, the worker cemented them into the ground, and now they're firm.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想水泥凝固后把立柱牢牢固定，再把这幅画面用于关系：让关系像固定好的柱子一样牢固。

gloss_zh: 产生好感；表示同情或认同

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel a liking for someone, or to understand and share another person's feelings or position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人产生好感，或理解并体谅他人的感受、认同其处境或立场。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħass simpatija lejn xi ħadd, jew fehem u qasam is-sentimenti jew il-pożizzjoni ta' persuna oħra.

sense_translations.en_definition: to have a liking, to sympathize
sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某人有好感；同情、体谅他人的感受或认同其立场。

collocations.en: felt a liking for the new colleague

formal.mt: Wara li sema' dwar id-diffikultajiet tagħhom, id-direttur ssimpatizza mal-familja u offra l-għajnuna tiegħu.
formal.en: After hearing about their difficulties, the director sympathized with the family and offered his help.
formal.zh: 听说他们的困难后，主任对这个家庭表示同情，并主动提供帮助。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif mar Ben mal-kollega l-ġdid? Maja: Ssimpatizza miegħu mill-ewwel; it-tnejn iħobbu l-mużika.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did Ben get on with the new colleague? Maja: He took a liking to him straight away; they both love music.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：本和新同事相处得怎么样？玛雅：他一下子就对那位同事有了好感，两个人都喜欢音乐。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 本和新同事相处得怎么样？
messages.en: How did Ben get on with the new colleague?

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ssimpatizza miegħu mill-ewwel; it-tnejn iħobbu l-mużika.
messages.mt_standard: Ssimpatizza miegħu mill-ewwel; it-tnejn iħobbu l-mużika.
messages.zh: 他一下子就对那位同事有了好感，两个人都喜欢音乐。
messages.en: He took a liking to him straight away; they both love music.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个相连的场景记忆：兴趣相投时心生好感，听到困难时设身处地；共同点是情感上靠近对方。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To combine separate elements or ideas into a coherent whole.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把不同的成分、资料或观点结合起来，形成一个有条理的整体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħaqqad elementi, informazzjoni jew ideat differenti biex jifforma ħaġa waħda koerenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 综合不同资料或观点；把不同成分合成为一个整体。

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur ssintetizza r-riżultati ta' diversi studji f'rapport wieħed.
formal.en: The researcher synthesized the findings of several studies in one report.
formal.zh: 研究人员把多项研究的结果综合成一份报告。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandna ħafna ideat. Tista' tissintetizzahom? Mark: Iva, ngħaqqadhom fi pjan wieħed ċar.
colloquial.en: Lara: We have lots of ideas. Can you synthesize them? Mark: Yes, I'll combine them into one clear plan.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们有很多想法。你能把它们综合起来吗？马克：可以，我会把它们整合成一个清晰的计划。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 我们有很多想法。你能把它们综合起来吗？
messages.en: We have lots of ideas. Can you synthesize them?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ngħaqqadhom fi pjan wieħed ċar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ngħaqqadhom fi pjan wieħed ċar.
messages.zh: 可以，我会把它们整合成一个清晰的计划。
messages.en: Yes, I'll combine them into one clear plan.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把散落的想法卡片拼成一张完整图，联想这个词的“综合、合成”义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To drink a liquid slowly in small mouthfuls.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 每次只喝一小口，慢慢饮用液体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jixrob likwidu bil-mod, ftit kull darba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小口地喝；慢慢啜饮。

formal.mt: Il-mistieden ssippja t-te waqt li sema' d-diskors.
formal.en: The guest sipped the tea while listening to the speech.
formal.zh: 客人一边听演讲，一边小口喝茶。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-te għadu jaħraq. Ssippja ftit kull darba. Pawlu: Tajjeb, se nixorbu bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Maja: The tea is still hot. Sip a little at a time. Pawlu: Okay, I'll drink it slowly.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：茶还很烫。每次小口喝一点。保罗：好，我会慢慢喝。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-te għadu jaħraq. Ssippja ftit kull darba.
messages.mt_standard: It-te għadu jaħraq. Ssippja ftit kull darba.
messages.zh: 茶还很烫。每次小口喝一点。
messages.en: The tea is still hot. Sip a little at a time.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我会慢慢喝。
messages.en: Okay, I'll drink it slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一杯烫茶，只能轻轻喝一小口，用这个动作记住“啜饮”。

gloss_zh: 使系统化；有条理地整理

teaching_sense.en_definition: To organize information, materials, or procedures according to a clear system.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按照清晰的体系整理资料、物品或程序，使其有条理。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jorganizza informazzjoni, materjal jew proċeduri skont sistema ċara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使系统化；按照统一而有条理的体系加以整理。

formal.mt: L-amministratur ssistematizza r-rekords biex ikun aktar faċli li tinstab l-informazzjoni.
formal.en: The administrator systematized the records to make information easier to find.
formal.zh: 管理员对记录进行了系统整理，以便更容易查找资料。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ma nista' nsib xejn f'dawn il-fajls. Tista' tissistematizzahom? Daniel: Iva, nirranġahom skont is-suġġett u d-data.
colloquial.en: Sara: I can't find anything in these files. Can you systematize them? Daniel: Yes, I'll organize them by subject and date.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这些文件里我什么都找不到。你能系统整理一下吗？丹尼尔：可以，我会按主题和日期整理。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)

messages.mt_standard: Ma nista' nsib xejn f'dawn il-fajls. Tista' tissistematizzahom?
messages.zh: 这些文件里我什么都找不到。你能系统整理一下吗？

messages.mt_standard: Iva, nirranġahom skont is-suġġett u d-data.
messages.zh: 可以，我会按主题和日期整理。
messages.en: Yes, I'll organize them by subject and date.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把杂乱文件放进带标签的抽屉，重点记住“建立体系、整理有序”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To engage in anal intercourse with another person as the penetrating partner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为插入方与另一人进行肛交。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu x'jaqsam sesswalment ma' persuna oħra billi jippenetra l-anus tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某人实施肛交。

formal.mt: Il-glossarju jiddefinixxi l-verb 'ssodomizza' bħala li jippenetra l-anus ta' persuna oħra waqt att sesswali.
formal.en: The glossary defines the verb 'ssodomizza' as penetrating another person's anus during a sexual act.
formal.zh: 词汇表将动词“ssodomizza”定义为在性行为中插入另一人的肛门。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Xi jfisser 'ssodomizza' f'din is-sentenza? David: Ifisser li jagħmel sess anali ma' persuna oħra bħala l-parti li tippenetra.
colloquial.en: Anna: What does 'ssodomizza' mean in this sentence? David: It means to have anal sex with another person as the penetrating partner.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这句话里的“ssodomizza”是什么意思？戴维：意思是作为插入方与另一人进行肛交。

messages.en: What does 'ssodomizza' mean in this sentence?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用中性的词义卡记忆：这是及物动词，表示对某人实施肛交，后接行为对象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To keep doing something or to carry on without stopping.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 继续做某件事，或使某项活动持续进行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikompli jagħmel xi ħaġa jew jibqa' għaddej mingħajr ma jieqaf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 继续做某件事。
继续；持续进行下去。

formal.mt: Il-kelliem ssokta jispjega l-proposta wara l-waqfa.
formal.en: The speaker continued explaining the proposal after the break.
formal.zh: 休息结束后，发言人继续解释这项提案。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadni ma spiċċajtx il-kapitlu. Pawlu: Ssokta aqra, mela. Nistenna sakemm tispiċċa.
colloquial.en: Maja: I haven't finished the chapter yet. Pawlu: Keep reading, then. I'll wait until you finish.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我还没读完这一章。保罗：那就继续读吧。我等你读完。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我还没读完这一章。
messages.en: I haven't finished the chapter yet.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
