messages.mt_standard: Ssokta aqra, mela. Nistenna sakemm tispiċċa.
messages.zh: 那就继续读吧。我等你读完。
messages.en: Keep reading, then. I'll wait until you finish.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象阅读时把书签往后移动，动作没有停下，帮助记住“继续做下去”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For a problem, dispute, or mystery to receive a solution or resolution.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指问题、争议或谜团得到解决或被解开。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tinstab soluzzjoni għal problema, tilwima jew misteru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被解决；得到解决；被解开。

formal.mt: Il-każ issolva wara li ġiet eżaminata l-evidenza kollha.
formal.en: The case was solved after all the evidence had been examined.
formal.zh: 在审查全部证据后，这起案件得到了解决。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dak il-misteru fl-istorja fl-aħħar issolva? Mark: Iva, fl-aħħar kapitlu sar ċar min ħa ċ-ċavetta.
colloquial.en: Lara: Was that mystery in the story finally solved? Mark: Yes, in the last chapter it became clear who took the key.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：故事里的那个谜团终于解开了吗？马克：是的，最后一章交代清楚了是谁拿走钥匙。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 故事里的那个谜团终于解开了吗？
messages.en: Was that mystery in the story finally solved?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, fl-aħħar kapitlu sar ċar min ħa ċ-ċavetta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, fl-aħħar kapitlu sar ċar min ħa ċ-ċavetta.
messages.zh: 是的，最后一章交代清楚了是谁拿走钥匙。
messages.en: Yes, in the last chapter it became clear who took the key.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象谜团自己挂上“已解决”的牌子，记住这里强调问题得到解决的结果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To add numbers or amounts together to find their total.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把若干数字或金额相加，算出总数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħodd numri jew ammonti flimkien biex isib it-total tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把数字或数量加起来；加总，合计。

formal.mt: Il-kontabilist ssomma l-ispejjeż kollha biex jikkalkula t-total ta' kull xahar.
formal.en: The accountant added up all the expenses to calculate the monthly total.
formal.zh: 会计把所有费用相加，以计算每月的费用总额。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tista' tissomma dawn l-ammonti? Daniel: Iva. Għaxra u ħmistax jagħmlu ħamsa u għoxrin ewro.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can you add up these amounts? Daniel: Yes. Ten and fifteen make twenty-five euros.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你能把这些金额加起来吗？丹尼尔：可以。十加十五，一共是二十五欧元。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 你能把这些金额加起来吗？
messages.en: Can you add up these amounts?

messages.speaker: Daniel (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva. Għaxra u ħmistax jagħmlu ħamsa u għoxrin ewro.
messages.mt_standard: Iva. Għaxra u ħmistax jagħmlu ħamsa u għoxrin ewro.
messages.zh: 可以。十加十五，一共是二十五欧元。
messages.en: Yes. Ten and fifteen make twenty-five euros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把小票上的每笔金额用加号连起来，最后画线写总数，记住“加总”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To restrain or forcibly stop an activity, expression, or feeling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 压制或强行阻止某种活动、表达或情感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Trażżan jew twaqqaf attività, espressjoni jew sentiment, xi drabi bil-forza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 压制；镇压；抑制。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif il-gvern ssopprima l-protesti.
formal.en: The report describes how the government suppressed the protests.
formal.zh: 报告描述了政府如何镇压抗议活动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark deher irrabjat waqt il-laqgħa. Lara: Iva, imma ssopprima r-rabja tiegħu u tkellem bil-kalma.
colloquial.en: Maja: Mark looked angry during the meeting. Lara: Yes, but he suppressed his anger and spoke calmly.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克开会时看起来很生气。拉拉：是啊，不过他压住了怒气，平静地说话。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 马克开会时看起来很生气。
messages.en: Mark looked angry during the meeting.

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ssopprima r-rabja tiegħu u tkellem bil-kalma.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ssopprima r-rabja tiegħu u tkellem bil-kalma.
messages.zh: 是啊，不过他压住了怒气，平静地说话。
messages.en: Yes, but he suppressed his anger and spoke calmly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与“把怒气压下去”的画面相连：既可压制外部活动，也可抑制自己的情绪。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To present something for consideration or approval; reflexively, to submit oneself to an authority or decision.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将材料提交审议或批准；反身用法表示使自己服从某个权威或决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tressaq xi ħaġa biex tiġi eżaminata jew approvata; fl-użu riflessiv, taċċetta li tkun taħt awtorità jew deċiżjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 提交；反身用法表示使自己服从、接受支配。

formal.mt: Il-kandidat ssottometta l-applikazzjoni tiegħu qabel id-data tal-għeluq.
formal.en: The candidate submitted his application before the closing date.
formal.zh: 候选人在截止日期前提交了申请。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark bagħat l-applikazzjoni? Lara: Iva, ssottometta kollox ilbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has Mark sent in the application? Lara: Yes, he submitted everything yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克把申请交了吗？拉拉：交了，他昨天把所有材料都提交了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克把申请交了吗？
messages.en: Has Mark sent in the application?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 交了，他昨天把所有材料都提交了。
messages.en: Yes, he submitted everything yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“交出去”串联两种意思：交出申请是提交；让自己接受权威或决定则是服从。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To spend time interacting with other people in a friendly or informal way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以友好或轻松的方式与他人相处、交谈和来往。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqatta' ħin ma' nies oħra, jitkellem magħhom u jagħmilha magħhom b'mod amikevoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 参加社交活动；与他人交往、聊天和相处。

formal.mt: Wara l-konferenza, ir-rappreżentant ssoċjalizza mal-parteċipanti l-oħra.
formal.en: After the conference, the representative socialized with the other participants.
formal.zh: 会议结束后，代表与其他与会者进行了交流。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Trid tiġi magħna llejla? Ikollok ċans tissoċjalizza ftit. Mark: Iva, niġi. Nixtieq niltaqa' ma' nies ġodda.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you want to come with us tonight? You'll have a chance to socialize a little. Mark: Yes, I'll come. I'd like to meet new people.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：今晚想跟我们一起去吗？你可以趁机和大家聊聊。马克：好，我去。我想认识一些新朋友。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tiġi magħna llejla? Ikollok ċans tissoċjalizza ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Trid tiġi magħna llejla? Ikollok ċans tissoċjalizza ftit.
messages.zh: 今晚想跟我们一起去吗？你可以趁机和大家聊聊。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, niġi. Nixtieq niltaqa' ma' nies ġodda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, niġi. Nixtieq niltaqa' ma' nies ġodda.
messages.zh: 好，我去。我想认识一些新朋友。
messages.en: Yes, I'll come. I'd like to meet new people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象聚会上主动走向人群聊天，把这个场景与“社交、与人交往”相连。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To intentionally end one's own life.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有意结束自己的生命。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It temm ħajtek stess b'mod intenzjonat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自杀；有意结束自己的生命。

collocations.en: a person who died by suicide
died by suicide during a crisis

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jgħid li r-raġel ssuwiċida, iżda ma jagħtix dettalji oħra.
formal.en: The report states that the man died by suicide but gives no further details.
formal.zh: 报告称该男子自杀身亡，但未提供其他细节。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'ssuwiċida' f'dan l-artiklu? Lara: Tfisser li persuna temmet ħajjitha stess.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'ssuwiċida' mean in this article? Lara: It means that a person ended their own life.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这篇文章里的“ssuwiċida”是什么意思？拉拉：意思是一个人结束了自己的生命。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的“ssuwiċida”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'ssuwiċida' mean in this article?

messages.speaker: Lara (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li persuna temmet ħajjitha stess.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li persuna temmet ħajjitha stess.
messages.zh: 意思是一个人结束了自己的生命。
messages.en: It means that a person ended their own life.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它作为严肃报道中的动词记忆，核心意思是“结束自己的生命”，用中性释义帮助辨认。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put forward an idea, plan, or possible action for someone to consider.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 提出一个想法、计划或可采取的行动，供别人考虑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tipproponi idea, pjan jew azzjoni possibbli biex xi ħadd jikkunsidraha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 建议；提出供人考虑的想法或做法。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat issuġerixxa li l-iskola testendi l-ħinijiet tal-librerija.
formal.en: The committee suggested that the school extend the library's opening hours.
formal.zh: 委员会建议学校延长图书馆的开放时间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ssuġerixxa Mark għall-ikla? Lara: Issuġerixxa li nagħmlu l-għaġin. Maja: Tajjeb, mela nagħmlu hekk.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did Mark suggest for the meal? Lara: He suggested that we make pasta. Maja: Good, let's do that then.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克建议这顿饭吃什么？拉拉：他建议我们做意面。玛雅：好，那就这么办。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 马克建议这顿饭吃什么？
messages.en: What did Mark suggest for the meal?

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 他建议我们做意面。
messages.en: He suggested that we make pasta.

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 好，那就这么办。
messages.en: Good, let's do that then.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友提出“今晚做意面”的点子，把这个词记成“提出一个让大家考虑的建议”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone or something undergo a process or condition, or to bring someone under control.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人或事物经受某种过程或处境，或使某人受到控制、被制服。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tqiegħed lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa taħt proċess jew kundizzjoni, jew iġġib lil xi ħadd taħt kontroll.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使经受；使受制于；制服、使屈服。

formal.mt: Il-laboratorju ssuġġetta l-materjal għal serje ta' testijiet qabel l-użu tiegħu.
formal.en: The laboratory subjected the material to a series of tests before it was used.
formal.zh: 实验室在材料投入使用前对其进行了一系列测试。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark għadu ma għażilx il-materjal? Lara: Għax ssuġġetta kull kampjun għal test ieħor.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why hasn't Mark chosen the material yet? Lara: Because he subjected each sample to another test.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克怎么还没选好材料？拉拉：因为他又对每个样品做了一次测试。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark għadu ma għażilx il-materjal?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark għadu ma għażilx il-materjal?
messages.zh: 马克怎么还没选好材料？
messages.en: Why hasn't Mark chosen the material yet?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ssuġġetta kull kampjun għal test ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ssuġġetta kull kampjun għal test ieħor.
messages.zh: 因为他又对每个样品做了一次测试。
messages.en: Because he subjected each sample to another test.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“置于某种作用或控制之下”记忆：材料经受测试，对手则被制服；留意后接的对象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To change from one option, setting, activity, or system to another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从一个选项、设置、活动或系统切换到另一个。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tgħaddi minn għażla, issettjar, attività jew sistema għal oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 切换；转换到另一选项、状态或系统。

collocations.en: switched from one system to another
collocations.zh: 从一个系统切换到了另一个系统

formal.mt: L-uffiċċju sswiċċja għal sistema ġdida biex jipproċessa l-applikazzjonijiet.
formal.en: The office switched to a new system for processing applications.
formal.zh: 该办公室改用了新系统来处理申请。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex m'għadniex naraw il-film? Mark: Sswiċċjajt għal kanal ieħor bi żball. Maja: Erġa' lura għall-kanal ta' qabel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why aren't we watching the film anymore? Mark: I switched to another channel by mistake. Maja: Go back to the previous channel.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：怎么不放刚才那部电影了？马克：我不小心换到别的频道了。玛雅：换回刚才的频道吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 怎么不放刚才那部电影了？
messages.en: Why aren't we watching the film anymore?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sswiċċjajt għal kanal ieħor bi żball.
messages.mt_standard: Sswiċċjajt għal kanal ieħor bi żball.
messages.zh: 我不小心换到别的频道了。
messages.en: I switched to another channel by mistake.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 换回刚才的频道吧。
messages.en: Go back to the previous channel.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象按遥控器从一个频道跳到另一个频道，把“切换”与这个具体动作一起记住。

gloss_zh: 被撞击；被猛地关上；摔倒；昏倒

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be banged or slammed, to fall to the ground, or to faint, according to the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 依语境表示被撞击、被猛地关上、摔倒在地或昏倒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tintlaqat jew tingħalaq b'saħħa; taqa' mal-art jew tintilef minn sensik, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被撞击；受到猛烈碰撞。
被猛地摔上或关上；被用力摔碰。
摔倒在地；跌落到地面。
昏倒；暂时失去知觉。

collocations.en: the door slammed in the wind

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem żelaq fuq l-art imxarrba u stabat mal-art.
formal.en: The worker slipped on the wet floor and fell to the ground.
formal.zh: 工人在湿滑的地面上滑了一下，摔倒在地。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'kien dak il-ħoss? Mark: Il-bieb stabat mar-riħ. Maja: Ħsibt li waqa' xi ħadd!
colloquial.en: Maja: What was that noise? Mark: The door slammed in the wind. Maja: I thought someone had fallen!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：刚才是什么声音？马克：门被风猛地关上了。玛雅：我还以为有人摔倒了！

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 刚才是什么声音？
messages.en: What was that noise?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 门被风猛地关上了。
messages.en: The door slammed in the wind.

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 我还以为有人摔倒了！
messages.en: I thought someone had fallen!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“突然一下”的情景辅助记忆：物体可能撞响或猛关，人可能摔倒或昏倒；具体意思须看上下文。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place or organization where a business or another organized activity operates.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经营商业业务或开展其他有组织活动的场所或机构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post jew organizzazzjoni fejn jitmexxa negozju jew issir attività organizzata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 营业场所；经营单位；机构。

formal.mt: L-ispetturi żaru l-istabbiliment tal-ikel biex jeżaminaw il-kundizzjonijiet tal-iġjene.
formal.en: The inspectors visited the food establishment to examine hygiene conditions.
formal.zh: 检查人员走访了该餐饮营业场所，检查卫生状况。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Taf xi post tajjeb fejn nieklu? Mark: Iva, hemm stabbiliment żgħir ħdejn il-pjazza li jagħmel soppa tajba ħafna. Maja: Mela mmorru hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you know a good place to eat? Mark: Yes, there's a small establishment near the square that makes very good soup. Maja: Let's go there then.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你知道有什么吃饭的好地方吗？马克：知道，广场旁边有家小店，汤做得很好。玛雅：那我们就去那里吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taf xi post tajjeb fejn nieklu?
messages.mt_standard: Taf xi post tajjeb fejn nieklu?
messages.zh: 你知道有什么吃饭的好地方吗？
messages.en: Do you know a good place to eat?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm stabbiliment żgħir ħdejn il-pjazza li jagħmel soppa tajba ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm stabbiliment żgħir ħdejn il-pjazza li jagħmel soppa tajba ħafna.
messages.zh: 知道，广场旁边有家小店，汤做得很好。
messages.en: Yes, there's a small establishment near the square that makes very good soup.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我们就去那里吧。
messages.en: Let's go there then.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象广场旁一家有固定店面、持续营业的小店，把这个名词记成“开展经营或活动的场所”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To create or formally put in place an organisation, rule, system, or arrangement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 建立组织、制度或安排，或正式确立规则。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħloq jew iwaqqaf organizzazzjoni, sistema jew arranġament, jew jistabbilixxi regoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 建立；设立；确立

formal.mt: Il-kumitat stabbilixxa proċedura ġdida biex jevalwa l-applikazzjonijiet.
formal.en: The committee established a new procedure for evaluating applications.
formal.zh: 委员会制定了评估申请的新程序。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min stabbilixxa dawn ir-regoli? Mark: Il-kowċ, biex kulħadd ikun jaf x'għandu jagħmel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who established these rules? Mark: The coach, so everyone knows what to do.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些规则是谁定的？马克：教练定的，好让大家都知道该做什么。

messages.speaker: Maja (队员)
messages.zh: 这些规则是谁定的？
messages.en: Who established these rules?

messages.speaker: Mark (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kowċ, biex kulħadd ikun jaf x'għandu jagħmel.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kowċ, biex kulħadd ikun jaf x'għandu jagħmel.
messages.zh: 教练定的，好让大家都知道该做什么。
messages.en: The coach, so everyone knows what to do.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它联想到把规则正式写上公告板：从没有规则到确立规则，记住核心是“建立、确立”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something steady or bring it into a condition with fewer changes or fluctuations.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某事物变得平稳，减少变化、波动或不稳定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa aktar soda jew iġibha fi stat b'inqas tibdil u taqlib.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使稳定；使恢复平稳

formal.mt: L-intervent tat-tabib stabbilizza l-kundizzjoni tal-pazjent.
formal.en: The doctor's intervention stabilized the patient's condition.
formal.zh: 医生的干预稳定了患者的病情。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-prezz għadu jitla' u jinżel? Mark: Le, il-ftehim il-ġdid stabbilizza l-prezz.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the price still going up and down? Mark: No, the new agreement stabilized the price.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：价格还在忽高忽低吗？马克：没有了，新协议把价格稳定下来了。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 价格还在忽高忽低吗？
messages.en: Is the price still going up and down?

messages.speaker: Mark (店主)
messages.zh: 没有了，新协议把价格稳定下来了。
messages.en: No, the new agreement stabilized the price.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一条上下波动的价格线被调成平线：这个动词强调“使它变稳定”的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of making something stable or bringing fluctuations under control.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使事物趋于稳定、让波动得到控制的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa ssir aktar soda jew it-taqlib tagħha jinġieb taħt kontroll.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 稳定化；使稳定的过程

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi miżuri għall-istabbilizzazzjoni tal-prezzijiet tal-ikel.
formal.en: The report describes measures for the stabilisation of food prices.
formal.zh: 报告说明了稳定食品价格的措施。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-prezzijiet m'għadhomx jinbidlu kuljum? Mark: Il-miżuri ta' stabbilizzazzjoni qed jgħinu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why aren't prices changing every day anymore? Mark: The stabilisation measures are helping.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：价格怎么不再天天变了？马克：稳定措施正在起作用。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 价格怎么不再天天变了？
messages.en: Why aren't prices changing every day anymore?

messages.speaker: Mark (店主)
messages.zh: 稳定措施正在起作用。
messages.en: The stabilisation measures are helping.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“稳定化”想成一段影片：价格从波动走向平稳。这个名词着重整个变化过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality or condition of remaining steady, secure, and unlikely to change suddenly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 保持平稳、牢固或可靠，不容易突然变化的性质或状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità jew il-qagħda ta' xi ħaġa soda, sigura u li ma tinbidilx f'daqqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 稳定；稳定性；稳固性

formal.mt: L-istabbiltà finanzjarja tal-organizzazzjoni tiddependi fuq dħul regolari.
formal.en: The organisation's financial stability depends on regular income.
formal.zh: 该组织的财务稳定依赖于持续的收入。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għażilt dan ix-xogħol? Mark: Għax jagħtini aktar stabbiltà u paga regolari.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you choose this job? Mark: Because it gives me more stability and regular pay.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么选这份工作？马克：因为它让我更安稳，而且工资按时发。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么选这份工作？
messages.en: Why did you choose this job?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jagħtini aktar stabbiltà u paga regolari.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jagħtini aktar stabbiltà u paga regolari.
messages.zh: 因为它让我更安稳，而且工资按时发。
messages.en: Because it gives me more stability and regular pay.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张四脚平稳的桌子：这里说的是它具有的“稳定性”，区别于让它变稳的过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Steady, secure, or unlikely to change suddenly or become unbalanced.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 平稳、稳固或可靠的，不容易突然变化或失去平衡的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sod, sigur jew li ma jinbidilx f'daqqa u ma jitlifx il-bilanċ malajr.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 稳定的；平稳的；稳固的
不动产；房地产

formal.mt: L-aġenzija tispeċjalizza fil-bejgħ ta' stabbli.
formal.en: The agency specialises in the sale of real estate.
formal.zh: 这家中介机构专门从事不动产销售。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-mejda jitbandal? Mark: Le, huwa stabbli ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this table wobble? Mark: No, it is very stable.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这张桌子会晃吗？马克：不会，它很稳。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这张桌子会晃吗？
messages.en: Does this table wobble?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.zh: 不会，它很稳。
messages.en: No, it is very stable.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做两张学习卡分别记词性：形容词卡画稳固的桌子，名词卡画待售房产，避免混淆两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having enough money to live comfortably without financial difficulty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经济条件宽裕，能够舒适生活而不受钱财困扰的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu biżżejjed flus biex jgħix komdu mingħajr diffikultajiet finanzjarji.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 富裕的；经济宽裕的；生活优裕的

formal.mt: L-istudju jqabbel l-infiq ta' familji stabene ma' dak ta' familji bi dħul baxx.
formal.en: The study compares the spending of well-off families with that of low-income families.
formal.zh: 这项研究比较了富裕家庭与低收入家庭的支出。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-familja ta' Lara hi stabene? Mark: Iva, għandhom biżżejjed flus biex jgħixu komdi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is Lara's family well-off? Mark: Yes, they have enough money to live comfortably.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：拉拉家经济宽裕吗？马克：是的，他们有足够的钱，日子过得很舒适。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 拉拉家经济宽裕吗？
messages.en: Is Lara's family well-off?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandhom biżżejjed flus biex jgħixu komdi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandhom biżżejjed flus biex jgħixu komdi.
messages.zh: 是的，他们有足够的钱，日子过得很舒适。
messages.en: Yes, they have enough money to live comfortably.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想一个家庭付完日常账单仍有余钱：记住它形容经济宽裕，而不只是心情愉快。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To engage someone to do work in return for payment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以支付报酬的方式雇用某人完成工作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqabbad lil xi ħadd biex jagħmel xogħol bi ħlas.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 雇用；聘请

formal.mt: Id-direttur staġar ħaddiem ieħor biex jgħin fit-tlestija tal-proġett.
formal.en: The director hired another worker to help complete the project.
formal.zh: 主管又雇用了一名工人，协助完成项目。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jgħinna fil-ħanut? Mark: Missieri staġar ħaddiem ġdid.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is going to help us in the shop? Mark: My father hired a new worker.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁来帮我们照看店里？马克：我爸爸雇了一名新员工。

messages.speaker: Maja (店员)
messages.zh: 谁来帮我们照看店里？
messages.en: Who is going to help us in the shop?

messages.speaker: Mark (店主的儿子)
messages.zh: 我爸爸雇了一名新员工。
messages.en: My father hired a new worker.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象店主递出工资，新员工开始工作：把“付报酬请人做事”的画面与这个动词一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To stop developing, progressing, or showing useful activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 停止发展或推进，陷入缺少进展的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieqaf jiżviluppa jew javvanza u jibqa' mingħajr progress.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 停滞；停止发展；陷于停顿

formal.mt: Il-proġett staġna għal diversi xhur minħabba nuqqas ta' fondi.
formal.en: The project stagnated for several months because of a lack of funds.
formal.zh: 由于资金不足，项目停滞了数月。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sejjer il-proġett? Mark: Staġna ftit, għax għadna nistennew il-materjal.
colloquial.en: Maja: How is the project going? Mark: It has stalled a little because we are still waiting for the materials.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：项目进展怎么样？马克：有点停滞了，因为我们还在等材料。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 项目进展怎么样？
messages.en: How is the project going?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Staġna ftit, għax għadna nistennew il-materjal.
messages.mt_standard: Staġna ftit, għax għadna nistennew il-materjal.
messages.zh: 有点停滞了，因为我们还在等材料。
messages.en: It has stalled a little because we are still waiting for the materials.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象项目进度条一直卡在同一位置：它表达没有继续发展的“停滞”，而不是已经完成。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A country and archipelago in the Atlantic Ocean off Central Africa, officially the Democratic Republic of São Tomé and Príncipe.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于中部非洲近海大西洋上的国家和群岛，正式国名为圣多美和普林西比民主共和国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż u arċipelagu fl-Oċean Atlantiku qrib l-Afrika Ċentrali, bl-isem uffiċjali Repubblika Demokratika ta' São Tomé u Príncipe.

sense_translations.en_definition: São Tomé and Príncipe (a country and archipelago of Central Africa in the Atlantic Ocean; official name: Repubblika Demokratika ta’ São Tomé u Príncipe)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 圣多美和普林西比，中部非洲位于大西洋上的国家和群岛；正式国名为圣多美和普林西比民主共和国。

collocations.mt: ir-Repubblika Demokratika ta' São Tomé u Príncipe
collocations.en: the Democratic Republic of São Tomé and Príncipe
collocations.zh: 圣多美和普林西比民主共和国

collocations.mt: il-gżejjer ta' São Tomé u Príncipe
collocations.en: the islands of São Tomé and Príncipe
collocations.zh: 圣多美和普林西比的岛屿

formal.mt: São Tomé u Príncipe huwa pajjiż u arċipelagu fl-Oċean Atlantiku qrib l-Afrika Ċentrali.
formal.en: São Tomé and Príncipe is a country and archipelago in the Atlantic Ocean off Central Africa.
formal.zh: 圣多美和普林西比是位于中部非洲近海大西洋上的国家和群岛。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn jinsab São Tomé u Príncipe? Toni: Fl-Oċean Atlantiku, qrib l-Afrika Ċentrali.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is São Tomé and Príncipe? Toni: In the Atlantic Ocean, off Central Africa.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：圣多美和普林西比在哪里？托尼：在大西洋上，靠近中部非洲。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn jinsab São Tomé u Príncipe?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn jinsab São Tomé u Príncipe?
messages.zh: 圣多美和普林西比在哪里？
messages.en: Where is São Tomé and Príncipe?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.zh: 在大西洋上，靠近中部非洲。
messages.en: In the Atlantic Ocean, off Central Africa.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分成“São Tomé＋u＋Príncipe”三段记忆，中间的 u 表示“和”；再配一张非洲近海群岛图，记住完整国名和位置。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A shrub or small tree; a diminutive form of siġra.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一株灌木或小树，是 siġra 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arbuxxell jew siġra żgħira; forma diminuttiva ta' siġra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 灌木；小树，词形上是 siġra 的指小形式。

formal.mt: Il-pjan tal-ġnien juri sġajra ħdejn id-daħla u żewġ siġriet kbar fuq wara.
formal.en: The garden plan shows a shrub beside the entrance and two large trees at the back.
formal.zh: 花园规划图在入口旁标出了一株小灌木，在后方标出了两棵大树。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Fejn inpoġġu din is-sġajra? Ġanni: Ħdejn il-ħajt, fejn hemm post biżżejjed.
colloquial.en: Marta: Where shall we put this shrub? Ġanni: Beside the wall, where there's enough space.
colloquial.zh: Marta：这株小灌木放在哪里？Ġanni：放在墙边吧，那里空间够。

messages.speaker: Marta (园艺爱好者)
messages.zh: 这株小灌木放在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall we put this shrub?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn il-ħajt, fejn hemm post biżżejjed.
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn il-ħajt, fejn hemm post biżżejjed.
messages.zh: 放在墙边吧，那里空间够。
messages.en: Beside the wall, where there's enough space.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 siġra“树”和 sġajra“小灌木”并排记，脑中把大树缩小成一株灌木。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cloud or clouds, considered collectively as masses of tiny water drops or ice crystals in the sky.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由微小水滴或冰晶组成、悬浮在天空中的云，常用于整体描述云层。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qtar żgħir tal-ilma jew kristalli tas-silġ miġbura f'mases fis-sema, meqjusa flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 云；云朵；统称天空中的云层。

formal.mt: Matul wara nofsinhar, sħab skur għatta s-sema fuq il-gżira.
formal.en: During the afternoon, dark clouds covered the sky over the island.
formal.zh: 下午，乌云覆盖了岛屿上空。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara kemm hemm sħab skur! Mark: Nieħu l-umbrella miegħi, għal li jista' jkun.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at all those dark clouds! Mark: I'll take my umbrella with me, just in case.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看，天上那么多乌云！马克：我带上雨伞，以防万一。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看，天上那么多乌云！
messages.en: Look at all those dark clouds!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nieħu l-umbrella miegħi, għal li jista' jkun.
messages.mt_standard: Nieħu l-umbrella miegħi, għal li jista' jkun.
messages.zh: 我带上雨伞，以防万一。
messages.en: I'll take my umbrella with me, just in case.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看整片天空时记 sħab：把许多云朵连成一片云层，帮助记住它的集合用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A single visible mass of tiny water drops or ice crystals floating in the sky.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 悬浮在天空中、由微小水滴或冰晶组成的一朵云。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Massa waħda viżibbli ta' qtar żgħir tal-ilma jew kristalli tas-silġ fis-sema.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 云；一朵云。

formal.mt: Sħaba kbira għattiet ix-xemx għal ftit minuti.
formal.en: A large cloud covered the sun for a few minutes.
formal.zh: 一朵大云遮住了太阳几分钟。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dik is-sħaba tidher qisha kelb! Rita: Veru, u dik ta' ħdejha qisha dgħajsa.
colloquial.en: Nina: That cloud looks like a dog! Rita: It does, and the one beside it looks like a boat.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：那朵云看起来像一只狗！丽塔：真像，旁边那朵还像一条船。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.zh: 那朵云看起来像一只狗！
messages.en: That cloud looks like a dog!

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, u dik ta' ħdejha qisha dgħajsa.
messages.mt_standard: Veru, u dik ta' ħdejha qisha dgħajsa.
messages.zh: 真像，旁边那朵还像一条船。
messages.en: It does, and the one beside it looks like a boat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用手指单独指出一朵云，念 sħaba；同时把 sħaba bajda 整组记成“一朵白云”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small cloud; the diminutive form of sħaba.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 体积较小的一朵云，是 sħaba 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sħaba żgħira; il-forma diminuttiva ta' sħaba.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small cloud (the diminutive form of 'sħaba')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一小朵云，是 sħaba 的指小形式。

formal.mt: Fis-sema ċar dehret sħajba bajda waħda fuq l-għolja.
formal.en: In the clear sky, a single small white cloud appeared above the hill.
formal.zh: 晴朗的天空中，山丘上方出现了一小朵白云。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara dik is-sħajba fuq id-dar! Pawlu: Rajtha; tidher qisha qalb żgħira.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look at that little cloud above the house! Pawlu: I see it; it looks like a little heart.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：看房子上方的那一小朵云！保罗：看到了，它像一颗小爱心。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 看房子上方的那一小朵云！
messages.en: Look at that little cloud above the house!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 看到了，它像一颗小爱心。
messages.en: I see it; it looks like a little heart.

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排画一朵普通云和一朵迷你云：普通云标 sħaba，小云标 sħajba，成对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fairly strong or sturdy, with a softened degree of strength.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示颇为强壮、结实或有力，语气比直接说“强壮”稍轻。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu saħħa mhux ħażina; pjuttost b'saħħtu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 颇强壮的；挺有力的（sħiħ 的指小形式）。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-bidwi huwa raġel sħajjaħ li jgħin lill-ġirien fix-xogħol tal-għelieqi.
formal.en: In the story, the farmer is a fairly strong man who helps his neighbours with work in the fields.
formal.zh: 在这个故事里，农夫是个颇强壮的男人，会帮助邻居干田里的活。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ħuk jista' jgħinna nġorru din il-mejda? Pawlu: Iva, huwa sħajjaħ u jista' jgħinna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can your brother help us carry this table? Pawlu: Yes, he is fairly strong and can help us.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你哥哥能帮我们搬这张桌子吗？保罗：可以，他挺有力气，能帮我们。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħuk jista' jgħinna nġorru din il-mejda?
messages.mt_standard: Ħuk jista' jgħinna nġorru din il-mejda?
messages.zh: 你哥哥能帮我们搬这张桌子吗？
messages.en: Can your brother help us carry this table?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa sħajjaħ u jista' jgħinna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa sħajjaħ u jista' jgħinna.
messages.zh: 可以，他挺有力气，能帮我们。
messages.en: Yes, he is fairly strong and can help us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个搬桌子挺有力的人，用“颇强壮”记住语气，不必夸成力大无穷。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Slightly warm, with a mild degree of heat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 温度略高，摸起来或喝起来有一点暖意。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ftit sħana; xi ftit sħun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有点暖的；微温的。

formal.mt: Għal din it-taħlita, uża ilma sħajjen u ħawwad bil-mod.
formal.en: For this mixture, use slightly warm water and stir slowly.
formal.zh: 调配这份混合物时，使用微温的水并慢慢搅拌。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-ħalib għadu jaħraq? Rita: Le, issa sħajjen. Tista' tixorbu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is the milk still hot? Rita: No, it is only slightly warm now. You can drink it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：牛奶还烫吗？丽塔：不烫了，现在只是温温的，可以喝了。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.zh: 牛奶还烫吗？
messages.en: Is the milk still hot?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.zh: 不烫了，现在只是温温的，可以喝了。
messages.en: No, it is only slightly warm now. You can drink it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一杯放凉后仍带暖意的牛奶，把这个词与“温温的、不烫嘴”联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of crushing something; also, insistence on a particular point.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指把东西压碎的行为；也可指坚持某个论点或反复强调某一点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil ta' tgħaffiġ jew tkissir bil-pressjoni; ukoll, insistenza fuq punt partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 压碎；碾碎。
对某个论点的坚持；对某一点的反复强调。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi s-sħiq tal-ġebel qabel ma l-materjal jintuża fil-kostruzzjoni.
formal.en: The report describes the crushing of stone before the material is used in construction.
formal.zh: 报告描述了石料用于建筑之前的破碎过程。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dan is-sħiq kollu fuq il-ħin? Mark: Għax irridu nibdew fil-ħin biex kulħadd ikun jista' jitlaq kmieni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why all this insistence on the time? Mark: Because we need to start on time so everyone can leave early.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么这么坚持时间这一点？马克：因为我们得准时开始，大家才能早点离开。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan is-sħiq kollu fuq il-ħin?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan is-sħiq kollu fuq il-ħin?
messages.zh: 为什么这么坚持时间这一点？
messages.en: Why all this insistence on the time?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax irridu nibdew fil-ħin biex kulħadd ikun jista' jitlaq kmieni.
messages.mt_standard: Għax irridu nibdew fil-ħin biex kulħadd ikun jista' jitlaq kmieni.
messages.zh: 因为我们得准时开始，大家才能早点离开。
messages.en: Because we need to start on time so everyone can leave early.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张学习卡分别记“压碎石头”和“坚持论点”，帮助区分实物动作与表达态度。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of directing curses at someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指针对某人说出咒骂或诅咒话语的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil ta' min jisħet lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 咒骂某人；对某人发出诅咒。

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tad-djalogu, l-awtriċi tispjega kif is-sħit kontra l-ġar juri r-rabja tal-karattru.
formal.en: In her analysis of the dialogue, the author explains how the cursing directed at the neighbour reveals the character's anger.
formal.zh: 作者在分析对话时解释道，针对邻居的咒骂表现出了这个人物的愤怒。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex tlaqt minn ħdejn dawk it-tnejn? Toni: Għax bdew bis-sħit kontra xulxin, u ma ridtx nibqa' nismagħhom.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you walk away from those two? Toni: Because they started cursing each other, and I did not want to keep listening.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么从那两个人旁边走开了？托尼：因为他们开始互相咒骂，我不想继续听。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tlaqt minn ħdejn dawk it-tnejn?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tlaqt minn ħdejn dawk it-tnejn?
messages.zh: 你为什么从那两个人旁边走开了？
messages.en: Why did you walk away from those two?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax bdew bis-sħit kontra xulxin, u ma ridtx nibqa' nismagħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Għax bdew bis-sħit kontra xulxin, u ma ridtx nibqa' nismagħhom.
messages.zh: 因为他们开始互相咒骂，我不想继续听。
messages.en: Because they started cursing each other, and I did not want to keep listening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把场景定为两个人互相咒骂，记住这个名词指咒骂行为本身。
